units.la: ANno hujus seculi octuagesimo edidi per disputationem SPECIMEN aliquod novi Lexici Hebraici Biblici, ad mo-dum Lexici Schreveliani Græci composi-tum. Idem illud SPECIMEN, paulo auctius, altera vice in lucem emisi anno octuagesimo tertio; illudque addidi CLAVI HEBRAICÆ Ve-teris Testamenti, addita præfatione, in quâ allego causas suscepti hujus Operis; & simul quemvis invito ad hoc opus, à me ita inchoatum, continuan-dum & perficiendum. Animus non erat illud novum Lexicon brevi edere; sed sperabam me per ta-lem invitationem liberatum iri ab illo immenso labore tale Lexicon conficiendi; quod ex parte non caruit bono successu. Scribebat mihi die VI. Aprilis anno 1686 maximi Patris patrissans filius, D. Joh. Henricus Hottingerus, linguarum Orientalium in Illustri Schola Tigurina Professor, se velle tale Lexicon novum, quale ego conceperam, componere & edete ; si modo hic in Belgio Typographus aliquis inve-niretur, cui maximus esset opus hoc compositum luci publicæ exponere. Antequam clarissimo D. Hottingero responderem, ecce Typographus aliquis Anglus apportat ex Anglia Opus præstantissimum & laboriosissimum, à celeberrimo Viro D. Guljelmo Robertsono compositum, nominatum LEXICON CONCORDANTIALE Hebræo-Latino-Biblicum; opus valde laudandum, in quo Concordantiæ Buxtorfii & pleraque Lexica Hebraica continentur. In hoc Concordantiale Lexicon idem Clarissimus D. Robertsonus triennio post, scil. anno 1683. INDICEM ALPHABETICUM Hebræo-Biblicum, constantem circiter undecim foliis, conscripsit; ex quo jam composui hoc novum Lexicon Hebraicum ad modum Lexici Schrevelia-ni Græci, constans circiter triginta foliis. Si D. Robertsonus hunc Indicem plerarumque vocum Hebraicarum Veteris Testamenti non edidisset, & viam commodam perficiendi hoc Lexicon præparasset, non facile hoc Lexicon in publicum emisissem.
units.tr: In the year 1680 I published, by way of a disputation, a specimen of a new Biblical Hebrew Lexicon, composed after the manner of the Greek Lexicon of Schrevelius. I brought out the same specimen again in 1683, a little enlarged, and added to it the Clavis Hebraica of the Old Testament, with a preface in which I set out the reasons for undertaking this work, and at the same time I invite anyone to continue and complete this work, which I have thus begun. I did not intend to publish the new Lexicon soon; but I hoped that by such an invitation I would be freed from the immense labour of compiling such a Lexicon, and this hope has not been wholly without success. On 6 April 1686 the son of the great father, who imitates his father, Mr. Johann Heinrich Hottinger, Professor of Oriental Languages at the Illustrious School of Zurich, wrote to me that he was willing to compose and publish such a new Lexicon as I had conceived, if only some printer could be found here in the Netherlands who would be willing to bring this completed work before the public. Before I could reply to the most distinguished Hottinger, behold, an English printer brought from England a most excellent and laborious work, composed by the most celebrated man Mr. William Robertson, entitled Lexicon Concordantiale Hebraeo-Latino-Biblicum: a work deserving of high praise, in which the Concordances of Buxtorf and most of the Hebrew Lexicons are contained. In this Concordance-Lexicon the same most distinguished Mr. Robertson, three years later, namely in 1683, wrote an alphabetical index of the Hebrew Biblical words, of about eleven sheets; and from this index I have now composed this new Hebrew Lexicon after the manner of the Greek Lexicon of Schrevelius, of about thirty sheets. If Mr. Robertson had not published this index of most of the Hebrew words of the Old Testament, and prepared a convenient way of completing this Lexicon, I would not easily have brought this Lexicon out to the public.

units.la: In hoc Indice omnes fere voces totius Veteris Test. regulares, irregulares, defectivæ & quiescentes ad proprias suas Radices reducuntur. Jam ubique additur Versio Latina, quæ quasi anima est illius Indicis; etiam allegantur varii Textus Biblici, continentes voces irregulares & valde anomalas, quæ jam facile hic inquiri possunt. Abhinc multis annis incitatus eram sæpissime à multis tum per literas, tum etiam coràm ad Lexicon tale, more Schreveliano , componendum ; sed absterrebat me semper à tali Lexico infinitus & immensus labor , quem scie-bam primò in Indice componendo esse adhibendum. Verum , viso hoc Indice , cum in mentem revoca-rem maximam utilitatem talis Lexici ; & me jam posse executioni mandare , quod à multis annis in animo meo conceperam , non potui non operi tam uti-lissimo statim manum admovere. Hoc Lexicon , non concernens hanc vel illam religionem , inserviet cujusvis professionis hominibus ; etiam omnibus Na-tionibus : nam Galli , Angli , Hispani , Itali , Belgæ aliique , modo linguam Latinam noverint , poterunt uti hoc Lexico. Etiam cujuscunque fue-rint facultatis , sive Theologi, sive Jurisconsulti , sive Medici, sive Philosophi fuerint, experientur magnam utilitatem in hoc Lexico , modo à limine salutarint hanc linguam. Voces enim Biblicæ ita hic proponuntur, uti ea extant in Bibliis ; addun-tur Tempora, Genera, Personæ, Numeri, Con-jugationes; etiam Radices, quæ sæpè respectu quarundam vocum difficulter investigantur. Voces ir-regulares, quales multæ extant in Textu Hebræo, hic sæpissime ad regularem formam reducuntur ; additis locis Sacræ Scripturæ , ubi ea inveniuntur. Nervosum est hoc Lexicon, & paucissimis literis ac vocibus plurima hic denotantur: nam hic sunt plu-rimæ abbreviaturæ ; & literæ , quæ integras voces denotant, clarè mox explicantur. In omnibus etiam respectu significationis Latinæ , brevitatem observavimus : nam omnes fere voces , exceptis He-
units.tr: In this index almost all the words of the whole Old Testament, regular, irregular, defective and quiescent, are reduced to their proper roots. Everywhere a Latin version is added, which is as it were the soul of that index; also various Biblical texts are cited, containing irregular and very anomalous words, which can now easily be looked up here. For many years I have been very often urged by many people, both by letter and in person, to compose such a Lexicon in the manner of Schrevelius; but an infinite and immense labour, which I knew had to be undertaken first in compiling the index, always deterred me from such a Lexicon. Yet, having seen this index, and calling to mind the very great usefulness of such a Lexicon, and seeing that I could now carry into effect what I had long conceived in my mind, I could not but immediately apply my hand to a work so useful. This Lexicon, not concerned with this or that religion, will serve men of every profession, and of all nations: for the French, English, Spanish, Italians, Dutch and others, provided they know the Latin language, will be able to use this Lexicon. And whatever their faculty, whether they are theologians, jurists, physicians or philosophers, they will experience great usefulness in this Lexicon, provided they have saluted this language from the threshold. For the Biblical words are set forth here just as they stand in the Bible; the tenses, genders, persons, numbers and conjugations are added; also the roots, which are often difficult to track down with respect to certain words. The irregular words, of which many occur in the Hebrew text, are here for the most part reduced to their regular form, with the places of Holy Scripture where they are found added. This Lexicon is concise, and very many things are indicated here with very few letters and words: for there are very many abbreviations here; and the letters which stand for whole words are soon clearly explained. In all things, also with respect to the Latin meaning, we have observed brevity: for almost all words, except the Hebrew...

units.la: PRÆFATIO.
units.tr: PREFACE.

units.la: Hebraicis & Versione Latina, abbreviatè, ut vi-liori pretio comparari posset, proponuntur. Cum prima vice hic Index celeberrimi D. Robertsoni in Urbem nostram inferretur, omnes, qui Indicem illum Hebraicum videbant, uno quasi ore eum approbabant; sed omnes Versionem Latinam in eo desiderabant, eique Animadversiones quasdam unà cum Textibus, continentibus voces anomalas, adjiciendas judicabant. Imo Amstelodamenses Typographi, videntes primò hunc Indicem Hebraicum, propter præstantiam Operis, illum tali modo sine addita versione Latina, quæ tamen anima hujus Lexici est, simpliciter impressissent, si non prævenissem.
units.tr: are presented in abbreviated form, in the Hebrew and in the Latin translation, so that the work might be obtained at a lower price. When this Index of the most celebrated Dr. Robertson was first brought into our city, all who saw that Hebrew Index approved it with one voice; but all of them missed a Latin translation in it, and they thought that some remarks should be added to it, together with the texts containing the anomalous words. Indeed, the Amsterdam printers, seeing this Hebrew Index for the first time, would have simply printed it in such a way, on account of the excellence of the work, without an added Latin translation, which nevertheless is the soul of this Lexicon, if I had not anticipated them.

units.la: Ne aliquis miretur, me hoc novum Lexicon qui-busdam disputationibus publici juris facere, illudque aliorum judicio tali modo subjicere; nam simile quid in Academiis Augustanæ Confessionis tentatum & factum est jam diu. Magnus CHRISTOPHO-RUS CRINESIUS anno hujus seculi undecimo & duodecimo in illustri Academia Wittenbergensi Lexicon suum Syriacum celeberrimum, in usum Novi Testamenti Syriaci, tredecim disputationibus, à capite ad calcem publicè defendit; ex quibus disputationibus postea conjunctis natum est præstantissimum Lexicon Syriacum Crinesii. Secundus Respondens, qui hoc Lexicon una cum aliis Studiosis defen-dit, fuit MARTINUS TROSTIUS, propter editionem Novi Testamenti Syriaci celeber-rimus.
units.tr: So that no one may wonder why I make this new lexicon public by means of certain disputations and submit it in this way to the judgment of others: a similar thing was attempted and carried out long ago in the academies of the Augsburg Confession. The great CHRISTOPHER CRINESIUS, in the eleventh and twelfth years of this century, in the famous Academy of Wittenberg, publicly defended his celebrated Syriac lexicon, for the use of the Syriac New Testament, from beginning to end in thirteen disputations; from these disputations, afterwards joined together, came the most excellent Syriac Lexicon of Crinesius. The second respondent, who defended this lexicon along with other students, was MARTIN TROST, famous for his edition of the Syriac New Testament.

units.la: Ne in hoc Lexico Hebraico aliquid desideraretur, judijudicavimus consultum & de re Studiosorum alio-rumque fore, si adderemus simile Lexicon Chaldai-cum in Danielem & Ezram. In Veteri Testamen-to extant versus Chaldaici ducenti & sexaginta octo, scil. in Daniele ducenti, in Ezra sexaginta septem, & in Jeremia versus unicus; quos omnes in lingu-am Hebraicam transtuli, & fini Philologi Graeci editionis secundae, adjeci. Hi versus in hoc indi-ce D. Robertsoni nec annotantur nec resolvuntur; sed ego omnes illos versiculos explicavi & eviscera-vi; atque ex versiculis illis explicatis & enodatis composui LEXICON CHALDÆO-BI-BLICUM, ad modum Lexici Schreveliani Graeci; quod hic in fine apposui. Nolui hic tam prolixus esse in adjiciendis Personis & Numeris Ver-borum aliisque; nam ex addita significatione Latina & Personae & Numeri Verborum aliaque multa clarissime innotescunt.
units.tr: So that nothing should be lacking in this Hebrew lexicon, we judged it advisable, and that it would be welcome to students and others, to add a similar lexicon of the Chaldee on Daniel and Ezra. In the Old Testament there are two hundred and sixty-eight Chaldee verses, namely two hundred in Daniel, sixty-seven in Ezra, and one verse in Jeremiah; all of these I have translated into Hebrew and added at the end of the second edition of the Philological Greek. These verses are neither annotated nor resolved in the index of Robertson; but I have explained and disentangled all those little verses, and from the verses so explained and unfolded I have composed a CHALDEE-BIBLICAL LEXICON, in the manner of the Greek Lexicon of Schrevelius, which I have placed here at the end. I did not wish to be so lengthy in adding the persons and numbers of the verbs and other things; for by the added Latin meaning both the person and number of the verbs and many other things become very clear.

units.la: In utroque hoc Lexico duplices abbreviaturae usurpantur, quas peperit partim celeritas scribendi, partim etiam parcitas, ne opus nimium excresceret, & nimio pretio constaret: nam si abbreviaturae illae non fuissent adhibitae, forte opus duplo majus fuisset, & pretium pro magnitudine operis etiam valde augendum; quod non fuisset è re Studiosorum. Ne igitur Lector circa abbreviaturas impingeret, ordine ea in fine hujus Praefationis recensentur.
units.tr: In both of these lexicons double abbreviations are used, which arose partly from the speed of writing and partly also from brevity, so that the work might not grow too large and cost too much; for if those abbreviations had not been employed, the work would perhaps have been twice as large, and the price would have had to be greatly increased in proportion to the size of the work, which would not have been to the advantage of students. So that the reader should not stumble over the abbreviations, they are listed in order at the end of this Preface.

Rad. בָּרַךְ benedixit. — a tender father; compounded from the noun אָב, father, root אָבָה, to be willing, and the noun רָךְ or רַךְ, tender, root רָכַךְ, to become soft; or, for הִבְרֵךְ, to bend the knees, or to kneel, imperative Hiphil or infinitive, root בָּרַךְ, to bless.

units.tr: ʾēʾēlti, "I have defiled," Isa. 63.3, first person, perfect Hiphil, with aleph for he, for hig'ʾaltī [?]; root גָּאַל. ʾăgurōt, "bundles," noun, plural feminine; root gādar, "to lay waste," or from root ʾāgar, "bundle." ʾāgô, "nut," noun, masculine and feminine; root ʾāgan. le'ăgôrat, "for a small coin," feminine, construct with prefix; noun ʾăgôrāh, "small coin," root gārad, "cut," or root ʾāgar, "gathered." ʾāgôr, "I will sojourn," etc., first person singular, future Kal, with paragogic, root gûr. ʾāgûaʿ, "I will expire," first person future Kal; root gāwaʿ. ʾāgûp, "I will strike," first person future Kal; root gānap. ʾāgēr or ʾāgîd, "I will declare," "I will declare to him," etc., first person future Hiphil with paragogic ending; root nāgar. ʾăgîlāh, "I will rejoice," first person singular future Hiphil with paragogic; root gôl. ʾāgālāh, "I will go into exile," first person future Kal; root gālāh. ʾăgālê, "drops," plural construct; noun ʾāgāl, "drop." ʾagmêhem, "their pools," masculine plural with suffix, from the masculine noun; noun ʾagam, "pool, marsh"; whence masculine plural ʾagmîm, "pools." ʾagpô, "I will strike him," first person future Kal; root nāgap. ʾagpāyw, "his hosts," ʾagpekā, "your hosts"; masculine plural noun ʾagpîm, "hosts," with suffix from the noun; root ʾagap, "wing, host." ʾōger, "gathering," masculine participle Kal; root ʾāgar. ʾogrāh, "gathers," third person feminine perfect Kal; root ʾāgar. ʾogrôf, "fist," masculine singular noun; root gārap, "rolls down." ʾagrešem, "I will drive them out," "I will drive him out," future Piel, first person singular, ʾagrēš, "I will drive out," root gārash. ʾigrōtêhem, "their letters," feminine plural with suffix; singular noun.

units.la: אוֹהֵב amans, אוֹהַבְתִּי illa
units.tr: loving [אוֹהֵב]; she, loving [אוֹהַבְתִּי].

units.la: amans, Hos.10.11. cum Jod parag, &c. Ben. Kal. f. masc. & f. fæm. אוֹהֲבַת illa amans, Rad. אָהַב.
units.tr: loving, Hos.10.11. With paragogic Yod, etc. Benoni, Qal, masculine and feminine; she, loving [אוֹהֲבַת]. Root [אָהַב].

units.la: אוֹדוֹתֶיךָ causa tui, plur. fæm. aff. No. Rad. inusit. in sing. אוֹד propter, causa.
units.tr: On your account [אוֹדוֹתֶיךָ], plural feminine with suffix; the singular is not used. Root [אוֹד], on account of, because.

units.la: אוֹדִיעַ notum faciam, הֹ nota faciam, םּ ostendam eis, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. & aff. Rad. יָדַע.
units.tr: I will make known [אוֹדִיעַ], I will make her known [הֹ], I will show them [םּ], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic and suffix. Root [יָדַע].

units.la: וָאוָּדֵעַ & notus factus sum, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָדַע.
units.tr: and I was made known [וָאוָּדֵעַ], 1st person singular future Niphal. Root [יָדַע].

units.la: אוֹחִיל exspectabo, הֹ idem, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָחַל.
units.tr: I will wait [אוֹחִיל], the same [הֹ], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic. Root [יָחַל].

units.la: אוֹחִים mustelæ, pl. m. No. Rad. אוֹחַ.
units.tr: Weasels [אוֹחִים], masculine plural noun. Root [אוֹחַ].

units.la: אוֹטַם obturavit, Ben. Kal, f. m. R. אָטַם.
units.tr: Stopped up [אוֹטַם], Benoni, Qal, feminine and masculine. Root [אָטַם].

units.la: אוֹיָה eheu, væ; part. Interject. אוֹי heu.
units.tr: Alas, woe [אוֹיָה]; interjection. Alas [אוֹי].

units.la: אוֹיִל stultus, יִם stulti, &c. No. sing. & plur. masc. Rad. אָוַל stul-
units.tr: Foolish [אוֹיִל], fools [-יִם], etc. Masculine noun, singular and plural. Root [אָוַל] be foolish-

units.la: [the text of the last line is cut at the foot of the column; see signature and catchword] tus , stultitia.
units.tr: -tus, folly.

units.la: אוֹיֵב inimicus , ים' inimici , &c. Ben. Kal , sing. & pl. masc. Rad. אָיַב inimicatus est.
units.tr: Enemy [אוֹיֵב], enemies [-ים], etc. Benoni, Qal, singular and plural masculine. Root [אָיַב] was hostile.

units.la: אוֹיְתִךְ desidero te , אוֹיְתִיהָ expetivi eam , 1. sing. præt. Piel , aff. Rad. אָוָה.
units.tr: I desire you [אוֹיְתִךְ], I have desired her [אוֹיְתִיהָ], 1st person singular preterite Piel with suffix. Root [אָוָה].

units.la: אוֹכִיחַ arguam , הֹכִיחַ arguam te , &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix. Rad. יָכַח [?].
units.tr: I will reprove [אוֹכִיחַ], I will reprove you [הֹכִיחַ], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil with suffix. Root [יָכַח] [?].

units.la: אוֹכָל , אוֹכִיל cibus, commeatus , esca , No. f. m. R. אָכַל comedit.
units.tr: Food, provisions [אוֹכָל], [אוֹכִיל], food, feminine and masculine noun. Root [אָכַל] he ate.

units.la: אוֹכֵל comedens , ים' comedentes , &c. Ben. Kal , sing. & pl. m. Rad. אָכַל.
units.tr: Eating [אוֹכֵל], eating (plural) [-ים], etc. Benoni, Qal, singular and plural masculine. Root [אָכַל].

units.la: אוֹכַל potero , הָאוֹכַל num potero , 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. יָכַל.
units.tr: I shall be able [אוֹכַל], shall I be able? [הָאוֹכַל], 1st person singular future Qal. Root [יָכַל].

units.la: אוֹלִיד gignam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. R. יָלַד.
units.tr: I will beget [אוֹלִיד], 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָלַד].

units.la: אוֹלַד nascar , 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָלַד.
units.tr: I will be born [אוֹלַד], 1st person singular future Niphal. Root [יָלַד].

units.la: אוֹלִיךְ, vel הָ אוֹלִיכָה ire faciam , ם deducam
units.tr: I will make to go [אוֹלִיךְ], or [הָ אוֹלִיכָה]; I will lead [ם]

units.la: eos, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix. & parag. Rad. יָלַךְ.
units.tr: them, etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil with suffix and paragogic. Root [יָלַךְ].

units.la: אוּלָם profecto , certè , verumtamen, part. Adverb. Rad. inusit. אוֹל.
units.tr: Indeed, certainly, nevertheless [אוּלָם], adverb. Root not in use; [אוֹל].

units.la: אוּלָם robur eorum, No. sing. m. אוֹל aff. Rad. inusit. אוֹל robur, vel Rad. אָוַל.
units.tr: Their strength [אוּלָם], masculine singular noun with suffix. Root not in use; [אוֹל] strength, or root [אָוַל].

units.la: אוּלָם porticus, No. sing. masc. R. אָלַם ligare in fasciculum.
units.tr: Portico [אוּלָם], masculine singular noun. Root [אָלַם] to bind into a bundle.

units.la: אוּלְתִּי stultitia mea, אוּלְתֵּךְ stultitia sua, No. sing. fæm. אוּלַת stultitia, aff. Rad. inusit. אָוַל.
units.tr: My folly [אוּלְתִּי], your folly [אוּלְתֵּךְ], feminine singular noun [אוּלַת] folly with suffix. Root not in use; [אָוַל].

units.la: אוֹמֵר dicens , ים' dicentes, &c. Ben. Kal, sing. & pl. m. Rad. אָמַר.
units.tr: Saying [אוֹמֵר], sayers [-ים], etc. Benoni, Qal, singular and plural masculine. Root [אָמַר].

units.la: אוֹנָךְ vanitas tua , ם' iniquitas ipsorum , No. sing. masc. אָוֶן iniquitas , aff. Rad. inusit. אוֹן.
units.tr: Your vanity [אוֹנָךְ], their iniquity [-ם], masculine singular noun [אָוֶן] iniquity with suffix. Root not in use; [אוֹן].

units.la: אוֹנָם potentia ejus, אוֹנוֹ potentia mea, ים' vires, No. sing. masc. אוֹן potentia, aff. & pl. m. Rad. inu-sit. אוֹן.
units.tr: His power [אוֹנָם], my power [אוֹנוֹ], strengths [-ים], masculine singular noun [אוֹן] power with suffix; plural masculine. Root not in use; [אוֹן].

units.la: אוֹן robur, potentia, No. sing. masc. Rad. אוֹן iniquitas.
units.tr: Strength [אוֹן], power, masculine singular noun. Root [אוֹן] iniquity.

units.la: אוֹנִים lugentes, Ben. Kal, pl. masc. R. אָנָה lugere, mærere, vel pl. masc. No. sing. אוֹן robur, Rad. inusit. אוֹן.
units.tr: Mourning [אוֹנִים], Benoni, Qal, plural masculine. Root [אָנָה] to mourn, to grieve; or plural masculine noun, singular [אוֹן] strength, root not in use [אוֹן].

units.la: אוֹנֵן plangens, mæstus, Ben. Kal, sing. m. Rad. אָנַן plangere, lugere, unde הִתְאוֹנֵן planxit, מִתְאוֹנֵן plangens, &c.
units.tr: Lamenting [אוֹנֵן], sorrowful, Benoni, Qal, singular masculine. Root [אָנַן] to lament, to mourn, whence [הִתְאוֹנֵן] he lamented, [מִתְאוֹנֵן] lamenting, etc.

units.la: אוֹסִיף addam, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. יָסַף.
units.tr: I will add [אוֹסִיף], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָסַף].

units.la: אוֹפִירָה ophir, No. f. m. parag. R. אָפֵר cinis.
units.tr: Ophir [אוֹפִירָה], feminine and masculine noun with paragogic He. Root [אָפֵר] ashes.

units.la: וָאוּסַּר & castigatus sum, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָסַר.
units.tr: And I was chastised [וָאוּסַּר], 1st person singular future Niphal. Root [יָסַר].

units.la: אִוָּעֵר conveniam, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָעַר. [?]
units.tr: I will assemble [אִוָּעֵר], 1st person singular future Niphal. Root [יָעַר] [?].

units.la: אוֹעִיל proficiam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. יָעַל.
units.tr: I will profit [אוֹעִיל], 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָעַל].

units.la: אוֹצִיאָה producam, םּ e-duxi eos, &c. vel אוֹצִיאָה educam, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. & affix. Rad. יָצָא. [?]
units.tr: I will bring forth [אוֹצִיאָה], I led them out [םּ], etc., or I will lead out [אוֹצִיאָה], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic and suffix. Root [יָצָא] [?].

units.la: אוֹצָרָה thesaurarios constituam, fut. Kal, 1. f. parag. vel pro אוֹצִירָה, 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. אָצַר. [?]
units.tr: I will appoint treasurers [אוֹצָרָה], 1st person feminine future Qal with paragogic; or for [אוֹצִירָה], 1st person feminine future Hiphil. Root [אָצַר] [?].

units.la: אוֹקִיר pretiosum faciam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. R. יָקַר.
units.tr: I will make precious [אוֹקִיר], 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָקַר].

units.la: לְאוֹר ad illustrandum, Job.33.30.Infin. Niph. præf. Rad. אוֹר.
units.tr: For illuminating [לְאוֹר], to illuminate, Job.33.30. Infinitive Niphal with prefix. Root [אוֹר].

units.la: אוֹרִי illaminati sunt, 2 Sam.14.29. præt. Kal, 3. pl. אוֹרִי illucesce, imper. Kal. sing. fæm. Rad. אוֹר.
units.tr: They were illuminated [אוֹרִי], 2 Sam.14.29. Preterite Qal, 3rd person plural. Shine! [אוֹרִי], imperative Qal, singular feminine. Root [אוֹר].

units.la: אוֹרוּ maledicite, Jud.5.23. Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. אָרַר.
units.tr: Curse [אוֹרוּ], Jud.5.23. Imperative Qal, plural masculine. Root [אָרַר].

units.la: בְּאוֹר in luce, בְּאוּרִים per urim, וְרְאוּרֶךָ & urim tui; Nom. sing. m. & pl. m. aff. R. אוֹר lucere.
units.tr: In light [בְּאוֹר], through the Urim [בְּאוּרִים], your Urim [וְרְאוּרֶךָ]; masculine singular and plural noun with suffix. Root [אוֹר] to shine.

units.la: לְאוּרוֹת per stabula, No.
units.tr: By stalls [לְאוּרוֹת], noun.

units.la: pl. fæm. Rad. אוֹר luce-re, vel אָרָה carpere.
units.tr: Plural feminine. Root [אוֹר] to shine, or [אָרָה] to pluck.

units.la: אוֹרָה lux, אוֹרוֹת olera; No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. אוֹר lucere.
units.tr: Light [אוֹרָה], vegetables [אוֹרוֹת], noun, feminine and plural feminine. Root [אוֹר] to shine.

units.la: אוֹרָה docebo, אוֹרְךָ docebo te, &c. 1. f. fut. Hiph. affix. Rad. יָרָה.
units.tr: I will teach [אוֹרָה], I will teach you [אוֹרְךָ], etc. 1st person feminine future Hiphil with suffix. Root [יָרָה].

units.la: אוֹרִי lux mea, אוֹרְךָ lux tua, אוֹרְךָ, lux tua, אוֹרָם lux eorum, אוֹרֵהוּ lux ejus, &c. sing. masc. affix. Nom. אוֹר lux, Rad. אוֹר lucere.
units.tr: My light [אוֹרִי], your light [אוֹרְךָ], your light [אוֹרְךָ], their light [אוֹרָם], his light [אוֹרֵהוּ], etc. Masculine singular with suffix. Noun [אוֹר] light, root [אוֹר] to shine.

units.la: אוֹרֵךְ urim tui, pl. m. affix. ex abs. אוֹרִים, Rad. אוֹר lucere.
units.tr: Your Urim [אוֹרֵךְ], plural masculine with suffix, from the absolute [אוֹרִים]. Root [אוֹר] to shine.

units.la: אוֹרִיד dejiciam, &c. 1. singul.fut.Hiphil, Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: I will cast down [אוֹרִיד], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָרַד].

units.la: אוֹרִישׁ expellam, &c. 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: I will drive out [אוֹרִישׁ], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָרַשׁ].

units.la: אוֹרֵר maledicens, Ben. Kal, sing. m. Rad. אָרַר.
units.tr: Cursing [אוֹרֵר], Benoni, Qal, singular masculine. Root [אָרַר].

units.la: אוֹרִישׁ pauper fiam, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: I will become poor [אוֹרִישׁ], 1st person singular future Niphal. Root [יָרַשׁ].

units.la: אוֹשִׁינְךָ sedere faciam te, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix.
units.tr: I will make you sit [אוֹשִׁינְךָ], 1st person singular future Hiphil with suffix.

units.la: Rad. יָשַׁב.
units.tr: Root [יָשַׁב].

units.la: אוֹשִׁיעַ servabo, &c. 1. singul. futur. Hiph. Rad. יָשַׁע.
units.tr: I will save [אוֹשִׁיעַ], etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָשַׁע].

units.la: אוֹשַׁעַ servabor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָשַׁע.
units.tr: I will be saved [אוֹשַׁעַ], 1st person singular future Niphal. Root [יָשַׁע].

units.la: אוֹתוֹתֵיו signa ejus, יָנוֹ signa nostra, &c. pl. fæm. aff. No. Rad. אוֹת signum, vel Rad. אָתָה advenit.
units.tr: His signs [אוֹתוֹתֵיו], our signs [יָנוֹ], etc. Feminine plural with suffix. Noun. Root [אוֹת] sign, or root [אָתָה] he came.

units.la: אוֹתִיּוֹת eventura, Ben. Kal, pl. fæm. R. אָתָה.
units.tr: Things about to come [אוֹתִיּוֹת], Benoni, Qal, plural feminine. Root [אָתָה].

units.la: אוֹת desiderium, בְּאוֹתִי in desiderio meo, &c. sing. fæm. constr. affix. No. אַוָּה desiderium, Rad. אָוָה concupiscere, Piel, אָוָה expetivit.
units.tr: Desire [אוֹת], in my desire [בְּאוֹתִי], etc. Singular feminine construct with suffix. Noun [אַוָּה] desire. Root [אָוָה] to covet; Piel [אָוָה] he longed for.

units.la: אוֹתָה expetit, præt. Piel, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. אָוָה.
units.tr: He longs [אוֹתָה], preterite Piel, 3rd person singular feminine. Root [אָוָה].

units.la: אוֹתִיר relinquam, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. R. יָתַר.
units.tr: I will leave [אוֹתִיר], 1st person singular future Hiphil. Root [יָתַר]. ## Aleph, Zayin [א ז]

units.la: א ז
אָזוֹר accinctus, אָזוֹר cin-gulum, &c. part. Paul, Kal, & No. sing. m, R. R. אָזַר cingere.
units.tr: Girded [אָזוֹר], girdle [אָזוֹר], etc. Participle Pual, Qal, and noun, singular masculine. Root [אָזַר] to gird.

units.la: attendam, Job.32.12. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. pro אַאְזִין, Rad. אָזַן.
units.tr: I will attend, Job.32.12. 1st person singular future Hiphil, for [אַאְזִין]. Root [אָזַן].

units.la: אָזִיקִים catenæ, No. pl. masc. Rad. זָקַק fudit.
units.tr: Chains [אָזִיקִים], masculine plural noun. Root [זָקַק] he poured out.

units.la: אָזְכָּה purum habebo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. זָכָה.
units.tr: I will hold pure [אָזְכָּה], 1st person singular future Qal. Root [זָכָה].

units.la: אָזְכִּיר, ה commemorabo, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. זָכַר.
units.tr: I will remember [אָזְכִּיר], [ה] I will remember, etc. 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic. Root [זָכַר].

units.la: אָזְכָּרְתָּה odoramentum ejus, sing. fæm. aff. No.
units.tr: Its incense [אָזְכָּרְתָּה], feminine singular with suffix. Noun.

units.la: אָזְכָּרָה suffimentum, Rad. זָכַר recordatus fuit.
units.tr: Incense offering [אָזְכָּרָה]. Root [זָכַר] he remembered.

units.la: אָזְכְּרֵנִי recordabor tui, fut. Kal, 1. sing. cum aff. Rad. זָכַר.
units.tr: I will remember you [אָזְכְּרֵנִי], future Qal, 1st person singular with suffix. Root [זָכַר].

units.la: אָזַל abit, Ben. Kal, sing. masc. Rad. אָזַל.
units.tr: He goes away [אָזַל], Benoni, Qal, singular masculine. Root [אָזַל].

units.la: אָזְלַת abiit, Deut. 32. 36. pro אָזְלָה, 3. sing. fæm. præt. Kal, Rad. אָזַל.
units.tr: She went away [אָזְלַת], Deut.32.36, for [אָזְלָה]. 3rd person singular feminine preterite Qal. Root [אָזַל].

units.la: אַזַּן attendit, præt. Piel, 3.
units.tr: He attended [אַזַּן], preterite Piel, 3rd person singular masculine. Root [אָזַן].

units.la: sing. m. R. אָזַן.
units.tr: Singular masculine. Root [אָזַן].

units.la: אָזְנְךָ, vel אָזְנֶךָ arma tua, pl. masc. affix. abs. אָזְנַיִם, Rad. זן, vel זָן alere, pascere. Chald. זֵין arma, armatura.
units.tr: Your weapons [אָזְנְךָ], or [אָזְנֶךָ] your weapons; masculine plural with suffix, from the absolute [אָזְנַיִם]. Root [זן], or [זָן] to nourish, to feed. Chaldee [זֵין] arms, armour.

units.la: אָזְנוֹ auris ejus, auris mea, aures, יְנוּ aures nostræ, &c. sing. & pl. m. aff. No. Rad. אָזֶן auris.
units.tr: His ear [אָזְנוֹ], my ear [אָזְנִי], ears [אָזְנַיִם], our ears [יְנוּ], etc. Singular and plural masculine with suffix. Noun. Root [אָזֶן] ear.

units.la: אֲזִיקִים catenæ, No. pl. m. Rad. זָקַק liquare.
units.tr: Ezikim, chains; noun, plural, masculine. Root: zaqaq, to melt (liquefy).

units.la: אִזְרוֹעַ brachium, No. sing. masc. Rad. זָרַע seminavit.
units.tr: Izrōa, arm; noun, singular, masculine. Root: zaraʿ, he sowed.

units.la: אֲזָרָה dispergam, fut. Piel, 1. f. m. R. זָרָה.
units.tr: Azarah, I will scatter; future, Piel, 1st person singular, masculine. Root: zarah.

units.la: אֲזָרָה indigena, No. sing. masc. Rad. זָרַח oriri.
units.tr: Azarah, native; noun, singular, masculine. Root: zaraḥ, to rise.

units.la: אֲזָרֵם ventilabo eos, fut. Kal, 1. f. aff. R. זָרָה.
units.tr: Azarem, I will winnow them; future, Qal, 1st person singular, with suffix. Root: zarah.

units.la: אֲזָרְעָה seram, fut. Kal, 1. sing. cum parag. Rad. זָרַע.
units.tr: Azarʿah, I will sow; future, Qal, 1st person singular, with paragogic ending. Root: zaraʿ.

units.la: אח
units.tr: Aleph-Cheth (אח)

units.la: אֶחְבָּא abscondam me, fut. Niph. 1. sing. R. חָבָא.
units.tr: ekhba, I shall hide myself: future, Niphal, 1st person singular, root חָבָא.

units.la: אַחְבָּא occultabo, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. R. חָבָא.
units.tr: I will hide, future Hiphil, 1st person singular, root חָבָא.

units.la: אָחָה ulva, gramen, No. sing. masc. Rad. אָח.
units.tr: ulva, grass; noun, masculine singular, root אָחָה.

units.la: אֲחָוָה fraternitas, No. sing. fæm. à f. m. אָח frater, Rad. inusit. אָחָה.
units.tr: fraternity; noun, feminine singular, from the masculine noun אָח brother; root unused, אָחָה.

units.la: אֲחוּדָה proponam ænigma, 1. sing. fut. Kal, & parag. Rad. חוּר.
units.tr: I will propose a riddle; 1st person singular future Kal with paragogic ending, root חוּר.

units.la: אֲחַוֶּה indicabo, אֲחַוְךָ indicabo tibi, 1. sing. fut. Piel, aff. Rad. חָוָה.
units.tr: I will indicate, I will indicate to you; 1st person singular future Piel with suffix, root חָוָה.

units.la: אֲחֻם parcam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. חוּם.
units.tr: I will spare; 1st person singular future Kal, root חוּם.

units.la: אֲחוֹת, אֲחוֹת soror, No. f. fæm. אֲחָיוֹת, אֲחָיוֹת sorores, pl. fæm. à No. f. m. אָח frater, Rad. אָחָה.
units.tr: sister, אֲחוֹת sister; feminine noun; plural אֲחָיוֹת, אֲחָיוֹת sisters; plural feminine from the masculine noun אָח brother, root אָחָה.

units.la: אָחוֹר retrorsum, אֲחוֹרִי posteriora mea, &c. No. sing. & pl. m. aff. Rad. אַחַר post, postea,
units.tr: backward; אֲחוֹרִי my hinder parts, etc.; noun, singular and plural masculine with suffix; root אַחַר after, afterward.

units.la: אֲחוֹתִי indicatio mea, sing. fæm. aff. No. אֲחָוָה indicatio, Rad. חָוָה indicavit.
units.tr: my indication; feminine singular with suffix; from the noun אֲחָוָה indication, root חָוָה he indicated.

units.la: אָח, constr. אֲחִי frater, אָחִיו frater ejus, אַחִים, אֲחֵי fratres, אֲחֵיהֶם fratres ejus, &c. No. sing. & pl. masc. affix. Rad. אָחָה.
units.tr: brother, construct אֲחִי brother; אָחִיו his brother; אַחִים, אֲחֵי brothers; אֲחֵיהֶם their brothers, etc.; noun, singular and plural masculine with suffixes; root אָחָה.

units.la: וָאֶחֱזֶה & comprehendi, אֲחֻזָּה prehendam, &c. 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. אָחַז.
units.tr: and I laid hold of; I will seize, I will grasp; 1st person singular future Kal, root אָחַז.

units.la: אֶחֱזֶה videbo, Job. 23. 9. fut. Kal, 1. sing. apocop. pro אֶחֱזֶה; Rad. חָזָה.
units.tr: I shall see, Job 23.9; future Kal, 1st person singular, apocopated for אֶחֱזֶה; root חָזָה.

units.la: אֲחֻזַּתְכֶם possessio vestra, אֲחֻזַּתָּם possessio ipsorum, sing. fæm. constr. aff. No. אֲחֻזָּה; R. אָחַז.
units.tr: your possession; their possession; feminine singular construct with suffix; noun אֲחֻזָּה; root אָחַז.

units.la: אֶחְטֶנָּה expiabo illud, fut. Piel, 1. sing. אַחְטָא aff. Rad. חָטָא.
units.tr: I will make atonement for it; future Piel, 1st person singular, from אַחְטָא with suffix; root חָטָא.

units.la: אֲחוּלָה exspectabo, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָחַל.
units.tr: I will wait; 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic ending; root יָחַל.

units.la: אֶחְיֶה vivam, fut. Kal, אֶחְיֶה in vita conserva-bo, fut. Piel, 1. sing. Rad. חָיָה.
units.tr: I shall live; future Kal; I will keep alive; future Piel, 1st person singular; root חָיָה.

units.la: אֲחִישָׁנָּה accelerabo, אֲחִישֶׁנָּה accelerabo illud, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. & aff. Rad. חוּשׁ.
units.tr: I will hasten; I will hasten it; 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic ending and suffix; root חוּשׁ.

units.la: אָחֵל, אָחֵל incipiam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: I will begin; 1st person singular future Hiphil; root חָלַל.

units.la: וַאֲחַל & profanor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. חָלַל.
units.tr: and I was profaned; 1st person singular future Niphal; root חָלַל.

units.la: וַאֲחַלְלֶךָּ & profanabo te, fut. Piel, 1. sing. affix. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: and I will profane you; future Piel, 1st person singular with suffix; root חָלַל.

units.la: אָחֵן gratiam faciam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. חָנַן.
units.tr: I will show favour; 1st person singular future Kal; root חָנַן.

units.la: אֲחַכְמָה sapiens ero, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. חָכַם.
units.tr: I shall be wise; 1st person singular future Kal; root חָכַם.

units.la: אַחְלָמָה amethystus, No. sing. fæm. R. חָלַם somniare.
units.tr: amethyst; noun, feminine singular; root חָלַם, to dream.

units.la: אַחַר distulit, præt. Piel, 3. sing. m. וַיְאַחֵר & moratus sum, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. אָחַר.
units.tr: he deferred; past tense Piel, 3rd person singular masculine; וַיְאַחֵר; and I tarried; 1st person singular future Kal; root אָחַר.

units.la: אַחֲרוֹן posterior, אַחֲרִית posteriorit...
units.tr: latter, אַחֲרִית latter end...

units.la: אַחֲרִית posteritas, extremitas, &c. No. sing. maf. & fæm. Rad. אַחַר post, postea.
units.tr: posterity, extremity, etc.; noun, singular masculine and feminine; root אַחַר after, afterward.

units.la: אַחֵרִין alii, No. pl. m. à sing. m. אַחַר alius, alter, Rad. אַחַר post, postea.
units.tr: others; noun, plural masculine from the singular masculine אַחַר other, another; root אַחַר after, afterward.

units.la: אַחֲרוּ differunt, Jud. 5.28. præt. Pih. 3. pl. Rad. אָחַר.
units.tr: they delay; Judges 5.28; past tense Piel, 3rd person plural; root אָחַר.

units.la: אֲחַשֵּׁךְ cohibebo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. חָשַׁךְ.
units.tr: I will restrain; 1st person singular future Kal; root חָשַׁךְ.

units.la: אַחַת אַחַת una, pro אַחַת No. sing. fæm. Rad. אֶחָד unus.
units.tr: one, for אַחַת one; noun, singular feminine; root אֶחָד one.

units.la: אֶחְתָּה terrebor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. paragog. Rad. חָתַת.
units.tr: I shall be terrified; 1st person singular future Niphal with paragogic ending; root חָתַת.

units.la: אַחְתְּךָ conteram te, 1. singul. futur, Hiph. affix. Rad. חָתַת.
units.tr: I will crush you; 1st person singular future Hiphil with suffix; root חָתַת.

units.la: וַאֲחַתָּם & obsignavi, 1. f. fut. Kal, R. חָתַם.
units.tr: and I sealed; 1st person singular future Kal; root חָתַם.

units.la: וַאֲחַתֹּר & fodi, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. חָתַר.
units.tr: and I dug; 1st person singular future Kal; root חָתַר.

units.la: אט sensim, lente, לְאַטִּי ad lenitatem meam, Part. præf. affix. Rad. inusit. אַטַּ.
units.tr: gently, slowly; to my gentleness, prefix with suffix; root unused, אַטַּ.

units.la: אַט declinabo, וָאַט & inclino, וָאַט & extendo, (apocop. pro) אַטָּה inclinabo, extendam; 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. נָטָה.
units.tr: I will incline; and I incline; and I extend; (apocopated for) אַטָּה I will incline, I will extend; 1st person singular future Hiphil; root נָטָה.

units.la: אַטָּהַר mundus ero, fut. Kal, אַטַּהֵר mundabo, fut. Piel, 1. sing. Rad. טָהַר, Piel טִהַר.
units.tr: I shall be clean; future Kal; I will cleanse; future Piel, 1st person singular; root טָהַר, Piel טִהַר.

units.la: אַטִּילְךָ dejiciam te, 1. f. fut. Hiph. aff. R. טוּל.
units.tr: I will cast you down; 1st person singular future Hiphil with suffix; root טוּל.

units.la: אַטּוֹן funis, funiculus, No. sing. m. R. inusit. אֵטַן.
units.tr: rope, small rope; noun, singular masculine; root unused, אֵטַן.

units.la: אָטוֹר vel אָטֹר servabo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. נָטַר.
units.tr: I will keep, or אָטֹר I will keep; 1st person singular future Kal; root נָטַר.

units.la: אַטִּים præstigiatores, &c. No. pl. m. R. אָטַט sensim, leniter.
units.tr: deceivers, etc.; noun, plural masculine; root אָטַט, gently, softly.

units.la: אַטְמָא polluam, fut. Piel, 1. sing. R. טָמָא.
units.tr: I will pollute; future Piel, 1st person singular; root טָמָא.

units.la: אַטְמְנֵהוּ abscondam ipsum, 1. f. fut. Kal, aff. R. טָמַן.
units.tr: I will hide him; 1st person singular future Kal with suffix; root טָמַן.

units.la: אַטָּף stillabo, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. R. נָטַף. ubi, Rad. אַיֵּה pica, vel אַיֵּה ubi, vel אַיִן non, ni-hil.
units.tr: I will drop; 1st person singular future Hiphil; root נָטַף. Where? Root אַיֵּה magpie, or אַיֵּה where, or אַיִן not, nothing.

units.la: אֵיבָה, אֵיבַת inimicitia, No. sing. fæm. constr. Rad. אָיַב inimicatus est.
units.tr: enmity, אֵיבַת enmity; noun, singular feminine construct; root אָיַב he was hostile.

units.la: אֵיבְנוּ inimicus noster, אֵיבֵינוּ inimici nostri, sing. & pl. masc. aff. No. אֵיב inimicus, Rad. אָיַב inimicatus est.
units.tr: our enemy, אֵיבֵינוּ our enemies; singular and plural masculine with suffix; noun אֵיב enemy; root אָיַב he was hostile.

units.la: אֵיבְתִּי inimicatus sum, 1. sing. præt. Kal, R. אָיַב.
units.tr: I was hostile; 1st person singular past tense Kal; root אָיַב.

units.la: אֵידְכֶם calamitas vestra, f. m. aff. No. Rad. אֵיד vapor.
units.tr: your calamity; masculine with suffix; noun; root אֵיד vapour.

units.la: אִיבָשׁ exarescam, fut. Kal, 1. sing. Rad. יָבַשׁ.
units.tr: I shall wither; future Kal, 1st person singular; root יָבַשׁ.

units.la: אֵיטִיב benefaciam, 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. יָטַב.
units.tr: I will do good; 1st person singular future Hiphil; root יָטַב.

units.la: אִיִּים, אִיּ, אִיִּי insulæ, &c. pl. m. constr. No. Rad. אִי insula, regio.
units.tr: islands, etc.; plural masculine construct; noun; root אִי island, region.

units.la: אֶיגָע laborabo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. יָגַע.
units.tr: I will labour; 1st person singular future Kal; root יָגַע.

units.la: אֶיחַל exspectabo, sperabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, Rad. יָחַל.
units.tr: eychal, I shall wait for, I shall hope: 1st person singular future, Piel, root יָחַל.

units.la: אֵיכְכָה quomodo, אֵיכֹה ubinam, particulae Adv. Rad. אֵךְ quomodo.
units.tr: how; אֵיכֹה where; adverbial particles; root אֵךְ how.

units.la: אַיֵּה ubi tu? אַיּוֹ ubi ille? אַיִם ubi illi? part. Adv. aff. à part. Rad. אַיֵּה vel אֵיָּה.
units.tr: where are you? אַיּוֹ where is he? אַיִם where are they? adverbial particle with suffix, from the particle; root אַיֵּה or אֵיָּה.

units.la: אֵילוּת fortitudo, אַיִל aries, אַיִל planicies, אֵילִים arietes, אֵילָה, אֵילָת cerva, &c. sing. & pl. fæm. & m. No. Rad. אֵיל fortitudo.
units.tr: strength; אַיִל ram; אַיִל plain; אֵילִים rams; אֵילָה, אֵילָת hind, etc.; singular and plural feminine and masculine nouns; root אֵיל strength.

units.la: אֵילִיל ejulabo, וְאֵילִילָה & ejulabo, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָלַל.
units.tr: I will wail; and I will wail; 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic ending; root יָלַל.

units.la: אֵילְכָה ibo, 1. f. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. יָלַךְ.
units.tr: I will go; 1st person singular future Kal with paragogic ending; root יָלַךְ.

units.la: אֵילָמוֹ vestibula ejus, pl. m. aff. No. sing. אֵילָם vestibulum, Rad. אָלַם obmutescere.
units.tr: its vestibule; plural masculine with suffix; noun singular אֵילָם vestibule; root אָלַם, to be mute.

units.la: אֵימָה terrifica, אֵימָה, אֵימַת formido, אֵימִים, gigantes, &c. No. sing. fæm. & pl. masc. Rad. [?]
units.tr: terror, a fearful thing; אֵימַת dread, אֵימִים giants, etc.; noun, singular feminine and plural masculine; root [?].

units.la: אֵיוֹם, vel אֵים formidabilis.
units.tr: formidable, or אֵים formidable.

units.la: וְאֵימְנָה & dexteram petam, vel אֵימְנָה, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָמִן.
units.tr: and I will seek the right hand, or אֵימְנָה; 1st person singular future Hiphil with paragogic ending; root יָמִן.

units.la: אֵינְךָ non illi, אֵינֶנּוּ non tu, מֵאֵין, בְּאֵין absque, &c. præf. & aff. cum part. Rad. אַיִן non, nihil, nullus.
units.tr: not to him, not to you, מֵאֵין, בְּאֵין without, etc.; prefix and suffix with participle; root אַיִן not, nothing, no one.

units.la: אִין insulæ, No. pl. masc. à sing. masc. No. Rad. אִי insula.
units.tr: islands; masculine plural from the masculine singular; noun; root אִי island.

units.la: אֵינָק sugam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. יָנַק.
units.tr: I will suck; 1st person singular future Kal; root יָנַק.

units.la: אֵיצַר castigabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, Rad. יָסַר.
units.tr: I will chastise; 1st person singular future Piel; root יָסַר.

units.la: אֵיסִירֵם castigabo eos, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix. Rad. יָסַר.
units.tr: I will chastise them; 1st person singular future Hiphil with suffix; root יָסַר.

units.la: אֵיפָה epha, f. fæm. constr. No. R. אֵיפָה.
units.tr: ephah; feminine noun, construct; root אֵיפָה.

units.la: אֵיצָה consulam, הָ consulam tibi, 1. sing. fut. Kal, parag. & affix. Rad. יָעַן.
units.tr: I will counsel; I will counsel you; 1st person singular future Kal with paragogic ending and suffix; root יָעַן.

units.la: אֵיפּוֹא, אֵיפָא, אֵיפֹה nunc, ubiubinam, אֵיפוֹ jam, &c. particulæ à part. Rad. הֵא hic.
units.tr: now, where, whither; ubinam; אֵיפוֹ already, etc.; particles from the particle; root הֵא here.

units.la: וָאִיקָץ & evigilavi, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. יקץ.
units.tr: and I awoke; 1st person singular future Kal; root יקץ.

units.la: אִירָא timebo, אִירָאֵנִי timebo eum, 1. sing. fut. Kal, aff. Rad. יָרָא.
units.tr: I will fear; I will fear him; 1st person singular future Kal with suffix; root יָרָא.

units.la: אִירְשֶׁנָּה possidebo eam, 1. f. fut. Kal, aff. R. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: I will possess it; 1st person singular future Kal with suffix; root יָרַשׁ.

units.la: אִישׁוֹן nigrum, nigredo, &c. No. sing. m. R. אִישׁ vir, mas.
units.tr: blackness, blackening, etc.; noun, singular masculine; root אִישׁ man, male.

units.la: אִישָּׁנָה dormiam, 1. singul. futur. Kal, parag. Rad. יָשַׁן.
units.tr: I shall sleep; 1st person singular future Kal with paragogic ending; root יָשַׁן.

units.la: אִישַּׁר æquabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, R. יָשַׁר.
units.tr: I will level; 1st person singular future Piel; root יָשַׁר.

units.la: אִתּוֹן ingressus, No. sing. masc. Rad. אָתָה venit.
units.tr: entrance; noun, singular masculine; root אָתָה he came.

units.la: אִיתָּם integer ero, 1. sing. fut. Niph. Rad. תָּמַם.
units.tr: I shall be complete; 1st person singular future Niphal; root תָּמַם.

units.la: אֵיתָן fortis, robur suum, יִם robusti, &c. No. sing. masc. affix. & pl. masc. Rad. אִית [?].
units.tr: strong, its own strength; robust, etc.; noun, singular masculine with suffix, and plural masculine; root אִית [?].

units.la: א כ
units.tr: Aleph, K

units.la: נְאַךְ & percussi, אַכָּה percutiam, אַכָּה percutiam te, נִי percutiam eum &c. 1. s. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. נָכָה.
units.tr: Naḥ, I struck; akkah, I will strike; akkah, I will strike thee; ni, I will strike him, etc. 1st sing. fut. Hiph. with affix. Root nākāh.

units.la: אֶכְבֹּד honorabor, וְאֶכְבַּד & honorabor, Hag. 1. 8. (pro אֶכְבְּדָה) 1. f. fut. Niph. parag. R. כָּבַד.
units.tr: ekbad, I shall be honoured; w'ekbad, and I shall be honoured, Hag. 1.8 (for ekbādāh), 1st fem. fut. Niph. with paragogic. Root kābad.

units.la: אַכְזָב fallax, No. sing. masc. R. כָּזַב mentiri.
units.tr: akzāb, deceitful, masc. sing. noun. Root kāzab, to lie.

units.la: אַכְזֵב mentiar, 1. sing. fut. Piel, R. כָּזַב.
units.tr: akzēb, I shall lie, 1st sing. fut. Piel, root kāzab.

units.la: אַכְזָר crudelis, No. sing. m. Rad. כזר.
units.tr: akzār, cruel, masc. sing. noun. Root kzr.

units.la: אַכְחַד celabo, 1. sing. fut. Piel, R. כָּחַד.
units.tr: akḥad, I will hide, 1st sing. fut. Piel, root kāḥad.

units.la: אֲכִין ה præparabo, stabiliam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. כּוֹן.
units.tr: akīn, I will prepare, I will establish, 1st sing. fut. Hiph. with paragogic. Root kūn.

units.la: אָכֵל cibus, esca, אָכְלוֹ cibus ejus, &c. No. sing. masc. affix. Rad. אָכַל comedit.
units.tr: ākēl, food, meal; okhlō, his food, etc. masc. sing. noun with affix. Root ākal, he ate.

units.la: אֲכִיל ה agnascam, &c. 1. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. נָבַר. [?]
units.tr: akīl, I will cause to dwell, etc. 1st sing. fut. Hiph. with paragogic. Root nābar. [?]

units.la: וָאֹכַל & consumam, (apoc. pro) אֲכַלֶּה, 1. sing. fut. Piel, Rad. אָכַל. [?]
units.tr: w'okhal, and I will consume, (apocopated for) akallēh, 1st sing. fut. Piel, root ākal. [?]

units.la: וָאֹכְלָה & potero, pro אֹכַל, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. יָכַל. [?]
units.tr: w'okhlāh, and I shall be able, for ōkhal, 1st sing. fut. Kal, root yākal. [?]

units.la: אֻכַּל consumptus fuit, præt. Pual, 3. s. f. m. R. אָכַל. [?]
units.tr: ukkal, he was consumed, perfect Pual, 3rd sing. masc. root ākal. [?]

units.la: אֻכְלָה cohibebo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. כָּלָא. [?]
units.tr: uklāh, I will restrain, 1st sing. fut. Kal, root kālā. [?]

units.la: אֹכְלָה consumens, &c. Ben. Kal, sing. fœm. Rad. אָכַל. [?]
units.tr: ōklāh, consuming, etc. participle Kal, fem. sing. root ākal. [?]

units.la: וַאֲכַלָה & comede, Gen. 27.19. Imperat. Kal, sing. masc. parag. Rad. אָכַל. [?]
units.tr: wa'akhlāh, and eat, Gen. 27.19, imperative Kal, masc. sing. with paragogic. Root ākal. [?]

units.la: אֲכָלֵנִי absumsit me, præt. Kal, 3. sing. masc. aff. Rad. אָכַל.
units.tr: akhalēnī, he has consumed me, perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with affix. Root ākal.

units.la: אֲכַלְּכֶם sustentabo eos, fut. Piel, gem. 1. sing. affix. Rad. כּוּל. [?]
units.tr: akhalkem, I will sustain them, fut. Piel, doubled 1st sing. with affix. Root kūl. [?]

units.la: בְּאָכְלָם in comedendo ipsos, Infin. Kal. aff. R. [?]
units.tr: be'oklam, in devouring them, infinitive Kal with affix. Root [?]

units.la: אָכַל, אָכְלָה comedam, אָכְלָם comedam illa, &c. 1. sing. fut. Kal, parag. & aff. R. אָכַל. [?]
units.tr: ākhal, I will eat, ākhlām, I will eat them, etc. 1st sing. fut. Kal, with paragogic and affix. Root ākal. [?]

units.la: אָכַן aptabo, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. כּוּן aptavit. [?]
units.tr: ākhan, I will prepare, 1st sing. fut. Hiph. Root kūn, he prepared. [?]

units.la: אֲכַנֶּה cognomine utar, ה. cognominabo te, 1. sing. fut. Piel, affix. Rad. in Piel כִּנָּה. [?]
units.tr: akhanneh, I will use a surname, or I will name you, 1st sing. fut. Piel, with affix. Root in Piel kinnāh. [?]

units.la: אֲכַנִּיךָ humiliabo, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. כָּנַע. [?]
units.tr: akhanniyka, I will humble, 1st sing. fut. Hiph. Root kānaʿ. [?]

units.la: אֲכַפָּה operiam, אֲכַפְּךָ operiam te, אֲכַפֶּנּוּ operiam ipsum, &c. 1. sing. fut. Piel, aff. Rad. כָּפָה. [?]
units.tr: akhappeh, I will cover, akhappekha, I will cover you, akhappennû, I will cover him, etc. 1st sing. fut. Piel, with affix. Root kāphāh. [?]

units.la: אֲכַפְךָ incurvabo me, 1. sing. fut. Niph. Rad. כָּפַף. [?]
units.tr: akhpekha, I will bow myself, 1st sing. fut. Niph. Root kāphaph. [?]

units.la: אַכַּפִּי manus mea, No. sing. masc. אַכַּף manus, affix. Rad. אָבַף curvavit. [?]
units.tr: akappî, my hand, masc. sing. noun akkaph, hand, with affix. Root ʾābaph, he bent. [?]

units.la: אֲכַרוּת pangam, fut. Kal, אֲכְרִית exscindam, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. Rad. כָּרַת. [?]
units.tr: akhārût, I will pierce, fut. Kal; ekhrît, I will cut off, fut. Hiph. 1st sing. Root kārat. [?]

units.la: וַאֲכוֹת & contrivi, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. כָּתַת aromata, vel כָּתַת tudit, contudit. אֶכְתְּבֶנָּה scribam illud, sutur. Kal, 1. sing. affix. Rad. כָּתַב.
units.tr: wa'akhôt, and I have crushed, 1st sing. fut. Kal, root kātat, to pound, or kātat, he bruised, crushed. ekhtebennāh, I will write it, suffixed 1st sing. Kal, with affix. Root kātab.

units.la: א ל
units.tr: Aleph, L

units.la: אֵל fortis, אֵלִם fortes, &c. No. sing. & pl. m. Rad. אֵל fortitudo. אֵלַד pariam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. יָלַד. אֱלוֹת exsecrando, Infin. Kal, Rad. אָלָה. אָלָה exsecratio, אֲלוֹת adjurationes, No. sing. & pl. fæm. Rad. אָלָה jurare, exsecrari. אָלָה quercus, אַלְיָה cauda, אֵלוֹן quercus, No. sing. fæm. & masc. Rad. אָלָה exsecratus est. לְאֵלָה Deo, לֵאלֹהוֹ Deo suo, sing. masc. præf. & aff. No. Rad. אֵלָה Deus. אֲלוֹת adjurationes, pl. fæm. No. אָלָה adjuratio, R. אָלָה jurare. אֵלִים, & אֵלִי, אֵילִים quercus, &c. No. pl. masc. Rad. אָלָה exsecratus est. אֱלֹהִי Deus, אֱלֹהֵי, אֱלֹהִים Deus meus, &c. pl. m. aff. No. Rad. אֱלֹהָ Deus. אֶלְחָם vescar, 1. sing. fut. Kal, R. לָחַם. אֶלִּין pernoctabo, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. Rad. לוּן. אָלִית exsecrata es, 2. f. fæm. præt. Kal, R. אָלָה. אֵלְכָה ibo, 1. sing. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. יָלַךְ. אֲלֵי væ, hei, Part. à Rad. יָלַל ejulare. אַלְמָנוּת viduitas, אַלְמָנוֹת vidua, אַלְמוֹנִי almoni, cujus nomen reticetur, &c. No. sing. & pl. fæm. & No. sing. masc. Rad. אָלַם colligare. אַלְמֻתַּי fasciculi sui, &c. אַלְמִי, אַלְמוֹת vestibula, &c. No. plur. fæm. aff. & pl. masc. Rad. אָלַם colligare.
units.tr: ēl, strong, ēlim, strong ones, etc. masc. sing. and pl. noun. Root ēl, strength. ēlad, I will bring forth, 1st sing. fut. Kal, root yālad. elōt, cursing, infinitive Kal, root ʾālāh. ālāh, oath, curse, ʾalōt, oaths, noun sing. and pl. fem. Root ʾālāh, to swear, to curse. lē'elāh, to God, le'elōhô, to his God, masc. sing. prefixed and suffixed noun. Root ēlāh, God. alōt, oaths, pl. fem. noun, ʾālāh, oath, root ʾālāh, to swear. ēlim, and ēlī, ʾêlîm, oaks, etc. noun pl. masc. Root ʾālāh, he cursed. elōhî, my God, elōhê, elōhîm, my God, etc. pl. masc. with affix. Noun. Root ʾelōh, God. elḥām, I will eat, 1st sing. fut. Kal, root lāḥam. ellîn, I will spend the night, fut. Hiph. 1st sing. Root lūn. ālît, you cursed, 2nd fem. perfect Kal, root ʾālāh. elkhāh, I will go, 1st sing. fut. Kal, paragogic. Root yālak. ʾălē, woe, alas, participle from root yālal, to wail. almānût, widowhood, almānôt, widow, almônî, so-and-so, whose name is withheld, etc. noun sing. and pl. fem. and noun sing. masc. Root ʾālam, to bind. almōtay, his bundles, etc. almî, almôt, vestibules, etc. noun pl. fem. with affix and pl. masc. Root ʾālam, to bind.

units.la: אֲלֻפִּים duo millia, No. du. m. à sing. אֶלֶף.
units.tr: ʾalupîm, two thousand, noun dual masc. from sing. ʾelef.

units.la: אַלְקַח sumar, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. לָקַח.
units.tr: alqaḥ, I will take, 1st sing. fut. Niph. Root lāqaḥ.

units.la: אַלְתּוֹ exsecratio ejus, f. fæm.aff. No. אָלָה; Rad. אָלָה exsecratus est.
units.tr: altô, his cursing, fem. noun with affix. Root ʾālāh; root ʾālāh, he swore.

units.la: אַלְקוּם alkum, invictus, comp. ex part. neg. אַל nè, non, & Rad. קוּם surgere.
units.tr: alqûm, invincible, compounded of the negative particle ʾal, not, and the root qûm, to rise.

units.la: א מ
units.tr: Aleph, M

units.la: וַאֲמַאסָךְ & spernam te, Hof. 4. 6. 1. sing. fut. Kal, cum א redund. Rad. מָאַס.
units.tr: wa'amâsākh, and I will despise you, Hos. 4.6, 1st sing. fut. Kal, with superfluous aleph. Root māʾas.

units.la: אִמָּה, אִמּוֹ mater ejus, אִמּוֹת matres, אִמִּי mater mea, &c. sing. fæm. aff. & pl. fæm. No. אֵם mater, Rad. אָמַם.
units.tr: immāh, immô, his mother, imôt, mothers, immî, my mother, etc. fem. sing. with affix and fem. pl. Noun ēm, mother, root ʾāmam.

units.la: אֹם, vel אוֹם Natio, וּלְאִמֵּי הָאֻמִּים nationes, & natio mea, &c. No.
units.tr: ōm, or ʾôm, nation; ulʾimmê hāʾummîm, nations, and my nation, etc. noun

units.la: f. m. & pl. m. aff. Rad. אָמַם.
units.tr: masc. sing. and masc. pl. with affix. Root ʾāmam.

units.la: אֲמָהוֹת, אַמְהוֹת ancillæ, &c. pl. fæm. No. & constr. Rad. אָמָה an-cilla.
units.tr: ʾămāhôt, ʾamhôt, maidservants, etc. fem. pl. noun and construct. Root ʾāmāh, maidservant.

units.la: אָמוּט dimovebor, 1. f. fut. Niph. R. מוּט.
units.tr: ʾāmôṭ, I shall be moved, 1st fem. fut. Niph. Root mûṭ.

units.la: אָמֵן, אֱמֵן, אֶמֵן fides, אָמֵן veritas, אָמוֹן nutritus, אֹמֵן nutriens, אֻמְנַת nutrix, אֻמְנָתוֹ nutrix e-jus, אֻמְנָם, אֻמְנָם re-vera, &c. No. sing. masc. & fæm. aff. Rad. אָמַן nutrivit.
units.tr: ʾāmēn, ʾĕmēn, ʾemēn, faithfulness; ʾāmēn, truth; ʾāmôn, nursling; ʾōmēn, nurturing; ʾumnat, nurse; ʾumnātô, his nurse; ʾumnām, ʾomnām, indeed, in truth, etc. noun sing. masc. and fem. with affix. Root ʾāman, he nourished.

units.la: אֱמוּנָה veritas, אֱמוּנִים fi-deles, אֱמוּנַת fides, נַתִּי fides mea, &c. No. sing. fæm. constr. aff. & No. pl. m. Rad. אָמַן nutrivit.
units.tr: ʾĕmûnāh, truth; ʾĕmûnîm, faithful ones; ʾĕmûnat, faithfulness; ʾĕmûnātî, my faithfulness, etc. noun sing. fem. construct, with affix, and noun pl. masc. Root ʾāman, he nourished.

units.la: אַמּוֹת cubiti, &c. pl. fæm. No. אַמָּה cubitus, Rad. אַמַּם.
units.tr: ʾammôt, cubits, etc. pl. fem. noun; ʾammāh, cubit. Root ʾamam.

units.la: אָמוּתָה moriar, 1. f. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. מוּת.
units.tr: ʾāmûṯāh, I shall die, 1st fem. fut. Kal, paragogic. Root mûṯ.

units.la: אֲמְחָה delebo, אֲמְחֻנוּ dele-bo bo eum, &c. 1. f. fut. aff. Rad. מָחָה.
units.tr: ʾămḥāh, I will blot out; ʾămḥennû, I will blot him out, etc. 1st fem. fut. with affix. Root māḥāh.

units.la: אֲמִילֵם exscindam eos, 1. f. fut. Hiph. aff. R. מוּל circumcidit.
units.tr: ʾāmîlēm, I will cut them off, 1st fem. fut. Hiph. with affix. Root mûl, he circumcised.

units.la: אָמִיר commutabo, Hof. 4. 7. 1. f. fut. Hiph. Rad. מוּר: vel summus ramus, No. f. m. R. אָמַר dixit.
units.tr: ʾāmîr, I will change, Hos. 4.7, 1st fem. fut. Hiph. Root mûr; or highest branch, noun fem. masc. Root ʾāmar, he said.

units.la: אָמִישׁ amovebo, 1. f. fut. Hiph. R. מוּשׁ.
units.tr: ʾāmîš, I will remove, 1st fem. fut. Hiph. Root mûš.

units.la: אָמִית morte afficiam, 1. f. fut. Hiph. Rad מוֹת.
units.tr: ʾāmîṯ, I will put to death, 1st fem. fut. Hiph. Root môṯ.

units.la: אֶמְלָאֶה replebor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. parag. Rad. מָלָא.
units.tr: ʾemlāʾeh, I shall be filled, 1st sing. fut. Niph. paragogic. Root mālāʾ.

units.la: אַמְלָה languidus, אָמְלָל languere, אָמְללוּ languescunt, &c. ut & אֲמֻלִּים languidi, No. f, fæm. & præt. Pual 3. f. m. & 3. pl. ut & No. pl. m. R. אָמַל.
units.tr: ʾamlāh, languid; ʾāmĕlāl, to languish; ʾāmĕllû, they languish, etc.; also ʾămullîm, languid ones, noun fem. and perfect Pual 3rd fem. sing. and 3rd pl., and noun pl. masc. Root ʾāmal.

units.la: אַמְלְטֶה eripiam me. 1. sing. fut. Niph. parag. Rad. מָלַט.
units.tr: ʾamlĕṭeh, I shall rescue myself, 1st sing. fut. Niph. paragogic. Root mālaṭ.

units.la: אַמְסָה madefaciam, fut. Hiph. 1. f. R. מסה.
units.tr: ʾamsāh, I will moisten, fut. Hiph. 1st fem. Root msh.

units.la: אָמִין אֲמִיָּה robur, No. f. m. & fæm. R. אָמַן robustus fuit, Piel אַמֵּן.
units.tr: ʾāmîn, ʾămîyāh, strength, noun masc. and fem. Root ʾāman, he was strong, Piel ʾammēn.

units.la: אַמְצָאֲךָ inveniam te, fut. Kal, 1. f. aff. R. מָצָא.
units.tr: ʾamṣāʾăkhā, I will find you, fut. Kal, 1st fem. with affix. Root māṣāʾ.

units.la: בְּאָמְרָם in dicere eos, אָמְרָה dicam, אִמְרָתְךָ sermo tuus, Infin. Kal aff. & fut. Kal 1. sing. parag. ut & fing. fæm. aff. No. אִמְרָה sermo, Rad. אָמַר dixit.
units.tr: bĕʾomrām, in their saying, ʾomrāh, I will say, ʾimrāṯəkhā, your word, infinitive Kal with affix, and fut. Kal 1st sing. paragogic, and fem. sing. with affix. Noun ʾimrāh, word. Root ʾāmar, he said.

units.la: אֲמָרֵר amarum reddam, 1. f. fut. Piel, Rad. מָרַר.
units.tr: ʾămārēr, I will make bitter, 1st fem. fut. Piel. Root mārar.

units.la: וָאַמִּישֶׁךָ & palpabo te, 1. f. fut. Kal. aff. R. מוּשׁ.
units.tr: wa'ammîšekha, and I will feel you, 1st fem. fut. Kal, with affix. Root mûš.

units.la: אָמְשֶׁכֶם Traham eos, 1. sing. fut. Kal, aff. Rad. מָשַׁךְ.
units.tr: ʾāmšekhem, I will draw them, 1st sing. fut. Kal, with affix. Root māšak.

units.la: אַמִּתְּהָתִי saccus meus, אַמִּתְּחוֹת sacci, &c. sing. fæm. אַמִּתְּחַת saccus, aff. & pl. fæm. Rad. מָתַח extendit. אָמַת vel אָמוֹת morior, 1. sing. fut. Kal. Rad. מוּת. אֱמֶת veritas, (pro אֲמָנָה) אֲמִתּוֹ veritas ejus, &c. No. f. fæm. aff. Rad. אָמַן nutrivit. אֲמָתּוֹ ancilla ejus, &c. f. fæm. aff. No. Rad. אָמָה. אַמְתַּיִם cubiti duo, No. du. à f. fæm. אַמָּה, Rad. אַמַּם.
units.tr: ʾamittĕhātî, my sack, ʾamittĕḥôt, sacks, etc. fem. sing. ʾamittĕḥat, sack, with affix and fem. pl. Root māṯaḥ, he stretched. ʾāmaṯ or ʾāmôṯ, I die, 1st sing. fut. Kal. Root mûṯ. ʾĕmeṯ, truth, (for ʾămānāh) ʾimmĕṯô, his truth, etc. noun fem. with affix. Root ʾāman, he nourished. ʾamṯô, his maidservant, etc. fem. with affix, noun. Root ʾāmāh. ʾamtayim, two cubits, noun dual fem. from ʾammāh, root ʾamam.

units.la: א ן אָנָא, & אֲנָה quæso, obsecro, particulæ, à part. Rad. נָא quæso, nunc. אָנָה obvenire fecit, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. Rad. אָנָה luxit. אָנָה, אָנָה, אָנָא, אָנָה quò, quorsum, &c. particulæ à Part. Rad. אָנֵה quò. אָנָּו Jer. 42. 6. pro אֲנַחְנוּ, atque id pro אֲנַחְנוּ nos, Pron. 1. pl. à f. Rad. אֲנִי ego. אָנוּ lugent, 3. pl. m. præt. Kal, Rad. אָנָה. אָנַח quiescam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. נוּחַ. אֲנוּחָה fugiam, 1. sing. fut. Kal, parag. R. נוּם. אֲנוּשָׁה mortifera, sing. fæm. No. f. m. אָנוּשׁ æger, Rad. אָנַשׁ ægrum esse. וְאָנוּשָׁה & afficior ægritudine, Psal. 69. 21. pro אֲנוּשָׁה, 1. sing. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. אָנַשׁ. אֲנַחֲהוּ ducam eum, אֲנַחֲהָ eam, אֲנַחְנוּ eum, &c. 1. f. fut. Hiph. aff. R. נָחָה. אֲנַחֵם consolationem capiam, pænitebit me, 1. f.fut. Niph. R. נִחַם. אֲנַחֲמֶךָּ consolabor te, fut. Piel, 1. f. aff. R. נָחַם. אֲנַחְנוּ nos, pl. à sing. No. Rad. אֲנִי. אֲנָחָתִי gemitus, meus, 1. f. fæm.aff. אַנְחָה gemitus, const. No. אַנְחָתִי, Rad. אָנַח suspiravit. אֳנִיָּה navis, אֳנִיּוֹת naves, ves, אֲנִיָּה mæstitia, &c. No. f. m. & fæm. & pl. fæm. R. אָנָה mæstus fuit.
units.tr: Aʾ n ʾānāʾ, and ʾănāh, I pray, I beseech, particles, from the particle root nāʾ, I pray, now. ʾānāh, he caused to befall, perfect Piel, 3rd fem. sing. Root ʾānāh, he mourned. ʾānāh, ʾānāʾ, ʾānāʾ, ʾānāh, whither, whereto, etc. particles from the particle ʾēnēh, whither. ʾānû, Jer. 42.6, for ʾănaḥnû, and this for ʾănaḥnû, we, 1st pl. pronoun from the root ʾănî, I. ʾānû, they mourn, 3rd pl. masc. perfect Kal, root ʾānāh. ʾānaḥ, I shall rest, 1st sing. fut. Kal, root nûaḥ. ʾănûḥāh, I will flee, 1st sing. fut. Kal, paragogic. Root nûm. ʾănûšāh, deadly, fem. sing. of ʾānûš, sick, root ʾānaš, to be sick. wā'ānûšāh, and I am afflicted with sickness, Psalm 69.21, for ʾănûšāh, 1st sing. fut. Kal, paragogic. Root ʾānaš. ʾănahăhû, I will lead him, ʾănahăhā, her, ʾănahnû, him, etc. 1st fem. fut. Hiph. with affix. Root nāḥāh. ʾănaḥēm, I will take comfort, I shall repent, 1st fem. fut. Niph. Root nīḥam. ʾănaḥămekhā, I will comfort you, fut. Piel, 1st fem. with affix. Root nāḥam. ʾănaḥnû, we, pl. of the singular, noun. Root ʾănî. ʾănāḥātî, my groaning, 1st fem. fem. with affix; ʾanḥāh, groaning, construct, noun ʾanḥātî, root ʾānaḥ, he sighed. ʾŏnîyāh, ship, ʾŏnîyôt, ships, ʾănîyāh, sorrow, etc. noun fem. masc. and fem. and pl. fem. Root ʾānāh, he was sorrowful.

units.tr: ʾefo, "now", ʾeyfoh, "where", ʾefo, "already", etc.

units.la: particulæ à Part. Rad. פֹּה hîc.
units.tr: particles from the Part. Root פֹּה, "here".

units.la: אֵפוֹד ephod, cinctura, אֲפֻדָּתוֹ amictus ejus, &c. No. sing. masc. & sing. fœm. constr. aff. Rad. אָפַד amicivit,
units.tr: ephod, girdle; אֲפֻדָּתוֹ his ephod/ his covering, etc. Noun singular masculine and singular feminine construct with suffix. Root אָפַד, he put on (clothed).

units.la: אַפִּיל cadere faciam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. R. נָפַל.
units.tr: ʾafil, "I will cause to fall", 1st sing. fut. Hiph. R. נָפַל.

units.la: אַפִּיר dispergam, & אֲפִיר irritum faciam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. Rad. פּוּר & פּוֹר.
units.tr: ʾafir, "I will scatter", and ʾafir, "I will make void", 1st sing. fut. Hiph. Root פּוּר and פּוֹר.

units.la: אַפִּיץ fortis, יִם, יְ validi, vires, robora, &c. No. f. & pl. m. constr. Rad. אָפַק fortiter se continere.
units.tr: ʾafiz, "strong", ... "mighty ones", "strength", "power", etc. No. f. and pl. m. constr. Root אָפַק, "to restrain oneself strongly".

units.la: אֶפְלָה, אָפֵל, אֻפְלָה cadam, &c. 1. f. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. נָפַל.
units.tr: ʾefelah, ʾafel, ʾuflah, "I shall fall", etc.: 1st f. fut. Kal, parag. Root נָפַל.

units.la: אֶפְלָה caligo, אֲפֵלְתְּךָ caligo tua, אֲפֵלוּת caligines, אֶפִילוֹת obscura, &c. No. f. fœm. aff. & pl. fœm. à No. Rad. אָפַל caligo.
units.tr: ʾefelah, "darkness", ʾafeltekha, "your darkness", ʾafelut, "darknesses", ʾefilot, "obscure things", etc. No. f. fem. aff. and pl. fem. from No. Root אָפַל, "darkness".

units.la: אַפְּנֶה aspiciam (& apoc.)
units.tr: ʾafneh, "I will look" (and apoc.)

units.la: רַאֲפֵן & verti me, 1. sing. fut. Kal. Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: ra-ʾafen, "and I turned myself", 1st sing. fut. Kal. Root פָּנָה.

units.la: אֲפָנִים rotæ, יְ rotæ suæ, &c. pl. m. constr. aff. No. Rad. אֽפַן rota.
units.tr: ʾafanim, "wheels", … "his wheels", etc. pl. m. constr. aff. No. Root ʾafan, "wheel".

units.la: אֶפֵס nihilum, אֶפְסַיִם tali pedum, No. sing. & dual. m. Rad. אֶפֶס defsiit, præf. הָאֶפֶס an deficeret.
units.tr: ʾefes, "nothing", ʾefsayim, "two ends of a foot", No. sing. and dual m. Root ʾefes, "he failed", praef. ha-ʾefes, "whether he would fail".

units.la: אֶפְעֶה vipera, No. sing. fœm. Rad. אָפַע.
units.tr: Ephah? viper, noun, singular feminine. Root אָפַע.

units.la: אֶפְעֶה exclamabo, 1. f. fut. Kal, Rad. פָּעָה.
units.tr: אֶפְעֶה: I will cry out, 1st person singular future Kal, root פָּעָה.

units.la: אֲפָפוּנִי circumdederunt me, præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. R. אָפַף.
units.tr: אֲפָפוּנִי: they surrounded me, perfect Kal, 3rd person plural, with suffix; root אָפַף.

units.la: אָפֵר irritum faciam, fut. Hiph. 1. sing. R. פּוּר.
units.tr: אָפֵר: I will make void, future Hiphil, 1st person singular; root פּוּר.

units.la: אַפְרְחוֹ pulli ejus, (pro יו) אַפְרְחָיו pulli sui, No. pl. m. אֲפַרְחִים pulli avium, aff. R. פָּרַח florere.
units.tr: אַפְרְחוֹ: his young ones (for יו), אַפְרְחָיו: his own young ones; noun, plural masculine; אֲפַרְחִים: young birds; with suffix; root פָּרַח, to flourish.

units.la: וַאֶפַּת & pellectus sum, Jer. 20.7. 1. sing. fut. Niph. def. pro אֶפָּתֶה. Rad. פָּתָה .
units.tr: וַאֶפַּת: and I was enticed, Jer. 20.7; 1st person singular future Niphal, defective for אֶפָּתֶה; root פָּתָה.

units.la: אֲפַתְּנִי[?] diligenter pelliciam eum, 1.s. fut. Piel, aff. R. פָּתָה .
units.tr: אֲפַתְּנִי [?]: I will diligently entice him; 1st person singular future Piel, with suffix; root פָּתָה.

units.la: א צ
units.tr: א צ

units.la: אָץ festinavit, 3. sing. m. præt. Kal, vel אָץ festinus, אָצִים festini, sing. & pl. m. No. part. Rad. אוץ .
units.tr: אָץ: he hastened, 3rd person singular masculine perfect Kal; or אָץ: hasty, אָצִים: hasty, singular and plural masculine, participle; root אוץ.

units.la: אָצָא · אֲצָאָה exibo, 1. s. fut. Kal, parag. Rad. יָצָא .
units.tr: אָצָא · אֲצָאָה: I will go out, 1st person singular future Kal, with paragogic ending; root יָצָא.

units.la: אֶצְבַּע digitus, ות digiti, &c. No. sing. m. & pl. fæm. Rad. צָבַע pinxit.
units.tr: אֶצְבַּע: finger, pl. אֶצְבְּעוֹת: fingers, etc.; noun, singular masculine and plural feminine; root צָבַע, he dyed.

units.la: אֲצַוֶּה præcipiam, (& apoc.) וַאֲצַו & præcepi, אֲצַוְּךָ præcipiam tibi, אֲצַוֶּנּוּ præcipiam ei, 1.s. fut. Piel, aff. R. צִוָּה .
units.tr: אֲצַוֶּה: I will command, (and apocopated) וַאֲצַו: and I commanded; אֲצַוְּךָ: I will command you; אֲצַוֶּנּוּ: I will command him; 1st person singular future Piel, with suffix; root צִוָּה.

units.la: אֲצוֹם jejunabo, 1. s. fut. Kal, Rad. צוּם .
units.tr: אֲצוֹם: I will fast; 1st person singular future Kal; root צוּם.

units.la: אֲצִינָה constituam, 1. sing. fut Hiph. parag. Rad. יָצַג .
units.tr: אֲצִינָה: I will appoint; 1st person singular future Hiphil, with paragogic ending; root יָצַג.

units.la: אֲצִיל eripiam, ה eripiam[?]
units.tr: אֲצִיל: I will deliver; [and] ה: I will deliver [?]

units.la: te, &c. 1.s. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. נָצַל .
units.tr: ... 1st person singular future Hiphil, with suffix; root נָצַל.

units.la: אֲצִיל ala, אֲצִילָה ad alam usque, אֲצִילוֹת, אֲצִילִי axillæ, אֲצִילִים, אֲצִילִי magnates, &c. No. s. & pl. m. & fæm. Rad. אָצַל .
units.tr: אֲצִיל: armpit; אֲצִילָה: up to the armpit; אֲצִילוֹת, אֲצִילִי: armpits; אֲצִילִים, אֲצִילִי: nobles, etc.; noun, singular and plural, masculine and feminine; root אָצַל.

units.la: אֲצִיעָה stratum posuero, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. parag. Rad. יָצַע .
units.tr: אֲצִיעָה: I will lay a bed; 1st person singular future Hiphil, with paragogic ending; root יָצַע.

units.la: אֲצִיתָנָה comburam eam, 1. s. fut. Hiph. aff. R. צִית .
units.tr: אֲצִיתָנָה: I will burn it; 1st person singular future Hiphil, with suffix; root צִית.

units.la: אֲצָלָה assabo, 1. s. fut. Kal, Rad. צָלָה .
units.tr: אֲצָלָה: I will roast; 1st person singular future Kal; root צָלָה.

units.la: אֲצְלָם apud eos, &c. particula aff. R. אֶצֶל .
units.tr: אֲצְלָם: beside them, etc.; particle with suffix; root אֶצֶל.

units.la: אֲצְפֶּה speculabor, fut. Piel, 1. sing. Rad. צָפָה .
units.tr: אֲצְפֶּה: I will watch; future Piel, 1st person singular; root צָפָה.

units.la: אֲצִק, אֲצָק fundam, 1. s. fut. Kal, R. יָצַק .
units.tr: אֲצִק, אֲצָק: I will pour; 1st person singular future Kal; root יָצַק.

units.la: אֲצָר, אֲצָרָה custodiam, אֲצָרְךָ custodiam te, אֲצָרֶנָּה custodiam eam, 1. s. fut. Kal, parag. & aff. R. נָצַר .
units.tr: אֲצָר, אֲצָרָה: I will guard; אֲצָרְךָ: I will guard you; אֲצָרֶנָּה: I will guard it; 1st person singular future Kal, with paragogic and suffix; root נָצַר.

units.la: אֲצָרָה thesaurarios consti-tuam, fut. Kal, vel Hiph. 1. sing. parag. R. אָצַר.
units.tr: אֲצָרָה: I will appoint treasurers; future Kal, or Hiphil, 1st person singular, with paragogic ending; root אָצַר.

units.la: אָקַב exsecrabor, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. נָקַב. אֶקְבֹּר sepeliar, 1. s. fut. Niph. R. קָבַר. וָאֶקֹּד & inclinavi me, 1. f. fut. Kal, Rad. קָרַר. הַאֶקְדְּמֶנּוּ num praeveni-am eum, fut. Piel, 1. sing. praef. aff. Rad. קָדַם. אֶקְדַּשׁ sanctificabor, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. קָדַשׁ. אֶקֹּף rupicapra, No. f. m. à R. אֶקַּף. אֶקְוֶּה exspectabo, fut. Piel, 1. sing. R. קָוָה. אֶקּוֹט fastidio habebo, fut. Kal, 1. f. Rad. קוּט. אֶקּוּמָה surgam, fut. Kal, 1. sing. parag. Rad. קוּם. אֶקְחָה accipiam, ה- accipiam te, הוּ eum, ם ea, &c. 1. sing. fut. Kal, parag. & aff. Rad. לָקַח. אֶקִּימָה suscitabo, 1. f. fut. Hiph. & Piel, parag. Rad. קוּם. אֶקִּיץ expergiscar, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. R. קִיץ. וָאֶקַּל & vilis habita sum, pro אֶקַּל, 1. f. fut. Niph. Rad. קָלַל. אֶקּוּם surgam, אֶקּוֹמֶם erigam, &c. 1. f. fut. Kal, & Piel, Rad. קוּם. אֶקְנֶה emam, fut. Kal, 1. sing. Rad. קָנָה. אֶקְנִיאֵם ad zelum commovebo eos, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. קנא. וָאֶקּוּץ & taeduit me, 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. קוּץ. וָאֶקְרָאָה & clamavi, 1. Sam. 28. 15. fut. Kal, 1. sing. parag. Rad. קָרָא. אֶקָּרֶה obvius fiam, 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. קָרָה. אֶקְשֶׁה indurabo, 1. f. fut. Hiph.
units.tr: אָקַב I shall be cursed, 1st person singular future Kal, root נָקַב. אֶקְבֹּר I shall be buried, 1st person singular future Niph., root קָבַר. וָאֶקֹּד and I bowed myself, 1st person feminine future Kal, root קָרַר. הַאֶקְדְּמֶנּוּ shall I anticipate him? future Piel, 1st person singular with interrogative prefix and suffix, root קָדַם. אֶקְדַּשׁ I shall be sanctified, 1st person singular future Niph., root קָדַשׁ. אֶקֹּף rupicapra (a wild goat), noun feminine and masculine, from the root אֶקַּף. אֶקְוֶּה I shall wait for, future Piel, 1st person singular, root קָוָה. אֶקּוֹט I shall have contempt, future Kal, 1st person feminine, root קוּט. אֶקּוּמָה I shall rise, future Kal, 1st person singular with paragogic ending, root קוּם. אֶקְחָה I shall take, with ה I shall take you, הוּ him, ם them, etc.: 1st person singular future Kal, with paragogic and pronominal suffixes, root לָקַח. אֶקִּימָה I shall raise up, 1st person feminine future Hiph. and Piel, with paragogic ending, root קוּם. אֶקִּיץ I shall awake, 1st person singular future Hiph., root קִיץ. וָאֶקַּל and I was held vile, for אֶקַּל, 1st person feminine future Niph., root קָלַל. אֶקּוּם I shall rise, אֶקּוֹמֶם I shall raise up, etc.: 1st person feminine future Kal and Piel, root קוּם. אֶקְנֶה I shall buy, future Kal, 1st person singular, root קָנָה. אֶקְנִיאֵם I shall move them to jealousy, 1st person singular future Hiph. with suffix, root קנא. וָאֶקּוּץ and I was weary, 1st person singular future Kal, root קוּץ. וָאֶקְרָאָה and I cried out, 1 Sam. 28. 15, future Kal, 1st person singular with paragogic ending, root קָרָא. אֶקָּרֶה I shall meet, 1st person singular future Niph., root קָרָה. אֶקְשֶׁה I shall harden, 1st person feminine future Hiph.

units.tr: I will give (אֶתֵּן, or אֶתְּנָה, dabo), I will give you (אֶתְּנֶךָּ, dabo te), I will give them (אֶתְּנָם, eos), I will give him (אֶתְּנוֹ, eum), etc.: first person singular future Kal, with paragogic and affixed forms, from the root נָתַן. אָתְנָה: wages, a feminine singular noun, from the root תְּנָה, "he hired for wages." אָתְנַהֲלָה: I will lead myself, first person singular future Hithpael, paragogic, from the root נָהַל. אָתְנוּ: his ass, אָתְנְךָ: your ass, etc., a masculine singular noun with suffix, from the root אָתַן. אָתְנוּ: we came, first person plural perfect Kal, from the root אָתָה. אָתְנוּ: with us, with the suffix, from the particle אֵת with the preposition. אָתְנַחֵם: I will console myself, first person singular future Hithpael, from the root נָחַם. אָתְנָן, or wages: אָתְנָנָה: his wages, אָתְנָנִיָּה: his wages, etc., a feminine singular and masculine plural noun with suffix, from the root תְּנָה, "he hired for wages." אָתְעָב: I will abhor, first person singular future Piel, paragogic, from the root אָתַע [?]. אֶתְפָּאֵר, or ר: I will glory, first person singular future Hithpael, from the root פָּאַר. אֶתְפֹּשׂ: I will seize, first person singular future Kal, from the root תָּפַשׂ. אֶתְפַּלָּלָה, אֶתְפַּלֵּל: I will pray, first person singular future Hithpael, paragogic, from the root פָּלַל. אֶתֵּן: I will destroy, first person singular future Kal, from the root נָתַן. אָתְקוֹמְמָה: I am weary of, I am held in disgust, first person singular future Hithpael, paragogic, from the root קוּם. אָתְקֵךְ: I will pull you away, first person singular future Kal, with suffix, from the root נָתַק. אֶתֵּשׁ: I will pluck out, first person singular feminine future Kal, from the root נָתַשׁ.
