Rad. גָּאָה gloriatus est. venit turma, qu. בָּא בָּאנָד, vide R. בוא & גָּד cibi ejus, בְּנוֹ ipsorum, בָּנָם vide No. R. בָּנ cibus. in prædam, pro לְבַּז? No. Rad. בָּזַז diripuit. in erumpendo eo, בִּגִיחוֹ Job. 38.8. pro, בְּהִנִּיחוֹ Infin. Hiph. praef. aff. Rad. גּוּחַ in orbe, No. praef. בְּגַלְגַּל Rad. גָּלַל volvit. in deportare ipsum, בְּגְלוּתוֹ Jer. 27. 19. pro בְּהַגְלוּתוֹ Inf. Hiph. praef. aff. Rad. גָּלָה in guttare ipsorum, בְּגְרוֹנָם No. praef. & aff. R. גָּרַר secuit, vel גָּרָה miscere lites.
units.tr: in superbia, בְּגְאוֹת (read בִּגְאוּת) noun f., feminine construct, with prefix; from the root גָּאָה he was proud/exulted. He came, the troop, qu. בָּא (בָּאנָד) see root בוא and גָּד his food, בְּגוֹ of them, בָּנָם see noun and root בָּנ food. For plunder, for לְבַּז? Noun, from root בָּזַז he plundered. In breaking forth from him, בִּגִיחוֹ Job 38:8, for בְּהִנִּיחוֹ, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix and suffix, from root גּוּחַ in the circle, noun with prefix בְּגַלְגַּל, from root גָּלַל he rolled. In carrying them away, בְּגְלוּתוֹ Jer. 27:19, for בְּהַגְלוּתוֹ, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix and suffix, from root גָּלָה in their throats, בְּגְרוֹנָם noun, with prefix and suffix, from root גָּרַר he cut, or גָּרָה to stir up strife.

units.la: ב ד
units.tr: ב ד

units.la: solus, בְּדִי בְּדִים mendacia, No. R. בָּדָד solitarius fuit, & בָּדָא mentitus est. in loqui te, Inf. בְּרְכְּךָ Kal, praef. aff. R. דָּבַר in triturare ipsum, בְּרִישׁ Deut. 25. 4. pro, בְּהָרִישׁוֹ Infin. Hiph. praef. aff. Rad. דוּשׁ.
units.tr: alone, בְּדִי בְּדִים lies, noun, from root בָּדָד he was solitary, and בָּדָא he lied. In speaking to you, infinitive בְּרְכְּךָ Kal, with prefix and suffix, from root דָּבַר in threshing it, בְּרִישׁ Deut. 25:4, for בְּהָרִישׁוֹ, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix and suffix, from root דוּשׁ.

units.la: ב ה
units.tr: ב ה

units.la: בְּהַבִּיט[?] in intueri me, Infin. Hiph. praef. aff. R. נָבַט.
units.tr: בְּהַבִּיט[?] in looking at me, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix and suffix, from root נָבַט.

units.la: בְּהָגִיגִי in meditatione mea, No. sing. m. praef. & aff. Rad. הָגָה meditari.
units.tr: בְּהָגִיגִי in my meditation, noun, singular masculine, with prefix and suffix, from root הָגָה to meditate.

units.la: בְּהוּ inanitas, No. f. m. Rad. בָּהָה.
units.tr: בְּהוּ emptiness, noun, feminine/masculine, from root בָּהָה.

units.la: בְּהִוָּסְדָם[?] in consultando eos, Infin. Niph. praef. & aff. Rad. יָסַד fundavit.
units.tr: בְּהִוָּסְדָם[?] in consulting them, infinitive Niphal, with prefix and suffix, from root יָסַד he founded.

units.la: בְּהַוּרָתָהּ[?] in pravitate sua, No. f. faem. הַוָּה praef. aff. Rad. הָוָה fuit.
units.tr: בְּהַוּרָתָהּ[?] in her perversity, noun, feminine, הַוָּה with prefix and suffix, from root הָוָה he was.

units.la: בִּהְיוֹתוֹ in esse eum, Infin. Kal, praef. aff. Rad. הָיָה.
units.tr: בִּהְיוֹתוֹ in his being, infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix, from root הָיָה.

units.la: בְּהַפְרֵת in excindendo, Inf. Niph. praef. R. כָּרַת.
units.tr: בְּהַפְרֵת in cutting off, infinitive Niphal, with prefix, from root כָּרַת.

units.la: בְּהַדְּגוֹ[?] in lucere facere ipsum, Job. 29.3. pro, בְּהַהֲלוֹ, Infin. Hiph. praef. aff. Rad. הָלַל.
units.tr: בְּהַדְּגוֹ[?] in making it shine, Job 29:3, for בְּהַהֲלוֹ, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix and suffix, from root הָלַל.

units.la: בְּהַמִּיר in mutando, Inf. Hiph. praef. R. מוּר.
units.tr: בְּהַמִּיר in changing, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix, from root מוּר.

units.la: בְּהֶמְתָּם Jumentum eorum, f. f. constr. בְּהֶמַת, No. בְּהֵמָה, vel בְּהֶמֶת. Rad. inus. בהם.
units.tr: בְּהֶמְתָּם their cattle, feminine, construct בְּהֶמַת, noun בְּהֵמָה, or בְּהֶמֶת. Root unused, בהם.

units.la: בְּהַצְּתוֹ in certando ipsum, Infin. Hiph. praef. & aff. Rad. נָצָה.
units.tr: בְּהַצְּתוֹ in contending with him, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix and suffix, from root נָצָה.

units.la: בְּהִקָּבְּצוֹ[?] in congregando se, Inf. Niph. praef. R. קָבַץ.
units.tr: בְּהִקָּבְּצוֹ[?] in gathering himself, infinitive Niphal, with prefix, from root קָבַץ.

units.la: בְּהַקִּיץ[?] in evigilando, Inf. Hiph. praef. R. קִיץ.
units.tr: בְּהַקִּיץ[?] in awaking, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix, from root קִיץ.

units.la: בְּהָרֵג in occidi, Ezech. 26. 15. pro, בְּהַהָרֵג, Infin. Niph. praef. Rad. הָרַג.
units.tr: בְּהָרֵג in being slain, Ezek. 26:15, for בְּהַהָרֵג, infinitive Niphal, with prefix, from root הָרַג.

units.la: בְּהַשַּׁמָּה in desolari eam, Lev. 26. 43. pro, בְּהַשַּׁמָּה, vel pro, בְּהוּשַּׁמָּה Infin. Hoph. praef. aff. Rad. שָׁמַם.
units.tr: בְּהַשַּׁמָּה in its being desolated, Lev. 26:43, for בְּהַשַּׁמָּה, or for בְּהוּשַּׁמָּה, infinitive Hophal, with prefix and suffix, from root שָׁמַם.

units.la: בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ in judicari ipsum, Infin. Niph. praef. & aff. Rad. שָׁפַט.
units.tr: בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ in his being judged, infinitive Niphal, with prefix and suffix, from root שָׁפַט.

units.la: ב ן
units.tr: ב ן

units.la: בּוֹרְאָם affingens ea, Neh. 6. 8. vel, בְּרִאם, pro בּוֹרְאָם, Ben. Kal, f. m. m. aff. R. בָּרָא לִבְזֹּה ad diripiendum, Infin. Kal, Rad. בָּזַז. מְבֻכָּה flens, Lam. 1. 16. pro בֹּכָה, Ben. Kal, f. fæm. Rad. בָּכָה. בּוֹסִים conculcantes, Part. Kal, vel potius No. part. pl. m. R. בּוּס. בּוֹסְסוּ conculcaverunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. R. בּוּס. בּוּקָה vacuitas, No. f. fæm. à Rad. בּוּק. וּלְבָרֵר [?] & ad declarandum, Inf. Kal, præf. R. בָּרַר. בּוֹרְאָ creans, בּוֹרְאֶיךָ creantes te, Ben. Kal, f. m. & pl. m. aff. Rad. בָּרָא. בּוּשׁ, parag. בּוּשָׁה · בּוּשְׁ erubesce, בּוּשׁוּ erubesci-te, &c. Imper. Kal, f. m. & f. & pl. m. R. בּוּשׁ. בּוּסְכֶם conculcare vos, Infin. Kal, vel Piel, aff. Rad. בָּסַם [?]
units.tr: בּוֹרְאָם creating them, Neh. 6:8, or, בְּרִאם, for בּוֹרְאָם, participle Kal, masculine singular with suffix, from root בָּרָא. לִבְזֹּה to plunder, infinitive Kal, from root בָּזַז. מְבֻכָּה weeping, Lam. 1:16, for בֹּכָה, participle Kal, feminine, from root בָּכָה. בּוֹסִים treading down, participle Kal, or rather noun, masculine plural, from root בּוּס. בּוֹסְסוּ they trod down, preterite Piel, 3rd plural, from root בּוּס. בּוּקָה emptiness, noun, feminine, from root בּוּק. וּלְבָרֵר [?] and to declare, infinitive Kal, with prefix, from root בָּרַר. בּוֹרְאָ creating, בּוֹרְאֶיךָ creating you, participle Kal, masculine and masculine plural with suffix, from root בָּרָא. בּוּשׁ, paragogic בּוּשָׁה · בּוּשְׁ be ashamed, בּוּשׁוּ be ashamed, you, etc., imperative Kal, feminine and masculine plural, from root בּוּשׁ. בּוּסְכֶם to trample you, infinitive Kal or Piel, with suffix, from root בָּסַם [?]

units.la: בָּז
units.tr: בָּז

units.la: בָּזַז diripuit, בָּזוּ diripuerunt, (& pro eo) בָּזְאוּ Jes. 12. 2. præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. בָּזַז. בִּזָּה præda, No. f. fæm. Rad. בָּזַז. בָּזוּי spretus, Pahul Kal, f. m. R. בָּזָה sprevit. בָּזוּן contemptus, No. f. m. Rad. בָּזָה. בָּזִיתָ sprevisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. בָּזָה. בִּזְכָּרֵנוּ in recordando nos, Inf. Kal, præf. aff. R. זָכַר. בִּזְנוֹתֶךָ in scortari te, Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. זָנָה. בִּזִקִּים in compedibus, No. pl. m. præf. R. זָקַק fudit.
units.tr: בָּזַז he plundered, בָּזוּ they plundered, (and for it) בָּזְאוּ Isa. 12:2, preterite Kal, 3rd feminine singular and 3rd plural, from root בָּזַז. בִּזָּה plunder, noun, feminine, from root בָּזַז. בָּזוּי despised, Pual participle Kal, masculine singular, from root בָּזָה he despised. בָּזוּן contemptible, noun, masculine singular, from root בָּזָה. בָּזִיתָ you despised, preterite Kal, 2nd masculine singular, from root בָּזָה. בִּזְכָּרֵנוּ in remembering us, infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix, from root זָכַר. בִּזְנוֹתֶךָ in whoring you, infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix, from root זָנָה. בִּזִקִּים in fetters, noun, masculine plural with prefix, from root זָקַק he poured out.

units.la: ב ח
units.tr: ב ח

units.la: בְּחֻקַּי in diligere me, Inf. Kal, præf. & aff. R. חָבַב.
units.tr: בְּחֻקַּי in loving me, infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix, from root חָבַב.

units.la: בְּחֵינָיו Speculæ exploratoriæ ejus, pro בְּחוֹנָיו, pl. aff. m. à No. f. m. בָּחוֹן R. בָּחַן probavit.
units.tr: בְּחֵינָיו his watchtowers, for בְּחוֹנָיו, plural masculine with suffix, from noun masculine בָּחוֹן, root בָּחַן he tested.

units.la: בְּחָזוֹן in visione, No. f. m. præf. Rad. חָזָה.
units.tr: בְּחָזוֹן in vision, noun, masculine, with prefix, from root חָזָה.

units.la: בְּחַיַּי in vita mea, בְּחַיָּיו ejus, בְּחַיִּים in vita, &c. No. pl. m. aff. Rad. חָיָה vixit.
units.tr: בְּחַיַּי in my life, בְּחַיָּיו in his life, בְּחַיִּים in life, etc., noun, masculine plural with suffix, from root חָיָה he lived.

units.la: בְּחֵילְךָ, vel, בְּחֵילֵךְ in virtute tua, No. R. חַיִל præf. aff. m. & f.
units.tr: בְּחֵילְךָ, or, בְּחֵילֵךְ in your strength, noun, from root חַיִל, with prefix and suffix, masculine and feminine.

units.la: בְּחַלּוֹתָם in ægrotare ipsos, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. חָלָה.
units.tr: בְּחַלּוֹתָם in their being sick, infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix, from root חָלָה.

units.la: בְּחָלְיוֹ in morbo ejus, No. חָלִי, præf. aff. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: בְּחָלְיוֹ in his sickness, noun חָלִי, with prefix and suffix, from root חָלָה.

units.la: בְּחַמָּא in excandescentia, Dan. 11.44. No. f. fæm. præf. R. חָמַם incaluit.
units.tr: בְּחַמָּא in heat, Dan. 11:44, noun, feminine, with prefix, from root חָמַם he grew hot.

units.la: בְּחֶמְאָה in butyro, Job. 29.6. pro בְּחֶמְאָה, No. R. præf. חֶמְאָה butyrum.
units.tr: בְּחֶמְאָה in butter, Job 29:6, for בְּחֶמְאָה, noun, from root, with prefix, חֶמְאָה butter.

units.la: בְּחַמָּם in æstu eorum, בְּחַמּוֹ ejus, No. vel Inf. præf. & aff. Rad. חָמַם.
units.tr: בְּחַמָּם in their heat, בְּחַמּוֹ in his heat, noun or infinitive, with prefix and suffix, from root חָמַם.

units.la: בְּחַצִּי in medio, No. f. m. præf. Rad. חָצָה dimidiavit.
units.tr: בְּחַצִּי in the middle, noun, masculine, with prefix, from root חָצָה he halved.

units.la: בְּחֻקֹּתֶיךָ in statutis tuis, No. pl. m. & fæm. præf. & aff. Rad. חָקַק statuit.
units.tr: בְּחֻקֹּתֶיךָ in your statutes, noun, masculine and feminine plural, with prefix and suffix, from root חָקַק he decreed.

units.la: בַּחֲרוּת in ardere, Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. חָרָה.
units.tr: בַּחֲרוּת in burning, infinitive Kal, with prefix, from root חָרָה.

units.la: ב ט
units.tr: ב ט

units.la: בְּטֹחוֹת in renibus, No. pl. fæm. præf. R. טוּחַ obduxit.
units.tr: בְּטֹחוֹת in the kidneys, noun, feminine plural, with prefix, from root טוּחַ he daubed.

units.la: בְּטֶרֶם antequam, Rad. טֶרֶם cum præf.
units.tr: בְּטֶרֶם before, from root טֶרֶם with prefix.

units.la: בִּינוֹן in mærore, No. f. m. præf. R. יָנָה mærore affecit.
units.tr: בִּינוֹן in mourning, noun, masculine, with prefix, from root יָנָה he afflicted with grief.

units.la: בִּיוֹן in luto, No. f. m. constr. Rad. יוֹן, præf.
units.tr: בִּיוֹן in mire, noun, masculine, construct, from root יוֹן, with prefix.

units.la: בְּיָמֵי in diebus, בְּיָמַי meis, בְּיוֹמֵיהֶם ipsarum, No. pl. m. constr. aff. f. יוֹם pl. יָמִים.
units.tr: בְּיָמֵי in the days, בְּיָמַי in my days, בְּיוֹמֵיהֶם in their days, noun, masculine plural construct with suffix; feminine יוֹם, plural יָמִים.

units.la: בְּיָמִים in maribus, pl. m. præf. à sing. No. Rad. ימם.
units.tr: בְּיָמִים in the seas, masculine plural, with prefix, from the singular noun, root ימם.

units.la: בִּימִינְךָ in dextra tua, præf. aff. No. Rad. יָמִין
units.tr: בִּימִינְךָ in your right hand, with prefix and suffix, noun, from root יָמִין.

units.la: בִּינָה [?] בִּין intellige, בִּינוּ intelligite, Imper. Hiph. f. m. parag. & pl. m. Rad. בּוֹן.
units.tr: בִּינָה [?] בִּין understand, בִּינוּ understand, you, imperative Hiphil, masculine singular and masculine plural, paragogic, from root בּוֹן.

units.la: הַמְּבִינָתְךָ בִּינַת intelligentia, num ex intelligentia tua? est f. f. constr. aff. & præf. No. בִּינָה, R. בּוֹן.
units.tr: הַמְּבִינָתְךָ בִּינַת understanding, perhaps "from your understanding?" is feminine construct with suffix and prefix, noun בִּינָה, root בּוֹן.

units.la: בִּינוֹתַי considerāvi, Dan. 9.2. pro, הַבִּינוֹתִי, præt. Hiph. 1. f. Rad. בּוֹן.
units.tr: בִּינוֹתַי I considered, Dan. 9:2, for הַבִּינוֹתִי, preterite Hiphil, 1st singular, from root בּוֹן.

units.la: בִּיקָר in pretio, בִּיקָרוֹתָיךָ inter pretiosas tuas, No. f. m. præf. & pl. fæm. præf. & aff. R. יָקַר pretiosus fuit.
units.tr: בִּיקָר in price, בִּיקָרוֹתָיךָ among your precious things, noun, masculine, with prefix; feminine plural with prefix and suffix, from root יָקַר he was precious.

units.la: בִּירְאָתְךָ in timore, בִּירְאָה cum reverentia tua, No. constr. sing. fæm. יִרְאָה, præf. aff. Rad. יָרֵא timuit.
units.tr: בִּירְאָתְךָ in your fear, בִּירְאָה with your reverence, noun, feminine singular construct יִרְאָה, with prefix and suffix, from root יָרֵא he feared.

units.la: בִּירָנִיּוֹת [?] palatia, No. pl. fæm. No. Rad.
units.tr: בִּירָנִיּוֹת [?] palaces, noun, feminine plural, noun, root.

units.la: בִּיר putteus.
units.tr: בִּיר a well.

units.la: בִּירְקַרְק [?] in subfulvo, No. præf. Rad. יָרַק exspuit.
units.tr: בִּירְקַרְק [?] in yellowish, noun, with prefix, from root יָרַק he spat out.

units.la: בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ in salute ejus, תִּי mea, תֵּךְ [?] tua, &c. No. fæm. יְשׁוּעָה, præf. & aff. R. יָשַׁע salvavit.
units.tr: בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ in his salvation, בִּישׁוּעָתִי in my, בִּישׁוּעָתֵךְ in your, etc., noun feminine יְשׁוּעָה, with prefix and suffix, from root יָשַׁע he saved.

units.la: בִּישִׁימוֹן in solitudine, No. יְשִׁימוֹן, præf. Rad. יָשַׁם desolatus fuit.
units.tr: בִּישִׁימוֹן in the wilderness, noun יְשִׁימוֹן, with prefix, from root יָשַׁם he was desolate.

units.la: בִּיתָן palatium, No. f. m. à No. R. בַּיִת domus.
units.tr: בִּיתָן palace, noun, masculine, from the noun root בַּיִת house.

units.la: ב כ
units.tr: ב כ

units.la: בְּכָה in te, Psal. 41. 8. pro בְּךָ, &c. præf. בְּ in, & aff. ךָ te.
units.tr: בְּכָה in you, Ps. 41:8, for בְּךָ, etc., prefix בְּ in, and suffix ךָ you.

units.la: בָּכוּ flere, Jef. 22. 10. pro בָּכָה, Inf. Kal, בָּכוּ fleverunt, בָּכֵיתִי flevi, בָּכְתָה illa flevit, præt. Kal, 3. pl. & 1. f. ut & 3. sing. fæm. Rad. בָּכָה.
units.tr: בָּכוּ to weep, Jer. 22:10, for בָּכָה, infinitive Kal; בָּכוּ they wept, בָּכֵיתִי I wept, בְּכָתָה she wept, preterite Kal, 3rd plural and 1st singular, as well as 3rd feminine singular; from root בָּכָה.

units.la: בְּכוֹשְׁרוֹת [?] in compedibus, No. pl. fæm. cum כ, prop, à Rad. קָשַׁר [?] li-gavit, gavit, vel, simplici-ter, à Rad. בָּשַׁר re-ctum est.
units.tr: בְּכוֹשְׁרוֹת [?] in fetters, noun, feminine plural, with כ, properly from root קָשַׁר he bound, or, simply, from root בָּשַׁר it was right.

units.la: בְּכִי fletus meus, No. בְּכִי aff. Rad. בָּכָה flevit.
units.tr: בְּכִי my weeping, noun with suffix, from root בָּכָה he wept.

units.la: בָּכְיָנוּ flevimus, præt. Kal, 1. pl. R. בָּכָה.
units.tr: בָּכְיָנוּ we wept, preterite Kal, 1st plural, from root בָּכָה.

units.la: בִּכְיָתוֹ fletus ejus, No. sing. fæm. aff. R. בָּכָה. Item, בְּכוֹת fletus, No. f. fæm. R. בָּכָה.
units.tr: בִּכְיָתוֹ his weeping, noun, singular feminine with suffix, from root בָּכָה. Likewise, בְּכוֹת weeping, noun, feminine, from root בָּכָה.

units.la: בַּכָּסָה in statu feriæ, No. f. m. præf. Rad. כָּסָה texit, vel כָּסַס numeravit.
units.tr: Bakkasah, in the state of a feast: a feminine noun with prefix, from the root כָּסָה, "he covered," or כָּסַס, "he counted."

units.la: בְּכַפַּי in manibus meis, No. du. præf. aff. à f. כַּף, Rad. כָּפַף curvavit.
units.tr: Bekhappai, "in my hands": a dual noun with prefix and suffix, from the feminine כַּף, from the root כָּפַף, "he bent."

units.la: הַבְּכֵרוֹת præcocia, No. pl. fæm. præf. Rad. בכר.
units.tr: Habbekhorot, "early fruits": a plural feminine noun with prefix, from the root בכר.

units.la: וּבְכַשְּׁלוֹ in corruendo eo, Prov. 24. 17. pro, בְּהִכָּשְׁלוֹ, Inf. Niph. præf. aff. Rad. כָּשַׁל.
units.tr: Ubevkashlo, "and in his stumbling," Prov. 24. 17., for בְּהִכָּשְׁלוֹ, infinitive Niphal with prefix and suffix, from the root כָּשַׁל.

units.la: ב ל
units.tr: ב ל

units.la: בְּלִבִּי in corde meo, ǀ ejus, ם eorum, ךָ tuo, וְתָם ipsorum, &c. No. לְבָב præf. aff. à No. R. לֵבָב.
units.tr: Bilevbi, "in my heart"; with suffix ejus, "his"; eorum, "their"; ךָ, "your"; וְתָם, "their own," etc. A noun with prefix and suffix, from the noun לֵבָב, and the noun לְבָב.

units.la: לַבָּלָה effœtæ, No. f. fæm. præf. R. בָּלָה veterascit.
units.tr: Labbalah, "worn out": a feminine noun with prefix, from the root בָּלָה, "he grew old."

units.la: בְּלוּהוֹת turbationes, Jef. 17.14, No. pl. fæm. pro בְּהִלּוֹת, à Rad. בָּהַל turbavit, à fing. בָּלָהָה.
units.tr: Bilukhot, "dismays," Isa. 17. 14., a plural feminine noun, for בְּהִלּוֹת, from the root בָּהַל, "he dismayed," from the singular בָּלָהָה.

units.la: בָּלוּ veterascunt, בְּלוּתִי veterascere me, &c. 3. pl. præt. & Inf. Kal, aff. Rad. בָּלָה.
units.tr: Balu, "they grow old"; bileutti, "that I should grow old," etc.: third person plural perfect and infinitive Qal with suffix, from the root בָּלָה.

units.la: בְּלוּיִם, בְּלוּי, בְּלוּאֵי veteramenta, No. pl. m, Rad. בָּלָה veterascit.
units.tr: Beluyim, belui, beluai, "old garments": a plural masculine noun, from the root בָּלָה, "he grows old."

units.la: בְּלוּלוֹת mista, pl. fæm. Pahul, Kal, Rad. בָּלַל.
units.tr: Belulot, "mixed": a plural feminine, Pual participle, Qal, from the root בָּלַל.

units.la: לִבְלוֹם ad constringendum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. בָּלַם.
units.tr: Libelom, "to restrain": an infinitive Qal with prefix, from the root בָּלַם.

units.la: בְּלוֹת בְּלִים vetera, trita, No. pl. m. & fæm, Rad. בָּלָה.
units.tr: Belot, belim, "old, worn": a plural masculine and feminine noun, from the root בָּלָה.

units.la: לִבְלּוֹת ad consumendum, Infin. Piel, Rad. בָּלָה.
units.tr: Liblot, "to consume": an infinitive Piel, from the root בָּלָה.

units.la: בְּלוֹתִי , seu בַּלּוֹתִי perfudi , perfundere me , praet. Kal, 1. sing. vel, Infin. Kal, aff. à Rad. בָּלַל, vel Inf. Piel, aff. R. בָּלָה.
units.tr: Belotti, or ballotti, "I was drenched," "to drench myself": a first person singular perfect Qal, or infinitive Qal with suffix, from the root בָּלַל; or infinitive Piel with suffix, from the root בָּלָה.

units.la: בְּלִי non, particula Adv. à part. R. בַּל.
units.tr: Bli, "not": an adverbial particle, from the participle root בַּל.

units.la: בְּלִילָה nihilum, vide, in part. Rad. בַּל.
units.tr: Bililah, "nothing": see under the root בַּל.

units.la: בְּלֵילוֹת in noctibus , No. pl. à sing. No. Rad. לַיִל.
units.tr: Belelot, "in the nights": a plural noun, from the singular noun, from the root לַיִל.

units.la: בְּלִיַּעַל nequam, à בַּל, vel בְּלִי non, & שׁוּל? jugum, vel, יָעַל profuit, vide part. Rad. בָּל.
units.tr: Beliyaal, "worthless": from בַּל, or בְּלִי, "not," and שׁוּל, "yoke," or יָעַל, "he profited"; see under the root בָּל.

units.la: בְּלִיל farrago , No. f. m. Rad. בָּלַל miscuit.
units.tr: Belil, "mixture": a feminine and masculine noun, from the root בָּלַל, "he mixed."

units.la: בִּלְמְדִי in discere me, Inf. Kal, praef. aff. R. לָמַד.
units.tr: Bilmedi, "in my learning": an infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root לָמַד.

units.la: בִּלְעֲדֵי praeterquam , vide in Rad. בַּל non, vel בְּלַעֲדֵי absorpsit.
units.tr: Biladei, "except": see under the root בַּל, "not," or בְּלַעֲדֵי, "he swallowed up."

units.la: בִּלְתִּי , vide supra, בַּלּוֹתִי .
units.tr: Biltti, see above, Ballotti.

units.la: בִּלְתִּי excepto, vide in Rad. בַּ, ubi &, מִבִּלְתִּי praeterea quòd non, בִּלְתִּי absque te, &c.
units.tr: Biltti, "except": see under the root בַּ, where also מִבִּלְתִּי, "besides that not," and בִּלְתִּי, "without you," etc.

units.la: ב מ
units.tr: ב מ

units.la: בָּם in iis , &c. comp. ex praef. בְּ in , & aff. ם iis, &c.
units.tr: Bam, "in them," etc.: compounded of the prefix בְּ, "in," and the suffix ם, "them," etc.

units.la: בִּמֹאזְנַיִם in stateris, No. du. מֹאזְנַיִם, praef. R. אָזַן auris.
units.tr: Bimoznayim, "in balances": a dual noun מֹאזְנַיִם, with prefix, from the root אָזַן, "ear."

units.la: בְּמַאְרָב in insidiis, No. f. m. מַאְרָב, à R. אָרַב insidiatus est.
units.tr: Bemaarav, "in ambush": a masculine singular noun מַאְרָב, from the root אָרַב, "he lay in ambush."

units.la: בְּמְגוּרֵיהֶם in commoratione, ipsorum, No. מְגוּר, praef. & aff. à Rad. גּוּר commoratus fuit.
units.tr: Bemegureihem, "in their sojourning": the noun מְגוּר, with prefix and suffix, from the root גּוּר, "he sojourned."

units.la: בִּמְגִלַּת in volumine, No. f. faem. מְגִלָּה, constr. praef. Rad. גָּלַל volvit.
units.tr: Bimgillat, "in the scroll": a feminine noun, construct, מְגִלָּה, with prefix, from the root גָּלַל, "he rolled."

units.la: בַּמָּה in quo, comp. ex praef. בְּ, & מָה .
units.tr: Bammah, "in which": compounded of the prefix בְּ and מָה.

units.la: בְּמַהֲמֹרוֹת in foveis, No. pl. faem. מַהֲמֹרוֹת, praef. Rad. הָמַר.
units.tr: Bemahamorot, "in pits": a plural feminine noun מַהֲמֹרוֹת, with prefix, from the root הָמַר.

units.la: בְּמוֹ in, est comp. ex בְּ, in, & expletiva particula מוֹ.
units.tr: Bemo, "in": compounded of בְּ, "in," and the expletive particle מוֹ.

units.la: בְּמוֹעֲדֵיהֶם בְּמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם cum consiliis ipsorum, pl. fæm. præf. & aff. No. מוֹעֵצָה, Rad. יָעַץ consuluit. בָּמוֹת excelsa; בָּמוֹתִי mea, בָּמוֹתְךָ tua, בָּמוֹתוֹ ejus, בָּמוֹתֵי excelsa, pl. fæm. aff. constr. No. Rad. בָּמָה. בְּמֹתָיו in mortibus ejus, No. pl. m. præf. & aff. à s. מוֹת constr. מוֹת, R. מוּת, vel, No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. בָּמָה. בְּמַלְכוֹ in regnare ipsum, Inf. Kal, præf. & aff. R. מָלַךְ. בִּמְנִים in fidibus, No. pl. m. præf. R. מִנִּין [?] בְּמִצְוֹתָיו in præceptis ejus, pl. fæm. No. מִצְוָה Rad. צָוָה. בְּמְשִׁיחִי in unctis meis, No. pl. m. præf. & aff. à s. מָשִׁיחַ, Rad. מָשַׁח unxit. בְּמִשְׁכּוֹ in trahere ipsum, Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. מָשַׁךְ. בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם in pinguibus ipsorum, No. pl. m. præf. & aff. à s. מִשְׁמַן, Rad. שָׁמַן saginatus fuit. הַבָּמָתָה in excelsum illud, vide in No. Rad. בָּמָה. בְּמֵתִים in mortuis, pl. masc. præf. No. מֵת, Rad. מוּת mori. בְּמַתְּנֵינוּ in lumbis nostris, No. du. מָתְנַיִם præf. & aff. Rad. מָתַן.
units.tr: Bemoadeihem, bemoatzoteihem, "with their counsels": plural feminine nouns with prefix and suffix, from the noun מוֹעֵצָה, from the root יָעַץ, "he counselled." Bamot, "high places"; bamoti, "my high places"; bamotekha, "your high place"; bamoto, "his high place"; bamotei, "high places," feminine plural construct, from the noun בָּמָה. Bemotav, "in his deaths," a masculine plural noun with prefix and suffix, from the singular noun מוֹת, construct מוֹת, from the root מוּת; or a feminine plural noun with suffix, from the root בָּמָה. Bemalkho, "in his reigning," an infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root מָלַךְ. Bimnim, "on stringed instruments," a masculine plural noun with prefix, from the root מִנִּין [?]. Bemitzvotav, "in his commandments," a feminine plural noun, from the noun מִצְוָה, root צָוָה. Bemshichi, "in my anointed," a masculine plural noun with prefix and suffix, from the singular noun מָשִׁיחַ, root מָשַׁח, "he anointed." Bemishkho, "in his drawing," an infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root מָשַׁךְ. Bemishmanneihem, "in their fat things," a masculine plural noun with prefix and suffix, from the singular noun מִשְׁמַן, root שָׁמַן, "he was fattened." Habbamatah, "into that high place": see under the noun בָּמָה. Bemetim, "among the dead," a masculine plural with prefix, from the noun מֵת, root מוּת, "to die." Bemattenu, "in our loins," a dual noun מָתְנַיִם with prefix and suffix, from the root מָתַן.

units.la: ב נ בֵּן, vel בִּן filius, No. s. m. Rad. בָּנָה ædificavit. בִּן intelligens, &c. est part. Ben. Kal, Rad. בִּין, vel, בִּין. בְּנָאוֹת inhabitaculis amœ-nis, No. pl. fæm. præf. R. נָאָה, vel נָוָה. בִּנְגֹּעַ in attingere ipsum, Inf. Kal, præf. aff. R. נָגַע. בְּנֹה & בְּנוֹת ædificare
units.tr: Bar, bin, "son," a masculine singular noun, from the root בָּנָה, "he built." Bin, "understanding," etc.: a participle Qal Ben, from the root בִּין, or בִּין. Benaot, "pleasant dwellings," a feminine plural noun with prefix, from the root נָאָה, or נָוָה. Binggo'a, "in touching him," an infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root נָגַע. Benoh and benot, "to build,"

units.la: Inf. Kal, R. בָּנָה.
units.tr: Infinitive Qal, root בָּנָה.

units.la: filius ejus, No. בֵּן, aff. Rad. בָּנָה
units.tr: "His son," the noun בֵּן with suffix, root בָּנָה.

units.la: in nobis, comp. ex præf. בְּ, & aff. נוּ.
units.tr: "In us," compounded of the prefix בְּ and the suffix נוּ.

units.la: venimus, 1 Sam. 25. 8. (pro בָּאנוּ) præt. Kal, 1. pl. Rad. בוא.
units.tr: "We came," 1 Sam. 25. 8., for בָּאנוּ, perfect Qal, first person plural, root בוא.

units.la: edificarunt, vel intel-lexerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. בָּנָה vel, בין.
units.tr: "They built," or "they understood," perfect Qal, third person plural, root בָּנָה or בין.

units.la: ædificatus & בְּנוּיָה ædificata, Pahul, Kal, f. m. & fæm. Rad. בָּנָה
units.tr: "Built," and בְּנוּיָה, "built" (feminine), Pual, Qal, masculine and feminine, root בָּנָה.

units.la: in fugere ipsos, Inf. Kal, præf. aff. R. נוּס.
units.tr: "In fleeing them," an infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root נוּס.

units.la: בְּנוֹת filiæ, No. pl. fæm. abf. & constr. &c. à f. בַּת, R. בָּנָה.
units.tr: Benot, "daughters," a feminine plural noun, absolute and construct, etc., from the feminine noun בַּת, root בָּנָה.

units.la: וּבְנוּחַ & in quiescere ipsum, Num. 10. 36. pro וּבְנוּחוֹ; Inf. Kal, præf. & aff. cum ה R. נוּחַ.
units.tr: Ubenuach, "and in his resting," Num. 10. 36., for וּבְנוּחוֹ; infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, with ה, from the root נוּחַ.

units.la: in inclinare ipsum, בִּנְטוֹתִי me, &c. Inf. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. נָטָה.
units.tr: "In bending him," binṭoti, "me," etc.: an infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root נָטָה.

units.la: filius meus, No. f. aff.
units.tr: "My son," a feminine noun with suffix.

units.la: filii, No. pl. masc. constr. & בָּנִים filii, &c. ejus, בָּנֶיךָ tui, בְּנֵינוּ nostri, &c. cum aff. à sing. בֵּן; Item, בִּנְיָה, & בִּנְיָן ædificium, No. f. fæm. & masc. à Rad. בָּנָה.
units.tr: Banim, "sons," etc.: a masculine plural noun, construct, and banim, "sons," with suffix ejus, "his," banekha, "your," benenu, "our," etc., from the singular בֵּן. Likewise binyah and binyan, "building," a feminine and masculine noun, from the root בָּנָה.

units.la: בָּנִיתִי ædificavi, בָּנִינוּ ædificavimus, &c. præt. Kal, 1. sing. & pl. Rad. בָּנָה; item, בֹּנִים intelligentes; ut מְבִינִים, ab intelligentibus, vel prudentibus; est pl. m. part. Ben. Kal, à f. בִּין; & à Rad. בין, vel בִּין.
units.tr: Banitti, "I built," bananu, "we built," etc.: perfect Qal, first person singular and plural, root בָּנָה. Likewise bonim, "understanding," as mevinim, "by those who understand" or "the prudent"; a masculine plural participle Qal, from the feminine בִּין; and from the root בין, or בִּין.

units.la: בִּנְפְלָאוֹתָיו inter mirabilia ejus, ךָ tua, &c. Part. Niph. pl. fæm. præf. & aff. R. פָּלָא.
units.tr: Bin'pla'otav, "among his wonders," tua, "your," etc.: a plural feminine participle Niphal with prefix and suffix, from the root פָּלָא.

units.la: בִּנְקִיּוֹן in innocentia, No. f. m. præf. Rad. נָקָה mundus fuit.
units.tr: Binqiyyon, "in innocence": a masculine feminine noun with prefix, from the root נָקָה, "he was clean."

units.la: בְּנַשְׂאִי in portare me, Inf. Kal, præf. aff. R. נָשָׂא. בִּנְתָה [?] intellexisti, præt. 2. sing. m. parag. Kal, 2. sing. m. parag. Rad. בִּין [?]
units.tr: Benasi, "in my bearing": an infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root נָשָׂא. Binta [?], "you understood": second person masculine singular perfect with paragogic ending, Qal, root בִּין [?].

units.la: ב ם בְּמֶךָ [?] in turba mixta, No. f. m. præf. Rad. סָךְ [?] unxit. בְּסֻכָּה in tabernaculo, ejus, Pf. 27. 5. (pro סֻכּוֹ) No. f. fæm. סֻכָּה, præf. & f. m. כּוֹךְ [?], præf. & aff. à Rad. סָכַךְ [?] texit.
units.tr: Bemekha [?], "in the mixed crowd": a feminine masculine noun with prefix, from the root סָךְ [?], "he anointed." Besukkah, "in his tabernacle," Ps. 27. 5., for סֻכּוֹ: feminine noun סֻכָּה, with prefix, and masculine כּוֹךְ [?], with prefix and suffix, from the root סָכַךְ [?], "he covered."

units.la: ב ע בְּעֲבֹתִים in densis funibus, vide עֲבֹתִים [?]. בְּעָבִים in crassis nubibus, No. pl. m. præf. à R. עָב condensatus fuit. בְּעֵדֹתֶיךָ in cœtibus velte-stimoniis tuis, pl. fæm. præf. aff. No. עֵדָה; Rad. יָעַד indixit, vel עוּד testatus est. בְּעַרְתָּם in cœtu ipsorum, בְּעֵרַת in cœtu, vide עֵדָה. בְּעוֹלוֹת in holocaustis, pl. fæm. præf. No. עֹלָה [?] Rad. עָלָה scandit. בְּעָוֹן in iniquitate. No. f. m. constr. præf. R. עָוָה inique egit. בְּעָרְתְּךָ [?] conturbationes tuæ, No. pl. masc. constr. aff. Rad. בָּעָה conturbavit. בְּעִתְּתַנִי [?] perterruit me, præt. pih. 3. f. f. aff. R. בָּעַת. בְּעָזְּךָ [?] in robore tuo, No. עֹז, sing. m. præf. aff. Rad. עָזַז roboravit. בְּעָטְּךָ [?] cum obrueretur Thren. 2. 11. pro בְּהַעֲטֵף, Infin. Niph. præf. Rad. עָטַף. בְּעִי petitio, &c. No. f. m. Rad. בָּעָה petivit; vel, No. עִי cumulus, præf. Rad. עִיָּה. בַּעְיוּ quærite, Jer. 21. 12. Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. בָּעָה. בְּעִיר, & בָּעִיר in urbe, præf. cum No. R. עִיר. בְּעִר [?]
units.tr: Be'avotim, "in thick cords": see עֲבֹתִים [?]. Be'avim, "in thick clouds": a masculine plural with prefix, from the root עָב, "he was condensed." Be'edotekha, "in your assemblies, testimonies": feminine plural with prefix and suffix, from the noun עֵדָה, root יָעַד, "he appointed," or עוּד, "he testified." Be'arttam, "in their assembly," be'erat, "in the assembly": see עֵדָה. Be'olot, "in burnt offerings": feminine plural with prefix, from the noun עֹלָה [?], root עָלָה, "he ascended." Be'avon, "in iniquity": a masculine feminine noun, construct, with prefix, from the root עָוָה, "he acted perversely." Be'artekha [?], "your disturbances": a masculine plural construct noun with suffix, from the root בָּעָה, "he disturbed." Be'ittatani [?], "he terrified me": third person feminine perfect Piel with suffix, from the root בָּעַת. Be'ozzekha [?], "in your strength": masculine singular noun עֹז, with prefix and suffix, from the root עָזַז, "he strengthened." Be'atekha [?], "when he was overwhelmed," Lam. 2. 11., for בְּהַעֲטֵף, infinitive Niphal with prefix, from the root עָטַף. Be'i, "a petition," etc.: masculine feminine noun, from the root בָּעָה, "he asked"; or the noun עִי, "heap," with prefix, from the root עִיָּה. Ba'yu, "seek," Jer. 21. 12., imperative Qal, masculine plural, root בָּעָה. Be'ir and ba'ir, "in the city," with prefix, from the noun עִיר, root עִיר.

units.tr: Beshonai and beshurai: in my enemies, masculine plural with prefix and suffix, from the root שׂוּר, "he contemplated." Beseibah: in hoary old age, a feminine noun with prefix, from the root שׂוּב, "to grow grey." Beshichi: in my prayer, a masculine noun with prefix and suffix, from the root שׂוּחַ, "he spoke." Beshir: in the song, a masculine noun with prefix, from the root שִׁיר, "he sang." Beshalvi: in my tranquillity (Ps. 30.7), contracted for בְּשַׁלְוָתִי, a feminine noun in construct with prefix and suffix, from the root שָׁלָה, "he was tranquil." Beshalmei: in its peace, masculine plural with prefix and suffix, from the noun שָׁלוֹם, root שָׁלַם, "he had peace." Bishmei: in the heavens, masculine dual in construct with prefix, from the noun שָׁמַיִם. Bishmo'an: in hearing him; bishmeram: in keeping them; infinitives Qal with prefix and suffix, from the roots שָׁמַע and שָׁמַר. Bishnah: shame, a feminine noun, from the root בּוּשׁ. Bishnoto: in repeating it, infinitive Piel with prefix and suffix, from the root שָׁנָה. Bishpatekha: in judging you, infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, from the root שָׁפַט. Bishpatotekha: in your lips, the feminine plural שְׂפָתוֹת with suffix, taken from the feminine שְׂפָתָהּ, from the noun, root שָׂפָה. Bishpatav: in his lips; bishpatai: in my lips, dual with prefix and suffix, from the noun, root שָׂפָה. Bishrirah: in contemplation, a feminine noun with prefix, from the root שָׂרַר. Boshesh: he was delayed, third person masculine singular perfect Piel, from the root בָּשַׁשׁ. Boshti: my shame; boshtam: their shame, etc., a feminine noun, from בָּשָׁה with suffix, root בּוּשׁ.

units.la: ב ת
units.tr: ב ת

units.la: בַּת filia, qu. pro בִּנָּה, vel בִּנַּת, No. f. & à Rad. בָּנָה ædificavit.
units.tr: בַּת filia, a contracted form of בִּנָּה or בִּנַּת, a feminine noun from the root בָּנָה ædificavit [banah, "he built"].

units.la: בַּת bathus; est No. Rad.
units.tr: בַּת bathus; it is a noun from the root.

units.la: בַּתְבְּ pupilla, Ps. 17.8. qu. contracte pro כִּבַּת, constr. à No. Rad. fæm.
units.tr: בַּתְבְּ pupilla, Ps. 17.8. contracted from כִּבַּת, construct of a noun from the feminine root.

units.la: בְּתוּלָה virgo, f. fæm. constr. No. בְּתוּלָה; Item, בְּתוּלֵי virginitates, pl. m. constr. à No. pl. m. בְּתוּלִים, à R. בָּתַל [?]
units.tr: בְּתוּלָה virgo, feminine noun, construct form בְּתוּלָה; likewise בְּתוּלֵי virginitates, masculine plural construct of the plural noun בְּתוּלִים, from the root בָּתַל [?]

units.la: הַבְּתוּלוֹת desolationes, No. pl. fem. à f. fæm. בָּתָה, à R. בָּת, pro כּוּת; vide, Rad. בָּת, vel, בִּית.
units.tr: הַבְּתוּלוֹת desolationes, plural feminine noun from the feminine noun בָּתָה, from the root בָּת, for כּוּת; see the root בָּת or בִּית.

units.la: בָּתִים, forma pl. m. à sing. No. Rad. בַּת bathus.
units.tr: בָּתִים, masculine plural form of the singular; noun from the root בַּת bathus.

units.la: בָּתִּים domus, בֵּיתוֹ ejus, pl. m. & constr. aff. (qu. pro בְּנוֹתִים, à Rad. בָּנָה) à f. m. No. R. בַּיִת, constr. בֵּית.
units.tr: בָּתִּים houses, בֵּיתוֹ his, masculine plural and construct with suffix (perhaps for בְּנוֹתִים, from the root בָּנָה), from the masculine noun בַּיִת, construct בֵּית.

units.la: בָּתָם in integritate, No. sing. masc. præf. constr. No. תָּם; Rad. תָּמַם consumptus est.
units.tr: בָּתָם in integrity, a singular masculine noun with prefix, construct form from תָּם; root תָּמַם was consumed.

units.la: בְּתֻמִּים in integritate, No. f. m. præf. R. תָּמַם.
units.tr: בְּתֻמִּים in integrity, a masculine plural noun with prefix, from the root תָּמַם.

units.la: בְּתַקּוֹמְמִיךְ in insurgentes contrate, Ps. 139.21. pro בְּמִתְקוֹמְמֶךָ, part. Hithp. præf. aff. R. קוּם.
units.tr: בְּתַקּוֹמְמִיךְ against those who rise up against you, Ps. 139.21. for בְּמִתְקוֹמְמֶךָ, a participle of the Hithpael with prefix and suffix, from the root קוּם.

units.la: נ א
units.tr: נ א

units.la: נָא vallis, נָאָוָה valles, &c. vide in No. Rad.
units.tr: נָא valley, נָאָוָה valleys, etc.; see under the root.

units.la: נָא, in Rad. נָאָה [?]
units.tr: נָא, from the root נָאָה [?]

units.la: נָא, נָאָה excellens, נָאוֹת fastus, נָאִים superbi,
units.tr: נָא, נָאָה excellent, נָאוֹת pride, נָאִים proud,

units.la: נָאוֹת, נָאוֹן, נְאָוָה superbia, נְאוֹנִים superbi, &c. videantur omnia, in R. נָאָה [?]
units.tr: נָאוֹת, נָאוֹן, נְאָוָה pride, נְאוֹנִים proud, etc.; all these are to be consulted under the root נָאָה [?]

units.la: נָאָה extollere. Infin. Kal, נָאוּ extulerunt, 3. pl. præt. Rad. נָאָה
units.tr: נָאָה to lift up. Infinitive Kal; נָאוּ they lifted up, 3rd plural perfect, from the root נָאָה.

units.la: ג ב
units.tr: ג ב

units.la: נָב dorsum, gibbus, No. f. m. R. נָבִי נָבֵי dorsum meum, נָבְךָ fornix tu-us, id. No. aff. ibid. נָבְאֵי paludes ejus, No. pl. m. aff. à sing. No. Rad. נָבָא נָבָא fossa. נָבְהָא extitit se, Ezech. 31. 5. pro נָבְהָה præt Kal, 3. f. fæm. Rad. נָבָה נְבוֹת supercilia, נְבֵי eminentiæ, נְבְהֶם ipsorum, &c. No. pl. fæm. & m. aff. à f. נָב, R. נָבַב נְבִי locustæ, נְבִים locustæ, trabes, &c. No. pl. masc. Rad. נוב, & נָבֵב נְבְעֹל culmus, No. f. m. Rad. נבע scyphus.
units.tr: נָב back, hump, masculine noun from the root נָבִי; נָבֵי my back, נָבְךָ your vault, the same, with suffix, in the same place; נָבְאֵי its marshes, masculine plural with suffix from the singular noun, from the root נָבָא; נָבָא ditch. נָבְהָא it stood up, Ezek. 31.5, for נָבְהָה, perfect Kal, 3rd feminine singular, from the root נָבָה; נְבוֹת eyebrows, נְבֵי heights, נְבְהֶם their, etc., feminine and masculine plural nouns with suffix from the feminine noun נָב, root נָבַב; נְבִי locust, נְבִים locusts, beams, etc., masculine plural nouns from the root נוב, and נָבֵב; נְבְעֹל stalk, masculine noun from the root נבע bowl.

units.la: ג ג
units.tr: ג ג

units.la: נָנוּ tectum ejus, No. f. m. aff. נָוֹת tecta, pl. fæm. à No. Rad. נג [?]
units.tr: נָנוּ its roof, masculine noun with suffix; נָוֹת roofs, feminine plural from the noun of the root נג [?]

units.la: ג ד
units.tr: ג ד

units.la: נַד coriandrum, No. Rad. sing. masc. נַר turma, Unde בָּנַר venit turma, pro בְּאנַר No. f. m. Rad. נָגַר turmatim convenire. נָגַד hædus, נְגָדִים hædi, No. f. & pl. m. ut & נְדִיוֹתֶיךָ capellæ, tuæ, pl. fæm. aff. & נְדוֹת ripæ, נְדוֹתַי ripæ ejus, pl. fæm. aff. Rad. נָדָה hædus.
units.tr: נַד coriander, from the root; singular masculine noun נַר troop. Hence בָּנַר the troop came, for בְּאנַר, masculine noun from the root נָגַר to gather in troops. נָגַד kid, נְגָדִים kids, masculine noun and masculine plural, as also נְדִיוֹתֶיךָ your female goats, feminine plural with suffix; and נְדוֹת banks, נְדוֹתַי its banks, feminine plural with suffix, from the root נָדָה kid.

units.la: ג ה
units.tr: ג ה

units.la: נָה hic, iste, Ezech. 47. 13. pro זָה, No. Rad.
units.tr: נָה this, that, Ezek. 47.13, for זָה; from the root.

units.la: ג ו
units.tr: ג ו

units.la: נָו corpus, tergum, No. f. m. Rad. נָוָה. נָוִי locustæ, pl m. No. Rad. נוב נָוָה superbia, No. sing. fæm. Rad. נָאָה. נָוִי avulsor meus, No. sing. m. m. aff. Rad. נָוַו avulsit. נוּחִי, educ me, eductor meas, pro, נוּחִי Imper. Kal, f. fæm. & No. f. m. aff. Rad. נוּחַ edu-xit. נְוֵי corpus meam נוּךְ, נוּךְ ; item, נוּךְ tuam, נוּהֶם ipsorum, &c. No. f. m. נוּ, & נוּ corpus, aff. Rad. נָוָה. נְוִיָּה, נְוִית corpus, נְוִיוֹת corpora, נְוִיוֹתֵיהֶם sua, E-zech. 1. 11. No. f. & pl. fæm. aff. parag. R. נָוָה. נוּל, vel, גּוּל volve, Imper. Kal, sing. m. Rad. נָלַל. נוֹלָה migratio, No. f. fem. Rad. נָלָה migravit. נוֹעַ exspirans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. נָעַע exspira-vit. נוֹשׁ accede, Ruth. 2. 14. pro נֵשׁ, & נוֹשׁ accedi-te, Jos. 3. 9. pro נְשׁוּ Imper. Kal, f. fæm. & pl. masc. Rad. נָשַׁשׁ. נָאַל avulsit, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נוּ. נוּ, נוָה, נוּה vellus, נוּי vel-leru, &c. No f. m. & fæm. & pl. m. Rad. נָוָה totondit. נוּ tonde, Imper. Kal, f. fæm. Rad. נוּ. נוּית cæsura, pro נוּית, No. f. fæm. R. נָוָה.
units.tr: נָו body, back, masculine noun from the root נָוָה. נָוִי locusts, masculine plural from the root נוב. נָוָה pride, singular feminine noun from the root נָאָה. נָוִי my tearer, singular masculine noun with suffix from the root נָוַו tore away. נוּחִי, lead me, my leader, for נוּחִי, imperative Kal, feminine singular, and masculine noun with suffix, from the root נוּחַ led out. נְוֵי my body; נוּךְ your [suffix form]; likewise נוּךְ your, נוּהֶם their, etc., masculine noun נוּ, and נוּ body, with suffix, from the root נָוָה. נְוִיָּה, נְוִית body, נְוִיוֹת bodies, נְוִיוֹתֵיהֶם their own, Ezek. 1.11, feminine noun and feminine plural with suffix and paragogic ending, from the root נָוָה. נוּל, or גּוּל roll, imperative Kal, singular masculine, from the root נָלַל. נוֹלָה migration, feminine noun from the root נָלָה migrated. נוֹעַ breathing out, participle Kal, masculine singular, from the root נָעַע breathed out. נוֹשׁ draw near, Ruth 2.14, for נֵשׁ; and נוֹשׁ draw near, Josh. 3.9, for נְשׁוּ, imperative Kal, feminine singular and masculine plural, from the root נָשַׁשׁ. נָאַל tore away, perfect Kal, 3rd masculine singular, from the root נוּ. נוּ, נוָה, נוּה fleece, נוּי fleeces, etc., masculine and feminine nouns and masculine plural, from the root נָוָה shore. נוּ shear, imperative Kal, feminine singular, from the root נוּ. נוּית cutting, for נוּית, feminine noun, from the root נָוָה.

units.tr: ג ז

units.la: נַחֲלַת pruna, נַחֲלָתוֹ ejus, No. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. נָחַל.
units.tr: נַחֲלַת plum, נַחֲלָתוֹ its, singular feminine noun with suffix, from the root נָחַל.

units.la: ג ח
units.tr: ג ח

units.la: נַיְאוֹת vallis, נִיָּא vallis, נִיאוֹת valles, נִיאוֹתֶיךָ tae, &c. No. f. m. ut & pl. fæm. aff. No. R. נַיָּא.
units.tr: נַיְאוֹת valley, נִיָּא valley, נִיאוֹת valleys, נִיאוֹתֶיךָ your, etc., masculine nouns and feminine plural with suffix, from the noun נַיָּא.

units.la: ג י
units.tr: ג י

units.la: גִיל exsulta, exsultare, Joel 2. 23. Imper. vel Infin. Hiph. pro הָגִיל, נִילִי exsulta, fæm. נִילוּ exsul-
units.tr: גִיל exult, to exult, Joel 2.23, imperative or infinitive Hiphil, for הָגִיל; נִילִי exult, feminine; נִילוּ exult,

units.la: exsultate, pro הָגִילוּ, &c. Imper. fing. fæm. & pl. m. Hiph. Rad. גּוּל.
units.tr: exult, for הָגִילוּ, etc., imperative, feminine singular and masculine plural Hiphil, from the root גּוּל.

units.la: גִּיל, No. f. m. גִּילָה גִּילַת exsultatio, f. fæm. absol. & constr. Rad. גּוּל.
units.tr: גִּיל, masculine noun; גִּילָה גִּילַת exultation, feminine noun, absolute and construct, from the root גּוּל.

units.la: כְּגִילְכֶם secundùm similitudinem vestram, No. R. גִּיל, præf. & aff.
units.tr: כְּגִילְכֶם according to your likeness, from the root גִּיל, with prefix and suffix.

units.la: ג ל
units.tr: ג ל

units.la: גַּלretege, Pf. 119.22. Imper. Piel, f. m. per apoc. pro גָּלָּה, à Rad. גָּלָה.
units.tr: גַּלuncover, Ps. 119.22, imperative Piel, feminine singular masculine, by apocope, for גָּלָּה, from the root גָּלָה.

units.la: גַּלvolve, volvere, volvit, Imper. Kal, f. m. vel Infin. vel præt. Kal, 3. f. m. Pf. 22.9. (quasi contractè ex forma præt. Kal, גָּלוּל,) vel Ben. Kal, pro גּוּלּ, vel No. adject. à Rad. גָּלַל, contr. גַּל, vel, גֹּל.
units.tr: גַּלroll, to roll, rolled, imperative Kal, masculine singular, or infinitive, or perfect Kal, 3rd masculine singular, Ps. 22.9 (as if contracted from the perfect form Kal, גָּלוּל), or participle Kal, for גּוּלּ, or an adjective from the root גָּלַל, contracted גַּל or גֹּל.

units.la: גַּלacervus, No. f. m. R. גָּלַל.
units.tr: גַּלheap, masculine noun, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: גַּלְגַּלrota, גִּלְגֹּלֶתcalvaria, &c. No. f. m. & fæm. Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: גַּלְגַּלwheel, גִּלְגֹּלֶתskull, etc., masculine and feminine nouns, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: וְגִלְגַּלְתִּיךָ & devolvam te, Jer. 51.25. præt. Piel, geminatum, in 1. f. Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: וְגִלְגַּלְתִּיךָ and I will roll you, Jer. 51.25, perfect Piel with doubling, 1st singular, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: גָּלָה lenticula, גִּלּוֹת lenticula, גִּלַּת lenticula, No. f. fæm. & pl. fæm. & constr. Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: גָּלָה lentil, גִּלּוֹת lentil, גִּלַּת lentil, feminine noun, feminine plural and construct, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: גֹּלּוּ volvite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: גֹּלּוּ roll, imperative Kal, masculine plural, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: גָּלוּ revelárunt, exsultárunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. גָּלָה vel גּוֹל ; sed accentus distinguit.
units.tr: גָּלוּ they uncovered, they exulted, perfect Kal, 3rd plural, from the root גָּלָה or גּוֹל; but the accent distinguishes them.

units.la: גָּלוּת deportatio, No. f. fæm. Rad. גָּלָה.
units.tr: גָּלוּת deportation, feminine noun, from the root גָּלָה.

units.la: גָּלוֹתִי volvi, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: גָּלוֹתִי I was rolled, perfect Kal, 1st singular, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: גַּלֵּיךָ fluctus tui, גַּלִּים fluctus, &c. No. pl. m. aff. à f. גַּל, Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: גַּלֵּיךָ your waves, גַּלִּים waves, etc., masculine plural with suffix from the feminine noun גַּל, root גָּלַל.

units.la: גִּלִּיתִי revelásti, גִּלִּיתִי revelavi, &c. præt. Piel, 2. f. m. & 1. f. R. גָּלָה, Piel, גָּלָּה.
units.tr: גִּלִּיתִי you revealed, גִּלִּיתִי I revealed, etc., perfect Piel, 2nd masculine singular and 1st singular, from the root גָּלָה, Piel גָּלָּה.

units.la: גִּלָּיוֹן volumen, No. f. m. Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: גִּלָּיוֹן scroll, masculine noun, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: גִּלְיוֹנִים specula, No. pl. m.
units.tr: גִּלְיוֹנִים mirrors, masculine plural noun.

units.la: Rad. גָּלָה
units.tr: Root גָּלָה

units.la: secundum similitudinem vestram, vide כְּגִילְכֶם [?]
units.tr: according to your likeness, see כְּגִילְכֶם [?]

units.la: גָּלְתָה deportatur, præt. Pual, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. גָּלָה, in Pual, גֻּלָּה.
units.tr: גָּלְתָה is deported, perfect Pual, 3rd singular feminine, from the root גָּלָה, in Pual גֻּלָּה.

units.la: וְרַגְלְתִי & exsultavi, præt. Kal, 1. s. Rad. גּוּל.
units.tr: וְרַגְלְתִי and I exulted, perfect Kal, 1st singular, from the root גּוּל.

units.la: ג נ
units.tr: ג נ

units.la: גִּנְבָּהּ ea surripuit illum, pro גִּנְבָּהוּ, illa, præt. Kal, 3. s. f. גָּנְבָה cum aff. גָּנְבָתִי furto ablatum, pro גְּנֻבַת Pahul Kal, f. f. cum Jod parag. sed גָּנְבְּתִי furto surreptus sum, & גָּנוֹב furando, præt. Pyh. 1. s. & inf. Pyh. à גָּנַב furatus est.
units.tr: גִּנְבָּהּ she stole him, for גִּנְבָּהוּ, her, perfect Kal, 3rd singular feminine; גָּנְבָה with suffix; גָּנְבָתִי stolen by theft, for גְּנֻבַת, Pual/Pahul Kal, feminine, with paragogic Yod, but גָּנְבְּתִי I was stolen, and גָּנוֹב stealing, perfect Pual, 1st singular, and infinitive Pual, from גָּנַב he stole.

units.la: גַּן, גִּנָּה hortus, גַּנּוֹת horti, גַּנָּה hortus, גַּנִּי meus, גַּנֵּיהֶם horti, &c. No. f. & pl. m. & fæm. & s. m. aff. Rad. גָּנַן.
units.tr: גַּן, גִּנָּה garden, גַּנּוֹת gardens, גַּנָּה garden, גַּנִּי my, גַּנֵּיהֶם their gardens, etc., feminine and plural masculine and feminine nouns and singular masculine with suffix, from the root גָּנַן.

units.la: גַּנֵּן protegendo, Infin. Kal,
units.tr: גַּנֵּן protecting, infinitive Kal,

units.la: וְרָנּוֹתִי & protexi, præt. Kal, 1. s. Rad. גָּנַן
units.tr: וְרָנּוֹתִי and I protected, perfect Kal, 1st singular, from the root גָּנַן.

units.la: גַּנְזֵיהוּ gazophylacia ejus, No. pl. m. cum aff. à s. גָּנוּז, Rad. גָּנַז thesaurus,
units.tr: גַּנְזֵיהוּ his treasuries, masculine plural nouns with suffix, from the singular גָּנוּז, root גָּנַז treasure.

units.la: ג ע
units.tr: ג ע

units.la: גַּע percute, Imper. Kal, s. m. R. גָּנַע.
units.tr: גַּע strike, imperative Kal, masculine singular, from the root גָּנַע.

units.la: נָּעָה mugire, 1 Sam. 6, 12. pro נָּעָה, Infin. Kal, R. נָּעָה.
units.tr: נָּעָה to low, 1 Sam. 6.12, for נָּעָה, infinitive Kal, from the root נָּעָה.

units.la: כְּנַעַת juxta attingere, לְנַעַת ad attingendum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. נָּגַע.
units.tr: כְּנַעַת to touch near, לְנַעַת for touching, infinitive Kal, with prefix, from the root נָּגַע.

units.la: ג פ
units.tr: ג פ

units.la: גְּפוֹ corpus ejus, גְּפֵי corpora, &c. s. m. aff. & pl. m. constr. No. גַּף, R. גָּפַף.
units.tr: גְּפוֹ his body, גְּפֵי bodies, etc., masculine singular with suffix and masculine plural construct, from the noun גַּף, root גָּפַף.

units.la: ג ר
units.tr: ג ר

units.la: גָּר commoratus fuit, commorans, peregrinus, præt. Kal, s. m. & Ben. Kal, vel, No. adj. s. m.
units.tr: gār, dwelt as a sojourner, dwelling as a stranger, a sojourner: preterite, Kal, masc. sing., and Ben. Kal, or, adjective, masc. sing.

units.la: נָר [?] peregrinus, No. f. m; & נָרִים, vel נָרִים, pl. m. Rad. נור [?]
units.tr: nār [?], a sojourner: noun, fem. and masc.; and nārīm, or nārīm, masc. plural. Root nūr [?].

units.la: נָרָה [?] ruinam [?], נָרָן guttur, [illegible, ~5 letters], נָרָם [?] eorum, נָרָה hospitium, נָרוֹת faux, &c. omnia nomina Rad. נור, vel, נָרָה [?]
units.tr: nārāh [?], ruin [?]; nārān, throat; [illegible, about 5 letters]; nārām [?], of them; nārāh, inn; nārōt, jaw, etc.: all nouns from the root nūr, or nārāh [?].

units.la: נָרְתִּי commoratus sum, נָרְתֶּם commorati estis, &c. praet. Kal, 1. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נור [?]
units.tr: nārtī, I have dwelt; nārtem, you have dwelt, etc.: preterite, Kal, first person singular and second person plural, masc. Root nūr [?].

units.la: נָשׁ accede, נָשׁוּ accedite, &c. Imper. Kal, f. m. & fem. & pl. m. à Rad. נגש approxinquavit.
units.tr: nāsh, draw near; nāshū, draw near, etc.: imperative, Kal, masc. and fem. singular and masc. plural, from the root nagash, he approached.

units.la: נִגְשָׁה [?] accedere, נִגְשָׁו ejus, נִגְשָׁם ipsorum, &c. Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. נגש
units.tr: nigshāh [?], to approach; nigshāw, his; nigshām, their, etc.: infinitive, Kal, with suffixes. Root nagash.

units.la: נ ת
units.tr: נ ת

units.la: נָתוֹת torcular, נָתוֹת torcula-ria, &c. No. f. & pl. fem. Rad. נתת [?]
units.tr: nātōt, wine-press; nātōt, wine-presses, etc.: noun, fem. and fem. plural. Root nātat [?].

units.la: [illegible, ~5 letters] lumbæ, à Rad. נָנָה fraude oppressit.
units.tr: [illegible, about 5 letters] loins, from the root nānāh, he oppressed by fraud.

units.la: רִבַּת infamia, דִּבָּתָם infamia ipsorum, No. f. fem. constr. aff. Rad. דבב
units.tr: ribbat, infamy; dibbātām, their infamy: noun, fem. sing., construct with suffix. Root dibb.

units.la: נָדָג [?] piscis, Nehem. 13. 16. pro דָּג, No. f. m. R. דוג piscari.
units.tr: nādag [?], fish, Nehemiah 13:16, for dāg; noun, masc. sing. Root dūg, to fish.

units.la: ד ב
units.tr: ד ב

units.la: דֹּב ursi, דֻּבִּים ursi, No. sing. & pl. masc. Rad. דָּבַב locutus fuit.
units.tr: dōb, of bears; dubbīm, bears: noun, sing. and masc. plural. Root dābab, he spoke.

units.la: דִּבָּה infamia, No. sing. fem. Rad. דָּבַב
units.tr: dibbāh, infamy: noun, sing. fem. Root dābab.

units.la: דִּבְיוֹנִים stercus columbarum, No. pl. m. constr. ex No. Rad. דִּיב stercus, & No pl. m. יוֹנִים co-
units.tr: dibyōnīm, pigeon dung: noun, masc. plural, construct from the noun dīb, dung, and the masc. plural noun yōnīm, doves.

units.la: דָּג piscis, דָּגִים pisces, דָּגָה piscis, &c. No. f. & pl. m. ut & No f. fem. R. דוג
units.tr: dāg, fish; dāgīm, fishes; dāgāh, fish, etc.: noun, masc. and plural; likewise a noun, fem. sing. Root dūg.

units.la: דָּגַיִם pisces, No. pl. m. constr. & דָּגָם piscis, דָּגָם ipsorum, sing. fem. constr. aff. Rad. דוג
units.tr: dāgayim, fishes: noun, masc. plural, construct; and dāgām, fish; dāgām, their fish: fem. sing., construct with suffix. Root dūg.

units.la: ד ד
units.tr: ד ד

units.la: דד
units.tr: דד

units.la: דָּדַיִךְ ubera tua, No. du. aff. à s. No. R. דד mam-ma.
units.tr: dadayikh, your breasts: noun, dual, with suffix, from the sing. noun. Root dad, breast.

units.la: דו
units.tr: דו

units.la: דּוֹב ursus, No. s. masc. Rad. דָּבַב.
units.tr: dōb, bear: noun, sing. masc. Root dābab.

units.la: דָּג piscator, No. s. m, & דֹּגָה piscatio, sing. fæm. Rad. דּוּג.
units.tr: dāg, fisher: noun, sing. masc.; and dōgāh, fishing, sing. fem. Root dūg.

units.la: דַּוִי languidum, דַּוִי languor, No. s. m. & דַּוּוֹת languor, sing. fæm. Rad. דָּוֶה languidus.
units.tr: dawi, faint; dawi, faintness: noun, sing. masc.; and dawwōt, faintness, sing. fem. Root dāweh, faint.

units.la: הַדּוּכִיפַת gallus sylvestris, No. s. fæm. vide in Rad. דָּכָה tutudit, vel הַדָּכָּה [?].
units.tr: haddūkīfat, wild cock: noun, sing. fem. See under the root dākah, he crushed, or hadākāh [?].

units.la: דּוֹמָה silentium, No. s. fæm. & דּוֹמָם silens, s. m. Rad. דָּם silui.
units.tr: dōmāh, silence: noun, sing. fem.; and dōmām, silent: sing. masc. Root dām, I was silent.

units.la: דּוֹמָה similis est, Ben. Kal, s. m. Rad. דָּמָה.
units.tr: dōmāh, is like: Ben. Kal, sing. masc. Root dāmāh.

units.la: דּוֹמוּ ; vel דְּמוּ silete, item, דּוּמִי sile, Imper. Kal, pl. m. & s. fæm. à R. דָּמַם.
units.tr: dōmū, or dəmū, be silent; likewise dūmī, be silent: imperative, Kal, plural masc. and sing. fem., from the root dāmam.

units.la: דָּמַם.
units.tr: dāmam.

units.la: דּוּמִיָּה silentium, No. s. fæm. Rad. דָּמָה.
units.tr: dūmiyyāh, silence: noun, sing. fem. Root dāmāh.

units.la: דּוֹמַמְתִּי silui, præt. Piel, seu Poel, 1. s. Rad. דּוֹם vel דַּמֵּם.
units.tr: dōmamtī, I was silent: preterite, Piel or Poel, first person singular. Root dōm or dammēm.

units.la: שֶׁדִּין quod judicium est, No. s. m. præf. שׁ; R. דִּין judicavit.
units.tr: shedīn, that is judgment: noun, sing. masc., with prefix shin; root dīn, he judged.

units.la: דּוּשָׁם tritare ipsos [?], Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. דּוּשׁ.
units.tr: dūshām, to thresh them [?]: infinitive, Kal, with suffix. Root dūsh.

units.la: דח
units.tr: דח

units.la: דְּחָה, & דְּחוֹת Infin. Kal, דָּחָה impellere, דָּחוּה impellitur, (pro דָּחָה,) דָּחוּ impelluntur, præt. Pual, 3. s. m. & 3. pl. Rad. דָּחָה.
units.tr: dəhāh, and dəhōt: infinitive, Kal; dāhāh, to thrust; dāhūh, is thrust (for dāhāh); dāhū, they are thrust: preterite, Pual, third person singular masc. and third person plural. Root dāhāh.

units.la: הַדְּחוּיָה impulsa, Pahul, Kal, sing. fæm, Rad. דָּחָה.
units.tr: hadhəwiyyāh, thrust: Pahul, Kal, sing. fem. Root dāhāh.

units.la: דְּחִי impulsio, à lapsu, No. sing. m. דְּחִיָּתִי impulisti me, præt. Kal, 2. s. m. aff. R. דָּחָה.
units.tr: dəhī, thrusting, from a fall: noun, sing. masc.; dəhiyyātī, you have thrust me: preterite, Kal, second person singular masc., with suffix. Root dāhāh.

units.la: ד י
units.tr: d y

units.la: רִ, רַי, constr. רֵי sufficien-tia, לְמַדֵּי? ad sufficientiam, 2. Paral. 30.3. (pro לְמַדֵּי?, pleonasmus præf.) רִם ipsorum, No. Rad. f. m. præf. & aff.
units.tr: rī, ray, construct rē, sufficiency; lemaddē?, to sufficiency, 2 Chronicles 30:3 (for lemaddē?, with prefixed pleonasm); rim, of them: noun, fem. and masc., with prefix and suffix. Root [?].

units.la: דָּג piscator, דָּגִים piscatores, No. f. & pl. masc. Rad. דּוּג.
units.tr: dāg, fisher; dāgīm, fishers: noun, fem. and masc. plural. Root dūg.

units.la: וְדִינוּם & piscabuntur ipsos, Jerem 16.16. (pro וְהַדִּינוּם) præt. Hiph. 3. pl. aff. Rad. דּוּג.
units.tr: wədīnūm, and they will fish them, Jeremiah 16:16 (for wəhadīnūm): preterite, Hiphil, third person plural, with suffix. Root dūg.

units.la: דִּיּוֹת milvi, No. pl. fœm. à f. No. דִּיָּה; ut & דִּיָּה atramentum, No. f. m. Rad. דִּיָּה.
units.tr: dīyōt, kites: noun, fem. plural, from the fem. noun dīyāh; likewise dīyāh, ink: noun, fem. masc. Root dīyāh.

units.la: דִּין judicium, דִּין judex, No. f. m. Rad. דִּין.
units.tr: dīn, judgment; dayyān, judge: noun, fem. masc. Root dīn.

units.la: דִּין judicare, (pro הַדִּין,) & לְדִין ad judicandum, (pro לְהַדִּין,) Inf. Hiph. Rad. דִּין.
units.tr: dīn, to judge (for hadīn), and ləḏīn, to judging (for ləhadīn): infinitive, Hiphil. Root dīn.

units.la: דִּין judica, Job. 35.14. (pro הַדִּין,) Imper.
units.tr: dīn, judge, Job 35:14 (for hadīn): imperative.

units.la: Hiph. f. m. ut & דִּינוּ judicate, (pro הַדִּינוּ,) pl. m. Rad. דִּין.
units.tr: Hiphil, fem. masc.; likewise dīnū, judge (for hadīnū), plural masc. Root dīn.

units.la: דִּינִי judicium meum; judica, No. f. m. דִּין, aff. vel, Imper. Hiph. f. fœm. Rad. דִּין.
units.tr: dīnī, my judgment; judge: noun, fem. masc. dīn, with suffix; or imperative, Hiphil, fem. fem. Root dīn.

units.la: דִּיק antemurale, No, Rad. sing. masc.
units.tr: dīq, bulwark: noun, root sing. masc.

units.la: דִּישׁ trituratio, בְּדִישׁוֹ in triturationesua, No. f. m. præf.& aff. ut & דִּישׁ tritura, & דִּישׁן pygargus, No. f. m. Rad. דּוּשׁ trituravit.
units.tr: dīsh, threshing; bədīshō, in his threshing: noun, fem. masc., with prefix and suffix; likewise dīsh, threshing-floor, and dīshan, pygarg: noun, fem. masc. Root dūsh, he threshed.

units.la: ד כ
units.tr: d k

units.la: דָּךְ tutudit, דָּכוּ tutude-runt, præt. Kal, f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. דּוּךְ.
units.tr: dākh, he crushed; dākū, they crushed: preterite, Kal, fem. masc. and third plural. Root dūk.

units.la: דָּךְ attrivit, m. רָכָּה attrivit, f. דָּכוּ attrive-runt, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & fœm & 3.pl, Rad. דָּכַךְ.
units.tr: dākh, he crushed, masc.; dākhāh, she crushed, fem.; dākū, they crushed: preterite, Kal, third person masc. and fem. and third plural. Root dākhakh.

units.la: דָּךְ attritus, דַּכִּים, pauperes, דַּכִּי ejus, No. f. m. & pl. m. aff,
units.tr: dākh, crushed; dakkīm, poor; dakkī, his: noun, fem. masc. and plural masc., with suffix.

units.la: Rad. דָּכָּה.
units.tr: Root dākāh.

units.la: דָּכְּי contritio, דָּכֵיהֶם eorum, No. f. m. aff. R. דָּכָּה.
units.tr: dakkī, contrition; dakkēyhem, their: noun, fem. masc., with suffix. Root dākāh.

units.la: דָּכִּיתָ attrivisti, דְּכִיתָנוּ nos, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. דָּכָּה.
units.tr: dakkītā, you have crushed; dəkhītānū, us: preterite, Piel, second person fem. masc., with suffix. Root dākāh.

units.la: ד ל
units.tr: D L

units.la: דָּלַל exhausit, m. דָּלָה fæm. דָּלוּ exhauserunt, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & fæm. & 3. pl. R. דָּלַל.
units.tr: DALAL exhausted, m. DALAH fem. DALU they exhausted, perf. Qal, 3rd sing. m. & fem. & 3rd pl. Root DALAL.

units.la: דָּל ostium, דָּלָה penicula-mentum, דָּלוֹת penicu-lamenta, No. f. m. & f. & pl. fæm. R. דָּלַל, vel דָּלַת ostium.
units.tr: DAL door, DALAH bucket, DALOT buckets, noun, sing. m. & f. & pl. fem. Root DALAL, or DALATH door.

units.la: דָּלְנוּ attenuamur, דָּלוֹתָ attenuatus es, דָּלוֹתִי attenuatus sum, præt. Kal, 1. pl. & 2. sing. masc. ut & 1. f. Rad. דָּלַל.
units.tr: DALNU we are reduced, DALOTA you were reduced, DALOTI I was reduced, perf. Qal, 1st pl. and 2nd sing. masc., as also 1st sing. fem. Root DALAL.

units.la: דָּלִי situla, מִדְּלָיו è situlis ejus, No. f. m. & du. vel, pl. m. præf. aff. Rad. דָּלָה hausit.
units.tr: DALI bucket, MIDDALAV out of his buckets, noun, fem. m. & du. or pl. m., prefix & suffix. Root DALAH drew water.

units.la: דָּלְיוּ hauserunt, Prov. 26. 7. elevate, est vel, præt.
units.tr: DALEYU they drew water, Prov. 26. 7. lift up, is either perf.

units.la: Kal. 3. pl. vel, Imper. Piel, pl. m. R. דָּלָה.
units.tr: Qal, 3rd pl., or imperative Piel, pl. m. Root DALAH.

units.la: דְּלוֹת propagines (quasi à sing. דָּלִית,) דְּלוֹתָיו ejus, No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. דָּלָה evexit.
units.tr: DELOT shoots (as if from the sing. DALIT), DELOTAV his, noun, pl. fem., suffix. Root DALAH raised.

units.la: דַּלִּים tenues, No. pl. m. à sing. דַּל, vel דָּל, Rad. דָּלַל attenuari.
units.tr: DALIM poor, noun, pl. m. from the sing. DAL, or DAL, Root DALAL to be brought low.

units.la: דָּלִיתָנִי attenuasti me, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. דָּלַל.
units.tr: DALITANI you have brought me low, perf. Piel, 2nd sing. m., suffix. Root DALAL.

units.la: דַּלְתָּ peniculus, וּמִדַּלְתּ ex tenuitate, No. f. fæm. constr. præf. Rad. דָּלַל.
units.tr: DALTA a sieve, UMIDDALT and from poverty, noun, fem., construct, prefix. Root DALAL.

units.la: דְּלָתוֹת, דְּלָתֵי, דְּלָתַיִם valvæ, No. du. masc. & pl. fæm. à sing. No. Rad. דָּלַת ostium.
units.tr: DELOTOT, DELATAI, DELATAYIM leaves (of a door), noun, dual masc. & pl. fem. from the sing. noun. Root DALATH door.

units.la: ד מ
units.tr: D M

units.la: דָּם vel רוֹם subsiste, דָּמוּ subsistite, Imper. Kal, f. & pl. m. Rad. דָּמַם.
units.tr: DAM or ROM be still, DAMU be still (pl.), Imper. Qal, f. & pl. m. Root DAMAM.

units.la: דָּמוּ, vel דָּמְּ conticuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. דָּמַם.
units.tr: DAMU, or DAMM they were silent, perf. Qal, 3rd pl. Root DAMAM.

units.la: דָּמוּ siluerunt, præt. Kal, 3.

units.tr: BHAABQO in wrestling with him, Infin. Niph., suffix. Root ʾBQ dust. HAAZRUSh whether by consulting, Ezek. 14:3. for HHRSh, Infin. Niph., interrogative prefix. Root DRSh. HAAZIN he gave ear, perf. Hiph. 3rd sing. m. HAAZIN attend, paragogic HAAZINH, imper. Hiph. f. m., and HAAZINU attend ye, pl. m. Root ʾWN ear.

units.la: הַאֲזֵנָה attenditote, Gen. 4. 22. Imper. Hiph. (pro הַאֲזִינָה, ) pl. fæm. Rad. אזן.
units.tr: HAAZENAH attend ye, Gen. 4. 22. Imper. Hiph. (for HAAZINAH), pl. fem. Root ʾZN.

units.la: הַאֲזִינָה & longè depellent, Esa. 19. 6. 3. pl. præt. Hiph. cùm א epen-thetico, pro הַאֲזִינוּ, R. זנח.
units.tr: HAAZINAH they will utterly drive away, Isa. 19. 6. 3rd pl. perf. Hiph., with epenthetic ʾ, for HAAZINU, Root ZNuH.

units.la: הָאִירָה fac lucere, Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. אור.
units.tr: HAIRAH make to shine, Imper. Hiph. f. m. Root ʾWR.

units.tr: HAOKHAL I have eaten, Infin. Niph. Root ʾKL.

units.tr: HAALOTO to adjure him, Infin. Hiph., suffix. Root ʾLH.

units.tr: HAANAH to sigh, or sigh, HAANAQ to cry out, or cry out, HAASAF to be gathered, or gather, Infin. or Imper. Niph. Roots ʾNH, ʾNQ, ʾSP.

units.la: הָאסֹף congregando, 2 Sam. 17.11. pro הָאָסֵף, Infin. Niph. & הָאסְפוּ congregator, Imper. Niph. f. fæm. Rad. אסף.
units.tr: HAASO by gathering, 2 Sam. 17:11. for HAASEF, Infin. Niph., and HAASPU be gathered, Imper. Niph. f. fem. Root ʾSP.

units.la: הָאסְרוּ vincti estote, Imper. Niph. pl. masc. Rad. אסר.
units.tr: HAASRU be bound, Imper. Niph. pl. masc. Root ʾSR.

units.la: הָאֵר fac lucere, Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. אור.
units.tr: HAER make to shine, Imper. Hiph. f. m. Root ʾWR.

units.tr: H B

units.tr: HAVI, HAVU, and HAVAH give, Imper. Qal, f. & pl. m. Root YHB.

units.la: הָבָא num veniens, vel venit, Ben. vel præt. Kal, R. בוא.
units.tr: HABA coming, or comes, part. or perf. Qal. Root BWʾ.

units.la: הָבְאָה adductus est, Gen. 33. 11. pro הוּבְאָה & הוּבְאתָ adductus es, pro הוּבְאתָה praet. Hoph. 3. sing. fæm. & 2 sim. parag. R. בּוֹא ; contr. בָּא. הַבְּהֵבִים, בִּי donaria, בִּי mea, &c. No. pl. m. Rad. יָהַב dedit. הַבּוֹ dirigendo, Infi. Niph. Rad. בָּוַז [?]. הַבּוּק exhauriendo, Infin. Niph. Rad. בָּקַק. לְהַבְּזוֹת ad spermendum, Infin. Hiph. Rad. בָּזָה. הַבַּט, vel הַבִּיט intuere, vel intueri, Imper. vel Infin. Hiph. הִבַּטְתֶּם vi-distis, præt. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. נָבַט. הַבִּיא venire fecit, הֵבִיאוֹ ipsum, item, הֵבִא venire fecit, הֵבִיאֲתָנוּ venire fecisti nos, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & 2. s.m.aff. Rad. בּוֹא. הַבִּיאָם intuetur, הַבִּיט intuentur, præt. Hiph 3. f. & pl. m. הַבִּישָׁה intuere, Imper. Hiph. f.m. parag. Rad. נָבַט. הַבִּין intellexit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. הָבִין intelligere, vel facintelligere, Infin. vel Imper. Hiph. sing. masc. Rad. בִּין. הַבִּישׁ, vel הִבִּישׁ, sive הוֹבִישׁ pudefecit, 3. f. masc. הַבִּישָׁה, & הוֹבִּישָׁה, vel הִבַּשְׁתָּ pudefecisti, 2. sing. m. præt. Hiph. Rad. בּוּשׁ. הַכְּנִיָּה ædificata, Part. Pahul Kal, sfæm. Rad. בָּנָה. לְהִכָּנוֹת ut ædificetur, Inf. Niph. Rad. בָּנָה. הַכָּנִים filii, No. pl. m. à sing. בֵּן, in Rad. בָּנָה. הַכָּנִים ebena ligna, No. pl. m. Rad. הָבֵן. הַבַּנִּים, vel הַפּוֹנִים ædificantes, pl. m. Ben. Kal, Rad. בָּנָה. לְהַבָּקֵעַ ad disrumpendum, Infin. Niph. Rad בָּקַע. הַבְּקִיעָה perrupta est, præt. Hoph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. בָּקַע.
units.tr: HABEAH was brought, Gen. 33:11. for HUBAAH; and HUBATA you were brought, for HUBATAH, perf. Hoph. 3rd sing. fem. and 2nd similarly, paragogic. Root BWʾ; contracted BʾA. HABEHABIM, BI gifts, BI my, etc., noun, pl. m. Root YHB gave. HABO by directing, Infin. Niph. Root BZ [?]. HABUQ by emptying, Infin. Niph. Root BQQ. LEHAZBOT to despise, Infin. Hiph. Root BZH. HABBET, or HABIT look, or to look, Imper. or Infin. Hiph. HIBBATTEM you have seen, perf. Hiph. 2nd pl. m. Root NBT. HABIA made to come, HEBIAV him, likewise HEBA made to come, HEBIATANU you made us come, perf. Hiph. 3rd sing. f. & 2nd sing. m., suffix. Root BWʾ. HABIAM looks, HABIT they look, perf. Hiph. 3rd sing. f. & pl. m. HABISHAH look, Imper. Hiph. f. m., paragogic. Root NBT. HABIN understood, perf. Hiph. 3rd sing. m. HABIN to understand, or make to understand, Infin. or Imper. Hiph. sing. masc. Root BYN. HABISH, or HIBISH, or HOBISH shamed, 3rd sing. m. perf. Hiph. HABISHAH, and HOBISHAH, or HIBASHTA you shamed, 2nd sing. m. perf. Hiph. Root BWSh. HAKNIYAH built, Part. Pual, fem. Root BNH. LEHIKKANOT to be built, Infin. Niph. Root BNH. HAKNIM sons, noun, pl. m. from sing. BN, Root BNH. HAKNIM ebony wood, noun, pl. m. Root HBN. HABANIM, or HAPONIM building, pl. m. part. Qal, Root BNH. LEHIBBAQEAʿ to break through, Infin. Niph. Root BQʿ. HIBQIAH was broken through, perf. Hoph. 3rd sing. fem. Root BQʿ.

units.la: הָבַר purificari, לְהָבֵר ad purificandum, Infin. Hiph. הָבְרוּ purificate, Imper. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. בָּרַר.
units.tr: HAVAR be purified, LEHAVER to purify, Infin. Hiph. HAVRU purify, Imper. Hiph. pl. m. Root BRR.

units.la: הִבָּרֵאךְ creari te, Infin. Niph. aff. R. בָּרָא.
units.tr: HIBBAREKH to be created for you, Infin. Niph., suffix. Root BRʾ.

units.la: הִבָּרוּ purificamini, Imper. Niph. pl. m. R. בָּרַר.
units.tr: HIBBARU be purified, Imper. Niph. pl. m. Root BRR.

units.la: לְהַבְרוֹת ad ribandum[?], Infin. Hiph. Rad. בָּרָה.
units.tr: To make clear (to bless?), infinitive Hiphil, root בָּרָה.

units.la: הַבְּרִים, הַבְּרִי observantes, pl. m. Ben. Kal, Rad. הָבַר.
units.tr: observing, plural masculine, Benoni Kal, root הָבַר.

units.la: ה ג
units.tr: ה ג

units.la: הָגַד nunciatum est, הָגֵּד nunciando, praet & Infin. Hoph. הָגְּדְתִּי indicavi, praet. Hiph. 1. f. Rad. נָגַד.
units.tr: הָגַד it has been announced; הָגֵּד in announcing: preterite and infinitive Hophal; הָגְּדְתִּי I have indicated, preterite Hiphil first person singular. Root נָגַד.

units.la: הָגָה meditari, Infin. Kal, הָגוּת meditatio, No. f. fæm. Rad. הָגָה.
units.tr: הָגָה to meditate, infinitive Kal; הָגוּת meditation, noun feminine. Root הָגָה.

units.la: הָגוֹן rectum, הַגִּינָה recta, No. Rad. הָגַן.
units.tr: הָגוֹן right; הַגִּינָה right (feminine), noun. Root הָגַן.

units.la: הָגִיג meditatio, No. f. m.
units.tr: הָגִיג meditation, noun masculine.

units.la: Rad. הָגַג, vel הָגָה.
units.tr: Root הָגַג, or הָגָה.

units.la: הִגִּיד indicavit, הִגִּידוּ indicaverunt, praet. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. & הִגִּיד indica, הִגִּירוּ indicate, Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָגַד.
units.tr: הִגִּיד he indicated; הִגִּידוּ they indicated, preterite Hiphil third person singular and plural masculine; and הִגִּיד indicate; הִגִּירוּ indicate (plural), imperative Hiphil feminine and plural masculine. Root נָגַד.

units.la: הָגִּיּוֹן, & הֲגִיּוֹן meditatio, No. Rad. הָגָה meditatus est.
units.tr: הָגִּיּוֹן and הֲגִיּוֹן meditation, noun. Root הָגָה, he meditated.

units.la: הִגִּיעַ pervenire fecit, הִגִּיעוּ pervenire fecerunt, praet. Hiph. 3. f & pl. m. Rad. נָגַע.
units.tr: הִגִּיעַ he caused to arrive; הִגִּיעוּ they caused to arrive, preterite Hiphil third person feminine and plural masculine. Root נָגַע.

units.la: הִגְרִיד fudit, הִגְרִיתִי fudi, praet. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. f. Item, הַגְרֵם fun-de eos, Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. Rad. נָגַר.
units.tr: הִגְרִיד he poured out; הִגְרִיתִי I poured out, preterite Hiphil third person masculine and first person feminine. Likewise, הַגְרֵם pour out on them, imperative Hiphil feminine masculine with suffix. Root נָגַר.

units.la: הִגִּישׁ accedere fecit, ipsum, 3. sing. masc. aff. & הִגִּישׁוּ accedere fecerunt, 3. pl. praet. Hiph. Rad. נָגַשׁ.
units.tr: הִגִּישׁ he caused to approach, him, third person singular masculine with suffix; and הִגִּישׁוּ they caused to approach, third person plural preterite Hiphil. Root נָגַשׁ.

units.la: הָגִיתָ meditatus es, הָגִיתִי sum, 2. f. m. & 1. f. praet. Kal, Rad. הָגָה.
units.tr: הָגִיתָ you meditated, הָגִיתִי I am, second person feminine masculine and first person feminine, preterite Kal. Root הָגָה.

units.la: הָגְלוּ deportaverunt, 3. pl. הָגְלִיתִי deportavi , 1. sing. præt. Hiph. & הָגְלוּ deportati sunt , 3. pl. præt. Hoph. Rad. גָּלָה. הִגָּלוּ revelamini , Imper. pl. masc. & הִגָּלוֹת revelare , Infin. Niph. Rad. גָּלָה. הִגְלַת deportavit , f. pro הִגְלְתָה , præt. Hiph. & הָגְלָת deportata est , Jer. 13.19. pro הָגְלְתָה , præt. Hoph. 3. f. fæm. Rad. גָּלָה. הָגְמַל ablactari , Infin. Niph. Rad. גָּמַל. הִגַּשׁ admotus est , הִגָּשׁוּ , & גָּגַשׁ [?] admoti sunt , præt. Hoph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. נָגַשׁ.
units.tr: הָגְלוּ they deported, third person plural; הָגְלִיתִי I deported, first person singular preterite Hiphil; and הָגְלוּ they were deported, third person plural preterite Hophal. Root גָּלָה. הִגָּלוּ be revealed, imperative plural masculine; and הִגָּלוֹת to be revealed, infinitive Niphal. Root גָּלָה. הִגְלַת she deported, feminine for הִגְלְתָה, preterite Hiphil; and הָגְלָת she was deported, Jer. 13.19, for הָגְלְתָה, preterite Hophal third person feminine. Root גָּלָה. הָגְמַל to be weaned, infinitive Niphal. Root גָּמַל. הִגַּשׁ he was brought near, הִגָּשׁוּ, and גָּגַשׁ [?] they were brought near, preterite Hophal third person masculine singular and plural. Root נָגַשׁ.

units.la: ה ד
units.tr: ה ד

units.la: הֵידָד , הֵד celeusma , No. Rad. הָדַר. הָדוֹם , vel הָדֹם scabel-lum , ipsum No. Rad. הָדוּר honoratus , הֲדוּרִים honorati , Pahul Kal, R. הָדַר. הַדּוֹר generatio , No. R. דּוֹר habitavit. כַּהֲדוּשׁ ficut triturat , Infin. Niph. Rad. דּוּשׁ. הַדְּחוּיָה impulsa , Pahul Kal , f. fæm. ה dem. à f. m. רְחוּי impulsus , Rad. דָּחָה. הֵדִיחַ impulit , præt. Hiphil , & הֵדִיחַ impelle, הֵדִיחֻמוֹ eos , Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. Rad. נָדַח. הֲדִיחַנִי dispulit , me, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. דּוּחַ. הָדַךְ conterere , Infin. Kal, Rad. הָדַךְ. הַדְלֵק accende , Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. דְּלַק. הֶרְמְנוּ silere fecit , nos , præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. דָּמַם. הָדַק comminuit , præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. הָדַק com-
units.tr: הֵידָד, הֵד shout of joy, noun. Root הָדַר. הָדוֹם or הָדֹם footstool, noun itself. Root הָדוּר honored, הֲדוּרִים honored, Pahul Kal participle, root הָדַר. הַדּוֹר generation, noun. Root דּוֹר, he dwelt. כַּהֲדוּשׁ as he threshes, infinitive Niphal. Root דּוּשׁ. הַדְּחוּיָה thrust, Pahul Kal, feminine noun; the ה is a diminutive of the masculine רְחוּי thrust. Root דָּחָה. הֵדִיחַ he thrust, preterite Hiphil; and הֵדִיחַ thrust, הֵדִיחֻמוֹ thrust them, imperative Hiphil feminine masculine with suffix. Root נָדַח. הֲדִיחַנִי he thrust me out, preterite Hiphil third person masculine with suffix. Root דּוּחַ. הָדַךְ to crush, infinitive Kal. Root הָדַךְ. הַדְלֵק kindle, imperative Hiphil feminine masculine. Root דְּלַק. הֶרְמְנוּ he made us silent, preterite Hiphil third person masculine with suffix. Root דָּמַם. הָדַק he crushed, preterite Hiphil third person masculine. הָדַק crush

units.la: minuere, & לְהַדֵּק [?] ad comminuendum, 2 Par. 34.7. pro לְהַדֵּק [?], Infin. Hiph. item, הַדְּקוֹתָ [?] comminuisti, 2. f. m. & fæm. præt. Hiph. Rad. דָּקַק.
units.tr: to crush, and לְהַדֵּק [?] for crushing, 2 Chr. 34.7, for לְהַדֵּק [?], infinitive Hiphil; likewise הַדְּקוֹתָ [?] you have crushed, second person masculine and feminine, preterite Hiphil. Root דָּקַק.

units.la: incedere fecit eam, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. vel, pro הַדְרִיכָה [?], Infin. Hiph. aff. Rad. דָּרַךְ.
units.tr: he caused her to walk, preterite Hiphil third person masculine with suffix; or, for הַדְרִיכָה [?], infinitive Hiphil with suffix. Root דָּרַךְ.

units.la: הַדָּרַת [?] decus, &c. No. Rad. הָדָר.
units.tr: הַדָּרַת [?] splendor, etc., noun. Root הָדָר.

units.la: הַדְּשָׁנָה [?] pinguefiet, Jef. 34. 6. præt. comp. ex Hoph. & Hithp. Rad. דָּשַׁן.
units.tr: הַדְּשָׁנָה [?] shall be made fat, Isa. 34.6, preterite compounded from Hophal and Hithpael. Root דָּשַׁן.

units.la: ה ח
units.tr: ה ח

units.la: הַהֻפַּךְ [?] conversus est, præt. Hoph. 3. sing. masc. Rad. הָפַךְ.
units.tr: הַהֻפַּךְ [?] was turned, preterite Hophal third person singular masculine. Root הָפַךְ.

units.la: הַהֹפְכִי [?], הַהֹפֶכֶת [?] convertens, Ps. 114. 8. &c. Ben. Kal, f. m. parag. Rad. הָפַךְ.
units.tr: הַהֹפְכִי [?], הַהֹפֶכֶת [?] turning, Ps. 114.8, etc., Benoni Kal, feminine masculine with paragogic ending. Root הָפַךְ.

units.la: הַהֹלְכוֹא [?] qui iverunt, Jos. 10.24. præt. Kal, cum א parag. lit. ה est præf.
units.tr: הַהֹלְכוֹא [?] those who went, Josh. 10.24, preterite Kal, with paragogic א; the ה is a prefix.

units.la: rel. pro אֲשֶׁר
units.tr: relative, for אֲשֶׁר.

units.la: הָהָר [?] mens, הָהָרִים [?] montes, No. sing. & pl. m. præf. à No. Rad. הָר.
units.tr: הָהָר [?] mind, הָהָרִים [?] mountains, noun singular and plural masculine, with the prefixed ה from the noun. Root הָר.

units.la: ה ו
units.tr: ה ו

units.la: הוֹ heu, in Rad. הוֹי.
units.tr: הוֹ oh, in Root הוֹי.

units.la: הֱוֵא [?] esto, Job. 37.6. pro הָוֵא [?], Imper. Kal, sing. m. Rad. הָוָה.
units.tr: הֱוֵא [?] be, Job 37.6, for הָוֵא [?], imperative Kal singular masculine. Root הָוָה.

units.la: הֱוֵי [?] esto, Imp. Kal, s. f. R. הָוָה.
units.tr: הֱוֵי [?] be, imperative Kal singular feminine. Root הָוָה.

units.la: הוֹאיל voluit, הוֹאַלְתָּ voluisti, præt. Hiph. יָאַל.
units.tr: הוֹאיל he was willing, הוֹאַלְתָּ you were willing, preterite Hiphil. Root יָאַל.

units.la: הוּבָא allatus est, הוּבְאוּ allati sunt, &c. præt, Hoph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. R. בּוֹא.
units.tr: הוּבָא it was brought, הוּבְאוּ they were brought, etc., preterite Hophal third person singular masculine and third person plural. Root בּוֹא.

units.la: הוּבִישׁ exaruit, vel pudefecit, הוּבִישׁוּ plur. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. item, הוּבַשְׁתָּ exaruisti, vel pudefecisti, הוּבַשְׁתִּי exarui, vel pudefeci, &c. 2. & 1. f. præt. Hiph. Rad. בּוֹשׁ, vel, יָבֵשׁ.
units.tr: הוּבִישׁ it dried up, or it shamed, הוּבִישׁוּ plural, third person feminine masculine and third person plural; likewise הוּבַשְׁתָּ you dried up, or you shamed, הוּבַשְׁתִּי I dried up, or I shamed, etc., second and first person feminine preterite Hiphil. Root בּוֹשׁ, or יָבֵשׁ.

units.la: הוֹגָה mœrore affecit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יָגָה.
units.tr: הוֹגָה he afflicted with grief, preterite Hiphil third person masculine. Root יָגָה.

units.la: הוֹנָה, pro הוּנָה amotus fu-it, 2 Sam. 20. 13. præt. Hoph. 3. f. m. Rad. הָנָה.
units.tr: הוֹנָה, for הוּנָה he was removed, 2 Sam. 20.13, preterite Hophal third person masculine. Root הָנָה.

units.la: הָנוּ pro הָגָה effari, Jer. 59.13. Inf. Kal, R. הָגָה.
units.tr: הָנוּ for הָגָה to utter, Jer. 59.13, infinitive Kal. Root הָגָה.

units.la: הוֹנִיעַ fatigavit, הוֹנִיעוּ fatigavimus, הוֹנִיעָם fatigastis, הוֹנִיעֵנִי fatigasti me, הוֹנִיעֲךָ fatigatite, &c. 3. f. masc. 1. pl. 2. pl. m. 2. f. m. & 1. f. aff. Rad. יָנַע.
units.tr: הוֹנִיעַ he wearied, הוֹנִיעוּ we wearied, הוֹנִיעָם you wearied, הוֹנִיעֵנִי you wearied me, הוֹנִיעֲךָ you have wearied, etc., third person masculine, first person plural, second person plural masculine, second person feminine masculine and first person feminine with suffix. Root יָנַע.

units.la: הוֹדָה celebravit, הוֹדוּ celebraverunt, הוֹדִינוּ celebravimus, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. 3. pl. & 1. pl. item, הוֹדוּ celebrate, pl. m. Imper. Hiph. R. יָדָה.
units.tr: הוֹדָה he celebrated, הוֹדוּ they celebrated, הוֹדִינוּ we celebrated, preterite Hiphil third person masculine, third person plural and first person plural; likewise הוֹדוּ celebrate, plural masculine, imperative Hiphil. Root יָדָה.

units.la: הוֹרִיעַ notificavit, הוֹרִיעָה notificasti, הוֹרִיעוּ notificavimus, &c. 3. & 2. f. m. & 1. pl. præt. Hiph. Rad. יָדַע.
units.tr: הוֹרִיעַ he notified, הוֹרִיעָה you notified, הוֹרִיעוּ we notified, etc., third and second person feminine masculine and first person plural, preterite Hiphil. Root יָדַע.

units.la: הוֹרִיעַ vel הוֹדִיעַ notifica; f. m. הוֹרִיעִי notificate, pl. m. Imper. Hiph.
units.tr: הוֹרִיעַ or הוֹדִיעַ notify, feminine masculine; הוֹרִיעִי notify, plural masculine, imperative Hiphil.

units.la: Rad. יָדַע
units.tr: Root יָדַע

units.la: הוֹדְךָ gloria tua, הוֹדֵךְ vel הוֹדוֹ ejus, No: Rad. הוֹד, aff.
units.tr: הוֹדְךָ your glory, הוֹדֵךְ or הוֹדוֹ his, noun. Root הוֹד, with suffix.

units.la: הוֹדַע cognosci, הוֹדַעְתִּי me-um, Inf. Niph. aff. R. יָדַע.
units.tr: הוֹדַע to be known, הוֹדַעְתִּי to be made known, infinitive Niphal with suffix. Root יָדַע.

units.la: הָוֶה existens, הָיָה e-sto, Job. 37.6. הֱיֵה esto, f. g. הָיָה erumna, הָיוֹת erumnæ, &c. vide in Rad. הָיָה.
units.tr: הָוֶה existing, הָיָה be, Job 37.6, הֱיֵה be, feminine masculine; הָיָה calamity, הָיוֹת calamities, etc.; see under the root הָיָה.

units.la: הוֹחִיל expectavit, הוֹחִילוּ expectaverunt, הוֹחַלְתִּי expectavi, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. 3. pl. & 1. f. ut הוֹחִיל expecta, f. g. הוֹחִילוּ expectate, Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. masc. & f. fem, Rad. יָחַל.
units.tr: הוֹחִיל expectavit, הוֹחִילוּ expectaverunt, הוֹחַלְתִּי expectavi, the third person masculine singular and the first person singular of the perfect Hiphil; the feminine form הוֹחִילָה, and the plural forms, are from the same root. The imperative of the Hiphil, masculine and feminine, singular and plural: הוֹחִילִי expecta, הוֹחִילוּ expectate. Root יָחַל.

units.la: הוֹחַל captum est, 3. f. m. præt. Hoph. R. חָלַל.
units.tr: הוֹחַל was taken, third person feminine masculine, preterite Hophal. Root חָלַל.

units.la: הוּגְלָה deportatus est, deportati sunt, præt. Hoph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. גָּלָה.
units.tr: הוּגְלָה he was deported, they were deported, preterite Hophal third person feminine masculine and third person plural. Root גָּלָה.
