units.tr: [יָדַע] for knowing, Jer. 29.23. Benoni Qal, fem. and masc., with prefix. Root [יָדַע]. [הוּכָּה] or [הִכָּה] was struck, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. fem. and masc. Root [נָכָה]. [הוּכִיחַ] he reproves, [הוּכִיחָה] thou didst reprove, [הוּכַּח] was reproved, etc., perfect Hiphil 3rd and 2nd sing. fem. and masc., and perfect Hophal 3rd sing. fem. Root [יָכַח]. [הוּכַן] was established, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root [כּוּן]. [בְּהִוָּלְדוֹ] when he was born, [הוּלְדּוֹ] he, [הוּלְדָה] she, infinitive Niphal with suffix. Root [יָלַד]. [הוּלְדֹת] or [הִלְדֹת] to be born, Gen. 40.20. Infinitive Hophal. Root [יָלַד]. [הוֹלִיד] begot, [הוֹלִידוּ] they begot, [הוֹלַדְתָּ] thou begattest, etc., perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. and pl. masc. and 2nd sing. masc. Root [יָלַד]. [הוֹלִיךְ] led away, [הוֹלִיכוּ] they led away, [הוֹלַכְתְּ] thou didst lead away, perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl. masc., as also 1st sing. fem. with suffix. Root [יָלַךְ]. [הוֹלֵךְ] walking, Benoni Qal, fem. and masc. Root [הָלַךְ]. [הוּלְלוּ] for [הִלְּלוּ] were praised, perfect Pual 3rd pl. Root [הָלַל]. [הוֹלְלִים] praising, Benoni Qal, masc. pl. Root [הלל]. [הוֹמְיָה] noisy, Prov. 7.11. [הוֹמִיּוֹת] to be noisy, Prov. 1.21, for [הֻמָּה] [הֹמוֹת], Benoni Qal, fem. sing. and pl. Root [הָמָה]. [הוֹמַת] was put to death, [הוֹמַתּוּ] or [הֻמְּתוּ] were put to death, perfect Hophal 3rd fem. sing. and masc. pl. Root [מוּת]. [הוֹנָה] oppressed, [הוֹנוּ] they oppressed, [לְהוֹנוֹתָם] to oppress them, perfect Hiphil 3rd fem. sing. and masc. pl., as also infinitive Hiphil with prefix and suffix. Root [יָנָה]. [הוֹנַח] rest was granted, perfect Hophal 3rd fem. masc. Root [נוּחַ]. [מֵהוֹנֶךָ] from thy substance, [הוֹנְךָ] thy riches, fem. and masc. pl. with suffix. Noun. Root [הוֹן]. (illegible) was agitated, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) was founded, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) founded her [?], perfect (illegible). (illegible) in their being founded, infinitive Niphal with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) added, perfect (illegible). (illegible) thou didst add, perfect (illegible). (illegible) to add, perfect Hiphil 3rd and 2nd sing. masc., as also infinitive Hiphil. Root (illegible). (illegible) was chastened, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) be chastened, imperative Niphal pl. masc. Root (illegible). An attestation was made, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). That it might profit, infinitive Hiphil. Root (illegible). (illegible) (illegible), for (illegible) was offered, Jud. 6.28. And (illegible) for (illegible) was carried away, Nah. 2.7. Perfect Hophal 3rd fem. and masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) make to shine, to shine, shine festively, imperative Hiphil fem. masc. paragogic, and passive Hiphil (illegible). Root Hiphil (illegible), or (illegible) for (illegible) turning, Ps. 114.8. Benoni Qal, fem. masc. paragogic. Root (illegible). (illegible) lead out, (illegible) lead out... etc. Imperative Hiphil fem. masc. paragogic and with suffix. Root (illegible) for leading out, Gen. 8.17. Imperative Hiphil fem. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) was led out, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. fem. Root (illegible). For thou hast brought forth, Job 15.13, perfect Hiphil 2nd sing. masc. Root (illegible). He led us out, perfect Hiphil with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) was poured out, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) was raised up, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) hanged, we hanged them, perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl. [?] with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) we were slain, perfect Hiphil pl. Root (illegible). (illegible) thou wast led down, etc., perfect Hophal 2nd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) I had led down, perfect [?] Hiphil 4th sing. fem. with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) for (illegible) to conceive, Jer. 59.13. Infinitive Qal. Root (illegible). (illegible) my forefathers, noun pl. masc. with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) he dismissed, (illegible) dismiss, (illegible) him, perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. masc. and imperative Hiphil sing. masc. with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) appointed heir, appoint, to appoint, perfect, imperative or infinitive Hiphil. Root (illegible). (illegible), perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) it became me, imperative Hiphil fem. masc. and perfect 3rd fem. masc. with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) was made void, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) or (illegible) thou hast cast out, perfect Hiphil 2nd sing. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) to teach, (illegible) I taught, infinitive Hiphil, perfect and perfect Hiphil fem. Root (illegible). (illegible) my mother, (illegible) of them, Benoni Kal, fem. (illegible) mother, with suffix. Root (illegible). (illegible) had returned, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. fem. masc. Root (illegible). (illegible) and I will cause them to return, Zach. 10.6. Perfect Hiphil 1st sing. with suffix, compounded from Root (illegible) and (illegible). (illegible) you shall be made to dwell, (-ciamini), perfect Hophal 2nd pl. masc. Root [יָשַׁב]

units.la: ה־הוֹשִׁיב qui habitare fe-cit, הוֹשִׁיבֵנִי me habita-re fecit, לְהוֹשִׁיבִי ut me habitare faciat, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. præf. & aff. ut & Inf. præf. & aff. R. ישב
units.tr: [ה־הוֹשִׁיב] who made to dwell, [הוֹשִׁיבֵנִי] made me dwell, [לְהוֹשִׁיבִי] that he may make me dwell, perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. masc. with prefix and suffix, as also infinitive with prefix and suffix. Root [ישב].

units.la: הוֹשָׁבִי, pro הוֹשִׁיב habita-re faciendo, Pf. 113. 8. Infin. Hiph. parag. Rad. ישב
units.tr: [הוֹשָׁבִי] for [הוֹשִׁיב] causing to dwell, Ps. 113.8. Infinitive Hiphil, paragogic. Root [ישב].

units.la: הוֹשִׁיעָה salvavit, הוֹשִׁיעוֹ ipsum, הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי salva me, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. fæm. & aff. ut & Imper. f. m. aff. Rad. יָשַׁע
units.tr: [הוֹשִׁיעָה] saved, [הוֹשִׁיעוֹ] him, [הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי] save me, etc., perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. masc. and fem., with suffix, as also imperative masc. sing. with suffix. Root [יָשַׁע].

units.la: הוֹשַׁע, & הוֹשַׁע salva, Imper. Hiph. f. m. (unde הוֹשַׁעְנָא salva quæso, HOSANNA, comp. ex Imper. הוֹשַׁע & part. Rad. נָא) Rad. יָשַׁע
units.tr: [הוֹשַׁע] and [הוֹשַׁע] save, imperative Hiphil masc. sing. (whence [הוֹשַׁעְנָא] save, I beseech, HOSANNA, compounded of imperative [הוֹשַׁע] and particle [נָא]). Root [יָשַׁע].

units.la: הוּשְׁעוּ salvamini, Imper. Niph. pl. m. R. יָשַׁע
units.tr: [הוּשְׁעוּ] be saved, imperative Niphal masc. pl. Root [יָשַׁע].

units.la: הוֹשַׁעְתַּנִי salvasti me, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָשַׁע
units.tr: [הוֹשַׁעְתַּנִי] thou didst save me, perfect Hiphil 2nd sing. fem. and masc. with suffix. Root [יָשַׁע].

units.la: הוֹשֵׁר, pro הוֹשֵׁר complana, Pf. 5. 9. Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. יָשַׁר
units.tr: [הוֹשֵׁר] for [הוֹשֵׁר] make level, Ps. 5.9. Imperative Hiphil masc. sing. Root [יָשַׁר].

units.la: הוֹתִיר reliquit, הוֹתֵר relinque, הוֹתַרְתִּי reliqui, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. f. & Imper. f. m. Rad. יָתַר
units.tr: [הוֹתִיר] he left, [הוֹתֵר] leave, [הוֹתַרְתִּי] I left, perfect Hiphil 3rd fem. masc. and 1st fem., and imperative masc. sing. Root [יָתַר].

units.la: הוּתַל illusus est, præt. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. הָתַל
units.tr: [הוּתַל] was mocked, perfect Hophal 3rd sing. fem. masc. Root [הָתַל].

units.la: ה ז [?]
הִזָּה aspersit, הִזָּתָה aspersi-sti, præt. Hiph. 3. & 2. f. m. item, הַזֶּה asperge, Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. נָזָה
units.tr: [הִזָּה] he sprinkled, [הִזָּתָה] thou hast sprinkled, perfect Hiphil 3rd and 2nd sing. fem. masc.; likewise [הַזֶּה] sprinkle, imperative Hiphil masc. sing. Root [נָזָה].

units.la: לְהַזְהִיר ut admoneatur, Infin. Niph. Rad. זָהַר
units.tr: [לְהַזְהִיר] that he may be admonished, infinitive Niphal. Root [זָהַר].

units.la: וְהַזֹּרֶה & qui aspergitur, Jef. 59. 5. Part. præt, Kal, cum Sægol loco Kamets, vel Part. Pual. f. m. R. זוּר, vel זָרָה
units.tr: [וְהַזֹּרֶה] and he who is sprinkled, Isa. 59.5. Perfect participle Qal, with Segol in place of Qamets, or participle Pual, fem. and masc. Root [זוּר] or [זָרָה].

units.la: הִזְּרוּ superbiverunt, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. R. זוּר fluere fecerunt eam, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. aff. R. זָלַל
units.tr: [הִזְּרוּ] they acted proudly, perfect Hiphil 3rd pl. Root [זוּר]. they made it flow, perfect Hiphil 3rd pl. with suffix. Root [זָלַל].

units.la: הֵזִיל separavit, הַזְרִיתֶם separastis, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 2. pl. Rad. נָזַר.
units.tr: הֵזִיל "he separated"; הַזְרִיתֶם "you separated"; perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. masc. and 2nd pl. masc. Root נָזַר.

units.la: הִזְכּוּ purificate vos, pro הַזְכּוּ imper. Hithp. pl. m. R. זָכָה.
units.tr: הִזְכּוּ "purify yourselves"; for הַזְכּוּ, imperative Hithpael pl. masc. Root זָכָה.

units.la: וְהִזְכּוֹתִי & purus sum, 1. f. præt. Hiph. R. זָכַךְ.
units.tr: וְהִזְכּוֹתִי "and I am pure"; 1st sing. perfect Hiphil. Root זָכַךְ.

units.la: הַזֹּנָה scortatus est, הַזֹּנוּ scortati sunt, scortatuses, præt. Hiph. 3. & 2. f. m. & 3. pl. item, הַזְנָה scortare, הַזְנוֹת scortari, &c. Imper. & Infin. Hiph. Rad. זָנָה.
units.tr: הַזֹּנָה "she played the harlot", הַזֹּנוּ "they played the harlot", "you played the harlot": perfect Hiphil, 3rd and 2nd masc. sing. and 3rd pl. Likewise הַזְנָה "to play the harlot", הַזְנוֹת "to be made to play the harlot", etc.: imperative and infinitive Hiphil. Root זָנָה.

units.la: הַזְרִיתֶם, pro הַזְהִירְתֶם monebitis, Lev. 15. 31. præt. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. זָהַר vel, separabitis, R. נָזַר separavit.
units.tr: הַזְרִיתֶם, for הַזְהִירְתֶם "you will warn", Lev. 15:31: perfect Hiphil, 2nd pl. masc. Root זָהַר; or "you will separate", root נָזַר "he separated".

units.tr: [The Hebrew forms in this column are only partly legible; see notes.]

units.la: בְּהָחְבָּא cum occultatur, לְהָחְבָּא ut occultetur, vel הַחְבָּא occultati, Infin. Niph. Rad. חָבָא, vel חָבָה.
units.tr: בְּהָחְבָּא "when it is hidden", לְהָחְבָּא "that it may be hidden", or הַחְבָּא "to be hidden": infinitive Niphal. Root חָבָא or חָבָה.

units.la: הָחְבָּאוּ occultati sunt, 3. pl præt. Hoph. R. חָבָא.
units.tr: הָחְבָּאוּ "they were hidden": 3rd pl. perfect Hophal. Root חָבָא.

units.la: הָחְבָּאתָה abscondidit, Jos. 6. 17. 3. f. fæm. præt. Hiph. Rad. חָבָא cum, dupl. lit. f. g.
units.tr: הָחְבָּאתָה "she hid it", Josh. 6:17: 3rd sing. fem. perfect Hiphil. Root חָבָא, with a double letter, f. g.

units.la: הַחְרַלְתִּי desistere coactus fui, Jud. 9. 9. ex Hiph. & Hoph. comp. vel, pro הַחְדַּלְתִּי cogerere desistere, Interr. præt. Hoph. 1. f. Rad. חָדַל.
units.tr: הַחְרַלְתִּי "I was compelled to desist", Judg. 9:9: a combined Hiphil and Hophal form; or, for הַחְדַּלְתִּי, "to compel to desist": interrogative perfect Hophal, 1st sing. Root חָדַל.

units.la: הַחוֹסִים qui sperant, Ben. Kal, pl. m. præf. Rad. חָסָה.
units.tr: הַחוֹסִים "those who hope": participle Qal, masc. pl., with prefix. Root חָסָה.

units.la: הַחְטִיא, & הֶחֱטִיא peccare facere, Infin. Hiph. R. חָטָא.
units.tr: הַחְטִיא and הֶחֱטִיא "to cause to sin": infinitive Hiphil. Root חָטָא.

units.la: הֶחֱיִיתִי vivificavit, הֶחֱיִיתָ vivificavi, הֶחֱיִיתָנוּ vivificastinos, 3. f. m. 1. f. &
units.tr: הֶחֱיִיתִי "he gave life", הֶחֱיִיתָ "I gave life", הֶחֱיִיתָנוּ "you gave us life": 3rd masc. sing., 1st sing. and 1st and 2nd masc. sing. with suffix, perfect Hiphil.

units.la: 1 & 2. f. m aff. præt. Hiph. Rad. חָיָה
units.tr: Root חָיָה.

units.la: vivum conservan-do me, Infin. Hiph. aff. Rad. חָיָה
units.tr: "preserving myself alive": infinitive Hiphil with suffix. Root חָיָה.

units.la: הַחִישׁ festinabant, 3. pl. præt. Hiph. R. חוּשׁ.
units.tr: הַחִישׁ "they hastened": 3rd pl. perfect Hiphil. Root חוּשׁ.

units.la: הָחְלָה incepit, הֵחֵלּוּ inceperunt, præt. Hiph. 3. sing. masc. & fæm. & 3. pl. m. Rad. חָלַל
units.tr: הָחְלָה "he began", הֵחֵלּוּ "they began": perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. masc. and fem. and 3rd pl. masc. Root חָלַל.

units.la: הַחֵל profanari, לְהָחֵלּוֹ ad ipsum profanandum, Infin. Hiph. aff. Rad. חָלַל
units.tr: הַחֵל "to be profaned", לְהָחֵלּוֹ "for profaning it": infinitive Hiphil with suffix. Root חָלַל.

units.la: הַחֵל incipe vel incipere, Imper. vel Inf. Hiph. R. חָלַל.
units.tr: הַחֵל "begin", or "to begin": imperative or infinitive Hiphil. Root חָלַל.

units.la: הַחְלוֹתָ incepisti, הַחְלוֹתִי incepi, præt. Hiph. 2 m. & 1. f. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: הַחְלוֹתָ "you began", הַחְלוֹתִי "I began": perfect Hiphil, 2nd masc. and 1st sing. Root חָלַל.

units.la: הַחֱלִי morbo affecit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: הַחֱלִי "he afflicted with disease": perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. sing. Root חָלָה.

units.la: הַחֲלִיתִי ægritudine affeci, הַחֲלוּ morbo affecerunt, præt. Hiph. 1. f. & 3. pl. m. Rad. חָלָה.
units.tr: הַחֲלִיתִי "I afflicted with sickness", הַחֲלוּ "they afflicted with disease": perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. and 3rd masc. pl. Root חָלָה.

units.la: הַחֲלִיתִי morbo affectus sum, præt. Hoph. 1. f. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: הַחֲלִיתִי "I was afflicted with disease": perfect Hophal, 1st sing. Root חָלָה.

units.la: הַחֲלֹם incipere eorum, Infin. Hiph. aff. R. חָלַל.
units.tr: הַחֲלֹם "to begin of them": infinitive Hiphil with suffix. Root חָלַל.

units.la: הַחְלְצוּ expediti estote, Imper. Niph. pl. m. R. חָלַץ.
units.tr: הַחְלְצוּ "be ready": imperative Niphal, masc. pl. Root חָלַץ.

units.la: הַחְסוּת hoc refugium, No. f. fæm. præf. R. חָסָה.
units.tr: הַחְסוּת "this refuge": noun fem., with prefix. Root חָסָה.

units.la: הַחֳרְבָה vastatus est, הַחֳרְבָה vastata fuit, præt. Hoph. 3. f. masc. & fæm. at, הֲחָרֵב vastari, Infin. Hoph. Rad. חָרַב.
units.tr: הַחֳרְבָה "he was laid waste", הַחֳרְבָה "it was laid waste": perfect Hophal, 3rd masc. and fem. sing.; but הֲחָרֵב "to be laid waste": infinitive Hophal. Root חָרַב.

units.la: הַחֳרָה exarsit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. חָרָה.
units.tr: הַחֳרָה "it burned": perfect Hiphil, 3rd fem. masc. Root חָרָה.

units.la: הַחְשִׁיתִי silui, præt. Hiph. 1. f. R. חָשָׁה.
units.tr: הַחְשִׁיתִי "I was silent": perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. Root חָשָׁה.

units.la: הַחְתָּתָ contrivisti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. חָתַת.
units.tr: הַחְתָּתָ "you crushed": perfect Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. Root חָתַת.

units.la: הַחְתִּיתִי consternatum reddam, Jef. 49. 37. pro הַחְחוּתִי, præt. Hiph. 1. f. Rad. חָתַת.
units.tr: הַחְתִּיתִי "I will make them dismayed", Isa. 49:37, for הַחְחוּתִי: perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. Root חָתַת.

units.la: ה ש
units.tr: H–Sh

units.la: הַטֵּה inclina, Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. נָטָה
units.tr: הַטֵּה "incline": imperative Hiphil, fem. masc. Root נָטָה.

units.la: הֵטִיב benefecit, 3. pret. Hiph. 3. f. m. הֵטִיבָה be-
units.tr: הֵטִיב "he did good": 3rd sing. masc. perfect Hiphil. הֵטִיבָה "you did good":

units.la: nefecisti, 2. f. f. הֵטִיבִי
units.tr: 2nd sing. fem. perfect. הֵטִיבִי

units.la: benefac, Imper. f.f. pro הֵטִיבִי, R. טָב
units.tr: "do good": imperative fem. sing., for הֵטִיבִי. Root טָב.

units.la: הֵטִיבְנוּ benefecimus, pret. Hiph. 1. pl. R. יָטַב
units.tr: הֵטִיבְנוּ "we did good": perfect Hiphil, 1st pl. Root יָטַב.

units.la: הָטְבַּע figebantur, pret. Hoph. 3. pl. R. טָבַע
units.tr: הָטְבַּע "they were fixed": perfect Hophal, 3rd pl. Root טָבַע.

units.la: הֵטַבְתָּ benefecisti, הֵטִיבִי
units.tr: הֵטַבְתָּ "you did good": הֵטִיבִי

units.la: benefeci, pret. Hiph. 2. m. f. & 1. f. Rad. יָטַב
units.tr: "I did good": perfect Hiphil, 2nd masc. and 1st sing. Root יָטַב.

units.la: וְהֵטִיבְתִּי & benefaciam, pret. Hiph. 1. f. R. טוב
units.tr: וְהֵטִיבְתִּי "and I will do good": perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. Root טוב.

units.la: הֵטָה inclinavit, הֵטוּ inclinaverunt, pret. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m.
units.tr: הֵטָה "he inclined", הֵטוּ "they inclined": perfect Hiphil, 3rd fem. and 3rd pl. masc.

units.la: הֵטָּה inclina, & הֵטוּ inclinate, Imper. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָטָה
units.tr: הֵטָּה "incline", and הֵטוּ "incline (pl.)": imperative fem. and pl. masc. Root נָטָה.

units.la: הָטְהְרוּ mundaverunt, הֶטְהַרְנוּ mundaveri-
units.tr: הָטְהְרוּ "they cleansed", הֶטְהַרְנוּ "we cleansed": perfect Hithpael, 3rd and 1st pl.

units.la: מַטְהֵר munda, pret. Hiph. p. 3. & 1. pl. vel Imper. pl. R. טָהַר
units.tr: מַטְהֵר "cleanse": perfect Hiphil, 3rd and 1st pl., or imperative pl. Root טָהַר.

units.la: הֵטִיבוֹתִי benefeci, Ezech. 36. 11. pro הֵטִיבוֹתִי, pret. Hiph. 1. f. Rad. טוֹב
units.tr: הֵטִיבוֹתִי "I did good", Ezek. 36:11, for הֵטִיבוֹתִי: perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. Root טוֹב.

units.la: הָטַל dejecit, הָטַלְתָּ dejecisti, dejicite
units.tr: הָטַל "he cast down", הָטַלְתָּ "you cast down", "cast (pl.) down": perfect Hiphil, 3rd and 2nd masc. sing., and imperative pl.

units.la: me, pret. Hiph. 3. & 2. f. m. ut & Imper. pl. aff. Rad. טוּל
units.tr: "me": perfect Hiphil, 3rd and 2nd masc. sing., as well as imperative pl. with suffix. Root טוּל.

units.la: הָטְמְאָה contaminata est, Deut. 24. 4. pret. comp.
units.tr: הָטְמְאָה "she was defiled", Deut. 24:4: compound perfect, from Hophal and Hithpael, 3rd fem. sing. Root טָמֵא.

units.la: ex Hoph. & Hithp. 3. f. fæm. Rad. טָמֵא
units.tr: Root טָמֵא.

units.la: הִטָּמֵן abscondaris, Imper. Niph. sing. masc. Rad. טָמַן
units.tr: הִטָּמֵן "you hide yourself": imperative Niphal, sing. masc. Root טָמַן.

units.la: הָטָעוּ errare fecerunt, pret. Hiph. 3. pl. R. טָעָה
units.tr: הָטָעוּ "they caused to err": perfect Hiphil, 3rd pl. Root טָעָה.

units.la: ה
units.tr: H

units.la: וְהוּ & vs, & lamentum, particula Rad. vel No. ל m. à Rad. נָהָה lamentari.
units.tr: וְהוּ and vs, "and lamentation": a particle, root, or noun masc., from root נָהָה "to lament".

units.la: הָיָה celsus, Nō. f. m.
units.tr: הָיָה "high": noun masc.

units.la: Rad. הָיָה
units.tr: Root הָיָה

units.la: הֱיֵה esto, Imper. Kal, f. m. Rad. הָיָה
units.tr: הֱיֵה "be": imperative Qal, masc. sing. Root הָיָה.

units.la: הָיוּ fuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. הָיָה
units.tr: הָיוּ "they were": perfect Qal, 3rd pl. Root הָיָה.

units.la: לִהְיוֹת esse, Infin. Kal, Rad. הָיָה
units.tr: לִהְיוֹת "to be": infinitive Qal. Root הָיָה.

units.la: הֵיטִיב benefecit, הֵיטִיבָה benefecisti, הֵיטִיבוּ benefecerunt, præt. Hiph. 3. & 2. sg. m. & f. & 1. pl. Rad. [?]
units.tr: הֵיטִיב "he did good", הֵיטִיבָה "you did good", הֵיטִיבוּ "they did good": perfect Hiphil, 3rd and 2nd sing. masc. and fem., and 1st pl. Root [?].

units.la: הָיִיתָ fuisti, הָיִינוּ fuimus, præt. Kal, 2. sing. & 1. pl. Rad. הָיָה
units.tr: הָיִיתָ "you were", הָיִינוּ "we were": perfect Qal, 2nd sing. and 1st pl. Root הָיָה.

units.la: הָיְתָה fuit, pro הָיָה, præt. Kal, 2. sing. fem. Rad. הָיָה
units.tr: הָיְתָה "she was", for הָיָה: perfect Qal, 2nd sing. fem. Root הָיָה.

units.la: הֵלִיב abduc, pro הָלַךְ, Exod. [?], Imper. Hiph. f. & fem. Rad. [?]
units.tr: הֵלִיב "lead away", for הָלַךְ, Exod. [?]: imperative Hiphil, fem. Root [?].

units.la: הִלִּיל eiulavit, vel הִלֵּל, præt. Hiph. 3. s. masc. & [?] Rad. הָלַל
units.tr: הִלִּיל "he wailed", or הִלֵּל: perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. masc. and [?]. Root הָלַל.

units.la: הֵילִיל e-jula[?], vel הֵילִילוּ e-jularunt, præt. Hiph. [?]
units.tr: הֵילִיל "wail [?]", or הֵילִילוּ "they wailed": perfect Hiphil [?].

units.la: הֵילֵל lucifer, Nō. f. m. R. הלל
units.tr: הֵילֵל "morning star", noun masc. Root הלל.

units.la: לְהָמִין vel לְהֵימִין ad lex-trandum, 2. Sam. [?]
units.tr: לְהָמִין or לְהֵימִין "to go to the right", 2 Sam. [?].

units.la: הֵילִין Infin. Hiph. ad lex-tram, Imper. Hiph. sing. fem. Rad. [?]
units.tr: הֵילִין "infinitive Hiphil, to go to the right"; imperative Hiphil sing. fem. Root [?].

units.la: הֵילִיךְ lactavit, הֵילִיכוּ lactaverunt, præt. Hiph. f. & m. & f. & pl. m. Rad. [?]
units.tr: הֵילִיךְ "she gave suck", הֵילִיכוּ "they gave suck": perfect Hiphil, fem. and masc., and fem. and masc. pl. Root [?].

units.la: הוֹרֵה pro הוֹרֵה dirige, Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. יָשַׁר
units.tr: הוֹרֵה, for הוֹרֵה "direct": imperative Hiphil, fem. masc. Root יָשַׁר.

units.la: הָיְתָה finit, præt. Kal, 3. f. fem. Rad. הָיָה
units.tr: הָיְתָה "she ends": perfect Qal, 3rd fem. sing. Root הָיָה.

units.la: ה כ
units.tr: H–K

units.la: הָכָה pro הָכָה percute, Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. נָכָה
units.tr: הָכָה, for הָכָה "smite": imperative Hiphil, fem. masc. Root נָכָה.

units.la: הִכְאִיב dolore affeci eum, præt. Hiph. 1. sing. aff. Rad. כָּאַב
units.tr: הִכְאִיב "I caused him pain": perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. with suffix. Root כָּאַב.

units.la: הַבְּאוֹת attertere, Infin. Hiph. Rad. בָּאָה
units.tr: הַבְּאוֹת "to bring against": infinitive Hiphil. Root בָּאָה.

units.la: הַכְּבֵד graves, vel gravari, Imper. vel Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּבַד
units.tr: הַכְּבֵד "make heavy", or "to be made heavy": imperative or infinitive Niphal. Root כָּבַד.

units.la: הַכְּבֵּס ablui, Lev. 13. 56. Infin. comp. ex Hoph. & Hithp. Rad. כָּבַס
units.tr: הַכְּבֵּס "to be washed", Lev. 13:56: compound infinitive from Hophal and Hithpael. Root כָּבַס.

units.la: הַכָּה percussit, הִכּוּ percusserunt, הַכֵּה percute, הַכּוּ percutite, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. & Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָכָּה
units.tr: הַכָּה "he struck", הִכּוּ "they struck", הַכֵּה "strike", הַכּוּ "strike (pl.)": perfect Hiphil, 3rd fem. and masc. pl., and imperative Hiphil, fem. and masc. pl. Root נָכָּה.

units.la: הֻכָּה percussus est, הֻכּוּ percussi sunt, præt. Hoph. 3. f. & pl. Rad. נֻכָּה
units.tr: הֻכָּה "he was struck", הֻכּוּ "they were struck": perfect Hophal, 3rd fem. and pl. Root נֻכָּה.

units.la: הַכּוּם percutite eum, הַכּוּם percutite ipsos, Imper. Hiph. pl. m. aff. Rad. נְכָּה
units.tr: הַכּוּם "strike him", הַכּוּם "strike them": imperative Hiphil, masc. pl. with suffix. Root נְכָּה.

units.la: הָכּוֹן paratus esto, Imper. Niph. f. m. R. כּוֹן
units.tr: הָכּוֹן "be prepared": imperative Niphal, fem. masc. Root כּוֹן.

units.la: הַכּוֹתֵנִי percutere, הַכּוֹתִי me, ו ipsum, ם eos, &c. Infin. Hiph. Rad. נָכָּה
units.tr: הַכּוֹתֵנִי "to strike", הַכּוֹתִי "me", ו "him", ם "them", etc.: infinitive Hiphil. Root נָכָּה.

units.la: הָכִיל continendo, Infin. Hiph. R. כּוּל
units.tr: הָכִיל "in containing": infinitive Hiphil. Root כּוּל.

units.la: הֵכִין præparavit, præparaverunt, Hiph. 3. f. & pl. Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. כּוּן
units.tr: הֵכִין "he prepared", "they prepared": perfect Hiphil, 3rd fem. and pl. Imperative Hiphil, fem. and masc. pl. Root כּוּן.

units.la: הַכִּינוֹת præparasti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. כּוּן
units.tr: הַכִּינוֹת "you prepared": perfect Hiphil, 2nd fem. masc. Root כּוּן.

units.la: הַכִּינִי, pro הַכִּינִי percute me, Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. Rad. נָכָּה
units.tr: הַכִּינִי, for הַכִּינִי "strike me": imperative Hiphil, fem. masc. with suffix. Root נָכָּה.

units.la: הַכִּירוּ agnovit, agnoverunt, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. Rad. נָכַר
units.tr: הַכִּירוּ "he acknowledged", "they acknowledged": perfect Hiphil, 3rd fem. and pl. Root נָכַר.

units.la: הַכִּיתָ percussisti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. נָכָּה
units.tr: הַכִּיתָ "you struck": perfect Hiphil, 2nd fem. masc. Root נָכָּה.

units.la: הַכִּיתִי percussus sum, præt. Hoph. 1. f. R. נָכָּה
units.tr: הַכִּיתִי "I was struck": perfect Hophal, 1st sing. Root נָכָּה.

units.la: הַכְּלִם ignominiâ affici, Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּלַם
units.tr: הַכְּלִם "to be put to shame": infinitive Niphal. Root כָּלַם.

units.la: הַכְּלִמְנוּ pudore affecti eos, 1 Sam. 25. præt. Hiph. aff. Rad. כָּלַם
units.tr: הַכְּלִמְנוּ "we put them to shame", 1 Sam. 25: perfect Hiphil with suffix. Root כָּלַם.

units.la: הַכִּין firmeris, Imper. Niph. f. m. sed הַכִּין præparatus per. Hiph. Rad. כּוּן
units.tr: הַכִּין "you shall be established": imperative Niphal, fem. masc.; but הַכִּין "prepared by": Hiphil. Root כּוּן.

units.la: הַכִּנּוּ præparavimus, pro הִכְּנוּ הִכְנִנוּ, præt. Hiph. 1. pl. Rad. כִּין הִכְנַע humiliari, Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּנַע הִכָּסוֹת operiri, Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּסָה הַכֵּר agnosce, Imper. Hiph. Rad. נָכַר הַכְרִיעֹתִי depressisti me, Jud. 11. 35. præt. Hiph. 2. f. f. aff. Rad. כָּרַע הִכָּרֵת exscindendo, Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּרַת הִכְרַת excisum est, præt. Hoph. 3. sing. masc. Rad. כָּרַת הַכָּרַת agnitio, No. f. fæm. constr. R. נכר וּבְהִכָּשְׁלָם & in corruendo ipsos, Infin. Niph. præf. aff. Rad. כָּשַׁל
units.tr: הַכִּנּוּ "we prepared", for הִכְּנוּ הִכְנִנוּ: perfect Hiphil, 1st pl. Root כִּין. הִכְנַע "to be humbled": infinitive Niphal. Root כָּנַע. הִכָּסוֹת "to be covered": infinitive Niphal. Root כָּסָה. הַכֵּר "acknowledge": imperative Hiphil. Root נָכַר. הַכְרִיעֹתִי "you bowed me down", Judg. 11:35: perfect Hiphil, 2nd fem. sing., with suffix. Root כָּרַע. הִכָּרֵת "in cutting off": infinitive Niphal. Root כָּרַת. הִכְרַת "was cut off": perfect Hophal, 3rd masc. sing. Root כָּרַת. הַכָּרַת "recognition": noun fem., construct. Root נכר. וּבְהִכָּשְׁלָם "and in making them stumble": infinitive Niphal with prefixes and suffix. Root כָּשַׁל.

units.la: ה ל הִלְאָנִי fatigavit me, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. לָאָה הַלְאוֹת fatigare, Infin. Hiph. Rad. לָאָה הִלְאָה fatigavit, Ezech. 24. 12. (pro הִלְאָתָה,) præt. Hiph. 3. f. fæm. Rad. לָאָה הִלְאָתִיךָ fatigavit e, præt. Hiph. 1. sing. aff. Rad. לָאָה הִלְבִּינוּ albi ev aserunt, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. R. לָבַן הִלֵּדֶת Gen. 40. 20. vel הוֹלֶדֶת nasci, Ezec. 16. 4. comp. ex הִלֵּד, Infin. Hoph. & לֵדָת, Infin. Kal. Rad. יָלַד הַלּוֹ in lucere facere eum, Job. 29. 3. (pro בְּהַהִלּוֹ,) Infin. Hiph. præf. aff. Rad. הָלַל הִלִּינָה mutuasti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. לָוָה הִלְּחֵמוּ pugnate, הִלָּחֲמוּ pugnatote, Imper. Niph. f. & pl. m. Rad. לָחַם הַלִּיכָה ambulatio, No. f. fæm. Rad. הָלַךְ הַלִּיכֵי gressus mei, pl. m. aff. הַלִּין derivat · הליצי deri-
units.tr: He has wearied me (præt. Hiph., 3rd fem./masc. with suffix; root לָאָה). Hiphil infinitive, to weary. He wearied her, Ezek. 24.12 (for הִלְאָתָה), perfect Hiphil 3rd fem. sing. Root לָאָה. I have wearied you, perfect Hiphil 1st sing. with suffix, root לָאָה. They made white, perfect Hiphil 3rd pl., root לָבַן. Gen. 40.20, or הוֹלֶדֶת, to be born, Ezek. 16.4, compounded of הִלֵּד, Infinitive Hophal, and לֵדָת, Infinitive Kal, root יָלַד. In causing him to shine, Job 29.3 (for בְּהַהִלּוֹ), Infinitive Hiphil with prefix and suffix, root הָלַל. You have borrowed, perfect Hiphil 2nd fem./masc., root לָוָה. Fight, pugnate (fight ye), Imperative Niphal fem. and masc. pl., root לָחַם. Walking, a going, noun fem., root הָלַךְ. My steps, masc. pl. with suffix. They shall deride me, perfect Hiphil 3rd fem. and masc. pl. with suffix, root לוין; ...

units.la: dent me, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. לוין
units.tr: dent me, perfect Hiphil 3rd fem. and masc. pl. with suffix, root לוין.

units.la: הלך itio, Nom. f. m. Rad. הלך
units.tr: going, a going, noun masc., nominative, root הלך.

units.tr: They went, Josh. 10.24, for הלכו, 3rd pl. perfect Kal, with paragogic א, root הלך.

units.la: הללה laudata est, הללו laudati sunt, præt. Pual, 3. sing. fæm. & 3. pl. Rad. הלל
units.tr: She has been praised; they were praised, perfect Pual, 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl., root הלל.

units.la: הללו laudate, & cum No. הללויה יה laudate Dominum, Imper. Piel, pl. m. R. הלל
units.tr: Praise, and with the noun: Hallelujah, praise the Lord, Imperative Piel, pl. masc., root הלל.

units.la: הללו laudavimus, præt. Piel, 1. pl. R. הלל
units.tr: We have praised, perfect Piel, 1st pl., root הלל.

units.la: הלנותם murmurastis, præt. Hiph. 2. pl. masc. Rad. לון
units.tr: You murmured, perfect Hiphil 2nd pl. masc., root לון.

units.la: הלקח capi, Infin. Niph. Rad. לקח
units.tr: To be taken, Infinitive Niphal, root לקח.

units.tr: ה מ

units.tr: He, that one.

units.la: המאזרני accingens me, part. Piel, sing. m. aff. Rad. אזר
units.tr: Girding me, participle Piel, sing. masc. with suffix, root אזר.

units.la: המביט intuens, part. Hiph. f. m. R. נבט
units.tr: Looking upon, participle Hiphil, fem. or masc., root נבט.

units.la: המבין intelligens, part. Hiph. f. m. R. בין
units.tr: Understanding, participle Hiphil, masc., root בין.

units.la: המבשרות nunciantes, part. Piel, pl. fæm. Rad. בשר
units.tr: Bringing good tidings, participle Piel, pl. fem., root בשר.

units.la: המגביה exaltans, & cum Jod, parag. המגביהי, 113.5. pl. Hiph. sing. masc. Rad. גבה [?]
units.tr: Exalting, and with Yod, paragogic המגביהי, Psalm 113.5, pl.; Hiphil sing. masc., root גבה [?].

units.la: המה fremuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. המה
units.tr: They roared, perfect Kal, 3rd pl., root המה.

units.la: המון multitudo, המונים multitudines, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. המה
units.tr: Multitude, multitudes, noun fem. and pl. masc., root המה.

units.la: המיה inclinans, scipio, המטים inclinantes, part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. vel No. Rad. נמה
units.tr: Inclining, a fork (?); inclining ones, participle Hiphil fem. and pl. masc., or noun, root נמה.

units.la: המהומה tumultum faciens, Prov. 7.11. part. Kal, f. fæm. pro המהומה, à masc. המה, Rad. המה
units.tr: Making tumult, Prov. 7.11, participle Kal, fem., for המהומה from the masc. המה, root המה.

units.tr: חמיה,

units.la: הַמַּיָּה, הַמַּיִת, & הַמִּית fre-quens, Nom. f. fæm. & constr. Rad. חָיָה [?]
units.tr: Frequent, noun fem. and construct, root חָיָה [?].

units.la: לְהַיְמִין ad dexteram flecte-re, 2 Sam. 14. 19. pro לְהַיְמִין, Infin. Hiph. à præt. הֵימִין, Rad. יָמִין

units.la: הֵמִיר mutavit, præt. Hiph. 3. sing. masc. & בְּהָמִיר in mutando, Infin. Hiph. Rad. מִיר, vel מוּר.
units.tr: He changed, perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. masc.; in changing, Infinitive Hiphil, root מִיר or מוּר.

units.la: הַמִּשְׁנִי fac ut palpem, Jud. 16. 26. pro הַמִּישְׁנִי, Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. R. מוּשׁ.
units.tr: Make that I may feel, Judg. 16.26 (for הַמִּישְׁנִי), Imperative Hiphil fem. masc. with suffix, root מוּשׁ.

units.la: הָמִית interfecit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. מוּת.
units.tr: He killed, perfect Hiphil 3rd fem. masc., root מוּת.

units.la: הַמִּיתִין interficiebam eum, pro הַמְּתִיתִי, præt. Hiph. 1. f. aff. Rad. מוּת.
units.tr: I was killing him (for הַמְּתִיתִי), perfect Hiphil 1st fem. with suffix, root מוּת.

units.la: הַמְּכוּ attenuantur, Job. 24. 24. præt. Hoph. 3. pl. m. (pro הָמְּכוּ,) Rad. מָךְ.
units.tr: They are wasted, Job 24.24, perfect Hophal 3rd pl. masc. (for הָמְּכוּ), root מָךְ.

units.la: הַמְכְּרוּ vendimini, Imper. Niph. pl. masc. Rad. מָכַר.
units.tr: Sell (yourselves), Imperative Niphal pl. masc., root מָכַר.

units.la: הַמּל, vel הַמּוֹל circumcidi, circumciditor, Infin. vel Imper. Niph. f. m. Rad. מוֹל.
units.tr: To circumcise, or circumcised, be circumcised, Infinitive or Imperative Niphal fem. masc., root מוֹל.

units.la: הַמּוּלָה, & הַמּוּלָה tumultus, Nom. sing. fæm. Rad. הָמַל.

units.la: בְּהַמּוֹל in circumcidendo eum, Infin. Niph. præf. & aff. Rad. מוֹל.
units.tr: In circumcising him, Infinitive Niphal with prefix and suffix, root מוֹל.

units.la: הַמְלָחָה saliendo, הַמְלַחְתִּי fuisti salitus, Infin. & præt. Hoph. 2. f. m. R. מָלַח.
units.tr: By leaping, you were salted (?); I was salted, Infinitive and perfect Hophal 2nd fem. masc., root מָלַח.

units.la: הַמְלָחָה salita fuisti, pro הַמְלָחָה, præt. Hoph. 2. f. fæm. Rad. מָלַח.
units.tr: You were salted, for the form above, perfect Hophal 2nd fem., root מָלַח.

units.la: הַמְלֵט eripitor, eripi, Imper. vel Infin. Niph. Rad. מָלַט.
units.tr: Be delivered, to be rescued, Imperative or Infinitive Niphal, root מָלַט.

units.la: וְהַמָּם & conteret eos, præt. Kal, 3 f. m. præf. & aff. R. הֵם, vel הוֹם.
units.tr: And he shall crush them, perfect Kal 3rd masc., with prefix and suffix, root הֵם or הוֹם.

units.tr: To shake them, Infinitive Kal with prefix and suffix, root הָמַם. He crushed them, he crushed me, perfect Kal 3rd masc. with suffix, root הָמַם. To be numbered, Infinitive Niphal with prefix, root מָנָה. To multiply you, Infinitive Kal with suffix, root הָמַן. Melting, Infinitive Niphal, root מָסַס. They melted, perfect Hiphil 3rd pl. masc., root מָסַס. They melted, Josh. 14.8, perfect Hiphil (from the Chaldee for הַמְּסוּ), 3rd pl., root מָסָה. Stubble, noun pl. masc., root הַמַּס or מָסַס. Distress, narrowness, noun fem. masc., root צָרַר. I have delivered you, 2 Sam. 3.8 (for הַמְּצִאתִיךָ), perfect Hiphil 1st fem. with suffix, root מָצָא. To melt, or to dissolve, Infinitive Hiphil, root מָקַק. Who happens, participle Piel fem. masc., root קָרָה. In changing, Infinitive Hiphil, root מִיר or מוּר. He provoked, perfect Hiphil 3rd fem. masc., and to make bitter, Infinitive Hiphil, root מָרַר. They provoked, perfect Hiphil 3rd pl., and in provoking them, Infinitive Hiphil with prefix and suffix, root מָרָה. To be anointed, Infinitive Niphal, root מָשַׁח. Killing, to kill (?) Infinitive Hiphil with prefix, root מוּת. They were put to death, perfect Hophal 3rd pl., root מוּת. And I shall crush, perfect Kal 1st fem., root הָמַם. And I will slay her, her; they put him to death, they killed you, perfect Hiphil 1st fem. with suffix, 3rd pl. with suffix, and 2nd pl. masc. and fem., root מוּת.

units.tr: He has left (reliquisti) it; הִנְחַתּוֹ [hinḥatto]: he has left it; הִנְחַתִּיו [hinḥatti·v]: I have left him; הִנְחַתֶּם [hinḥatem]: you (pl.) have left; and so on: perfect Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular with suffix, and 1st person singular with suffix; also 2nd person plural masculine. Root נָחַח.

units.tr: הַנְחֵת descendere fac, Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. נָחַת.

units.la: לְהַנְחֹתָם ad ducendum eos, Infin. Hiph. præf. aff. Rad. נָחָה. הֵנִיחַ requiescere facit , וְהָנִיחוֹתִי, vel & requiem dedi , הָנִיחוּ quietum reddiderunt , &c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. f & 3. pl. Rad. נוּחַ הָנִיחַ requiem dato, vel da-re, Imper. vel Inf. Hiph. R. נוּחַ. הֻנִּיחָה collocatur, Zach. 5. 11. est præt. comp. cum Jod ex Hiph. & Kibbutz ex Hoph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. נוּחַ לְהַנִּיס fugere fecit, ad fugandum, præt. 3. f. m. & Infin. Hiph. Rad. נָס הֵנִיעָה movit ille, הֵנִיעָה illa, & הָנִיעַ moveto, & eos, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & fæm. ut & Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. R. נוּעַ הֵנִיף agitavit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נוּף. הֵנִיפוּתִי agitavi, הֵנִיפוֹתָ agitaveris, לְהַנִּיף ad agi-tandum, Jer. 30. 18. item הֵנִיפָם agitare vos, & הָנִיפוּ agitate, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & i. & 2. f. m. ut & Infin. præf. & aff. & Imper. pl. m. Rad. נוּף. וְהִנְעַשְׁתִּי & commovebo, præt. Hiph. 1. f. R. נוּעַ. הֵנְעֲשׂוּ floruerunt, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָץ. הַנְצֵל eripe te, Imper. Niph. f. m. R. נָצַל. הַנָּקָה impunis esto, Imper. Niph. Rad. נָקָה. הִנָּקֵם ultionem sume, vel sumere, Imper. vel Infin. Niph. Rad. נָקַם. הִנָּתֵן dando, Infin. Niph. Rad. נָתַן. הִנָּתֵק avulsi sunt, præt. Hoph. 3. pl. R. נָתַק.
units.tr: לְהַנְחֹתָם [lehanḥotam]: to lead them, infinitive Hiphil with suffix. Root נָחָה. הֵנִיחַ [heniaḥ]: he causes to rest; וְהָנִיחוֹתִי [vehaniḥoti]: and I gave rest, or: and I have given rest; הָנִיחוּ [hanihu]: they made quiet; etc.: perfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular, and 1st singular and 3rd plural. Root נוּחַ. הָנִיחַ [haniaḥ]: give rest, imperative or infinitive Hiphil; root נוּחַ. הֻנִּיחָה [hunniḥah]: it is placed, Zech. 5.11, is a perfect compound with yod from Hiphil and kibbutz from Hophal, 3rd feminine singular. Root נוּחַ. לְהַנִּיס [lehaniss]: to make flee, to put to flight, perfect 3rd masculine singular and infinitive Hiphil. Root נָס. הֵנִיעָה [heni'ah]: he moved it; הֵנִיעָה [heni'ah]: she moved it; and הָנִיעַ [hani'a]: move (imperative masculine singular), and move them; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masculine and feminine, as also imperative Hiphil masculine singular with suffix. Root נוּעַ. הֵנִיף [heniph]: he waved; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masculine singular. Root נוּף. הֵנִיפוּתִי [heniphuti]: I waved; הֵנִיפוֹתָ [heniphota]: you waved; לְהַנִּיף [lehaniph]: to wave, Jer. 30.18; likewise הֵנִיפָם [heniphamm]: to wave them, and הָנִיפוּ [haniphu]: wave, etc.: perfect Hiphil, 3rd masculine singular, and 1st and 2nd masculine singular, as also infinitive with and without suffix and imperative plural masculine. Root נוּף. וְהִנְעַשְׁתִּי [vehin'asti]: and I will move, perfect Hiphil, 1st singular. Root נוּעַ. הֵנְעֲשׂוּ [hin'asu]: they flourished, perfect Hiphil, 3rd plural masculine. Root נָץ. הַנְצֵל [hanzel]: deliver yourself, imperative Niphal masculine singular. Root נָצַל. הַנָּקָה [hannaqah]: be unpunished, imperative Niphal. Root נָקָה. הִנָּקֵם [hinnaqem]: take vengeance, or to take vengeance, imperative or infinitive Niphal. Root נָקַם. הִנָּתֵן [hinnaten]: by giving, infinitive Niphal. Root נָתַן. הִנָּתֵק [hinnatek]: they were torn away, perfect Hophal, 3rd plural. Root נָתַק.

units.tr: הסרתי amovi, praet. Hiph. 1. f. R. סור

units.la: הסיתה ad inciteavit, 1 Reg. 21. 13. (pro הסיתה,)
units.tr: הסיתה ad inciteavit, 1 Reg. 21. 13. (pro הסיתה,)

units.la: præt. Hiph. 3. s. fæm. Rad. סות.
units.tr: præt. Hiph. 3. s. fæm. Rad. סות.

units.la: הַסְתּוֹפֵף in limine manere, Infin. Hithp. R. סָפַף.
units.tr: הַסְתּוֹפֵף in limine manere, Infin. Hithp. R. סָפַף.

units.la: לְהַסְתִּים occludi, Infin. Niph. R. סָתַם.
units.tr: לְהַסְתִּים occludi, Infin. Niph. R. סָתַם.

units.la: מִהַסְתַּפֵּחַ ab adhærendo, Infin Hithp. R. סָפַּח.
units.tr: מִהַסְתַּפֵּחַ ab adhærendo, Infin Hithp. R. סָפַּח.

units.la: הִסְתַּר absconde te, Imper. Niph. Rad. סָתַר.
units.tr: הִסְתַּר absconde te, Imper. Niph. Rad. סָתַר.

units.la: הַעֲדוּ contestare, contestando, Imper. vel Infin. Hiph. R. עוד.
units.tr: HAʿIDU: to call to witness, calling to witness; imperative or infinitive, Hiphil, from the root עוד [ʿuwd].

units.la: הַעְרוֹתָה, pro הַעֵדוֹתָ contestatus es, Exod. 19. 23. præt. Hiph. 2. s. m. parag. Rad. עוד.
units.tr: Ha'ărōtā, for הֵעֵדוֹתָ, you have contested/testified, Exod. 19. 23. perfect Hiphil, 2nd person sing. masc., with parag. ending; root עוד.

units.la: הַעֲוֹה inique age, Imper. Hiph. s. m. R. עָוָה.
units.tr: Ha'ăwōh: act wickedly, imperative Hiphil sing. masc.; root עָוָה.

units.la: הָעֲוֹוּ inique egit, perverterunt, præt. Hiph. 3. s. & pl. m. Rad. עָוָה.
units.tr: Hā'ăwū: he acted wickedly, they perverted; perfect Hiphil, 3rd person sing. and plural masc.; root עָוָה.

units.la: בְּהַעֲוּתָךְ in perverse agere te, Infin. Hiph. præf.
units.tr: Bəha'ăwtā͏ḵā: in perverting you; infinitive Hiphil with prefix.

units.la: הֶעֱוִיתִי inique egi, הֶעֱוִינוּ inique egimus, &c. præt. Hiph. 1. s. & pl. Rad. עָוָה.
units.tr: He'ĕwîtî: I acted wickedly; he'ĕwînû: we acted wickedly, etc.; perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. and plural; root עָוָה.

units.la: הֶעֱוָה is roborat, הֶעֱוָה illa, præt. Hiph. 3. s. m. & fæm. Rad. עָזַז.
units.tr: He'ĕwā: he strengthens; he'ĕwā: she; perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. masc. and fem.; root עָזַז.

units.la: הָעֲזוּ congrega, הָעֲזוּ congregate vos, Imper. Hiph. s. & pl. m. Rad. עָזַז, vel עִיז.
units.tr: Hā'ăzū: gather, gather yourselves together; imperative Hiphil, sing. and plural masc.; root עָזַז, or עִיז.

units.la: לְהַעֲזִיר adjuvari, Infin. Niph. Rad. עָזַר.
units.tr: Lə-ha'ăzîr: to be helped; infinitive Niphal; root עָזַר.

units.la: הֵעִידוּ contestatus est, הֵעִידוּ sunt, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. Rad. עוד.
units.tr: He'îdū: he testified, they testified, etc.; perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd plural; root עוד.

units.la: הֵעִיזוּ congregavit, הֵעִיזוּ congregarunt se, & הֵעִיזוּ vel הָעִיזוּ congrega, הֵעִיזוּ vel הֵעִיזוּ congregate vos, præt. Hiph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. ut & Imper. Hiph. s. & pl. m. Rad. עוז, vel עִיז.
units.tr: He'îzū: he gathered, they gathered themselves; and he'îzū or hā'îzū: gather; he'îzū or he'îzū: gather yourselves together; perfect Hiphil 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd plural, as also imperative Hiphil sing. and plural; root עוז, or עִיז.

units.la: הֵעִיר excitavit, הֵעִירוּ excitarunt, præt. Hiph. 3. s. m. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. עוּר[?].
units.tr: He'îr: he roused; he'îrû: they roused; perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. masc., 3rd fem. masc. and 3rd plural; root עוּר[?].

units.la: הָעִיר[?] suscita, הָעִירוּ suscitate, Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: Hā'îr[?]: rouse; hā'îrû: rouse ye; imperative Hiphil, fem. and plural masc.; root עוּר.

units.la: הַעַל educito, Exod.33.12. (apoc. pro הַעֲלֵה,) הַעֲלֵנִי offer eum, הַעֲלוּ adducite, הַעֲלִי ascendere fac, f.Imper.Hiph. f. m. aff. & pl. m. & f. f. Rad. עָלָה.
units.tr: Ha'al: lead out; Exod. 33.12 (shortened for הַעֲלֵה); ha'ălēnî: offer him; ha'ălû: bring up; ha'ălî: cause to ascend; imperative Hiphil fem. sing., masc. with suffix, and plural masc. and fem.; root עָלָה.

units.la: הַעֲלוֹת · הַעֲלֹת faciendo ascendere, וּלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ & ad educendum eum, &c. Infin. Hiph. aff. Rad. עָלָה.
units.tr: Ha'ălôt, ha'ălōt: causing to ascend; and lə-ha'ălōtô: and to lead him out, etc.; infinitive Hiphil with suffix; root עָלָה.

units.la: הֶעֱלָה ascendere fecit, הֶעֱלָנוּ nos, הֶעֱלֵךְ te, וְהֶעֱלָתָה & ea efferebat, הֶעֱלָתָם ea ascendere jussit eos, הֶעֱלִיתָ tu, f. וְהַעֲלִיתֶם & reducamea, הַעֲלִיתֶם ascendere fecistis, הֶעֱלִיתָנוּ nos, &c. præt. Hiph. 3.f.m. & fæm.aff. item, 2. f. masc. & fæm. &
units.tr: He'ĕlāh: he caused to ascend; he'ĕlānû: us; he'ĕlēk: you; wə-he'ĕlātāh: and she was lifting it up; he'ĕlātām: she commanded them to ascend; he'ĕlîtā: you; wə-ha'ălîtem: and reduce; ha'ălîtem: you caused to ascend; he'ĕlîtānû: us, etc.; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. and fem. with suffix, likewise 2nd masc. and fem., and 1st sing. with suffix, as also 2nd plural masc. with suffix; root עָלָה.

units.la: 1. sing. aff. ut & 2. pl. m. aff. Rad. עָלָה.
units.tr: (continuation of the preceding entry)

units.la: הָעֲלָתָה oblatus fuit, הָעֲלָתָה deducta est, præt. Hoph. 3. f. m. & fæm. Rad. עָלָה.
units.tr: Hā'ălātāh: it was offered; hā'ălātāh: she was brought down; perfect Hophal, 3rd fem. masc. and fem.; root עָלָה.

units.la: הֶעֱלוּךָ eduxerunt te, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. aff. Rad. עָלָה.
units.tr: He'ĕlûkā: they led you out; perfect Hiphil, 3rd plural with suffix; root עָלָה.

units.la: הֵעָלוֹת educi, הַעֲלוֹתוֹ educi eum, &c. Infin. Niph. aff. R. עָלָה, sed הֵעָלוּ educimini, est Imper. Niph. pl. m. ab cad. Rad.
units.tr: He'ālôt: to be led out; ha'ălôtô: to be led out, him, etc.; infinitive Niphal with suffix; root עָלָה; but he'ālû: be led out; is the imperative Niphal plural masc., from the defective root.

units.la: לְהַעֲצָבָה ad mærore afficiendum eam, Infin. Hiph. præf. aff. Rad. עָצַב.
units.tr: Lə-ha'ătsābāh: to cause her grief; infinitive Hiphil with prefix and suffix; root עָצַב.

units.la: בְּהַעֲצֵר in claudi, Infin. Niph. Rad. עָצַר.
units.tr: Bə-ha'ătsēr: in being shut up; infinitive Niphal; root עָצַר.

units.la: הֶעֱרוֹתִי, vel הֶעֱירוֹתִי excitavi, הֶעֱירוֹתִהוּ eum, præt. Hiph. 1. f. aff. R. עוּר.
units.tr: He'ĕrôtî, or he'êrôtî: I roused; he'êrôtîhû: I roused him; perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. with suffix; root עוּר.

units.la: הָעָרֵל præputiatus appare, Infin. Niph. Rad. עָרַל.
units.tr: Hā'ārēl: be made uncircumcised; infinitive Niphal; root עָרַל.

units.la: הֵעֲשׂוֹתוֹ fieri illud, Infin. Niph aff. R. עָשָׂה הֵעָתֵר exorari, Infin. Niph. Rad. עָתַר.
units.tr: He'ăsôtô: that it be done; infinitive Niphal with suffix; root עָשָׂה. He'ātēr: to be entreated; infinitive Niphal; root עָתַר. ## ה פ

וְהִפְדָּה & redimere faci-et, (pro הִפְ) præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. פָּדָה. וַהֲפְדֵּה [?] & redimendo, Infin. Hoph. Rad. פָּדָה. הַפּוּגוֹת, vel הַפְּגוֹת inter-missiones, No. pl. fæm. Rad. פּוּג. הֶפַּח illaqueando, Infin. Hiph. Rad. פּוּחַ. הַפִּיחִי perfla, Imper. Hiph. f. fæm, R. פּוּחַ. הִפִּיל projecit, הִפִּילוּ jecerunt, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. נָפַל. הַפִּיל cadere, וּבְהַפִּילָכֶם & in faciendo vos cadere, Infin. Hiph. præf. & aff. & הַפִּילָהּ fac cadere eam, הַפִּילוּ proji-cite, Imper. Hiph. f. m. aff. & pl. m. Rad. נָפַל. הַפִּיץ dispersit, הַפִּיצוּם dispersi eos, præt. Hiph, 3. f. m. & 1. f. aff. R. פּוּץ. הֵפִיר vel הֵפֵר irritum fecit, הֵפִירוּ vel הֵפְרוּ irritum fecerunt, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. פּוֹר. הַפְּכָה subversio, No. sing. fæm, R. הָפַךְ. הַפַּכְפֵּךְ [?] versatile, No. f. m. Rad. הָפַךְ. הִפִּיל cadere fecit, הִפַּלְנוּ jecimus, הִפַּלְתֶּם dejeci-sti eos, הִפַּלְתּוֹ dejeci eum, הִפַּלְתִּים eos, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. pl. ut & 2. f. m, & 1. f. aff. Rad. נָפַל. הַפְלָא mirifice agere, Infin. Hiph. Rad. פָּלָא. הִפְלִיא pro הִפְלָא, & הִפְלָא mirificum effecit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. פָּלָא. הִפְלָה separavit, הִפְלֵיתִי separavi, הִפְלָה separa, &c. &c. &c. præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. f. ut & Imper. f. m. R. פָּלָה[?] הָפְנוּ[?] respicere facti sunt, præt. Hoph. 3. pl. R. פָּנָה[?] הַעֲבֵר[?] transgredi, pro הַעֲבַר[?] Inf. Hiph. R. פָּצַר[?] הַפְקֵד[?] desiderando, Infin. Niph. הִפָּקֵד[?] depositum fuit, præt. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. פָּקַד[?] הַפְרִים[?] irritum fecit, וְהַפְרִיהָ[?] fecit illa irrita, & irritum facies, הָפְרוּ[?] irritum fecerunt, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 2. f. m. parag. & 3. pl. Rad. פּוּר[?] הָפֵר[?] irritum faciendo, לְהַפְרְכֶם[?] ad irritum facere vos, Infin. Hiph. præf. aff. ut & הָפֵר[?], הָפְרָה[?] irritum fac. Imper. Hiph. f. m. parag. Rad. פּוּר[?] הָפְרַד[?] separare, vel separari, Imper. vel Infin. Niph. Rad. פָּרַר[?] הִפְרִיס[?] findunt, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. R. פָּרַם[?] הַפְּרִנִי[?] fructuosum effecit me, הַפְרִיתִי[?] fructuosum reddidi, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 1. f. Rad. פָּרָה[?] הִפְתַּח[?] solvi, aperiri, Infin. Niph. Rad. פָּתַח הִפְתִּיתִי[?] & nunquid pelleceturus esses, est vel præt. Piel, 2. f. m. cum ה, Interrog. Rad. פָּתַח, vel pro, תִּפְתּוֹת[?] confringas, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. פָּתַת[?], vel pro, תְּפַתִּיתִי[?] pellexisti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. פָּתָה[?]
units.tr: Wə-hifdāh: and he caused to redeem (for hifdeh); perfect Hiphil, 3rd fem. masc. with suffix; root פָּדָה. Wa-hăfdēh[?]: redeeming; infinitive Hophal; root פָּדָה. Ha-pûgôt, or ha-pĕgôt: intermissions; noun, plural fem.; root פּוּג. Hefaḥ: ensnaring; infinitive Hiphil; root פּוּחַ. Hipîḥî: blow; imperative Hiphil fem. sing.; root פּוּחַ. Hipîl: he cast down; hipîlû: they cast down; perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. and 3rd plural masc.; root נָפַל. Hapîl: to fall; ū-behapîlām: and in causing you to fall; infinitive Hiphil with prefix and suffix; hapîlāh: cause it to fall; hapîlû: cast down; imperative Hiphil fem. sing. with suffix and masc. plural; root נָפַל. Hipîṣ: he scattered; hipîṣûm: I scattered them; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. and 1st fem. with suffix; root פּוּץ. Hêfîr, or hêfēr: made void; hêfîrû, or hêfərû: they made void, etc.; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. and 3rd plural; root פּוֹר. Hafkāh: overthrow; noun, sing. fem.; root הָפַךְ. Hafkafkēḵ[?]: changeable; noun, masc. sing.; root הָפַךְ. Hipîl: he caused to fall; hiplānû: we cast; hiplāṯem: you cast them down; hiplāṯô: I cast him down; hiplîm: them, etc.; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc., 1st plural, as also 2nd masc. and 1st fem. with suffix; root נָפַל. Hafləʾā: to act wonderfully; infinitive Hiphil; root פָּלָא. Hiflîʾ, for hiflā, and hafləʾ: made wonderful; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc.; root פָּלָא. Hiflāh: he separated; hiflêtî: I separated; hiflāh: separate; etc.; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. and 1st fem., as also imperative fem. masc.; root פָּלָה[?]. Hāfənû[?]: they were made to look back; perfect Hophal, 3rd plural; root פָּנָה[?]. Ha'ăbēr[?]: to cross over, for ha'ăbar[?]: infinitive Hiphil; root פָּצַר[?]. Hafqēḏ[?]: longing; infinitive Niphal. Hippāqēḏ[?]: was deposited; perfect Hophal, 3rd masc.; root פָּקַד[?]. Hafrîm[?]: he made void, wə-hafrîhā[?]: she made void, and you will make void; hāfərû[?]: they made void; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. with suffix, 2nd masc. with paragogic ending, and 3rd plural; root פּוּר[?]. Hāfēr[?]: making void; lə-hafrəḵem[?]: to make you void; infinitive Hiphil with prefix and suffix, as also hāfēr[?], hāfərāh[?]: make void; imperative Hiphil fem. masc. with paragogic ending; root פּוּר[?]. Hāfrād[?]: to separate, or be separated; imperative or infinitive Niphal; root פָּרַר[?]. Hiprîs[?]: they split; perfect Hiphil, 3rd plural; root פָּרַם[?]. Happarnî[?]: he made me fruitful; hafrîtî[?]: I made fruitful; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. with suffix and 1st fem.; root פָּרָה[?]. Hiftaḥ[?]: to be loosed, to be opened; infinitive Niphal; root פָּתַח. Hiftîtî[?]: and wouldst thou have enticed? is either the perfect Piel, 2nd masc. with interrogative ה, root פָּתַח, or for tiftôt[?]: you break, perfect Hiphil, 2nd masc.; root פָּתַת[?], or for təfattîtî[?]: you have enticed; perfect Hiphil, 2nd masc.; root פָּתָה[?] ## ה צ

units.la: ה צ הִצְבִּיתִי[?] statuisti, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. יָצַב הַצְּבוּ[?] statue, Imper. Hiph. f. m. & הִצְגִּיהוּ[?] statui eum, הַצְגִּיהָ[?] eam, præt. Hiph. 1. f. aff. Rad. יָצַג הִצּוּ rixas moverunt, præt. Hiph. 3. pl. & בְּהַצּוֹתָם [?] in rixando ipsos, בְּהַצּוֹתוֹ [?] ipsum, Infin. Hiph. præf. aff. Rad. נָצָה. הִצְטַּדְנוּ in viaticum sumpsimus, Jos. 9. 12. præt. Hithp. 1. pl. R. צוד. הִצִּיב statuit, הִצִּיבוּ statuunt, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. ut & הַצִּיב statuere, statue, Infin. & Imper. f. m. & הַצִּיבִי statue, f. fæm. Imper. Hiph. Rad. יָצַב. הַצִּיגוּ constituite, Imper. Hiph. pl. m. R. יָצַג. הִצִּינַנִי statuit me, præt. Hiph. 3. f. masc. aff. Rad. יָצַג. הִצִּיל liberavit, הִצִּילָם eos, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. sing. masc. aff. & הַצִּיל eripere, הַצִּילֵנִי eripe me, הַצִּילוּ eripite, &c. Infin. & Imper. f. m. aff. & pl. m. R. נָצַל. הִצִּיעַ stravit, præt. Hiph. הִצִּיף exundare fecit, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. צִיף. הִצִּיק premeret, הִצִּיקָה coarctat me, הִצִּיקַתְנִי eum, הִצִּיקוּתִי [?] & angustabo, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & fæm. aff. ut & 1. f. R. צוק. הִצִּית accendit, הִצִּיתוּ succenderunt, & הִצִּית succende, הִצִּיתוּהָ succendite eam, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & pl. ut & Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. יָצַת. הַצָּלָה liberatio, No. sing. fæm. Rad. נָצַל eruere, הִצַּר pressit, הַצֵּר preme, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. צוּר. הִצְרוֹתִי angustavi, præt. Hiph. 1. f. R. צוּר. הִצָּתִי accendi, pro הִצַּתִּי, præt. Hiph. 1. f. R. נָצַת, vel, potius, יָצַת. [Entries partly illegible; Hebrew vowel points and some Latin abbreviations are approximate.]
units.tr: Hiṣbîtî[?]: you have set up; perfect Hiphil, 2nd masc.; root יָצַב. Haṣbû[?]: set up; imperative Hiphil masc.; and hiṣgîhû[?]: he set him up, hiṣgîhā[?]: her; perfect Hiphil, 1st sing. with suffix; root יָצַג. Hiṣṣû: they stirred up strife; perfect Hiphil, 3rd plural; and bəhaṣṣôtām[?]: in stirring them up, bəhaṣṣôtô[?]: him; infinitive Hiphil with prefix and suffix; root נָצָה. Hiṣṭaddenû: we took for provision, Josh. 9. 12. perfect Hithpael, 1st plural; root צוד. Hiṣṣîb: he set up; hiṣṣîbû: they set up; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. and 3rd plural; likewise haṣṣîb: to set up, set up; infinitive and imperative masc.; and haṣṣîbî: set up; imperative Hiphil fem. sing.; root יָצַב. Haṣṣîgû: set up; imperative Hiphil plural masc.; root יָצַג. Hiṣṣînanî: he set me up; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. with suffix; root יָצַג. Hiṣṣîl: he delivered; hiṣṣîlām: them, etc.; perfect Hiphil, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix; and haṣṣîl: to deliver, haṣṣîlēnî: deliver me, haṣṣîlû: deliver, etc.; infinitive and imperative masc. with suffix and plural masc.; root נָצַל. Hiṣṣîaʿ: he spread out; perfect Hiphil. Hiṣṣîp: he caused to overflow; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc.; root צִיף. Hiṣṣîq: he would press; hiṣṣîqāh: he distresses me; hiṣṣîqatnî: him; hiṣṣîqûtî[?]: I will straiten; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. and fem. with suffix, likewise 1st fem.; root צוק. Hiṣṣîṯ: he kindled; hiṣṣîṯû: they kindled; and haṣṣîṯ: kindle; haṣṣîṯûhā: kindle it; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc. and plural, as also imperative Hiphil fem. and plural masc. with suffix; root יָצַת. Haṣṣālāh: deliverance; noun, sing. fem.; root נָצַל. To rescue: hiṣṣar: he pressed; haṣṣēr: press; perfect Hiphil, 3rd masc., and imperative Hiphil masc.; root צוּר. Hiṣrôtî: I straitened; perfect Hiphil, 1st sing.; root צוּר. Hiṣṣātî: I was kindled, for hiṣṣattî, perfect Hiphil, 1st sing.; root נָצַת, or rather יָצַת.

units.la: וְהַקְאֹתָ & evomas illud, vel וַהֲקְאוֹתָ, praet. Hiph. 2.f.m. (à simpli-ce, הַקְאֹתָ, vel הַקְאוֹתָ) aff. R. קָאָה, vel קוּא.
units.tr: And you shall vomit it out, or vahakuotha, second person masculine singular preterite Hiphil (from the simple form hakuotha, or hakuotha), derived from the root qaah, or qua.

units.la: הַקַּב cabus, mensura, No. f. m. praef. Rad. קָבַב maledicere,
units.tr: hakkab, a cab (a measure), noun masculine singular, with prefix, from the root qabab, to curse.

units.la: הַקְבְּצוּ congregate vos, Imper. Niph. pl. m. R. קִבַּץ
units.tr: hiqbetsu, gather yourselves together, imperative Niphal plural masculine, root qibbats.

units.la: בְּהַקְדִּישִׁי in sanctificari me, Infin. Niph. praef. aff. Rad. קדשׁ
units.tr: behaqdishi, in my being sanctified, infinitive Niphal with prefix and suffix, root qadash.

units.la: לְהַקָּהֵל ad congregandum, Infin. Niph. Rad. קָהַל
units.tr: lehaqahel, to gather together, infinitive Niphal, root qahal.

units.la: הָקִים erexit, הֵקִימוּ erexerunt, praet. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. fed הָקֵם, vel הָקִם erige, est Imper. Hiph. f. m. ut & הֲקִימוֹתָ suscitasti eum, praet. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. R. קוּם.
units.tr: haqim, he raised up, heqimu, they raised up, preterite Hiphil third person singular and plural masculine, with the form haqem or haqim, raise up, is the imperative Hiphil second person singular masculine; likewise haqimota, you raised him up, preterite Hiphil second person singular masculine with suffix, root qum.

units.la: הֵקִיפוּ circumegit, הֵקִיפוּ circumegerunt, praet.
units.tr: heqifu, he went round, heqifu, they went round, preterite

units.la: Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. sed, הָקֵף circumeundo, circumito, est Infin. vel Imper. Hiph. f. m. & הַקִּיפֵהוּ circumdate eam, pl. m. aff. Rad. יָקַף.
units.tr: Hiphil third person singular and plural masculine; but haqef, going round, circling, is the infinitive or imperative Hiphil singular masculine; and haqifehu, surround it, plural masculine with suffix, root yaqaf.

units.la: הִקִּיצָה evigilavit, הִקִּיצוּ evigilarunt, הִקִּיצוֹתִי evigilavi, הָקִיצָה evigila, הָקִיצוּ evigilate, &c. praet. Hiph. 3. f. m. f. & 3. pl. & 1. f. ut & Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. R. קִיץ
units.tr: hiqitsah, she awoke, hiqitsu, they awoke, hiqitsoti, I awoke, haqitsah, awake, haqitsu, awake (plural), etc.: preterite Hiphil third person feminine singular, third person plural and first person singular, and imperative Hiphil feminine and plural masculine; root qits.

units.la: הַקִּיל juxta manare, Infin. Hiph. Rad. קוּל [?]
units.tr: haqil, to flow alongside, infinitive Hiphil, root qul [?].

units.la: הִקִּלוּ levius fecit, הִקַּלּוּ vilipenderunt, הִקַּלּוֹתַנִי vilipendisti me, praet. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. ut & 2. f. m. aff. Rad. קָלַל.
units.tr: hiqqilu, he made light, hiqqallu, they despised, hiqqallotani, you despised me, preterite Hiphil third person singular and plural and second person singular masculine with suffix, root qalal.

units.la: הָקַל levare, leva, Infin. vel Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. קַלַּל
units.tr: haqal, to lift, lift up, infinitive or imperative Hiphil singular masculine, root qallal.

units.la: הִקַּל vilipendunt, praet. Hiph. 3. pl. R. קלל
units.tr: hiqqal, they despise, preterite Hiphil third person plural, root qalal.

units.la: הָקִים erigere, erige, Infin. vel Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. קוּם
units.tr: haqim, to erect, erect, infinitive or imperative Hiphil singular masculine, root qum.

units.la: הָקִים constitutus est, 2 Sam. 23. 1. pro הוֹקִים praet. Hoph. 3. f. m. Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: haqim, he was appointed, for hoqim, preterite Hophal third person singular masculine, root qum. (2 Sam. 23. 1.)

units.la: הֵקִמוֹ stabilivisti eum, הֵקַמְתִּי statui, הֵקִמְנוּ statuimus, praet. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. & 1. f. & pl. Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: heqimo, you established him, heqamti, I established, heqamnu, we established, preterite Hiphil second person singular masculine with suffix, and first person singular and plural, root qum.

units.la: הִקְנַנִי possidere fecit me, praet. Hiph. 3. f. masc. aff. Rad. קָנָה.
units.tr: hiqnani, he caused me to possess, preterite Hiphil third person singular masculine with suffix, root qanah.

units.la: הִקִּיפוּנִי circumdederunt me, הִקִּיפֶתֶם circumdedisfis, praet. Hiph. 3. pl. aff. & 2. pl. m. ut & הַקִּיף circumuendo, Infin. Hiph. &c. Rad. נקף.
units.tr: hiqifuni, they surrounded me, hiqifetem, you surrounded, preterite Hiphil third person plural with suffix and second person plural masculine; likewise haqif, surrounding, infinitive Hiphil, etc., root naqaf.

units.la: הִקִּיפוּנִי perfoderunt me, praet. Hiph. 3. plur. aff. Rad. נָקַב concidit, perfodit.
units.tr: hiqifuni, they pierced me, preterite Hiphil third person plural with suffix, root naqab, he cut off, pierced through.

units.la: הִקְצוּ abraserunt, praet. Hiph 3. pl. item, הִקְצוֹת
units.tr: hiqtsu, they shaved off, preterite Hiphil third person plural; likewise hiqtsot

units.la: abradere, Lev. 14 43. pro הַקְצוֹת, Inf. Hiph. Rad. קָצָה
units.tr: to shave off, Lev. 14. 43, for haqtsot, infinitive Hiphil, root qatsah.

units.la: הֲקֵר pretiosum habe, Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. יָקַר
units.tr: haqer, hold precious, imperative Hiphil singular masculine, root yaqar.

units.la: הִקְרָה eruciat, praet. Hiph. 3. sing. faem. Rad. קוּר.
units.tr: hiqrah, he meets with, preterite Hiphil third person singular feminine, root qur.

units.la: הֵקָה feeit ut aduenirent, הִקְרִיתֶם facistis accidere, הֵקָה facit ut obueniat, praet. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 2. pl. m. ut & Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. קָרָה
units.tr: heqah, he caused them to meet, hiqritem, you caused to befall, heqah, he causes to befall, preterite Hiphil third person singular masculine and second person plural masculine, and imperative Hiphil singular masculine, root qarah.

units.la: ה ר
units.tr: h r

units.la: הַר, & הָר mons, No. f. m. contracte, à No. Rad. הרר
units.tr: har, and har, mountain, noun masculine singular, contracted from a noun, root hrr.

units.la: הֲרָאֵה ostende te, Imper. Niph. f. m. R. רָאָה
units.tr: haraeh, show yourself, imperative Niphal singular masculine, root raah.

units.la: הֵרָאוֹת, ל הֵרָאוֹת apparere, הֵרָאוֹתוֹ ostendi ipsum, Infin. Niph. aff. Rad. רָאָה.
units.tr: heraot, to appear, lehéraot, to appear, herauto, I showed him, infinitive Niphal with suffix, root raah.

units.la: הֵרָאָה, vel הֵרָאֲה videre fecit, הֵרָאֵנִי & הֵרָאֲנִי me, הֵרָאִיךָ nobis, הֵרָאתִי tibi,
units.tr: heraah, or herahah, he caused to see, herani and heraani, me, heraik, to us, heratí, to you,

units.la: הַרְאֵם eis, &c. præt. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. רָאָה
units.tr: haremem, to them, etc., preterite Hiphil third person singular masculine with suffix, root raah.

units.la: הָרְאָה ostenditur, הָרְאִית tu videri factus es, præt. Hoph. 3. & 2. f. m. Rad. רָאָה
units.tr: horah, it is shown, horit, you were made to appear, preterite Hophal third person and second person feminine singular masculine, root raah.

units.la: לְהַרְאוֹת ad ostendendum, הַרְאוֹתְךָ o-ftendere tibi, הַרְאוֹתָם illis, Infin. Hiph. aff. Rad. רָאָה
units.tr: lehaaroot, to show, haraotkha, to show you, haraotam, to them, infinitive Hiphil with suffix, root raah.

units.la: הֶרְאֵיתָ fecisti videre, הֶרְאֵיתַנִי me, הֶרְאֵיתִי feci videre, הֶרְאֵיתְךָ te, הֶרְאֵיתִם ostendi eis, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. & 1. f. aff. R. רָאָה
units.tr: heraeta, you caused to see, heraitani, me, heraiti, I caused to see, heraitka, you, heraitam, I showed them, preterite Hiphil second person singular masculine and first person singular with suffix, root raah.

units.la: הַרְאֵנִי fac videre me, הַרְאֵנוּ ostende nobis, הַרְאֵנִי ostende mihi, Imper. Hiph. f. m. & fæm. aff. R. רָאָה
units.tr: harenni, make me see, harenu, show us, harenni, show me, imperative Hiphil singular masculine and feminine with suffix, root raah.

units.la: הָרְבָּ multiplica, est Imper. Hiph. (apoc. pro הַרְבֵּה,) 2. f. m. Rad. רָבָה
units.tr: harev, multiply, is the imperative Hiphil (apocopated for harbeh), second person singular masculine, root rabah.

units.la: חַרְבִּית & חַרְבָּה pro הַרְבּוּת multiplicando, 2 Sam. 14. 11. Infin. Hiph. R. רָבָה
units.tr: harbit and harbah, for harbut, multiplying, 2 Sam. 14. 11, infinitive Hiphil, root rabah.

units.la: הַרְבִּי multiplica, Imper. Hiph. 2. f. f. R. רָבָה
units.tr: harbi, multiply, imperative Hiphil second person singular feminine, root rabah.

units.la: בְּהָרְג in occidi, Ezech. 26. 15. (pro כְּהַהֲרֹג,) Infin. Niph. Rad. הָרַג
units.tr: beharog, in slaying, Ezek. 26. 15 (for kehahareg), infinitive Niphal, root harag.

units.la: הָרָה versus montem, No. הַר cum ה locali, R. הרר
units.tr: harah, toward the mountain, noun har with local he, root hrr.

units.la: הָרוֹ, הָרוֹן concipiendo, Infin. Kal, & הָרוֹן conceptus, No. f. m. R. הָרָה
units.tr: harov, harun, conceiving, infinitive Qal, and harun, conception, noun masculine singular, root harah.

units.la: הָרָה conceptus est, præt. pual. 3. f. m. R. הָרָה
units.tr: harah, she has conceived, preterite Pual third person singular masculine, root harah.

units.la: הָרְוָה inebriat, הָרְוֵיתִי inebriavi, præt. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 1. f. Rad. רָוָה
units.tr: haruah, he makes drunk, harveti, I made drunk, preterite Hiphil third person singular masculine and first person singular, root ravah.

units.la: הֲרֵי progenitores mei, pl. masc. aff. à f. masc. הָרָה, Rad. הָרָה
units.tr: harei, my forefathers, plural masculine, with suffix from the singular feminine harah, root harah.

units.la: הָרְיוֹתָיו prægnantes ejus, No. pl. fæm. aff. à sing. fæm. הֲרִיָּה, Rad. הָרָה.
units.tr: haryotav, his pregnant women, noun plural feminine, with suffix from the singular feminine hariyah, root harah.

units.la: לְהָרִיחַ ad odorari, וְהֵרִיחוּ & odorari ejus, Infin. Hiph. & aff. in præt. Hiph. הֵרִיחַ, à Rad. רִיחַ.
units.tr: lehariach, to smell, vehariachu, and they smelled his, infinitive Hiphil and preterite Hiphil with suffix, hiriach, from the root riach.

units.la: הָרִים montes, No. pl. masc. à f. m. No. הַר vel הוֹר. R. הָרַר.
units.tr: harim, mountains, noun masculine plural, from the masculine singular noun har or hor, root harar.

units.la: הָרִים extollere, Infin. Hiph. à præt. הֵרִים, & Rad. רוּם.
units.tr: harim, to lift up, infinitive Hiphil, from the preterite herim, and root rum.

units.la: הֵרִימוֹתָ extulisti, הֲרִימוֹתִי extuli, &c. præt. Hiph.2.&1.f.Rad. רוּם.
units.tr: herimota, you lifted up, herimoti, I lifted up, etc., preterite Hiphil second and first person singular, root rum.

units.la: הֵרִיעַ clanxit, הֵרִיעוּ clanxerunt, הָרִיעַ clange, הָרִיעוּ clangite, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. & Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. רִיעַ.
units.tr: heriah, he shouted, heriu, they shouted, hari, shout, hariu, shout (plural), preterite Hiphil third person singular and plural masculine, and imperative Hiphil singular and plural masculine, root riah.

units.la: הֵרִיקְ evacuavit, הֵרִיקוּ exferuerunt, וַהֲרִיקוֹתִי & evaginabo, &c. præt. Hiph. 3.f. & pl. m. & 1. sing. Rad. רִיק, vel רוּק.
units.tr: herik, he emptied, heriku, they poured out, vahariqoti, and I will draw out, etc., preterite Hiphil third person singular and plural masculine and first person singular, root rik, or ruq.

units.la: הֵרִית concepisti, præt. Kal, 2.f.fçm. R. הָרָה.
units.tr: herit, you conceived, preterite Qal second person singular feminine, root harah.

units.la: הֵרַךְ emollit, præt. Hiph. 3.f. m. R. רָכַךְ.
units.tr: herak, he softens, preterite Hiphil third person singular masculine, root rakak.

units.la: הָרֵם extolle, Imper. Hiph. f. m. & הָרֵם elevatum est, præt. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. רוּם.
units.tr: harem, lift up, imperative Hiphil singular masculine; and harem, it was lifted up, preterite Hophal third person singular masculine, root rum.

units.la: הָרְמוּ extollite vos, pro הָרִמוּ, Imper. Niph. pl. m. Rad. רָמַם.
units.tr: haremu, lift yourselves up, for harimu, imperative Niphal plural masculine, root ramam.

units.la: הָרִמוֹתָ extulisti, הָרִמוֹתֶם extulistis, præt. Hiph. 2. f. & pl. m. Rad. רוּם.
units.tr: harimota, you lifted up, harimotem, you lifted up, preterite Hiphil second person singular and plural masculine, root rum.

units.la: הָרְנֵךְ conceptus tuus, No. f. m. aff. Rad. הָרָה concepit.
units.tr: harnekh, your conception, noun masculine singular with suffix, root harah, he conceived.

units.la: הָרַע malefecit, הֵרִיעוּ malefecerunt, præt.Hiph.3. f. & pl. m. sed, הָרֵעַ malefaciendo, & לְהָרֵעַ ad malefaciendum, &c. Infin. Hiph. Rad. רוּעַ.
units.tr: hara, he did evil, heriu, they did evil, preterite Hiphil third person singular and plural masculine; but hare, doing evil, and lehare, to do evil, etc., infinitive Hiphil, root rua.

units.la: הֲרֵעֹתָ, & הֲרֵעֹתָה malefecisti, &c. præt. Hiph, 2. f.m. Rad. רוּעַ.
units.tr: harotah and harotah, you did evil, etc., preterite Hiphil second person singular masculine, root rua.

units.la: הֲרֵעֹתֶם malefecistis, vociferati estis, præt,
units.tr: harotem, you did evil, you shouted, preterite

units.la: Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. רוע, vel ריע.
units.tr: Hiphil third person plural masculine, root rua or ria.

units.la: הָרֵף remissum fac, apoc. הַרְפֵּה, Imper. Hiph. Rad. רָפָה.
units.tr: haref, remit, apocopated for harpeh, imperative Hiphil, root rafah.

units.la: הַרְפָּא curari, Infin. Niph. Rad. רָפָא.
units.tr: harpa, to be healed, infinitive Niphal, root rapa.

units.la: הָרְפָּה fecit desistere, הָרְפּוּ fecerunt desistere, praet. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. ut & הַרְפּוּ desistite, Imper. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. רָפָה.
units.tr: harpah, he caused to cease, harpu, they caused to cease, preterite Hiphil third person singular and plural masculine, and harpu, cease, imperative Hiphil plural masculine, root rafah.

units.la: הָרִין fac currete, Imper. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. רִין.
units.tr: harin, make run, imperative Hiphil second person singular masculine, root rin.

units.la: וְהִרְצַת & perficiet, Lev. 26.34. (contracte, pro הִרְצַתָּה,) praet. Hiph. 3. f. faem. R. רָצָה.
units.tr: vehirtsat, and he will complete, Lev. 26. 34 (contracted for hirtsatah), preterite Hiphil third person singular feminine, root ratsah.

units.la: הִרְקַח conficere fac pigmentum, Imper. Hiph. f. m. R. רָקַח.
units.tr: hirqach, make compound the perfume, imperative Hiphil singular masculine, root raqach.

units.la: הָרָה gravida, f. faem. constr. & הָרָתֵיהֶם praegnantes eorum, pl. faem. aff. à sing. faem. & Rad. הָרָה.
units.tr: harah, pregnant, feminine singular construct, and harateihem, their pregnant women, feminine plural with suffix, from the singular feminine and root harah.

units.la: הָרָתִי genitrix meu, הָרָתָם.
units.tr: haratí, my mother, harátam, their.

units.la: eorum, No. f. faem. הָרָה aff. Rad. הָרָה.
units.tr: of them, noun feminine singular, harah with suffix, root harah.

units.la: ה · ש
