units.la: וַתָּנַח et quievit, pro וַתָּנַח, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. נוּחַ.
units.tr: וַתָּנַח and she rested, for וַתָּנַח, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root נוּחַ.

units.la: וַתָּנָס et fugit, pro וַתָּנֹס, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. נוּס.
units.tr: וַתָּנָס and she fled, for וַתָּנֹס, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root נוּס.

units.la: וַיָּסֵר et amovit, pro וַיָּסֵר, fut. Hiph. 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. סוּר.
units.tr: וַיָּסֵר and he removed, for וַיָּסֵר, future Hiph. 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root סוּר.

units.la: וַיָּעַד et contestatus fuisti, pro וַיָּעֵד, fut. Hiph. 2. s. m. conv. Rad. עוּד.
units.tr: וַיָּעַד and you testified, for וַיָּעֵד, future Hiph. 2nd masc. sing. with conversive vav, root עוּד.

units.la: וַתַּעַשׂ et illa ornavit se, pro וַתַּעֲשֶׂה, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: וַתַּעַשׂ and she adorned herself, for וַתַּעֲשֶׂה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root עָשָׂה.

units.la: וַתַּעַשׂ et robora-ta fuit, pro וַתָּשׁ, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. עָשׂ.
units.tr: וַתַּעַשׂ and she was strengthened, for וַתָּשׁ, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root עָשׂ.

units.la: וַתַּעֲמֹס et amicivit, et contendit, forma, quasi apoc. pro וַתַּעֲמֹס, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. conv. à Rad. עָטָה obvolvit; sed est, pro וַתָּעֹט, vel וַתָּעֵט, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. fæm. conv. à Rad. עוּט, vel עֵיט involare.
units.tr: וַתַּעֲמֹס and she covered herself, and she strove; the form, as if apocopated for וַתַּעֲמֹס, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, from the root עָטָה, to wrap around; but it is for וַתָּעֹט or וַתָּעֵט, future Hiph. 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, from the root עוּט or עֵיט, to fly upon.

units.la: וַתַּעַל et ascendit, vel ascendere fecit, apoc. pro וַתַּעֲלֶה, fut. Kal, vel Hiph. 3. s. fæm. vel 2. s. m. Rad. עָלָה.
units.tr: וַתַּעַל and she went up, or she caused to go up, apocopated for וַתַּעֲלֶה, future Kal or Hiph., 3rd fem. sing. or 2nd masc. sing., root עָלָה.

units.la: וַתַּעַן & respondit, apoc. pro וַתַּעֲנֶה, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. עָנָה.
units.tr: וַתַּעַן and she answered, apocopated for וַתַּעֲנֶה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root עָנָה.

units.la: וַתַּעַשׂ et fecit, s. vel fecisti, v. apoc. pro וַתַּעֲשֶׂה, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. vel 2. s. m. conv. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: וַתַּעַשׂ and she made, or you made, apocopated for וַתַּעֲשֶׂה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. or 2nd masc. sing. with conversive vav, root עָשָׂה.

units.la: וַתִּפְנֶה et vertit se, apoc. pro וַתִּפְנֶה, fut. Kal, 3. s. fæm. conv. Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: וַתִּפְנֶה and she turned herself, apocopated for וַתִּפְנֶה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root פָּנָה.

units.la: וּתְקָם
units.tr: וּתְקָם

units.la: וַיָּקָם et surrexit, pro וַיָּקוּם, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. קום
units.tr: וַיָּקָם and he rose up, for וַיָּקוּם, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root קום.

units.la: וַתָּקָשׁ et difficilis fuit, apoc. pro וַתִּקְשֶׁה, fut. Piel, 3. f. fæm. conv. R. קָשָׁה
units.tr: וַתָּקָשׁ and it was difficult, apocopated for וַתִּקְשֶׁה, future Piel, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root קָשָׁה.

units.la: וַיַּרְא et vidit, f. et vidisti, v. apoc. pro וַיִּרְאֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. vel 2. f. m. R. רָאָה
units.tr: וַיַּרְא and he saw, or you saw, apocopated for וַיִּרְאֶה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. or 2nd masc. root רָאָה.

units.la: וַתֶּרֶב et major fuit, apoc. pro וַתִּרְבֶּה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. רָבָה
units.tr: וַתֶּרֶב and she was greater, apocopated for וַתִּרְבֶּה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root רָבָה.

units.la: וַיָּרָם et elevata fuit, pro וַיָּרוֹם, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. רוּם
units.tr: וַיָּרָם and she was exalted, for וַיָּרוֹם, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root רוּם.

units.la: וַיָּרֶם et extulisti, pro וַיָּרִים, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. conv. Rad. רוּם
units.tr: וַיָּרֶם and you lifted up, for וַיָּרִים, future Hiph. 2nd masc. sing. with conversive vav, root רוּם.

units.la: וַתָּרַע et makefecisti, pro וַתָּרֵעַ, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. conv. Rad. רוּעַ
units.tr: וַתָּרַע and you made evil, for וַתָּרֵעַ, future Hiph. 2nd masc. sing. with conversive vav, root רוּעַ.

units.la: וַתִּרְצֶה et acquievisti, v. et acquievit, f. apoc. pro וַתִּרְצֶה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. conv. Rad. רָצָה
units.tr: וַתִּרְצֶה and you were pleased, or and she was pleased, apocopated for וַתִּרְצֶה, future Kal, 2nd masc. or 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root רָצָה.

units.la: וַיָּרָץ et cucurrit, pro וַיָּרִיץ, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. רוּץ
units.tr: וַיָּרָץ and she ran, for וַיָּרִיץ, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root רוּץ.

units.la: וַתָּשָׁב et illa reversa est, vel turevertus es, pro וַתָּשׁוּב, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. vel 2. f. masc. conv. Rad. שׁוּב
units.tr: וַתָּשָׁב and she returned, or you turned back, for וַתָּשׁוּב, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. or 2nd masc. sing. with conversive vav, root שׁוּב.

units.la: וַתַּשְׁקֵּ et illa bibendum dedit, apoc. pro וַתַּשְׁקֵה, fut. Hiph. 3. f. fæm. conv. R. שָׁקָה
units.tr: וַתַּשְׁקֵּ and she gave to drink, apocopated for וַתַּשְׁקֵה, future Hiph. 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root שָׁקָה.

units.la: וַתָּשַׁר et illa cecinit, pro וַתָּשִׁיר, fut. kal, 3. f. fæm. conv. Rad. שִׁיר
units.tr: וַתָּשַׁר and she sang, for וַתָּשִׁיר, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root שִׁיר.

units.la: וַתִּשְׁתֶּ et illa bibit, vel tu bibisti, apoc. pro וַתִּשְׁתֶּה, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. vel 2. f. m. conv. Rad. שָׁתָה
units.tr: וַתִּשְׁתֶּ and she drank, or you drank, apocopated for וַתִּשְׁתֶּה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. or 2nd fem. masc. sing. with conversive vav, root שָׁתָה.

units.la: וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ et illa se incurvavit, apoc. pro וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. conv. Rad. שָׁחָה
units.tr: וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ and she bowed herself, apocopated for וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ, future Hithp. 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root שָׁחָה.

units.la: וַתֵּתַע et illa aberravit, Gen. 21. 14. apoc. pro וַתִּתְעֶה, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. conv. Rad. תָּעָה
units.tr: וַתֵּתַע and she went astray, Gen. 21. 14, apocopated for וַתִּתְעֶה, future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. with conversive vav, root תָּעָה.

units.la: ז א
units.tr: ז א

units.la: זֹאת hæc, Pron. fæm. vide in masc. זֶה hic.
units.tr: זֹאת haec, pronoun feminine. See under the masculine זֶה hic.

units.la: ז ב
units.tr: ז ב

units.la: זָב fluxu laborans, זָבָה, זְבַת fluxu affecta, Ben. Kal, f. m. & fæm. constr. Rad. זוב fluere.
units.tr: זָב afflicted with a flux; זָבָה, זְבַת affected with a flux, Ben. Kal, masc. and fem. construct. Root זוב to flow.

units.la: ז ד
units.tr: ז ד

units.la: זָדָה, זָד superbivit, זָדוּ superbiverunt, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & fæm. & 3. pl. Rad. זוד.
units.tr: זָדָה, זָד he acted proudly; זָדוּ they acted proudly, perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc. and fem., and 3rd pl. Root זוד.

units.la: זָד superbus, זֵדִים superbi, זָדוֹן, זְדוֹן superbia, No. f. & pl. m. & No. f. m. absol. & constr. Item, זֵדוֹנִים superbi, No. pl. m. Rad. זוד superbire.
units.tr: זָד proud; זֵדִים proud (men); זָדוֹן, זְדוֹן pride, noun feminine, and noun masculine, absolute and construct. Also זֵדוֹנִים proud (men), noun masculine plural. Root זוד to be proud.

units.la: ז ה
units.tr: ז ה

units.la: זֹהֲמָתוֹ abominatur eum, Job. 33. 20. (pro זָהֲמָתְהוּ) præt. Piel, 3 f. fæm. aff. Rad. זָהַם.
units.tr: זֹהֲמָתוֹ he abhors him, Job 33:20 (for זָהֲמָתְהוּ), perfect Piel, 3rd sing. fem. with suffix. Root זָהַם.

units.la: ז ו
units.tr: ז ו

units.la: זוֹ mensis aprilis nomen, Sif, No. Rad. sing masc. vel à Rad. Chald. זִיו splendor.
units.tr: זוֹ name of the month of April, Sif, noun, singular masculine; or from the Chaldee root זִיו splendour.

units.la: זוּ, זֹו, & זוֹה, vel זֶה hic, hæc, Pron. à. Rad. זֶה.
units.tr: זוּ, זֹו, and זוֹה, or זֶה this, this (fem.), pronoun. From the root זֶה.

units.la: זוֹחִים anguli, No. pl. fæm. Rad. זָוִיוֹת [?].
units.tr: זוֹחִים corners, noun feminine plural. Root זָוִיוֹת [?].

units.la: זוֹלָל epulo, vilis, No. f.m. & זוֹלָלָה vilis, commessatrix, f. fæm. Rad. זול, vel זָלַל.
units.tr: זוֹלָל a glutton, cheap, noun masculine; and זוֹלָלָה cheap, a reveller, feminine noun. Root זול, or זָלַל.

units.la: זוּלָתִי præter, זוּלָתְךָ præter, præterme, præter te, &c. à Rad. זָלַת.
units.tr: זוּלָתִי except; זוּלָתְךָ except, except me, except you, etc. From the root זָלַת.

units.la: זוֹנָה hospita, meretrix, No. f. fæm. R. זון alere, vel זָנָה scortatus est.
units.tr: זוֹנָה hostess, harlot, noun feminine. Root זון to feed, or זָנָה he played the harlot.

units.la: זוֹנָה meretrix, Ben. Kal, f. fæm. Rad. זָנָה.
units.tr: זוֹנָה harlot, Ben. Kal, feminine. Root זָנָה.

units.la: זוֹנָה scortatio peracta fuit, Ezech. 16. 34. (pro זֹנָה) præt. Pual, 3. f. m.
units.tr: זוֹנָה harlotry was committed, Ezek. 16:34 (for זֹנָה), perfect Pual, 3rd sing. fem.

units.la: Rad. זָנָה .
units.tr: Root זָנָה.

units.la: זוּעָה commotio, & transp. זַעֲוָה, No. s. fæm. Rad. זוע movit.
units.tr: זוּעָה commotion, and transposed זַעֲוָה, noun feminine singular. Root זוע he moved.

units.la: זוּעָמָה, vel זָעֲמָה detestare, Num. 23.7. pro זְוַעֲמָה vel זַעֲמָה, Imper. irreg. Kal, s. m. parag. Rad. זעם [?].
units.tr: זוּעָמָה, or זָעֲמָה curse, Num. 23:7 (for זְוַעֲמָה or זַעֲמָה), imperative irregular Kal, singular masculine with paragogic ending. Root זעם [?].

units.la: וְהַזּוּרָה & compressum, Pahul Kal, s. m. cum Sægol loco Kametz, R. זור.
units.tr: וְהַזּוּרָה and compressed, Pahul Kal, singular masculine, with Segol in place of Qamets, root זור.

units.la: זורו comprimuntur, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. זור, vel præt. Pual, 3. pl. Rad. זרה ventilavit.
units.tr: זורו they are compressed, perfect Kal, 3rd pl. Root זור, or perfect Pual, 3rd pl. Root זרה he winnowed.

units.la: ז י
units.tr: ז י

units.la: זִקּוֹת scintillæ, pl. fæm. à s. m. No. R. זִיק.
units.tr: זִקּוֹת sparks, plural feminine, from the singular masculine, noun. Root זִיק.

units.la: זֵיתֵיהֶם olivæ eorum, pl. m. aff. à s. f. m. No. Rad. זַיִת oliva, constr. זַיִת.
units.tr: זֵיתֵיהֶם their olives, plural masculine with suffix, from the singular feminine, noun. Root זַיִת olive, construct זַיִת.

units.la: ז כ
units.tr: ז כ

units.la: זַךְ, vel זָךְ purus, זַכָּה pura, No. s. f. m. & f. & זַכּוּ.
units.tr: זַךְ, or זָךְ pure; זַכָּה pure (fem.), noun singular feminine and masculine; and זַכּוּ.

units.la: mundi sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. זָכְכוּ.
units.tr: they are clean, perfect Kal, 3rd pl. Root זָכְכוּ.

units.la: זְכוּכִית gemma nitida, No. s. fæm. Rad. זָכַךְ.
units.tr: זְכוּכִית a bright gem, noun singular feminine. Root זָכַךְ.

units.la: זָכִיתָ purus fuisti, præt. Piel. 2. s. m. R. זכה.
units.tr: זָכִיתָ you were pure, perfect Piel, 2nd sing. masc. Root זכה.

units.la: זָכְרָה recordare, Imp. Kal, cum ה parag. pro זְכֹר.
units.tr: זָכְרָה remember, imperative Kal, with paragogic ה, for זְכֹר.

units.la: ז ל
units.tr: ז ל

units.la: זִלָּה vilitas, זִלּוּת vilitates, No. s. & pl. f. Rad. זול, vel זלל.
units.tr: זִלָּה cheapness; זִלּוּת cheapnesses, noun singular and plural feminine. Root זול, or זלל.

units.la: זִלְזִלִּים flagella in vitibus, No. pl. m. Rad. זלל.
units.tr: זִלְזִלִּים shoots on vines, noun masculine plural. Root זלל.

units.la: מְזַלְזְלִים vilipendentes, No. pl. m. Rad. זול.
units.tr: מְזַלְזְלִים despising, noun masculine plural. Root זול.

units.la: ז מ
units.tr: ז מ

units.la: זִמָּה scelus, זִמַּת tuum, זִמַּתְכֶם vestrum, Ezech.23.48. ubi ה est parag. No. s. fæm. aff. Rad. זמם cogitavit.
units.tr: זִמָּה wickedness; זִמַּת your; זִמַּתְכֶם your (pl.), Ezek. 23:48, where ה is paragogic; noun singular feminine with suffix. Root זמם he devised.

units.la: זַמּוֹתָ cogitasti, זַמֹּתִי cogitavi, &c. præt. Kal, 2. s. m. & 1. s. Rad. זמם. זמורה palmes, f. f. constr. No. זמורה, R. זמר
units.tr: זַמּוֹתָ you devised; זַמֹּתִי I devised, etc., perfect Kal, 2nd sing. masc. and 1st sing. Root זמם. זמורה vine-branch, feminine noun, construct; noun זמורה, root זמר.

units.la: ז ן
units.tr: ז ן

units.la: זן alimentum, בֵּין de alimento, f. m. No. Rad. זנה
units.tr: זן food; בֵּין concerning food, masculine noun. Root זנה.

units.la: זנות scortando, בזִמְּתֶךָ in scortarite, &c. Infin. Kal, praef. aff. Rad. זנה
units.tr: זנות whoring; בזִמְּתֶךָ in your whoredom, etc. Infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root זנה.

units.la: זנו scortati sunt, praet. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. זנה
units.tr: זנו they played the harlot, perfect Kal, 3rd pl. Root זנה.

units.la: זנונים fornicationes, No. pl. m. Rad. זנה
units.tr: זנונים whoredoms, noun masculine plural. Root זנה.

units.la: זנות scortatio, No. f. fem. Rad. זנה
units.tr: זנות whoredom, noun feminine. Root זנה.

units.la: זנותיכם scortationes vestre, No. pl. m. aff. a f. fem. זנות, Rad. זנה
units.tr: זנותיכם your whoredoms, noun masculine plural with suffix, from the feminine זנות. Root זנה.

units.la: זונים scortantes, זונה meretrices, Ben Kal, pl. m. fem. a f. m. זונה, & fing. fem. זונה, Rad. זנה
units.tr: זונים whoring; זונה harlots, Ben. Kal, masculine and feminine plural, from the masculine זונה, and the feminine זונה formed by analogy. Root זנה.

units.la: זנים species, No. pl. m. a f. No. R. זן
units.tr: זנים kinds, noun masculine plural, from the feminine זן. Root זן.

units.la: זניה scortatus es, זנית scortata es, praet. Kal, 2. f. m. & fem. Rad. זנה
units.tr: זניה you played the harlot; זנית you played the harlot (fem.), perfect Kal, 2nd sing. masc. and fem. Root זנה.

units.la: זנתה scortata est, praet. Kal, 3. f. fem. R. זנה
units.tr: זנתה she played the harlot, perfect Kal, 3rd sing. fem. Root זנה.

units.la: ז ע
units.tr: ז ע

units.la: זען movit se, vel movens, praet. Kal, 3. f. m. vel Ben Kal, f. m. Rad. זוע

Root זָרָה.

units.tr: חֵילָם, their wealth, noun, masc. with suffix. Root חַיִל.

units.la: חֵן gratia, No. f. m. Rad. חֵנָן gratiam fecit.
units.tr: חֵן, grace, noun, masc. Root חֵנָן, he showed grace.

units.la: חִיצוֹן exterior, No. f. m. & fem. Rad. חוּץ. foras.
units.tr: חִיצוֹן, exterior, noun, masc. & fem. Root חוּץ, outside.

units.la: חַיַּת caterva, חֵיתָם ipsorum, &c. No. f. f. constr. & aff. R. חָיָה.
units.tr: חַיַּת, troop, חֵיתָם, their, etc., noun, fem. construct & with suffix. Root חָיָה.

units.la: חָיְתָה vixit, praet. Kal, 3. f. fem. R. חָיָה.
units.tr: חָיְתָה, she lived, perfect Qal, 3rd fem. sing. Root חָיָה.

units.la: חַיָּתוֹ vita ejus, vel vita, No. f. fem. aff. vel parag. Rad. חָיָה.
units.tr: חַיָּתוֹ, his life, or life, noun, fem., with suffix or paragogic ending. Root חָיָה.

units.la: ח ב
units.tr: Ch B

units.la: חָכִי palatum חִכּוֹ ejus, חָכִּי meum, No. sing. masc. aff. Rad. חָכַךְ.
units.tr: chaki: palate; chikko: his palate; chakki: my palate. Noun, singular masculine with suffix. Root: chakak.

units.la: חַכָּה hamus, No. f. f. R. חכך.
units.tr: chakkah: hook. Noun, feminine. Root: chakak.

units.la: חִכּוּ expectarunt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. Rad. חָכָה.
units.tr: chikku: they waited. Perfect, Piel, third person plural. Root: chakah.

units.la: חֹכִי, vel חוֹכֵי expectantes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. Rad. חָכָה.
units.tr: chokhi, or chokhei: waiting. Participle, Kal, masculine plural. Root: chakah.

units.la: וּבְחַכֵּי & juxta praestolari, (pro חָכָה,) Infin. Piel, praef. Rad. חָכָה.
units.tr: uvechakkei: and to wait for, also to lie in wait. Infinitive, Piel, with prefix. Root: chakah.

units.la: חִכְלִלִי rubicundus, חִכְלִילוּת rubedo, No. s.m. f. m. & fæm. Rad. חָכָל.
units.tr: chiklili: ruddy; chiklilut: redness. Noun, singular masculine and feminine. Root: chakal.

units.la: ח ל
units.tr: Ch L

units.la: antemurale, pro חֵיל, No. f. m. R. חַיִל robur.
units.tr: antemurale: for cheil; noun, feminine and masculine. Root: chayil, strength.

units.la: חַל deprecare, Imper. Piel, f. m. apoc. (pro חִלָּה,) Rad. חָלָה.
units.tr: chal: entreat. Imperative, Piel, masculine and feminine, apocopated (for chillah). Root: chalah.

units.la: חַל, הַדַּל profanum, No. f. m. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: chal, hadal: profane. Noun, feminine and masculine. Root: chalal.

units.la: חַלְּאִים turba attrito-rum, ut duæ voces, à R. חיל, & כְּאֵה vel, ut una, à R. חָלַךְ.
units.tr: chal'im: a crowd of the crushed. It may be two words, from the root chayil and ke'eh; or, as one word, from the root chalak.

units.la: חַלָּאִים ornamenta, No. pl. m. à sing. חַלִּי, Rad. חָלָה ægrotavit.
units.tr: challa'im: ornaments. Noun, plural masculine, from the singular challi, root chalah, to be sick.

units.la: חַלְאָתָה spuma, חַלְאָתָה e-jus, No. f. fæm. aff. Rad. חלא spuma.
units.tr: chal'atah: foam; chal'atah, its foam. Noun, feminine, with suffix. Root: chal'a, foam.

units.la: חָלוּ doluerunt, ægrota-runt, præt. Kal, R. חול, vel חָלָה. חִלּוּ precati sunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: chalu: they grieved, they were sick. Perfect, Kal, root chul, or chalah. Chillu: they besought. Perfect, Piel, third person plural, root chalah.

units.la: חַלּוֹן fenestra, חַלּוֹנֵי, נִים, חַלּוֹנוֹת fenestræ, &c.
units.tr: chalon: window; chalone, chalonim, chalonot: windows, etc.

units.la: No. f. m. & pl. masc. & fæm. Rad. חָלַל perfo-rari.
units.tr: Noun, feminine and masculine, singular and plural masculine and feminine. Root: chalal, to be pierced.

units.la: חַלּוֹנֵי fenestræ, No. pl. m. irreg. à sing. חַלּוֹן, & Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: chalone: windows. Noun, plural masculine, irregular, from the singular chalon, and root chalal.

units.la: חָלוֹת ægrotare, Infin. Kal, חָלוֹת deprecari, Infin. Piel, Rad. חָלָה.
units.tr: chalot: to be sick, Infinitive, Kal; chalot: to entreat, Infinitive, Piel. Root: chalah.

units.la: חַלּוֹת placentæ, No. pl. fæm. à sing. חַלָּה, Rad. חָלַל perforari.
units.tr: chalot: cakes. Noun, plural feminine, from the singular challah, root chalal, to be pierced.

units.la: חַלּוֹתִי infirmare meum, Infin. Piel, vel No. Infin. aff. Rad. חָלָה.
units.tr: challoti: to make my sickness, Infinitive, Piel, or Noun Infinitive with suffix. Root: chalah.

units.la: חַלְחָלָה dolor vehemens, No. f. fæm. R. חול.
units.tr: chalchalah: severe pain. Noun, feminine. Root: chul.

units.la: חָלְיִ ornamentum, חֳלִי mor-bus, No. f. m. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: chali: ornament; choli: sickness. Noun, feminine and masculine. Root: chalah.

units.la: חָלִית ægrotasti, f. חָלִיתִי ægrotavi, præt. Kal, 2. f. fæm. & 1. f. Rad. חָלָה.
units.tr: chalit: you were sick; chalithi: I was sick. Perfect, Kal, second person feminine and first person singular. Root: chalah.

units.la: חָלִיתָ infirmatus es, præt. Pual, 2. f. masc. sed, חָלִיתִי ægrotare feci, præt. Piel, 1. f. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: chalita: you have been made sick. Perfect, Pual, second person masculine. But chalithi: I caused to be sick. Perfect, Piel, first person singular. Root: chalah.

units.la: חֲלִיתָה monile suum, No sing. fæm. חַלִּיָּה, aff. Rad. חָלָה. חַלְכָּאִים pauperes, No. pl. m.à f. חַלְכָּה, Rad. חָלַךְ vel, est comp. ex No. Rad. חַיִל, constr. חֵיל vel חַל robur, exercitus, & Rad. כָּאָה atterere, unde No. in f. m. כָּאָה attritus, in pl. m. כָּאִים. חָלְנוּ doluimus, præt. Kal, 1. pl. R. חוּל. חַלַּת placenta, No. f. fæm. constr. No. חַלָּה, Rad. חָלַל. בְּחַלְקְלַקּוֹת in blanditiis, No. pl. f. gem. R. חָלַק partitus est. חָלְּתִי parturivi, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. חוּל.
units.tr: chaliteh: her necklace. Noun, singular feminine, challiyyah, with suffix. Root: chalah. Chalk'im: the poor. Noun, plural masculine, from the feminine chalkah, root chalak; or it is compounded of the noun chayil, construct chel or chal, strength, army, and the root ka'ah, to crush, whence the noun ka'ah, crushed, in the masculine singular, and ka'im in the masculine plural. Chalnu: we grieved. Perfect, Kal, first person plural, root chul. Challat: a cake. Noun, feminine, construct of the noun challah, root chalal. Bechalaklakot: in flatteries. Noun, plural feminine, doubled, root chalak, he divided. Chalti: I travailed. Perfect, Kal, first person feminine, root chul.

units.la: ח מ
units.tr: Ch M

units.la: חַם incaluit, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. R. חַמַּם. חַם calor, No. f. m. Rad. חַמַּם incaluit. חַם incalescere, Infin. Kal, Rad. חַמַּם. חַם socer, חַם calidus, No. f. m. R. חַמָה, vel חַמַּם חַמְאָה חֶמְאַת butyrum, No. f. f. R. חָמָא. חֻמָּה, vel חוֹמָה murus, No. sing. fæm. Rad. חָמָה. חַמָּה calor, sol, No. f. fæm. Rad. חַמַּם. חַמָה æstuans ira, No. f. fæm. Rad. יָחַם incaluit. inca-luit. בְּ־חֶמָה in butyro, (pro בְּחַמְאָה,) No.sing.fæm. præf. Rad. חָמָא. בְּחַמָּם in æstu ejus, בְּחַמֵּי־חִמּוֹ eorum, No. f. m. חַם, præf. aff. Rad. חַמַּם. חַמּוֹת socrus, No. f. fæm. Rad. חָמָה. חַמּוֹת, vel חַמַּת excandescentiæ, pl. fæm. à f. fæm. חָמָה, Rad. יָחַם. חֲמוּתַיִם muri duo, comp. ex pl. fæm. & dual. à sing. חֹמָה, R. חָמָה. חָמֵיךָ socer tuus, No. f. m. חָם, aff. R. חָמָה. חַמִּים calidi, No. pl. à sing. masc. חָם, Rad. חָמַם incaluit. חַמָּנִים solaria idola, No. pl. m. Rad. חָמַם. חַמְרְמְרָה turbidæ sunt, Job.16.16. pro חַמְרְמְרוּ, præt. Pual, gem. 3. pl. Rad. חָמַר. חֵמָת excandescentia, f. fæm. constr. à No. חֲמָה R. יָחֵם. Item, חֲמַת, & חֲמַת uter, No. sing. fæm. constr. à. No. R. חָמָת uter. חֲמָתוֹ calor ejus, No. sing. fæm. חֲמָה, aff. Rad. חֲמַם.
units.tr: cham: he grew hot. Perfect, Kal, third person masculine singular, root chammam. Cham: heat. Noun, masculine, root chammam, he grew hot. Cham: to grow hot. Infinitive, Kal, root chammam. Cham: father-in-law; cham: hot. Noun, masculine, root chamah, or chammam. Chem'ah, or chem'at: butter. Noun, feminine, root chamam. Chummah, or chomah: wall. Noun, singular feminine, root chamah. Chammah: heat, sun. Noun, feminine, root chammam. Chamah: burning anger. Noun, feminine, root yacham, he grew hot. Be-chemah: in butter (for bechem'ah). Noun, singular feminine, with prefix, root chamam. Bechammam: in its heat; bechammei-chimmo: in their heat. Noun, masculine, cham, with prefix and suffix, root chammam. Chamot: mother-in-law. Noun, feminine, root chamah. Chamot, or chamat: fury. Plural feminine, from the feminine singular chamah, root yacham. Chamutayim: two walls. Compound of plural feminine and dual, from the singular chomah, root chamah. Chamekha: your father-in-law. Noun, masculine, cham, with suffix, root chamah. Chammim: hot ones. Noun, plural, from the singular masculine cham, root chammam, he grew hot. Chammanim: sun-images. Noun, plural masculine, root chammam. Chamr'mrah: they are troubled, Job 16:16, for chamr'meru. Perfect, Pual, doubled third person plural, root chamar. Chemat: fury. Noun, feminine, construct of the noun chamah, root yacham. Also chamat, or chamat, a vessel; noun, singular feminine, construct of the noun chamat, root chamat. Chamatho: his heat. Noun, singular feminine, chamah, with suffix, root chamam.

units.la: ח ן חֵן gratia, No. f. m. Rad. חָנַן gratiosus fuit. חָנוּ castra metati sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. חָנָה. חָנוֹ gratia ejus, No. f. m. aff. Rad. חֵן. חָנוֹת, חֲנוֹת gratiam facere, Ps.77.10. Infin. Kal, R. חָנַן. חַנּוּן gratiosus, No. f. m. Rad. חָנַן. חָנוּ castra metari, Infin. Kal, Rad. חָנָה. חָנּוֹתִי, vel חָנֵתִי gratiosus fui, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. חָנַן. חָנִיכָיו initiati ejus, No. pl. m. aff. R. חָנַךְ initiare. חָנִית hasta, וַחֲנִיתוֹתֵיהֶם & hastæ suæ, No. f. & pl. fæm. aff. Rad. חָנָה. חָנִיתִי castra metatus sum, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. חָנָה. חָנָךְ castra habens contra te, pro חֹנֶה עָלֶיךָ, Ben. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. חָנָה. חִנָּם immeritò, part. Adv. Rad. חָנַן. חָנָּה gratiam facere ei, pro חַנֵּה, Infin. Piel, aff. sed , חָנֵּנִי gratiam fac mihi, & חָנֵּנוּ nobis, est Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. חָנַן. חָנֵּנִי gratiam fac mihi, pro חָנֵּנִי Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. חָנַן.
units.tr: Ch N: chen: grace. Noun, feminine and masculine, root chanan, he was gracious. Chanu: they encamped. Perfect, Kal, third person plural masculine, root chanah. Chano: his grace. Noun, feminine and masculine, with suffix, root chen. Chanot, or chanot: to show grace, Psalm 77:10. Infinitive, Kal, root chanan. Channun: gracious. Noun, feminine and masculine, root chanan. Chanot: to encamp. Infinitive, Kal, root chanah. Chanoti, or chanetti: I was gracious. Perfect, Kal, first person feminine, root chanan. Chanikav: his initiates. Noun, plural masculine, with suffix, root chanak, to initiate. Chanit: spear; va-chaniyotehem: and their spears. Noun, feminine and plural feminine, with suffix, root chanah. Chanitti: I have encamped. Perfect, Kal, first person feminine, root chanah. Chanakh: encamping against you, for choneh alekha. Participle, Kal, masculine, with suffix, root chanah. Chinnam: undeservedly. Participle, adverb, root chanan. Channah: to show favour to him, for channeh, Infinitive, Piel, with suffix. But channeni: show me favour, and channenu: show us favour, is the Imperative, Kal, masculine, with suffix, root chanan. Channeni: show me favour, for channeni, Imperative, Kal, masculine, with suffix, root chanan.

units.tr: ח ס

units.la: חָמְלָה pepercerat, præt. Kal, 3. f. fæm. R. חָמַל [?]. חָסוּ sperarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. חָסָה. חָסוּ sperate, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. חָסָה. לַחֲסוֹת sperare, Infin. Kal, Rad. חָסָה. חָסָה sperat, Ps. 57. 12 [?] pro חָסָה præt. Kal, 3. f. fæm. Rad. חָסָה. חָסוּ sperarunt, Deut. 32. 37 pro חָסוּ præt. Kal, 3 pl. Rad. חָסָה. חֹסִים sperantes, Ben. Kal, pl. masc. Rad. חָסָה. חָסִין & חָסֵן robustus, No. f. m. R. חָסַן fortis fuit. חָסִיתִי speravi, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. חָסָה. חָסְתָּה pepercisti, præt. Kal; 2. f. m. R. חָמַל [?].
units.tr: חָמְלָה: she had spared; perfect, Kal, 3rd person feminine singular, root חָמַל [?]. חָסוּ: they trusted; perfect, Kal, 3rd person plural, root חָסָה. חָסוּ: trust ye; imperative, Kal, masculine plural, root חָסָה. לַחֲסוֹת: to trust; infinitive, Kal, root חָסָה. חָסָה: he trusts; Ps. 57. 12 [?] for חָסָה, perfect, Kal, 3rd person feminine singular, root חָסָה. חָסוּ: they trusted; Deut. 32. 37, for חָסוּ, perfect, Kal, 3rd person plural, root חָסָה. חֹסִים: trusting; participle, Kal, masculine plural, root חָסָה. חָסִין and חָסֵן: strong, adjective, masculine singular, root חָסַן, he was strong. חָסִיתִי: I trusted; perfect, Kal, 1st person singular, root חָסָה. חָסְתָּה: thou hast spared; perfect, Kal, 2nd person masculine singular, root חָמַל [?].

units.tr: ח פ

units.la: חַף nitidus, No. f. m. Rad. חָפַף texit. חָפָה protectio, No. sing. fæm. Rad. חָפַף. חָפוּ operuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. חָפָה. חָפוּי opertum, Pahul Kal, f. m. R. חָפָה.
units.tr: חַף: bright, adjective, masculine singular, root חָפַף, he covered. חָפָה: protection, noun, feminine singular, root חָפַף. חָפוּ: they covered; perfect, Kal, 3rd person plural, root חָפָה. חָפוּי: covered; Pahul, Kal, masculine singular, root חָפָה.

units.tr: ח צ

units.la: חֵץ sagitta, חִצּוֹ ejus, חִצִּים [?]. חִצֵּי sagittæ, חִצַּי e-jus, No. f. & pl. m. aff. R. חָצַץ exsoidit. חִצָּה sagitta, apoc. pro חִצִּים pl. m. No. חֵץ, sed הַחִצָּה sagitta, est idem No. f. m. חֵץ cum Jod
units.tr: חֵץ: arrow; חִצּוֹ: his arrow; חִצִּים [?]. חִצֵּי: arrows; חִצַּי: his arrows; noun, masculine plural with suffix, root חָצַץ, he shot forth. חִצָּה: arrow, shortened form for the masculine plural חִצִּים, noun from חֵץ; but הַחִצָּה, arrow, is the same, a noun of feminine masculine form from חֵץ with the paragogic Yod

units.la: parag. R. חָצַץ
units.tr: paragogic, root חָצַץ

units.la: חֲצִי חָצִי dimidium, חֲצִי ejus, No. f. m. & aff.
units.tr: חֲצִי, חָצִי: half; חֲצִי: his half; noun, masculine, with suffix.

units.la: חֲצָה dimidium, No. f. fæm. Rad. חָצָה divisit.
units.tr: חֲצָה: half; noun, feminine, root חָצָה, he divided.

units.la: חָצִיתָ divisisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. חָצָה
units.tr: חָצִיתָ: thou didst divide; perfect, Kal, 2nd person masculine singular, root חָצָה.

units.tr: ח ק

units.la: בְּחֵק in sinu, בְּחֵק esimu, præf. cum No. Rad. חֵק sinus.
units.tr: בְּחֵק: in the bosom; בְּחֵק: his bosom; preposition with noun, root חֵק, bosom.

units.la: חק statutum, חֻקִּים statuta, חֻקִּי ejus, &c. No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. חקק
units.tr: חק: statute; חֻקִּים: statutes; חֻקִּי: his statute, etc.; noun, feminine and masculine plural with suffix, root חקק.

units.la: חֻקָּה, חֻקַּת statutum, חֻקּוֹת statuta, חֻקֹּתִי mea, חֻקֹּתָיו ejus, &c. No. f. & pl. fæm. aff. Rad. חקק statuit.
units.tr: חֻקָּה, חֻקַּת: statute; חֻקּוֹת: statutes; חֻקֹּתִי: my statutes; חֻקֹּתָיו: his statutes, etc.; noun, feminine and feminine plural with suffix, root חקק, he decreed.

units.la: וְחָקְקוּ & describe, חֻקְקִיתָ descripsite, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. & 1. f. aff. Rad. חקק
units.tr: וְחָקְקוּ: and they engraved; חֻקְקִיתָ: thou didst engrave; perfect, Kal, 2nd person masculine singular and 1st person singular with suffix, root חקק.

units.tr: ח ר

units.la: וְחֹר & חֹר foramen, No.
units.tr: וְחֹר and חֹר: hole, noun.

Kal, Rad. אָהַב, & אָהַל. יֶאֱהָבֵנִי diliget eum, 1 Sam. 18. 1. pro יֶאֱהָבֶהוּ & יֶאֱהַבְנִי me, Gen.29.32. pro יֶאֱהַבְנִי, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. אָהַב. וַיֵּאוֹר & illuxit, 3. sing. masc. fut. Niph. Rad. אוֹר. יֵאוֹתוּ acquiescant, pro יֵאֹתוּ, fut. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. יָאַת. יְאַזְּרֵנִי accinget me, 3. f. m. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. אָזַר. יֵאחֲזוּ possessores fient, 3. pl. m. fut. Niph. R. אָחַז. יְאַחֵר tardabit, 3. f. m. fut. Piel, R. אָחַר. יֶאטֹם obturat, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. אָטַם. יֵאִין urgebit, & יֵאִיר lucere faciat, &c. 3. f. m. fut. Hiph. Rad. אוּן, & אוּר [?]. יֹאכַל comedetur, 3. f. m. fut. Niph. R. אָכַל. שֶׁיֹּאכַל ut comedat, 3. f. m. fut. Kal, R. אָכַל. וַיַּאכְלוּם & cibarunt eos, 3. pl. m. fut. Hiph. aff. Rad. אָכַל. וַיֹּאֶל & acquievit, & adjuratione obstrinxit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יָאַל; vel à Rad. אָלָה. יֵאָמֵן confirmetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָמַן. וַיַּאֲמֵן & credidit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. אָמַן. יֵאָמֵן robustus erit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. אָמַן. יֵאַמְּנוּ, & יֵאַמֵּן fortificabit, 3. f. m. fut. Piel, & Hiph. Rad. אָמַן. שֶׁיֵּאמְדוּ quam dicebant, 3. pl. masc. fut. Kal, Rad. אָמַר. יֵאמַר, vel י. ר dicetur, &c. fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. אָמַר. יֵאָנֶה tradetur, fut. Pual, 3. f. m. R. אָנָה. יֵאָנַח suspirat, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָנַח. יֵאָנַף irascetur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. אָנַף. יֵאָנַק exclamabit, 3. f. m. fut. Kal, R. אָנַק. יֵאָנֵשׁ aegritudine afficietur, pro יֵאָנֵשׁ fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. אָנַשׁ. יֵאַסֵּף addet, pro יֹסִיף, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. יָסַף. יֵאָסְפוּן congregabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. אָסַף. וַיֵּאַסְפֵם & congregavit eos, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. אָסַף. יֵאָסֵר vincietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָסַר. יֶאְסֹר ligabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. אָסַר. יֵאַסְרוּנִי vinciant me, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. אָסַר. יֵאַפּוּ coquent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. אָפָה. וַיֵּאָצֵל & sepofuit, Num. 11.25. pro יֵאָצֵל, fut. Hiph. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. אָצַל יֵאָצַר reponetur in thesaurum, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָצַר. יָאֵר lucere faciat, וַיָּאֶר & illustravit, & יָאֵר illustrabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. אוֹר. יְאֹר rivus, בִּיאֹר in rivo, &c. No. Rad. f. m. præf. כַּיְאֹר sicut rivus, pro quo extat כַּאֲר Amos 8.8. No. Rad. præf. וַיִּאְרוּ & jaculati sunt, pro וַיֵּרוּ 2 Sam. 11.24. fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. יָרָה. יַאֲרִיכוּן prolongabunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. אָרַךְ. יֶאְשַׁם reus fuerit, &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. אָשַׁם. וַיֵּאתְ & veniet, Jef. 41. 25. & וַיֶּאתָא & venit, Deut. 33.21. pro וַיֵּאתָה fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. אָתָה. יָאתָה acquiescit, præt. Kal, 3. f. fæm. Rad. יָאָתָה, vel יָאַת. יָאתָה veniet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. אָתָה. וַיֵּאתוּ & acquieverunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. יָאַת. יֵאתִיוּן advenient, וַיֵּאתִיוּן & adveniunt, pro יֵאתוּ, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. Rad. אָתָה. וַיֵּאתִנִי & evenit mihi, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. אָתָה.
units.tr: ׳ א they will be willing: 3rd person plural masculine imperfect Kal, root אָבָה. וַיֶּאֱבַל and he brings mourning: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Hiphil, root אָבַל. וַיֶּאֱבַק and he wrestled: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Niphal, root אָבַק. יַאְדִּיל he will magnify: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Hiphil, root אָדַר. יַאֹהֵל he will fix a tent: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Hiphil, root אָהַל, or for יַחֵל he will shine, Job 31.26 and 25.5, imperfect Hiphil 3rd person feminine masculine from the root הָלַל. יֶאֱהַב he will love, and וַיֶּאֱהַל he moved tents: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Kal, root אָהַב and אָהַל. יֶאֱהָבֵנִי he will love him, 1 Sam. 18.1, for יֶאֱהָבֶהוּ, and יֶאֱהַבְנִי me, Gen. 29.32, for יֶאֱהַבְנִי, imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine with suffix, root אָהַב. וַיֵּאוֹר and he shone: 3rd person singular masculine imperfect Niphal, root אוֹר. יֵאוֹתוּ they may acquiesce, for יֵאֹתוּ, imperfect Kal 3rd person plural, root יָאַת. יְאַזְּרֵנִי he will gird me: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Hiphil with suffix, root אָזַר. יֵאחֲזוּ they will become possessors: 3rd person plural masculine imperfect Niphal, root אָחַז. יְאַחֵר he will delay: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Piel, root אָחַר. יֶאטֹם he stops up: imperfect Hiphil 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָטַם. יֵאִין he will press, and יֵאִיר he will make to shine, etc.: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Hiphil, root אוּן, and אוּר [?]. יֹאכַל it will be eaten: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Niphal, root אָכַל. שֶׁיֹּאכַל that he may eat: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Kal, root אָכַל. וַיַּאכְלוּם and they fed them: 3rd person plural masculine imperfect Hiphil with suffix, root אָכַל. וַיֹּאֶל and he consented, and bound by oath: imperfect Hiphil 3rd person feminine masculine, root יָאַל, or from the root אָלָה. יֵאָמֵן it will be confirmed: imperfect Niphal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָמַן. וַיַּאֲמֵן and he believed: imperfect Hiphil 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָמַן. יֵאָמֵן he will be strong: imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָמַן. יֵאַמְּנוּ and יֵאַמֵּן he will strengthen: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Piel and Hiphil, root אָמַן. שֶׁיֵּאמְדוּ which they were saying: 3rd person plural masculine imperfect Kal, root אָמַר. יֵאמַר, or י. ר it will be said, etc.: imperfect Niphal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָמַר. יֵאָנֶה it will be delivered: imperfect Pual, 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָנָה. יֵאָנַח he sighs: imperfect Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָנַח. יֵאָנַף he will be angry: imperfect Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָנַף. יֵאָנַק he will cry out: 3rd person feminine masculine imperfect Kal, root אָנַק. יֵאָנֵשׁ he will be afflicted with grief, for יֵאָנֵשׁ imperfect Niphal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָנַשׁ. יֵאַסֵּף he will add, for יֹסִיף, imperfect Hiphil 3rd person feminine masculine, root יָסַף. יֵאָסְפוּן they will be gathered: imperfect Niphal 3rd person plural masculine, root אָסַף. וַיֵּאַסְפֵם and he gathered them: imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine with suffix, root אָסַף. יֵאָסֵר he will be bound: imperfect Niphal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָסַר. יֶאְסֹר he will bind: imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָסַר. יֵאַסְרוּנִי they will bind me: imperfect Kal 3rd person plural masculine with suffix, root אָסַר. יֵאַפּוּ they will bake: imperfect Kal 3rd person plural masculine, root אָפָה. וַיֵּאָצֵל and he set apart, Num. 11.25, for יֵאָצֵל, imperfect Hiphil, Hiphil 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָצַל. יֵאָצַר it will be laid up in the treasury: imperfect Niphal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָצַר. יָאֵר he will make shine, וַיָּאֶר and he illuminated, and יָאֵר he will illuminate: imperfect Hiphil 3rd person feminine masculine, root אוֹר. יְאֹר river, בִּיאֹר in the river, etc.: noun masculine, root, with preposition. כַּיְאֹר like a river, for which stands כַּאֲר Amos 8.8: noun, root, with preposition. וַיִּאְרוּ and they shot, for וַיֵּרוּ 2 Sam. 11.24: imperfect Hiphil 3rd person plural masculine, root יָרָה. יַאֲרִיכוּן they will prolong: imperfect Hiphil 3rd person plural masculine, root אָרַךְ. יֶאְשַׁם he will be guilty, etc.: imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָשַׁם. וַיֵּאתְ and he will come, Isa. 41.25, and וַיֶּאתָא and he came, Deut. 33.21, for וַיֵּאתָה: imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָתָה. יָאתָה he acquiesces: perfect Kal 3rd person feminine singular, root יָאָתָה, or יָאַת. יָאתָה he will come: imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine, root אָתָה. וַיֵּאתוּ and they acquiesced: imperfect Kal 3rd person plural masculine, root יָאַת. יֵאתִיוּן they will come, and וַיֵּאתִיוּן and they come, for יֵאתוּ: imperfect Kal 3rd person plural masculine, root אָתָה. וַיֵּאתִנִי and it happened to me: imperfect Kal 3rd person feminine masculine with prefix and suffix, root אָתָה.

units.la: יָבֹאנוּ veniet, יָבֹאנוּ e-veniet ei, &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. בוֹא. יָבִא, יָבֹא, יָבִיא adducet, יְבִיאֶךָ vel יְבִיאֲךָ te, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. בוֹא. וַיִּבֹאנִי & obvenerint mihi, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. præf. aff. Rad. בוֹא. יִבְּדֵל separabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. בָּדַל. יִבָּהַל accelerabit, fut. Piel: יִבַּהַל turbatus erit, fut. Niph. 3. f. Rad. בָּהַל. יָבוֹל proventus, No. f. m. Rad. יָבַל. יָבוֹל decidet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָבַל. יְכוֹנְנֵהוּ intelligentem reddet eum, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. R. בִּין. וִיכוֹקְקוּ & evacuabunt, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. præf. Rad. בּוּק, vel בָּקַק. יְבוֹשׁ erubescet, pro יְבוֹשׁ &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. בּוֹשׁ. יְבַשׁ arescet, pro יֵבַשׁ, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. יָבַשׁ. וַיִּבְזֶ & contempsit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. R. בָּזָה. יִבְזוּ contemnent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. בּוּז. יְבוּסוּ diripiant, יְבוּסוּם diripient eos, &c. fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. Rad. בָּזַז. יִבְזוּ spernent, יִבְזֻהוּ eum, &c. fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. בָּזָה. יִבָּחֵן probetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. בָּחַן. יִבֵּט, & יִבִּיט intuebitur, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נִבַּט. יָבִיא adducet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. & יְבִיאֻהוּ adducent eum, 3. pl. m. aff. R. בּוֹא. יָבִין intelliget, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. בִּין. יְבִיעַ eructabit, &c. 3. sing. masc. fut. Hiph. Rad. נָבַע. וַיֵּבְךְּ & flevit, 3. f. m. fut, Kal, apoc. ut & יִבְכּוּ, & יִבְכִּיון flebunt, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. בָּכָה. וַיָּבֶל & pabulum dedit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m, R. בָּלַל. יִבְלוּ deterent, fut. Piel, 3. pl. R. בָּלָה. יִבְלוּהָ deducent eam, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. aff. R. יָבַל.
units.tr: yābō'nū: he will come, or: he will come upon him, etc. Future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix. Root bô' (to come). yābi', yābō', yābîʾ: he will bring, lead; yebî'kā or yebî'ǎkā: he will bring you; future Hiphil, 3rd person, masculine, with suffix. Root bô'. wayyiḇōʾnî: and they came upon me; future Qal, 3rd person plural, masculine, with prefix and suffix. Root bô'. yibbādēl: he will be separated; future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root bādal. yibbāhal: he will hasten; future Piel: yibbahal: he will be troubled; future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine. Root bāhal. yābôl: produce, yield; noun, masculine. Root yābal. yāḇôl: he will fall; future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nābal. yekônenēhû: he will make him understand; future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix. Root bîn. wîḵôqqû: and they will empty; future Piel, 3rd person plural, masculine, with prefix. Root bûq or bāqaq. yebôsh: he will be ashamed, for yēḇōsh etc.; future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root bôsh. yebash: he will wither, for yēḇash; future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root yābash. wayyibzeh: and he despised; future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, apocopated. Root bāzāh. yibzû: they will despise; future Qal, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root bûz. yebûsû: they will plunder, yebûsûm: they will plunder them, etc.; future Qal, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root bāzaz. yibzû: they will despise, yibzuhû: they will despise him, etc.; future Qal, 3rd person plural, masculine, with suffix. Root bāzāh. yibbāḥēn: he will be tested; future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root bāḥan. yibbēṭ and yibbîṭ: he will look; future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nābaṭ. yābîʾ: he will bring, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, and yebî'uhû: they will bring him, 3rd person plural, masculine, with suffix. Root bô'. yābîn: he will understand, etc.; future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root bîn. yebîaʿ: he will pour forth, etc.; 3rd person singular, masculine, future Hiphil. Root nābaʿ. wayyibek: and he wept; future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, apocopated, as also yibkû and yibkiyyûn: they will weep; 3rd person plural, masculine, paragogic. Root bākāh. wayyāḇel: and he gave fodder; future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, root bālal. yibləû: they will deter; future Piel, 3rd person plural, root bālāh. yiblûhā: they will bring her down; future Hiphil, 3rd person plural, with suffix. Root yābal.

units.la: יִבְמָה affinitate junxerit sibi eam, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. יְבַם duc, Imper. Piel, f. m. Item, יְבָמִי levir meus, & יְבָמָהּ ejus, No. f. masc. יָבָם levir, aff. ut & יִבְמְתְּךָ fratria tua, & יִבְמֹּו ejus, No f. fæm. יִבְמַּת glos, fratria, aff. Rad. יָבַם.
units.tr: yibmāh: he has joined her to himself in marriage; perfect Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix. yabom: take as a brother-in-law; imperative Piel, feminine and masculine. Likewise yibmî: my brother-in-law, and yibmāh: her brother-in-law, noun, masculine; yābām: brother-in-law, with suffix, as also yibmətəkā: your sister-in-law, and yibmô: his, noun, feminine; yibmat: sister-in-law, with suffix. Root yābam.

units.la: וַיִּבֶן & ædificavit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. pro יִבְנָה, ut & יִבְנוּ ædificabunt, 3. pl. m. fut. Kal; Rad. בָּנָה ; sed, יִבָּנֶה exstruetur, est fut. Niph. 3. f. m. ab ead. Rad.
units.tr: wayyibən: and he built; future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, apocopated for yibnāh, as also yibnû: they will build; 3rd person plural, masculine, future Qal. Root bānāh. But yibbāneh: it will be built; is the future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, from the same root.

units.la: יְבַעֵר tollet, 3. f. m. fut. Piel; sed, יִבְעַר depascat, 3. f. fut. Hiph. Rad. בָּעַר.
units.tr: yəbaʿēr: he will take away; 3rd person, feminine and masculine, future Piel. But yibʿar: he will graze; 3rd person, feminine, future Hiphil. Root bāʿar.

units.la: יִבְעָתוּהוּ perturbabunt eum, & יִבְעָתוּנִי me, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. בָּעַת.
units.tr: yibʿātûhû: they will terrify him, and yibʿātûnî: me, future Piel, 3rd person plural, masculine, with suffix. Root bāʿat.

units.la: יִבָּקַע findetur, & יִבָּקְעוּ diffindent se; fut. Niph. 3. f.&pl.m. Rad. בָּקַע.
units.tr: yibbāqaʿ: it will be split, and yibbāqəʿû: they will split themselves; future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine plural. Root bāqaʿ.

units.la: יִבָּרְאוּן creabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. בָּרָא.
units.tr: yibbārəʾûn: they will be created; future Niphal, 3rd person plural, masculine, paragogic. Root bārāʾ.

units.la: יִבָּרֵךְ benedicet, &c. fut. Piel, & יְבֹרַךְ benedicetur, &c. fut. Pual, 3. f. m. R. בָּרַךְ.
units.tr: yibbārēk: he will bless, etc., future Piel; and yəbōrak: he will be blessed, etc., future Pual, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root bārak.

units.la: יְבָרְכֶנְהוּ benedicet ei, Ps. 72.15. pro יְבָרְכֵהוּ, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. & ɪ, epenth. R. בָּרַךְ.
units.tr: yəbārəkenhû: he will bless him, Ps. 72.15, for yəbārəkēhû; future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix and epenthetic ə. Root bārak.

units.la: יִבַּשׁ exsiccando, Infin. Kal, unde בִּיבֹשׁ in arescendo, Infin. Kal, cum præf. Rad. יָבֵשׁ.
units.tr: yabbēš: drying up, infinitive Qal, whence bîḇōš: in drying up, infinitive Qal, with prefix. Root yābēš.

units.la: יָבֵשׁ aruit, unde etiam יִבַּשׁ arescet, &c. fut. Kal, 3. fing masc. pro יִבַּשׁ; & וַיִּבְשֵׁהוּ & arefacit ipsum, Nah. 1. 4. pro יִבְּשֵׁהוּ, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. & יִבָּשׁ exsiccari, exsiccatio, Infin. etiam Kal, vel No. f. fæm. ut & יְבֵשָׁה arida, Nomen, f. fæm. & etiam ab ead. Rad. יִבְשׁוּ erubescent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. בּוּשׁ.
units.tr: yābēš: he has dried up, whence also yibbaš: he will dry up, etc., future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, for yibbaš; and wayyibšēhû: and he dried it up, Nah. 1.4, for yibbəšēhû, future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix; and yibbāš: to be dried up, drying up, infinitive, also Qal, or noun, feminine, as also yəbēšāh: dry land, noun, feminine, and also from the same root. yibšû: they will be ashamed, future Qal, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root būš.

units.la: ג׳
units.tr: G

units.la: יִנְאַל redimet, fut. Kal; יִנָּאֵל redimetur, fut. Niph. & יִנָּאֵל polluetur, fut. Pual, 3. sing. m. omnia à Rad. נָאַל. וַיִּגְבִּיהֵהוּ & extulit eum, 2. Chron. 33. 14. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. (à simplicè, יִגְבִּיהֵהוּ,) cum aff. & in 3. pl. יִגְבִּיהוּ altum petent, &c. à Rad. נָבַהּ, &c. יִנּוּרֶנּוּ populabitur, יִגּוּרֵנוּ eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. גּוּר. יִגְּרוּ turmatim conveniunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. גָּרַד. יִגַּהּ splendebit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָגַהּ. וַיִּגָּהּ & mœstitiâ afficit, Thren. 3. 33. fut. Piel, 3. f. m. pro וַיְגַּנֶּה, à Rad. יָגָה. יְהָה curabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָהָה. יָגוֹן mœror, מִגּוֹנָם à mœrore eorum, &c. No. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. יָגָה. יָגוֹף percutiet, pro יִגָּף, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָגַף. יָגוֹרִם timere facit eos, pro יְגוֹרֻם, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. גּוּר. יָגּוּשׁ exiget, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָגַשׁ. וַיָּגֹּז & totondit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָגַז. יַגַּח cornu feriet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָגַח. יָגִיד, vel יַגִּיד indicabit, &c. fut. Hiph. & יָגַּד annunciabitur, &c. fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָגַד. יָגִיהַּ splendere faciet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַהּ. יָגִיחַ educet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נוּחַ [?]. יָגִיל exultabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. גּוּל [?]. יָגִּיעַ attinget, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. f. m. R. נָגַע [?] וּמִגִּיעַ et à labore ejus, No. יָגִיעַ, f. m. præf. & aff. Rad. יָגַע laboravit. יַגִּיפוּ occludent, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָגַף. יָגִיר, vel יָגַר fundet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. & יַגִּירֵהוּ facient diffluere eum, 3. pl. m. aff. R. נָגַר. יַגִּישׁ afferant, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָגַשׁ. יָגַל exultabit, וַיָּגַל et exultavit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. גּוּל. וַיָּגֵל et volvetur, fut. Niph. יָגַל emigrabit, fut. Kal, וַיָּגַל & deportavit, fut. Hiph. Rad. גָּלָה migravit, vel גָּלַל volvit. יִגְלוּ migrabunt, fut. Kal; יִגְלוּ revelabuntur, Niphal; יִגְלוּ retegent, Piel; יִגְלוּ deportabunt, Hiphil, 3. pl. m. Rad. גָּלָה. יִגְמַל educabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נָמַל. יָגֵן proteget, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַן. יִגְנֹב furto auferetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. גָּנַב. וַיַּגֵּשׁ et admovit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַשׁ. יִגַּע attingent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. נָגַע. יִגְעוּ laborabunt, Jef.65.23. pro יגעו, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. Rad. יָגַע. יִגְּפֶנּוּ percutiet, יִגְּפֶנּוּ eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָגַף. וַיִּגֹּר et fudit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַר. יָגַר ruminabit, Lev. 11.7. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יָנוּר, Rad. גָּרַר. יִגְרָה miscebit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. גָּרָה. יָגוּרְךָ commorabitur tecum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. R. גּוּר. יִגְרֶם conteret, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. גָּרַם. יִגָּרַע diminuetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַע. יִגְרַע diminuet, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. נָגַע. יְגָרֵשׁ expellet, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. יְגָרְשִׁי ejicient, 3. pl. m. sed, יְגָּרְשׁוּ expellentur, fut. Pual, 3. pl. m. Rad. נָרַשׁ. יְגָרְשׁוּם expellent eos, Exod. 2. 17. pro יְגָרְשׁוּן eas, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. נָרַשׁ. יָגוֹרְתָּ metuisti, & תִּי־ metui, præt. Kal, 2. & 1. f. Rad. יָגוֹר. יִגַּשׁ accedet, fut. Kal; יִגִּישׁ vel admovebit, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. נָגַשׁ.
units.tr: yigʾal: he will redeem, future Qal; yinnāʾēl: he will be redeemed, future Niphal; and yinnāʾēl: he will be defiled, future Pual, 3rd person, masculine, singular. All from the root gāʾal. wayyigbihēhû: and he lifted him up, 2 Chron. 33.14, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine (from the simple form, yigbîhēhû), with suffix; and in the 3rd person plural yigbîhû: they will seek high places, etc., from the root gābah, etc. yinnûrennû: he will lay waste, yiggurenû: him, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix. Root gûr. yiggərû: they gather in troops, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root gārad. yiggah: he will shine, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgah. wayyiggāh: and he afflicts with sorrow, Lam. 3.33, future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, for wayəggannēh, from the root yāgāh. yəgahh: he will take care, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāhāh. yāgôn: sorrow; mîgônām: from their sorrow, etc., noun, masculine, with prefix and suffix. Root yāgāh. yāgôp: he will strike, for yiggāp, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgap. yāgôrim: he makes them fear, for yəgôrum, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix. Root gûr. yāgûš: he will exact, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaš. wayyāgōz: and he shore, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaz. yaggaḥ: he will gore with the horn, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaḥ. yāgîd, or yaggîd: he will declare, etc., future Hiphil; and yāggaḏ: he will be announced, etc., future Hophal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgad. yāgîah: he will cause to shine, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgah. yāgîaḥ: he will bring out, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nûaḥ [?]. yāgîl: he will exult, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root gûl [?]. yāgîaʿ: he will reach, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaʿ [?]; and miggîaʿ: and from his labour, noun, masculine, with prefix and suffix. Root yāgaʿ: he laboured. yaggîpû: they will shut up, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root nāgap. yāgîr, or yāgar: he will pour out, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine; and yaggîrēhû: they will cause it to flow, 3rd person plural, masculine, with suffix. Root nāgar. yaggîš: they will bring near, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root nāgaš. yāgal: he will exult; wayyāgal: and he exulted, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root gûl. wayyāgēl: and he will be rolled, future Niphal. yāgal: he will emigrate, future Qal; wayyāgal: and he carried off into exile, future Hiphil. Root gālāh: he migrated, or gālal: he rolled. yigləû: they will migrate, future Qal; yigləû: they will be revealed, Niphal; yigləû: they will uncover, Piel; yigləû: they will carry into exile, Hiphil, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root gālāh. yigmal: he will be weaned, future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāmal. yāgēn: he will protect, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgan. yiggənōb: he will be stolen away, future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root gānab. wayyaggēš: and he brought near, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaš. yigga: they will touch, future Qal, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root nāgaʿ. yigʿû: they will labour, Isa. 65.23, for yigʿû, future Qal, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root yāgaʿ. yiggəpennû: he will strike him, yiggəpennû: him, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix. Root nāgap. wayyiggōr: and he poured out, future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgar. yāgar: he will chew the cud, Lev. 11.7, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, for yānûr, root gārar. yigrāh: he will mix, future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root gārāh. yāgûrəkā: he will sojourn with you, future Qal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine, with suffix. Root gûr. yigrem: he will crush, future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root gāram. yiggāraʿ: he will be diminished, future Niphal, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaʿ. yigraʿ: he will diminish, future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaʿ. yəgārēš: he will drive out, future Piel, 3rd person, feminine and masculine; yəgārəšî: they will eject, 3rd person plural, masculine. But yəgārəšû: they will be expelled, future Pual, 3rd person plural, masculine. Root nārash. yəgārəšûm: they will drive them out, Exod. 2.17, for yəgārəšûn: they (feminine), future Piel, 3rd person plural, masculine, with suffix. Root nārash. yāgôrtā: you feared, and tî-: I feared, perfect Qal, 2nd and 1st person, feminine. Root yāgôr. yigaš: he will approach, future Qal; yigîš: or he will bring near, etc., future Hiphil, 3rd person, feminine and masculine. Root nāgaš.

units.la: ד יָד manus, &c. No. Rad. comm. gen. vel à Rad. יָדָה dejecit. וַיֵּרָא et volat, apoc. pro וַיֵּרְאָה, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. יָדָה וַיַּדַּח et expulit, 2 Reg. 17. 21. pro וַיֵּדַּח, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָדַח. יִדְּבְנוּ sponte moverit eum, fut. Kal, 3. sing. masc. aff. Rad. נָדַב. וַיִּרְּגָּנוּ et multiplicentur, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. דָּנָה. וַיִּנָּד et fugatur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. נָדַד. יִדְּדוּן fugerint, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. נָדַד. יְדוּ jaculamini, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. יָדָה. יָדוּ projecerunt, וַיָּדוּ et projecerunt, pro יִדּוּ, fut. Piel, 3. pl m. Rad. יָדָה. יִדּוֹם conticescet, &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יָדוֹם, Rad. דָּמַם. יָדוֹעַ scire, Inf. Kal, יְדוּעַ & expertus, Pahul Kal, f. m. constr. Rad. יָדַע. יִדּוֹר vovebit, pro יִדֹּר, fut. Kal, 3. f m. Rad. נָדַר לְיַדּוֹת ad dejiciendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. יָדָה יַדֵּת depellat, fut. Kal, יַדַּח expellet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָדַח יַדָּחָה impelletur, יִדָּחוּ impellentur, fut. Niph. 3. f & pl. m. Rad. דָּחָה יָדִיד dilectus, יְדִידָה dilecta, &c. No. f. m. & f. Rad. יָדַד jecit. יֵדִיחַ abluet, יֵדִיחוּ abluent, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. דּוּחַ וַיַּדִּיחוּ & expulerunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָדַח יָדָיו manus ejus, יָדֵינוּ nostræ, &c. No. pl. m. aff. à sing. No. R. יָד vel à R. יָדָה יָדִין judicabit, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. דִּין יֵדִיעַ notum facient, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. יָדַע וַיִּדְּכָּאוּ & conterantur, Job. 5. 4. pro יִתְדַּכְּאוּ, sync. fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. R. דָּכָא יְדַכֶּהָּ atteret, (pro quo scribitur וִדְכָּהָ, Psf 10. 10.) fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. דָּכָה יְדֵכֶם manus vestra, No. f. m. יָד, aff. R. יָד יָדַל attenuabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. דָּלַל יְדַלְּנָּה exhauriat illud, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. R. דָּלָה יִדַּם conticescet, יְדַמּוּ conticescent, pro יָדַם & יְדַמּוּ, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. R. דָּמַם יִדְמוּ silebunt, vel Dagesh ejecto, יִדְמוּ, &c. fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. דָּמַם יִדָּמוּ exscindentur, pro יִתְּדָּמוּ, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. דָּמָה יָדַע sciet, יֵדָעֻנּוּ cognoscat ipsum, ipsum, &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. ידע וְיֵדַע & notum faciet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. ידע לָדַעַת & cognoscere, Infin. Kal, Rad. ידע וְיֹדְעֶו & cognoscentes eum, Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. R. ידע וְיֹדְעִים & noti, Pahul Kal, pl. m. Rad. ידע יְדָעֲנִי ariolus, No. f. m. Rad. ידע scivit. יָדַעְתִּי cognovi, præt. Kal, 1. f. pro יָדַעְתִּי, Rad. ידע יִדְפֶּנּוּ impellat eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נדף יִדַּק & comminuit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. דקק יְדַקֶּנּוּ comminuet ipsum, fut. Kal, 3. sing. masc. aff. Rad. דקק יִדָּקַר confodietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. דקר יִדֹּד vovebit, יִדְּרוּ vovebunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. נדר יִדְשֵׁן pinguis efficietur, fut. Pual, 3. f. m. R. דשן יִדְשֶּׁנָּה incineret, Pf. 20.4. fut. Piel, 3. f. m. parag. Rad. דשן יִדְשֵׁנּוּ triturabit eum, fut. Kal, 3. sing. masc. aff, Rad. דוש.
units.tr: ד יָד manus, &c. No. Rad. comm. gen. vel à Rad. יָדָה dejecit. [Hand; noun, common gender, or from the root יָדָה, he cast down.] וַיֵּרָא and flies, apocopated for וַיֵּרְאָה, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. יָדָה. וַיַּדַּח and expelled, 2 Kings 17:21, for וַיֵּדַּח, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָדַח. יִדְּבְנוּ he will move him of his own accord, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix. Rad. נָדַב. וַיִּרְּגָּנוּ and they will be multiplied, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. m. R. דָּנָה. וַיִּנָּד and is driven away, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. נָדַד. יִדְּדוּן they will flee, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. m. with paragogic ending. Rad. נָדַד. יְדוּ hurl ye, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. יָדָה. יָדוּ they cast, and וַיָּדוּ and they cast, for יִדּוּ, fut. Piel, 3rd pl. m. Rad. יָדָה. יִדּוֹם he will be silent, etc., fut. Kal, 3. f. m., for יָדוֹם, Rad. דָּמַם. יָדוֹעַ to know, Inf. Kal; יְדוּעַ and known, Pahul Kal, f. m. construct. Rad. יָדַע. יִדּוֹר he will vow, for יִדֹּר, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָדַר. לְיַדּוֹת to cast down, Infin. Piel, with prefix, R. יָדָה. יַדֵּת he shall drive away, fut. Kal; יַדַּח he will expel, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָדַח. יַדָּחָה it will be thrust out; יִדָּחוּ they will be thrust out, fut. Niph. 3. f. and pl. m. Rad. דָּחָה. יָדִיד beloved; יְדִידָה beloved (fem.), etc., No. m. and f. Rad. יָדַד he cast. יֵדִיחַ he will wash away; יֵדִיחוּ they will wash away, fut. Hiph. 3. f. and pl. m. Rad. דּוּחַ. וַיַּדִּיחוּ and they expelled, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָדַח. יָדָיו his hands; יָדֵינוּ our (hands), etc., No. pl. m. with suffix from the sing. No. R. יָד or from R. יָדָה. יָדִין he will judge, etc., fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. דִּין. יֵדִיעַ they will make known, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. יָדַע. וַיִּדְּכָּאוּ and they will be crushed, Job 5:4, for יִתְדַּכְּאוּ, syncopated fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. R. דָּכָא. יְדַכֶּהָּ he will crush her (for which is written וִדְכָּהָ, Ps. 10:10), fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. דָּכָה. יְדֵכֶם your hand, No. f. m. יָד, with suffix. R. יָד. יָדַל it will be diminished, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. דָּלַל. יְדַלְּנָּה he will draw it out, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. with suffix. R. דָּלָה. יִדַּם he will be silent; יְדַמּוּ they will be silent, for יָדַם and יְדַמּוּ, fut. Kal, 3. f. and pl. m. R. דָּמַם. יִדְמוּ they will be silent, or with Dagesh removed, יִדְמוּ, etc., fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. דָּמַם. יִדָּמוּ they will be cut off, for יִתְּדָּמוּ, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. דָּמָה. יָדַע he will know; יֵדָעֻנּוּ let him know him, him, etc., fut. Kal, 3. f. m. with suffix. Rad. ידע. וְיֵדַע and he will make known, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. ידע. לָדַעַת to know, Infin. Kal, Rad. ידע. וְיֹדְעֶו and knowing him, Part. Kal, pl. m. with suffix. R. ידע. וְיֹדְעִים known, Pahul Kal, pl. m. Rad. ידע. יְדָעֲנִי a soothsayer, No. f. m. Rad. ידע he knew. יָדַעְתִּי I have known, perf. Kal, 1. f., for יָדַעְתִּי, Rad. ידע. יִדְפֶּנּוּ he will thrust him, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. with suffix. Rad. נדף. יִדַּק and he will crush, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. דקק. יְדַקֶּנּוּ he will crush him, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix. Rad. דקק. יִדָּקַר he will be pierced through, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. דקר. יִדֹּד he will vow, יִדְּרוּ they will vow, fut. Kal, 3. f. and pl. m. Rad. נדר. יִדְשֵׁן he will be made fat, fut. Pual, 3. f. m. R. דשן. יִדְשֶּׁנָּה he will burn to ashes, Ps. 20:4, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. paragogic. Rad. דשן. יִדְשֵׁנּוּ he will thresh him, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix, Rad. דוש.

units.la: ה יָהּ jah, No. Div. Rad. יִהְיֶה erit, Eccl. 11. 3. pro יִהְוֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. הוה. יְהוֹדָה celebrabit, Neh. 11. 17. pro יוֹדֶה, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. ידה. יְהוֹדוּךָ celebrabunt te, Ps. 45.18. pro יוֹדוּךָ; fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. ידה. יְהוָה Jehova, No. Div. à Rad. הָוָה fuit. יְהוֹלֵל insanire faciet, fut. Piel, in forma Pohel, pro יְהַלֵּל, Rad. הָלַל יְהוֹשִׁיעַ servabit, Pf. 116. 6. pro יוֹשִׁיעַ, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. יָשַׁע יְהִי erit, pro יִהְיֶה, item, יִהְיוּ erunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. R. הָיָה יְהִיר superbus, No. Rad. f. m. in R. יָהַר יָהֵל splendebit, יְהַלְלוּ lucere facient, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. הָלַל יָהֵל, vel יָהֶל tentorium figet, Jef. 13.20. pro יַאֲהֵל fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. אָהַל יְהֵילִלוּ, vel יְהֵילִלוּ ululabunt, Jef. 52. 5. fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. יָלַל וַיְהַמֵּם & contrivit, יְהַמֵּם cum מ abund. 2. Sam. 22. 15. וַיְהַמֵּם & contrivit eos, fut. Kal; 3. sing. masc. præf. & aff. Rad. הָמַם יְהֶמָּיוּן perstrepent, Ps. 39. 7. pro יְהֵמוּ, 3. pl. m. fut. Kal, Rad. הָמָה יְהֻפַּךְ vertetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. הָפַךְ יְהֻרַּג occidetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. הָרַג יְהֻרַּס destruetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. הָרַס וְיְהַתְּלוּ illudent, pro יְהַתְּלוּ fut. Piel, 3. f. m. Rad. הָתַל וַיּוֹאֶל & acquievit, 3. f. m. fut. Hiph. R. יָאַל וַיּוֹאֶל & adjuravit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. ad formam יָאַל, sed quoad signif. in 1 Sam. 14.24. est per apoc. pro יַאֲלָה, à Rad. אָלָה adjuravit. יֵאָר maledicetur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. אָרַר יוּבָא adducetur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. בּוֹא יוּבִלוּן adducent, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. יָבַל
units.tr: ה יָהּ Jah, No. Div. Rad. יִהְיֶה he will be, Eccl. 11:3, for יִהְוֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. הוה. יְהוֹדָה he will celebrate, Neh. 11:17, for יוֹדֶה, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. ידה. יְהוֹדוּךָ they will celebrate you, Ps. 45:18, for יוֹדוּךָ; fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. with suffix. Rad. ידה. יְהוָה Jehovah, No. Div. from the Rad. הָוָה he was. יְהוֹלֵל he will make mad, fut. Piel, in the form Pohel, for יְהַלֵּל, Rad. הָלַל. יְהוֹשִׁיעַ he will save, Ps. 116:6, for יוֹשִׁיעַ, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. יָשַׁע. יְהִי he will be, for יִהְיֶה; likewise, יִהְיוּ they will be, fut. Kal, 3. f. and pl. m. R. הָיָה. יְהִיר proud, No. Rad. f. m. in R. יָהַר. יָהֵל he will shine; יְהַלְלוּ they will make to shine, fut. Hiph. 3. f. and pl. m. Rad. הָלַל. יָהֵל, or יָהֶל he will fix a tent, Isa. 13:20, for יַאֲהֵל, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. אָהַל. יְהֵילִלוּ, or יְהֵילִלוּ they will howl, Isa. 52:5, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. יָלַל. וַיְהַמֵּם and he crushed, with מ added (pleonastic), 2 Sam. 22:15. וַיְהַמֵּם and he crushed them, fut. Kal; 3rd sing. masc. with prefix and suffix. Rad. הָמַם. יְהֶמָּיוּן they will roar, Ps. 39:7, for יְהֵמוּ, 3rd pl. m. fut. Kal, Rad. הָמָה. יְהֻפַּךְ it will be turned, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. הָפַךְ. יְהֻרַּג he will be slain, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. הָרַג. יְהֻרַּס he will be destroyed, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. הָרַס. וְיְהַתְּלוּ and they will mock, for יְהַתְּלוּ, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. Rad. הָתַל. וַיּוֹאֶל and he consented, 3. f. m. fut. Hiph. R. יָאַל. וַיּוֹאֶל and he swore, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. in the form of יָאַל, but as to meaning, in 1 Sam. 14:24, it is by apocope for יַאֲלָה, from the Rad. אָלָה he swore. יֵאָר he will be cursed, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. אָרַר. יוּבָא he will be brought, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. בּוֹא. יוּבִלוּן they will bring, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. with paragogic ending. Rad. יָבַל.

units.tr: יורע he will be made known, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. ידע.

units.tr: יודעם he will show them, and יודיענו to him, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. with suffix. Rad. ידע.

units.tr: ירק it will be crushed, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. דקק.

units.tr: יִדוּשׁ it will be threshed, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. דוש.

units.tr: יוחל and he waited, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יחל.

units.tr: ויוחר and he delayed, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. with ו in place of; Rad. אחר.

units.la: יושל projicietur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. טול
units.tr: יושל it will be cast out, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. טול.

units.tr: ויולד and he begot, ויוליד he will beget, etc. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. ילד.

units.tr: [יולד] was born, perfect Pual, 3 f. m. Root [ילד].

units.tr: [יולך] may lead, etc. Future Hiphil, 3 f. m. Root [ילך].

units.tr: [יומרך] will say to you, Ps. 139.

Rad. ינה יגתי[?] columba mea, No. f. fæm. aff. R. ינה בין[?] in cæno, No. f. m. constr. præf. R. ין יונקהו[?] tener ramus ejus, יונקותיו teneri rami ejus, No. sing. fæm. ותנקה[?], & pl. fæm. aff. units.tr: 20. For [יאמרוך?], future Qal, 3 pl. m. with suffix. Root [אמר]. [יומת] shall be slain, [יומתו] shall be put to death, future Hophal, 3 f. and pl. m. Root [מות]. [יגה?] oppressing, participle Qal, fem. Root [יגה?]. [יגה?] has oppressed, [יגו?] oppress, future Hiphil, 3 f. and pl. m. Root [ינה]. [ינה?] dove, noun fem. Root [ינה]. [יגים?] oppressing, participle Qal, pl. masc. Root [ינה?]. [ינה?] my dove, noun fem. with suffix. Root [ינה]. [בין?] in the mire, noun masc., construct, with prefix. Root [ין]. [יונקהו?] its tender branch, [יונקותיו] its tender branches, noun sing. fem. with suffix, and pl. fem. with suffix. Root [יונק]. [ותנקה?] sucked. [יסב] shall be surrounded, future Hophal, 3 f. m. Root [סבב].

[יועצהו] her counsellors, participle Qal, sing. fem. with suffix. Root [יעץ].

units.la: abdent se, fut. Niph. 3. 3. pl. m. R. הָבָא יֵחָבַּט [?] excutietur, ; fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. חָבַט וַיַּחְבִּיאֵם & abscondit eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. חָבָא. יֶחְבַּל in pignus dabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. חָבַל. הֲיֵחָבֶּרְךָ [?] an sociabitur tibi, pro הַיְחַבֵּר עִמָּךְ [?], vel pro הַיְחַבְּרֶךָ [?], fut. Pual; 3. f. m. praef. aff. Rad. חָבַר. וַיָּחֹגּוּ & festum celebrent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. חָגַג. יָחַד acuet, vel, יַחַד; est fut. Kal, (quasi à R. חָדָה letari, per apoc. pro יַחְדָּה) vel, fut. Hiph. (pro יַחְיד) 3. f. m. R. חָרַד acui. יָחַד lætabitur, Job. 3. 5. pro יָחֵד est fut. Kal, (per apoc. pro יַחְדָה, vel יַחְדָּה, ut יֵשֵׁב, cum Patach furtivo, pro Scheva, sub ח) 3. f. m. à Rad. הָרָה. יָחֹל dolebit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. חוּל. יְחוֹלְלוּ reformabuntur, fut. Pual, 3. pl. m. R. חוּל. יְחוֹקְקוּ decernent, fut. Piel, in forma Poel, 3. pl. m. R. חָקַק. יְחוּרוּ, vel יְחוֹרוּ albescent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. חָוַר. יֶחֱזוּן videbunt, Jef. 26. 11. protractè, & parag. pro יֶחֱזוּ, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. חָזָה. יְחִי vivat, וַיְחִי & vivat, וַיְחִי & vixit, יְחִי vivet, וַיְחִי & vivet, & וַיְחִי & vixit, omnia, apoc. pro יִהְיֶה, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. הָיָה. יִחְיוּ vivent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. הָיָה. יְחַיּוּ in vita conservabunt, יְחַיֵּנִי me, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. R. חָיָה, in Piel, חָיָה.
units.tr: will hide themselves, future Niphal, 3 pl. m. Root [הָבָא]; [יֵחָבַּט?] will be shaken out, future Niphal, 3 f. m. Root [חָבַט]; and [וַיַּחְבִּיאֵם] he hid them, future Hiphil, 3 f. m. with suffix. Root [חָבָא]; [יֶחְבַּל] will be given in pledge, future Niphal, 3 f. m. Root [חָבַל]; [הֲיֵחָבֶּרְךָ?] will be joined to you, for [הַיְחַבֵּר עִמָּךְ?] or [הַיְחַבְּרֶךָ?], future Pual, 3 f. m., with prefix and suffix. Root [חָבַר]; [וַיָּחֹגּוּ] and they will keep the feast, future Qal, 3 pl. m. Root [חָגַג]. [יָחַד] will sharpen, or [יַחַד]; it is future Qal (as if from the root [חָדָה], to rejoice, by apocope for [יַחְדָּה]), or future Hiphil (for [יַחְיד]), 3 f. m. Root [חָרַד], to be sharpened. [יָחַד] will rejoice, Job 3. 5, for [יָחֵד], is future Qal (by apocope for [יַחְדָה] or [יַחְדָּה], as [יֵשֵׁב], with furtive patach for the shewa under the [ח]), 3 f. m., from the root [הָרָה]. [יָחֹל] will grieve, future Qal, 3 f. m. Root [חוּל]. [יְחוֹלְלוּ] will be reformed, future Pual, 3 pl. m. Root [חוּל]. [יְחוֹקְקוּ] will decree, future Piel, in the form of Poel, 3 pl. m. Root [חָקַק]. [יְחוּרוּ] or [יְחוֹרוּ] will grow white, future Qal, 3 pl. m. Root [חָוַר]. [יֶחֱזוּן] will see, Isa. 26. 11, lengthened, and paragogic for [יֶחֱזוּ], future Qal, 3 pl. m. Root [חָזָה]. [יְחִי] let him live; [וַיְחִי] and he lived; [יְחִי] will live; [וַיְחִי] and he will live; and [וַיְחִי] and he lived, all apocopated for [יִהְיֶה], future Qal, 3 f. m. Root [הָיָה]. [יִחְיוּ] will live, future Qal, 3 pl. m. Root [הָיָה]. [יְחַיּוּ] will keep alive, [יְחַיֵּנִי] will keep me alive, future Piel, 3 pl. m. with suffix. Root [חָיָה], in Piel [חָיָה].

units.la: יֶחִיל dolebit, exspectans, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. חול. Vel est No. f. m. R. יָחִיל.
units.tr: yechil, he will grieve, waiting, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem. or masc., root חול. Or it is a noun, masc. sing., root יָחִיל.

units.la: יְחִילוּ dolore afficient, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. חול.
units.tr: yechilu: they will cause grief, fut. Hiph. 3rd pl. masc., root חול.

units.la: יְחַיֵּנִי vivificabit me, וִיחַיֶּהוּ eum, וַיְחַיָּהּ & vivifica-vit eam, & יְחַיֵּנוּ vivificabit nos, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. viz. יְחַיָּה, aff. Rad. חָיָה.
units.tr: yechayyeni: he will make me live; wiyechayyehu: he will make him live; wayechayyah: and he made her live; and yechayyenu: he will make us live; fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., viz. yechayyah, with affix; root חָיָה.

units.la: יְחִישָׁה festinabit, pro יְחִישָׁה, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. parag. R. חוּשׁ.
units.tr: yechishah: he will hasten, for yechishah, fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., with paragogic ending; root חוּשׁ.

units.la: וַיֶּחָל & timuit, (pro יֶחִיל) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. חול.
units.tr: vayyechal: and he feared (for yechil); fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., root חול.

units.la: יָחֵל incipiet, וַיָּחֶל & incepit; fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. חָלַל.
units.tr: yachel: he will begin; vayyachel: and he began; fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., root חָלַל.

units.la: יְחַל profanabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: yechal: he will be profaned; fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing., root חָלַל.

units.la: יְחַל profanabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: yechal: he will profane; fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., root חָלַל.

units.la: וַיֶּחַל & aegrotavit, fut. Kal, apoc. 3. f. m. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: vayyechal: and he was sick; fut. Kal, apocopated, 3rd fem. sing., root חָלָה.

units.la: וַיְחַל & deprecatus fuit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. apoc. R. חָלָה.
units.tr: vayechal: and he entreated; fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., apocopated, root חָלָה.

units.la: יְחַל expecta, imper. Piel, f. m. vel pro יְחַל expe-ctet, expectabit, &c. fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. יָחַל.
units.tr: yeḥal expecta, imperative Piel, masculine singular, or for yeḥal expectet, expectabit, etc., future Piel, 3rd person masculine singular. Root yāḥal [יָחַל].

units.la: וַיְחַל pro וַיְחַל & expecta-vit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. יָחַל.
units.tr: vayechal, for vayechal: and he waited; fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., root יָחַל.

units.la: וַיֶּחַל & expectavit; fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יָחַל.
units.tr: vayyechal: and he waited; fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., root יָחַל.

units.la: וַיְחַלָא & aegrotavit, 2Par. 16. 12. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. cum א, pro ה; Rad. חָלָה.
units.tr: vayechala: and he was sick, 2 Chron. 16:12; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., with aleph for he; root חָלָה.

units.la: וַיְחַלוּ & expectarunt, pro יְחִילוּ, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. חול.
units.tr: vayechalu: and they waited, for yechilu; fut. Hiph. 3rd pl. masc., root חול.

units.la: וַיְחַלוּ & coeperunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. חָלַל.
units.tr: vayechalu: and they began; fut. Hiph. 3rd pl. masc., root חָלַל.

units.la: וַיְחַלוּ, & וַיְחַלוּ & expecta-bant, praet. Piel, 3 pl. R. יָחַל.
units.tr: vayechalu and vayechalu: and they were waiting; pret. Piel, 3rd pl., root יָחַל.

units.la: יְחַלְּלוּהָ profanaverint eam, eam, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. Aff. R. חָלַל
units.tr: yechalleluha: they will profane it, her; fut. Piel, 3rd pl. masc., with affix; root חָלַל.

units.la: יְחָלְּצוּ eruentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. חָלַץ [?]
units.tr: yechalletzu: they will be rescued; fut. Niph. 3rd pl. masc., root חָלַץ [?]

units.la: יֵחָלֵק dividetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. חָלַק [?]
units.tr: yecheleq: it will be divided; fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing., root חָלַק [?]

units.la: וַיְחַלֵּקֵם & distribuit eos, 1 Par. 23. 6. pro יְחַלְּקֵם, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. R. חָלַק [?]
units.tr: vayechalleqem: and he distributed them, 1 Chron. 23:6, for yechalleqem; fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root חָלַק [?]

units.la: יְחֵם, & יַחַם incaluit, pro יָחַם, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יָחַם [?]
units.tr: yechem and yacham: he grew warm, for yacham; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., root יָחַם [?]

units.la: יַחַם incalescere, Infin. Piel, R. יחם [?]
units.tr: yacham: to grow warm, infinitive Piel, root יחם [?]

units.la: וַיֶּחְמוּ & conceperunt, pro וַיְחַמוּ, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. יָחַם [?]
units.tr: vayyechmu: and they conceived, for vayechmu; fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc., root יָחַם [?]

units.la: וַתְּחַמְנָה & incaluerunt, cum ', m. pro ת, fæm. pro וַתְּחַמְנָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. est verbum androgynum, Rad. יחם [?]
units.tr: vattechamnah: and they grew warm, with yod for tav, feminine for vattechamnah; fut. Kal, 3rd pl. fem.; it is a common-gender verb, root יחם [?]

units.la: לִיחַמְנָה ut conciperent ipse, pro לִיחָמָה, vel לִיחְמָה; infinit. Piel, præf. & aff. Rad. יחם [?]
units.tr: lichamnah: that they might conceive, themselves, for lichamah or lichmah; infinitive Piel, with prefix and affix; root יחם [?]

units.la: יְחַכְּתַנִּי concepit me, Ps. 51.7. pro יְחַמַּתְנִי, præt. Piel, 3. f. f. aff. R. יחם [?]
units.tr: yechakkatanni: he conceived me, Ps. 51:7, for yechammatanni; pret. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root יחם [?]

units.la: יְחָנֶּן gratiam faciet, וַיְחָן & gratiam fecit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. חנן [?]
units.tr: yechennen: he will show favour; vayechan: he showed favour; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., root חנן [?]

units.la: יְחָנֵּן gratiâ afficietur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. חנן [?]
units.tr: yechennen: he will be shown favour; fut. Hoph. 3rd fem. sing., root חנן [?]

units.la: וַיִּחַן & castra posuit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. Rad. חנה [?]
units.tr: vayyachan: he pitched camp; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., apocopated, root חנה [?]

units.la: וַיִּחֲנוּן & castrametati sunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. חנה [?]
units.tr: vayyachanu: they pitched camp; fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc., root חנה [?]

units.la: יְחָנְּךָ gratiam faciat tibi, (absque Dagesh, pro יְחָנֶּךָ, ut) וַיְחָנֶּךָ; Item, יְחָנֶּנּוּ nobis, וַיְחָנֵּנוּ ei, & שְׁיְחָנֵּנוּ nobis, omnia fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. & aff. R. חנן [?]
units.tr: yechennkha: he will show favour to you (without Dagesh, for yechennekha, as) vayechennekha; likewise yechennenu: to us, vayechennenu: to him, and shiyechennenu: to us; all fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., with prefix and affix; root חנן [?]

units.la: יְחָנְּבְנוּ initiabit eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. חנך [?]
units.tr: yechennevenu: he will initiate him; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root חנך [?]

units.la: יְחָנֵּן gratiam faciet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. חנן [?]
units.tr: yechennen: he will show favour; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., root חנן [?]

units.la: וַיְחָנֵּק & strangulavit se
units.tr: vayechenneq: and he strangled himself

units.la: fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. חָנַק
units.tr: fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing., root חָנַק

units.la: יֶחְסוּ sperabunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. חָסָה
units.tr: yechesu: they will hope; fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc., root חָסָה

units.la: יֶחָסֶן recondetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. חָסַן
units.tr: yechassen: it will be laid up; fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing., root חָסַן

units.la: וַיַּחֲף & obtexit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. apoc. pro יַחְפֶּה Rad חָפָה
units.tr: vayyachaf: and he covered; fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., apocopated, for yachfeh; root חָפָה

units.la: וַיַּחְפֵּהוּ & obtexit eam, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. præf. & aff. ut & וַיַּחְפּוּ & occultarunt; 2 Reg. 17.9. 3. pl. m. cum א loco ה R. הָפָה
units.tr: vayyachfehu: and he covered it; fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., with prefix and affix; likewise vayyachfu: and they hid; 2 Kings 17:9, 3rd pl. masc., with aleph in place of he; root הָפָה

units.la: וַיִּבְדֵּל & divisit, וַיַּחְצֵם eos, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. & aff. R. חָצָה
units.tr: vayyivdel: and he divided; vayyachtzem: he divided them; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., apocopated with affix; root חָצָה

units.la: יֵחָצְבוּן excidentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. חָצַב
units.tr: yechatzevun: they will be cut down; fut. Niph. 3rd pl. masc., with paragogic ending; root חָצַב

units.la: יֵחְצוּ dividem, fut. Kal, יֵחָצוּ dividentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. חָצָה
units.tr: yechetzu: they will divide</), fut. Kal; yechatzu: they will be divided, fut. Niph. 3rd pl. masc.; root חָצָה

units.la: וַיֵּחָקוּ & describerentur, Job. 19. 23. (absque Dagesh, pro יוּחָקוּ) fut. Hoph. 3 pl. m, R. חָקַק
units.tr: vayyechaqu: and they were inscribed, Job 19:23 (without Dagesh, for yuchaqu); fut. Hoph. 3rd pl. masc.; root חָקַק

units.la: יֵחְקְרוּ pervestigabantur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. R. חָקַר
units.tr: yechqeru: they were searched out; fut. Niph. 3rd pl.; root חָקַר

units.tr: vayyichar: and anger was kindled, fut. Kal, apocopated; vayyichar: and he kindled, fut. Hiph., apocopated; root הָרָה

units.tr: vayyechar: and he was humbled, and they were stripped; fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing. and pl. masc.; root חָרַר

units.tr: yēḥāram, "he will devote," future Hiphil; yŏḥŏram, "he will be devoted," future Hophal, 3rd person masculine singular, from the root ḥāram.

units.la: יְחָרְפֵנִי probro afficient me, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. חָרַף
units.tr: yecherfeni: they will reproach me; fut. Piel, 3rd pl. masc., with affix; root חָרַף
