units.tr: vayyecherqu: and they gnash; fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc.; root חָרַק

units.la: יֵחָשֵׁב imputabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. חָשַׁב
units.tr: yechashev: it will be imputed; fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing.; root חָשַׁב

units.la: יֶחְשׁוּ tacebunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. חָשָׁה
units.tr: yechshu: they will be silent; fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc.; root חָשָׁה

units.la: יֶחְשַׁךְ tenebrosum erit, יֶחְשְׁכוּ tenebrosa essent, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. יֶחְשַׁךְ obtenebrabitur, fut. Niph. & וַיֶּחְשַׁךְ et obtenebrabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. 3. f. m. R. חָשַׁךְ יֵחַת conteretur, יֵחָתוּ conterentur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. חָתַת יֵחַת descendet, fut. Kal, 3. f. R. נָחַת יִקָּחֶךָּ an accipiet, capiet te, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. praef. aff. R. חָזָה יְחַתֵּנִי [?] exterruit me, & eum Chirek magno, pro Dagesh, יִחְתֵּן terrebit eas, Hab. 2: 17. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. חָתַת וַיִּטַּהֲרוּ et mundarunt se, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. טָהַר וַיְטַהֲרוּ et mundarunt, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. Rad. טָהַר וַיָּטַל et projecit, וַיַּטְלֵהוּ eum projecerunt eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. טוּל יִטֹּל, vel יִטֹּל tollet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָטַל יִטַּל, vel יוּטַּל projicietur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָטַל, טִל, טֹל, vel נָטַל יִטְמָא polluet se, יִטַּמְּאוּ polluent se, pro וַיִּטַּמְּאוּ &c. fut. Hithp. 3. f. & pl. m. R. טָמָא וַיִּטַּעֵהוּ et plantavit, eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָטַע יִטְפּוּ stillabunt, fut. Kal, יַטִּיפוּ stillare facient, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָטַף יִטֹּר [?] servabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m.
units.tr: yechshakh: it will be dark; yechshekhu: they would be dark; fut. Kal, 3rd fem. and pl. masc.; yechshakh: it will be darkened, fut. Niph.; and vayyechshakh: and he will darken, fut. Hiph., 3rd fem. sing.; root חָשַׁךְ; yechat: he will be crushed; yechatu: they will be terrified, fut. Niph. 3rd fem. and pl. masc.; root חָתַת; yechat: he will descend, fut. Kal, 3rd fem.; root נָחַת; yiqqachekha: will he take you, capture you, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. masc., with prefix and affix; root חָזָה; yechattenni: he terrified me, and with a great Chirek instead of Dagesh, yichetten: he will terrify them, Hab. 2:17, fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root חָתַת; vayyitahharu: and they purified themselves, fut. Hithp. 3rd pl. masc.; root טָהַר; vayyetaharu: and they purified, fut. Piel, 3rd pl. masc.; root טָהַר; vayyatal: and he cast; vayyatlehu: they cast him, fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. and pl. masc., with affix; root טוּל; yittol: or yittol: he will take up, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root נָטַל; yittal: or yutal: he will be cast, fut. Hoph. 3rd fem. sing.; root נָטַל, טִל, טֹל; or נָטַל; yitmma: he will defile himself; yittammeu: they will defile themselves, for vayyitammeu, etc., fut. Hithp. 3rd fem. and pl. masc.; root טָמָא; vayyittaeh: and he planted, him, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root נָטַע; yitpu: they will drip, fut. Kal; yatiphu: they will cause to drip, fut. Hiph. 3rd pl. masc.; root נָטַף; yittor: he will keep, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root [?]

units.la: ט וַיֵּט & extendit, (apoc.) יֵט extendet, וַיִּטּוּ & declinarunt, fut. Kal, sed, וַיֵּט & inclinavit, יֵטֶה extendet, וַיַּטֵּהוּ & fecit diverte eum, וַיֵּטוּ & inclinarunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָטָה וַיִּטַב et bene erit, pro וַיִּטַב, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יָטַב
units.tr: t vayyet: and he stretched out, (apocopated) yet: he will stretch out; vayyittu: and they declined, fut. Kal, but vayyet: and he inclined; yeteh: he will stretch out; vayyatteehu: and he made him turn aside; vayyetu: and they inclined, fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. and pl. masc.; root נָטָה; vayyitav: and it will be well, for vayyitav, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root יָטַב

units.la: f m. R. יִשָּׂרֵף[?] יִשָּׂרֵף[?] discerptum fuerit, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. יִשָּׂרֵף[?] שׁ, vel שׁשׁ deseret, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָטַשׁ[?] וַיִּשְׁטְשׁ[?] & deseruerunt eum, fut. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. נָטַשׁ[?] defatigatur, יָגַע[?] defatigentur, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָגַע[?] יָדַע[?] cognoscet penitus. Ps. 138. 6. fut. compos. ex Kal & Pihel. ex Kal est יָדַע[?], ex Pih. alii putant esse f. Hiph. pro יוֹדִיעַ[?], vel יְהוֹדִיעַ[?], 3. f. m. R. יָדַע[?] וַיִּחַל[?] & spe detentus fuit, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. pro יוּחַל[?] Rad. יָחַל[?] יְחַכּוּ[?] exspectabunt, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. יָחַל[?] הֲיִטַב[?] num bonum erit? fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יִטַב[?] יִטַב[?], יִיטַב[?], יֵטַב[?] benefaciet, וַיֵּטֵב[?] & benefecit, omnia fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יֵטַב[?] יִטַב[?] benefaciet, Job. 24. 21. quasi, pro יְהֵטִיב[?], fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יֵטַב[?] יֵטִיבוּ[?] benefacient, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. יֵטַב[?] יֵטִיבְךָ[?] benefaciet tibi, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. יֵטַב[?] יְיֵלֵל[?] ejulabit, יְיֵלְלוּ[?] ejulabunt, est, quasi pro יְהֵילִילוּ[?], & יְהֵילִילוּ[?], fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. יִלֵּל[?] יַיִן[?] vinum tuum, No. Rad. f. m. יַיִן[?] aff. יָנְקוּ[?] fugent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. יָנַק[?] יִסֹּךְ[?] unget, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. סוּךְ[?] יִעְפּוּ[?] defatigabuntur, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. יָעַף[?] יָפֶה[?] & pulchra fuit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יָפָה[?] [illegible, ~3 letters] & pulchrum reddidit ipsum, fut. Piel, 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. יָפָה וַיִּצֶר & formavit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יָצַר וַיִּקַּץ & evigilavit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יִקַּץ יִקַּר pretiosus erit, pro יִקַּר, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. יָקַר יָדָה jaculo conficitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. יָדָה יִרַשׁ possidebit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יָרַשׁ יִרַשׁ possidebit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. יִרַשׁ יִשְׁרוּ rectificent, Prov. 4. 25. fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. יָשַׁר יִשַּׁר rectumavit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. יָשַׁר וַיִּשָּׁם & וַיִּשָּׂם & positum est, utrumque, pro וַיִּשָּׂם, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. Rad. שׂוּם וַיַּךְ & percutiet, וַיָּךְ & percussit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. apoc. pro יַךְ Rad. נָכָה יַכְבֶּנָּה exstinguet eam, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. כָּבָה יְכַבְּדֵנִי honorabit me, Ps. 50. 23. pro יְכַבְּדֵנִי, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. כָּבַד וַיִּכְבּוּ & extinxerunt, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. R. כָּבָה יַכֶּה percutiet, יַכְּךָ te, וַיַּכּוּ, וַיַּכֵּהוּ & percussit eum, יַכֶּם percutiet eas, &c. omnia fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. נָכָה יִכְהֶה caligabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. כָּהָה יְכַהֵן sacerdotem ageт, וַיְכַהֲנוּ et sacerdotio functi sunt, fut. Piel, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. כָּהַן וַיִּכּוּם et percusserunt, יַכּוּם percutient eos, יַכָּהוּ eum, &c. fut. Hiph. 3.
units.tr: f m. root yisseref [?] yisseref [?] will be torn in pieces, fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing.; root yisseref [?] sh, or shsh he will forsake, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root נָטַשׁ [?] vayyishtash [?] and they forsook him, fut. Kal, 3rd pl., with affix; root נָטַשׁ [?] is wearied, yaga [?] they will be wearied, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. and pl. masc.; root יָגַע [?] yada [?] he will know thoroughly. Ps. 138:6. fut. compounded of Kal and Piel. From Kal it is yada [?]; from Piel others think it is fem. Hiph. for yodia [?], or yehodia [?], 3rd fem. sing.; root יָדַע [?] vayyechal [?] and he was held by hope, fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing., for yuchal [?]; root יָחַל [?] yechakku [?] they will wait, fut. Piel, 3rd pl. masc., with paragogic ending; root יָחַל [?] hiyitav [?] will it be well? fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root yitav [?] yitav [?], yiyitav [?], yeitav [?] he will do good, and vayyeitev [?] and he did good, all fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing.; root yeitav [?] yitav [?] he will do good, Job 24:21, as if for yehetiv [?], fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing.; root yeitav [?] yeitivu [?] they will do good, fut. Hiph. 3rd pl. masc.; root yeitav [?] yeitivkha [?] he will do good to you, fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root yeitav [?] yeyelel [?] he will wail, yeyelelu [?] they will wail, is, as if for yehe'ililu [?], and yehe'ililu [?], fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing. and pl. masc.; root yillel [?] yayin [?] your wine, noun, masc. sing., root yayin [?] with affix; yanqu [?] they will put to flight, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc.; root yanaq [?] yissokh [?] he will anoint, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root sukh [?] yi'pu [?] they will be weary, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc.; root ya'af [?] yafeh [?] and it was beautiful, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root yafah [?] [illegible, about 3 letters] and he made it beautiful, fut. Piel, 3rd sing. masc., with affix; root yafah; vayyitzer and he formed, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root yatzar; vayyiqqatz and he awoke, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root yiqqatz; yiqqar will be precious, for yiqqar, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root yaqar; yadah is struck with a dart, fut. Niph. 3rd fem. sing.; root yadah; yirash will possess, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root yarash; yirash will possess, fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing.; root yirash; yishru they will make straight, Prov. 4:25, fut. Hiph. 3rd pl. masc.; root yashar; yishshar he made straight, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root yashar; vayyiasham and vayyissam and it was placed, both, for vayyissam, fut. Hoph. 3rd fem. sing.; root sum; vayyakh and he will strike, vayyakh and he struck, fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., apocopated, for yakh; root nakah; yakhbenna he will extinguish it, fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root kabah; yekhabbedeni he will honour me, Ps. 50:23, for yekhabbedeni, fut. Piel, 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root kabad; vayyikbu and they extinguished, fut. Piel, 3rd pl. masc.; root kabah; yakkeh he will strike, yakkekha he will strike you, vayyakku and vayyakkehu and he struck him, yakkem he will strike them, etc., all fut. Hiph. 3rd fem. sing., with affix; root nakah; yikhheh he will grow dim, fut. Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root kahah; yekhahen he will act as priest, vayekhahanu and they performed the priestly office, fut. Piel, 3rd fem. and pl. masc.; root kahan; vayyikkum and they struck, yakkum they will strike them, yakkahu he will strike him, etc., fut. Hiph. 3rd

units.la: יָכְלוּ potuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. יִכְלוּ absoluti sunt, fut. Pual, 3. pl m R. כָּלָה יִכְלִין deficient, Jef. 31. 3. fut. Kal, 3. pl. m R. כָּלָה יִכְלְכְּךָ sustinebunt te, &c. fut. Piel, gem. 3. pl. m aff. Rad. כּוּל. יְכַלְּמוּ ignominia afficientur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. כָּלַם. יְכֹלֶת posse, potentia, Infin. Kal; vel No. f. fæm. ab Infin. Rad. יָכַל. יָכְלָתִי patuisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. יָכַל. וַיָּכֶן et paravit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. כּוּן. וַיִּכְנֻנוּ vel וַיְכוֹנְנוּ & præparavit nos, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. כּוּן. וַיִּכְנַע & humiliavit, יִכְנִיעַם humiliabit eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. כָּנַע. וַיִּכָּנְשׁוּ & humiliati fuerunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. מ. R. בָּנַע. וַיִּכְםְ & operuit, fut. Piel, 3. sing. m. apoc. Rad. כָּסָה. יִכָּסֶה abtegetur, וַיִּכָּסוּ & operti sunt, fut Pual, 3.f. & pl.m. Rad. כָּסָה. יְכַסּוּ operient, יְכַסְּכוּ operient eos, Exod. 15. 5. fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. כַּסָּה. יְכַסֶּךָ operiet te, fut. Piel, 3 sing. masc. aff. Rad. כַּסָּה. וַיִּכַּר & agnovit, וַיְּכְרֵהוּ eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָכַר. יִכָּרֶה fodietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. כָּרָה. יִכְרוּ fodient, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. כָּרָה. יְכַרְסְּכַנָּה suffodiat eam, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. à Rad. in Piel quadrata, כַּרְסָם. יִכָּרֵת exscindetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. כָּרַת. יִכָּשֵׁל corruet, fut. Niph. 3. f. 3. f. m. R. כָּשֵׁל[?] יֵאָתֵרוּ[?] atteretur, יִכָּתְנוּ[?] contendentur, pro יוּכַּח[?], יוּכָתוּ[?], fut. Hoph. 3. sing. & pl. mafc. Rad. פָּתַח[?] יִכָּתֵבֶן[?] scribentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad כָּתַב[?] וַיִּכָּתוּם[?] & contriverunt eos, Num. 14. 45. pro וַיִּכְיָתוּם[?], fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. פָּתַת[?]
units.tr: they were able, perf. Kal, 3rd pl. masc. Root yakhlu; yikhlu they were finished, imperf. Pual, 3rd pl. masc. Root; yikhlin they fail, Jer. 31. 3, imperf. Kal, 3rd pl. masc. Root; yekhalkelkha they will sustain you, etc., imperf. Piel, doubled, 3rd pl. masc. aff. Root kul; yekhalmu they will be put to shame, imperf. Niph., 3rd pl. masc. Root kalam; yekholet ability, power, infin. Kal; or a feminine noun from the infinitive, Root yakhal; yakhlta you were able, perf. Kal, 2nd fem. sing. masc. Root yakhal; vaykhen and he prepared, imperf. Hiph., 3rd fem. sing. masc. Root kun; vaykhunenu or vaykhonenu he prepared us, imperf. Kal, 3rd fem. sing. masc. aff. Root kun; vaykhni' he humbled, yakhni'em he will humble them, imperf. Hiph., 3rd fem. sing. masc. aff. Root kana'; vayikkanesu they were humbled, imperf. Niph., 3rd pl. masc. Root kana'; vayikhsa he covered, imperf. Piel, 3rd sing. masc. apocopated, Root kasah; yikkaseh it will be covered, vaykkasu they were covered, imperf. Pual, 3rd fem. and pl. masc. Root kasah; yekhasu they will cover, yekhassekhu they will cover them, Exod. 15. 5, imperf. Piel, 3rd pl. masc. aff. Root kassah; yekhassekha he will cover you, imperf. Piel, 3rd sing. masc. aff. Root kassah; vaykkar he recognised, vaykrehu him, imperf. Hiph., 3rd fem. sing. masc. aff. Root nakar; yikkareh it will be dug, imperf. Niph., 3rd fem. sing. masc. Root karah; yikru they will dig, imperf. Kal, 3rd pl. masc. Root karah; yekharsekhenna he will dig it up, imperf. Piel, 3rd fem. sing. masc. aff. from the root in quadriliteral Piel, karsam; yikkaret it will be cut off, imperf. Niph., 3rd fem. sing. masc. Root karat; yikkashel it will fall, imperf. Niph., 3rd fem. and masc. Root kashal[?]; ye'ateru[?] it will be crushed, yikkatenu[?] they will be contended, for yukkakh[?], yukkatu[?], imperf. Hoph., 3rd sing. and pl. masc. Root patah[?]; yikkateven[?] they will be written, imperf. Niph., 3rd pl. masc. paragogic, Root katav[?]; vaykkatum[?] and they crushed them, Num. 14. 45, for vaykyatum[?], imperf. Hiph., 3rd pl. masc. aff. Root patat[?].

units.la: ל וַיִּלְאוּ[?] et defessi sunt, fut. Kal, וַיִּלְאוּךָ[?] & defatigarunt te, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. לָאָה[?] יִלָּבֵב[?] cordatus fiet, & יִלָּבֵט[?] conturbatus fiet, fut Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. לָבַב[?], & לָבַט[?] יָלַד generabit, יָלְדוּ generarunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. parag. Rad. יָלַד יָלֵד gignens, יֹלֶדֶת pariens, Ben. Kal, f. m. & fæm. Rad. יָלַד וַיֶּלֶד & genuit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יָלַד[?] וַיּוֹלְדָה[?] & paries, præt. Kal, comp. cum Ben. Kal, sing. fæm. vel, est præt. Poel, 2. f. fæm. R. יָלַד יָלַדְתָּנִי[?] peperisti, (pro יָלַדְתָּ[?]) me, יָלַדְתָּנוּ[?] nos, præt. Kal, 2. f. fæm. aff. Rad. יָלַד יָלַדְתִּיךְ[?] genui, peperi te, יָלַדְתִּיהוּ[?] illum, præt. Kal, 1. f. aff. Rad. יָלַד יָלְדַתְנִי[?] peperit me, יָלַדְתֶּךָ[?] te, יָלַדְתָּהוּ[?] eum, (pro יָלַדְתָּהוּ[?],) præt. Kal, 3. f. fæm. aff. Rad. יָלַד יִלְוֶה[?] adjunget se, וַיִּלְוּ[?] & adjungent se, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. לָוָה יִלְוֶךָּ[?] mutuabit tibi, יִלְוֻנּוּ[?] ei, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. לָוָה וַיִּלּוּנוּ[?] & murmurarunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m.
units.tr: vayle'u[?] and they were weary, imperf. Kal; vayle'ukha[?] and they wearied you, imperf. Hiph., 3rd pl. masc. aff. Root la'ah[?]; yillavev[?] he will become wise of heart, and yillavet[?] he will be troubled, imperf. Niph., 3rd fem. sing. masc. Root lavav[?] and lavat[?]; yalad he will beget, yaldu they begot, imperf. Kal, 3rd fem. sing. and pl. masc. paragogic, Root yalad; yaled begetting, yoledet bearing, Ben. Kal, masc. and fem., Root yalad; vayyeled and he begot, imperf. Hiph., 3rd fem. sing. masc., Root yalad; vayyoldah[?] and she bore, perf. Kal, with Ben. Kal, sing. fem., or it is perf. Pol'el, 2nd fem. sing., Root yalad; yaladtani[?] you bore me (for yaladta), yaladtanu[?] you bore us, perf. Kal, 2nd fem. sing. aff. Root yalad; yaladtikha[?] I begot you, I bore you, yaladtihu[?] I begot him, perf. Kal, 1st fem. sing. aff. Root yalad; yaldatni[?] she bore me, yaladteka[?] she bore you, yaladtahu[?] she bore him (for yaladtahu), perf. Kal, 3rd fem. sing. fem. aff. Root yalad; yilveh[?] he will attach himself, vayyilu[?] and they will attach themselves, imperf. Niph., 3rd fem. sing. and pl. masc. Root lavah; yilvekha[?] he will lend to you, yilvennu[?] to him, imperf. Hiph., 3rd fem. sing. masc. aff. Root lavah; vayyillunu[?] and they murmured, imperf. Niph., 3rd pl. masc. Root lun.

units.tr: Root LWN.

units.tr: they will cause to recede (Prov. 4.21, for ...); future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine. Root LWH.

units.la: וַיָּלִינוּ[?] & murmurare fecerunt, Num. 14. 36. fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. (pro יָלִינוּ[?]) Rad. לוּן.
units.tr: and they caused to murmur (Num. 14.36, for ...); future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine. Root LWN.

units.la: יַלִּין[?] deridebit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. לוּן.
units.tr: he will mock; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root LWN.

units.la: יַלְכוּ[?] quod deferat, וַיּוֹלִיכוּ[?] & deduxerunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. לוּךְ[?].
units.tr: that he may carry, and they led away; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root LWK.

units.la: יָלַךְ[?] ibit, יֵלְכוּ[?] ibunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. הָלַךְ[?].
units.tr: he will go, they will go; future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root HLK.

units.la: יִלָּכֵד[?] capietur, יִלָּכְדוּ[?] capientur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. לָכַד.
units.tr: he will be taken, they will be taken; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root LKD.

units.la: יִלְכְּדֻנוּ[?] capient eum, Prov. 5. 22. pro יִלְכְּדוּהוּ[?], fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. R. לָכַד.
units.tr: they will take him (Prov. 5.22, for ...); future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine, with suffix. Root LKD.

units.la: וַיִּלַּל[?] & ejulavit, Jer. 25. 36. pro וַיִּלְלֵת[?], constr. f. fæm. No. יִלְלָה[?], Rad. יָלַל[?] ejulavit.
units.tr: and he wailed (Jer. 25.36, for ...); construct feminine noun, from the root YLL, "he wailed."

units.la: וַיָּלֶן[?] & pernoctavit, וַיָּלִינוּ[?] & pernoctarunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. לוּן.
units.tr: and he spent the night, and they spent the night; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root LWN.

units.la: יָלַע[?] absorbebit, Prov. 20. 25. fut. Hiph. (pro יְלַעַ[?]) 3. f. m. Rad. לוּעַ.
units.tr: he will swallow up (Prov. 20.25, for ...); future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root LW'.

units.la: יִלְפְּתוּ[?] inclinabit se, יִלְפְּתוּ[?] inclinabunt se, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. לָפַת.
units.tr: he will bow himself, they will bow themselves; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root LPT.

units.la: יִלֹּק[?] lambet, יִלְקוּ[?] lingent, fut Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. לָקַק.
units.tr: he will lick, they will lick; future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root LQQ.

units.la: מ
units.tr: M.

units.la: refuset[?], יִמְאֲנוּ[?] renuent, fut. Piel, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָאַן.
units.tr: he will refuse, they will refuse; future Piel, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root M'N.

units.la: וַיָּמָאֵן[?] & disfavit se, fut.
units.tr: and he refused; future.

units.la: Niph. 3. f. m. R. [?] dissolvent se, fut. Niph. 3. pl. R. [?]; vel, ut quidam volunt, Pf. 58. 5. fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. (cum א, pro ם,) à Rad. [?] liquescere.

units.la: [?] & mensus est, [?] & mensi sunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. [?] mensurabitur, [?] mensurabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. [?]
units.tr: and he measured, and they measured; future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root [?]. He will be measured, they will be measured; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root [?].

units.la: [?] & [?] & mensus est, fut. Piel, & Poel, 3. f. m. R. [?]
units.tr: and he measured; future Piel and Poel, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root [?].

units.tr: he will appoint a time for him; future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine, with suffix. Root [?].

units.la: [?] dimovebitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. [?].
units.tr: he will be moved; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root [?].

units.la: [?] depauperatas fueris, fut. Kal 3. f. m. R. [?].
units.tr: you will be made poor; future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root [?].

units.la: [?] circumcidetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. [?].
units.tr: he will be circumcised; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root [?].

units.la: [?] recedet, [?] recedent, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. [?].
units.tr: he will depart, they will depart; future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root [?].

units.tr: he will die (for ...); future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root [?].

units.la: [?] dies, [?] secundum dies, pl. fem. praef. à sing. No. Rad. [?].
units.tr: days; according to days; plural feminine, with prefix, from a singular noun. Root [?].

units.tr: he will be blotted out (apocopated, for ...); future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root [?].

units.la: [?] complodent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. [?].
units.tr: they will clap their hands; future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine. Root [?].

units.la: [?] dies, [?] & dies, [?] juxta dies, [?] ad dies, [?] à diebus [?] dies tui, [?] vestri, &c. omnia pl. m. constr. praef. aff. à sing. No. Rad. [?], in pl. m. [?]
units.tr: days; and days; according to days; to days; from days; your days, your (plural) days, etc.: all plural masculine, construct, with prefixes and suffixes, from a singular noun. Root [?], in the masculine plural.

units.tr: from year to year.

units.tr: years; plural masculine, from the singular masculine noun. Root YWM.

units.tr: of the sea; noun, plural masculine, from the singular YAM ("sea"). Root YMM, unused.

units.la: מִימִין à dextra, בִּימִינוֹ ad dextram ejus, &c. No. Rad. f. m. יָמִין, const. præf. aff.
units.tr: from the right; at his right hand, etc.; noun, masculine, construct, with prefix and suffix. Root YMN.

units.la: יְמִינוֹ commutabit illud, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. מוֹר .
units.tr: he will exchange it; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine, with suffix. Root MWR.

units.la: יִמְשְׁשׁוּ palpabunt, Exod. 10. 21. pro יְמַשְׁשׁ, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. מָשַׁשׁ
units.tr: they will grope (Exod. 10.21, for ...); future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine. Root MShSh.

units.la: יְמִיתֶנּוּ interficiet eum, יְמִיתֻהוּ interficient eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. מוּת
units.tr: he will kill him, they will kill him; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, with suffix. Root MWT.

units.la: יִמְּעַט attenuabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. מָכַךְ
units.tr: he will be diminished; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root MKK.

units.la: וַיִּמָּכּוּ & attenuati fuerunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. מָכַּךְ
units.tr: and they were diminished; future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine. Root MKK.

units.la: יִסָּפֵּחַ succidetur, יִמָּלּ & succiditur, יִמָּלוּ succidentur, fut. Kal 3. f. & pl.
units.tr: he will be cut off, and it is cut off, they will be cut off; future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root NML.

units.la: m. R. נָמַל
units.tr: masculine. Root NML.

units.la: יִמָּכֵר vendetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. מָכַר
units.tr: he will be sold; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root MKR.

units.la: יִמָּלְאוּן implebuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. מָלָא
units.tr: they will be filled; future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine. Root MLA.

units.la: יְמַלֵּא implebit, Job 8.21, pro יִמְלָא, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. Rad. מָלָא
units.tr: he will fill (Job 8.21, for ...); future Piel, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root MLA.

units.la: יִמָּלְטוּ eripientur, 3 pl. m. fut. Niph. Rad. מָלַט
units.tr: they will be delivered; future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine. Root MLT.

units.la: וַיִּמְלֹךְ & consilium iniit, fut. Niph. 3 f. m. R. מֶלֶךְ
units.tr: and he took counsel; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root MLK.

units.la: יָמִים dies, pl. m. def. à f. m. יוֹם.
units.tr: days; plural masculine, definite, from the noun YWM ("day").

units.la: יָמִים, vel יָמִים muli, No. pl. m. absque sing. à Rad. inusit. יָמַם
units.tr: days, or, as a variant, mules; plural masculine, without a singular, from the unused root YMM.

units.la: וַיָּמֶן & constitait, (pro יִמְּנֶה) fut. Piel, 3. f. m. apoc. Rad. מָנָה
units.tr: and he appointed (for ...); future Piel, 3rd person feminine masculine, apocopated. Root MNH.

units.la: יִמְנֶה numerabitur, יִמְּנוּ supputabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָנָה
units.tr: he will be numbered; they will be reckoned; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root MNH.

units.la: יָמִין dexter, No. f. m. & יְמִינִית
units.tr: right; noun, masculine and feminine, and ...

units.la: יִמִּינַת [?] dextera, fæm. ג
units.tr: right hand; feminine.

units.la: No. Rad. יָמִין.
units.tr: noun. Root YMN.

units.la: יִמָּנַע cohibebitur, וַיִּמָּנְעוּ & cohibiti sunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָנַע
units.tr: he will be restrained; they were restrained; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root MN'.

units.la: יִמַּס liquescet, וַיִּמַּסוּ & dissoluta sunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָסַס
units.tr: it will melt; and they were dissolved; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root MSS.

units.la: וַיִּמְסֵם & liquefecit ea, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. מָסָה.
units.tr: and he melted them; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine, with suffix. Root MSH.

units.la: יִמָּסְרוּ & traditi sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. מָסַר
units.tr: they were delivered; future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine. Root MSR.

units.la: וַיִּמֵּן & expressit, (pro יִמְצָה,) fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. Rad. מָצָה
units.tr: and he squeezed out (for ...); future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine, apocopated. Root MTZH.

units.la: יִמָּצֵא invenietur, יִמָּצְאוּ invenientur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָצָא
units.tr: it will be found; they will be found; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine. Root MTS'.

units.la: יִמְצָאֶנָּה invenient eam, Jer.2.24. & יִמְצָאֻנִי me, pro יִמְצָאוּהָ, & יִמְצָאֻנִי, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. מָצָא
units.tr: they will find her (Jer. 2.24) and they will find me, for they found her and they found me; future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine, with suffix. Root MTS'.

units.la: יִמָּצֶה exprimetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. & יִמָּצוּ exprimentur, 3. pl. m.
units.tr: it will be squeezed out; they will be squeezed out; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine, and 3rd person plural masculine.

units.la: Rad. מָצָה.
units.tr: Root MTZH.

units.la: יִמַּקּוּ tabescient, vel (pro eo) יִמַּק, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. מָקַק.
units.tr: they will waste away, or (for it) he will waste away; future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine. Root MQQ.

units.la: יָמַר amarum erit, Jef.24. 9. (pro יִמַּר,) fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. מָרַר.
units.tr: it will be bitter (Isa. 24.9, for ...); future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root MRR.

units.la: יִמְרוּךָ dicent tibi, Pf.139. 20. pro יֹאמְרוּךָ, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. אָמַר.
units.tr: they will say to you (Ps. 139.20, for ...); future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine, with suffix. Root 'MR.

units.la: יִמָּרֵט glabrum fiet, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. מָרַט.
units.tr: it will be made smooth; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root MRT.

units.la: וַיְמָרְרֵהוּ et amaritudine affecerunt eum, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. מָרַר.
units.tr: and they treated him bitterly; future Piel, 3rd person plural masculine, with suffix. Root MRR.

units.la: וַיָּמָשׁ & amovebit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. מוּשׁ.
units.tr: and he will remove; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root MWSh.

units.la: יִמָּשְׁכוּ protrahentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. מָשַׁךְ.
units.tr: they will be drawn out; future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine. Root MShK.

units.la: יִמְשֵׁנִי amovebit me, הוּ eum, יִמְשׁוּ amovebunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. Rad. מוּשׁ.
units.tr: he will remove me, him; they will remove; future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine with suffix, and 3rd person plural masculine. Root MWSh.

units.la: יִמְשָׁנִי extrahet me, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. מָשָׁה.
units.tr: he will draw me out; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine, with suffix. Root MShH.

units.la: וַיָּמָת & mortuus est, שָׁמְתוּ quod morientur, יָמֻתוּן morientur, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. præf. R. מות.
units.tr: and he died; that they will die; they will die; future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, with prefix. Root MWT.

units.la: וַיָּמֵת & occidit, וַיְמִיתֵם eos, וַיְמִיתֵהוּ eum, וַיָּמִיתוּ & occiderunt eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. מות.
units.tr: and he killed; them; him; and they killed him; future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, with suffix. Root MWT.

units.la: וַיְמִתְּהוּ et interfecit eum, fut. Piel, vel Poel, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. מות.
units.tr: and he killed him; future Piel or Poel, 3rd person feminine masculine, with suffix. Root MWT.

units.la: נ
units.tr: N.

units.la: יִנָּאֵן efflorescet, Eccl. 12. 5. pro יִנִּין, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נין.
units.tr: it will flourish (Eccl. 12.5, for ...); future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root NYN.

units.la: יִנָּאֲצוּ contemnent, fut. Kal, יִנְאֲצֵנִי me, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. R. נאץ.
units.tr: they will despise; future Kal; they will despise me; future Piel, 3rd person plural masculine, with suffix. Root N'TS.

units.la: יִנָּבֵא prophetabit, וַיִּנָּבְאוּ & prophetârunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. & pl. Rad. נבא.
units.tr: he will prophesy; and they prophesied, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular and plural masculine, root נבא.

units.la: וַיִּנָּגְשׁוּ & tacti sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. נגע.
units.tr: and they were touched, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, root נגע.

units.la: יִנָּגַּף percutietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נגף.
units.tr: he will be struck, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular masculine, root נגף.

units.la: יְנַהֲדוּ expellent eum, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. aff. Rad. נדד.
units.tr: they will drive him out, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine with suffix, root נדד.

units.la: וַיָּנֻדוּ & vagati sunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. נוד.
units.tr: and they wandered, future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine, root נוד.

units.la: וַיִּנָּהוּ & lamentati sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. נהה.
units.tr: and they lamented, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, root נהה.

units.la: יִנּוֹבַב progerminabit, fut. Piel, seu Poel, R. נוב.
units.tr: he will sprout, future Piel or Pol'el, root נוב.

units.la: יִנּוֹן propagabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m, à Rad. No. נין filius.
units.tr: he will be propagated, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular masculine, from the root נו, or נין, son.

units.la: יִנּוֹעַ movebitur, יִנּוֹעוּ movebuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. נוע.
units.tr: he will be moved, they will be moved, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular and plural masculine, root נוע.

units.la: יִנָּזֵר abstrahetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נזר.
units.tr: he will be separated, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular masculine, root נזר.

units.la: וַיָּנַח & quievit, (pro יָנוּחַ,) fut. Kal, 3. f. s. m. R. נוח.
units.tr: and he rested, (for יָנוּחַ,) future Kal, 3rd person feminine singular masculine, root נוח.

units.la: וַיַּנַּח & collocavit, fut. Hiph. (יַנִּיחַ,) 3. f. s. m. Rad. נוח.
units.tr: and he placed, future Hiphil (יַנִּיחַ), 3rd person feminine singular masculine, root נוח.

units.la: וַיַּנִּיחוּ & collocaverunt eos, וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ eum, fut. Hiph. (pro יַנְחוּ[?]) 3. pl. m. aff. R. נָחַ[?]
units.tr: and they placed them, and they placed him, future Hiphil (for יַנְחוּ[?]), 3rd person plural masculine with suffix, root נָחַ[?].

units.la: יְנַחֵם consolationem accipiet, וַיִּנָּחֲמוּ et consolationem acceperunt, fut. Niph. 3. s. & pl. m. Rad. נחם[?]
units.tr: he will receive consolation, and they received consolation, future Niphal, 3rd person singular and plural masculine, root נחם[?].

units.la: יְנַחֵם consolabitur, יְנַחֲמוּ consolabuntur, fut. Piel, 3. s. & pl. m. Rad. נחם[?]
units.tr: he will comfort, they will comfort, future Piel, 3rd person singular and plural masculine, root נחם[?].

units.la: יַנְחֶנּוּ[?] ducet eum, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. נָחָה[?]
units.tr: he will lead him, future Hiphil, 3rd person singular masculine with suffix, root נָחָה[?].

units.la: יִנָּחֵשׁ experietur, יִנָּחֲשׁוּ experientur, fut. Piel, 3. s. & pl. m. R. נָחַשׁ[?]
units.tr: he will try, they will try, future Piel, 3rd person singular and plural masculine, root נָחַשׁ[?].

units.la: יִנְטוּ inclinabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. נָטָה[?]
units.tr: they will be bent, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, root נָטָה[?].

units.la: יִנְיא[?] rumpet, וַיִּנִּיאוּ & ruperunt, fut. Hiph. 3. s. & pl. m. Rad. נִיא[?]
units.tr: he will break, and they broke, future Hiphil, 3rd person singular and plural masculine, root נִיא[?].

units.la: וַיָּנֵד et errare fecit, fut. Hiph. 3. s. f. m. R. נוּד[?]
units.tr: and he caused to err, future Hiphil, 3rd person singular feminine masculine, root נוּד[?].

units.la: יַנִּיחֵנִי quiescere faciet, וַיְנִיחֵנִי et fecit me quiescere, וַיְנִיחֵךְ et quietem afferet tibi, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. aff. R. נָחַ[?]
units.tr: he will cause me to rest, and he caused me to rest, and he will bring you rest, future Hiphil, 3rd person singular masculine with suffix, root נָחַ[?].

units.la: s. m. aff R. נָחַ[?] collocabit, יַנִּיחַ[?] et collocavit eas, וַיַּנִּיחוּ[?] et collocabunt, וַיַּנִּיחֻהוּ[?] et collocabunt eum, Hiph. 3. s. & pl. m. aff. R. נָחַ[?]
units.tr: (3rd person singular masculine with suffix, root נָחַ[?]) he will place, and he placed them, and they will place, and they will place him, Hiphil, 3rd person singular and plural masculine with suffix, root נָחַ[?].

units.la: יְנִיסוּ fugabunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נוּס[?]
units.tr: they will flee, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine, root נוּס[?].

units.la: יְנִיעוּ agitabunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. נוּעַ[?]
units.tr: they will shake, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine, root נוּעַ[?].

units.la: יְנִיפְנוּ stillabit eum, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. Rad. נוּף[?]
units.tr: he will drip on him, future Hiphil, 3rd person singular masculine, root נוּף[?].

units.la: יִנְכַּר erit agnitus, fut. Niph. 3. s. m. R. נָכַר[?] in præt. Niph. נָכַר[?] agnitus fuit.
units.tr: he will be known, future Niphal, 3rd person singular masculine, root נָכַר[?]; in the past tense Niphal, נָכַר[?] he was known.

units.la: וַיָּנָס & fugit, יָנוּסוּ fugient, pro יָנוּסוּ, fut. Kal, 3. s. & pl. m. R. נוּס[?]
units.tr: and he fled, they will flee, for יָנוּסוּ, future Kal, 3rd person singular and plural masculine, root נוּס[?].

units.la: וַיְנַסֵּם & tentavit eos, fut. Piel, 3. sing. m. aff. וַיְנַסּוּ & tentaverunt, 3. pl. m. Rad. נָסָה[?]
units.tr: and he tested them, future Piel, 3rd person singular masculine with suffix; and they tested, 3rd person plural masculine, root נָסָה[?].

units.la: וַיָּנַע et movit se, וַיָּנֻעוּ et commoti sunt, fut. Kal, 3. s. & pl. m. R. נוּעַ[?] וַיָּנֻעוּ et moverunt; fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נוּעַ יְנַעֵר excutiet, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. נָעַר. יְנֻעֲרוּ excutientur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. [?]נָעַר יִנְפַּךְ agitabit, fut. Poel, 3. f. m. R. נוּף. יִנָּפֵשׁ respirabit, pro יִנָּפֵשׁ fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נָפַשׁ. יִנָּצוּ rixabuntur, 3. pl. m. fut. Niph. R. נָצָה. יִנָּצְלוּ eripient, fut. Piel, יִנָּצְּלוּ eripientur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. נָצַל. יִנָּקָה innocens declarabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נָקָה. וַיְנַקְּהוּ et lactavit eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. יָנַק. יִנָּקְמוּ vindicabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. נָקַם. יִנָּשְׂאוּ portabitur, יִנָּשְׂאוּ, & יִנָּשְׂאוּ portabuntur, Jer. 10. 5. fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. נָשָׂא. יִנָּשֵׂא extollet se, & יִנָּשְׂאוּ extollent se, pro יִתְנַשְּׂאוּ & יִתְנַשְּׂאוּ, fut. Hithp. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָשָׂא. וַיִּנְשָׂאֵהוּ et extulit eum, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָשָׂא. יִנְשׁוּף noctua, No. f. m. Rad. נָשַׁף flavit. יִנָּתֵן dabitur, וַיִּנָּתֲנוּ et dati sunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָתַן. יִנָּחֵשׁ avelletur, יִנְחַשׁ exstirpabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָתַק, & נָתַשׁ.
units.tr: and he moved himself, and they were moved, future Kal, 3rd person singular and plural masculine, root נוּעַ[?]; and they moved, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine, root נוּעַ. He will shake out, future Piel, 3rd person feminine masculine, root נָעַר. They will be shaken out, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, root [?]נָעַר. He will pour out, future Poel, 3rd person feminine masculine, root נוּף. He will breathe, for יִנָּפֵשׁ, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine, root נָפַשׁ. They will strive, 3rd person plural masculine, future Niphal, root נָצָה. They will deliver, future Piel; they will be delivered, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, root נָצַל. He will be declared innocent, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine, root נָקָה. And he nursed him, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine with suffix, root יָנַק. They will be avenged, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, root נָקַם. He will be carried, they will be carried, Jer. 10.5, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, root נָשָׂא. He will lift himself up, and they will lift themselves up, for יִתְנַשְּׂאוּ, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, root נָשָׂא. And he lifted him up, future Piel, 3rd person feminine masculine with suffix, root נָשָׂא. An owl, noun feminine masculine, root נָשַׁף, he blew. units.la: הַיַּעֲנָה, vel יַעֲנָה ulula, No. sing. fæm. Rad. עָנָה respondit.
units.tr: the owl (or the ostrich), singular feminine; from the root עָנָה, he answered.

units.la: כְּיַעֲנִים sicut ululæ, No. pl. m. præf. qu. à sing. יַעֲנָה, Rad. עָנָה. יַעֲנֵנִי affliget me, יַעֲנֶהָ eam, יַעֲנֶךָ te, יַעֲנֵם eos, יַעֲנוּ affligent me, &c. omnia fut. Piel, 3. sing. masc. aff. & 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. עָנָה. יַעַנֶּשׁ mulctabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָנַשׁ. יְעָרוּ excitabunt, fut. Piel, gem. 1. Rad. 3. pl. m. pro יְעָרֻּוּ; Rad. עוּר, vel pro יְרֽעֲעוּ confringent, fut. Piel, gem. 3. vel 2. Rad. 3. pl. m. R. רוּעַ, vel רַעַע. וַיַּעַף & volabit, וַיַּעַף & volavit, יַעֲפוּ volabunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. praef. & 3. pl. m. R. עוּף. וַיַּעַף & fuit fessus, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. praef. Rad. עָף, vel עוּף. וַיַּעַף et lassus fuit, וַיֵּעֲפוּ et lassi sint, pro יָעַף, יֵעָפוּ, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. praef. Rad. יָעַף. לַיָּעֵף lasso, No. f. m. praef. R. יָעַף. בְּיָעֵף in lassitudine, No. f. m. יָעֵף, praef. Rad. יָעַף lassus fuit. וַיֵּעָפוּ et lassi erunt, praet. Kal, 3. pl. R. יָעַף. וַיְיַעְפְּלוּ et impetuose contenderunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. עָפַל. יַעֲצֵב dolore afficietur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָצַב. הַיִּיעָצָה, vel הַיִּיעָצָה consulta, Paul Kal, f. faem. praef. Rad. יָעַץ. יָעֲצָה consuluit ei (faeminae) יָעֲצוּ consuluerunt, יְעָצֵהוּ ei, praet. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. יָעַץ. יָעֲצֵי consulentes illi, יְעָצֶךָ tibi, Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. à sing. יָעֵץ consulens, Rad. יָעַץ. יַעְצוֹר imperabit, וַיַּעַצְרֵהוּ et imperavit illi, יַעֲצָרְכָּה imperabit tibi, fut. Kal. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. עָצַר. יַעְקֹב supplantabit, וַיַּעְקְבֵנִי & supplantavit me, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. עָקַב. וַיַּעְקֵר & enervavit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. עָקַר. וַיַּעְקְשֵׁנִי & pervertit me, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. aff. R. עָקַשׁ. וַיַּעַר et excitabit, וַיַּעַר et excitavit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. præf. Rad. עוּר. יַעַרְבוּ vel יַעַרְכוּ miscebunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. à 3. f. m. יַעַרֵב, vel יַעַרֵב miscebit, Rad. עָרַב. יַעֲרָה effundetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָרָה. יַעְרִי silva ejus (viri) יַעְרָה silva ejus (fœminæ) יַעְרַי mea, יַעֲרִים silvæ, f. m. aff. & pl. m. à f. m. No. R. יַעַר silva. יַעוּרוּ excitabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. עוּר. וַיַּעֲרוּ et effundent, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. præf. à 3. f. m. יַעֲרָה effundet, Rad. עָרָה. יַעֲרִיכֶנּוּ æstimabit eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. עָרַךְ. יַעֲרִיצוּ formidabunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. עָרַץ. יַעַרְכֶנּוּ disponet eum, יַעַרְכוּנִי disponent contra me, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. aff. à 3. f. m. יַעַרְךָ; Rad. עָרַךְ. יַעֲרֹךְ decollabit, יַעַרְכוּ decollabunt, fut. Kal. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. עָרַךְ. יַעֲרַת favus, sing. fœm. constr. No. יַעֲרַת à No. Rad. יַעַר. יַעֲשֶׂה faciet, וַיַּעַשׂ et fecit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. pro יַעֲשֶׂה, Rad. עָשָׂה. וַיַּעַשׁ et involavit, et amicivit se, pro וַיַּעֲטֹ fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. pro וַיַּעֲטֶה à Rad. עָטָה: vel fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. עָט involare. שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה quod fiet, יַעֲשׂוּ fient, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. עָשָׂה. יַעֲשֶׂהוּ faciet eum, יַעֲשֶׂנָּה eam, יַעֲשׂוּן facient me, יַעֲשׂוּנִי me, יַעֲשׂוּהָ eam, &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. parag. & aff. Rad. עָשָׂה. יִעְשָׁן fumabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. עָשַׁן. יַעְשֵׁד, vel יַעְשַׁר ditefcet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. עָשַׁר[?]. יַעְשַׁר decimabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. עָשַׂר. יַעְשִׁיר ditabit, יַעְשִׁירֶנּוּ eum, (pro יַעְשִׁיר, & יַעְשִׁירֻנוּ,) וַיַּעְשִׁירוּ & ditarunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. R. עָשַׁר. יִתַּק transferetur, fut. Kal, יַעְתִּיק transferet, (pro יַעְתִּיק,) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. עָתַק. יַעְתֵּר exorabit, fut. Kal, exorabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָתַר.
units.tr: like owls, noun masculine plural with prefix, formed from the singular יַעֲנָה, from the root עָנָה. He will afflict me; he will afflict her; he will afflict you; he will afflict them; they will afflict me, etc.: all are imperfect Piel, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix and 3rd person masculine plural with suffix; from the root עָנָה. He will be fined (imperfect Niphal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָנַשׁ). They will stir up, will break in pieces: imperfect Piel, doubled first radical, 3rd person masculine plural, for יְעָרֻּוּ; from the root עוּר, or for יְרֽעֲעוּ, from the root רוּעַ or רַעַע. And he will fly, and he flew, they will fly: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with prefix and 3rd person masculine plural; from the root עוּף. And he was weary: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with prefix; from the root עָף or עוּף. And he was faint, and they were faint, for יָעַף, יֵעָפוּ: imperfect Kal, 3rd person feminine and masculine plural with prefix; from the root יָעַף. To the weary, noun masculine singular with prefix; from the root יָעַף. In weariness, noun masculine singular, with prefix; from the root יָעֵף, "he was weary." And they will be weary: preterite Kal, 3rd person plural; from the root יָעַף. And they impetuously contended: imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural; from the root עָפַל. He will be afflicted with grief: imperfect Niphal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָצַב. Consulted (one who is consulted), feminine singular with prefix, from the root יָעַץ. He consulted her; they consulted; he consulted him, preterite Kal, 3rd person feminine and masculine plural with suffix; from the root יָעַץ. Consulting him; consulting you; from the singular יָעֵץ, consulting, root יָעַץ: masculine plural with suffix, Kal. He will command; and he commanded him; he will command you: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix; from the root עָצַר. He will supplant; and he supplanted me: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix; from the root עָקַב. And he enervated: imperfect Piel, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָקַר. And he perverted me: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with prefix and suffix; from the root עָקַשׁ. And he will stir up, and he stirred up: imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular with prefix; from the root עוּר. They will mix: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine plural, from the 3rd person masculine singular יַעַרֵב, or יַעַרֵב, "he will mix"; from the root עָרַב. It will be poured out: imperfect Niphal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָרָה. His forest (of a man), her forest (of a woman), my forest, forests: masculine singular with suffix, and masculine plural from the feminine singular; noun, from the root יַעַר, forest. They will be stirred up: imperfect Niphal, 3rd person masculine plural; from the root עוּר. And they will pour out: imperfect Piel, 3rd person masculine plural with prefix, from the 3rd person masculine singular יַעֲרָה, "he will pour out," from the root עָרָה. He will esteem him: imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix; from the root עָרַךְ. They will dread: imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural; from the root עָרַץ. He will set him in order; they will set in order against me: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular and plural with suffix, from the 3rd person masculine singular יַעַרְךָ; from the root עָרַךְ. He will behead; they will behead: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular and plural; from the root עָרַךְ. Honeycomb, singular feminine construct; noun, from the noun, root יַעַר. He will make; and he made: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, apocopated for יַעֲשֶׂה, from the root עָשָׂה. And he flew upon, and he clothed himself: apocopated imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, for וַיַּעֲטֹ, from the root עָטָה; or imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular, from the root עָט, to fly upon. That will be done; they will be done: imperfect Niphal, 3rd person feminine and masculine plural; from the root עָשָׂה. He will do it to him; he will do it to her; they will do it to me; they will do it to me; they will do it to her, etc.: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix and 3rd person masculine plural with paragogic and suffix; from the root עָשָׂה. He will smoke: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָשַׁן. He will become rich, or he will be enriched: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָשַׁר[?]. He will tithe: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָשַׂר. He will enrich; he will enrich him, (for יַעְשִׁיר, and יַעְשִׁירֻנוּ,) and they enriched: imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix, and 3rd person masculine plural; from the root עָשַׁר. It will be transferred: imperfect Kal; he will transfer, (for יַעְתִּיק,) imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָתַק. He will entreat; he will be entreated: imperfect Kal, and imperfect Niphal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root עָתַר.

units.la: פ יִפְאַר ornabit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. à præt. Piel, פִּאֵר ornavit, Rad. פָּאַר. וַיִּפֶן & defecit, fut Kal, 3. f. m. præf. Rad. פּוּג[?]. יִפָּדֶה redimetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. פָּדָה. וַיִּפְדְּךָ et redemit te, וַיִּפְדּוּ & redemerunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. R. פָּדָה. וַיָּפֶה et pulcher, est sing. constr. יְפֵה, præf. à No. f. m. יָפָה, Rad. יָפָה pulcher fuit. יָפוּ pulchri sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. יָפָה. שֶׁיָּפוּחַ quod afflabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. Rad. פּוּחַ. יִפּוֹל cadet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָפַל. יְפוֹת pulchræ, constr. יְפוֹת
units.tr: He will adorn: imperfect Piel, 3rd person masculine singular, from the preterite Piel פִּאֵר, "he adorned"; from the root פָּאַר. He will faint (or: and he failed): imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with prefix; from the root פּוּג[?]. He will be redeemed: imperfect Niphal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root פָּדָה. And he redeemed you, and they redeemed: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix and 3rd person masculine plural; from the root פָּדָה. And he was fair; the construct is singular יְפֵה, with prefix, from the noun masculine singular יָפָה, from the root יָפָה, "he was fair." They are fair: preterite Kal, 3rd person plural; from the root יָפָה. That which will breathe upon: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular with prefix; from the root פּוּחַ. He will fall: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root נָפַל. Fair (feminine plural), construct יְפוֹת.

units.la: pl. fæm. à f. fæm. יָפָה
units.tr: feminine plural, from the feminine singular יָפָה

units.la: à No. f. m. יָפֶה pulcher,
units.tr: from the masculine singular noun יָפֶה, "fair,"

units.la: Rad. יפה
units.tr: root יפה

units.la: וַיָּפּוּ & roborati sunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. פּוּז [?]
units.tr: And they were strengthened: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine plural; from the root פּוּז[?]

units.la: וַיָּפַח, וַיָּפַח & efflabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. פוח
units.tr: And he will breathe out, and he breathed: imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root פּוּחַ, or פּוח.

units.la: וַיָּפַח, וַיָּפַח & spirans, No. sing. m. absol. יָפֹחַ constr. יְפַח; R. פּחַ
units.tr: And breathing, and breathing: participle, masculine singular, absolute יָפֹחַ, construct יְפַח; from the root פָּחַח[?]

units.la: וַיִּפַּח spiravit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נפח
units.tr: He breathed: imperfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root נפח.

units.la: יְפִי, יָפִי, & יָפְיָה pulchritudo, (ob pausam) יָפְיוֹ ejus, (viri) יָפְיָהּ ejus (fæminæ), יָפְיָךְ tua, (de viro) יָפְיָךְ tua, (de fœmina) &c.
units.tr: Beauty: יְפִי, יָפִי, and יָפְיָה; (for pause) his beauty (of a man), her beauty (of a woman), your beauty (said of a man), your beauty (said of a woman), etc.

units.la: No. f. m. aff. R. יפה pulchrum est.
units.tr: Noun masculine singular with suffix; from the root יפה, "it is fair."

units.la: יִפִּיחַ efflabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. פּוּחַ
units.tr: He will breathe out: imperfect Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular; from the root פּוּחַ.

units.la: יַפִּיל faciet cadere, יַפִּילֵם eos, יַפִּילוּן facient cadere, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. parag.
units.tr: He will cause to fall (יַפִּיל), he will cause them to fall (יַפִּילֵם), they will cause to fall (יַפִּילוּן): future Hiphil, 3rd person masc. sing., with suffix; and 3rd person masc. plur., with paragogic nun. Root פּוּחַ? See the entry below.

units.la: pulcher factus es, praet. Pual, gem. 2. f. m. Rad. יפה
units.tr: You have become beautiful: preterite Pual, 2nd person fem. sing. Root יפה.

units.la: יַפִּיץ disperget, וַיְפִיצֵם & dispersit eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. פוץ
units.tr: He will scatter (יַפִּיץ), and he scattered them (וַיְפִיצֵם): future Hiphil, 3rd person masc. sing., with suffix. Root פוץ.

units.la: יָפִיק vacillare faciet, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. פוק
units.tr: He will make to totter (יָפִיק): future Hiphil, 3rd person masc. sing. Root פוק.

units.la: יָפִית pulchra fuisti, praet. Kal, 2. f. fæm. R. יפה
units.tr: You were beautiful (יָפִית): preterite Qal, 2nd person fem. sing. Root יפה.

units.la: יַפִּיל, יַפִּיל faciet cadere, יַפִּילֵם eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. נפל
units.tr: He will cause to fall (יַפִּיל), he will cause to fall (יַפִּיל), he will cause them to fall (יַפִּילֵם): future Hiphil, 3rd person masc. sing., with suffix. Root נפל.

units.la: יִפֹּל, יִפֹּל vel cadet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נפל
units.tr: He will fall, or he will fall (יִפֹּל): future Qal, 3rd person masc. sing. Root נפל.

units.la: יִפְלָא mirum erit, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. פלא
units.tr: It will be wonderful (יִפְלָא): future Niphal, 3rd person masc. sing. Root פלא.

units.la: יַפְלֵא segregabit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. cum loco ה, R. פלא
units.tr: He will set apart (יַפְלֵא): future Piel, 3rd person masc. sing., with the letter ה in place of the root; root פלא.

units.la: יַפְלֵא segregabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. פלא
units.tr: He will set apart (יַפְלֵא): future Hiphil, 3rd person masc. sing. Root פלא.

units.la: יַפְלֶה segregabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. פלה
units.tr: He will set apart (יַפְלֶה): future Hiphil, 3rd person masc. sing. Root פלה.

units.la: [?]ויפלו & ceciderunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R: [?]נפל ; vel, ut quidam, pro [?]יפלאו mirabiles erunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. [?]פלא.
units.tr: And they fell (ויפלו): future Qal, 3rd person plur. masc., root נפל; or, as some hold, for יפלאו, they will be wonderful: future Niphal, 3rd person plur. masc., root פלא.

units.la: [?]וירפן & obvertit, fut. Hiph. [?]יפנו adspicient, fut. Kal, m. Rad. [?]פנה.
units.tr: And he turned (וירפן): future Hiphil; they will look (יפנו): future Qal, masc.; root פנה.

units.la: [?]וירפסח & claudus factus est, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. [?]פסח.
units.tr: And he became lame (וירפסח): future Niphal, 3rd person masc. sing.; root פסח.

units.la: [?]יפעתך splendor tuus, sing. fæm. constr. aff. No. [?]יפעה splendor, Rad. [?]פעה splenduit.
units.tr: Your splendour (יפעתך): singular feminine construct with suffix; the noun יפעה, splendour, root פעה, to shine.

units.la: [?]יפיץ disperget, [?]וירפיץ & dispersit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. [?]פוץ.
units.tr: He will scatter (יפיץ), and he scattered (וירפיץ): future Hiphil, 3rd person masc. sing.; root פוץ.

units.la: [?]יפוצו spargent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. [?]פוץ.
units.tr: They will scatter (יפוצו): future Qal, 3rd person plur. masc.; root פוץ.

units.la: [?]יפצה dissipabit, [?]ויפצני et dissipavit me, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. & 3. f. m. gem. præf. & aff. Rad. [?]פוץ visitabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. [?]פקד.
units.tr: He will break in pieces (יפצה), and he broke me in pieces (ויפצני): future Piel, 3rd person masc. sing., and 3rd person masc. sing. with prefixed and suffixed forms; root פוץ. He will be visited (יפקד): future Niphal, 3rd person masc. sing.; root פקד.
