Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. יָרָא. וַיֵּרָא & ostendit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יַרְאֶה,) Rad. רָאָה. יֵרָאֶה videbitur, fut. Niph. 3.f.m.apoc.(pro יֵרָאֶה) Rad. רָאָה. יִרְאֶה videbit, וַיִּרְא & videbit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יִרְאֶה,) Rad. רָאָה. וַיַּרְא & vidit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. (pro וַיַּרְאֶה) Rad. רָאָה. יִרְאָה illa timuit, יִרְאֶנּוּ nos timuimus, &c. præt. Kal, 3. f. fæm. & 1. pl. Rad. יָרָא. לִירְאָה timendo, Infin. Kal, præf. (pro לִירְאָה) Rad. יָרָא. וַיִּרְאֶהָ & vidit eam, וַיִּרְאֶהָ eam, יִרְאַנִי videbit me, וַיִּרְאֵנִי & vidit me, וַיִּרְאֵם eos, יִרְאֶנָּה videbit eam, יִרְאוּהָ videbunt eam, וַיִּרְאוּהָ & viderunt eum, יִרְאוּהוּ videbunt eum, יִרְאוּן videbunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. aff. & parag. Rad. רָאָה. וַיַּרְאֵהוּ & ostendit eum, וַיַּרְאֵם eos, & ostenderunt eos, f. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. רָאָה. יִירְאוּ timuerunt, יִרְאוּהוּ timuerunt eum, יִרְאֶךָּ te, רְאֵנִי [?]
units.tr: י יָרָא: fear! Imperative Kal, masculine singular. Root יָרָא. יָרָא: to fear; infinitive Kal. Root יָרָא. יָרֵא: fearing, masculine singular and construct יָרֵא, with prefix. Root יָרָא. וַיִּירָא: and he feared (for וַיִּירָא); future Kal, 3rd person masculine singular. Root יָרָא. וַיֵּרָא: and he showed; future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular, apocopated (for יַרְאֶה). Root רָאָה. יֵרָאֶה: will be seen; future Niphal, 3rd person masculine singular, apocopated (for יֵרָאֶה). Root רָאָה. יִרְאֶה: he will see; וַיִּרְא: and he will see; future Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, apocopated (for יִרְאֶה). Root רָאָה. וַיַּרְא: and he saw; future Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, apocopated (for וַיַּרְאֶה). Root רָאָה. יִרְאָה: she feared; יִרְאֶנּוּ: we feared, etc.; perfect Kal, 3rd person feminine singular and 1st person plural. Root יָרָא. לִירְאָה: in fearing; infinitive Kal, with prefix (for לִירְאָה). Root יָרָא. וַיִּרְאֶהָ: and he saw her; וַיִּרְאֶהָ: her, יִרְאַנִי: he will see me; וַיִּרְאֵנִי: and he saw me; וַיִּרְאֵם: them; יִרְאֶנָּה: he will see her; יִרְאוּהָ: they will see her; וַיִּרְאוּהָ: and they saw him; יִרְאוּהוּ: they will see him; יִרְאוּן: they will see; future Kal, 3rd person feminine singular and 3rd person masculine plural, with suffix and paragogic. Root רָאָה. וַיַּרְאֵהוּ: and he showed him; וַיַּרְאֵם: them; and they showed them; feminine Hiphil, 3rd person feminine and masculine plural with suffix. Root רָאָה. יִירְאוּ: they feared; יִרְאוּהוּ: they feared him; יִרְאֶךָּ: you; רְאֵנִי [?]

units.la: יִרְאֵנִי me, præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. R. יָרֵא.
units.tr: יִרְאֵנִי: me; perfect Kal, 3rd person plural with suffix. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: יִרְאוּ timete, pro יִרְאוּ, Imper. Kal, pl. Rad. יָרֵא.
units.tr: יִרְאוּ: fear (you), for יִרְאוּ, Imperative Kal, plural. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: יִרְאִים יִרְאֵי יִרְאוּ timentes, יִרְאֵהוּ eum, לְיִרְאֶךָּ te, לְיִרְאֵיךָ timentibus te, &c. pl. m. præf. & aff. à sing. m. יָרֵא, constr. יְרֵא Rad. יָרֵא.
units.tr: יִרְאִים, יִרְאֵי, יִרְאוּ: fearing; יִרְאֵהוּ: him; לְיִרְאֶךָּ: you; לְיִרְאֵיךָ: to those fearing you, etc.; masculine plural with prefix and suffix, from the masculine singular יָרֵא, construct יְרֵא. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: יִרְאֶךָּ timebit te, יִירָא timebunt, שֶׁיִּירְאוּ quod timebunt, וְיִרְאוּן & timebunt, fut. Kal, 3. sing. & pl. m. aff. & parag. Rad. יָרֵא.
units.tr: יִרְאֶךָּ: he will fear you; יִירָא: they will fear; שֶׁיִּירְאוּ: that they will fear; וְיִרְאוּן: and they will fear; future Kal, 3rd person singular and masculine plural, with suffix and paragogic. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: לְיִרְאָם ad exterrefaciendum eos, לְיִרְאֵנִי me, Inf. Piel, præf. aff. Rad. יָרֵא.
units.tr: לְיִרְאָם: to terrify them; לְיִרְאֵנִי: me; infinitive Piel, with prefix and suffix. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: יִרְאֻנִי exterrefecerunt me, præt. Piel, 3. pl. aff. Rad. יָרֵא.
units.tr: יִרְאֻנִי: they terrified me; perfect Piel, 3rd person plural with suffix. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: יַרְאֵנוּ faciet videre nos, יִרְאֵנִי me, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. הֶרְאָה.
units.tr: יַרְאֵנוּ: he will make us see; יִרְאֵנִי: me; future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix. Root הֶרְאָה.

units.la: יְרֵאתָ timuisti, יִרְאֲתֶם timuistis, præt. Kal, 2. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָרֵא
units.tr: יְרֵאתָ: you feared; יִרְאֲתֶם: you feared; perfect Kal, 2nd person masculine singular and masculine plural. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: יִרְאָתוֹ timor ejus, יִרְאָתִי meus, יִרְאָתָם eorum, הַמִּירְאָתְךָ an ex timore tui? sing. fæm. constr. aff. & præf. No. יִרְאָה timor, Sed מִיִּרְאָתוֹ ex timendo eo, est etiam Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. ad formam qu. constr. ab Infin. Kal, יִרְאָה timere, cum ה parag. unde לְיִרְאָה ad timendum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. יָרֵא.
units.tr: יִרְאָתוֹ: his fear; יִרְאָתִי: my; יִרְאָתָם: their; הַמִּירְאָתְךָ: is it from your fear? singular feminine construct with suffix and prefix, from the noun יִרְאָה fear. But מִיִּרְאָתוֹ: from fearing him, is also an infinitive Kal with prefix and suffix, in the form of a construct from the infinitive Kal יִרְאָה to fear, with paragogic ה, whence לְיִרְאָה: to fear, infinitive Kal with prefix. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: וַיִּרֶב & insidias posuit, vel & contendit, 1Sam. 15. 5. (pro וַיִּרְאֵב, vel pro וַיִּרֶב) fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. Rad. אָרֵב, vel הֵרֵב.
units.tr: וַיִּרֶב: and he laid an ambush, or and he contended, 1 Sam. 15.5 (for וַיִּרְאֵב, or for וַיִּרֶב), future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular. Root אָרֵב, or הֵרֵב.

units.la: יָרֵב contendet, (pro יָרֵב, vel יָרִיב) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. רוּב.
units.tr: יָרֵב: he will contend (for יָרֵב, or יָרִיב), future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine/masculine. Root רוּב.

units.la: יִרְבֶּה augescet, (apoc. pro יִרְבֶּה), fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. רָבָה multum esse.
units.tr: יִרְבֶּה: he will increase (apocopated for יִרְבֶּה), future Kal, 3rd person masculine. Root רָבָה, to be many.

units.la: וַיִּרֶב & auxit, (apoc. pro לִירְבָּה
units.tr: וַיִּרֶב: and he increased (apocopated for לִירְבָּה

units.la: יִרְבֶּה, ) fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. Rad. רָבָה.
units.tr: יִרְבֶּה): future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular. Root רָבָה.

units.la: יִרְבּוּ augescent, Deut. 8. 13. (pro יִרְבּוּ,) fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. רָבָה.
units.tr: יִרְבּוּ: they will increase, Deut. 8.13 (for יִרְבּוּ), future Kal, 3rd person masculine plural with paragogic. Root רָבָה.

units.la: וַיִּרְבְּ[?] & multiplicabit te, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. רָבָה.
units.tr: וַיִּרְבְּ[?]: and he will multiply you, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix. Root רָבָה.

units.la: וַיִּרָּנוּ & murmurqverunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. רָנַן.
units.tr: וַיִּרָּנוּ: and they murmured, future Niphal, 3rd person masculine plural. Root רָנַן.

units.la: descendere, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: to go down, infinitive Kal. Root יָרַד.

units.la: וַיֹּרֶד & diduxit, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. R. יָרַד.
units.tr: וַיֹּרֶד: and he caused to part, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular. Root יָרַד.

units.la: וַיִּרְדֶּ[?] & dominabitur, (apoc. pro יִרְדֶה) fut. Kal, 3. s. m. Rad. רָדָה.
units.tr: וַיִּרְדֶּ[?]: and he will rule (apocopated for יִרְדֶה), future Kal, 3rd person masculine singular. Root רָדָה.

units.la: יֵרֵד dominabitur, (apoc. pro יִרְדֶּה,) fut. Piel, 3. s. m. Rad. רָדָה.
units.tr: יֵרֵד: he will rule (apocopated for יִרְדֶּה), future Piel, 3rd person masculine singular. Root רָדָה.

units.la: יָרֵד faciet dominari, (apoc. pro יִרְדֶּה,) fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. Rad. רָדָה.
units.tr: יָרֵד: he will make rule (apocopated for יִרְדֶּה), future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular. Root רָדָה.

units.la: וַיֹּרִיד & descendere fecit, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. (pro יוֹרִיד,) Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: וַיֹּרִיד: and he caused to go down, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular (for יוֹרִיד). Root יָרַד.

units.la: יֵרֵד descendet, fut. Kal, 3. s. m. R. יָרַד.
units.tr: יֵרֵד: he will go down, future Kal, 3rd person masculine singular. Root יָרַד.

units.la: יָרֵד descendens, Ben. Kal, s. m. Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: יָרֵד: going down, participle Kal, masculine singular. Root יָרַד.

units.la: וַיִּרְדָּה & dominatus est ei, fut. Kal, 3. s. m. יִרְדֶּה, aff. Rad. רָדָה.
units.tr: וַיִּרְדָּה: and he ruled over him, future Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, יִרְדֶּה with suffix. Root רָדָה.

units.la: וַיֹּרִידֵהוּ & descendere fecerunt eum, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: וַיֹּרִידֵהוּ: and they caused him to go down, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural with suffix. Root יָרַד.

units.la: יֹרִידֵהוּ descendere faciet eum, [?] eos, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. aff. Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: יֹרִידֵהוּ: he will cause him to go down [?] them, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix. Root יָרַד.

units.la: יִרְדּוּ dominabuntur, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. רָדָה.
units.tr: יִרְדּוּ: they will rule, future Kal, 3rd person masculine plural. Root רָדָה.

units.la: יֹרִידוּ descendere facient, pro יוֹרִידוּ) fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: יֹרִידוּ: they will make go down (for יוֹרִידוּ), future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural. Root יָרַד.

units.la: מִיֶּרֶד ex descendendo me, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. R. יָרַד.
units.tr: מִיֶּרֶד: from my going down, infinitive Kal with prefix and suffix. Root יָרַד.

units.la: וַיִּרְדֵּם & somno sopitus fuit, fut. Niph. 3. s. m. Rad. רָדַם.
units.tr: וַיִּרְדֵּם: and he was overcome with sleep, future Niphal, 3rd person masculine singular. Root רָדַם.

units.la: יִרְדְּנוּ dominabitur ei (vi-ro) ro) ירדה[?] dominabitur ei, (fœminæ) fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. ירדה ירדנו descendimus, praet. Kal, 1. pl. R. ירד ירדף, vel ירדוף persequetur, pro ירדף, fut. Kal, vel pro ירדף, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. Rad. ירדף ירה projice, Imper. Kal, f. m. R. ירה ירה projicere, לירוא? (pro לירוה) לירוה? ad projiciendum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. ירה ירה projiciens, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. ירה ירתה jaculabuntur eum, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. aff. Rad. ירה ירו jaculabuntur, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. ירה ירוא projicere, pro ירה, Infin. Kal, R. ירה ירוח respirabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. רוח ירון inebriabuntur, Pf.36. ירוך dominabitur, fut. Kal, 3. ירוש timete, Imp. Kal, pl. m. Rad. ירא ירון cantabit, pro ירון, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. רנן ירוץ confringetur, malus fiet, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. רעע, vel רוע ירופפו concutiantur, fut. Pual, 3. pl. m. R. רוף. ירוץ curret, ירוץ current, fut. Kal, 3. f m. & 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. ירן ירון quassabit, pro יָרֵן fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. רצן ירוק viriditas, No. f. m. Rad. ירק spuit. ירזה emaciabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. הזה. ירחה & odoratus est, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. ריח. ירח odorabitur, pro יריחַ fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. ריח ירח mensis, ירחך & luna tua, כירחי sicut menses, ירחים lunæ, f. m. præf. aff. & pl. m. No. Rad. ירח luna, mensis. ירחם miserebitur, fut. Piel, ירחם misericordiâ afficietur, fut. Pual, 3. f. m. Rad. רחם ירשני inclinabit me, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. (pro ירשני) Rad. ירט; sed forma qu. à רטה ירכן ירכו contendent, [?] fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. pa-rag. Rad. רוב. יריבך adversarius tuus, No. f. m. יריב litigator, aff. R. רוב. יריחה odorabitur, יריחן odorabuntur, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. parag. Rad. ריח. הירים projicientes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. præf. Rad. ירה ירימו extollent, ירימה & exaltavit eam, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. & 3. f. m. aff. Rad. רום. יריע clangent, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. ריע. כיריעות sicut aulæa, pl. fæm. יריעות aulæa, præf. No. יריעה aulæum, Rad. ירע malum esse. יריצו currere facient, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. רוץ ויריתי & projiciam, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. ירה ירך mollescet, fut. Niph.
units.tr: יִרְדְּנוּ: he will rule over him (of a man), he will rule over her (of a woman), future Kal, 3rd person feminine/masculine with suffix. Root ירדה. ירדנו: we went down, perfect Kal, 1st person plural. Root ירד. ירדף, or ירדוף: he will pursue, for ירדף, future Kal, or for ירדף, future Piel, 3rd person feminine/masculine. Root ירדף. ירה: throw! Imperative Kal, feminine masculine. Root ירה. ירה: to throw, לירוא? (for לירוה) לירוה? for throwing, infinitive Kal with prefix. Root ירה. ירה: throwing, participle Kal, feminine masculine. Root ירה. ירתה: they will shoot at him, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine with suffix. Root ירה. ירו: they will shoot, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural. Root ירה. ירוא: to throw, for ירה, infinitive Kal. Root ירה. ירוח: he will breathe, future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root רוח. ירון: they will be inebriated, Ps. 36. ירוך: he will rule, future Kal, 3rd person. ירוש: fear!, Imperative Kal, masculine plural. Root ירא. ירון: he will sing, for ירון, future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root רנן. ירוץ: will be broken, will become evil, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root רעע, or רוע. ירופפו: they will be shaken, future Pual, 3rd person masculine plural. Root רוף. ירוץ: will run; ירוץ: they will run, future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine and 3rd person masculine plural, paragogic. Root ירן. ירון: he will shake, for יָרֵן future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root רצן. ירוק: greenness, noun feminine masculine. Root ירק. spits. ירזה: he will be emaciated, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root הזה. ירחה: and he smelled, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root ריח. ירח: he will smell, for יריח, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root ריח. ירח: month, ירחך: your moon, כירחי: like months, ירחים: moons, feminine masculine with prefix and suffix and masculine plural, noun. Root ירח. moon, month. ירחם: he will have mercy, future Piel. ירחם: he will be shown mercy, future Pual, 3rd person feminine masculine. Root רחם. ירשני: he will incline me, future Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine with suffix (for ירשני). Root ירט; but the form is from רטה. ירכן, ירכו: they will contend, [?] future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural, paragogic. Root רוב. יריבך: your adversary, noun masculine, with suffix. יריב: litigant, with suffix. Root רוב. יריחה: he will smell; יריחן: they will smell, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine and masculine plural, paragogic. Root ריח. הירים: throwing, participle Kal, masculine plural with prefix. Root ירה. ירימו: they will lift up; ירימה: and he exalted her, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural and 3rd person feminine masculine, with suffix. Root רום. יריע: they will shout, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural. Root ריע. כיריעות: like curtains, feminine plural; יריעות: curtains, with prefix, noun. יריעה: curtain. Root ירע, to be evil. יריצו: they will make run, future Hiphil, 3rd person masculine plural. Root רוץ. ויריתי: and I will throw, perfect Kal, 1st person feminine. Root ירה. ירך: will become soft, future Niphal.

units.la: 3. f. m. R. רָכַךְ
units.tr: 3. fem. masc. Rad. רָכַךְ [rakhakh]

units.la: ירכך femur tuum, ירכה ejus, (fœminæ) ירכו ejus, (viri) ירכים femora, ירכך tua, f. m. constr. ירך, aff. & dual. aff. No. Rad. ירך femur.
units.tr: ירכך your thigh, ירכה her (of a woman), ירכו his (of a man), ירכים thighs, ירכך your, fem. masc. constr. ירך, with suffix and dual with suffix. No. Rad. ירך thigh.

units.la: ירכתו latus ejus, ירכתים latera bina, ירכתי latera, &c. f. fœm. aff. & dual. constr. No. f. fœm. ירכה ; à No. R. ירך.
units.tr: ירכתו his side, ירכתים two sides, ירכתי sides, etc. fem. with suffix and dual, constr. No. fem. ירכה; from No. Rad. ירך.

units.la: וירם & jaculatus est eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. ירה.
units.tr: וירם & he shot at them, fut. Hiph. 3. masc. with suffix. Rad. ירה.

units.la: וירם, וירם, וירם & extulit se, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. Rad. רום.
units.tr: וירם, וירם, וירם & he lifted himself up, fut. Kal, 3. masc. with preformative. Rad. רום.

units.la: וירם et exaltavit, וירם et exaltabit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. רום.
units.tr: וירם and he exalted, וירם and he will exalt, fut. Hiph. 3. masc. Rad. רום.

units.la: וירם et vermificavit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. רמם.
units.tr: וירם and he bred worms, fut. Kal, 3. masc. Rad. רמם.

units.la: וירמו et elati sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. רמם.
units.tr: וירמו and they were exalted, fut. Niph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. רמם.

units.la: ירמון exaltant se, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. רום.
units.tr: ירמון they exalt themselves, fut. Kal, 3. pl. masc. with paragogic nun. Rad. רום.

units.la: ירנו acclamabunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. רנן.
units.tr: ירנו they will shout, fut. Kal, 3. pl. masc. Rad. רנן.

units.la: ירננו cantabunt, fut. Piel 3. pl. m. R. רנן.
units.tr: ירננו they will sing, fut. Piel, 3. pl. masc. Rad. רנן.

units.la: ירע malum erit, ירעו malè erunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. ירע.
units.tr: ירע it will be evil, ירעו they will be evil, fut. Kal, 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. ירע.

units.la: ירע malum erit, fut. Kal, vel (qu. pro ירע,) malo afficiet) fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. ירע.
units.tr: ירע it will be evil, fut. Kal, or (query, for ירע) he will afflict with evil, fut. Piel, 3. fem. masc. Rad. ירע.

units.la: ירע malefaciet, ירעו malefacient, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. ריע [?].
units.tr: ירע he will do evil, ירעו they will do evil, fut. Hiph. 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. ריע [?].

units.la: וירע et vociferatus est, וירעו et vociferati sunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. ריע.
units.tr: וירע and he raised a shout, וירעו and they raised a shout, fut. Hiph. 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. ריע.

units.la: ירע confringet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. רעע.
units.tr: ירע he will break in pieces, fut. Kal, 3. fem. masc. Rad. רעע.

units.la: ירעה illa fuit mala, præt. Kal, 3. f. fœm. R. ירע.
units.tr: ירעה she was evil, perf. Kal, 3. fem. sing. Rad. ירע.

units.la: ירעוך pascent te, ירעון pascent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. & parag. Rad. רָעָה יִרְעֵם et pavit eos, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. רָעָה. וַיִּרְעֵם & intonuit, fut. Hiph. 3. s. m. Rad. רַעַם. יִרְעַע vociferatio agitabitur, fut. Pual, 3. f. s. m. R. רָעַע. וַיִּרֶף & destitit, (apoc. pro יִרְפֶּה,) fut. Kal, 3. f. s. m. Rad. רָפָה. יִרְפָּא sanabit, fut. Kal, יְרַפֵּא sanabit, fut. Piel, 3. f. s. m. Rad. רָפָא. יִרָּפֵא sanabitur, יִרָּפְאוּ sanabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. רָפָא. יִרְפָּה deficiet, יִרְפּוּ deficient, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. רָפָה. וַיְרַפְּאוּ & sanaverunt, (pro יְרַפְּאוּ,) fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. Rad. רָפָא; sed forma qu. ex רָפָה. וַיִּרְפּוּ & sanati sunt, (pro יִרְפּוּ,) fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. רָפָא. יִרְפְּךָ deseret te, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. רָפָה. יָרִיץ curret, יָרִיץ, וַיָּרֶץ & cucurrit, fut. Kal, 3. f. s. m. Rad. רוּץ. יִרְצֶה gratus habebitur, יִרָּצוּ grati habebuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. רָצָה bene velle. וַיְרַצְּהוּ & currere fecerunt eum, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. רוּץ. וַיִּרְצָהוּ & bene voluit ei, יִרְצְךָ bene vellet tibi, fut. Kal, 3. f. s. m. יִרְצֶה aff. Rad. רָצָה. יִרְצוּן, יִרְצוּ current, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. רוּץ. יִרְצְּצוּ gratificabuntur, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. R. רָצָה. וַיִּרְצַּץ & quassavit, fut. Piel, 3. f. s. m. R. רָצַץ. יִרְצְּצוּ, vel יְצ quassabunt, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m.
units.tr: ירעוך they will feed you, ירעון they will feed, fut. Kal, 3. pl. masc. with suffix and paragogic nun. Rad. רָעָה. יִרְעֵם and he fed them, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. masc. with suffix. Rad. רָעָה. וַיִּרְעֵם and he thundered, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. masc. Rad. רַעַם. יִרְעַע the shouting will be stirred up, fut. Pual, 3. fem. sing. masc. Rad. רָעַע. וַיִּרֶף and he ceased, (apocopated for יִרְפֶּה,) fut. Kal, 3. fem. sing. masc. Rad. רָפָה. יִרְפָּא he will heal, fut. Kal; יְרַפֵּא he will heal, fut. Piel, 3. fem. sing. masc. Rad. רָפָא. יִרָּפֵא he will be healed, יִרָּפְאוּ they will be healed, fut. Niph. 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. רָפָא. יִרְפֶּה he will fail, יִרְפּוּ they will fail, fut. Kal, 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. רָפָה. וַיְרַפְּאוּ and they healed, (for יְרַפְּאוּ,) fut. Piel, 3. pl. masc. Rad. רָפָא; but the form is perhaps from רָפָה. וַיִּרְפּוּ and they were healed, (for יִרְפּוּ,) fut. Niph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. רָפָא. יִרְפְּךָ he will forsake you, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. masc. with suffix. Rad. רָפָה. יָרִיץ he will run, יָרִיץ, וַיָּרֶץ and he ran, fut. Kal, 3. fem. sing. masc. Rad. רוּץ. יִרְצֶה he will be accepted, יִרָּצוּ they will be accepted, fut. Niph. 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. רָצָה to be favourable. וַיְרַצְּהוּ and they made him run, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. with suffix. Rad. רוּץ. וַיִּרְצָהוּ and he was pleased with him, יִרְצְךָ he would be pleased with you, fut. Kal, 3. fem. sing. masc. יִרְצֶה with suffix. Rad. רָצָה. יִרְצוּן, יִרְצוּ they run, fut. Kal, 3. pl. masc. with paragogic nun. Rad. רוּץ. יִרְצְּצוּ they will be gratified, fut. Piel, 3. pl. masc. R. רָצָה. וַיִּרְצַּץ and he crushed, fut. Piel, 3. fem. sing. masc. R. רָצַץ. יִרְצְּצוּ, or יְצ they will crush, fut. Piel, 3. pl. masc.

units.la: Rad. רָצַץ[?]
units.tr: Rad. רָצַץ[?]

units.la: וְיֶרֶק & olus, sing. m. constr. No. יֶרֶק olus, Rad. יָרַק spuit.
units.tr: וְיֶרֶק and herb, sing. masc. constr. No. יֶרֶק herb, Rad. יָרַק to spit.

units.la: וּכְיֶרֶק & sicut viriditas, No. f. m. praef. R. יֶרֶק.
units.tr: וּכְיֶרֶק and as greenness, No. fem. masc. prefix. R. יֶרֶק.

units.la: יָרַק spuere, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָרַק.
units.tr: יָרַק to spit, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָרַק.

units.la: וַיָּרֶק & evacuavit (pro יָרַק, vel יָרִיק,) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. יוּק, vel יָרִיק.
units.tr: וַיָּרֶק and he emptied (for יָרַק, or יָרִיק,) fut. Hiph. 3. fem. masc. R. יוּק, or יָרִיק.

units.la: יִרְקוֹן rubigo, בִּירַקְרַק in subviridi, יִרְקְרַקּוֹת subviridես, (à f. fæm. יִרְקְרַקָּת,) No. f m praef. & pl. fæm. gem. R. יָרַק.
units.tr: יִרְקוֹן rust, בִּירַקְרַק in greenish, יִרְקְרַקּוֹת greenish, (from the fem. יִרְקְרַקָּת,) No. fem. masc. prefix and pl. fem. doubled. R. יָרַק.

units.la: וַיִּירַשׁ & hæreditate accipiet, יִירְשׁוּהָ et hæreditate acceperunt eam, pro יִירְשׁוּ, & יִרְשׁוּ, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. aff. R. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: וַיִּירַשׁ and he will receive as inheritance, יִירְשׁוּהָ and they have received her as inheritance, for יִירְשׁוּ, and יִרְשׁוּ, fut. Kal, 3. fem. masc. and 3. pl. masc. with suffix. R. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: וַיִּירַשׁ et hæredem instituit, it, וַיִּירְשָׁם eos, יִרְשָׁהוּ hæredem instituit eum,
units.tr: וַיִּירַשׁ and he appointed an heir, וַיִּירְשָׁם them, יִרְשָׁהוּ he appointed him heir,

units.la: יִרְשׁוּ fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: יִרְשׁוּ fut. Hiph. 3. fem. masc. with suffix. R. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: יָרְשָׁהּ posside, Imper. Kal, parag. pro יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: יָרְשָׁהּ possess, Imper. Kal, with paragogic ending for יָרַשׁ.

units.la: וִירִשְׁוּהָ & hæreditate acceperunt eam, pret. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: וִירִשְׁוּהָ and they received her as inheritance, perf. Kal, 3. pl. with suffix. Rad. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: הַלְּיִירְשָׁנוּ an possidendo nos, Infin. Kal, praef. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: הַלְּיִירְשָׁנוּ whether to possess us, Infin. Kal, with prefix and suffix. Rad. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: וִירְשָׁנוּךָ & hæreditate accepimus te, pret. Kal, 1. pl. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: וִירְשָׁנוּךָ and we have received you as inheritance, perf. Kal, 1. pl. with suffix. Rad. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: מִיִּרְשָׁתְךָ ex hæreditate tua, sing. fæm. praef. aff. No. יְרֻשָּׁה; Rad. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: מִיִּרְשָׁתְךָ from your inheritance, sing. fem. with prefix and suffix. No. יְרֻשָּׁה; Rad. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: וִירִשְׁתָּם & hæreditate accepistis, וִירִשְׁתָּה et hæreditate accepisti eam, ם eos, pret. Kal, 2. pl. m. & 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: וִירִשְׁתָּם and you have received as inheritance, וִירִשְׁתָּה and you have received her as inheritance, ם them, perf. Kal, 2. pl. masc. and 2. fem. masc. with suffix. Rad. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: יִרְשָׁתָּם hæreditate accepisti eos, pro יִרְשָׁתָּם. pret. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. R. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: יִרְשָׁתָּם you have received them as inheritance, for יִרְשָׁתָּם. perf. Kal, 2. fem. masc. with suffix. R. יָרַשׁ.

units.la: יַרְשִׁיהָ fervefaciet, fut. Hiph.
units.tr: יַרְשִׁיהָ he will make it boil, fut. Hiph.

units.la: Hiph. 3. f. m. R. רָתַח
units.tr: Hiph. 3. fem. masc. R. רָתַח

units.la: concatenabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. רָתַק
units.tr: will be chained together, fut. Niph. 3. fem. masc. R. רָתַק

units.la: ש
units.tr: ש

units.la: שׁ, vel יֵשׁ est, יְשָׁךְ tu es, יִשְׁנוֹ ille est, יֵשְׁכֶם vos estis, &c. est part. indeclin. aff. in Rad. יֶשׁ.
units.tr: שׁ, or יֵשׁ is, יְשָׁךְ you are, יִשְׁנוֹ he is, יֵשְׁכֶם you are, etc. is an indeclinable particle with suffix, from the root יֶשׁ.

units.la: יִשָּׂא feret, יִשְׂאֵךְ te, יִשְׂאֻהוּ eum, יִשְׂאֶנָּה eam, וַיִּשָּׂאֵם & tulit eos, יִשְׂאוּם ferent eos, יִשְׂאוּ ferent eum, יִשְּׂאֻנוּ ferent nos, & יִשְּׂאֻךָ ferent te, &c. fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: יִשָּׂא he will bear, יִשְׂאֵךְ you, יִשְׂאֻהוּ him, יִשְׂאֶנָּה her, וַיִּשָּׂאֵם and he bore them, יִשְׂאוּם they will bear them, יִשְׂאוּ they will bear him, יִשְּׂאֻנוּ they will bear us, and יִשְּׂאֻךָ they will bear you, etc. fut. Kal, 3. fem. and pl. masc. with suffix. R. נָשָׂא.

units.la: יִשָּׂאוּ ferent, pro יִשָּׂא, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: יִשָּׂאוּ they will bear, for יִשָּׂא, fut. Kal, 3. pl. masc. R. נָשָׂא.

units.la: יִשָּׁא, vel יִשִּׁיא decipiet, יִשָּׁאוּ, vel יִשִּׁיאוּ decipient, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: יִשָּׁא, or יִשִּׁיא he will deceive, יִשָּׁאוּ, or יִשִּׁיאוּ they will deceive, fut. Hiph. 3. fem. and pl. masc. R. נָשָׂא.

units.la: יִשָּׁאוּן tumultuabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. שָׁאָה.
units.tr: יִשָּׁאוּן they will be in tumult, fut. Niph. 3. pl. masc. with paragogic nun. Rad. שָׁאָה.

units.la: יִשָּׁאֵר relinquetur; יִשְׁאֲרוּ relinquent, fut. Niph. & Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁאַר.
units.tr: יִשָּׁאֵר it will be left; יִשְׁאֲרוּ they will leave, fut. Niph. and Hiph. 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. שָׁאַר.

units.la: relinquentur; יִשָּׁאֲרוּ re-
units.tr: relinquentur; יִשָּׁאֲרוּ re-

units.la: linquet; יִשְׁאִיר relin-
units.tr: linquet; יִשְׁאִיר relin-

units.la: quent, fut. Niph. & Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁאַר.
units.tr: quent, fut. Niph. and Hiph. 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. שָׁאַר.

units.la: וַיִּשְׁבֶּה et captivum abduxit, וַיִּשְׁבּוּ & captivos abduxerunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יִשְׁבָּה) & 3. pl. m. Rad. שָׁבָה.
units.tr: וַיִּשְׁבֶּה and he led away a captive, וַיִּשְׁבּוּ and they led captives away, fut. Kal, 3. fem. masc. apocopated (for יִשְׁבָּה) and 3. pl. masc. Rad. שָׁבָה.

units.la: וַיָּשָׁב, וַיָּשֶׁב & redire fecit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. שׁוּב.
units.tr: וַיָּשָׁב, וַיָּשֶׁב and he caused to return, fut. Hiph. 3. fem. masc. Rad. שׁוּב.

units.la: יָשַׁב sedebit, יֵשְׁבוּ sedebunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָשַׁב.
units.tr: יָשַׁב he will sit, יֵשְׁבוּ they will sit, fut. Kal, 3. fem. and pl. masc. Rad. יָשַׁב.

units.la: יָשַׁב sedere, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָשַׁב.
units.tr: יָשַׁב to sit, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָשַׁב.

units.la: וְהַיּשֵׁב & qui sederit, הַיּשֵׁבִי qui residens es, הַיּשִׁבָה quae residet, יֹשְׁבֵיהֶם habitatores eorum, part. Ben. Kal, f. m. parag. & sing. fæm. ut & pl. m. aff. Rad. יָשַׁב.
units.tr: וְהַיּשֵׁב and he who sits, הַיּשֵׁבִי you who dwell, הַיּשִׁבָה she who dwells, יֹשְׁבֵיהֶם their inhabitants, participle Kal, masc. with paragogic ending and fem. sing. as also masc. pl. with suffix. Rad. יָשַׁב.

units.la: וַיּשֵׁב & sedere fecit; וַיּשְׁבוּם & seære fecerunt eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. יָשֵׁב. יָשַׁב, יָשַׁב, יָשַׁב, revertetur, יָשׁוּב reverstentur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. שׁוּב. יִשֹּׁב flabit; וַיִּשְׁבֹּ & perflavit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָשַׁב. וַיִּשְׁבּוּ et collocabunt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. R. יָשַׁב. יִשַּׁבְּחֶנָּה laudabit eam, & יִשַּׁבְּחוּנְךָ laudabunt te, fut. Piel, 3. f. & pl. m. aff. cum epent. Rad. שָׁבַח. יִשְׂבִּיעֵנִי satiabit me, Job. 9. 18. pro יַשְׂבִּיעֵנִי, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. R. שָׂבַע. יִשְׁבֵּנִי redire faciet me, יִשְׁבָּהּ eam, וַיַּשְׁבּוּ et facient redire, וַיַּשְׁבֵּהוּ et fecerunt redire eum, וַיַּשְׁבּוּם eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּב. יִשָּׁבַע jurabit, יִשָּׁבְעוּ jurabunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁבַע. וַיִּשְׁבַּע et adjuravit me, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁבַע. יִשְׂבְּעוּ saturabunt, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. R. שָׂבַע. וַיִּשָּׁבְרוּ et fracti sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. à 3. f. m. יִשָּׁבֵר frangetur, Rad. שָׁבַר. וַיִּשְׁבֹּת et quievit, fut. Kal, 3. sing. masc. Rad. שָׁבַת. וַיִּשְׁבַּת et quiescere fecit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. שָׁבַת. וַיִּשָּׂג et attigit, וַיִּשָּׂגוּ et attigerunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. נָשַׂג. יִשְׂנַב exaltabitur, fut. Pual, 3. f. m. R. שָׂנַב. יִשְׁגּוּ errabunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. à 3. f. m. יִשְׁגֶּה errabit, Rad. שָׁגָה. יִשְׁחֲתֵם vastabit eos, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁדַד[?] ישׁה mutuabit, fut. Hiph. 3 f. m. R. נָשָׁה[?] ישׁוּב revertetur, pro ישׁוּב fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. שׁוּב ישׁוּב reverti faciet, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. שׁוּב ישׁוּד vastabit, pro ישׁוּד fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. שָׁדַד[?] ישׁוּת æquabit, ישׁוּ æquabuntur, fut. Piel, 3. f. & fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. שׁוּה[?] ישׁוּחֶה eloquetur, fut. Piel, 3. sing. masc. Rad. שׁוּחַ[?] ישׁוּך mordebit, pro ישׁוּך fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָשַׁךְ ישׁוֹם ponet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. שׂוּם[?] ישׁוֹם obstupescet, pro ישׁוֹם, fut. Kal, 3. f. Rad. שָׁמַם[?] לִישֹׁן[?] dormiendo. Eccles. ʒ. ıı. Infin. Kal, præf. R. יָשֵׁן[?] ישׁיע vociferabitur, ישׁיעוּ vociferabuntur, fut. Piel, 3. sing. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁוַע[?] ישׁועתה omnimoda salus, est No. cum duplici signo fæm. à ישׁועה salus, R. ישׁע ישׁועתך salus tua, ישׁועתה ejus, ישׁועות salutes, sing. fæm. constr. aff. & pl. fæm. No. ישׁועה, Rad ישׁע ישׁוּף conteret, ישׁופך conteret te, ישׁופנו conteret eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּף[?] ישׁור contemplabitur, ישׁורנו eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁור ישׁור contemplabitur, pro ישׁור, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. שׁור ישׁחה incurvabit se, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. à R. שְׁחָה[?] וישׁחה et incurvatus est, וַיִּשְׁחוּ [?] et incurvati sunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁחַח. יִשָּׁחֵט [?] jugulabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. שָׁחַט. וְיִשְׁחֲךָ [?] & depressio tua, f. m. aff. No. Rad. שָׁחַח depressio. יַשְׁחֶנָּה [?] deprimet illam, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. שָׁחָה. יִשְׁחֲרֻנִי [?] tempestive quaerent me, Prov. 1. 28. pro יִשְׁחֲרוּנִי, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. שָׁחַר. יִשְׁטֶּה [?] declinabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoe (pro יִשְׁטֶּה,) Rad. שָׁטָה. וַיִּשְׁטוּ [?] & discurrerunt, יִשְׁטוּ [?] percurrent, fut. Kal & Piel, 3. pl. m. Rad. שׁוּט. וַיִּשְׂטְמוּ [?] & odit, וַיִּשְׂטְמֻהוּ [?] & oderunt eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. שָׂטַם. יִשָּׁטֵף [?] inundabitur, יִשְׁטְפוּ [?] inundabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁטַף. יִשָּׂא [?], & יִשָּׂא [?] exactorem aget, pro יִשָּׂא [?], fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָשָׂא. יַשִּׁיא [?] decipiet, יַשִּׁיאֲךָ [?] decipiet te, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָשָׂא. וַיִּשְׁבֶּנּוּ [?] reducet eum, וַיִּשְׁבֵם [?] & reduxit eos, וַיִּשְׁבְּרוּ [?] & reduxerunt eum, יִשְׁבֵּנִי [?] reducent me, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. aff. à 3. f. m. יִשְׁב; Rad. שׁוּב. יִשִּׂיגוּן [?] assequentur, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. נָשַׂג. יְשִׁים [?] desolabit, Jer. 49. 20. (pro יְשִׁים, vel, יְשֻׁם,) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. שָׁמַם. יְשִׂימוּ [?] ponet eos, Deut. 7. 15. וַיָּשִׂימֵנִי [?] & posuit me, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. יָשִׂים, aff. R. שׂוּם. יִשְׁיעֵם [?] salvabit vos, fut.
units.tr: vayyashev and made to sit; vayyashvum and seated them, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl. masc. with suffix, root yashav. yashav, yashav, yashav, yashuv (he will return), yashuvu (they will return), fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl. masc. with paragogic, root shuv. yishov (he will blow); vayyashov and blew through, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem., root nashav. vayyashvu and they will set down, preterite Piel, 3rd pl., root yashav. yishabbeḥena he will praise her, and yishabbeḥunkha they will praise you, fut. Piel, 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl. masc. with suffix and epenthetic letter, root shavaḥ. yasbiʿeni he will satiate me, Job 9:18, for yasbiʿeni, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. masc. with suffix, root sava. yashiveni he will make me return, yashvah him/her, vayyashvu and they will make return, vayyashvehu and they made him return, vayyashvum and they made them return, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl. masc. with suffix, root shuv. yishaba` he will swear, yishaba`u they will swear, fut. Niph. 3rd sing. fem. and pl. masc., root shava`. vayyishba` and he made me swear, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. masc. with suffix, root shava`. yisbe`u they will be satisfied, fut. Piel, 3rd pl. masc., root sava`. vayyishshavru and they were broken, fut. Niph. 3rd pl. masc. from 3rd sing. masc. yishsher he will be broken, root shavar. vayyishbot and he rested, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc., root shavat. vayyishbat and he made to rest, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. masc., root shavat. vayyissag and he reached, vayyissagu and they reached, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem. and pl. masc., root nasag. yisnav he will be exalted, fut. Pual, 3rd sing. masc., root sanav. yishgu they will err, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc. from 3rd sing. fem. yishgeh he will err, root shagah. yishḥatem he will lay waste to them, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix, root shadad[?]. yishah he will lend, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. masc., root nashah[?]. yashuv he will return, for yashuv, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc., root shuv. yashiv he will make return, fut. Piel, 3rd sing. masc., root shuv. yashud he will lay waste, for yashud, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc., root shadad[?]. yashut he will make equal, yashu they will be made equal, fut. Piel, 3rd sing. fem. and fut. Kal, 3rd pl. masc., root shavah[?]. yishuḥeh he will speak, fut. Piel, 3rd sing. masc., root shuaḥ[?]. yishuk he will bite, for yishuk, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc., root nashak. yashom he will place, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. masc., root sum[?]. yashom he will be astonished, for yashom, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem., root shamam[?]. lishon[?] in sleeping. Eccles. 3:11. Infin. Kal, prefixed, root yashen[?]. yashia` he will cry out, yashi`u they will cry out, fut. Piel, 3rd sing. and pl. masc., root sha`a[?]. yeshu`atah every kind of salvation, a noun with the double feminine sign from yeshu`ah salvation, root yasha`. yeshu`atkha your salvation, yeshu`atah his/her, yeshu`ot salvations, singular fem. construct with suffix and plural fem. noun yeshu`ah, root yasha`. yashuf he will crush, yashufkha he will crush you, yashufenu he will crush him, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem. with suffix, root shuf[?]. yashur he will behold, yashurenu him, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem. with suffix, root shur. yashur he will behold, for yashur, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem., root shur. yishaḥeh he will bow himself, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem., from root shaḥah[?]. vayyishaḥeh and he was bowed down, vayyishḥu and they were bowed down, fut. Niph. 3rd sing. fem. and pl. masc., root shaḥaḥ. yishshaṭ he will be slaughtered, fut. Niph. 3rd sing. fem., root shaṭaṭ. veyishḥakha[?] and your depression, fem. masc. with suffix, from root shaḥaḥ depression. yashḥenah[?] he will press it down, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. masc. with suffix, root shaḥah. yishḥarunī[?] they will seek me diligently, Prov. 1:28, for yishḥaruni, fut. Piel, 3rd pl. masc. with suffix, root shaḥar. yishteh[?] he will turn aside, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem., an apocope (for yishteh), root shatah. vayyishṭu[?] and they ran about, yishṭu[?] they will run through, fut. Kal and Piel, 3rd pl. masc., root shut. vayyishṭemu[?] and he hated, vayyishṭemuhu[?] and they hated him, fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl. masc. with suffix, root shatam. yishshaṭef[?] he will be flooded, yishṭefu[?] they will be flooded, fut. Niph. 3rd sing. fem. and pl. masc., root shataf. yisha[?] and yisha[?] he will exact a creditor, for yisha[?], fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem., root nasa. yashi[?] he will deceive, yashiakha[?] he will deceive you, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem. with suffix, root nasa. vayyishbenu[?] he will bring him back, vayyishbem[?] and he brought them back, vayyishberu[?] and they brought him back, yishbeni[?] they will bring me back, fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl. masc. with suffix, from 3rd sing. fem. yishav; root shuv. yishigun[?] they will overtake, fut. Hiph. 3rd pl. masc. with paragogic, root nasag. yesh[?] he will make desolate, Jer. 49:20 (for yesheim, or yeshum), fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem., root shamam. yesimu[?] he will place them, Deut. 7:15, and vayyasimeni[?] and he placed me, etc., fut. Hiph. 3rd sing. fem., yasim, with suffix, root sum. yishi`em[?] he will save you, fut.

units.la: Hiph. 3. f. m. יִשְׁיַע, aff. Rad. יָשַׁע.
units.tr: Hiph. 3rd sing. fem., yishya, with suffix, root yasha`.

units.la: יִשְׁהָ cantabunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. שׁוּר.
units.tr: [יִשְׁהָ] they will sing, fut. Hiph., 3rd pl. m., root [שׁוּר].

units.la: יִשִּׁשׁ gaudebunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. שׂוּשׂ.
units.tr: [יִשִּׁשׁ] they will rejoice, fut. Hiph., 3rd pl. m., root [שׂוּשׂ].

units.la: יִשִׁית ponet, וַיִּשְׁתְּהוּ & ponet eum, יִשִּׁיתוּהוּ ponent eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. שׁוּת.
units.tr: [יִשִׁית] he will place, [וַיִּשְׁתְּהוּ] and he will place him, [יִשִּׁיתוּהוּ] they will place him, fut. Hiph., 3rd f. and pl. m. with suffix, root [שׁוּת].

units.la: יִשְׁךְ, & יִשָּׁךְ mordebit, יִשְׁכְּנוּ eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. R. נָשַׁךְ.
units.tr: [יִשְׁךְ] and [יִשָּׁךְ] he will bite, [יִשְׁכְּנוּ] him, fut. Kal, 3rd f. m., root [נָשַׁךְ].

units.la: וַיִּשְׁכּוּ & quieverunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. שָׁכַךְ.
units.tr: [וַיִּשְׁכּוּ] and they were quiet, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. m., root [שָׁכַךְ].

units.la: יִשְׁכַּת oblivioni tradetur, יִשְׁכְּחוּ oblivioni tradentur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁכַח.
units.tr: [יִשְׁכַּת] he will be consigned to oblivion, [יִשְׁכְּחוּ] they will be consigned to oblivion, fut. Niph., 3rd f. and pl. m., root [שָׁכַח].

units.la: יִשָּׁל dejicet, Job 27.8. vel tranquillus erit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יִשֵּׁל; Rad. נָשַׁל, vel pro יִשְׁלָה à שָׁלָה.
units.tr: [יִשָּׁל] he will cast down, Job 27. 8., or he will be tranquil, fut. Kal, 3rd f. m., for [יִשֵּׁל]; root [נָשַׁל], or for [יִשְׁלָה] from [שָׁלָה].

units.la: יִשְׁלְּךָ spoliabunt te, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. à 3. f. m. יִשְּׁלֵךְ; Rad. שָׁלַל.
units.tr: [יִשְׁלְּךָ] they will despoil you, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. m. with suffix, from the 3rd f. m. [יִשְּׁלֵךְ]; root [שָׁלַל].

units.la: יִשְׁלִי quiescent, Pf.122.6. fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. (pro יִשְׁלוּ,) Rad. שָׁלָה.
units.tr: [יִשְׁלִי] they will be quiet, Ps. 122. 6., fut. Kal, 3rd pl. m., for [יִשְׁלוּ], root [שָׁלָה].

units.la: יִשְׁלְכוּ dejicientur, pro יִשְׁלְכוּ, fut. Hoph. 3. pl. m. Rad. שָׁלַךְ.
units.tr: [יִשְׁלְכוּ] they will be cast down, for [יִשְׁלְכוּ], fut. Hoph., 3rd pl. m., root [שָׁלַךְ].

units.la: יִשֵּׂם ponet, וַיִּשֶּׂם & posuit, יִשְׂמֵנִי ponet me, יִשְׂמְךָ te, וַיִּשֵּׂמֵם & posuit eos, וַיִּשְׂמוּ & posuerunt, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. Rad. שׂוּם.
units.tr: [יִשֵּׂם] he will place, [וַיִּשֶּׂם] and he placed, [יִשְׂמֵנִי] he will place me, [יִשְׂמְךָ] you, [וַיִּשֵּׂמֵם] and he placed them, [וַיִּשְׂמוּ] and they placed, fut. Hiph., 3rd f. m. with suffix and 3rd pl. m., root [שׂוּם].

units.la: יִשֹּׁם obstupescet, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יִשֵּׁם; Rad. שָׁמַם.
units.tr: [יִשֹּׁם] he will be astonished, fut. Kal, 3rd f. m., for [יִשֵּׁם]; root [שָׁמַם].

units.la: יִשְׁמַד perdetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. שָׁמַד.
units.tr: [יִשְׁמַד] he will be destroyed, fut. Niph., 3rd f. m., root [שָׁמַד].

units.la: יִשְׁמוּ obstupescent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. שָׁמַם.
units.tr: [יִשְׁמוּ] they will be astonished, fut. Kal, 3rd pl. m., root [שָׁמַם].

units.la: יִשָּׁמַע audietur, יִשְׁמְעוּ audientur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁמַע.

(pro יִתְּוַכַּח,) Rad. יָכַח. יִתּוֹם absolvetur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. pro יָתוֹם, Rad. תָּמַם. יְתוֹמֶיךָ pupilli tui, pl. m. aff. No. Rad. f. m. יָתוֹם pupillus. יִתֵּן diruet, pro יִתֵּין, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. נָתַן. יָתוֹר excellens vel explo-ratio, f. m. constr. No. יָתוֹר, à R. יָתַר, vel No. f. m. R. תּוֹר. וַיִּתְחַל & aegrotum egit, fut Hithp. 3. f. m. apoc. pro יִתְחַלֶּה; Rad. חָלָה. יִתְיַלְּדוּ natales profitebuntur, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. יָלַד. יִתְיַעֲצוּ consultabunt, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. יָעַץ. יִתְיַצְּבוּ sistent se, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. יָצַב. וַיִּתְיָרוּ & explorarunt caraverunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. תּוּר. וַיִּתְּכוּ & effusi sunt, & effuderunt, fut. Kal, & Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. נָתַךְ. יִתְּכוֹן stabilietur, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. R. כּוּן. יִתָּכֵן aptabitur, יִתְּכְנוּ aptabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. תָּכַן. תִּתְכַּסֶּה & texit se, tegent se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יִתְכַּסֶּה,) & 3. pl. m. R. כָּסָה. יִתְלוּ suspendent, fut. Kal, וַיִּתְלוּ & suspensi sunt fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. תָּלָה [?] it, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. & consumptus fuit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. וַיִּתֹּם (pro יִתֹּם,) Rad. תָּמַם וַיִּתֵּם & absolvit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. (pro יִתֹּם,) Rad. תָּמַם וַיִּתְמְהוּ & mirati sunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. Rad. תָּמַהּ יִתַּמְּהָה morabitur, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. gem. Rad. מָהָה יִתַּמּוּ absolventur, & pro eo יִתַּמּוּ Deut. 34. 8. fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. תָּמַם יִתְמְרַד metietur se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. R. מָרַד יִתְמֹךְ sustentabit, יִתְמְכוּ sustentabunt, יִתָּמֵךְ sustentabitur, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. & fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. תָּמַךְ יִתְמַלָּאוּן explebunt se, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. [?] יִתְמַלְּלוּ praecidentur, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. כּוּל, vel מָלַל וַיִּתְמָרְמַר & exacerbavit se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. gem. Rad. מָרַר יִתֵּן dabit, וַיִּתְנֵהוּ ei, יִתְּנוּ & dabunt ei, 2 Reg. 22. 5. (pro וַיִּתְנוּהוּ,) וַיִּתְנוּם & dederunt eis, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. נָתַן יִתֵּן dabitur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. m. R. נָתַן יִתְּנוּ illae dabunt, pro תִּתֵּנָה fut. Kal, 3. pl. fæm. Rad. נָתַן יִתְנוּ mercede conducent, fut. Kal, יַתְנוּ confabulabuntur, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. R. תָּנָה יִתְנוֹדְדוּ vagi fugient, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. נוּד, vel נָדַד וַיִּתַע & erravit, יִתְעוּ errabunt, fut. Kal, 3. sing. m. apoc. (pro יִתְעֶה,) & 3. pl. m. Rad. תָּעָה. רִיתְעֵב [?] & abominatus est, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. תָּעַב. יִתְעַב abominabitur, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. תָּעַב. יִתְעַדְּנוּ [?] oblectabunt se, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. עָדַן. וַיִּתְעוּ [?] & fecerunt errare eos, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. תָּעָה. יִתְעַל extollet se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. apoc. (pro יִתְעַלֶּה,) Rad. עָלָה. יִתְעַלֵּם occultabit se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. Rad. עָלַם. וַיִּתְעֵם & fecit errare eos, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. תָּעָה. יִתְעַנַּג oblectabit se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. R. עָנַג. יִתְעַצֵּב dolebit, בוּ dolebunt, fut. Hithp. 3. f. & pl. m. R. עָצַב. יִתְעָרֵב immiscebit se, בוּ immiscebunt se, fut. Hithp. 3. f. & pl. m. R. עָרַב. יִתְפָּאֵר gloriabitur, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. masc. Rad. פָּאַר. יִתְפַּלָּל orabit, לוּ orabunt, fut. Hithp. 3. f. & pl. m. R. פָּלַל. יִתְפַּצְּצוּ [?] dissipabuntur, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. פּוּץ. יִתְפַּקָּד recensebit se, Jud. 21.9. יִתְפָּקְדוּ numerati erunt, Jud. 20.15. pro יִתְפַּקֵּד, & יִתְפַּקְדוּ, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. Rad. פָּקַד. וַיִּתְפְּרוּ & confuerunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. תָּפַר. יִתְפָּרְקוּ rumpentur, fut. Hitph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. פָּרַק. יִתָּפְשׂ capientur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. תָּפַשׂ. יִתְפְּשׂוּם prehendent eos, יִתְפָּשְׂךָ prehendet te, fut. Kal, 3. pl. & f. m. aff. R. חָפַשׂ. destruetur, fut. Hoph. יִתֵּן 3. f. m. R. נָתַן. יִתְצְרֵהוּ [?] destruent eum, נִי [?] destruet me, fut. Kal, 3. pl. & f. m. aff. Rad. נָתַן יִתְקַע clangetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. תָּקַע. וַיִּתְקָעֵהוּ & fixit eum, יִתְקְעוּ figent, וַיִּתְקָעֵם & fixit eos, fut. Kal, 3. sing. & pl. m. aff. Rad. תָּקַע. יִתְקְפוּ prævalebit ei, fut. Kal, 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. תָּקַף. יִתֵּר solvet, וַיִּתֵּר & solvit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָתַר. יָתֵר excellens, יִתֵר excellentia, יִתְרָה residuum, כְּיִתְרוֹן ut emolumentum, (pro כְּיִתְרוֹן,) &c. Nomina à Rad. יָתַר. וַיִּתְרָא & comparuerunt sibi, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. דָּאָה. יִתְרוּ explorent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. תּוּר. יִתְרֵי reliquum illius, יִתְרִים restes, f. m. aff. & pl. m. No. יֶתֶר, Rad. יָתַר. יִתְרוֹמֵם extollet se, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. m. Rad. רוֹם. יִתְרוֹעֲעוּ clangent, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. masc. Rad. רִיעַ. יִתְרַצֶּה benevolentiam conciliabit sibi, fut. Hithp. 3. f. m. Rad. רָצָה. יִתְרָה residuum, Jer. 4. 8. יִתְרָת reticulum hepa-tis, No. f. fæm. R. יֶתֶר. וַיִּתְשֵּׁם & exstirpavit eos, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָתַשׁ.
units.tr: This is a lexicon entry list of Hebrew verb forms, each giving the form, its meaning, its conjugation and its root. The forms include: יִתְהַלֵּל, and יִתְהַלֵּל, he will boast himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root הָלַל, in Piel הִלֵּל, or הלל. וַיִּתֵּן and he sealed, future Piel, 3rd person singular masculine, apocopated (for יְהַוֶּה), from the root הָוָה. יָהֻדּוּ they will confess, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine (for יִתְיַדּוּ), from the root יָדָה he cast. יִתּוֹכַּח he will dispute, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine (for יִתְּוַכַּח), from the root יָכַח. יִתּוֹם he will be acquitted, future Kal, 3rd person feminine/masculine, for יָתוֹם, from the root תָּמַם. יְתוֹמֶיךָ your orphans, plural masculine with suffix, from the root יָתוֹם orphan. יִתֵּן he will break down, for יִתֵּין, future Kal, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root נָתַן. יָתוֹר excelling or exploration, masculine construct; either from the root יָתַר or a noun of the masculine form from the root תּוֹר. וַיִּתְחַל and he made the sick man, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, apocopated (for יִתְחַלֶּה), from the root חָלָה. יִתְיַלְּדוּ they will declare their births, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root יָלַד. יִתְיַעֲצוּ they will consult, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root יָעַץ. יִתְיַצְּבוּ they will station themselves, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root יָצַב. וַיִּתְיָרוּ and they explored, they spied out, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תּוּר. וַיִּתְּכוּ and they were poured out, and they poured out, future Kal and Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root נָתַךְ. יִתְּכוֹן it will be established, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root כּוּן. יִתָּכֵן it will be fitted, יִתְּכְנוּ they will be fitted, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, from the root תָּכַן. תִּתְכַּסֶּה he covered himself, they will cover themselves, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, apocopated (for יִתְכַּסֶּה), and 3rd person plural masculine, from the root כָּסָה. יִתְלוּ they will hang, future Kal, וַיִּתְלוּ and they were hanged, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תָּלָה. [?] it, future Kal, 3rd person feminine/masculine, and it was consumed, future Kal, 3rd person feminine/masculine. וַיִּתֹּם (for יִתֹּם), from the root תָּמַם. וַיִּתֵּם and he finished, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine/masculine (for יִתֹּם), from the root תָּמַם. וַיִּתְמְהוּ and they were astonished, future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תָּמַהּ. יִתַּמְּהָה he will tarry, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, geminate, from the root מָהָה. יִתַּמּוּ they will be finished, and in place of it יִתַּמּוּ, Deuteronomy 34:8, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תָּמַם. יִתְמְרַד he will reap himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root מָרַד. יִתְמֹךְ he will sustain, יִתְמְכוּ they will sustain, יִתָּמֵךְ he will be sustained, future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, and future Niphal, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root תָּמַךְ. יִתְמַלָּאוּן they will fill themselves, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root [?]. יִתְמַלְּלוּ they will be cut off, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root כּוּל, or מָלַל. וַיִּתְמָרְמַר and he embittered himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, geminate, from the root מָרַר. יִתֵּן he will give, וַיִּתְנֵהוּ to him, יִתְּנוּ they will give to him, 2 Kings 22:5 (for וַיִּתְנוּהוּ), וַיִּתְנוּם and they gave to them, future Kal, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine with suffix, from the root נָתַן. יִתֵּן it will be given, future Hophal, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root נָתַן. יִתְּנוּ they will give, for תִּתֵּנָה, future Kal, 3rd person plural feminine, from the root נָתַן. יִתְנוּ they will hire themselves for wages, future Kal, יַתְנוּ they will converse, future Piel, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תָּנָה. יִתְנוֹדְדוּ they will flee wandering, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root נוּד, or נָדַד. וַיִּתַע and he wandered, יִתְעוּ they will wander, future Kal, 3rd person singular masculine, apocopated (for יִתְעֶה), and 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תָּעָה. רִיתְעֵב [?] and he abhorred, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root תָּעַב. יִתְעַב he will abhor, future Piel, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root תָּעַב. יִתְעַדְּנוּ [?] they will delight themselves, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root עָדַן. וַיִּתְעוּ [?] and they caused them to wander, future Hiphil, 3rd person plural masculine with suffix, from the root תָּעָה. יִתְעַל he will exalt himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, apocopated (for יִתְעַלֶּה), from the root עָלָה. יִתְעַלֵּם he will hide himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root עָלַם. וַיִּתְעֵם and he caused them to wander, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine/masculine with suffix, from the root תָּעָה. יִתְעַנַּג he will delight himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root עָנַג. יִתְעַצֵּב he will grieve, יִתְעַצְּבוּ they will grieve, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, from the root עָצַב. יִתְעָרֵב he will mingle himself, יִתְעָרְבוּ they will mingle themselves, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, from the root עָרַב. יִתְפָּאֵר he will glory, future Hithpael, 3rd person singular masculine, from the root פָּאַר. יִתְפַּלָּל he will pray, יִתְפַּלְּלוּ they will pray, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine and plural masculine, from the root פָּלַל. יִתְפַּצְּצוּ [?] they will be dispersed, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root פּוּץ. יִתְפַּקָּד he will review himself, Judges 21:9. יִתְפָּקְדוּ they will be numbered, Judges 20:15, for יִתְפַּקֵּד and יִתְפַּקְדוּ, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root פָּקַד. וַיִּתְפְּרוּ and they sewed together, future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תָּפַר. יִתְפָּרְקוּ they will be broken, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root פָּרַק. יִתָּפְשׂ he will be seized, future Niphal, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תָּפַשׂ. יִתְפְּשׂוּם they will seize them, יִתְפָּשְׂךָ he will seize you, future Kal, 3rd person plural and feminine masculine with suffix, from the root חָפַשׂ. it will be destroyed, future Hophal, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root נָתַן. יִתְצְרֵהוּ [?] they will destroy him, נִי [?] he will destroy me, future Kal, 3rd person plural and feminine masculine with suffix, from the root נָתַן. יִתְקַע it will be sounded, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root תָּקַע. וַיִּתְקָעֵהוּ and he fixed him, יִתְקְעוּ they will fix, וַיִּתְקָעֵם and he fixed them, future Kal, 3rd person singular and plural masculine with suffix, from the root תָּקַע. יִתְקְפוּ he will prevail over him, future Kal, 3rd person singular masculine with suffix, from the root תָּקַף. יִתֵּר he will loosen, וַיִּתֵּר and he loosed, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root נָתַר. יָתֵר excelling, יֶתֶר excellence, יִתְרָה remainder, כְּיִתְרוֹן as profit (for כְּיִתְרוֹן), etc., nouns from the root יָתַר. וַיִּתְרָא and they appeared to them, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root דָּאָה. יִתְרוּ they will explore, future Kal, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root תּוּר. יִתְרֵי the remainder of him, יִתְרִים cords, masculine with suffix and masculine plural, from the noun יֶתֶר, root יָתַר. יִתְרוֹמֵם he will exalt himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person singular masculine, from the root רוֹם. יִתְרוֹעֲעוּ they will sound, future Hithpael, 3rd person plural masculine, from the root רִיעַ. יִתְרַצֶּה he will win goodwill for himself, future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine/masculine, from the root רָצָה. יִתְרָה remainder, Jeremiah 4:8. יִתְרָת the caul of the liver, feminine noun, from the root יֶתֶר. וַיִּתְשֵּׁם and he uprooted them, future Kal, 3rd person feminine/masculine with suffix, from the root נָתַשׁ.

units.tr: כ, א

units.la: כָּאבִיר robustus, pro כָּבִיר, No. f. m. Rad. כָּבַר; vel pro כָּאבִיר ut potentissimus, No. f. m. præf. R. אָבִיר, unde No. אֲבִיר.
units.tr: Kaabir, robust, for kabir, Noun, masc. sing., from the root kabar; or for kaabir, as most powerful, Noun, masc. sing. with prefix, from the root abir, whence the Noun abir.

units.la: כְּאַהֲבָם juxta amare ipsorum, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. אָהַב.
units.tr: Ke'ahavam, as their loving, Infinitive Kal with prefix and suffix, root ahav.

units.la: כֵּאִים attrifi, unde חַל כֵּאִים viribus attriti, No. pl. m. à f. m. כֵּאָה attritus, R. כָּאָה.
units.tr: Ke'im, worn down, whence chal ke'im, worn down in strength, Noun, masc. pl., from the masc. sing. ke'ah, worn down, root ka'ah.

units.la: כְּאָכְלָם juxta comedere eos, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. אָכַל.
units.tr: Ke'akhlam, as to eat them, Infinitive Kal with prefix and suffix, root akhal.

units.la: כְּאֲרִי sicut leo, (quidam putant esse pro כְּאָרוֹ, idque pro כָּרוּ foderunt.)
units.tr: Keari, as a lion (some think it is for ke'aro, and that for karu, they dug).

units.la: כ, ב
units.tr: כ, ב

units.la: כָּבוּ extincti sunt, præt. Kal, & כִּבּוּ exstinxerunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. R. כָּבָה.
units.tr: Kabu, they were extinguished, Perfect Kal; and kibbu, they extinguished, Perfect Piel, 3rd pl., root kabah.

units.la: לְכַבּוֹת ad exstinguen-dum, בְּכַבּוֹחַ in exstinguendo te, Infin. Piel, præf. aff. R. כָּבָה.
units.tr: Lekabot, for extinguishing; bekabotekha, in extinguishing you, Infinitive Piel with prefix and suffix, root kabah.

units.la: כִּבַּס lavit, pro כִּבֵּס, præt. Piel, 3. f. s. m. Rad. כָּבַס.
units.tr: Kibbes, he washed, for kibbes, Perfect Piel, 3rd masc. sing., root kabas.

units.la: כ, ד
units.tr: כ, ד

units.la: כַּד cadus, כַּדָּהּ hydria sua, כַּדֶּךָ tua, כַּדִּים hydriæ, No. f. m. aff. & No. pl. m. R. כַּד.
units.tr: Kad, a pitcher; kaddah, her pitcher; kadekha, your pitcher; kadim, pitchers, Noun, masc. sing. with suffix and Noun, masc. pl., root kad.

units.la: כַּדּוֹר acies militum; No. f. m. R. כָּדַר.
units.tr: Kaddor, a battle line of soldiers; Noun, masc. sing., root kadar.

units.la: כַּדְכֹּד pyropus, lapis pretiosus, No. f. m. gem. 1. Rad. à Rad. כָּדַר.
units.tr: Kadkod, a pyrope, a precious stone, Noun, masc. sing., doubled first radical, from the root kadar.

units.la: כ, ה
units.tr: כ, ה

units.la: בְּכָהּ in sic, h. e. hoc mo-do, partt. Adv. Rad. כָּה, præf.
units.tr: Bekhah, in thus, that is, in this manner, particle, adverb, root kah, with prefix.

units.la: כָּהָה caligando, Infin. Kal, Rad. כָּהָה.
units.tr: Kahah, in dimming, Infinitive Kal, root kahah.

units.la: כֵּהוֹת contractæ, No. pl. fæm. à sing. fæm. כָּהָה;
units.tr: Kehot, dimmed, Noun, fem. pl., from the fem. sing. kehah;

units.la: Rad כָּהָה caligavit
units.tr: Root kahah, he was dim.

units.la: כָּהוֹת caligare, Infin. Pi-el; Rad. כָּהָה.
units.tr: Kahot, to be dim, Infinitive Piel; root kahah.

units.la: כַּהֲמוּת juxta strepete, Inf. Kal, præf. R. הַמָּה
units.tr: Kahamut, as they murmur, Infinitive Kal with prefix, root hamah.

units.la: כַּהִנְרָף juxta impetit, Pf. 68. 3. est comp. ex Infin. Kal, & Niph. præf. vel, est No. sing. m. præf. Rad. נָרַךְ dispulit.
units.tr: Kahinraf, as he attacks, Ps. 68.3, is compounded of the Infinitive Kal and Niphal with prefix; or it is a Noun, masc. sing. with prefix, root narak, he dispersed.

units.la: כַּהֲתָה caligavit, præt. Kal, & פֹּהַתָּה contrahet se, præt. Piel, 3. f. fæm. R. כָּהָה.
units.tr: Kahatah, he grew dim, Perfect Kal; and pohattah, he will contract himself, Perfect Piel, 3rd fem. sing., root kahah.

units.la: כּוֹאֵב dolens, Ben. Kal, f. m. R. כָּאַב.
units.tr: Kho'ev, suffering, Participle Kal, masc. sing., root ka'av.

units.la: כּוּיָה adustio, No. f. fæm. R. כָּוָה.
units.tr: Kiyah, a burn, Noun, fem. sing., root kavah.

units.la: כּוּנִים placentæ, No. pl. m. R. כַּן aptavit.
units.tr: Kunim, cakes, Noun, masc. pl., root kan, he fitted.

units.la: כּוּנָּנָה aptavit, כּוּנַנְתָּ statuisti, כּוּנְנוּ aptarunt, &c. præt. Piel, 3. f. m. & fæm. &c. f. m. ut & 3. pl. R. כּוּן.
units.tr: Kunnanah, he prepared, kunnanta, you established, kunnenu, they prepared, etc., Perfect Piel, 3rd masc. and fem., etc., masc. and also 3rd pl., root kun.

units.la: כּוֹנְנָה parate, כּוֹנְנָן [?] parate.
units.tr: Konenah, prepare her; konenan [?], prepare them.

units.la: confirma illud, Imper. Piel, 2. f. s. m. parag. & aff. R. כּוֹן.
units.tr: Confirm it, Imperative Piel, 2nd masc. sing. with paragogic and suffix, root kon.

units.la: כּוֹנְנוּ parata sunt, præt. Puaf, 3. pl. in pausa; Rad. כּוּן.
units.tr: Konenu, they are prepared, Perfect Pual, 3rd pl. in pause; root kun.

units.la: כְּוִיּוֹת sicut anguli, No. pl. fæm. præf. R. זֶה.
units.tr: Kevyot, like angles, Noun, fem. pl. with prefix, root zeh.

units.la: כִּרְכּוּם pro facultate sua, est f. m. præf. aff. No. Rad. כּוֹחַ.
units.tr: Kekhoham, according to his ability, is masc. sing. with prefix and suffix, Noun, root koach.

units.la: כִּי adustio, quoniam, No. f. m. R. כָּוָה. Item, part. Adv. Rad.
units.tr: Ki, a burn, because, Noun, masc. sing., root kavah. Likewise, particle, adverb, root.

units.la: כִּירוֹת scintillæ, No. pl. m. constr. R. כָּרָהּ.
units.tr: Kiyot, sparks, Noun, masc. pl. construct, root karah.

units.la: כִּירוֹן lancea, hasta; No. f. m. ג No. R. כִּיר perniries [?].
units.tr: Kiyon, a lance, a spear; Noun, masc. sing.; root kir, [?] to pierce.

units.la: לְכִידוֹר ad aciem, No. f. m. præf. R. כָּר.
units.tr: Lekidor, to the battle line, Noun, masc. sing. with prefix, root kar.

units.la: כַּיִן basis, No. f. m, Rad. כּוּן[?].
units.tr: Kayin, a base, Noun, masc. sing., root kun [?].

units.la: כִּיּוֹר[?], הַ־כִּיר[?] labrum, כִּיּוֹרִים[?]
units.tr: Kiyor [?], ha-kir [?], a laver, kiyorim [?]

units.la: כִּיּוֹרוֹת[?] labra, No. f. m. & pl. masc. & fæm. Rad. כִּיר[?].
units.tr: Kiyorot [?], lavers, Noun, fem. sing. and masc. and fem. pl., root kir [?].

units.la: כִּילִי[?] avarus, No. f. m. Rad. כִּיל[?], vel q. כְּלִלִי[?] omnia mea sunt, vel à Rad. כָּלָא[?] inclusit, aut כְּלָה[?] consumi.
units.tr: Kiyli [?], avaricious, Noun, masc. sing., root kiyl [?], or q. kelli, all things are mine, or from the root kala [?], he shut in, or kelah [?], to be consumed.

units.la: כִּילְפּוֹת[?], vel כִּלְפּוֹת[?] mallei, No. pl. fæm. Rad. כֶּלֶף[?].
units.tr: Kilpot [?], or kilpot [?], of mallets, Noun, fem. pl., root kelef [?].

units.la: כִּימָה[?] plejades, No. f. fæm. Rad. כִּים[?].
units.tr: Kimah [?], the Pleiades, Noun, fem. sing., root kim [?].

units.la: כִּימוֹת[?], כִּימֵי[?] sicut dies, No. pl. fæm. & m. præf. à sing. No. Rad. יוֹם[?].
units.tr: Kimot [?], Kimei [?], as days, Noun, fem. and masc. pl. with prefix, from the sing. Noun, root yom [?].

units.la: כִּיקָר[?] ut pretiosum, No. sing. m. יְקָר[?], præf. Rad. יָקַר[?].
units.tr: Kiyakar [?], as precious, Noun, masc. sing., yekar [?] with prefix, root yakar [?].

units.la: כִּירִים[?] testus, No. du. m. R. כִּיר[?].
units.tr: Kiyrim [?], woven, Noun, masc. dual, root kir [?].

units.la: כִּישׁוֹר[?] versiculum, No. f. m. R. כָּשֵׁר[?] rectum esse.
units.tr: Kishor [?], a little verse, Noun, masc. sing., root kasher [?], to be right.

units.la: כ כ
units.tr: כ כ

units.la: כִּכְבֵיהֶם[?] stellæ eorum,
units.tr: Kikhbeihem [?], their stars,

units.la: No. pl. m. aff. à f. No. Rad. כּוֹכָב[?].
units.tr: Noun, masc. pl. with suffix, from the fem. Noun, root kokhav [?].

units.la: כִּכְלוֹת[?] cum deficit, Infin. Kal, præf. R. כָּלָה[?].
units.tr: Kiklot [?], when it fails, Infinitive Kal with prefix, root kalah [?].

units.la: כְּכֵלִי[?] sicut vas, No. f. m. præf. R. כָּלָה[?].
units.tr: Kekheli [?], as a vessel, Noun, masc. sing. with prefix, root kalah [?].

units.la: כ ל
units.tr: כ ל

units.la: כָּל[?] omnis, omne, כֹּל[?] totus ipse, כְּלְךָ[?] tota tu, No. comm. gen. & num. Rad. כָּלַל[?] perfecit.
units.tr: Kol [?], all, every, kol [?], the whole itself, kelkha [?], the whole of you, Noun, common gender and number, root kalal [?], he perfected.

units.la: וְכָלַל[?] & complexus est, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. R. כּוּל[?].
units.tr: Vekhalal [?], and he embraced, Perfect Kal, 3rd masc. sing., root kul [?].

units.la: לְכַלֵּא[?] ad cohibendum, Dan. 9. 24. pro לְכַלָּה[?]. Infin. Piel, R. כָּלָה[?]: vel, à Rad. כָּלָא[?].
units.tr: Lekhalle [?], for restraining, Dan. 9.24, for lekhalah [?]. Infinitive Piel, root kalah [?]; or, from the root kala [?].

units.la: כְּלָא[?] tota, Ezech. 36. 5. pro כָּל[?], כְּלוּל[?] totus ipse, pro כְּלִי[?], No. כָּל[?], aff. R. כָּלַל[?].
units.tr: Khela [?], the whole, Ezek. 36.5, for kol [?]; kelul [?], the whole itself, for keli [?], Noun, kol [?] with suffix, root kalal [?].

units.la: כִּלְאֵי[?] exerceris sui, No. f. m. aff. & כְּלָאִים[?] carceres, pl. masc. à f. m. כְּלָא[?]. ut & כִּלְאַיִם heteroge-nea, No. du. m. R. כָּלָא clausit.
units.tr: Kil'ei [?], of your exercises, Noun, masc. sing. with suffix, and kela'im [?], prisons, masc. pl., from the masc. sing. Noun kela [?]. Likewise kil'ayim, things of different kinds, Noun, masc. dual, root kala, he shut in.

units.la: כָּלְאָתִי cohibui, Pf. 119. 101. pro כָּלְאָתִי, praet. Kal, 1. f. Rad. כָּלָא.
units.tr: Kalati, I restrained, Ps. 119.101, for kalati, Perfect Kal, 1st sing., root kala.

units.la: כַּלָּה sponsa, No. f. fæm. R. כָּלַל perfecit.
units.tr: Kalah, a bride, Noun, fem. sing., root kalal, he perfected.

units.la: כֻּלָּהֶם universi ipsi, 2. Sam. 23. 6. pro כֻּלָּם No. כֹּל aff. Rad. כָּלַל.
units.tr: Kulahem, all of them, 2 Sam. 23.6, for kulam, Noun kol with suffix, root kalal.

units.la: כֻּלָּהֶנָּה omnes ipsi, 1. Reg. 7. 37. pro כֻּלָּנָּה, idque pro כֻּלָּן, No. כל aff. Rad. כָּלַל.
units.tr: Kulahenah, all of them, 1 Kings 7.37, for kulanah, which is for kulan, Noun kal with suffix, root kalal.

units.la: כָּלוּ concluserunt, 1 Sam. 6. 10. pro כָּלְאוּ, praet. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. כָּלָא.
units.tr: Kalu, they shut in, 1 Sam. 6.10, for kal'u, Perfect Kal, 3rd pl., root kala.

units.la: כָּלוּ absoluti sunt, Pf. 72. 20. pro כָּלוּ, praet. Pual, 3. pl. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kalu, they were finished, Ps. 72.20, for kalu, Perfect Pual, 3rd pl., root kalah.

units.la: כָּלוּ consumuntur, praet. Kal, & כִּלּוּ absolve-runt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kalu, they are consumed, Perfect Kal; and killu, they finished, Perfect Piel, 3rd pl., root kalah.

units.la: כַּלּוּ consumite, Imper. Pi-el, pl. m. R. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kallu, consume, Imperative Piel, masc. pl., root kalah.

units.la: כְּלוֹא, & כָּלָא inclusus, Pahul, Kal, f. m. Rad. כָּלָא.
units.tr: Kelo', and kala, shut in, Pahul, Kal, masc. sing., root kala.

units.la: הַכֶּלוֹא carcer, No. f. m. R. כָּלָא.
units.tr: Ha-kelo', the prison, Noun, masc. sing., root kala.

units.la: לִכְלוֹא ad cohibendum, Infin. Kal, Rad. כָּלָא.
units.tr: Likhlo', to restrain, Infinitive Kal, root kala.

units.la: כְּלוּלוֹתֶיךָ sponsalia tua, No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. כָּלַל. Item, כְּלִילַת per-secta, No. f. fæm. constr. à f. m. כָּלִיל perse-ctus, & fæm. כְּלִילָה Rad. כָּלַל.
units.tr: Kelulotekha, your betrothals, Noun, fem. pl. with suffix, root kalal. Likewise, kelilat, perfected, Noun, fem. sing. construct, from the masc. sing. Adjective kalil, perfected, and the fem. kelilah, root kalal.

units.la: כְּלוֹם consumpserunt eos, כְּלוּנִי me, praet. Piel, 3. pl. aff. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kelom, they consumed them; kelunni, me, Perfect Piel, 3rd pl. with suffix, root kalah.

units.la: כְּלוֹתָם ad compleri, לִכְלוֹת consumi eos, &c. Infin. Kal, praef. aff. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Keltom, to be completed, likhlot, they to be consumed, etc., Infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix, root kalah.

units.la: לְכַלּוֹת ad consumendum, וּבְכַלּוֹתָם & juxta absolvere eos, Infin. Piel, praef. & aff. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Lekallot, to consume, uvekhallotam, and as they finish them, Infinitive Piel, with prefix and suffix, root kalah.

units.la: כַּלּוֹתֵיכֶם sponsæ vestræ, No. pl. fæm. aff. à f. fæm. כַּלָּה, Rad. כָּלַל perfecit.
units.tr: Kallotekhem, your brides, Noun, fem. pl. with suffix, from the fem. sing. kallah, root kalal, he perfected.

units.la: כְּלִי vas, כֵּלִים · כְּלֵי vasa, כֵּלִי mea, כֵּלָיו ejus, &c. No. f. m. & pl. m. aff. R. כַּלָּה.
units.tr: Kli, a vessel, kelim, kelei, vessels, keli, my, keliv, his, etc., Noun, fem. and masc. pl. with suffix, root kalah.

units.la: כַּלֵּי tenax, pro כִּלִּי, id vide.
units.tr: Kalli, tenacious, for killi; see that.

units.la: כִּלְיוֹת renes, כִּלְיוֹתַי mei, &c. No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. כָּלָה absolvit.
units.tr: Kilyot, kidneys, kilyotai, my, etc., Noun, fem. pl. with suffix, root kalah, he finished.

units.la: כָּלִינוּ consumimur, כָּלִיתִי deficio, כָּלִיתֶם consumtiestis, præt. Kal, 1. pl. & 1. f ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kalinu, we are consumed, kality, I fail, kalitem, you consumed, Perfect Kal, 1st pl. and 1st sing., and 2nd pl. masc., root kalah.

units.la: כִּלִּיתִם consumpsi eos, כִּלִּיתֶם consumpsisti eos, כִּלִינוּ consumpsimus, כִּלִּיתֶם perfecistis, &c. præt. Piel, 1. f & 2. f m. aff. ut. & 1. pl. & 2. pl. masc. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kilitem, I consumed them, kilitem, you consumed them, kilinu, we consumed, kilitem, you perfected, etc., Perfect Piel, 1st sing. and 2nd sing. masc. with suffix, and 1st pl. and 2nd pl. masc., root kalah.

units.la: כִּלִּיתַנִי coërcuisti me, 1 Sam. 25. 33. pro כְּלָאתַנִי.
units.tr: Kilitani, you restrained me, 1 Sam. 25.33, for kela'tani.

units.la: præt. Kal, 2. f. fæm. aff. R. כָּלְאָה.
units.tr: Perfect Kal, 2nd fem. sing. with suffix, root kela'.

units.la: לְכַלְכֵּל כִּלְכֵּל sustentavit, לְכַלְכֵּל sustentare, כִּלְכֵּלוּ sustentatione instructi sunt, præt. Piel, (gem. 1. Rad.) 3. f. m. & Inf. Piel, ut & 3. pl. præt. Pual, Rad. כּוּל.
units.tr: Lekhalkel, kilkel, he sustained, lekhalkel, to sustain, kilkelu, they were furnished with sustenance, Perfect Piel (doubled first radical), 3rd masc. sing. and Infinitive Piel, likewise 3rd pl. Perfect Pual, root kul.

units.la: כִּלְּנוּ consumpsit eos, כִּלָּנוּ nos, præt Piel, 3. f. m. כִּלָּה absolvit, aff. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kilnu, he consumed them, kilanu, us, Perfect Piel, 3rd masc. sing., kilah, he finished, with suffix, root kalah.

units.la: כֻּלָּם universi ipsi, כֻּלָּנָה omnia illa, &c. No. כֹּל aff. Rad. כָּלַל.
units.tr: Kulam, all of them, kulanah, all those, etc., Noun kol with suffix, root kalal.

units.la: כְּלָתָה absolutum est, præt. Kal, 3. f. fæm. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kelatah, it is finished, Perfect Kal, 3rd fem. sing., root kalah.

units.la: כַּלָּתָה illa consumsit, כַּלָּתוֹ eum, præt. Piel, 3. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Kallatah, she consumed, kallato, him, Perfect Piel, 3rd fem. sing. with suffix, root kalah.

units.tr: Kappayim, "hands"; kappai, "my"; kappav, "his"; kappekha, "thy"; kappeikhem, "your"; kappav, "their", etc. Dual number with suffixes, from the singular kaph, root כָּפַף. Kappayim, "rocks", plural number, from the singular masculine Keifa; and from the root kif, kafar, "he made atonement", for kipper, perfect Piel, third person singular masculine, root כָּפַר.

units.la: כ ר כַּר pascuum, No. sing. m. vel, Rad. vel, à Rad. כָּרַד. כֹּר corus, No. s. m. Rad. כּוּר catinus, fornax. כָּרָה convivium, No. s. fæm. Rad. כָּרָה effodit. כָּרוּ effoderunt, כָּרוּהָ eam, præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. כָּרָה. הַכָּרִי primores, לְכָרִי pri-moribus, pro כָּרִים pl. m. à s. m. כַּר, Rad. כָּרַר. כָּרִים cori, pl. m. à s. m. כַּר, R. כּוּר fornax. כָּרִיתָ perfodisti, כָּרִיתִי fo-di, præt. Kal, 2. & 1. s. Rad. כָּרָה. כְּרִיתָת, vel כְּרִיתָתְ repudium, כְּרִיתָתָהּ repudiaejus, No. s. fæm. & pl. aff. R. כָּרַת scidit. כָּרַם juxta extolli, pro כְּרוֹם Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. רוּם. כָּרַת abscissus fuit, Ezec. 16.4. (Corrath, nam Resch istud in textu est Dageschatum) pro כּוֹרַת, præt. Pual, 3. sing. m. Rad. כָּרַת. כָּרַתְּ exscidisti, כְּרַתִּי pepigi, præt. Kal, 2. & 1. s. Rad. כָּרַת. כָּרֻת fossuræ, No. pl. fæm. R. כָּרָה. כָּרֹת כָּרַת, vel כָּרוֹת pangere, לִכְרוֹת ad pangendum, &c. Infin. Kal, Rad. כָּרַת.
units.tr: Kar, "pasture", singular masculine noun, or, with the root kar, from the root כָּרַד. Kor, "cor" (a measure), singular masculine noun, root כּוּר, "pot, furnace". Karah, "feast", singular feminine noun, root כָּרָה, "he dug". Karu, "they dug", Karuha, "them", perfect Kal, third person plural with suffix, root כָּרָה. Hakkarim, "the nobles", lekharim, "to the nobles", for karim, masculine plural of the masculine singular kar, root כָּרַר. Karim, "cori", masculine plural of the masculine singular kar, root כּוּר, "furnace". Karita, "thou didst dig through", Kariti, "I dug", perfect Kal, second and first person singular, root כָּרָה. Kheritat, or kheritat, "divorce", kheritatah, "her divorce", singular feminine noun and plural with suffix, root כָּרַת, "he cut". Karam, "to be raised up", for kerom, infinitive Kal, prefixed, root רוּם. Karat, "was cut off", Ezek. 16.4 (Corrath, for the Resch in the text is a Dagesh), for kórat, perfect Pual, third person singular masculine, root כָּרַת. Karatta, "thou didst cut off", kerati, "I covenanted", perfect Kal, second and first person singular, root כָּרַת. Karut, "trenches", feminine plural noun, root כָּרָה. Karot, or karot, "to cover", lekhrot, "for covering", etc., infinitive Kal, root כָּרַת.
