units.la: לְאָרִיב ad cruciandum, 1 Sam. 2. 33. pro לְהַאֲרִיב, Infin. Hiph. Rad. ארב: vel per transp. Lit. pro לְהַרְאִיב, Infin. Hiph. à Rad. רָאַב doluit.
units.tr: לְאָרִיב to afflict, 1 Sam. 2.33, for לְהַאֲרִיב, Infinitive Hiphil. Root ארב: or by transposition of letters, for לְהַרְאִיב, Infinitive Hiphil, from the root רָאַב grieved.

units.la: לַאְמִים clam, senfim, pro בְּלָט, No. f. m. לט, præf. Rad. לוט abscondit.
units.tr: לַאְמִים secretly, stealthily, for בְּלָט, noun, m. לט, prefix. Root לוט hid.

units.la: לְאֹם natio, מְּאֹם pro natione, לְאֻמִּים nationes, nes, לָהֶם eorum, No. f. m. præf. & pl. masc. & fæm. aff. idem quod, & pro, אוֹם, אֻמִּים, אֻמּוֹת, אֹם, &c. Rad. אָמַם.
units.tr: לְאֹם nation; מְּאֹם from a nation; לְאֻמִּים nations; לָהֶם to them; noun, m., prefix, and masc. and fem. plural suffix; the same as, and for, אוֹם, אֻמִּים, אֻמּוֹת, אֹם, etc. Root אָמַם.

units.la: dicendo, pro לֵאמֹר, Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. אָמַר.
units.tr: saying, for לֵאמֹר, Infinitive Kal, prefix. Root אָמַר.

units.la: ad ligandum te, Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. אָסַר.
units.tr: to bind you, Infinitive Kal, prefix and suffix. Root אָסַר.

units.la: לב
units.tr: לב

units.la: לֵב, vel, לֵבּ, לִבָּה, לִבּוֹ cor, ejus, &c. No. f. m. aff. à No. Rad. לָבַב cor.
units.tr: לֵב, or לֵבּ, לִבָּה, לִבּוֹ heart, his, etc. Noun, m., with suffixes, from the noun Root לָבַב heart.

units.la: לְבָאִים leones, pro לְבָאִים, pl. m. à f. m לָבִיא leo immanis, Rad. לָבָא.
units.tr: לְבָאִים lions, for לְבָאִים, pl. m., from the f. m. noun לָבִיא fierce lion, Root לָבָא.

units.la: לִבְאֹתַי leænis suis, No. pl. fæm. præf. & aff. Rad. לָבָא.
units.tr: לִבְאֹתַי my lionesses, noun, pl. fem., prefix and suffix. Root לָבָא.

units.la: לִבְבוֹת corda, No. pl. fæm. à No. Rad. לֵבָב.
units.tr: לִבְבוֹת hearts, noun, pl. fem., from the noun Root לֵבָב.

units.la: לִבַּבְתִּנִי cor meum rapuisti, pro לִבַּבְתִּנִי, præt. Pi-el, (continued)
units.tr: לִבַּבְתִּנִי you have ravished my heart, for לִבַּבְתִּנִי, Perfect Piel, (continued)

units.la: el, 2. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. לָבַב.
units.tr: el, 2nd sing. fem., suffix. Root לָבַב.

units.la: לַבַּר, & לְבַד seorsum, part. Adv. R. לְבַד solitarius fuit.
units.tr: לַבַּר, and לְבַד apart, participle, adverb. Root לְבַד was alone.

units.la: לְבוֹר ad declarandum, Ec-cl.9.1. Infin. Kal, præf. pro לָבוֹר, Rad. בָּרַר.
units.tr: לְבוֹר to make clear, Eccl. 9.1, Infinitive Kal, prefix, for לָבוֹר, Root בָּרַר.

units.la: לְבּוֹת corda, לָהֶם cor eorum, לָהֶן earum, &c. No. pl. fæm. & sing. masc. aff. à לֵב, ex לֵבָב.
units.tr: לְבּוֹת hearts; לָהֶם their heart; לָהֶן their, etc. Noun, pl. fem., and sing. masc., suffixes, from לֵב, from לֵבָב.

units.la: לִבְיָא afferre, Jer. 39.7. pro לְהָבִיא, Inf. Hiph. præf. Rad. בּוֹא venit.
units.tr: לִבְיָא to bring, Jer. 39.7, for לְהָבִיא, Infinitive Hiphil, prefix. Root בּוֹא came.

units.la: לָבִיא leo immanis, לְבִיָּא leæna, No. f. masc. & fæm. à Rad. לָבָא.
units.tr: לָבִיא fierce lion; לְבִיָּא lioness; noun, m. and f., from Root לָבָא.

units.la: לְבָלוֹת terendo, Infin. Pi-el, præf. R. בָּלַה.
units.tr: לְבָלוֹת by wearing down, Infinitive Piel, prefix. Root בָּלַה.

units.la: לִבְנָה populus arbor, לִבְנוֹן libanus mons, &c. No. sing. m. Rad. לָבַן albuit.
units.tr: לִבְנָה poplar tree; לִבְנוֹן Mount Lebanon, etc. Noun, sing. m. Root לָבַן was white.

units.la: לִבְנַת pavimentatio, est sing. constr. à No. sing. fæm. לִבְנָה later, Rad. לָבַן.
units.tr: לִבְנַת pavement, is the singular construct of the noun sing. fem. לִבְנָה brick, Root לָבַן.

units.la: לְבָרְכָם ad declarandum i-sta, sta, Inf. Kal, præf. aff. R. בָּרָא.
units.tr: לְבָרְכָם to declare these, Infinitive Kal, prefix and suffix. Root בָּרָא.

units.la: בְּלֵב in corde, sing. constr. q. à No sing. fœm. לִבָּה, & à s. m. לֵב, à No. Rad. לִבַּב; vel est contr. pro כִּלְּהָבָה, vel בִּלְהָבָה in flamma, sing. fœm. constr. à לַהֵבָה flamma, & No. Rad. s. m. לַהַב flamma.
units.tr: בְּלֵב in the heart, singular construct, from the noun sing. fem. לִבָּה, and from the sing. m. לֵב, from the noun Root לִבַּב; or it is a contraction for כִּלְּהָבָה, or בִּלְהָבָה in flame, singular fem. construct, from לַהֵבָה flame, and the noun Root, sing. m. לַהַב flame.

units.la: לִבְּךָ cor tuum, sing. constr. aff. à No. s.fœm. לִבָּה, à s. m. לֵב, & No. Rad. לִבַּב cor.
units.tr: לִבְּךָ your heart, singular construct with suffix, from the noun sing. fem. לִבָּה, from the sing. m. לֵב, and the noun Root לִבַּב heart.

units.la: לג
units.tr: לג

units.la: לֹג logus, mensura, מִלֹּג de logo, No. s m. præf. à No. Rad. לוֹג.
units.tr: לֹג log, measure; מִלֹּג from a log; noun, sing. m., prefix, from the noun Root לוֹג.

units.la: לד
units.tr: לד

units.la: לְדָה partus לְלֵדָה ad partum, מִלֵּדָה à partu, No. s. fœm. præf. vel pro לָדַת parere, Infin. Kal, Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: לְדָה childbirth; לְלֵדָה to childbirth; מִלֵּדָה from childbirth; noun, sing. fem., prefix; or for לָדַת to bear, Infinitive Kal, Root יָלַד.

units.la: לָדִין ad judicandum, pro לָדִין Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. דון.
units.tr: לָדִין to judge, for לָדִין, Infinitive Hiphil, prefix. Root דון.

units.la: לה
units.tr: לה

units.la: לָדַת parere, לְלֶדֶת ad pariendum, מְלֶדֶת à pariendo, לְדָתָהּ parere eam, בְּלְדָתָהּ in parere eam, לְלֵדְתִּי me, לְדָתָנָה eas, Inf. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: לָדַת to bear; לְלֶדֶת to bring forth; מְלֶדֶת from bearing; לְדָתָהּ to bear her; בְּלְדָתָהּ in bearing her; לְלֵדְתִּי to bear me; לְדָתָנָה to bear them; Infinitive Kal, prefix and suffix. Root יָלַד.

units.la: לה
units.tr: לה

units.la: לְהָרֵק ad comminuendum, 2. Chron. 34. 7. pro לְהָרֵק, Inf. Hiph. præf. Rad. דָּקַק.
units.tr: לְהָרֵק to crush small, 2 Chron. 34.7, for לְהָרֵק, Infinitive Hiphil, prefix. Root דָּקַק.

units.la: בְּלְטֵיהֶם incantationibus suis, pro בִּלְטֵיהֶם, No. pl. m. constr. præf. aff: à No. s. m. לָט absconsio, & à Rad. לוּט abscondit.
units.tr: בְּלְטֵיהֶם with their incantations, for בִּלְטֵיהֶם, noun, pl. m. construct, prefix and suffix, from the noun sing. m. לָט concealment, and from the Root לוּט hid.

units.la: לְהַכִּיל ad capiendum, Infin. Hiph. præf. R: כּוּל.
units.tr: לְהַכִּיל to contain, Infinitive Hiphil, prefix. Root כּוּל.

units.la: לְהַכִּיל ad consumendum, Ezech. 21. 28. pro לְהַאֲכִיל, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. אָכַל.
units.tr: לְהַכִּיל to consume, Ezek. 21.28, for לְהַאֲכִיל, Infinitive Hiphil, prefix. Root אָכַל.

units.la: לְהַמִּיתוֹ ad occidendum eum, eum, Infin.Hiph. praef. aff. Rad. מוּת.
units.tr: לְהַמִּיתוֹ to kill him, Infinitive Hiphil, prefix and suffix. Root מוּת.

units.la: לְהַמִּיתוֹ ad strepitum ejus, No. f. fæm. הֲמִית, praef. aff. Rad. הָמָה strepuit.
units.tr: לְהַמִּיתוֹ at its noise, noun, f. fem. הֲמִית, prefix and suffix. Root הָמָה made a noise.

units.la: לְהַקָּהַת congregatio, f. fæm. constr. No. לְהַקַּת, Rad. לחק.
units.tr: לְהַקָּהַת assembly, noun, f. fem. construct, from לְהַקַּת, Root לחק.

units.la: לְהָרַע ad malefaciendum, ad malum, Infin. Hiph. vel No. f. m. רַע, praef. Rad. רוּעַ malum esse, vel, No. f. m. רֵעַ socius, praef. Rad. רָעָה pascere.
units.tr: לְהָרַע to do evil, to evil, Infinitive Hiphil, or noun, f. m. רַע, prefix, Root רוּעַ was evil; or noun, f. m. רֵעַ companion, prefix, Root רָעָה pastured.

units.la: לְהַשּׁוֹת ad vastandum, 2 Reg.19.25. pro לְהַשָּׁאוֹת Inf. Hiph. praef. Rad. שָׁאָה.
units.tr: לְהַשּׁוֹת to lay waste, 2 Kings 19.25, for לְהַשָּׁאוֹת, Infinitive Hiphil, prefix. Root שָׁאָה.

units.la: לְהַשְׁמִיד ad perdi eos, Infin. Niph. praef. aff. R. שָׁמַד.
units.tr: לְהַשְׁמִיד to destroy them, Infinitive Niphal, prefix and suffix. Root שָׁמַד.

units.la: לְהִשְׁתַּבַּח ad gloriandum, Infin. Hithp. praef. Rad. שָׁבַח.
units.tr: לְהִשְׁתַּבַּח to glory, Infinitive Hithpael, prefix. Root שָׁבַח.

units.la: לְהִתְנוֹסֵס ad vexillandum, Infin. Hithp. praef. Rad. נָסַס.
units.tr: לְהִתְנוֹסֵס to display a banner, Infinitive Hithpael, prefix. Root נָסַס.

units.la: לו
units.tr: Lamed-Vav (לו)

units.la: לוֹ ipsi, comp. ex לְ, praef. & ו, aff. sed interdum ponitur pro לֹא non.
units.tr: לוֹ to him: compounded of לְ (prefix) and ו (suffix); but sometimes it is put for לֹא not.

units.la: לוּ utinam, Part. Adv. item, לוּא non, pro לֹא, & לוּא, pro לוּ.
units.tr: לוּ would that: particle adverb. Likewise לוּא not, for לֹא; and לוּא for לוּ.

units.la: לָוֶה mutuo accipiens, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. R. לָוָה.
units.tr: לָוֶה borrowing, taking on loan: participle, Kal, masculine singular, from the root לָוָה.

units.la: לוֹט opertus, Jef.25.7. pro לוּט, unde לוּטָה involuta, Part. Pahul, Kal, sing. masc. & fæm. Rad. לוּט abscondit.
units.tr: לוֹט covered, Isa. 25.7, for לוּט, whence לוּטָה wrapped up: participle Pahul (Kal), singular masculine and feminine, from the root לוּט he hid.

units.la: לֵוִי levi, levita, לְוִיִּם levite, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. לָוָה mutuo accepit.
units.tr: לֵוִי Levi; a Levite; לְוִיִּם Levites: noun, masculine singular and plural, from the root לָוָה he borrowed.

units.la: לָוִינוּ mutuamur, praet. Kal, 1. pl. R. לָוָה.
units.tr: לָוִינוּ we borrow: perfect, Kal, first person plural, from the root לָוָה.

units.la: לְוִית adjunctio, sing. fæm. constr. No. לְוָה; Rad. לָוָה.
units.tr: לְוִית a joining: noun, feminine singular construct, from לָוָה; root לָוָה.

units.la: לִוְיָתָן balæna, leviathan, No. f. m. Rad. לָוָה.
units.tr: לִוְיָתָן whale, leviathan: noun, masculine, from the root לָוָה.

units.la: לוּלָא nisi, Part. Adv. vel conj. Rad.
units.tr: לוּלָא unless: particle, adverb or conjunction. Root unknown.

units.la: לוּאוֹת laqueoli, ligulæ, No. pl. fæm. à No. f. m.
units.tr: לוּאוֹת little loops, small cords: noun, feminine plural, from the masculine noun.

units.la: Rad. לוּל cochlea.
units.tr: Root לוּל snail shell.

units.la: בְּלוּעֲךָ in fauces tuas, No. f. m. לוּעַ, præf. aff. Rad. לוּעַ absorberi.
units.tr: בְּלוּעֲךָ into your throat: noun, masculine, with prefix and suffix; root לוּעַ to be swallowed up.

units.la: לז
units.tr: Lamed-Zayin (לז)

units.la: לוּת pravitas, No. f. fæm. Rad. לוּ decessit, sed forma, à Rad. לָזָה.
units.tr: לוּת perversity: noun, feminine, from the root לוּ he departed, but of the form from the root לָזָה.

units.la: לח
units.tr: Lamed-Chet (לח)

units.la: לַח, לַח virens, recens, לָחִים recentes, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. לָחַח.
units.tr: לַח, לַח green, fresh; לָחִים fresh ones: noun/adjective, masculine singular and plural, from the root לָחַח.

units.la: לַח viror, לֹחוֹ ejus, Deut. 34. 7. (pro לֹחוֹ,) No. f. m. aff. R. לָחַח.
units.tr: לַח greenness; לֹחוֹ its, Deut. 34.7 (for לֹחוֹ): noun, masculine, with suffix; root לָחַח.

units.la: לָחוּל ad saltandum, Jud. 21.21. pro לָחוּל, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. הָלַל.
units.tr: לָחוּל for dancing, Judg. 21.21, for לָחוּל: infinitive Kal, with prefix; root הָלַל.

units.la: בְּלָחוּמוֹ in cibo ejus, No. sing. m. præf. aff. Rad. לָחַם vesci.
units.tr: בְּלָחוּמוֹ in his food: noun, masculine singular, with prefix and suffix; root לָחַם to eat.

units.la: לַחֲזוֹת ad videndum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. חָזָה.
units.tr: לַחֲזוֹת for seeing: infinitive Kal, with prefix; root חָזָה.

units.la: לַחֲטִיא ad faciendum pec-care, Eccl. 5. 5. pro לַהֲחֲטִיא, Infin. Hiph.
units.tr: לַחֲטִיא for causing to sin, Eccl. 5.5, for לַהֲחֲטִיא: infinitive Hiphil, with prefix; root חָטָא.

units.la: præf. Rad. חָטָא.
units.tr: with prefix; root חָטָא.

units.la: לְחִי, לְחִי maxilla, לְחִיוּ e-jus, לְחַיִם, לְחַיֵּי ambæ maxillæ, לְחִי meæ, לְחַיִךְ, לְחַיֵּךְ tuæ, לְחָיו ejus, לְחֵיהֶם eorum, (ult. q. à f. לַיִּ,) No. Rad. sing. fæm. aff. & du. aff. Rad. לְחָהּ.
units.tr: לְחִי, לְחִי cheek, jaw; לְחִיוּ his; לְחַיִם, לְחַיֵּי both cheeks; לְחִי my; לְחַיִךְ, לְחַיֵּךְ your; לְחָיו his; לְחֵיהֶם their (the last from the feminine noun לַיִּ): noun, singular feminine, with suffixes, and dual with suffixes; root לְחָהּ.

units.la: כְּ־לְחַךְ juxta lambere, Infin. Kal, præf. & לְחֻכָה delinxit, præt. Piel, 3. f. fæm. R. לָחַךְ.
units.tr: כְּ־לְחַךְ to lick up: infinitive Kal, with prefix; and לְחֻכָה he licked, perfect Piel, third person feminine singular; root לָחַךְ.

units.la: לְחַלֵּק ad dividendum se, Jer. 37.12. pro לְהַחֲלִיק, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. חָלַק.
units.tr: לְחַלֵּק to divide himself, Jer. 37.12, for לְהַחֲלִיק: infinitive Hiphil, with prefix; root חָלַק.

units.la: לְחַנָּה gratiam faciendi ei, Ps. 102.14. Infin. Piel, præf. aff. (pro לְחַנֵּהוּ,) Rad. חָנַן.
units.tr: לְחַנָּה to show favour to him, Ps. 102.14: infinitive Piel, with prefix and suffix (for לְחַנֵּהוּ); root חָנַן.

units.la: לְהַחְתָּם ad obsignan-dum, Inf. Kal, irreg. vel finiendum, cum ח loco ה, pro הֶחָתֵם, Inf. Hiph. præf. R. תָּמַם.
units.tr: לְהַחְתָּם for sealing: infinitive Kal, irregular; or for finishing, with ח in place of ה, for הֶחָתֵם, infinitive Hiphil, with prefix; root תָּמַם.

units.la: לט
units.tr: Lamed-Tet (לט)

units.la: absconsio, לָט clàm, בְּלָט, לָטִים incantationes, בְּלָטֵיהֶם incantationi-bus suis, No. f.m. præf. & No. pl. m. præf. & aff. Rad. לוּט abscondit. לַטָּעַת ad plantandum, Inf. Kal, præf. R. נָטַע.
units.tr: concealment; לָט secretly; בְּלָט, לָטִים incantations; בְּלָטֵיהֶם with their incantations: noun, masculine singular with prefix, and noun, masculine plural with prefix and suffix; root לוּט he hid. לַטָּעַת for planting: infinitive Kal, with prefix; root נָטַע.

units.la: ל
units.tr: Lamed (ל)

units.la: לִי mihi, comp. ex ל, præf. & ', aff. לִיּוֹת adjectiones, No. pl. fæm. R. לָוָה mutuo accepit. כְּלַיְלָה sicut nox, לַיְלָה nox, לֵילוֹת noctes, &c. sing. m. constr. præf. & parag. ut & No. pl. fæm. à f. m. No. Rad. לַיִל. לִילִית strix, No. sing. fæm. à f.m. No. Rad. לַיִל nox. לִין, לִינִי pernocta, לִינוּ pernoctate, pro הַלִּין, &c. Imper. Hiph. f. masc. & fæm. & pl. m. Rad. לוּן fundare, 2 Chron. 31. 7. pro יְסוֹד, vel לִיסוֹד, Inf. Kal, יְסוֹד, præf. Rad. יָסַר. לִירוֹת ad jaculandum, à יָרוֹת, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. יָרָה.
units.tr: לִי to me: compounded of ל (prefix) and י (suffix). לִיּוֹת additions: noun, feminine plural; root לָוָה he borrowed. כְּלַיְלָה like the night; לַיְלָה night; לֵילוֹת nights, etc.: masculine singular construct, with prefix and paragogic ending, and feminine plural noun from the masculine noun; root לַיִל. לִילִית screech-owl: noun, feminine singular, from the masculine noun root לַיִל night. לִין, לִינִי lodge overnight; לִינוּ lodge overnight (plural), for הַלִּין, etc.: imperative Hiphil, masculine and feminine singular and masculine plural; root לוּן to lodge. 2 Chron. 31.7: לוּן to found, for יְסוֹד, or לִיסוֹד, infinitive Kal, יְסוֹד, with prefix; root יָסַר. לִירוֹת for shooting, from יָרוֹת, infinitive Kal, with prefix; root יָרָה.

units.la: לכ
units.tr: Lamed-Kaf (לכ)

units.la: לְךָ, לָךְ, & parag. לְכָה tibi, comp. ex ל, præf. ex ךָ & ךְ aff. לָךְ, & לְךָ, & parag. לְכָה ito, age, vel pro eo, absque ה, לֵךְ, Imper. Kal, 2. f.m. R. יָלַךְ. לְכִנָה ite, לְכִי, לְכִי ito, לְכֶנָה, & לְכֶן itote, Imper. Kal, pl. m. & f. & pl. fæm. cum, & sine ה; Rad. יָלַךְ. לָכֶם vobis, m. לָכֶן vobis, f. comp. ex ל, præf. & כֶם, & כֶן aff. m. & fæm.
units.tr: לְךָ, לָךְ, and paragogic לְכָה to you: compounded of ל (prefix) with ךָ or ךְ (suffix). לָךְ, and לְךָ, and paragogic לְכָה go, come on, or for it without ה, לֵךְ: imperative Kal, second person masculine singular; root יָלַךְ. לְכִנָה go, לְכִי, לְכִי go, לְכֶנָה, and לְכֶן go (plural): imperative Kal, masculine and feminine plural, with and without ה; root יָלַךְ. לָכֶם to you, masculine; לָכֶן to you, feminine: compounded of ל (prefix) with כֶם and כֶן (suffix), masculine and feminine.

units.la: לָכֵן propterea, part. Conj. causalis, comp. ex ל,
units.tr: לָכֵן therefore: particle, causal conjunction, compounded of ל

units.la: præf. & בן, ex Rad. כון.
units.tr: (prefix) and בן, from the root כון.

units.la: לָכַת, לָכֶת ire, לְכָהָךְ ire te, בִּלְכַתָּם in ire eos, בְּלֶכְתָּן eas, &c. Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. יָלַךְ.
units.tr: לָכַת, לָכֶת to go; לְכָהָךְ to go yourself; בִּלְכַתָּם in their going; בְּלֶכְתָּן in their going (feminine), etc.: infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix; root יָלַךְ.

units.la: ל ל
units.tr: Lamed-Lamed (ל ל)

units.la: לַלָּאות, לְלָאוֹת laqueoli, No. pl. fæm. abs. & constr. à f m. No. Rad. לוֹל cochlea.
units.tr: לַלָּאות, לְלָאוֹת little loops: noun, feminine plural, absolute and construct, from the masculine noun; root לוֹל snail shell.

units.la: לְלַבֵּן ad dealbandum, Dan. 11.35. (pro לְהַלְבֵּן,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. לָבַן.
units.tr: לְלַבֵּן to whiten, Dan. 11.35, for לְהַלְבֵּן: infinitive Hiphil, with prefix; root לָבַן.

units.la: לָלִין ad pernoctandum, (pro לְהָלִין,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. לוּן.
units.tr: לָלִין to lodge overnight, for לְהָלִין: infinitive Hiphil, with prefix; root לוּן.

units.la: לָלֶדֶת ad pariendum, 1.Sam. 4.19 (pro לְלֶדֶת,) Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: לָלֶדֶת to bear, 1 Sam. 4.19, for לְלֶדֶת: infinitive Kal, with prefix; root יָלַד.

units.la: ל מ
units.tr: L M

units.la: לָמָּה, & לְמָּה, vel לָמָה quare? comp. ex מָה, præf. & No. interrog. מָה.
units.tr: lamma, and lemma, or lama: why? Compounded from ma, the prefix l, and the interrogative particle ma.

units.la: לָמוֹ illis, comp. ex ל, præf.
units.tr: lamo: to them. Compounded of the prefix l.

units.la: & מוֹ aff. Poët. pro םָ, &c.
units.tr: and mo: a suffix, poetic, for the form -am, etc.

units.la: לְמוֹתֵת ad morte afficiendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. מוּת.
units.tr: lemotet: to put to death. Infinitive Piel, with prefix l. Root mut.

units.la: לְמָחוֹת ad delendum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. מָחָה.
units.tr: lemachot: to blot out. Infinitive Kal, with prefix l. Root machah.

units.la: לְמָחוֹת ad delendum, Prov. 31.3. (pro לְהַמָּחוֹת,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. מָחָה.
units.tr: lemachot: to blot out, Prov. 31.3 (for lehammachot). Infinitive Hiph., with prefix l. Root machah.

units.la: לְמִלִּין verbis, præf. cum No. pl. R. מָלַל locutus est.
units.tr: lemillin: with words, with prefix l and the plural noun. Root malal, he spoke.

units.la: לְמְלָכְתּ operi, Jer.7.18. cum defectu א, pro לִמְלָאכְתּ, R. לָאךְ.
units.tr: lemelachet: to the work, Jer. 7.18, with the aleph omitted, for limlachet. Root la'k.

units.la: לְמְנוֹת ad numerandum, Infin. Kal, R. מָנָה.
units.tr: lemenot: to number. Infinitive Kal. Root manah.

units.la: לְמְנַצֵּחַ præcentori, (pro לְהַמְנַצֵּחַ,) Part. Piel, f. m. præf. Rad. נָצַח vicit.
units.tr: lemenatseach: to the chief musician (for lehamnatseach). Participle Piel, masculine singular, with prefix. Root natsach, he prevailed.

units.la: לְמַעַן propter, ut, Part. cauf. præf. R. מַעַן.
units.tr: lema'an: for, that, in order that. Causal participle with prefix. Root ma'an.

units.la: לְמְרוֹת ad exacerbandum, Jef. 3.8. (pro לְהַמְרוֹת,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. מָרָה.
units.tr: lemarot: to provoke, Isa. 3.8 (for lehamarot). Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root marah.

units.la: לנ
units.tr: L N

units.la: לָן pernoctavit, præt. Kal, 3. s. m. R. לוּן.
units.tr: lan: he lodged overnight. Preterite Kal, third person singular masculine. Root lun.

units.la: לָן eis, comp. ex ל, præf. & ן, aff.
units.tr: lan: to them. Compounded of the prefix l and the suffix n.

units.la: לֶאֱמָנִים fidelibus, facundis, Part. Niph. pl. masc. præf. Rad. אָמַן nutrivit, & No. pl. m. præf. Rad. נָאַם dixit,
units.tr: le'emanim: to the faithful, to the eloquent. Participle Niph., masculine plural, with prefix. Root aman, he nourished; and the masculine plural noun with prefix. Root na'am, he said.

units.tr: lanah: dwelling, Zech. 5.4 (for lenah). Preterite Kal, third person singular feminine. Root lun.

units.la: לָנוּ nobis, comp. ex ל, præf. & נוּ, aff.
units.tr: lanu: to us. Compounded of the prefix l and the suffix nu.

units.la: לָנוּ pernoctârunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. לוּן.
units.tr: lanu: they lodged overnight. Preterite Kal, third person plural. Root lun.

units.la: לָנוּ pernoctemus, Jud. 19. 13. præt. Kal, (per syne. [?] pro לָנוּ,) 1. pl. Rad. לוּן.
units.tr: lanu: let us lodge overnight, Judg. 19.13. Preterite Kal, (by syncope [?] for lanu), first person plural. Root lun.

units.la: לָנוּחָם ad ducendum eos, Exod. 13. 21. pro לְהַנְחוֹתָם, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. נָחָה.
units.tr: lenuchamm: to lead them, Exod. 13.21, for lehanchotam. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root nachah.

units.la: לְנוּטָם ad declinandum
units.tr: lenutam: to turn aside

units.la: eos, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. נָטָה.
units.tr: them. Infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root natah.

units.la: לָנִים pernoctantes, No. pl. m. à sing. masc. לָן; Rad. לוּן.
units.tr: lanim: lodging, masculine plural noun from the singular masculine lan. Root lun.

units.tr: linpol: to cast down, Num. 5.22 (for lehampil). Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root naphal.

units.tr: L S

units.tr: lesapotah: to consume it. Infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root sapah.

units.la: לְסַתֵּר, vel לַסְתִּיר abscondere, Jef. 59. 15. (pro לְהַסְתֵּר vel לְהַסְתִּיר,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. סָתַר.
units.tr: lesater, or laster: to hide, Isa. 59.15 (for lehaster or lehastir). Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root satar.

units.tr: L '

units.tr: le'avir: to cause to pass over, 2 Sam. 19.18 (for lehaavir). Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root avar.

units.la: לָעוּ deglutiuntur, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. לוּן.
units.tr: la'u: they are swallowed up. Preterite Kal, third person plural. Root lun.

units.la: לָעוּת opportune loqui, Jef. 50.4. 50.4. pro לַעֹת, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. עתה. לָעֵד ad excitandum, Mich.6.9.(pro לְהָעִיר,) Infin.Hiph. præf. Rad. עור. לַעֲלוֹת ascendere, Infin. Kal, præf.R. עָלָה. לַעֲנָה absinthium; No. Rad. f. fæm. R. לַעַן. לַעָנוֹת humiliari, Exod. 10.3. pro לְהַעָנוֹת, Infin. Niph. præf. Rad. עָנָה. לַעֲנוֹת ad affligendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. עָנָה לַעֲשׂוֹת ad faciendum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. עָשָׂה לַעֲשֵׂר decimare, Deut.26.12. pro לְהַעֲשֵׂר, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. עָשַׂר.
units.tr: la'ut: to speak opportunely, Isa. 50.4, 50.4 (for la'ot). Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root 'atah. la'ed: to stir up, Mic. 6.9 (for lehe'ir). Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root 'ur. la'alot: to ascend. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root 'alah. la'anah: wormwood; noun, feminine. Root la'an. la'anot: to be humbled, Exod. 10.3 (for lehe'anot). Infinitive Niph. with prefix. Root 'anah. la'anot: to afflict. Infinitive Piel, with prefix. Root 'anah. la'asot: to do. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root 'asah. la'aser: to tithe, Deut. 26.12 (for lehaaser). Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root 'asar.

units.la: ל פ לַפַּחַת ad sufflandum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. נָפַח. לִפְנֵי ori, secundum, comp. ex ל, præf. & פְּנֵי, à No. Rad. פָּה. לְפִיד faces, No. pl. m. constr. à f. m. לַפִּיד; Rad. לפר. לִפְנוֹת ad aspiciendum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. פָּנָה:
units.tr: L P: lappachat: to blow. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root napach. lifne: before the face, in front of; compounded of the prefix l and the noun pne, from the root pah. lappid: torches, masculine plural noun construct from the masculine lappid; root lpr. lifnot: to look, Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root panah.

units.la: ל צ לִין derisor, לְצִים derisores, No. f. & pl. m. R. לוּן illudere. לְצַבּוֹת ad tumidum reddendum, Num. 5.22. (pro לְהַצְבּוֹת,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. צָבָה. לָצוֹן derisio, No. f. m. Rad. לוּן. לְצַצִּים derisores, No. pl. m. à f. לוֹצָן; Rad. לוּן illudere. לְצִתָּ derisisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. לוּן.
units.tr: L TS: litsin: a scoffer; letsim: scoffers, feminine and masculine plural noun. Root lun, to mock. letsabbot: to make swollen, Num. 5.22 (for lehatsbot). Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root tsabah. lotsan: mockery, masculine noun. Root lun. letsatsim: scoffers, masculine plural noun from feminine lotsan; root lun, to mock. letsit: you mocked, preterite Kal, second person feminine singular. Root lun.

units.tr: L Q: laqechah: taken, for lqchah, preterite Pual, third person singular feminine. Root laqach. liqchat: to take, Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root laqach [?]

units.la: Infin. Kal, קָחָה, præf. Rad. לָקַח [?]
units.tr: liqchat: to take, Infinitive Kal, qachah, with prefix. Root laqach [?]

units.la: לָקַחְתָּ accepisti, pro לָקַחְתָּ praet. Kal, 2. f. fæm. Rad. לָקַח
units.tr: laqachta: you took, for laqachta, preterite Kal, second person feminine singular. Root laqach.

units.la: לִקְרַאת in occursum, לִקְרַאתוֹ ipsi, לִקְרַאתְכֶם vestri, No. f. f. קְרִיאָה occursus, præf. & aff. cum א, pro ה, nam Rad. est קָרָה obvenit.
units.tr: liqrat: to meet, liqratho: to him, liqratkem: to you, masculine noun qeri'ah: meeting, with prefix and suffix, with aleph for he, for the root is qarah, he happened.

units.tr: L R

units.la: לִרְאוֹת timere, 1. Sam. 18. 29. pro יִרְאָה, vel לִירְאֹה Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. יָרֵא.
units.tr: lir'ot: to fear, 1 Sam. 18.29, for yir'ah, or lirho. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root yare.

units.la: לִרְאוֹת ad videndum, Ezec. 28. 17. Inf. Kal, præf. pro לִרְאוֹת, Rad. רָאָה.
units.tr: lir'ot: to see, Ezek. 28.17. Infinitive Kal, with prefix, for lir'ot. Root ra'ah.

units.la: לִרְאוֹת ad comparendum, Exod. 34. 24. pro לְהֵרָאוֹת, Infin. Niph. præf. Rad. רָאָה.
units.tr: lir'ot: to appear, Exod. 34.24, for lehera'ot. Infinitive Niph. with prefix. Root ra'ah.

units.la: לִרְאוֹת ad ostendendum, pro לְהַרְאוֹת, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. רָאָה.
units.tr: lir'ot: to show, for lehar'ot. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root ra'ah.

units.la: לִרְאוֹתָם videre eos, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. רָאָה.
units.tr: lir'otam: to see them. Infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root ra'ah.

units.la: לִרְבַּ multiplicari, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. רָבַב.
units.tr: lirbav: to be multiplied. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root rabav.

units.la: לִירוֹת ad jaculandum, pro יְרוֹת, Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. יָרָה.
units.tr: lirot: to shoot, for yerot. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root yarah.

units.la: לָרִיב ad litigandum, Job. 9. 3. pro לְהָרִיב, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. רוּב.
units.tr: lariv: to contend, Job 9.3, for lehariv. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root rub.

units.la: לִרְעוֹת ad pascendum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. רָעָה.
units.tr: lir'ot: to feed. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root ra'ah.

units.la: לִרְצוֹת benevolus esse, Infin. Kal, præf. R. רָצָה.
units.tr: lirtsot: to be favourable. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root ratsah.

units.la: לִרְשַׁת ad possidendum, לִרְשָׁתוֹ eum, &c. Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: lirshat: to possess, lirshato: him, etc. Infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root yarash.

units.tr: L SH

units.tr: lishbit: to cause to cease, Amos 8.4, for lehashbit. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root shabat.

units.tr: leshonam: their tongue, feminine masculine noun lashon, with suffix; root, used irregularly, lshn.

units.la: לְשָׁת depsentes, Part. Beni. Kal, pl. fæm. à f. m. לָשׁ; Rad. לוּשׁ.
units.tr: leshat: kneading, Participle Beni. Kal, plural feminine, from the masculine lash; root lush.

units.la: לָשִׂיחַ ad meditandum, pro לְהָשִׂיחַ, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. שִׂיחַ.
units.tr: lasiach: to meditate, for lehasiach. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root siach.

units.tr: lasir: to sing, for lehasir. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root shir.

units.tr: lasit: to place, for lehasit. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root shut.

units.la: לָשְׂמֵד ad perdendum, pro לְהַשְׁמִיד, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. שָׁמַד [?].
units.tr: lashmed: to destroy, for lehashmid. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root shamad [?].

units.la: 7. pro לְהַשְׁמִיעַ, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. שָׁמַע.
units.tr: 7, for lehashma'. Infinitive Hiph. with prefix. Root shama'.

units.la: לָלֶדֶת ad pariendum, 1. Sam. 4. 19. pro לְלֶדֶת, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: laledet: to bear, 1 Sam. 4.19, for leledet. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root yalad.

units.la: לָתֶת ad dandum, pro לְתֶנֶת, &c. לָתְתִּי me, &c. Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. נָתַן.
units.tr: latet: to give, for letenet, etc. latti: to me, etc. Infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root natan.

units.la: לְתֵּתָן ad dandum, 1. Reg. 6. 19. pro לְתֵת, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. נָתַן.
units.tr: letettan: to give, 1 Kings 6.19, for letet. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root natan.

units.la: מ א
units.tr: M ', or M A

units.la: מְאֻדָּם rubefactus, Nah. 2. 3. מְאֻדָּמִים rubefacti, pro מְאָדָם, &c. Part. Pual, s. & pl. masc. Rad. אָדַם.
units.tr: me'udam: reddened, Nah. 2.3; me'udamim: reddened, for me'adam, etc. Participle Pual, singular and plural masculine. Root 'adam.

units.la: מְאֻזָּל abire factus, vel מְאֻזָּל, Part. Pual, f. m. Rad. אָזַל.
units.tr: me'uzal: gone away, made to depart, or me'uzal. Participle Pual, feminine singular. Root 'azal.

units.la: מְאָיִם, מְאַיִּים desideria, No. pl. m. R. אָוָה.
units.tr: me'ayim, me'ayyim: desires, masculine plural noun. Root 'avah.

units.la: מְאוֹם, vel מְאוֹם vitium, cum א, epenth. pro No. Rad. f. m. מוֹם vi-tium.
units.tr: me'om, or me'om: blemish, with aleph inserted as epenthesis for the feminine noun mom, blemish. Root mom.

units.la: מְאוּמָה, מְאוּם aliquid, Part. Rad. in Rad. inu-sit [?]. מְאוּם.
units.tr: me'umah, me'um: anything, participle. Root [unused]. me'um.

units.la: מְאוֹרֵי luminaria, constr. pl. m. sicut & מְאוֹרוֹת pl. fæm. à f. m. מָאוֹר Rad. אוֹר lucidum esse.
units.tr: me'orei: lights, masculine plural construct, as also me'orot, feminine plural, from the masculine me'or. Root 'ur, to be bright.

units.la: מְאוֹרָשָׁה , vel מְאוֹרֵשָׁה desponsata , Part. Pual, f. fæm. Rad. אָרַשׂ.
units.tr: me'orasha, or me'oresha: betrothed, Participle Pual, feminine. Root 'aras.

units.la: מְאוּרַת caverna, No. f. f. constr. R. אוֹר lucere.
units.tr: me'urat: cave, feminine noun construct. Root 'ur, to shine.

units.la: מְאֻשָּׁר , vel מְאֻשָּׁר beatus , מְאֻשְּׁרֵי , vel מְאֻשְּׁרֵיו beatificati ejus, &c. Part. Pual, f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. אָשַׁר.
units.tr: me'ushshar, or me'ushshar: blessed; me'ushsherei, or me'ushsherav: their blessed ones, etc. Participle Pual, feminine and masculine plural, with suffix. Root 'ashar.

units.la: מָאָז à tunc, comp. ex מ, praef. & part. Rad. אָז.
units.tr: ma'az: from then, compounded of the prefix m and the participle root 'az.

units.la: מֹאזְנַיִם , מֹאזְנִי lances, statera, No. du. m. R. אֹזֶן.
units.tr: mo'znayim, mo'zni: scales, balance, masculine dual noun. Root 'ozen.

units.la: מְאַחְזִי continens, Part. Pi-el, f. m. מְאַחְזִים comprehensi, Part. Hoph. pl. m. R. אָחַז.
units.tr: me'achzi: holding, Participle Piel, masculine singular; me'achzim: seized, Participle Hophal, masculine plural. Root 'achaz.

units.la: מֵאָחוֹר à post, comp. ex מ praef. & אָחוֹר, Rad. אָחַר.
units.tr: me'achor: from behind, compounded of the prefix m and 'achor. Root 'achar.

units.la: מְאַחֲרִים morantes, Part. Pi-el, pl. m. constr. à f. m. מְאַחֵר morans , Rad. אָחַר.
units.tr: me'acharim: delaying, Participle Piel, masculine plural construct, from the masculine me'achter, delaying. Root 'achar.

units.la: מֵאַיִן undenam? idem quod מִן, comp. ex מ, Præp. præf. & Part. Rad. אַיִן non, & אַיִן quo?
units.tr: me'ayin: whence? the same as min, compounded of the prefix m, preposition, and the participle root 'ayin, not, and 'ayin, where?

units.la: מְאִירָה , מְאִירָה, & מְאִירַת illustrans , Part. Hiph. f. m. & f. R. אוֹר.
units.tr: me'irah, me'irah, and me'irat: illuminating, Participle Hiph. feminine singular and feminine. Root 'ur.

units.la: מְאֵרוֹת incendunt, Part. Hiph. pl. fæm. Rad. אוּר.
units.tr: Meërot, "they kindle": participle Hiphil, plural feminine, from the root אוּר.

units.la: מֵאָכֵל à comedendo, Infin. Kal, præf. & מָאֳכָל cibus, No. f. m. R. אָכַל.
units.tr: Meʾākhel, "from eating": infinitive Qal with prefix; and māʾokhal, "food", noun masculine, from the root אָכַל.

units.la: מֵאֵל à Deo, est No. sing. m. אֵל, cum מ, Præp. præf. à No. Rad. אֵל.
units.tr: Meʾel, "from God": noun singular masculine, אֵל, with the preposition מ prefixed, from the noun root אֵל.

units.la: מְאַלְּפוֹת milleficantes , Part. Hiph. pl. fæm. Rad. אָלַף.
units.tr: Meʾallᵉfot, "bewitching": participle Hiphil, plural feminine, from the root אָלַף.

units.la: מַאֲמִין credens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. אָמַן nutrivit.
units.tr: Maʾamin, "believing": participle Hiphil, masculine singular, from the root אָמַן, "nourished".

units.la: מַאֲמָר sermo, No. f. m. R. אָמַר dixit.
units.tr: Maʾamar, "word": noun masculine, from the root אָמַר, "said".

units.la: מֵאֵן undenam? comp. ex מ, præf. & Part. Rad. אֵן quo.
units.tr: Meʾen, "whence?": compounded of the prefix מ and the participle from the root אֵן, "where".

units.la: מָאֲנָה renuit, מָאֲנוּ renue[?]nt, præt. Piel; 3. f. fæm. & 3. pl. R. מָאֵן, in Piel, מֵאֵן מְאֹנוֹתֵיהֶם è Hebræis suis, No. pl. fæm. præf. aff. à f. m. אֳנִי navis, & f. f. אֳנִיָּה Rad. אָנָה moestus fuit. מָאֲסוּ spreverunt, [?] spreverunt, [?] sprevit eos, præt. Kal, 3. pl. & 3. f. m. aff. R. מָאַס מַאֲפֵה coctum, No. f. m. R. אָפָה coxit. מַאֲפֵל caligo, מַאֲפֵלָה caligo maxima, No. f. m. & comp. cum No. [?] Rad. אָפַל מַאְרָב insidiæ, No. f. m. R. אָרַב insidiatus est. מְאָרְבִים insidiantes, Part. Piel, pl. m. Rad. אָרַב מְאָרָה maledictio, מְאֵרוֹת maledictiones, No. f. f. & pl. fæm. R. אָרַר maledixit. מְאָרִים maledictionem inferentes, Part. Piel, pl. masc. Rad. [?] מְאַשְּׁרִים beatum prædicans, & מְאֻשָּׁר beatis, &c. Part. Piel, & Pual, f. m. R. אָשַׁר
units.tr: Māʾᵃnāh, "he refused"; māʾᵃnu, "they refused": preterite Piel, third person feminine singular and third person plural, from the root מָאֵן in Piel. Meʾōnōtēhem, "their (own) Hebrew..."; noun plural feminine with prefix and suffix, from the masculine noun אֳנִי, "ship", and the feminine noun אֳנִיָּה, from the root אָנָה, "was sad". Māʾasu, "they despised": preterite Kal, third person plural and third person feminine, from the root מָאַס. Maʾapheh, "baked": noun masculine, from the root אָפָה, "baked". Maʾapel, "darkness"; maʾapelah, "very great darkness": noun masculine, and compounded with a noun [illegible], from the root אָפַל. Maʾrav, "ambush": noun masculine, from the root אָרַב, "lay in wait". Meʾᵃrᵉvim, "lying in wait": participle Piel, masculine plural, from the root אָרַב. Meʾarah, "curse", meʾarot, "curses": noun feminine singular and plural feminine, from the root אָרַר, "cursed". Meʾarim, "bringing a curse": participle Piel, masculine plural, from the root [illegible]. Meʾashᵉrim, "pronouncing blessed", and meʾushshar, "blessed", etc.: participle Piel and Pual, masculine singular, from the root אָשַׁר.

units.la: מ ב
units.tr: מ ב

units.la: מָבוֹא, vel מְבוֹאָה occasus ejus, No. sing. m. מָבוֹא aff. Rad. בּוֹא venire. מְבַהֲלִים turbantes, Part. Piel, & מְבֻהָלִים accelerati, Part. Puat, pl. m. R. בָּהַל מְבֻהֲלָה accelerata, Part. Pual, f f. R. בָּהַל מְבוּכָתָם perplexitas eorum, No. f. f. מְבוּכָה aff. Rad. בּוּךְ. מַבּוּל diluvium, No. f. m. Rad. נָבַל cecidit. מְבוּקָה conculcatio, מְבוּקָה vacuitas, No. f. f. R. בּוּק conculcavit, & בּוּק. מִבּוּז scaturigo, No. f. m. R. נָבַע scaturivit. מִבְּטָה exspectatio ipsorum, No. f. m. aff. R. נִבְּט [illegible, ~3 letters] intritus est מָבִיא, pro מֵבִיא addens מְבִיאִים addacentes Part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. R. בּוֹא מֵבִיט inturens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. נָבַט מֵבִין intelligens, מְבִינִים intelligentes, &c. Part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. בִּין מַבִּישָׁה pudefaciens, Part. Hiph. f. m. & f. Rad בּוּשׁ מְבַכּוֹת deflentes; Part. Piel, pl. f. à f. f. מְבַכָּה Rad. בָּכָה flevit. מְבַלִּינִיתִי recreans se, Jer. 8. 18. Part. Hiph. f. f. cum parag. à f. m. מְבַלִּין, R. בָּלָה [?] מִבְנָה structura, No. f. m. Rad. בָּנָה aedificavit. מְבֹעֶרֶת accensus, Part. Pual, f. & R. בָּעַר [?] מְבַעֲתְּךָ deturbat te, ו, Sam. 16. 16. pro מְבַעֲתֶּךָ Part. Piel, f. f. aff. à f. מְבֹאָה, R. בּוֹא [?] m. מְבֹצְרָיו monitiones ejus, No. pl. m. aff. R. בָּצַר vindemiavit מְבָרֵחַ transiens, Part. Hiph. sing. masc. sed מְבָרְחוֹ profugi ejus, No. pl. m. aff. R. בָּרַח fugit. מְבָרֵךְ benedicens, Part. Piel, sing. masc. sed מְבֹרָכָיו benedicti ejus, Part. Pual; pl. m. aff. Rad. בָּרַךְ בִּ־מְבֻשָּׁה in pudenda ejus, No. pl. m. praef. aff. à f. m. מְבֹשׁ, Rad. בּוּשׁ erubescere.
units.tr: Mavo, or mevoʾah, "its going down": noun singular masculine, מָבוֹא with suffix, from the root בּוֹא, "come". Mevahalim, "troubling": participle Piel, and mevuhalim, "hastened": participle Pual, masculine plural, from the root בָּהַל. Mevuhalah, "hastened": participle Pual, feminine singular, from the root בָּהַל. Mevukhatam, "their perplexity": noun feminine with suffix, from the noun מְבוּכָה, root בּוּךְ. Mabbul, "flood": noun masculine, from the root נָבַל, "fell". Mevuqah, "trampling"; mevuqah, "emptiness": noun feminine, from the root בּוּק, "trampled", and בּוּק. Mibbuz, "spring": noun masculine, from the root נָבַע, "gushed". Mibbeṭah, "their expectation": noun masculine with suffix, from the root נִבְּט [illegible, about three letters] "was worn out". Maviʾ, for mevi, "adding"; mevi'im, "bringing": participle Hiphil, feminine and masculine plural, from the root בּוֹא. Mevit, "gazing intently": participle Hiphil, masculine singular, from the root נָבַט. Mevin, "understanding"; mevinim, "understanding": participle Hiphil, masculine singular and plural, from the root בִּין, etc. Mabbishah, "shaming": participle Hiphil, masculine singular and feminine, from the root בּוּשׁ. Mevakkot, "weeping": participle Piel, feminine plural, from the feminine noun מְבַכָּה, root בָּכָה, "wept". Mevallinitti, "refreshing myself", Jer. 8.18: participle Hiphil, feminine, with paragogic ending, from the masculine מְבַלִּין, root בָּלָה. Mivneh, "structure": noun masculine, from the root בָּנָה, "built". Meboʿeret, "kindled": participle Pual, feminine, from the root בָּעַר. Mevaʿattekha, "he terrifies you", 1 Sam. 16.16 for mevaʿatteka: participle Piel, feminine, with suffix, from the feminine noun מְבֹאָה, root בּוֹא. Mevoṣrav, "his fortifications": noun plural masculine with suffix, from the root בָּצַר, "vintaged". Mevarehh, "passing over": participle Hiphil, masculine singular; but mivrḥo, "his fugitives": noun plural masculine with suffix, from the root בָּרַח, "fled". Mevareḵ, "blessing": participle Piel, masculine singular; but mevorakhav, "his blessed ones": participle Pual, plural masculine with suffix, from the root בָּרַךְ. Bi-mevushshah, "in his nakedness": noun plural masculine, with prefix and suffix, from the masculine noun מְבֹשׁ, root בּוּשׁ, "to be ashamed".

units.la: מ נ מְנָאֵל pollutus, Part. Pual, f. m. R. נָאַל מְנַבִּיהַ exaltans, & pro eo, הַ מְנַבִּיהַ Ps. 113. 5. Part. Hiph. f. m. praef. & parag. Rad. נָבַהּ מְנֻבְּלוֹת terminates, No. pl. faem. R. נָבַל termi-navit.
units.tr: M N. Menaʾel, "defiled": participle Pual, masculine singular, from the root נָאַל. Menabbeha, "exalting", and for it, hamenabbiha, Ps. 113.5: participle Hiphil, masculine singular, with prefix and suffix, from the root נָבַהּ. Menubbelot, "ends": noun plural feminine, from the root נָבַל, "ended".

units.la: מְגִדָּלֶיהָ turres ejus, No. pl. m. aff. R. גָּדַל magnum esse.
units.tr: Migdalehah, "its towers": noun plural masculine with suffix, from the root גָּדַל, "to be great".

units.la: מְגוֹלָלָה volutatum, Part. Pual, f. f. R. גָּלַל.
units.tr: Mequlalah, "rolled about": participle Pual, feminine singular, from the root גָּלַל.

units.la: מְגוּרוֹתַי formidines meæ, No. pl. m. & f. aff. à f. m. מָגוֹר; Rad. גּוּר commoratus fuit.
units.tr: Meguroteai, "my terrors": noun plural masculine and feminine with suffix, from the masculine noun מָגוֹר; root גּוּר, "sojourned".

units.la: מְגֵרוֹת ferræ, secures, No. pl. fæm. Rad. נָגַר secuit.
units.tr: Megeroth, "iron tools, saws": noun plural feminine, from the root נָגַר, "cut".

units.la: מְגִידֵי indicantes, &c. Part. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. נָגַד[?]
units.tr: Megidey, "declaring, etc.": participle Hiphil, masculine plural, from the root נָגַד[?].

units.la: מֵגִיחַ educens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. גּוּחַ[?].
units.tr: Meggiach, "bringing forth": participle Hiphil, masculine singular, from the root גּוּחַ[?].

units.la: מְגִיעַ pertingens, Part. Hiph. f. m. & fæm. Rad. נָגַע.
units.tr: Megiʿa, "reaching": participle Hiphil, masculine singular and feminine, from the root נָגַע.

units.la: מְגִלָּה volumen, No. f. f. R. גָּלַל volvit.
units.tr: Megillah, "scroll": noun feminine singular, from the root גָּלַל, "rolled".

units.la: מְגַלָּה revelans, Part. Piel, f. m. Rad. גָּלָה.
units.tr: Megallah, "revealing": participle Piel, feminine singular and masculine, from the root גָּלָה.

units.la: מְגֻלִּים deportati, pro מְגֻלִּים, Part. Hoph. pl. m. Rad. גָּלָה.
units.tr: Megullim, "carried away", for megullim: participle Hophal, masculine plural, from the root גָּלָה.

units.la: מָגֵן clypeus, מָגִנִּי meus, מָגִנִּים scuta, מָגִנּוֹת scu-
units.tr: Magen, "shield"; magini, "my"; maginnim, "shields"; magginot, "shields", etc.: noun masculine singular with suffix, and feminine plural, from the root גָּנַן, "protected".

units.la: tum, &c. No. f. m. aff. & pl. m. & f. f. Rad. גָּנַן protexit.
units.tr: Maggefah, "plague"; maggefot, "plagues": noun feminine singular and plural feminine, from the root נָגַף, "struck".

units.la: מַגֵּפָה plaga, מַגֵּפוֹת plagæ, No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. נָגַף percussit.
units.tr: Bimgrah, "in the saw"; bimgerot, "in the saws": noun feminine singular and plural, with prefix, from the root גָּזַר[?], "cut".

units.la: בְּמִגְרָה in serra, בְּמִגְרוֹת in serris, No. f. & pl. fæm. præf. Rad. גָּזַר[?] secuit.
units.tr: Meggorim, "poured out": participle Hophal, masculine plural, from the root נָגַר, "flowed down".

units.la: מְגֹרִים profusæ, Part. Hoph. pl. masc. Rad. נָגַר defluxit.
units.tr: Magash, "brought near": participle Hophal, masculine singular, from the root נָגַשׁ.

units.la: מָגַשׁ adductum, Part. Hoph. f. m. R. נָגַשׁ.
units.tr: adducted, Participle Hophal, feminine/masculine, root נָגַשׁ.

units.la: מ ד
units.tr: מ ד

units.la: לְמַדֵּד ad mensurandum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. מָדַד.
units.tr: לְמַדֵּד for measuring, Infinitive Kal with prefix לְ, root מָדַד.

units.la: מֵד mensura, No. f. m. R. מָדַד.
units.tr: Madbeir, "speaking", Num. 7.89, for metaddeir: participle Hithpael, masculine singular, from the root דָּבַר.

units.la: מַדְבֵּר loquens, Num. 7. 89. pro מְתַדֵּר, Part. Hithp. f. m. Rad. דָּבַר.
units.tr: Umededah, "and he measured": preterite Piel, third person feminine singular and masculine, from the root מָדַד.

units.la: וּמְדֵדָה & mensus fuerit, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. R. מָדַד.
units.tr: Middatah, "its measure": noun masculine with suffix, from מַד, root מָדַד.

units.la: מִדָּתָהּ mensura ejus, No. f. m. מַד, aff. R. מָדַד.
units.tr: Middah, "measure": noun singular feminine, from the root מָדַד.

units.la: מִדָּה mensura, No. f. fæm. R. מָדַד.
units.tr: Midhabah, "goldsmith": noun feminine singular, from the Chaldee noun דַּהַב, "gold", for the Hebrew זָהָב.

units.la: מִדְהָבָה aurifica, No. f. fæm. à No. Rad. Chald. דַּהַב aurum, pro Hebr. זָהָב.
units.tr: Mado, mᵉdo, "his garment": noun masculine singular with suffix, from מַד, root מָדַד, "measured".

units.la: מָדוֹ, מְדוֹ vestimentum suum, No. sing. m. מַד, aff. R. מָדַד mensus est.
units.tr: Mᵉdu, construct mᵉdu, "sickness": noun feminine, and mᵉduḏe, "sicknesses": noun masculine plural construct, from the root וָזֶה, "weak".

units.la: מְדוּהָ, constr. מְדוּהָ langor, No. f. & מְדוּדֵי languores, pl. m. constr. Rad. וָזֶה languidus.
units.tr: Medukhim, "expulsions": noun masculine plural, from the root נָדַח, "drove out".

units.la: מְדוּחִים expulsiones, No. pl. m. Rad. נָדַח expulit.
units.tr: Madwehem, "their garments", 2 Sam. 10.4 for medeihem: noun masculine plural with suffix, from the feminine noun מַד; root מָדַד.

units.la: מַדְוֵיהֶם vestes eorum, 2 Sam. 10.4. pro מְדֵיהֶם, No. pl. m. aff. à f. m. מַד ; Rad. מָדַד.
units.tr: Madon, "strife": noun masculine; mᵉdonim, mᵉdoni, mᵉdonim, "strifes": noun feminine and masculine plural, from the root דִּין, "judged".

units.la: מָדוֹן contentio, מְדוֹנִים, מְדוֹנִי, מְדוֹנִים contentiones, No. f. & pl. m. R. דִּין judicavit.
units.tr: Mᵉdo, "why": adverb participle, from the root יָדַע, "knew".

units.la: מְדוֹ quare, Part. Adv. Rad. יָדַע novit.
units.tr: Middot, "measures"; middoteha, "her garments": noun feminine plural, with suffix, from the feminine noun מִדָּה; root מָדַד.

units.la: מִדּוֹת mensuræ, מִדּוֹתֶיהָ vestes ejus, No. pl. fæm. aff. à f. f. מִדָּה ; Rad. מָדַד.
units.tr: Umedoti, "and I shall measure", umedotem, "and you shall measure", etc.: preterite Kal, first person feminine and second person plural masculine, from מָדַד.

units.la: וּמְדוֹתִי & metiar, וּמְדוֹתֶם & metiemini, &c. prêt. Kal, 1. f. & 2. pl. m. מָדַד.
units.tr: Mᵉdah, "expelled": participle Hophal, feminine singular and masculine, from the root נָדַח.

units.la: מְדָה expulsus, Part. Hoph. f. m. R. נָדַח.
units.tr: Mᵉdehah, "impulse": noun feminine singular, from the root דָּחָה, "pushed".

units.la: מְדֵחָה impulsio, No. f. m. Rad. דָּחָה impulit.
units.tr: Mᵉdehfot, "impulses": noun feminine plural, from the root דָּחַף, "pushed".

units.la: מְדֵחְפוֹת impulsiones, No. pl. fæm. Rad. דָּחַף impulit.
units.tr: Mᵉdiboth, "those afflicting with grief", Lev. 26.16, for madʾibot: participle Hiphil, feminine plural, from the root דָּאַב.

units.la: מְדִיבוֹת moerore afficientes, Lev. 26. 16. pro מַדְאִיבוֹת, Part. Hiph. pl. fæm. Rad. דָּאַב.
units.tr: Mᵉdin, "its garments", maddᵉka, "your": noun masculine plural with suffix, from the masculine noun מַד; root מָדַד.

units.la: מְדִין vestes ejus, מַדְּךָ tuæ, No. pl. m. aff. à f. m. מַד ; Rad. מָדַד.
units.tr: Medinah, "province", medinot, "provinces", etc.: noun feminine singular and plural feminine, from the root דִּין, "judged".

units.la: מְדִינָה provincia, מְדִינוֹת provinciæ, &c. No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. דִּין judicavit.
units.tr: Mᵉduka, "crushed", mᵉdukkaʾim, "bruised": participle Pual, masculine singular and plural, from the root דָּבָא.

units.la: מְדֻכָּא attritus, מְדֻכָּאִים contriti, Part. Pual, f.
units.tr: מְדֻכָּא crushed, מְדֻכָּאִים contrite, Participle Pual, feminine.

units.la: & pl. m. Rad. דָּבָא.
units.tr: and plural masculine, root דָּכָא.

units.la: קְרַע scientia, No. f. m. Rad. יָדַע scivit.
units.tr: דַּעַת knowledge, noun feminine singular, root יָדַע he knew.

units.la: מְרוּכָךְ vel מְרוֹכָךְ habitatio tua, No. f. m. aff. Rad. דּוּר habitare.
units.tr: Mᵉrishati, "my threshing": noun feminine with suffix, from the root דּוּשׁ, "threshed".

units.la: מְדִרָתָהּ pyra ejus, No. f. f. aff. Rad. דּוּר.
units.tr: Mᵉdah, "measure": noun singular feminine, construct mᵉdat, from the root מָדַד, "measured".

units.la: מְרִשָׁתִי tritura mea, No. f. fæm. aff. R. דּוּשׁ tritu-ravit.
units.tr: M H.

units.la: מְדָּה mensura, No. sing. fæm. מִדָּה, constr. Rad. מָדַד mensus est.
units.tr: מִדָּה measure, noun singular feminine, construct מִדַּת, root מָדַד he measured.

units.la: מ ה
units.tr: מ ה

units.la: מָה, מָה vel מַה quid, quod, quæ, Part. Interrog. Rad.
units.tr: מָה, or מַה, what, which, who, interrogative particle, root —.

units.la: מְהַבִּלִים, vel מַהְבִּילִים vanos efficiunt, Part. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. הָבַל.
units.tr: מְהַבִּלִים, or מַהְבִּילִים, make vain, Participle Hiphil, plural masculine, root הָבַל.

units.la: הַמֻּהָנִים mussitantes, Part. Hiph. pl. masc. Rad. הָנָה.
units.tr: Mussitantes (muttering), participle Hiphil plural masculine, from the root הָנָה.

units.la: מָהוּל mixtum, Part. Pahul, Kal, sing. m. Rad. מָהַל.
units.tr: Mixed (mixtum), participle Pual (Pahul), Kal, singular masculine, from the root מָהַל.

units.la: מְהוּלֵי insanientes contra me, Part. Pyh. pl. masc. aff. Rad. הָלַל.
units.tr: Raving against me (insanientes contra me), participle Poel, plural masculine with suffix, from the root הָלַל.

units.la: מְהוּמָה vexatio, מְהוּמוֹת vexationes, No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. הוּם turbavit.
units.tr: Vexation (mehumah, vexatio), vexations (mehumoth, vexationes), noun feminine singular and plural, from the root הוּם, he troubled.

units.la: מְהַלֵּךְ ambulans, מְהַלְּכִים ambulantes, Part. Piel, f. & pl. m. R. הָלַךְ.
units.tr: Walking (mehalleko, ambulans), walking ones (mehallekim, ambulantes), participle Piel, feminine and masculine plural, from the root הָלַךְ.

units.la: מְהַלְּכִים via, No. pl. masc. vel pro מְהַלִּיכִים ambulantes, Part. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. הָלַךְ.
units.tr: Ways (mehallekim, via), a noun masculine plural, or for mehallikim, causing to walk, participle Hiphil plural masculine, from the root הָלַךְ.

units.la: מְהַלְּכְךָ iter tuum, No. f. m. aff. R. הָלַךְ.
units.tr: Your way (mehallekha, iter tuum), noun feminine masculine with suffix, from the root הָלַךְ.

units.la: מְהֻלָּל laudatus, Part. Pual, f. m. R. הָלַל insanivit.
units.tr: Praised (mehullal, laudatus), participle Pual, feminine masculine, from the root הָלַל, he acted madly.

units.la: מְהַלְלִים laudantes, Part. Piel, pl. m. Rad. הָלַל.
units.tr: Praising (mehalelim, laudantes), participle Piel, plural masculine, from the root הָלַל.

units.la: מְחַלְמוֹת contusiones, No. pl. fæm. R. הָכַם contudit.
units.tr: Bruises (mehalmoth, contusiones), noun plural feminine, from the root הָכַם, he bruised.

units.la: מֵהֶם ab illis, comp. ex מ, præf. & הֶם, aff. ab הוּא. מחפרות scrobes, fovea, No. pl. fæm. R. חָפַר הַהֲפֵכֶת cippus, No. f. fæm. R. הָפַךְ vertit. מְהֻקִּיץ ab evigilando, Infin. Hiph. præf. R. קִיץ מִקְצֹעוֹת angularia, pro מִקְצֹעוֹת, ex Part. Hoph. pl. m. Rad. קצע מְחַרְסִים destruentes te, Part. Piel, pl. m. aff. Rad. הָרַס מְהַשְׁחִית a perdendo, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. שָׁחַת מְהַתְּלוֹת ludificationes, No. pl. fæm. R. הָתַל
units.tr: From them (mehem, ab illis), a compound of מ prefix and הֶם suffix, from הוּא. Mahpherot, pits (scrobes, fovea), noun plural feminine, from the root חָפַר. Hahăpekheth, a pillar (cippus), noun feminine, from the root הָפַךְ, he turned. Mehuqqits, from awaking, infinitive Hiphil with prefix, from the root קִיץ. Miqtso'oth, corners (angularia), for miqtso'oth, from the participle Hophal plural masculine, root קצע. Mehar'sim, destroying you (Mehar'sim, Piel participle plural masculine with suffix, root הָרַס). Mehashchith, from perdendo, infinitive Hiphil with prefix, root שָׁחַת. Mehattelot, mockeries (ludificationes), noun plural feminine, from the root הָתַל.

units.la: מ ו מוֹ illis, illi, In fine distinctionis, est aff. Poët. pro הֵם, vel [?] לְמוֹל ex adverso, est Præp. מוּל, vel מוֹל ex-ram, cum א, epenth. מוּבָא adductus, מוּבָאָה adducta, מוּבָאִים adducti, מוּבָאוֹת adductæ, Part. Hoph. f. & pl. m. & fæm. Rad. בוא. מוּבָאֵךְ ingressus tuus, מוּבָאוֹ aditus ejus, No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. בוא. מוּכָם consultatum, Part. Hoph. f. m. R. כּוּם [?] מוֹנִיךְ afflígentes te, part. Hiph. pl. m. aff. Rad. יָגָה [?] מוֹדָה confitens, מוֹדִים confitentes, Part. Hiph. sing. & pl. m. Rad. יָדָה מוֹדִיעַ notam faciens tibi, מוֹדִיעָם illis, מוֹדִיעִים notum facientes, Part. Hiph. f. m. aff. & pl. m. R. יָדַע מוֹרַע affinis, No. f. m. R. יָדַע מוֹדִיעָה notum sit, Part. Hoph. f. fæm. constr. Rad. יָדַע מוֹדְעָתֵנוּ cognatio nostra, (pro מוֹדְעָתֵנוּ,) No. f. f. מוֹדְעַת, aff. Rad. יָדַע מִזְּנִים, pro מִזֻּנִים bene pasti, Part. Hoph. vel No. pl. m. Rad. יזן: vel pro מְזֻנִים armati, Part. Pual, pl. masc. Rad. יזן
units.tr: Mo, mu, mou, them, them (illis, illi). At the end of a distinction it is a poetic suffix for hem, or [?] lemol, over against, is the preposition mul, or mol, ex-ram, with aleph epenthetic. Mu'va, brought (adductus), mu'vah, brought (adducta), mu'vim, brought (adducti), mu'voth, brought (adductae), participle Hophal feminine and masculine and feminine plural, from the root בוא. Mu'vakha, your entrance (ingressus tuus), mu'vo, its approach (aditus ejus), noun feminine and plural masculine with suffix, from the root בוא. Mukkam, consulted, participle Hophal feminine masculine, from the root כּוּם [?]. Moniakh, afflicting you, participle Hiphil plural masculine with suffix, from the root יָגָה [?]. Modah, confessing, modim, confessing ones, participle Hiphil singular and plural masculine, from the root יָדָה. Modia, making known to you, modia'm, to them, modi'im, making known, participle Hiphil feminine masculine with suffix and plural masculine, from the root יָדַע. Mora', related (affinis), noun feminine masculine, from the root יָדַע. Modi'ah, let it be known, participle Hophal feminine feminine construct, from the root יָדַע. Modi'atenu, our kinship (for modi'atenu), noun feminine, from modi'ath, with suffix, from the root יָדַע. Mizzanim, for mizzunim, well fed, participle Hophal or noun plural masculine, from the root יזן; or for mezunim, armed, participle Pual plural masculine, from the root יזן.

units.la: מוֹזֵר alienus factus, Part. Hoph. f. m. R. זור.
units.tr: Mozar, made alien, participle Hophal feminine masculine, from the root זור.

units.la: מוּט mutare, dimotio, pro מוּט, Infin. Kal, vel No. f. m, Rad. מוּט.
units.tr: Mut, to change, removal (dimotio), for mut, infinitive Kal, or noun feminine masculine, from the root מוּט.

units.la: מוֹטָה jugum, מוֹטוֹת juga, No. f. & pl. fæm. sed, מוֹטֹתוֹ ejus, No. f. m. מוּט, aff. Rad. מוּט motus fuit.
units.tr: Motah, yoke (jugum), mototh, yokes (juga), noun feminine and plural feminine. But mototho, his (ejus), noun feminine masculine, from mut, with suffix, from the root מוּט, it moved.

units.la: מוֹכִיחַ arguens, מוֹכִיחִים corripientes, Part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. יכח.
units.tr: Mokhiakh, arguing (arguens), mokhihim, rebuking (corripientes), participle Hiphil feminine and plural masculine, from the root יכח.

units.la: מוּבָן paratus, Part. Hoph. f. m. R. כון.
units.tr: Muvan, prepared (paratus), participle Hophal feminine masculine, from the root כון.

units.la: מוּל circumcide, pro מוּל, Imper. Kal, f. m. Rad. מול.
units.tr: Mul, circumcise, for mul, imperative Kal, feminine masculine, from the root מול.

units.la: מִמּוּל è regione, part. Præp. cum præf. R. מול circumcidit.
units.tr: Mimmul, opposite (è regione), participle preposition with prefix, from the root מול, he circumcised.

units.la: מוֹלַדְתּוֹ cognatio ejus, מוֹלַדְתֵּךְ tua, [?] tuæ, No. sing. fæm. & pl. aff. à sing. fæm. מוֹלֶדֶת; Rad. יָלַד genuit.
units.tr: Moladto, his kinship (cognatio ejus), moladtekh, your (tua), [?] your (tuae), noun singular feminine and plural with suffix, from the singular feminine molédeth; root יָלַד, he begot.

units.la: לְמוּלוֹת propter circumcisiones, No. pl. fæm. præf. à s fæm. מוּלָה Rad. מול circumcidit.
units.tr: Lemuloth, on account of circumcisions (propter circumcisiones), noun plural feminine with prefix, from the singular feminine mulah, root מול, he circumcised.

units.la: מוֹלִיד gignens, מוֹלִידִים gignentes, Part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: Molid, begetting (gignens), molidim, begetting ones (gignentes), participle Hiphil feminine and plural masculine, from the root יָלַד.

units.la: מוֹלִיךְ ducens, מוֹלִיכִים ducentes, Part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָלַךְ.
units.tr: Molikh, leading (ducens), molikhim, leading ones (ducentes), participle Hiphil feminine and plural masculine, from the root יָלַךְ.

units.la: מָל succidit, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. R. מול.
units.tr: Mal, he cut off, preterite Piel, third person feminine masculine, from the root מול.

units.la: מוֹנִיךְ oppressores tui, Part. Hiph. pl. masc. aff. Rad. יָנָה.
units.tr: Moniakh, your oppressors (oppressores tui), participle Hiphil plural masculine with suffix, from the root יָנָה.

units.la: מוֹסֵב, מוֹסַב circumductus, ambitus, מוֹסַבּוֹת circumdatæ, Part. Hoph. vel, No. Part. f. m. & pl. fæm. Rad. סָבַב circuivit.
units.tr: Mosev, Mosav, turned about (circumductus), encompassing (ambitus), mosavoth, encircled (circumdatae), participle Hophal or noun participle masculine and feminine plural, from the root סָבַב, he went around.

units.la: מוֹסַד, מוֹסָד fundatus, fundatio, Part. Hoph. vel No. Part. f. m. R. יָסַד.
units.tr: Mosad, Mosad, founded (fundatus), foundation (fundatio), participle Hophal or noun participle masculine, from the root יָסַד.

units.la: מוסרות , מוסרה , מוסר fundamenta , & מוסדה fundamentum , מוסד fundamenta , No. pl. fæm. & m. constr. ut & No. f. & pl. f. Rad. יסד fundavit.
units.tr: Musrot, musrah, musar, foundations (fundamenta), and musdah, foundation (fundamentum), mosad, foundations (fundamenta), noun plural feminine and masculine construct, as also noun feminine and plural feminine, from the root יסד, he founded.

units.la: addentes , Part. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. יסף
units.tr: Adding (addentes), participle Hiphil plural masculine, from the root יסף.

units.la: מוסך , constr. מוסך teg-en , No. f. masc. Rad. יסך texit.
units.tr: Mosakh, covering (tegen), construct mosakh, noun feminine masculine, from the root יסך, he covered.

units.la: מוסר amota, part. Hoph. f. m. R. יסר. Hiph. הסיר removit, & Hoph. הוסר remotum est. Vel est No. f. m. Rad. יסר castigavit, Hiph. הוסיר & Hoph. הוסר.
units.tr: Musar, removed (amota), participle Hophal feminine masculine, from the root יסר. Hiphil hasir, he removed, and Hophal husar, it has been removed. Or it is a noun feminine masculine, from the root יסר, he chastised, Hiphil hosir and Hophal husar.

units.la: מוסר , מוסר , מוסר castiga-tio , מוסרה vin-culum , מוסרי , מוסרים vincula , מוסרי mea , מוסרות vincula , מוסרותיהם eorum , &c. No. f. m. & f. & pl. m. & f. aff. R. יסר casti-gavit.
units.tr: Musar, musar, musar, chastisement (castigatio), musarah, chain (vinculum), musari, musarim, chains (vincula), musari, my (mea), musaroth, chains (vincula), musarotheihem, their (eorum), etc. Noun feminine masculine and feminine and plural masculine and feminine with suffix, from the root יסר, he chastised.

units.la: מועד tempus statutum , מועדות , מועדי , מועדים tempora statuta , &c. No. f. m. & pl. m. & f. Rad. יעד constituit.
units.tr: Mo'ed, appointed time (tempus statutum), mo'edoth, mo'edi, mo'edim, appointed times (tempora statuta), etc. Noun feminine masculine and plural masculine and feminine, from the root יעד, he appointed.

units.la: מועדה conventus, No. f. R. יעד.
units.tr: Mo'edah, assembly (conventus), noun feminine, from the root יעד.

units.la: מוערי vacillantes , Part, Ben. Kal, pl. m. constr. Rad. מער.
units.tr: Mo'ere, wavering ones (vacillantes), participle Pual? Kal, plural masculine construct, from the root מער.

units.la: מועדים constituti , מועדות constitutæ , Part, Hoph. pl. m. f. R. יעד.
units.tr: Mo'edim, appointed (constituti), mo'edoth, appointed (constitutae), participle Hophal plural masculine and feminine, from the root יעד.

units.la: מוערת luxatus , Prov. 25. 19. pro מוערת , Part. Kal, f. fæm. vel Part. pyh. Vide clavem meam Hebr. ad hunc locum, Rad. מער.
units.tr: Mu'arath, luxated (luxatus), Prov. 25. 19, for mu'arath, participle Kal feminine, or participle Piel. See my Hebrew key at this place, from the root מער.

units.la: מועל quod profit , Part. Hiph. f. m. R. יעל.
units.tr: Mu'al, which profits (quod profit), participle Hiphil feminine masculine, from the root יעל.

units.la: מועף , vel מעף volare factus , Part. Hoph. f. m. Rad. עוף.
units.tr: Mu'af, or muaf, made to fly (volare factus), participle Hophal feminine masculine, from the root עוף.

units.la: מועצות consilia , במועצותיהם cum consiliis suis , No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. יעץ.
units.tr: Mo'atsoth, counsels (consilia), bemo'atsotheihem, with their counsels (cum consiliis suis), noun plural feminine with suffix, from the root יעץ.

units.la: מועקה pressura , No fæm.
units.tr: Mo'aqah, pressure (pressura), noun feminine.

units.la: Rad. שׁק[?].
units.tr: Root shaq [?].

units.la: מֻסָּךְ[?] depuratum, Part. Hoph. f. m. R. פּוּז consolidari.
units.tr: Musakh [?], purified (depuratum), participle Hophal feminine masculine, from the root פּוּז, to be consolidated.

units.la: מוּפֶת prodigium, מוֹפְתִים, מוֹפְתֵי prodigia, ejus, &c. No. f. & pl. m. aff. R. יָפַת.
units.tr: Mophet, portent (prodigium), mophetim, mophete, portents (prodigia), of his (ejus), etc. Noun feminine and plural masculine with suffix, from the root יָפַת.

units.la: כְּמוֹץ sicut gluma, (pro כְּהַמּוֹץ,) No. f. m. præf. R. מָצַץ expressit, vel, est No. Rad.
units.tr: Kemots, like chaff (sicut gluma), (for kehamots), noun feminine masculine with prefix, from the root מָצַץ, he squeezed out; or it is a noun from another root.

units.la: מוֹצָא exitus, מוֹצָאוֹ ejus, מוֹצָאִים, מוֹצָאָיו exortus, מוֹצָאוֹ ejus, &c. No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. יָצָא exivit.
units.tr: Motsa, going out (exitus), motsao, its (ejus), motsaim, motsao, rising (exortus), motsao, his (ejus), etc. Noun feminine and plural masculine with suffix, from the root יָצָא, he went out.

units.la: מוֹצָא, vel מוֹצִיא producens, ut & מוֹצִיאִים, & מוֹצִיא proferentes, &c. Part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָצָא.
units.tr: Motsa, or motsi, producing (producens), as also motsim, and motsi, bringing forth (proferentes), etc. Participle Hiphil feminine and plural masculine, from the root יָצָא.

units.la: מוֹצְאָם inveniens, מוֹצְאֵיהֶם invenientes eos, מוֹצֵאת inveniens, &c. Part. Ben. Kal, f. & pl. m. aff. ut & f. f. constr. Rad. מָצָא.
units.tr: Motsam, finding (inveniens), motsehem, finding them (invenientes eos), motsaet, finding (inveniens), etc. Participle Kal, feminine and plural masculine with suffix, as also feminine feminine construct, from the root מָצָא.

units.la: מוֹצֵא inveniens, pro מוֹצָא. Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. מָצָא.
units.tr: Motse, finding (inveniens), for motsa. Participle Kal, feminine masculine, from the root מָצָא.

units.la: מוֹצָאוֹתָיו exortus ejus, No. pl. f. aff. R. יָצָא exivit.
units.tr: Motsaotav, his rising (exortus ejus), noun plural feminine with suffix, from the root יָצָא, he went out.

units.la: הַמּוֹצָאִים qui educuntur, מוֹצָאת quae educitur, Part. Hoph. pl. m. & f. f. R. יָצָא.
units.tr: Hamotsaim, those who are brought out (qui educuntur), motsaet, she who is brought out (quae educitur), participle Hophal plural masculine and feminine feminine, from the root יָצָא.

units.la: בִּמְצָאָם, vel בִּמְצַאֲכֶם in inveniendo vos, pro בִּמְצָאֲכֶם, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. מָצָא.
units.tr: Bimtsaam, or bimtsa'khem, in finding you (in inveniendo vos), for bimtsa'khem, infinitive Kal with prefix and suffix, from the root מָצָא.

units.la: מוֹצְאָה inveniens, מוֹצְאוֹת invenientes, &c. Ben. Kal, f. & pl. fem. Rad. מָצָא.
units.tr: Mots'ah, finding (inveniens), mots'oth, finding (invenientes), etc. Participle Kal, feminine and plural feminine, from the root מָצָא.

units.la: מוּצָאת educebatur, pro מוּצָאת, Part. Hoph. sing. fæm. Rad. יָצָא.
units.tr: Mutsaath, was being brought out (educebatur), for mutsaath, participle Hophal singular feminine, from the root יָצָא.

units.la: מֻצָּק fusum, Part. Hoph. f. m. R. יָצַק.
units.tr: Mutsaq, poured (fusum), participle Hophal feminine masculine, from the root יָצַק.

units.la: מוֹקֵד focus, מוֹקְדֵי ardores, מוֹקְדָה adustio, No. f. & pl. m. & No. f. f. R. יָקַד arsit.
units.tr: Moked, hearth (focus), mokde, burnings (ardores), mokdah, burning (adustio), noun feminine and plural masculine, and noun feminine feminine, from the root יָקַד, he burned.

units.la: מוּצָקוֹת infundibula, בְּמֻצְקֵי בְּמִצְקָתוֹ in fusura ejus, No. pl. f. & f. f. מוּצָקֹת praef. aff. R. יָצַק fudit. מוּקָעִים suspensi, Part. Hoph. pl. m. Rad. יָקַע מוֹרָא timor, (vel pro eo, מוֹרָה ,) מוֹרָאוֹ ejus, מוֹרָאִים terrores, &c. No. f. m. aff. & pl. m. Rad. יָרָא timuit. מוֹרָאָה exhibita est tibi videnda, ingluvies, pro מַרְאָה, Part.Hoph. f. faem. vel No. f. f. R. רָאָה מוֹרָאִים jaculantes, pro מוֹרִים, Part. Hiph. pl. m. à f. m. מוֹרָה ; R. יָרָה לְמוֹרָג in tribulam, No. f. m. praef. R. מָרַג. מוֹרָד descensus, No. f. m. R. יָרַד descendit. בְּמוֹרְדֵי, vel בִּמוֹרֵד inter rebellantes, Part. Ben. Kal, pl. m. constr. praef. R. מָרַד. מוֹרָה timor, pro מוֹרָא, No. sing. masc. Rad. יָרָא timuit. מוֹרָה novacula, No. f. fæm. R. מָרָה rebellis fuit. מוֹרָה docens, doctor, Part. Hiph. vel No. f. m. Rad. יָרָה. מוֹרַט depilatus, Part. Pual, f. m. R. מָרַט. מוֹרְטָה expolita est, pro מוֹרָטָה, praet. Pual, 3. f. fæm. à 3. f. m. מוֹרַט. vel Part. Pual, sing. fæm. R. מָרַט. מוֹרִי, vel מֹרִי myrrha mea, No. sing. m. aff. Rad. מוֹר mutare. מוֹרִיד demittens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. יָרַד. הַ־מוֹרִים jaculantes, (pro quo etiam, הַמּוֹרִאִים) כְּמוֹרְכָךְ tui, &c. Part. Hiph. pl. m. aff. Rad. יָרָה. מוֹרִישָׁם expellens, מוֹרִישָׁם eos, Part. Hiph. f. m. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ. מוֹרָשׁ , מוֹרָשׁ hereditas , מוֹרָשֵׁיהֶם hæreditates sue , מוֹרָשָׁה possessio , מוֹרָשֶׁת nomen loci, No. f. m. & pl. aff. ut & No. f. f. R. יָרַשׁ מוֹשָׁב habitatio , מוֹשָׁבִים מוֹשָׁבוֹת habitationes , No. f. m. & pl. m. & f. R. יָשַׁב מוֹשֵׁב , מוֹשְׁבִים Part. Hoph. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָשַׁב מוֹשִׁיב , vel מוֹשֵׁב , מוֹשִׁיבִי collocans , Part. Hiph. f. m. parag. Rad. יָשַׁב מוֹשִׁיעַ servans , מוֹשִׁיעֵיהֶם servatores eorum , &c. Part. Hiph. f. & pl. m. aff. R. יָשַׁע מוֹשָׁעוֹת salutes , No. pl. fæm. R. יָשַׁע מוֹת mori , mors , Infin. Kal ; vel, No. f. m. constr. אֶת־מוֹת , Rad. מוֹת mori. מוֹתִי mors mea, מוֹתוֹ ejus , מוֹתָם eorum , מוֹתֵנוּ nostra, &c. No. f. m. מוֹת , aff. R. מוֹת . מוֹתָר , מוֹתָר præstantia , No. f. m. R. יָתַר מוֹתִּי ? ad morte afficiendum , Infin. Piel, præf. R. מוּת . מוֹתַתְנִי morte affecit me , præt. Piel , 3. f. m. aff. מוֹתַתְנִי interfice me , Imper. Piel , sing. m. aff. מוֹתַתְנִי morte affeci , præt. Piel, 1. sing. Rad. מוּת .
units.tr: Mutsaqoth, funnels (infundibula), bemutsqe, bemitsqatho, in its casting (in fusura ejus), noun plural feminine and feminine feminine, mutsaqoth with prefix and suffix, from the root יָצַק, he poured. Muqa'im, hanged (suspensi), participle Hophal plural masculine, from the root יָקַע. Mora, fear (timor, or for it, morah), moro'o, his fear (ejus), mora'im, terrors (terrores), etc. Noun feminine masculine with suffix and plural masculine, from the root יָרָא, he feared. Mora'ah, it has been shown to you to be seen, gluttony, for marah, participle Hophal feminine feminine or noun feminine feminine, from the root רָאָה. Mora'im, hurling (jaculantes), for morim, participle Hiphil plural masculine, from the feminine masculine morah; root יָרָה. Lemorag, into a threshing sledge, noun feminine masculine with prefix, from the root מָרַג. Morad, descent (descensus), noun feminine masculine, from the root יָרַד, he descended. Bemorde, or bimored, among rebels (inter rebellantes), participle Kal, plural masculine construct with prefix, from the root מָרַד. Mora, fear, for mora', noun singular masculine, from the root יָרָא, he feared. Morah, razor (novacula), noun feminine feminine, from the root מָרָה, he rebelled. Morah, teaching, teacher (doctor), participle Hiphil or noun feminine masculine, from the root יָרָה. Morat, made bare (depilatus), participle Pual, feminine masculine, from the root מָרַט. Moroth, has been polished, for morath, preterite Pual, third person feminine feminine, from the third person feminine masculine morat; or participle Pual, singular feminine, from the root מָרַט. Mori, or mori, my myrrh (myrrha mea), noun singular masculine with suffix, from the root מוֹר, to change. Morid, letting down (demittens), participle Hiphil feminine masculine, from the root יָרַד. Ha-morim, hurling (jaculantes), (for which also hamora'im), kemorkha, your (tui), etc. Participle Hiphil plural masculine with suffix, from the root יָרָה. Morisham, dispossessing (expellens), morisham, them (eos), participle Hiphil feminine masculine with suffix, from the root יָרַשׁ. Morash, morash, inheritance (hereditas), moroshehem, their inheritances (haereditates suae), morashah, possession (possessio), morashet, name of a place (nomen loci), noun feminine masculine and plural with suffix, as also noun feminine feminine, from the root יָרַשׁ. Moshav, habitation (habitatio), moshavim, moshavoth, habitations (habitationes), noun feminine masculine and plural masculine and feminine, from the root יָשַׁב. Moshev, moshevim, participle Hophal feminine and plural masculine, from the root יָשַׁב. Moshiv, or mosheb, moshivi, placing (collocans), participle Hiphil feminine masculine with paragogic, from the root יָשַׁב. Moshia, saving (servans), moshi'eihem, their saviours (servatores eorum), etc. Participle Hiphil feminine and plural masculine with suffix, from the root יָשַׁע. Moshaoth, salvations (salutes), noun plural feminine, from the root יָשַׁע. Mot, to die, death (mors), infinitive Kal; or noun feminine masculine construct, et mot, from the root מוֹת, to die. Moti, my death (mors mea), moto, his (ejus), motam, their (eorum), moteinu, our (nostra), etc. Noun feminine masculine, mot, with suffix, from the root מוֹת. Motar, motar, excellence (praestantia), noun feminine masculine, from the root יָתַר. Moti? to be put to death, infinitive Piel with prefix, from the root מוּת. Motathni, he put me to death, preterite Piel, third person feminine masculine with suffix. Motathni, put me to death, imperative Piel, singular masculine with suffix. Motathi, I put to death, preterite Piel, first person singular, from the root מוּת.

Mezuzah, mezuzath doorpost; mezuzotham their; mezuzoth doorposts, etc., noun singular feminine with suffix and noun plural feminine. Root Zuz. Menezunu our storehouses, noun plural masculine with suffix, root [illegible]. [?] food, noun feminine masculine, root [?] to nourish. [?] wound, [?] his, noun feminine masculine with suffix, root [?] to be alienated. units.tr: R. R. צָוָה volvere (to roll), מְנַדֵּב fulgens (shining), participle Hophal, masculine, root צהב; מְצוּדָתְךָ binnitus tui (your humming), noun, plural feminine with suffix, root צָרָה binnivit (hummed). מְצוּדָה, or מָצוֹד, מְצוּדָה rete (net), מְצוּדָתִי meum (my), מְצוּדָתוֹ ejus (his), מְצוּדוֹת munitiones (fortifications), etc., noun, feminine masculine and feminine feminine with suffix and plural feminine, root צוד, or צוד. מְצוּדוֹת, or מְצוּדוֹת venantes (hunting), participle Piel, plural feminine, root צוד. מְצַוֶּה, construct מְצַוַּה præcipiens (commanding), participle Piel, feminine masculine, root צָוָה. מִצְוָה, construct מִצְוַת præceptum (commandment), מִצְווֹת præcepta (commandments), etc., noun, feminine and plural feminine, root צִוָּה præcepit (commanded). מָצוֹק situs (situation), מְצוּקָה angustia (distress), etc., noun, feminine masculine and feminine, root צוק arctari (to be confined). מְצוּדָה, מְצוּדָה munitio (fortification), etc., noun, feminine masculine and feminine, root צוד obsedit (besieged). מָצַב, מַצִּב constituens (setting up), מַצִּיל eripiens (rescuing), participle Hiphil, feminine masculine, root צִיל [?]. מְצִיץ effloresçens (blossoming), מְצִיץ co-arctans (constricting), participle Hiphil, singular masculine, root צִיץ and צוּץ. מְצִית exsufflisti [?], poetic Kal, active feminine feminine, root מָצָה [?]. מְצִיתָה succendens (kindling), participle Hiphil, feminine masculine, root יָצַת. מָצוּל ereptas (snatched away), participle Hophal; מַצִּיל eripiens (rescuing), participle Hiphil, feminine masculine, root צל [?]. מֵצֵל umbram faciens (casting shade), for מְצַל, participle Hiphil, feminine masculine, root צָלַל obumbrari (to be overshadowed). מְצִלּוֹת, מְצִלְּתַיִם tintinnabula (cymbals/bells), noun, plural feminine and dual, root צָלַל. הַמְּצַע stratum (bed/couch), noun, feminine masculine, root יצע. מְצַעֵק clamans (crying out), participle Piel, feminine masculine, root צעק. מְצַפֵּף pipiens (chirping), participle Piel, geminate, root צָפַף.
