units.la: מְרַגְּזִים commovens , commoventes , Part. Hiph. f. m. & pl. m. constr. Rad. רָגַז
units.tr: מְרַגְּזִים stirring, stirring ones, participle Hiph., fem. and masc. singular and masc. plural, construct; root רָגַז.

units.la: מְרַגְּלִים explorantes, Part. Piel, pl. masc. Rad. רָגַל.
units.tr: מְרַגְּלִים spying out, participle Piel, masc. plural; root רָגַל.

units.la: מִרְגְּלוֹתֵיו fragulae pedales ejus, No. pl. aff. R. רָגַל obtrectare.
units.tr: מִרְגְּלוֹתֵיו his foot-stools, noun, plural with suffix; root רָגַל to slander.

units.la: מְרַגְּמָה fundá, No. f. f. Rad. רָגַם lapidavit.
units.tr: מְרַגְּמָה sling, noun, fem.; root רָגַם stoned.

units.la: מְרָדָה a descendendo, Gen. 46.3. pro מְרָדָה, Infin. Kal, praef. Rad. יָרַד
units.tr: מְרָדָה from going down, Gen. 46. 3., for מְרָדָה, infinitive Kal, with prefix; root יָרַד.

units.la: הַמְּרִדּוּת rebellia, No. sing. fem. Rad. מָרַד rebellavit, unde etiam, No. f. m. מֶרֶד re-bellio.
units.tr: הַמְּרִדּוּת rebellion, noun, singular fem.; root מָרַד rebelled; whence also noun, fem. and masc., מֶרֶד rebellion.

units.la: מָרָה amara est, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. מָרַר.
units.tr: מָרָה is bitter, perfect Kal, 3rd fem. sing.; root מָרַר.

units.la: מָרָה amara, No. f. f. à f. m. מַר, vel מָר amarus, Rad. מָרַר.
units.tr: מָרָה bitter, noun, fem., from masc. מַר, or מָר bitter; root מָרַר.

units.la: מָרָה rebellis, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. R. מָרָה.
units.tr: מָרָה rebellious, participle Kal, fem. and masc.; root מָרָה.

units.la: מֹרָה, vel מוֹרָה jaculans, docens, doctor, Part. Hiph. vel, No. part. f. m. R. יָרָה.
units.tr: מֹרָה, or מוֹרָה darting, teaching, teacher, participle Hiph., or noun participle fem. and masc.; root יָרָה.

units.la: מָרוּ rebellarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. מָרָה.
units.tr: מָרוּ they rebelled, perfect Kal, 3rd plural; root מָרָה.

units.la: מָרוֹד rebellare, pro מָרָה Infin. Kal, R. מָרָה.
units.tr: מָרוֹד to rebel, for מָרָה, infinitive Kal; root מָרָה.

units.la: מָרוֹד exul, מְרוּדִים exules, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָרַד rebellavit.
units.tr: מָרוֹד exile, מְרוּדִים exiles, noun, fem. and masc. plural; root מָרַד rebelled.

units.la: מָרוּד ploratus, מְרוּדִים deplorati, מְרוּדָיו ploratus ejus, No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. מוּר dominatus est.
units.tr: מָרוּד lamentation, מְרוּדִים the lamented, מְרוּדָיו his lamentation, noun, fem. and masc. plural with suffix; root מוּר ruled.

units.la: מְרוָה irrigans, Part. Hiph.
units.tr: מְרוָה watering, participle Hiph.

units.la: מָרַח [?] atritus, No. f. m. Rad. מָרַח contrivit.
units.tr: מָרַח rubbed, noun, fem. and masc.; root מָרַח crushed.

units.la: מְרוּחִים perspirata, Part. Pual, pl. masc. Rad. רוּחַ.
units.tr: מְרוּחִים breathed through, participle Pual, masc. plural; root רוּחַ.

units.la: מְרוּמָה extersus, Pahal, Kal, f. f. R. מָרַט.
units.tr: מְרוּמָה wiped, Pahal, Kal, fem. and fem.; root מָרַט.

units.la: מְרוֹם altitudo, מְרוֹמִים altitudines, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. רוּם altum esse.
units.tr: מְרוֹם height, מְרוֹמִים heights, noun, fem. and masc. plural; root רוּם to be high.

units.la: מְרוֹמֵם extollens, Part. Piel, f. m. aff. Rad. רוּם.
units.tr: מְרוֹמֵם extolling, participle Piel, fem. and masc. with suffix; root רוּם.

units.la: מְרוֹמָם elatus, Part. Pual, f. m. R. רוּם.
units.tr: מְרוֹמָם exalted, participle Pual, fem. and masc.; root רוּם.

units.la: מְרוֹן cursus, No. f. m. Rad. רוּץ currere.
units.tr: מְרוֹן course, noun, fem. and masc.; root רוּץ to run.

units.la: מְרוּצָה concussio, cursus, מְרוּצֹתָם ipsorum, No. f. fæm. aff. Rad. רוּץ currere.
units.tr: מְרוּצָה shaking, course, מְרוּצֹתָם their courses, noun, fem. and fem. with suffix; root רוּץ to run.

units.la: מְרוּקִים positus, מְרוּקֵיהֶן munitiones ipsarum, Part. Pahal, Kal, f. m. & No. pl. m. R. מָרַק.
units.tr: Merukim, placed; Merukei hen, their fortifications; participle Pahal, Kal, feminine and masculine, and noun plural masculine. Root מָרַק.

units.la: [illegible, ~12 letters]
units.tr: [illegible, about 12 letters]

units.la: Ps. 78.17. pro לַהַמְרוֹת Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. מָרָה
units.tr: Ps. 78.17. for לַהַמְרוֹת, infinitive Hiphil with prefix. Root מָרָה.

units.la: מְרַזַּח curator funebris, item, מִרְזָח luxus funebris, constr. מִרְזַח, No. f. m. Rad. רָזַח inusit. רָזַח
units.tr: Merzach, a funeral overseer; also Mirzach, funeral luxury, construct Mirzach, noun feminine and masculine. Root רָזַח, not in use: רָזַח.

units.la: מְרִיחַ latitudo, & מְרְחָק longinquitas, No. f. m. Rad. רָחַב dilatari, & רָחַק procul esse.
units.tr: Merich, breadth, and merchak, remoteness, noun feminine and masculine. Root רָחַב, to be widened, and רָחַק, to be far off.

units.la: מְרֻחָם misericors; Part. Piel, f. m. R. רַחַם.
units.tr: Merchum, merciful; participle Piel, feminine and masculine. Root רַחַם.

units.la: מְרַחֶפֶת movens se, Part. Piel, f. f. R. רָחַף.
units.tr: Merchefet, moving itself, participle Piel, feminine. Root רָחַף.

units.la: מָרַט extersus est, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. & מֹרָט vel, מוּרָט depilatus, Part. Pual, vel No. Part. f. m. Rad. מָרַט depilavit.
units.tr: Marat, he was wiped clean, preterite Pual, third person feminine and masculine; and Morat or Murat, depilated, participle Pual, or participle noun, masculine. Root מָרַט, he plucked.

units.la: מָרְטָה expo[?]lita est, præt. Pual, 3. f. f. Rad. מֹרָטָה
units.tr: Mortah, she has been polished, preterite Pual, third person feminine. Root מֹרָטָה.

units.la: לִמְרָטָה ad expoliendum, Infin. Kal, præf. & parag. Rad. מָרַט.
units.tr: Limrata, for polishing, infinitive Kal, with prefix and paragogic ending. Root מָרַט.

units.la: מָרִי, & מְרִי rebellio, No. f. m. R. מָרָה rebellavit.
units.tr: Mari, and meri, rebellion, noun feminine and masculine. Root מָרָה, he rebelled.

units.la: מְרִיאִים saginatum, מְרִיאֵיכֶם pingues, מְרִיאֵיכֶם vestri, No. f. & pl. m. aff. R. מְרָא.
units.tr: Meriim, fattened; Merieikem, your fat ones; Meriekem, yours, noun feminine and plural masculine with suffix. Root מְרָא.

units.la: מְרִיב contendens; מְרִיבִי contendentes, מְרִיבָיו cum eo, Part. Hiph. f. m. & pl. m. aff. R. רוּב litigavit.
units.tr: Merib, contending; meriby, contending ones; meriv, with him, participle Hiphil, masculine singular and plural with suffix. Root רוּב, he disputed.

units.la: מְרִיבָה nomen loci, contentio, No. f. fæm. Rad. רוּב.
units.tr: Meriba, name of a place, strife, noun feminine. Root רוּב.

units.la: מָרִיד, vel מוּרִיד demittens, Part. Hiph. f. m. Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: Marid, or murid, causing to descend, participle Hiphil, masculine. Root יָרַד.

units.la: מְרִיבְךָ rebellio tua, בְּמְרִיכֶם rebellione sua, No. f. m. מְרִי, aff. Rad. מָרָה rebellavit.
units.tr: Meriberka, your rebellion; bimerikem, in their rebellion, noun masculine, Meri with suffix. Root מָרָה, he rebelled.

units.la: מְרִים amari, No. pl. m. à f. m. מַר amarus, Rad. מָרַר amarum esse.
units.tr: Merim, bitter things, noun plural masculine from מַר, bitter, root מָרַר, to be bitter.

units.la: מְרִים tollens, מְרִימֵי tollentes, מְרִימָיו tollentes eum, Part. Hiph. f. m. & pl. m. aff. רוּם. הַכּוֹרִים rebelles, Ben. Kal, pl. m. R. מָרָה הַמֹּהָם jaculantes, Part. Hiph. pl. m. R. יָרָה מְרִיעִים vociferantes, art. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. רוּעַ vel, potiùs, רִיעַ מְרִיקִים evacuantes, part. Hiph. plur. masc. Rad. רִיק מָרִיר amarus, No. f. m. Rad. מָרַר amarum esse, unde & No. f. fæm. מְרִירוּת amaritudo. כְּמְרִירֵי sicut amaritudines, No. pl. m. constr. præf. Rad. מָרַר; vel æstus, nigredines, No. pl. m. gem. à Rad. כָּמַר מַרְכָּה mollities, No. f. m. Rad. רָכַךְ molle esse. מַרְכָּב sedile, equitatus, מַרְכָּבָה currus, מַרְכָּבוֹת currûs, No. f. m. & f. & No. pl. f. R. רָכַב equitavit. בְּמַרְכֻּלָה in mercatu, No. f. fæm. מַרְכֹּלֶת, præf. aff. Rad. רָכַל mer-cator. מַרְכְּסֵי à perversitatibus, No. pl. m. constr. רְכְסֵי. præf. qu. à sing. מַרְכֵּס vel מַרְכָּס, Rad. רָכַס li-gavit. מִרְמָה fraus, מִרְמוֹת fraudes, No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. רָמָה projecit. מְרַע, מֵרַע, & רַע malefi-cus, malefaciens, No. vel Part. Hiph. f. m. Rad. רוּעַ malum esse. מְרֵעַ amicus, מְרֵעֵהוּ, & מְרֵעֵהוּ ejus, &c. No. f. m. aff. Rad. רָעָה pascere. מֶרַע, vel מָרַע à malo, No. f. m., רַע, vel רָע, præf. Rad. רוּעַ malum esse. מַרְעֵה pascuum, No. f. m. Rad. רָעָה pascere. מְרֵעִים malefici, Part.
units.tr: Merim, lifting up, Merimei, lifting up ones; Merimav, lifting him up, participle Hiphil, masculine singular and plural with suffix. Root רוּם. Hakorim, rebels, Ben Kal, plural masculine. Root מָרָה. Hamohem, throwing, participle Hiphil, plural masculine. Root יָרָה. Merii'im, shouting, participle Hiphil, plural masculine. Root רוּעַ, or rather רִיעַ. Merikim, emptying, participle Hiphil, plural masculine. Root רִיק. Marir, bitter, noun masculine. Root מָרַר, to be bitter, whence also the noun feminine Merirut, bitterness. Kemmerirei, like bitternesses, noun plural masculine construct with prefix. Root מָרַר; or heat, blackness, noun plural masculine, doubled from the root כָּמַר. Markah, softness, noun feminine. Root רָכַךְ, to be soft. Markav, seat, cavalry; Merkavah, chariot; Merkavot, chariots, noun masculine and feminine, and noun plural feminine. Root רָכַב, he rode. Bemarkulah, in the market, noun feminine, Markolet, with prefix and suffix. Root רָכַל, merchant. Markesei, from perversities, noun plural masculine construct, Rekesei, with prefix, questionably from the singular Markes or Markas. Root רָכַס, he bound. Mirmah, deceit; mirmot, deceits, noun feminine and feminine plural. Root רָמָה, he cast. Mera, Mera, and ra, evildoer, doer of evil, noun or participle Hiphil, feminine masculine. Root רוּעַ, to be evil. Mera, friend; merehu, and merehu his, etc., noun masculine with suffix. Root רָעָה, to feed. Mera, or mara, from evil, noun masculine, ra or ra, with prefix. Root רוּעַ, to be evil. Marhe, pasture, noun masculine. Root רָעָה, to feed. Merim, evildoers, participle

units.la: Hiph. vel No. pl. m. Rad. רָעַע[?] malum esse.
units.tr: Hiphil, or noun plural masculine. Root רָעַע, to be evil.

units.la: מְרֵעִים[?] socii, No. pl. m. Rad. רֵעָה.
units.tr: Merim, companions, noun plural masculine. Root רֵעָה.

units.la: מַרְעִית[?] pascuam, מַרְעִיתִי[?] meum, מַרְעִיתָם[?] ipsorum, &c. No. s. f. aff. R. רָעָה pascere.
units.tr: Mar'it, pasture; mar'iti, my pasture; mar'itam, their pasture, etc., noun singular feminine with suffix. Root רָעָה, to feed.

units.la: מַרְפָּא[?] remissas reddit; Jer. 38. 4 pro רָפָה Part. Piel, s. m. Rad. רָפָה.
units.tr: Marpa, he makes slack; Jeremiah 38.4, for רָפָה, participle Piel, singular masculine. Root רָפָה.

units.la: מַרְפָּא, & pro eo, מַרְפֵּה[?] sanatio, No. s. m. Rad. רָפָא curavit.
units.tr: Marpa, and for it Marpeh, healing, noun singular masculine. Root רָפָא, he healed.

units.la: הַמִּרְצַע subula, No. s. m. Rad. רָצַע perforavit.
units.tr: Hamir'a, awl, noun singular masculine. Root רָצַע, he pierced.

units.la: מְרֹרָה, & מְרָרָה, מְרֹרַת fel, מְרֹרָתוֹ è felle ejus, מְרֹרָתִי fel meum, מְרוֹרוֹת amaritudines, &c. No. s. f. constr. aff. & pl. f. Rad. מָרַר amarum esse.
units.tr: Merorah, and Mererah, Merorat, gall; merorato, from his gall; merorati, my gall; merorot, bitternesses, etc., noun singular feminine construct with suffix, and plural feminine. Root מָרַר, to be bitter.

units.la: הַמְּרַשָּׁעָה[?] improba, No. s. f. Rad. רָשַׁע improbum esse.
units.tr: Hamresha'ah, wickedness, noun singular feminine. Root רָשַׁע, to be wicked.

units.la: מָרָה amara, & מָרַת amaritudo, (cum Refch Dagefchato, Morrath,) No. s. f. constr. à s m. & f. מַר, amarus, מָרָה amara, Rad. מָרַר amarum esse.
units.tr: Marah, bitter, and Marat, bitterness (with Refch Dagesh, Morrath), noun singular feminine construct from singular masculine and feminine מַר, bitter, Marah, bitter. Root מָרַר, to be bitter.

units.la: מְרִיתִם rebelliones, No. du. fæm. Rad. מָרָה rebellavit, vel, est No. propr.
units.tr: Meritim, rebellions, noun dual feminine. Root מָרָה, he rebelled, or it is a proper noun.

units.la: מ ש
units.tr: Mem Shin

units.la: מָשׁ reoeffit, praet. Kal, 3. f. m. R. מוּשׁ.
units.tr: Mash, he departed, preterite Kal, third person singular masculine. Root מוּשׁ.

units.la: מַשָּׂא, & מַשָּׂאָה, constr. מַשַּׂאת onus, prophetia, מַשְׂאוֹת fercula, &c. No. f. m. & No. f. & pl. f. Rad. נָשָׂא tulit.
units.tr: Masa, and Masa'ah, construct Masat, burden, prophecy; Masa'ot, dishes, etc., noun feminine and masculine, and noun feminine and feminine plural. Root נָשָׂא, he bore.

units.la: מַשָּׂא acceptio, No. s. f. m. Rad. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: Masa, acceptance, noun singular feminine masculine. Root נָשָׂא.

units.la: מַשָּׂה, pro מַשָּׂה, & fæm. constr. מַשַּׂאת debitum, מַשְּׂאוֹת debita, No. f. m. & f. & pl. f. R. נָשָׂה oblitus fuit, mutuavit.
units.tr: Masah, for Masah, and feminine construct Masat, debt; Mas'ot, debts, noun masculine and feminine and feminine plural. Root נָשָׂה, he forgot, he lent.

units.la: מַשָּׁאוֹן deceptio, No. f. m. Rad. נָשָׁא. בְּמַשְׁאָן [?] in solitudine, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁאָה vastari. מַשְׁאוֹת [?], & מַשֵּׁאוֹת [?] vasti-tates, No. pl. fæm. Rad. שָׁאָה. מַשְׁאֵיהֶם à vastationibus ipsorum, No. pl. m. præf. & aff. qu. à f. m. שְׁאָה, Rad. שָׁאָה. מִשְׁאֲלוֹת petitiones, מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶיךָ tuæ, No. pl. f. aff. Rad. שָׁאַל petiit. מִשְׁאַרְתְּךָ mactra tua, מִשְׁאֲרוֹתֶיךָ mactræ tuæ, No. f. & pl. f. aff. à sing. fæm. מִשְׁאָרָה, Rad. שָׁאַר superesse. מַשָּׂאת onus, No. f. f. Rad. נָשָׂא. מַשָּׂאת ab elevando, מַשְּׂאָתוֹ de excellentia ejus, Infin. Kal, vel No. Infin. שָׂאת ferre, præf. & aff. Rad. נָשָׂא. מִשְׁבָּה aversu, aversio, מִשְׁבֹּתֵיהֶם aversiones ipsorum, No. f. & pl. fæm. aff. Rad. שׁוּב reמַשְׁבִּית cessare faciens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. שָׁבַת. מַשְׁבֵּר matrix, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁבַר fregit. מַשְׁגֶּה errare faciens, Part. Hiph. sing. m. sed, מִשְׁגֶּה error, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁגָה. מַשְׁגִּיא augens, Part. Hiph. f. m. R. שָׁגָא. מַשֶּׂגֶת assequatur, Part. Hiph. f. f. R. נָשַׂג. מַשָּׁרֵד vastans, Part. Piel, f. m. R. שָׁרַד. מַשֶּׁה mutuum dans, constr. מַשֵּׁה, Part. Hiph. f. m. Rad. נָשָׁה. מְשׁוֹאָה devastatio, No. f. f. Rad. שָׁאָה vastati. מְשׁוּבָּב restituens, redux, Part. Piel, f. m. & f. Rad. שׁוּב. מְשׁוּבַת perversitas, No. f. f. constr. R. שׁוּב. מְשִׁיָּה dispōnens, Part. Piel, cl, el, s. m. R. שָׁוָה æquari. מְשׁוּחַ unctus, Part. Pahul, Kal, & מְשׁוּחַ pictum, No. s. m. Rad. מָשַׁח unxit. מָשׁוּט remus, No. s. m. Rad. שׁוּט circuire. מְשׁוּט à peragrando, Infin. Kal, praef. Mesheitcha, oars, meshutcha, your oar, noun plural masculine with suffix. Root שׁוּט, to go about. Meshoch, draw out, imperative Kal, singular masculine. Root מָשַׁךְ. Meshol and mashol, ruling, infinitive Kal. Root מָשַׁל. Meshomem, desolating, participle Piel, singular masculine. Root שָׁמַם. Mesha'a, crying out, participle Piel, singular masculine. Root שָׁוַע. Meshuphti, from my judge, participle Kal, singular masculine with prefix and suffix. Root שָׁפַט. Mesor, saw, noun singular masculine. Root נָשַׁר. Mesor, from an ox, noun singular masculine with prefix. Root שׁוֹר, he sang. Mesorah, measure, noun singular feminine. Root שׁוֹר, he held the principate. Mesorer, singing, participle Piel, singular masculine. Root שׁוּר. Mashosh, joy, noun singular masculine. Root שׂוּשׂ, he rejoiced. Mashor, twisted, participle Hophal, singular masculine. Meshichtah, from corruption, noun singular feminine with prefix. Root שָׁחַת. Mishar, dawn, noun singular masculine. Root שָׁחַר, to grow dark. units.la: מְתַאֵּים concupiscentes, Part. Hitph. pl. m. à s. m. מִתְאַוֶּה, Rad. אָוָה concupiscit.
units.tr: מְתַאֵּים desiring, participle Hithpael, plural masculine, from the singular masculine מִתְאַוֶּה; root אָוָה he desires.

units.la: כְּמִתְאַנְּנִים sicut plan-gentes, Part. Hitph. pl. m. præf. Rad. אָנַן.
units.tr: כְּמִתְאַנְּנִים as those who lament, participle Hithpael, plural masculine, with prefix; root אָנַן.

units.la: מִתְאֵימוֹת gemelliparæ, Part. Hiph. plur. fæm. Rad. תָּאַם.
units.tr: מִתְאֵימוֹת twin-bearing women, participle Hiphil, plural feminine; root תָּאַם.

units.la: מִתְאַנָּה occasionem quæ-rens, Part. Hithp. sing. masc. Rad. אָנָה.
units.tr: מִתְאַנָּה seeking an occasion, participle Hithpael, singular masculine; root אָנָה.

units.la: הַמִּתְאָֽר qui describitur, Part. Pual, s. m. R. תָּאַר.
units.tr: הַמִּתְאָֽר one who is described, participle Pual, singular masculine; root תָּאַר.

units.la: מַתְבֵּן stramen, palea, No. s. m. à No. R. תֶּבֶן.
units.tr: מַתְבֵּן straw, chaff, noun, singular masculine, from the noun תֶּבֶן; root תֶּבֶן.

units.la: מִתְבַּסָּסָה conculcata, vel בּוֹס, Part. Hithp. s. f. Rad. בּוֹס.
units.tr: מִתְבַּסָּסָה trampled, or בּוֹס, participle Hithpael, singular feminine; root בּוֹס.

units.la: מִתְבָּרֵךְ benedicens sibi, Part. Hithp. s. m. R. בָּרַךְ.
units.tr: מִתְבָּרֵךְ blessing oneself, participle Hithpael, singular masculine; root בָּרַךְ.

units.la: מִתְנוֹרְדִים incidentes se, Part. Hithp. pl. m. Rad. נָרַד.
units.tr: מִתְנוֹרְדִים descending themselves, participle Hithpael, plural masculine; root נָרַד.

units.la: מִתְגּוֹרֵר commorans, disse-cans, Part. Hithp. s. m. R. גּוּר, vel, גָּרַר.
units.tr: מִתְגּוֹרֵר dwelling, dissecting, participle Hithpael, singular masculine; root גּוּר, or גָּרַר.

units.la: מִתְגּוֹלֵל volutans se, Part. Hithp. s. m. R. גָּלַל.
units.tr: מִתְגּוֹלֵל rolling oneself, participle Hithpael, singular masculine; root גָּלַל.

units.la: מִתְגָּרֶה à conflictu, No. s. f. תְּגָרָה conflictus, constr. præf. Rad. גָּרָה miscere.
units.tr: מִתְגָּרֶה from a conflict, noun, singular feminine; תְּגָרָה conflict, in construct, with prefix; root גָּרָה to stir up.

units.la: מֻתָּה mortuus es, præt. Kal; Kal, 2. f. m. ה, patag. Rad. מוּת, pro מָתַּה. מָתָה mortua fuit, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. vel Part. Kal, aut No. Part. f. f. R. מוּת. מְתַהֲלֵךְ ambulans, Part. Hithp. f. m. R. הָלַךְ. מִתְהַלֵּל jactans se, מִתְהַלְלִים jactantes se, Part. Hithp. f. & pl. m. Rad. הָלַל. מֵתוּ mortui sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. מוּת. מְתוֹדָה confitens, מְתוֹדִים confitentes, Part. Hithp. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָדָה. מְתַחְרָה miscens es, Jer. 22. 15. Part. Piel, sing. m. pro מְתַחֵר, à præt. Piel, quadr. תְּחֵרָה, vel תַּהֵר miscuit, Rad. תָּהַר. מֵתִי mortuus sum, pro מֻתִּי, præt. Kal, 1. sing. Rad. מוּת. מִתְיַהֲדִים Judaizantes, Part. Hithp. pl. m. à יְהוּדִי Judæus, in Rad. יָדָה jecit. מֵתִים, מֵתֵי mortui, Part. Kal, vel No. part. pl. m. Rad. מוּת מֵתֵי, מְתֵיהֶם homines, מְתַיו ejus, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. מָתָה. מְהַמְּתְכָּן dispositum, Part. Pual, f. m. R. תָּכַן. מִתְכְּנַת summa, dispositio, & מְתָכְּנָתוֹ ejus, No. f. fæm. aff. Rad. תָּכַן perpendit. מִתְפַּסִּים operti, Part. Hithp. pl. m. à f. m. מִתְכַּסָּה, Rad. כָּסָה. מַה תְּלָאָה quæ molestia? pro מַה־תְּלָאָה, No. f. f. Rad. לָאָה ægre ferre. מִתְלַהֲלָה insaniens, Part. Hithp. gem. f. m. Rad. לָהָה. מִתְלַעִים coccino induti, No. pl. m. à No. Rad. תּוֹלַע coccus. מִתְלְעוֹת molares dentes, (pro, מִלְתָּעוֹת,) & מִתְלְעוֹתָיו ejus, No. pl. fæm. transp. Rad. לָתַע[?]
units.tr: מֻתָּה you died, preterite Qal; Qal, second person feminine singular, with ה, paragogic; root מוּת, for מָתַּה. מָתָה she died, preterite Qal, third person feminine singular, or participle Qal, or noun participle feminine singular; root מוּת. מְתַהֲלֵךְ walking, participle Hithpael, feminine/masculine; root הָלַךְ. מִתְהַלֵּל boasting himself, מִתְהַלְלִים boasting themselves, participle Hithpael, feminine and masculine plural; root הָלַל. מֵתוּ they died, preterite Qal, third person plural; root מוּת. מְתוֹדָה confessing, מְתוֹדִים confessing, participle Hithpael, feminine and masculine plural; root יָדָה. מְתַחְרָה you mix, Jeremiah 22:15, participle Piel, singular masculine, for מְתַחֵר, from the preterite Piel quadriliteral תְּחֵרָה, or תַּהֵר he mixed; root תָּהַר. מֵתִי I died, for מֻתִּי, preterite Qal, first person singular; root מוּת. מִתְיַהֲדִים Judaizing, participle Hithpael, plural masculine, from יְהוּדִי Jew, in root יָדָה he threw. מֵתִים, מֵתֵי the dead, participle Qal, or noun participle, plural masculine; root מוּת. מֵתֵי, מְתֵיהֶם men, מְתַיו his, noun, plural masculine with suffix; root מָתָה. מְהַמְּתְכָּן arranged, participle Pual, feminine/masculine; root תָּכַן. מִתְכְּנַת sum, arrangement, and מְתָכְּנָתוֹ his, noun, feminine, with suffix; root תָּכַן he weighed. מִתְפַּסִּים covered, participle Hithpael, plural masculine, from the feminine noun מִתְכַּסָּה; root כָּסָה. מַה תְּלָאָה what trouble? for מַה־תְּלָאָה, noun, feminine; root לָאָה to bear with difficulty. מִתְלַהֲלָה raving, participle Hithpael, doubled, feminine/masculine; root לָהָה. מִתְלַעִים clothed in scarlet, noun, plural masculine, from a noun; root תּוֹלַע scarlet worm. מִתְלְעוֹת molar teeth, (for מִלְתָּעוֹת,) and מִתְלְעוֹתָיו his molars, noun, plural feminine, transposed; root <bl>לָתַע</bl>[?]

units.la: מְתֹם homo, No. f.m. Rad. מָתָה[?].
units.tr: mĕtōm, homo, noun, masc. and fem. Root מָתָה [?].

units.la: מְתֹם perfectio, No. f. m. Rad. תָּמַם absolvi.
units.tr: mĕtōm, perfection, noun, fem. and masc. Root תָּמַם, to be finished.

units.la: מִתְמַהְמַהִּי tardans, Part. Hithp. Rad. מָהַה[?].
units.tr: mithmahmahi, lingering, participle Hithpael, root מָהַה [?].

units.la: מַתָּנָה, מַתָּנוֹת donum, dona, No. f. m. & f. & pl. f. Rad. נָתַן dedit.
units.tr: mattanah, mattanoth, gift, gifts, noun masc. and fem. and plural fem. Root נָתַן, he gave.

units.la: מֹתָן mors ipsarum, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. מוּת.
units.tr: mōthan, the death of them, infinitive Kal with suffix, root מוּת.

units.la: מִתְנוֹסְסוֹת erectæ ut vexil-la, Part. Hithp. pl. fæm. Rad. נָסַס.
units.tr: mithnōsĕsōth, raised up like banners, participle Hithpael plural fem., root נָסַס.

units.la: מָתְנֵי, מָתְנַיִם lumbi, ejus, No. du. m. Rad. מָתַן.
units.tr: mothnei, mothnayim, loins, his, noun dual masc., root מָתַן.

units.la: לְמַתְעֵב abominanti, Part. Piel, f. m. R. תָּעַב.
units.tr: lĕmatʿēv, to one abhorring, participle Piel, fem. masc., root תָּעַב.

units.la: מְתַעוֹרֵר excitans se, Part. Hithp. f. m. R. עוּר.
units.tr: mĕtaʿōrēr, rousing himself, participle Hithpael fem. masc., root עוּר.

units.la: מְתַעִים sedacentes[?], Part. Hiph. pl. m. à f. m. מְתַעָה, Rad. תָּעָה.
units.tr: mĕtaʿim, misleading [?], participle Hiphil plural masc. and fem. masc., from מְתַעָה, root תָּעָה.

units.la: מִתְעֲרָה virescens, Part. Hithp. f. m. R. עָרָה.
units.tr: mithʿărāh, growing green, participle Hithpael fem. masc., root עָרָה.

units.la: nudari.
units.tr: nudari, to be made bare.

units.la: מְתַעִים sedurentes[?], 2 Par. 36. 16. pro, מְתַתְעִתְּעִים, Part. Hithp. gem. pl. R. תָּעָה.
units.tr: mĕtaʿim, deceiving [?], 2 Chron. 36. 16., for מְתַתְעִתְּעִים, participle Hithpael doubled plural, root תָּעָה.

units.la: מְתַפְּפוֹת tympana pulsantes, tympanistriæ, Part. Piel, vel No. Part. pl. fæm. Rad. תָּפַף.
units.tr: mĕtappĕpoth, playing the timbrel, timbrel-players, participle Piel, or noun participle plural fem., root תָּפַף.

units.la: לְמִתְּפְּרוֹת consuentibus[?], Part. Piel, pl. fæm. Rad. תָּפַר.
units.tr: lĕmitappĕroth, to those sewing, participle Piel, plural fem., root תָּפַר.

units.la: מִתְקוֹמֵם insurgens, Part. Hithp. f. m. Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: mithqōmēm, rising up, participle Hithpael fem. masc., root קוּם.

units.la: מִתְרוֹנֵן cantans, Part. Hithp. f. m. R. רָנַן.
units.tr: mithrōnēn, singing, participle Hithpael fem. masc., root רָנַן.

units.la: מִתְרַפִּים remisse segeren-tes, Part. Hithp. pl. m. à f. m. מִתְרַפָּה, Rad. רָפָה.
units.tr: mithrappim, acting remissly, participle Hithpael plural masc. and fem. masc., from מִתְרַפָּה, root רָפָה.

units.la: מִתְרַשֵּׁשׁ pauperem se fin-gens, Part. Hithp. f. m. R. רוּשׁ.
units.tr: mithrasshesh, feigning himself poor, participle Hithpael fem. masc., root רוּשׁ.

units.la: מַתָּה donum, sing. fæm. constr. No. מַתַּת, Rad. נָתַן dedit.
units.tr: mattah, gift, singular fem. construct, noun from מַתַּת, root נָתַן, he gave.

units.la: נא
units.tr: naʾ

units.la: נָא quaeso, nunc, crudum, Exod. 12. 9. Part. Rad. vel, ab אַנָּא quaeso, vel, No. f. m. Rad. נָא, vel, אַיִן [?] quo?.
units.tr: nāʾ, I pray, now, raw, Exod. 12. 9., participle, root, or from אַנָּא, I pray, or noun fem. masc., root נָא, or אַיִן [?], where?

units.la: נאבֶרָה peribimus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. אבר.
units.tr: nāʾbĕrāh, we shall perish, imperfect Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic ending, root אבר.

units.la: נאורות utres, No. pl. fæm. à f. m. No. Rad. נאר uter.
units.tr: nĕʾōroth, bottles, noun plural fem. from fem. masc. noun, root נאר, a bottle.

units.la: נארך parag. נאַרְדִי magnificus, Part. Niph. f. m. Rad. ארך.
units.tr: nĕʾardi, with paragogic ending, nĕʾardi, magnificent, participle Niphal fem. masc., root ארך.

units.la: הַנֶּאֱהָבִים dilecti, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. אהב.
units.tr: hanneʾĕhāvim, the beloved, participle Niphal plural masc., root אהב.

units.la: נאוה decora est, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. (cum ו, pro ה) Rad. נאוה pulchrum esse, vel, est præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אוה.
units.tr: nĕʾwāh, is comely, perfect Kal, 3rd person fem. sing. (with ו for ה), root נאוה, to be beautiful; or perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. sing., root אוה.

units.la: נאוה conveniens, נאוה decet, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. & fæm. Rad. (cum ו, pro 3. Rad. ה) נאוה vel, Part. Niph. f. m. & f. R. אוה.
units.tr: nĕʾwāh, fitting, nĕʾwāh, is becoming, participle Kal, fem. masc., root (with ו for the third radical ה) נאוה; or participle Niphal, masc. and fem., root אוה.

units.la: נאוו decoræ sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. (cum ו, pro ה,) Rad. נאוה; vel præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. אוה.
units.tr: nĕʾwō, they are comely, perfect Kal, 3rd person plural (with ו for ה), root נאוה; or perfect Niphal, 3rd person plural, root אוה.

units.la: נאור lucidus factus est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. m, vel, Part. Niph. f. m. R. אור.
units.tr: nĕʾōr, has become bright, perfect Niphal, 3rd person masc. sing., or participle Niphal fem. masc., root אור.

units.la: נאות caulæ, pro נוות, No. pl. fæm. à f. m. נוה, & sing. fæm. נוה; Rad. נוה inhabitavit.
units.tr: neʾoth, sheepfolds, for נוות, noun plural fem. from masc. נוה, and sing. fem. נוה; root נוה, he dwelt.

units.la: נאות acquiescemus, Gen. 34. 35. pro נאת parag. נאותה, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. יאת.
units.tr: neʾoth, we shall acquiesce, Gen. 34. 35., for נאת, with paragogic ending נאותה, imperfect Kal, 1st person plural, root יאת.

units.la: נאור accinctus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & נאור vel, נאור accinctus, Part. Niph. sing. m. Rad. אור.
units.tr: nāʾor, girded, perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc., and nāʾor, or nĕʾor, girded, participle Niphal masc. sing., root אור.

units.la: נאחז detentus fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & נֶאֱחָזוּ detentus, שֶׁנֶּאֱחָזִים qui capiuntur, Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. præf. Rad. אָחַז. נֶאֱחָזוֹ possessores facti, (cum א, quiesc. in Cholem, ut in fut.Kal, pro נֶאֱחָזוּ,) præt.Niph. 3. pl. R. אָחַז. נֶאְכַּל consumtus est, præt. Niph. 3.f.m.& הַנֶּאֱכֶלֶת quæ comeditur, Part. Niph. f. fæm. Rad. אָכַל. נֶאֱכָּל, vel, נֶאֱכַל נֶאֱכְלָה comedemus, וַנֶּאֱכְלֵהוּ & comedimus eum, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. & aff. R. אָכַל. נֶאֱלוּ stultescunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. יָאַל voluit. נֶאֱלַח fœtidus factus est, נֶאֱלְחוּ sunt, præt.Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. אָלַח נֶאֱלַם abmutuit, נֶאֱלְמִתִּי abmutui, præt. Niph. 3.f.m. & 1. f. R. אָלַם נֶאֱמָם dictum, pro, נֶאֱמָם, Part. Pahul Kal, vel No. Part. f. m. constr. Rad. נֶאֱמָם נֶאֱמָן firmus est, נֶאֱמָנָה firma est, נֶאֱמָנִי, & נֶאֱמָנוּ fideles sunt, præt.Niph, 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. Rad. אָמַן. נֶאֱמָן fidus, נֶאֱמָנָה, & נֶאֱמֶנֶת fidelis, נֶאֱמָנִים, נֶאֱמָנִי fidi, & נֶאֱמָנוֹת fidæ, &c. Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. & fæm. Rad. אָמַן nutrivit. לְנֶאֱמָנִים fidelibus, Part. Niph. pl. m. præf. vel est No. pl. m. præf. à Rad. אָמַן. נֶאֱמַר dictum fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. אָמַר נֶאֱמַר dicemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. אָמַר. נֶאֱנַח suspiravit, נֶאֱנְחוּ suspirârunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. אָנַח. נֶאֱנָחָה suspirabundus, gemens, גְּאָנִים gementes, Part. Niph. f. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad. אנה. וְהַנֶּאֱנָקִים & exclamantes, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. אנק. נֶאֱסַף congregatus fuit, נֶאֱסְפוּ fuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. אסף. נֶאֱסָף aggregatus, נֶאֱסָפִים congregati, Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. Rad. אסף. נֶאֱסֹף colligemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. Rad. אסף. נֶאְסְרָה vinciemus te, fut. Kal, 1. pl. aff. R. אסר. נֹאֵף adulterans, נֹאֵף adulterando, Ben. Kal, f. m. & Inf. Kal, Rad. נאף. נֶאְאָף adulteratus est, נֶאֱפָה adulterata est, נֶאֱפוּ adulterantur, &c. præt. Piel, 3. sing. m. & f. & 3. pl. Rad. נאף. נְאוּפֶיהָ adulteria ejus, No. pl. m. aff. R. נאף. נֵאֲפִים adulteria, נֵאֲפֶיךָ tua, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. נאף adulteravit. נָאַף irritando, 2 Sam. 12. 14. pro נָאַץ, Inf. Piel, R. נאץ. נָאַץ irritavit, pro נָאַץ, נִאֲצוּנִי irritaverunt me, præt. Piel, 3. sing. m. & 3. pl. aff. Rad. נאץ. נַאֲצָה irritatio contumeliosa, No. f. fæm. R. נאץ. נָאֲצוּ spreverunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נאץ. נַאֲצוֹתֶיךָ contumeliæ, tuæ, No. pl. f. aff. Rad. נאץ. נָאַץ sepositus fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נאל. נַאֲקָתָם clamor eorum, נַאֲקוֹת clamores, f. fæm. aff. & pl. fæm. No. f. f. Rad. נאק gemuit. נָאַץ, vel, נָאָצָה detestatus est, נְאֻצָתָה detestatus es, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. & 2. f. m. parag. Rad. נָאַר. נֵאָרְבָה[?] insidiemur, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. אָרַב. נֵאָרִים maledicti, pro נְאָרִים, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. אָרַר. וְנִשְׁאַרְתִּי[?] & reliquus fui ego, Ezech. 9. 8. (pro, נִשְׁאַרְתִּי, vel, אֲנִי נִשְׁאָר, epenth. א) 1. f. præt. Niph. vel, Part. Niph. f. m. cum Pronom. 1. perf. sing. vel est comp. ex præt. Niph. נִשְׁאַי, & fut. Kal, אֶשְׁאַר &c. vide Lex. vel est pro אֶשְּׁאַר, fut. Niph. 1. f. Rad. שָׁאַר. נֵאָשֵׁם rei erimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. אָשַׁם. נֶאְשְׁמוּ desolantur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. אָשַׁם.
units.tr: נאחז detentus fuit, perfect Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular and masculine; נֶאֱחָזוּ detentus (they were held), and שֶׁנֶּאֱחָזִים qui capiuntur (those who are seized), Participle Niphal, feminine and masculine plural, with prefix; root אָחַז. נֶאֱחָזוֹ possessores facti (they became possessors), (with א, quiescent in Cholem, as in the future Kal, for נֶאֱחָזוּ), perfect Niphal 3rd person plural; root אָחַז. נֶאְכַּל consumtus est (he was consumed), perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine and masculine; and הַנֶּאֱכֶלֶת quæ comeditur (which is eaten), Participle Niphal feminine; root אָכַל. נֶאֱכָּל, or, נֶאֱכַל נֶאֱכְלָה comedemus (we shall eat), וַנֶּאֱכְלֵהוּ and comedimus eum (we eat him), future Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic and affixed forms; root אָכַל. נֶאֱלוּ stultescunt (they become foolish), perfect Niphal 3rd person plural; root יָאַל voluit (he willed). נֶאֱלַח fœtidus factus est (he became foul-smelling), נֶאֱלְחוּ sunt (they are), perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine and masculine and 3rd person plural; root אָלַח. נֶאֱלַם abmutuit (he became dumb), נֶאֱלְמִתִּי abmutui (I became dumb), perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine and masculine and 1st person feminine; root אָלַם. נֶאֱמָם dictum (said), for נֶאֱמָם, Participle Pahul Kal, or Noun Participle feminine masculine construct; root אָמַם. נֶאֱמָן firmus est (he is firm), נֶאֱמָנָה firma est (she is firm), נֶאֱמָנִי, and נֶאֱמָנוּ fideles sunt (they are faithful), perfect Niphal, 3rd person feminine and masculine and feminine and 3rd person plural; root אָמַן. נֶאֱמָן fidus (faithful), נֶאֱמָנָה, and נֶאֱמֶנֶת fidelis (faithful), נֶאֱמָנִים, נֶאֱמָנִי fidi (faithful ones), and נֶאֱמָנוֹת fidæ (faithful women), etc. Participle Niphal feminine and plural masculine and feminine; root אָמַן nutrivit (he nourished). לְנֶאֱמָנִים fidelibus (to the faithful), Participle Niphal plural masculine with prefix, or is a Noun plural masculine with prefix from root אָמַן. נֶאֱמַר dictum fuit (it was said), perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine and masculine; root אָמַר. נֶאֱמַר dicemus (we shall say), future Kal, 1st person plural; root אָמַר. נֶאֱנַח suspiravit (he sighed), נֶאֱנְחוּ suspirârunt (they sighed), perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine and masculine and 3rd person plural; root אָנַח. נֶאֱנָחָה suspirabundus, gemens (sighing, groaning), גְּאָנִים gementes (groaning ones), Participle Niphal feminine and masculine and feminine and plural masculine; root אנה. וְהַנֶּאֱנָקִים and exclamantes (and crying out), Participle Niphal plural masculine; root אנק. נֶאֱסַף congregatus fuit (he was gathered), נֶאֱסְפוּ fuerunt (they were), perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine and masculine and 3rd person plural; root אסף. נֶאֱסָף aggregatus (gathered), נֶאֱסָפִים congregati (gathered ones), Participle Niphal feminine and plural masculine; root אסף. נֶאֱסֹף colligemus (we shall gather), future Kal, 1st person plural; root אסף. נֶאְסְרָה vinciemus te (we shall bind you), future Kal, 1st person plural with affix; root אסר. נֹאֵף adulterans (committing adultery), נֹאֵף adulterando (in committing adultery), Participle Kal masculine and Infinitive Kal; root נאף. נֶאְאָף adulteratus est (he was made an adulterer), נֶאֱפָה adulterata est (she was made an adulteress), נֶאֱפוּ adulterantur (they are made adulterers), etc., perfect Piel, 3rd person singular masculine and feminine and 3rd person plural; root נאף. נְאוּפֶיהָ adulteria ejus (her adulteries), Noun plural masculine with suffix; root נאף. נֵאֲפִים adulteria (adulteries), נֵאֲפֶיךָ tua (your adulteries), Noun plural masculine with suffix; root נאף. adulteravit (he committed adultery). נָאַף irritando (provoking), 2 Sam. 12. 14., for נָאַץ, Infinitive Piel; root נאץ. נָאַץ irritavit (he provoked), for נָאַץ, נִאֲצוּנִי irritaverunt me (they provoked me), perfect Piel, 3rd person singular masculine and 3rd person plural with suffix; root נאץ. נַאֲצָה irritatio contumeliosa (reproachful provocation), Noun feminine; root נאץ. נָאֲצוּ spreverunt (they despised), perfect Kal, 3rd person plural; root נאץ. נַאֲצוֹתֶיךָ contumeliæ tuæ (your reproaches), Noun plural feminine with suffix; root נאץ. נָאַץ sepositus fuit (he was set apart), perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine and masculine; root נאל. נַאֲקָתָם clamor eorum (their cry), נַאֲקוֹת clamores (cries), Noun feminine with suffix and plural feminine Noun feminine; root נאק gemuit (he groaned). נָאַץ, or, נָאָצָה detestatus est (he despised), נְאֻצָתָה detestatus es (you despised), perfect Piel, 3rd person feminine and masculine and 2nd person feminine and masculine with paragogic; root נָאַר. נֵאָרְבָה[?] insidiemur (we shall lie in wait), future Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic; root אָרַב. נֵאָרִים maledicti (cursed ones), for נְאָרִים, Participle Niphal plural masculine; root אָרַר. וְנִשְׁאַרְתִּי[?] et reliquus fui ego (and I was left), Ezek. 9. 8. (for נִשְׁאַרְתִּי, or אֲנִי נִשְׁאָר, with epenthetic א), 1st person feminine perfect Niphal or Participle Niphal feminine masculine with 1st person singular pronoun; or it is compounded from perfect Niphal נִשְׁאַי and future Kal אֶשְׁאַר etc.; see Lexicon. Or it is for אֶשְּׁאַר, future Niphal 1st person feminine; root שָׁאַר. נֵאָשֵׁם rei erimus (we shall be guilty), future Kal, 1st person plural; root אָשַׁם. נֶאְשְׁמוּ desolantur (they are made desolate), perfect Niphal 3rd person plural; root אָשַׁם.

units.la: נ ב נָא, vel נְבוֹאָה, נָבוֹא veniemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. בּוֹא. נָבָא prophetavit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. vel, Part. Niph. f. m. R. נָבָא. נְבִיאִים, & נְבִיאִים, prophetantes, Part. Niph. pl. R. נָבָא. נְבִיאִים prophetæ, pro נְבִיאִים, pl. m. No. נְבִיא; Rad. נָבָא prophetavit. נִבְאַשׁ fœtidus factus est, נִבְאֲשׁוּ fœtidi facti sunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3 pl. R. בָּאַשׁ. נִבְּגַד perfidè agemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. בָּגַד. נִבְדַּל separavit se, נִבְהַל turbatus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. בָּדַל, & בָּהַל. נִבּוּב, נָבוּב evacuatus, pro נָבוּב, Part. Niph. Rad. inusit. בּוּב. נִבְּזָה prædemur, 1. Sam. 14. 36. pro נִבָּזָה, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. pro נִבּוֹז, Rad. בָּזַז. נִבּוֹכָה perplexa est, præt. vel part. Niph. f. f.
units.tr: nB nāʾ, or nĕbōʾāh, nābōʾ, we shall come, imperfect Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic ending, root בּוֹא. Nābāʾ, he prophesied, perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc., or participle Niphal fem. masc., root נָבָא. Nĕbiʾīm and nĕbiʾīm, prophesying, participle Niphal plural, root נָבָא. Nĕbiʾīm, prophets, for nĕbiʾīm, noun plural masc., from נְבִיא; root נָבָא, he prophesied. Nibʾash, became fetid, nibʾăshū, they became fetid, perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc. and 3rd person plural, root בָּאַשׁ. Nibbĕgad, we shall act treacherously, imperfect Kal, 1st person plural, root בָּגַד. Nibdal, he separated himself, nibhal, was troubled, perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc., root בָּדַל and בָּהַל. Nibbūb, nāḇūb, emptied, for nāḇūb, participle Niphal, root not in use, בּוּב. Nibbāzāh, let us plunder, 1 Sam. 14. 36., for nibbāzāh, imperfect Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic ending, for nibbōz, root בָּזַז. Nibbōḵāh, she is perplexed, perfect or participle Niphal fem. fem.

units.la: Rad. בּוּק.
units.tr: Rad. בּוּק. (Root בּוּק.)

units.la: נָבוֹן intelligens, נְבוֹנִים intelligentes, Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. Rad. בִּין.
units.tr: נָבוֹן intelligens [nābôn, understanding], נְבוֹנִים intelligentes [nebônîm, understanding (plural)], Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. Rad. בִּין.

units.la: נְבוֹנוֹתִי intellexi, 1. f. praet. Niph. R. בִּין.
units.tr: נְבוֹנוֹתִי intellexi [nebônôtî, I understood], 1. f. praet. Niph. R. בִּין.

units.la: נִבּוּ conculcabimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. בּוּס.
units.tr: נִבּוּ conculcabimus [nibbû, we shall trample down], fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. בּוּס.

units.la: נָבְזוּ direpti sunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּזַז.
units.tr: נָבְזוּ direpti sunt [nobzû, they were plundered], praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּזַז.

units.la: נִבְזִים contempti, Part. Niph. pl. m. R. בָּזָה.
units.tr: נִבְזִים contempti [nibzîm, despised], Part. Niph. pl. m. R. בָּזָה.

units.la: נִבְחָרָה eligamus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. בָּחַר; Niph. נִבְחַר electus est.
units.tr: נִבְחָרָה eligamus [nibḥārāh, let us choose], fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. בָּחַר; Niph. נִבְחַר electus est [nibḥar, he was chosen].

units.la: וְנִבַּט & intuebitur, praet. Niph. vel Piel, 3. f. m. Rad. נָבַט.
units.tr: וְנִבַּט & intuebitur [wenibbaṭ, and he will look], praet. Niph. vel Piel, 3. f. m. Rad. נָבַט.

units.la: נָבִיא propheta, נְבִיאִים, נְבִיאֵי prophetae, נְבִיאָה prophetissa, & נְבוּאָה prophetia, No. f. & pl. m. ut & No. sing. fæm. Rad. inusit. in Kal, נָבָא sed in Niph. נִבָּא prophetavit, נִבְּא prophe-tarunt, & in Piel, נִבֵּא &c.
units.tr: נָבִיא propheta [nāḇî, prophet], נְבִיאִים, נְבִיאֵי prophetae [nebî'îm, nebî'ê, prophets], נְבִיאָה prophetissa [nebî'āh, prophetess], & נְבוּאָה prophetia [nebû'āh, prophecy], No. f. & pl. m. ut & No. sing. fæm. Rad. inusit. in Kal, נָבָא sed in Niph. נִבָּא prophetavit [nibbā', he prophesied], נִבְּאוּ prophetarunt [nibbə'û, they prophesied], & in Piel, נִבֵּא &c. [nibbē', etc.]

units.la: נָבִיא afferemus, וַנְּבִיאֵם et adducemus eos, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. בּוֹא, in praet. Hiph. הֵבִיא adduxit.
units.tr: נָבִיא afferemus [nāḇî', we shall bring], וַנְּבִיאֵם et adducemus eos [wannəḇî'ēm, and we shall bring them], fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. בּוֹא; in praet. Hiph. הֵבִיא adduxit [hēḇî', he brought].

units.la: נִבּוּכָה perplexa sunt, נִבּוּכָה perplexa est, praet. Niph. 3. pl. & 3. f. f. Rad. בּוּךְ.
units.tr: נִבּוּכָה perplexa sunt [nibbûkāh, they were perplexed], נִבּוּכָה perplexa est [nibbûkāh, she was perplexed], praet. Niph. 3. pl. & 3. f. f. Rad. בּוּךְ.

units.la: נִבְכִים perplexi, pro נִבְּכִים, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. בּוּךְ.
units.tr: נִבְכִים perplexi [nibkîm, perplexed], pro נִבְּכִים, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. בּוּךְ.

units.la: נִבְּכִי fluenta, Part. Niph. pl. m. constr. Rad. נָבְכָה.
units.tr: נִבְּכִי fluenta [nibbəḵê, streams], Part. Niph. pl. m. constr. Rad. נָבְכָה.

units.la: וַנִּבָּל & decidimus, Jes. 64.6. fut. Hiph. 1. pl. (pro וַנַּבִּל,) Rad. נָבַל.
units.tr: וַנִּבָּל & decidimus [wannibbāl, and we shall fall], Jes. 64.6. fut. Hiph. 1. pl. (pro וַנַּבִּל,) Rad. נָבַל.

units.la: נִבְלָה concidit, praet. Kal, 3. f. f. R. נָבַל.
units.tr: נִבְלָה concidit [niblāh, he fell], praet. Kal, 3. f. f. R. נָבַל.

units.la: וַנִּבְלָה & confundamus, Gen. 11.7. fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. (pro נִבְלָה) vel confundantur, pro נִבְלָה, praet. Niph. 3. perf. f. f. uti vult Kimchi. chi, R. בָּלַל confudit.
units.tr: "And let us confound" (Gen. 11.7), future Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic nun (for נִבְלָה), or "let them be confounded," for נִבְלָה, perfect Niphal 3rd person feminine singular, as Kimchi wishes. The root בָּלַל, he confounded.

units.la: וְנִבְלֵי & utres, pl. m. constr. No. נְבָל, Rad. נָבַל cecidit.
units.tr: "And skins" (utres), masculine plural construct of נְבָל; root נָבַל, he fell.

units.la: נִבְלַע absorbentur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּלַע.
units.tr: נִבְלַע absorbentur [niblaʿ, they are swallowed up], praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּלַע.

units.la: נִבְלַת cadaver, s. fæm. constr.No. נִבְלַת, Rad. נָבַל cecidit.
units.tr: "Carcass" (cadaver), feminine singular construct, of נִבְלַת; root נָבַל, he fell.

units.la: נִבְלָתָה stultitia ejus, No. sing. fæm. cum aff. Rad. נָבַל.
units.tr: "Her folly" (stultitia ejus), feminine singular noun with suffix; root נָבַל.

units.la: וְנִבְלֹתִיךָ & turpitudine afficiam te, præt. Piel, 1. sing. aff. Rad. נָבַל [?].
units.tr: וְנִבְלֹתִיךָ & turpitudine afficiam te [wənivlōtîḵā, and I will bring shame upon you], praet. Piel, 1. sing. aff. Rad. נָבַל [?].

units.la: נִבְנֶה ædificabimus, ædificatus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. vel Part. Niph. s. m. Rad. בָּנָה.
units.tr: נִבְנֶה ædificabimus [nibneh, we shall build], ædificatus [built], fut. Kal, 1. pl. vel Part. Niph. s. m. Rad. בָּנָה.

units.la: נִבְנוּ ædificatus fuit, ædificantur, נִבְנִית ædificata es, נִבְנָתָה est, præt. Niph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. ut & 2. s. f. & 3. s. f. R. בָּנָה.
units.tr: נִבְנוּ ædificatus fuit [nibnû, they were built], ædificantur [they are built], נִבְנִית ædificata es [nibnît, you were built], נִבְנָתָה est [nibnātāh, she was built], praet. Niph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. ut & 2. s. f. & 3. s. f. R. בָּנָה.

units.la: נִבְעָה tumens, Part. Niph. s. m. & נִבְשׁ perquirun-tur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּעָה bullavit.
units.tr: נִבְעָה tumens [nibʿāh, swelling], Part. Niph. s. m. & נִבְשׁ perquirun-tur [nibʿû, they are searched out], praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. בָּעָה bullavit [bubbled].

units.la: נִבְעַר obbrutescit ille, illa, נִבְעֲרוּ obbrutuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. R. בָּעַר.
units.tr: נִבְעַר obbrutescit ille [nibʿar, he becomes brutish], illa [she becomes brutish], נִבְעֲרוּ obbrutuerunt [nibʿărû, they became brutish], praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. R. בָּעַר.

units.la: נְבַעֲרָה tollamus, fut. Piel, 1. plur. parag. Rad. בָּעַר.
units.tr: נְבַעֲרָה tollamus [nəḇaʿărāh, let us take away], fut. Piel, 1. plur. parag. Rad. בָּעַר.

units.la: נִבְעָתִי territus fuit, perturbatus fui, pro נִבְעָתִי, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 1. sing. Rad. בָּעַת.
units.tr: נִבְעָתִי territus fuit [nivʿātî, he was terrified], perturbatus fui [I was dismayed], pro נִבְעָתִי, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 1. sing. Rad. בָּעַת.

units.la: וְנִבְקָה & evacuata fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. f. (pro נִבְקָה,) Rad. בָּקַק.
units.tr: וְנִבְקָה & evacuata fuit [wənibqāh, and it was emptied], praet. Niph. 3. f. f. (pro נִבְקָה,) Rad. בָּקַק.

units.la: וְתַבְקִיעֶנָּה & findemus eam, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. בָּקַע.
units.tr: וְתַבְקִיעֶנָּה & findemus eam [wənivqîʿennāh, and we shall split it], fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. בָּקַע.

units.la: נִבְקְשֶׁנּוּ quæremus eum, fut. Piel, 1. plur. aff. Rad. בָּקַשׁ.
units.tr: נִבְקְשֶׁנּוּ quæremus eum [nivqəšennû, we shall seek him], fut. Piel, 1. plur. aff. Rad. בָּקַשׁ.

units.la: נִבְרָא creatus est, נִבְרְאוּ creata fuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. (vel Part. Niph. f. m.) ut & 3. pl. Rad. בָּרָא.
units.tr: נִבְרָא creatus est [nivrā', he was created], נִבְרְאוּ creata fuerunt [nivrəʾû, they were created], praet. Niph. 3. f. m. (vel Part. Niph. f. m.) ut & 3. pl. Rad. בָּרָא.

units.la: נִבְרֵאת [?] creata fuisti, præt. Niph. 2. sing. fem. Rad. בָּרָא.
units.tr: נִבְרֵאת [?] creata fuisti [nivrēʾt, you were created], praet. Niph. 2. sing. fem. Rad. בָּרָא.

units.la: וְנִבְרְחָה [?] & fugiamus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. בָּרַח.
units.tr: וְנִבְרְחָה [?] & fugiamus [wənivrəḥāh, and let us flee], fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. בָּרַח.

units.la: וְנְבָרֵךְ [?] benedicemus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. & נִבְרָכָה genua flectamus, (pro נִבְרֵךְ) fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. בָּרַךְ.
units.tr: וְנְבָרֵךְ [?] benedicemus [wənevārēḵ, we shall bless], fut. Piel, 1. pl. & נִבְרָכָה genua flectamus [nivrāḵāh, let us bend the knee], (pro נִבְרֵךְ) fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. בָּרַךְ.

units.la: וְנִבְרְכוּ [?] & benedicentur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. בָּרַךְ.
units.tr: וְנִבְרְכוּ [?] & benedicentur [wənivrəḵû, and they shall be blessed], praet. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. בָּרַךְ.

units.la: נָבָר purificatus, (contracte pro נִבְרָךְ,) Part. Niph. sing. m. Rad. בָּרַר.
units.tr: purificatus, (contracted for נִבְרָךְ,) participle Niphal, singular masculine. Root בָּרַר.

units.la: נְבַשֵּׁל coquemus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. R. בָּשַׁל.
units.tr: נְבַשֵּׁל coquemus [nəḇaššēl, let us cook], fut. Piel, 1. pl. R. בָּשַׁל.

units.la: נ נ
units.tr: נ נ

units.la: נִגְאָלָה polluta est, præt. Niph. 3. sf. à s. m. נִגְאַל pollutus est, ut & נִגְאָלוּ contaminati sunt, Thren. 4. 14. comp. ex præt. Niph. & præt.
units.tr: נִגְאָלָה polluta est [niḡʾālāh, she was polluted], praet. Niph. 3. sf. à s. m. נִגְאַל pollutus est [niḡʾal, he was polluted], ut & נִגְאָלוּ contaminati sunt [they were defiled], Thren. 4. 14. comp. ex praet. Niph. & praet.

units.la: נָאַל Paal [?], 3. pl. Rad. נָאַל redemit.
units.tr: נָאַל Paal [?], 3. pl. Rad. נָאַל redemit [he redeemed].

units.la: לִנְגֶּבָה ad meridiem, No. נֶגֶב, Rad. cum præf. & ה locali.
units.tr: לִנְגֶּבָה ad meridiem [liněgḇāh, toward the south], No. נֶגֶב, Rad. cum præf. & ה locali.

units.la: וַנַּגֵּד & indicavimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. נָגַד.
units.tr: וַנַּגֵּד & indicavimus [wannaggēḏ, and we declared], fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. נָגַד.

units.la: נַגִּיד indicabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. נָגַד.
units.tr: נַגִּיד indicabimus [naggîḏ, we shall declare], fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. נָגַד.

units.la: נִגְרְשׁוּ [?] succisi sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. נָגַר [?].
units.tr: נִגְרְשׁוּ [?] succisi sunt [nigrəšû, they were cut off], praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. נָגַר [?].

units.la: נֹגָהֶם splendor ipsorum, No. sing. m. נֹגַהּ, aff. & לִנְגֹהוֹת ad splendores, No. pl. fæm. præf. Rad. נָגַהּ splenduit.
units.tr: נֹגָהֶם splendor ipsorum [nōḡāhem, their splendour], No. sing. m. נֹגַהּ, aff. & לִנְגֹהוֹת ad splendores [linḡōhôt, to the splendours], No. pl. fæm. præf. Rad. נָגַהּ splenduit [it shone].

units.la: נָגוֹהוּ [?] tonsi fuerunt, Nah. 1. 12. præt. Niph. 3. pl. pro נָגְזוּ, Rad. גָּזַז.
units.tr: נָגוֹהוּ [?] tonsi fuerunt [they were shorn], Nah. 1. 12. praet. Niph. 3. pl. pro נָגְזוּ, Rad. גָּזַז.

units.la: נָגוֹלוּ convoluti sunt, Jes. 34. 4. pro נָגְלוּ, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. גָּלַל.
units.tr: נָגוֹלוּ convoluti sunt [they were rolled up], Jes. 34. 4. pro נָגְלוּ, praet. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. גָּלַל.

units.la: נָגַע plagâ affectus, Paul Kal, s. m. R. נָגַע.
units.tr: נָגַע plagâ affectus [struck with a plague], Paul Kal, s. m. R. נָגַע.

units.la: נִרְאֶה minuentur, fut. Niph. 1. pl. R. נָרַע.
units.tr: נִרְאֶה minuentur [nirʾeh, they shall be diminished], fut. Niph. 1. pl. R. נָרַע.

units.la: נִגְרְשָׁה expellitur, præt. Niph. 3. f. f. R. נָרַשׁ.
units.tr: נִגְרְשָׁה expellitur [nigrəšāh, she is driven out], praet. Niph. 3. f. f. R. נָרַשׁ.

units.la: נִגַּשׁ adductus est, & נִגַּשׁ pressus fuit, נִגָּשִׁים accessistis, præt. Niph. 3. f. & 2. pl. m. R. נָגַשׁ, vel נָגַשׁ.
units.tr: נִגַּשׁ adductus est [niggaš, he was brought near], & נִגַּשׁ pressus fuit [he was pressed], נִגָּשִׁים accessistis [you approached], praet. Niph. 3. f. & 2. pl. m. R. נָגַשׁ, vel נָגַשׁ.

units.la: נִגְשָׁשָׁה palpabimus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. parag. Rad. נָשַׁשׁ.
units.tr: נִגְשָׁשָׁה palpabimus [nigšāšāh, we shall feel about], fut. Piel, 1. pl. parag. Rad. נָשַׁשׁ.

units.la: נ ד
units.tr: N D

units.la: נָד cumulus, נָד vagus, No. f. m. Rad. נוד vagari.
units.tr: Nad, cumulus; Nad, vagus; noun, masc. and fem. Root: nud, to wander.

units.la: נְדָבוֹת liberalitates, נִדְבוֹתֵיהֶם spontaneæ ipsorum, No. pl. f. aff. Rad. נָדַב.
units.tr: Nedavoth, liberalities; nidvotheihem, their voluntary gifts; noun, fem. pl., with suffix. Root: nadav.

units.la: נְדַבֵּר loquemur, נִדְבְּרוּ locuti sunt, נִדְבַּרְנוּ locuti fumus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. & præt. Niph. 3. & 1. pl. Rad. דָּבַר.
units.tr: Nidbar, we shall speak; nidberu, they have spoken; nidbarnu, we have spoken; future Piel, 1st pl., and perfect Niphal, 3rd and 1st pl. Root: dabar.

units.la: נְדַגֵּל vexillum erigemus, כְּנִדְגָּלוֹת sicut vexil-
units.tr: Nidgal, we shall raise a banner; kenidgalot, as banners

units.la: לאָתָא latæ copiæ, fut. Kal, 1. pl. & Part. Niph. pl. f. R. דָּגַל.
units.tr: lata, brought-up forces; future Kal, 1st pl., and participle Niphal, fem. pl. Root: dagal.

units.la: נָדְדוּ fugerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָדַד.
units.tr: Nadedu, they fled; perfect Kal, 3rd pl. Root: nadad.

units.la: נְדָּה separatio, נְדָּה merces meretricia, No. f. f. & No. f. m. Rad. in Piel, נִדָּה procul amovit.
units.tr: Nedah, separation; Nedah, harlot's wages; noun fem. and noun masc. Root, in Piel, nidah, he removed far away.

units.la: נִדְהָם defatigatus, Part. Niph. f. m. R. דָּהַם.
units.tr: Nidham, wearied out; participle Niphal, masc. sing. Root: daham.

units.la: נָדוּ emigrarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נוּד.
units.tr: Nadu, they emigrated; perfect Kal, 3rd pl. Root: nud.

units.la: נְדוּ migrate, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. נוּד.
units.tr: Nedu, migrate; imperative Kal, masc. pl. Root: nud.

units.la: נָדוֹן disceptans, & נָדוּשׁ tritturatur, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. דוּשׁ, & דִּין.
units.tr: Nadon, disputing, and nadush, is threshed; perfect Niphal, 3rd fem. or masc. Root: dush, and din.

units.la: נִדְחָה expulsus est, נִדְחָה depulsas, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. נָדַח.
units.tr: Nidhah, he was expelled; nidhah, cast out; perfect Niphal, 3rd fem. or masc., and participle Niphal, fem. or masc. Root: nadah.

units.la: נִדְחָה expulsa, נִדְחִים expulsi, נִדְחֵי nei, &c. Part. Niph. f. fæm. constr. & pl. m. aff. Rad. נָדַח.
units.tr: Nidhah, expelled; nidhim, expelled ones; nidhei, of the expelled, etc. Participle Niphal, fem. sing. construct and masc. pl. with suffix. Root: nadah.

units.la: נִדְחָה expulsa est, exexpulsus es, præt. Niph. 3. 1. f. & 2. f. m. Rad. נָדַח
units.tr: Nidhah, she is expelled; you were expelled; perfect Niphal, 1st sing., 3rd fem. sing., and 2nd masc. sing. Root: nadah.

units.la: נִדְּחוּ expulsus suus, 2 Sam. 14. 13. pro נִדְּחוֹ, & נִדָּחֶךָ tuus, pro נִדְּחֲךָ. Part. Niph. f. m. aff. Rad. נדח
units.tr: Nidchu, his expelled, 2 Sam. 14:13, for nidcho; and nidachekha, your expelled, for nidachka. Participle Niphal, masc. sing. with suffix. Root: nadah.

units.la: נִדְּחוּ depulsi fuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. נָדַח
units.tr: Nidchu, they were cast out; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. Root: nadah.

units.la: נִדְּחֵי expulsi, Part. Niph. pl. m. constr. Rad. נָדַח impulit.
units.tr: Nidchei, expelled; participle Niphal, masc. pl. construct. Root: nadah, he thrust.

units.la: נִדְּחֵי depulsi, Part. Niph. pl. m. constr. Rad. דָּחָה depulit.
units.tr: Nidchei, driven away; participle Niphal, masc. pl. construct. Root: dachah, he drove away.

units.la: נְדִי vagatio mea, No. f. m. נוֹד Nod, nomen regionis, aff. Rad. נוּד vagari.
units.tr: Nedi, my wandering; noun fem. masc., Nod, the name of a region, with suffix. Root: nud, to wander.

units.la: נְדִיבֵיהֶם principes eorum, pro נְדִיבֵיהֶם, pl. masc. constr. aff. No. נָדִיב, R. נָדַב sponte movit.
units.tr: Nedibeihem, their princes, for nedibeihem; masc. pl. construct with suffix. Noun nadiv, root nadav, he moved willingly.

units.la: נְדִיבָתִי spontanea mea, sing fæm. aff. No. נְדִיבָה Rad. נדב.
units.tr: Nedibathi, my voluntary; sing. fem. with suffix. Noun nedibah, root nadav.

units.la: נִדְכְּתִי contriti, Part. Niph. pl. masc. Rad. דָּכָא
units.tr: Nidketi, the contrite; participle Niphal, masc. pl. Root: dakah.

units.la: נִדְכָּה contritum, נִדְכֵּתִי attritus sum, Part. Niph. f. m. & præt. Niph. 1. f. Rad. דָּכָה attrivit se, in Niph. נִדְכָּה
units.tr: Nidkah, the contrite one, nidkethi, I am crushed; participle Niphal, fem. or masc., and perfect Niphal, 1st fem. Root: dakah, he crushed himself; in Niphal, nidkah.

units.la: נִדְמָה similis, Part. Niph. f. m. R. דָּמָה
units.tr: Nidmah, like; participle Niphal, fem. or masc. Root: damah.

units.la: וַנִּדְמָה & similes simus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. דָּמָה
units.tr: Vanidmah, and may we be like; future Kal, 1st pl. Root: damah.

units.la: וְנִדְמָה & silebimus, Jer. 8. 14. (pro נִדָּמִים, vel נִדְמָה, à 3. f. m. יָדִים,) fut. Niph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. דָּמַם silui.
units.tr: Venidmah, and we shall be silent, Jer. 8:14 (for nidmim, or nidmah, from the 3rd masc. yadim); future Niphal, 1st pl. with paragogic ending. Root: damam, I was silent.

units.la: נִדְמָה excindendo, Hos. 10 9. pro הַדְמָה, Infin. Niph. Rad. דָּמָה
units.tr: Nidmah, by cutting off, Hos. 10:9, for hadmah; infinitive Niphal. Root: damah.

units.la: נִדְמוּ conticuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. דָּמַם
units.tr: Nidmu, they fell silent; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. Root: damam.

units.la: נִדְמָה similes sunt, נִדְמָתָה excisa est, præt. Niph. 3. pl. & 3. f. f. Rad. דָּמָה
units.tr: Nidmah, they are like; nidmatah, she was cut off; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. and 3rd fem. sing. Root: damah.

units.la: נִדְמִיתָ similis factus es
units.tr: Nidmita, you were made like; perfect Niphal, 2nd fem. sing.

units.la: præt. Niph. 2. f. m. Rad. נָהָה[?]
units.tr: Perfect Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. Root: nahah[?].

units.la: נָרָתָה[?] vagina ejus, f. m. aff. No. R. נָרַן[?]
units.tr: Narathah[?], its sheath; noun fem. masc. with suffix. Root: naran[?].

units.la: נְרָתְךָ[?] pretiosa tua, pl. m. aff. No. pl. נְרָיִם, Rad. נָהָה separavit.
units.tr: Nerathkha[?], your precious things; masc. pl. with suffix, noun plural nerayim. Root: nahah, he separated.

units.la: נָרְעָה[?] cognoscemus, נָרָע[?] & navimus ea, נְרַעָם[?] & cognoscemus eum, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. & aff. Rad. יָדַע
units.tr: Nar'eh[?], we shall know; nara'a[?], and we shall know them; nera'am[?], and we shall know him; future Kal, 1st pl. with paragogic and suffix. Root: yada.

units.la: נָרַע cognitus est, נָרְעוּ sunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. יָדַע.
units.tr: Nara', he was known; nar'u, they are; perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing. and 3rd pl. Root: yada.

units.la: extinguuntur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. דָּעַךְ[?]
units.tr: they are extinguished; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. Root: da'ak[?].

units.la: נָדַף depulsus est, נָדַף depulsus, præt. Niph, 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. נָדַף
units.tr: Nadaf, it was driven away; nadaf, driven away; perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing., and participle Niphal, masc. sing. Root: nadaf.

units.la: נֶדֶר votum ejus, נְדָרָה[?] votatua, f. m. & pl. m. aff. No. נְדָר; Rad. נָדַר vovit.
units.tr: Nedar, his vow; nedarah[?], your vow; fem. and masc. pl. with suffix. Noun nedar; root nadar, he vowed.

units.la: נָדְרוּ voverunt, נִדְרוּ vovete, נִדְנוּ vovimus,
units.tr: Nedru, they vowed; nidru, vow; nidnu, we vowed;

units.la: לִנְדֹּר ad vovendum, præt. Kal, 3. pl. & Imper. pl. m. ut & præt. 1. pl. & Infin. Kal; Rad. נָדַר
units.tr: Lindor, to vow; perfect Kal, 3rd pl., and imperative masc. pl., as well as perfect Kal, 1st pl., and infinitive Kal. Root: nadar.

units.la: נִדְרַשְׁתִּי quæsitus sum, præt. Niph. 1. f. R. דָּרַשׁ.
units.tr: Nidrashti, I was sought; perfect Niphal, 1st fem. sing. Root: darash.

units.la: נְדָּרָה separatio, נְדָּתָה ejus, sing. f. constr. aff. No. נִדָּה; Rad. נָדָה separavit.
units.tr: Nedarah, separation; nedatah, her; sing. fem. construct with suffix. Noun nidah; root nadah, he separated.

units.la: נ ה
units.tr: N H

units.la: נָהָה lamentum, No. f. m. R. נָהָה lamentatus est.
units.tr: Nahah, lamentation; noun fem. masc. Root: nahah, he lamented.

units.la: נָהְגָּה meditabimur, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. הָגָה.
units.tr: Nehgeh, we shall meditate; future Kal, 1st pl. Root: hagah.

units.la: נָהֲגוּ abduxerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָהַג.
units.tr: Nahagu, they led away; perfect Kal, 3rd pl. Root: nahag.

units.la: נֶהְדְּרוּ honore afficiuntur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. הָדַר, Niph. נֶהְדָּר.
units.tr: Nehdru, they are honored; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. Root: hadar; Niphal, nehdar.

units.la: נֶהֵה ede lamentum. Imper. Kal, f. m. Rad. נָהָה.
units.tr: Neheh, raise a lament; imperative Kal, fem. sing. Root: nahah.

units.la: נָהִי; & נְהִיָּה lamentum, No. f. m. R. נָהָה.
units.tr: Nahi, and nehiyah, lamentation; noun fem. masc. Root: nahah.

units.la: נְהִי [?] erimus, apoc. pro נִהְיֶה vel, נִהְיֶה fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. הָיָה.
units.tr: Nehi[?], we shall be, apocopated for nihyeh, or nihyeh; future Kal, 1st pl. Root: hayah.

units.la: נִהְיָה factus est, facta, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. vel, Part. Niph. f. f. R. הָיָה.
units.tr: Nihyah, was made, was made (fem.); perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing., or participle Niphal, fem. sing. Root: hayah.

units.la: נִהְיֵיתִי factus fui, נִהְיֵיתָה facta est, præt. Niph. 1. f. & 3. f. Rad. הָיָה.
units.tr: Nihyiti, I was made; nihyetah, she was made; perfect Niphal, 1st sing. and 3rd fem. sing. Root: hayah.

units.la: וְיֵד נֶהֱלָאָה [?] & procul dissi-ta, Part. Niph. sing. fæm. præf. à Rad. inusit. הָלָא.
units.tr: Ve-yed nehela'ah[?], and far away; participle Niphal, fem. sing., with prefix, from the unused root hala'.

units.la: הַתְּהַלִּלִים laudibus elati, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. הָלַל.
units.tr: Hitehallelim, elated with praises; participle Niphal, masc. pl. Root: halal.

units.la: נֶהֱלֵךְ deducemus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. R. הָלַךְ.
units.tr: Nehelekh, we shall lead; future Piel, 1st pl. Root: halakh.

units.la: נֶהֱלְכִתִּי abire cogitur, cogor, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 1. f. Rad. הָלַךְ.
units.tr: Nehelkhiti, I am compelled to depart, I am compelled; perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing. and 1st fem. sing. Root: halakh.

units.la: נֶהֱלָתָּ commode ducis, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. R. נָהַל.
units.tr: Nehelatta, you lead well; perfect Piel, 2nd fem. sing. Root: nahal.

units.la: נֶהֱמָה frememus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. הָמָה.
units.tr: Nehemah, we shall roar; future Kal, 1st pl. Root: hamah.

units.la: מִ־נֶּהֱמַת ex fremitu, s. f.
units.tr: Mi-nehemat, from the roaring; noun fem. sing.

units.la: נֶהַם constr. No. נַהֲמָה; Rad. נָהַם fremuit.
units.tr: Nehem, construct, noun nahamah; root nahams, he roared.

units.la: נֶהֱפַךְ conversus fuit, Esth. 9. 1. pro נֶהְפַּךְ, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. הָפַךְ.
units.tr: Nehepakh, was turned, Esth. 9:1, for nehpakh; perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing. Root: hafakh.

units.la: נֶהְפְּכוּ conversi sunt, נֶהְפָּךְ conversus, præt. Niph. 3. pl. & 3. f. m. vel Part. Niph. f. m. Rad. הָפַךְ.
units.tr: Nehpekhu, they were turned; nehpak, turned; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. and 3rd masc. sing., or participle Niphal, masc. sing. Root: hafakh.

units.la: נֶהְפְּכָה subversa, Part. Niph. f. f. R. הָפַךְ.
units.tr: Nehpekhah, overturned; participle Niphal, fem. sing. Root: hafakh.

units.la: נֶהֱרוּ confluxerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָהַר.
units.tr: Nehiru, they flowed together; perfect Kal, 3rd pl. Root: nahar.

units.la: נֶהֱרְסוּ destructi sunt, הַ־נֶּהֱרָסוֹת destructæ, præt. Niph. 3. pl. (à 3. f. m. נֶהֶרֶס) & Part. Niph. pl. fæm. Rad. הָרַס.
units.tr: Nehersu, they were destroyed, the destroyed ones; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. (from the 3rd masc. sing. nehereis) and participle Niphal, fem. pl. Root: haras.

units.la: ו
units.tr: Vav

units.la: נוֹאֲלוּ stultescunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. יָאַל.
units.tr: No'alu, they become foolish; perfect Niphal, 3rd pl. Root: ya'al.

units.la: נוֹאֲלְנוּ stultè egimus, præt. Niph. 1. pl. R. יָאַל; vel est irreg. pro נוֹאֲלְנוּ, præt. Niph. 1. pl. Rad. אוֹל[?] נוֹאַשׁ desperavit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. יֵאשׁ[?] נוּג dolore affecti, נוּגוֹת mœstæ, (pro נוּגִי, נוּגּוֹת) Part. Niph. pl. m. constr. & f. R. יָגָה, Niph. נוּגָה, Part. Niph. f. m. נוּגָה. נוּגְשִׁים angustans, נוּגְשָׁיו exactares, ejus, Ben. Kal, f. m. & pl. m. aff. R. נָגַשׁ נוּדִי. נוּד migra, נוּרוּ migrate, Imper. Kal, f. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad. נוּד. לָנוּד ad migrandum, ad condolendum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. נוּד. נוּדָד, vel נוֹדָד vagatus est, errans, נוֹדָדֶת quæ errat, præt. Piel, vel Pual, 3. f. m. vel Ben. Kal, f. m. & f. R. נָדַד נוֹדָה celebrabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. יָדָה. נוּדִי vagatio mea, No. f. m. נוּד, aff. R. נוּד vagari. נוֹדִישָׁה notum faciemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. יָדַע. נוֹדַע notum fit, נוֹדְעוּ nota fiunt, &c præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. יָדַע. נָוָה habitatio, No. sing. fæm. Rad. נָוָה inhabitavit. נָוֶה pulcher, נָוָה pulchra, (pro נָאֶה, נָאָה,) No. f. m. Rad. נָאָה pulchrum esse. נָוֶה, constr. נְוֵה habitaculum, נָוְךָ tuum, נָוֵהוּ ejus, & נָוֵהֶם eorum, (pro נָוֵיהֶם,) No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. נָוָה. נָוֹת habitationes, No. pl. fæm. Rad. נָוָה. נוֹזְלִים fluenta, vide נוֹזְלִים[?]. לָנוּחַ ad quiescendum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. נוּחַ. נוֹחֲלוּ exspectarunt, præt.
units.tr: No'alnu, we have acted foolishly; perfect Niphal, 1st pl. Root: ya'al; or it is irregular for no'alnu, perfect Niphal, 1st pl. Root: ‘ul[?]. No'ash, he despaired; perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing. Root: ye'ash[?]. Nug, affected with grief; nugot, sorrowful (for nugi, nugot), participle Niphal, masc. pl. construct and fem. Root: yagah; Niphal, nugah; participle Niphal, fem. sing. Nugeshim, oppressing; nugesho, his exactors; participle Kal, masc. sing. and masc. pl. with suffix. Root: nagash. Nudi. Nud, migrate; nuru, migrate; imperative Kal, masc. sing., fem., and masc. pl. Root: nud. Lanud, to migrate, to condole; infinitive Kal with prefix. Root: nud. Nudad, or nodad, wandered, wandering; nodadet, who wanders; perfect Piel or Pual, 3rd masc. sing., or participle Kal, masc. and fem. Root: nadad. Nodah, we shall celebrate; future Hiphil, 1st pl. Root: yadah. Nudi, my wandering; noun fem. masc. nud, with suffix. Root: nud, to wander. Nodishah, we shall make known; future Hiphil, 1st pl. with paragogic ending. Root: yada'. Nodaa, it is made known; nod'u, they are made known; perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing. and 3rd pl. Root: yada'. Navah, dwelling; noun sing. fem. Root: navah, he dwelt. Navveh, beautiful; navah, beautiful (fem.) (for na'eh, na'ah); noun masc. Root: na'ah, to be beautiful. Navveh, construct nevēh, dwelling-place; navkha, your; nevehu, his; and nevehem, their (for navehem); noun fem. and masc. pl. with suffix. Root: navah. Nevot, dwellings; noun pl. fem. Root: navah. Nozelim, streams; see nozelim[?]. Lanuach, to rest; infinitive Kal with prefix. Root: nuach. Nochalu, they waited; perfect

units.la: Niph. 3. pl. R. יהד
units.tr: Niphal, 3rd person plural, root [יהד]

units.la: נוטַע plantans, pro נטַע Part. Benon. Kal, f. m. Rad. נטע
units.tr: planting [נוטַע], for [נטַע], Benoni participle, Qal, masc. sing., root [נטע]

units.la: נוטְרָה custodiens, pro נטְרָה, Bon. Kal, f. f. Rad. נטַר.
units.tr: keeping [נוטְרָה], for [נטְרָה], Benoni, Qal, fem. sing., root [נטַר]

units.la: נוכַח redarguus est, discertans, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. vel Part. Niph. f. m. Rad. יָכַח
units.tr: is rebuked [נוכַח], disputing [נוכַח], perfect Niphal 3rd person masc. sing., or participle Niphal masc. sing., root [יָכַח]

units.la: וְנוּכְחוּ & argutabimur, fut. Niph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. יכח
units.tr: and we will argue [וְנוּכְחוּ], future Niphal 1st person plural with paragogic ending, root [יכח]

units.la: נוּכָל machinator, No: f. m. Rad. נָכַל machinatus est.
units.tr: schemer [נוּכָל], noun masc. sing., root [נָכַל]; schemed [נָכַל]

units.la: נוּכַל poterimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. יכל
units.tr: we shall be able [נוּכַל], future Qal 1st person plural, root [יכל]

units.la: נוּלַד natus est, נוֹלְדוּ nati sunt, & נוֹלַד natus, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. uş & Part. Niph. f. m. Rad. ילד
units.tr: was born [נוֹלַד], were born [נוֹלְדוּ], and born [נוֹלַד], perfect Niphal 3rd person masc. sing. and 3rd person plural, and participle Niphal masc. sing., root [ילד]

units.la: נוֹלְדוּ nati sunt, 1. Par. 3. 5. pro נוֹלְדוּ, præt. Niph. 3. pl. vel præt. comp. ex Niph. & pual,
units.tr: were born [נוֹלְדוּ], 1 Chron. 3. 5., for [נוֹלְדוּ], perfect Niphal 3rd person plural, or a compound perfect of Niphal and Pual,

units.la: Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: root [יָלַד].

units.la: לִנוּם ad dormitandum, נוּמָה dormitatio, Infin. Kal, & No. sing. fæm. Rad. נוּם.
units.tr: to sleep [לִנוּם], sleeping [נוּמָה], infinitive Qal and noun fem. sing., root [נוּם]

units.la: נוּם fugere, Infin. Kal, Rad. נוּם.
units.tr: to flee [נוּם], infinitive Qal, root [נוּם]

units.la: נוּסַר fundatus est, נוּסְדוּ fundati sunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. יָסַד.
units.tr: was founded [נוּסַד], were founded [נוּסְדוּ], perfect Niphal 3rd person masc. sing. and 3rd person plural, root [יָסַד]

units.la: נוּסוּ fugite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. Rad. נוּם.
units.tr: flee [נוּסוּ], imperative Qal, plural masc., root [נוּם]

units.la: נוּסּ vexillum ferens, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. נסס.
units.tr: bearing a standard [נוּסּ], Benoni, Qal, masc. sing., root [נסס]

units.la: נוֹסָף additur, נוֹסָפָה adjectus, נוֹסְפוּ adjecte, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & Part. Niph. f. m. & pl. f. Rad. יָסַף.
units.tr: is added [נוֹסָף], added [נוֹסָפָה], were added [נוֹסְפוּ], perfect Niphal 3rd person masc. and fem. sing., and participle Niphal masc. sing. and fem. plural, root [יָסַף]

units.la: וְנוּסַרָה & erudientur, Ezech. 23. 48. (pro נִתּוּסְרוּ) comp. ex præt. Niph. & præt. Hithp. 3. pl. Rad. יָסַר.
units.tr: and they will be instructed [וְנוּסַרָה], Ezek. 23. 48., for [נִתּוּסְרוּ], compound of perfect Niphal and perfect Hithpael, 3rd person plural, root [יָסַר]

units.la: נוּעַ movere sese, pro נוּעַ. Infin. Kal, Rad. נוּעַ.
units.tr: to move oneself [נוּעַ], for [נוּעַ], infinitive Qal, root [נוּעַ]

units.la: נוֹעַר convenit, נוֹעֲדוּ conve-
units.tr: meets [נוֹעַד], they met [נוֹעֲדוּ], assem-

units.la: convend. nerunt, [?] uemeui, הנועדים congregati, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. 3. pl. & 1. f. ut & Part. Niph. pl. m. R. נועד convenìamus, ונועדה & convenianus, fut. Niph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. יעד נועז robore præditus, part. Niph. f. m. R. יעז נועל proficiemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. יעל נועץ consultauit, נועצו consultarunt, נועצים consultantes, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. & Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. יעץ ורנועצה & inibimus consi-lium, fut. Niph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. יעץ נוף stillatus, No. f. m. Rad. נוף stillavit. נופה defilliatio, No. f. fæm. Rad. נוף. נוצה pluma, No. f. fæm. Rad. נצה volare. emitte faciemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. יצא נוצר formatus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. יצר נוקש illaqueatus fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. pro נוקש, Rad. יקש vel Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. נקש נוקשו illaqueati sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. יקש נוּרָא timendus est, נוראה timenda, נוראיך terribilia tua, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. vel Part. Niph. f. m. & f. & pl. f. aff. R. ירא נושב inhabitator, נושבה inhabitantur, Jer. 22. 6. pro נושבו, נושבה habitata, נושבות habitatæ, &c. præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. ut & Part. Niph. sing. & pl. fæm. Rad. ישב נושא mutuum, 1. units.la: נֻחַמְתִּים consolatus sum eos, præt. Piel, 1. sing. aff. Rad. נָחַם.
units.tr: nuchamtim, I have comforted them, perfect Piel, 1st sing. with suffix, root nachem.

units.la: נַחְנוּ nos, pro אֲנַחְנוּ, Pronom. 1. pl. à f. m. Rad. אֲנִי ego.
units.tr: nachnu, we, for anachnu, personal pronoun, 1st pl., from the masc. form, root ani, I.

units.la: נְחָנִי deduxit me, נְחָנִי deduc me, Præt. Kal, f. m. & Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. R. נָחָה.
units.tr: nechani, he led me; nechani, lead me; perfect Qal, masc. sing., and imperative Qal, masc. sing. with suffix, root nachah.

units.la: נְחָנִי gratiosa fuisti, Jer.
units.tr: nechani, you were gracious, Jer.

units.la: 22,23. pro נְחֻנוֹת, נְחֻנָה gratiosus fuisti, præt. Niph. 2. sing. fæm. & masc. Rad. חָנַן
units.tr: 22, 23, for nechunot, nechunah, you were gracious; perfect Niphal, 2nd sing. fem. and masc., root chanan.

units.la: נְחֻפָּה tecta, Part. Niph. f. f. à f. m. נְחֻפָּה; Rad. חָפָה
units.tr: nechupah, covered, participle Niphal, fem. sing., from the masc. nechupah; root chafah.

units.la: נָחֲפוּ acceleratus, נָחֲפוּ ac-celerarunt, Part. Niph. f. m. & præt. Niph. 3. pl. à 3. s. m. נָחְפוּ, Rad. חָפַז [?]
units.tr: nachafu, hastened, nachafu, they hastened, participle Niphal, masc. sing., and perfect Niphal, 3rd pl., from the 3rd masc. sing. nachfu, root chafaz [?].

units.la: נַחְפְּשָׂה scrutemur, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. חָפַשׂ
units.tr: nachpeshah, let us search, imperfect Qal, 1st pl., paragogic, root chafas.

units.la: נֶחְפְּשׂוּ pervestigata sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. חָפַשׂ
units.tr: nechpeshu, were searched out, perfect Niphal, 3rd pl., root chafas.

units.la: נֶחְקַר pervestigatus est, præt. Niph. 3. s. m. R. חָקַר
units.tr: nechkar, was searched out, perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing., root chakar.

units.la: נַחְקָרָה perscrutabimur, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. R. חָקַר
units.tr: nachkarah, we shall search through, imperfect Qal, 1st pl., paragogic, root chakar.

units.la: נַחַר ronchus, No. s. m. R. inusit. נָחַר.
units.tr: nachar, snorting, noun, masc. sing., root unused nachar.

units.la: נָחַר exsiccatur, Ps. 69. 4.
units.tr: nachar, is dried up, Ps. 69. 4.

units.la: pro נְחַר; præt. Niph. 3. s. m. Rad. חָרַר [?]
units.tr: for nechar; perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing., root charar [?].

units.la: נֶחֱרְבוּ desolarunt se, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. חָרַב
units.tr: nechervu, they laid waste themselves, perfect Niphal, 3rd pl., root charav.

units.la: נֶחֱרָבֹת desolata, נֶחֱרָבוֹת desolatæ, Part. Niph. s. & pl. fæm. Rad. חָרַב
units.tr: nechorabot, laid waste, nechorabot, laid waste, participle Niphal, sing. and fem. pl., root charav.

units.la: נֶחֱרִי, & נֶחֱרוּ exsiccantur, pro נֶחֱרוּ, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. חָרַר

units.la: הַנֶּחֱרִים qui exardescunt, Part. Niph. pl. masc. Rad. חָרָה
units.tr: hannecharim, those who burn with anger, participle Niphal, masc. pl., root charah.

units.la: וַנֶּחֱרִים & devovimus [?], fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. חָרַם
units.tr: vanecharim, and we have devoted, imperfect Hiphil, 1st pl., root charam.

units.la: נֶחֶרְפָה despecta, Part. Niph. sing. fæm. Rad. חָרַף
units.tr: necherfah, despised, participle Niphal, sing. fem., root charaf.

units.tr: necheratzah, necharutzat, cut off, participle Niphal, sing. fem., root charatz.

units.tr: nachar, rouchus [?], construct sing. fem., noun, nacharah, and also necharo, his, sing. masc. with suffix, root unused nachar.

units.la: נְחַשׁ experiendo, Infin. Piel, à Rad. in præt. Piel, נָחַשׁ augur atus est.
units.tr: nechash, by experiment, infinitive Piel, from the root in perfect Piel, nachash, he practised augury.

units.la: & cogitabimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. חָשַׁב.
units.tr: and we shall consider, imperfect Qal, 1st pl., paragogic, root chashav.

units.la: נַחְשְׁבִּי reputamur, נַחְשַׁבְתִּי reputor, præt. Niph. 1. pl. & 1. s. Rad. חָשַׁב.
units.tr: nachshbi, we are reckoned, nachashbti, I am reckoned, perfect Niphal, 1st pl. and 1st sing., root chashav.

units.la: כְּנְחָשָׁה quasi chalybea, sing. fæm. præf. No. f. m. נָחוּשׁ, Rad. נָחַשׁ.
units.tr: kenechashah, as brazen, sing. fem., with prefix, noun, fem. masc., nachush, root nachash.

units.tr: nechashim, serpents, auguries, masc. pl., noun, masc., nachash, serpent, or nachash, augury, root nachash.

units.tr: nechashti, I learned by experience, perfect Piel, 1st sing. fem., root nachash.

units.tr: nechashti, my brazen coin, nechashtah, its rust, nechashtcha, your, nechashtam, their bronze, nechashtayim, two brazen coins, sing. fem. with suffix and dual, noun, nechoshet; root nachash.

units.tr: nechushtan, nechushtan, name of a serpent, noun, fem. masc., root nachash.

units.tr: nachat, he was let down; nachatu, they were let down (for nechatu), perfect Niphal, 3rd masc. sing. and 3rd pl., root nachat.

units.la: נְחַתָּה contritus est, נְחַתָּה contrita est, נְחַתּוּ contriti sunt, pro נָחַת, נְחַתָּה, & נְחַתּוּ; præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. R. חָתַת.

units.tr: [נִי] lamentation, [כְּנִיהֶם] in their lamentation, noun feminine masc., with prefix and suffix, root [נהה], he lamented

units.tr: [נִיב] produce, [וְנִיבוֹ] and its produce, noun singular masc. with suffix, root [נוב] to yield produce
