units.la: וְנִכְאָה & attritus, f. m. constr. Part. Niph. à f. m. absol. נִכְאָה; Rad. כָּאָה.
units.tr: [נְכָאִים] crushed, noun plural masc., root [כאה] or [נכה]

units.la: נִכְאוּ percussi sunt, Job. 38.8. præt. Niph. 3. pl. (pro נִכְאוּ) Rad. נָכָה.
units.tr: Nichau: they were smitten, Job. 38.8, preterite Niphal, 3rd person plural (for Nichau). Root Nakah.

units.la: נְכָאִים attriti, No. pl. m.
units.tr: Nechaim: crushed, noun masculine plural.

units.la: Rad. כָּאָה, vel נָכָה.
units.tr: Root Kaah or Nakah.

units.la: נִכְבָּדִים honorati, Jes. 23. 8. pro נִכְבָּדִים, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. כָּבַד.
units.tr: Nichbadim: honoured, Isa. 23. 8. (for Nichbadim), participle Niphal, masculine plural. Root Kabad.

units.la: נָכֶה percussus, constr. נָכֶה, & נָכֶה percussus pedibus, נְכִים loripedes, No. f. m. & No. f. & pl. m. Rad. נָכֶה.
units.tr: [נִכּוּ] they had been struck, perfect Pual, 3rd person plural, root [נכה]

units.la: וְנַכֵּה & percutiemus, נַכֵּהוּ eum, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. נָכָה.
units.tr: [נָכוֹן] it was prepared, [נְכוֹנָה] prepared, perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc., or Participle Niphal, fem. masc., root [כון]

units.la: וְנָכָה & percussus fuit, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. נָכָה.
units.tr: [נִכְחַד] we will hide, imperfect Piel, 1st person plural, root [כחד], Piel [כַּחֵד]

units.la: נִכּוּ percussi erant, præt. Pual, 3. pl. R. נָכָה.
units.tr: [נָכְחַד] cut off, or was hidden, [נִכְחֲדוּ] they were cut off, perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc. and 3rd person plural, root [כחד]

units.la: נָכוֹן aptatum est, נְכוֹנָה aptata, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. vel Part. Niph. f. m. & f. R. כּוּן.
units.tr: [נְכֹחָה] straight, [נְכֹחִים] straight, fem. fem. and plural masc., noun fem. masc.

units.la: נִכְחַד abscondemus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. Rad. כָּחַד, Piel כַּחֵד.
units.tr: [נָכַח] straight, from the noun, root

units.la: נָכְחַד excisus, vel celatus fuit, נִכְחֲדוּ excisi sunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. כָּחַד.
units.tr: [נֹכַח] before

units.la: נְכֹחָה recta, נְכֹחִים recti, f.f. & pl. m. No. f. m.
units.tr: [נִכְחוֹ] opposite him, fem. masc. with suffix, cf. noun [נָכְחָה]; and [נְכֹחוֹ] his uprightness, fem. masc. with suffix, from the noun, root [נכח]?

units.la: נָכַח rectum, à No. R.
units.tr: Nachach: straight, right, from a noun, root [?].

units.la: נֹכַח coram.
units.tr: Nochach: before, over against.

units.la: נִכְחוֹ è regione ejus, f. m. aff. qu. No. נָכְחָה; & נְכֹחוֹ rectitudo sua, f. m. aff. No. נָכְחָה, à No. Rad. נכח[?].
units.tr: Nichcho: over against him, feminine or masculine singular with suffix, as if from the noun Nochchah; and Nechocho: his straightness, feminine or masculine singular with suffix, from the noun Nechochah, root Nachach[?].

units.la: נָכַח.
units.tr: Nachach.

units.la: וְנַכְחִידֵם & excindemus eos, fut. Hiph. 1 pl. aff. Rad. כָּחַד[?].
units.tr: Venachchidem: and we shall cut them off, future Hiphil, 1st person plural with suffix. Root Kachad[?].

units.la: וְנִכְחָתָה & redarguta, sing. fæm. Part. Niph. aliàs est, נְכָחָה, à praet. Niph. נָכַח; Rad. יָכַח[?].
units.tr: [וְנַכֵּם] and we will strike them, [נַכֵּנוּ] him, imperfect Hiphil, 1st person plural with suffix, root [נכה]

units.la: נִכְלוּ machinati sunt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. R. נָכַל.
units.tr: [נְכֹנִים] prepared, Participle Niphal, plural masc., from fem. masc. [נָכֹן]; root [כון]

units.la: נִכְלָם erubuit, נִכְלְמוּ erubuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. כָּלַם.
units.tr: [נִכְסוֹף] to be affected with longing, Gen. 31.30 (for [הַכְּסֵף]), Infinitive Niphal, root [כסף]

units.la: וְנַכֵּם & percutiemus eos, נַכֵּנוּ eum, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. נָכָה.
units.tr: [נְכָסִים] wealth, noun plural masc., root not in use [נכם]

units.la: נְכֹנִים aptati, Part. Niph. pl. m. à f. m. נָכֹן; Rad. כּוּן.
units.tr: [נִכְסְפָה] was held by longing, perfect Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular, root [כסף]

units.la: נִכְסוֹף desiderio affici, Gen. 31.30. pro הַכְּסֵף, Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּסַף.
units.tr: [נִכְסָתָה] is covered, perfect Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular, from 3rd person fem. masc. [נִכְסָה]; root [כסה]

units.la: נְכָסִים opes, No. pl. m. R. inusit. נָכַם.
units.tr: [וְנִכְפַּר] and it will be atoned, Deut. 21.8, is compounded of perfect Niphal and perfect Hithpael, root [כפר]

units.la: נִכְסְפָה desiderio tenebatur, praet. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. כָּסַף.
units.tr: [נִכַּר] was recognized, [נִכְּרוּ] were recognized, perfect Niphal or Piel; 3rd person fem. masc. and 3rd person plural, root [נכר]

units.la: נִכְסָתָה operitur, praet. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. à 3. f. m. נִכְסָה; Rad. כָּסָה.
units.tr: [נָכְרִי] foreigner, [נָכְרִים] foreigners, [נָכְרִיָּה] alien woman, [נָכְרִיּוֹת] alien women, noun fem. and plural masc. and fem., root [נכר] he recognized

units.la: וְנִכְפַּר & expiabitur, Deut. 21.8. est comp. ex praet Niph. & praet. Hithp Rad. כָּפַר.
units.tr: [נִכְרִית] we will cut off, imperfect Hiphil, 1st person plural, root [כרת]

units.la: נִכַּר agnitus fuit, נִכְּרוּ agniti fuere, praet. Niph. vel Piel; 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. נָכַר.
units.tr: [וְנִכְרְעָה] and let us kneel down, imperfect Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic ending, root [כרע]

units.la: נָכְרִי extraneus, נָכְרִים extranei, נָכְרִיָּה alienigena, נָכְרִיּוֹת alienigenae, ne, No. f. & pl. m. & f. R. נָכַר agnovit.
units.tr: [נִכְרַתָּה] was cut off, [נִכְרְתָה] was cut off, [נִכְרַתָּ] you were cut off, [נִכְרְתוּ] they were cut off, etc., perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc. and fem., and 2nd person masc., and 3rd person plural, root [כרת]

units.la: נִכְרִית exscindemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. כָּרַת.
units.tr: [נִכְרָתָה], [נִכְרְתָה] we will cut off, [נִכְרָתֵנוּ] him, imperfect Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic ending and suffix, root [כרת]

units.la: וְנִכְרְעָה & procumbamus in genua, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. כָּרַע.
units.tr: Venichr'ah: and let us bow down on our knees, future Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic ending. Root Karaʿ.

units.la: נִכְרַתָּה excisus fuit, נִכְרְתָה excisa fuit, נִכְרַתָּ excisus fuisti, נִכְרְתוּ excisi fuerunt, &c. praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 2. f. m. ut & 3. pl. R. כָּרַת.
units.tr: Nichrathah: was cut off; Nichrethah: was cut off (feminine); Nichrath: you were cut off; Nichrethu: they were cut off, etc., preterite Niphal, 3rd person feminine and masculine, feminine, and 2nd person masculine, as also 3rd person plural. Root Karath.

units.la: נִכְרָתָה, נִכְרְתָה exscinde-mus, נִכְרָתֵנוּ eum, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. & aff. Rad. כָּרַת.
units.tr: Nichratah, Nichrethah: we shall cut off; Nichrathenu: him, future Kal, 1st person plural with paragogic ending and suffix. Root Karath.

units.la: נִכְשָׁל impegit, נִכְתַּב scriptus est, נִכְתָּם inanuatus est, &c. praet. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. כָּשַׁל, כָּתַב, & כָּתַם.
units.tr: Nichshal: he stumbled; Nichtab: he was written; Nichtam: he was sealed; etc., preterite Niphal, 3rd person feminine and masculine. Roots Kashal, Katab, and Katam.

units.la: נֻכָּתָה percussa erat, praet. Pual, 3. f. f. R. נָכָה.
units.tr: נֻכָּתָה was struck, preterite Pual, 3rd sing. fem., from the root נָכָה.

units.la: נ ל
units.tr: נ ל

units.la: נִלְאֵיתִי fatigatus fuit, נִלְאֵיתִי sum, pro נִלְאֵיתִי; praet.
units.tr: נִלְאֵיתִי was wearied, נִלְאֵיתִי I am, for נִלְאֵיתִי; preterite

units.la: Niph. 3. f. m. & 1. f. R. לָאָה.
units.tr: Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 1st sing. from the root לָאָה.

units.la: נִלְבְּנָה formemus lateres, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. לָבֵן.
units.tr: נִלְבְּנָה let us make bricks, future Kal, 1st pl. with paragogic נ, from the root לָבֵן.

units.la: נִלּוּ adjunxerunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. à 3. f. m. נִלְוָה; vel pro הִלְּוּ, Imper. Niph. pl. m. Rad. לָוָה.
units.tr: נִלּוּ they joined, preterite Niph. 3rd pl., from 3rd sing. masc. נִלְוָה; or for הִלּוּ, imperative Niph. pl. masc., from the root לָוָה.

units.la: נִלּוֹ perversus, constr. נִלּוֹ נִלְוִים perversi, Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. Rad. לוּז[?].
units.tr: נִלּוֹ perverse, construct נִלּוֹ; נִלְוִים perverse ones, participle Niph. fem. and pl. masc., from the root לוּז[?].

units.la: כ־נִלּוּתְךָ secundum absol-vere te, Jef. 33. 1. pro כְּהַנְלוֹתְךָ[?]; Infin. Hiph. praef. & aff. Rad. נָלָה.
units.tr: כ־נִלּוּתְךָ according as I absolve you, Jer. 33:1, for כְּהַנְלוֹתְךָ[?]; infinitive Hiph. with prefix and suffix, from the root נָלָה.

units.la: נִלְחָם pugnavit, נִלְחָם pugnans, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. sing. m. Rad. לָחַם vesci.
units.tr: נִלְחָם he fought, נִלְחָם fighting, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and participle Niph. sing. masc., from the root לָחַם to eat.

units.la: נִלְחָם pugnare, Jud. 14. 25[?]. Infin. Niph. (cum Cholem & נ Niph. pro הִלָּחֵם) Rad. לָחַם.
units.tr: נִלְחָם to fight, Judg. 14:25[?]. Infinitive Niph. (with Cholem, and נ Niph. for הִלָּחֵם), from the root לָחַם.

units.la: וְנִלָּחֲמָה & pugnabimus fut. Niph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. לָחַם נִלִּין, pernoctabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. plur. parag. Rad. לוּן. נַלְכָה, ibimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. יָלַךְ נִלְכַּד captus fuit, נִלְכְּדָה capta fuit, &c. praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. Rad. לָכַד וְנִלְכֹּד & cepimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. לָכַד נִלְכָּדָה captus fuit, נִלְכְּדָה capta est, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. Rad. לָכַד
units.tr: וְנִלָּחֲמָה and we will fight, future Niph. 1st pl. with paragogic ה, from the root לָחַם. נִלִּין we will lodge overnight, future Hiph. 1st pl. with paragogic נ, from the root לוּן. נַלְכָה we will go, future Kal, 1st pl. with paragogic ה, from the root יָלַךְ. נִלְכַּד he was captured, נִלְכְּדָה she was captured, etc., preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and fem., from the root לָכַד. וְנִלְכֹּד and we took, future Kal, 1st pl., from the root לָכַד. נִלְכָּדָה she was captured, נִלְכְּדָה she was captured, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and fem., from the root לָכַד.

units.la: נ מ
units.tr: נ מ

units.la: נִמְאָם reprobatus, Part. Niph. f. m. R. מָאַם נִמְבָּזָה contemptibilis, No. f. f. (pro נִבְזָה, per epenth. literæ מ,) R. בָּזָה sprevit, vel comp. ex Part. Niph. f. נִבְזָה contempta, & Part. Pual, מְבֻזָּה; R. בָּזָה. נִמְהָרָה præcipitatur, נִמְהָר præceps, נִמְהָרִים præcipites, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָהַר. נָמוּ dormit averunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נוּם. נָמוּג dissolvitur, נְמוּגוּ, vel נְמוּגִים dissolvuntur, dissoluti, præt. Niph. 3. f. m & 3. pl. & Part. Niph. f. & pl. m. R. מוּג. נָמוֹט dimotus fuit, נָמוֹטוּ dimoti fuerunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. מוֹט. נִמּוֹל circumcisus fuit, נִמּוֹלוּ circumcisi fuerunt, נִמּוֹלִים circumcisi, pro נִמַּל, נִמְלוּ, & נִמָּלִים. præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. ut & Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. נָמַל. נָמוּת moritur, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. מוּת. נִמְחוּ deleti sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. מֶהָה[?]. נִמְטַט dimotus fuit, נִמְטוּ dimoti fuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. מָטַט, vel טוּט. נִמִּיתָה interficiemus, נִמִּיתֶךָ te, וּנִמִּיתֵהוּ eum, נִמִּיתֶם eos, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. Rad. מוּת. venditus fuit, נִמְכַּר venditi fuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. מָכַר. vendemus eum, נִמְכְּרֶנּוּ fut. Kal, 1. pl. נִמְכּוֹר aff. Rad. מָכַר. נִמְלָא implebimus, fut. Pi-el, 1. pl. R. מָלָא. נִמְלָא oppletus est, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. R. מָלָא. נִמְלָה formica, No. sing. fem. Rad. נָמַל circumcidit. נִמְלוּ circumcisi sunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. נָמַל. נִמְלְחוּ evanuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. מָלַח. [?]ripiemur, fut. Niph. 1. pl. à praet. Niph. נִמְלְטוּ; Rad. מָלַט. נִמְלַךְ, vel נִמְלָךְ regnare faciemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. Rad. מָלַךְ. נִמָּלִים circumcisi, Part. Niph. pl. m. R. נָמַל, ex forma Cholem ut supra נִמְלוֹ. נִמָּלִים formicae, pl. m. No. f. f. נִמָּלָה; Rad. נָמַל circumcidit. נִמְלָן suave fuit, נִמְלוּ suavia fuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. מָלַן. נִמְלְתֶּם circumcidistis, praet. Kal, 2. pl. masc. Rad. נָמַל. נִמְנָה annumeratus fuit, נִמְנַע cohibitus fuit, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. מָנָה, & מָנַע. נִמַּס liquefit, pro נִמְּסוּ liquefiunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. R. מָסַס.
units.tr: נִמְאָם rejected, participle Niph. fem. and masc., from the root מָאַם. נִמְבָּזָה contemptible, noun fem. sing. (for נִבְזָה, by epenthesis of the letter מ), from the root בָּזָה he despised, or compounded of the participle Niph. fem. נִבְזָה despised, and the participle Pual מְבֻזָּה; root בָּזָה. נִמְהָרָה is hastened, נִמְהָר hasty, נִמְהָרִים hasty ones, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and fem. and participle Niph. fem. and pl. masc., from the root מָהַר. נָמוּ they slumbered, preterite Kal, 3rd pl., from the root נוּם. נָמוּג is dissolved, נְמוּגוּ or נְמוּגִים they are dissolved, dissolute, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl. and participle Niph. fem. and pl. masc., from the root מוּג. נָמוֹט was moved, נָמוֹטוּ they were moved, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl., from the root מוֹט. נִמּוֹל was circumcised, נִמּוֹלוּ they were circumcised, נִמּוֹלִים circumcised, for נִמַּל, נִמְלוּ and נִמָּלִים; preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl., as also participle Niph. pl. masc., from the root נָמַל. נָמוּת he dies, future Kal, 1st pl., from the root מוּת. נִמְחוּ they were blotted out, preterite Niph. 3rd pl., from the root מֶהָה[?]. נִמְטַט was moved, נִמְטוּ they were moved, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl., from the root מָטַט, or טוּט. נִמִּיתָה we will kill, נִמִּיתֶךָ you, וּנִמִּיתֵהוּ and him, נִמִּיתֶם them, future Hiph. 1st pl. with suffixes, from the root מוּת. was sold, נִמְכַּר they were sold, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl., from the root מָכַר. we will sell him, נִמְכְּרֶנּוּ future Kal, 1st pl., with suffix, from the root מָכַר. נִמְלָא we will fill, future Piel, 1st pl., from the root מָלָא. נִמְלָא was filled, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc., from the root מָלָא. נִמְלָה ant, noun sing. fem., from the root נָמַל he circumcised. נִמְלוּ they were circumcised, preterite Niph. 3rd pl., from the root נָמַל. נִמְלְחוּ they vanished, preterite Niph. 3rd pl., from the root מָלַח. [?] we shall escape, future Niph. 1st pl., from the preterite Niph. נִמְלְטוּ; root מָלַט. נִמְלַךְ, or נִמְלָךְ we will make reign, future Hiph. 1st pl., from the root מָלַךְ. נִמָּלִים circumcised, participle Niph. pl. masc., from the root נָמַל, in the form with Cholem as above נִמְלוֹ. נִמָּלִים ants, pl. masc., noun fem. נִמָּלָה; root נָמַל he circumcised. נִמְלָן was pleasant, נִמְלוּ they were pleasant, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl., from the root מָלַן. נִמְלְתֶּם you circumcised, preterite Kal, 2nd pl. masc., from the root נָמַל. נִמְנָה was counted, נִמְנַע was restrained, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc., from the roots מָנָה and מָנַע. נִמַּס melts, for נִמְּסוּ they melt, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl., from the root מָסַס.

units.tr: וַיָּמַס[?] and melted, 1 Sam. 15:9. Participle Niph. fem. and masc., from the root מָסַס[?].

units.tr: נִמְצָא was found, נִמְצְאוּ they were found, נִמְצְאָה she was found, נִמְצְאִים found, נִמְצְאוֹת found, etc., preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc. and 3rd pl., and participle Niph. fem. and pl. masc. and fem., from the root מָצָא.

units.la: נִמְצֵאתִי inventa es, inventus sum, praet. Niph. 2. f. f. & r. f. Rad. מָצָא
units.tr: נִמְצֵאתִי you were found, I was found, preterite Niph. 2nd sing. fem. and 1st sing. common, from the root מָצָא.

units.tr: נִמְצָה was squeezed out, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc., from the root מָצָה.

units.tr: נִמְּקְתֶּם you waste away, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc., 3rd pl. and 2nd pl. masc., as also participle Niph. fem. and pl. masc., from the root מָקַק.

units.tr: נִמְשַׁח was anointed, preterite Niph. 3rd sing. masc., from the root מָשַׁח.

units.tr: נִמְשַׁל was made like, נִמְשְׁלָה you became, etc., preterite Niph. 3rd sing. and 2nd sing. fem. masc., from the root מָשַׁל.

units.la: נַעֲשִׂיבִנוּ chibebimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. שׁוּב [?].
units.tr: נַעֲשִׂיבִנוּ we shall return, future Hiph. 1st pl. with paragogic. Root שׁוּב [?].

units.la: נַעֲוָּה perversus est, & וְנַעֲוָּה perversus, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. עָוַּה [?].
units.tr: נַעֲוָּה was perverse, and וְנַעֲוָּה perverse, past Niph. 3rd masc. & Part. Niph. masc. sing. Root עָוַּה [?].

units.tr: נַעַר boy, noun masc. Root נָעַר he shook out.

units.tr: וְלַנַּעַר and to the boy, noun masc. with prefix. Root נָעַר.

units.la: יְנַעֵר excussit, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. R. נָעַר.
units.tr: יְנַעֵר he shakes out, past Piel, 3rd masc. sing. Root נָעַר.

units.la: נְעוּרִים pueritia, No. f. m. Rad. נָעַר excussit.
units.tr: נְעוּרִים youth, noun masc. Root נָעַר he shook out.

units.la: נֹעֵר excutiens, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. נָעַר.
units.tr: נֹעֵר shaking out, participle Kal, masc. sing. Root נָעַר.

units.la: הַנַּעֲרָה puella, לַנַּעֲרָה puelle, &c. ut & def. absque נַעֲרָה No. sing. fæm. præf. à No. f. m. נַעַר; Rad. נָעַר excussit.
units.tr: הַנַּעֲרָה the girl, לַנַּעֲרָה to the girl, etc., as also the definite form without נַעֲרָה, noun fem. sing. formed from the noun masc. נַעַר; Root נָעַר he shook out.

units.la: נַעֲרָה puer ejus, &c. f. m.
units.tr: נַעֲרָה his boy, etc., fem. masc.

units.la: f. m. aff. No. נַעַר; Rad. נַעַר
units.tr: fem. masc. with suffix, noun נַעַר; Root נַעַר

units.la: נָעֲרוּ excusserunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָעַר.
units.tr: נָעֲרוּ they shook out, past Kal, 3rd pl. Root נָעַר.

units.la: נְעָרוֹת, & נְעָרוֹת puellæ, נְעָרִים pueri, &c. pl. f. & pl. m. No. f. m. נַעַר; Rad. נַעַר
units.tr: נְעָרוֹת, and נְעָרוֹת girls, נְעָרִים boys, etc., pl. fem. & pl. masc., noun masc. נַעַר; Root נַעַר

units.la: נַעֲרָ ordinabinus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. עָרַךְ
units.tr: נַעֲרָ we shall arrange, future Kal, 1st pl. Root עָרַךְ.

units.la: נֶעֶרְמוּ coacervatæ sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. עָרַם.
units.tr: נֶעֶרְמוּ they were heaped up, past Niph. 3rd pl. Root עָרַם.

units.la: נֶעֱרַץ formidabilis est, vel נֶעֱרָץ formidabilis, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. עָרַץ.
units.tr: נֶעֱרַץ is terrible, or נֶעֱרָץ terrible, past Niph. 3rd masc. sing. & Part. Niph. masc. sing. Root עָרַץ.

units.la: נַעֲרֵתִי excussi, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. נָעַר.
units.tr: נַעֲרֵתִי I shook out, past Kal, 1st fem. Root נָעַר.

units.la: נַעֲרָתִי puellæ meæ, נַעֲרָתוֹ ejus, &c. pl. f. aff. No. f. fæm. נַעֲרָה, Rad. נַעַר excussit.
units.tr: נַעֲרָתִי my girl, נַעֲרָתוֹ his, etc., pl. fem. with suffix, noun fem. נַעֲרָה, Root נַעַר he shook out.

units.la: וַנַּעֲשֶׂה & fecimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. apoc. (pro נַעֲשָׂה) Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: וַנַּעֲשֶׂה and we made, future Kal, 1st pl., apocopated (for נַעֲשָׂה). Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: נַעֲשָׂה factum est, נַעֲשָׂה fa-
units.tr: נַעֲשָׂה it was made, נַעֲשָׂה they were made

units.la: cta sunt, נַעֲשָׂה factus, נַעֲשִׂים facti, נַעֲשׂוֹת fa-
units.tr: (cont.) נַעֲשָׂה made, נַעֲשִׂים made (pl.), נַעֲשׂוֹת made (fem.), past Niph. 3rd masc. sing. & 3rd pl., and Part. Niph. masc. sing. & masc. & fem. pl. Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: cte, præt. Niph. 3. s. m. & 3. pl. & Part. Niph. s. m. & pl. m. & f. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: (cont.) Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: הַנַּעֲשֶׂה an faciemus? fut. Kal, 1. plur. præf. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: הַנַּעֲשֶׂה shall we do? future Kal, 1st pl. with interrogative prefix. Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: נַעֲשֶׂה faciemus illud, fut. Kal, 1. pl. aff. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: נַעֲשֶׂה we shall do that, future Kal, 1st pl. with suffix. Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: נַעֲשָׂתָה, & נַעֲשְׂתָה facta est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: נַעֲשָׂתָה, and נַעֲשְׂתָה it was made, past Niph. 3rd sing. fem. Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: נֶעְתַּם obscuratus est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. m. Rad. עָתַם.
units.tr: נֶעְתַּם he was darkened, past Niph. 3rd sing. masc. Root עָתַם.

units.la: נֶעְתָּר, & נֶעְתּוֹר vel נַעְתַּר exoratus fuit, 1 Par. 5. 20. pro נֶעְתָּר, vel נַעְתַּר; præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָתַר.
units.tr: נֶעְתָּר, and נֶעְתּוֹר or נַעְתַּר he was entreated, 1 Chron. 5:20, for נֶעְתָּר or נַעְתַּר; past Niph. 3rd fem. masc. Root עָתַר.

units.la: נֶעְתָּרוֹת exorate, Patt. Niph. plur. fæm. Rad. עָתַר.
units.tr: נֶעְתָּרוֹת entreated, Participle Niph. pl. fem. Root עָתַר.

units.tr: נִפְרָתָה was redeemed, past Niph. 3rd sing. fem. Root רָ Root.

units.la: נָפָה cribrum, No. sing. fæm. Rad. נוף agitavit.
units.tr: נָפָה sieve, noun sing. fem. Root נוף he shook.

units.la: נְפוּתִי debilitatus sum, praet. Niph. 1. f. R. פוג.
units.tr: נְפוּתִי I was weakened, past Niph. 1st fem. Root פוג.

units.la: נָפוּחַ efflatus, Paul Kal, f. m. Rad. נָפַח.
units.tr: נָפוּחַ blown, Participle Kal, masc. sing. Root נָפַח.

units.la: נָפוֹל cadere, כְּנָפוֹל sicut cadere, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. נָפַל.
units.tr: נָפוֹל to fall, כְּנָפוֹל as to fall, Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root נָפַל.

units.la: נָפוֹץ, & נְפוֹץ spargere, Infin. Kal, R. נָפַץ.
units.tr: נָפוֹץ, and נְפוֹץ to scatter, Infinitive Kal. Root נָפַץ.

units.la: נְפוּצָה sparsus est, sparsa est, נְפוּצִי sparsi sunt, נְפוּצִים sparsi, נְפוּצָה sparsa, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. ut & Part. Niph. pl. m. & f. f. Rad. פוץ.
units.tr: נְפוּצָה was scattered, was scattered (fem.), נְפוּצִי they were scattered, נְפוּצִים scattered, נְפוּצָה scattered (fem.), past Niph. 3rd fem. & masc. & 3rd pl., and Part. Niph. pl. masc. & fem. fem. Root פוץ.

units.la: נָפוּצוּ dispergemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. Rad. פוץ.
units.tr: נָפוּצוּ we shall scatter, future Kal, 1st pl. Root פוץ.

units.la: נָפוּץ dispersus, Paul Kal, f. m. Rad. נָפַץ.
units.tr: נָפוּץ scattered, Participle Kal, masc. sing. Root נָפַץ.

units.la: נְפוּצְתֶם dispersistis, E-
units.tr: נְפוּצְתֶם you were scattered, E-

units.la: praet. Niph. 2. pl. m. Rad. פוץ.
units.tr: past Niph. 2nd pl. masc. Root פוץ.

units.la: נְפוּצָה dispersa, 2 Sam. 18. 8. pro נְפוּצָה, Part. Niph. sing. fæm. Rad. פוץ.
units.tr: נְפוּצָה scattered, 2 Sam. 18:8, for נְפוּצָה, Participle Niph. sing. fem. Root פוץ.

units.la: נָפוּשׁוּ diffundent se, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. פוש abundare.
units.tr: נָפוּשׁוּ they will spread themselves, past Niph. 3rd pl. Root פוש to abound.

units.tr: נָפוֹת sieves, pulled, pl. fem., noun נָפָה; Root נוף dripped.

units.tr: נָפְזְרוּ were scattered, past Niph. 3rd pl. Root פָּזַר.

units.la: נָפֵחַ efflans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. נָפַח.
units.tr: נָפֵחַ blowing, Participle Kal, masc. sing. Root נָפַח.

units.la: נָפַח efflatus est, praet. Pual, 3. f. m. R. נָפַח.
units.tr: נָפַח was blown, past Pual, 3rd masc. sing. Root נָפַח.

units.la: נָפְחָה efflavit illa, נָפַחְתִּי efflavi, praet. Kal, 3. f. f. & 1. f. Rad. נָפַח.
units.tr: נָפְחָה she blew, נָפַחְתִּי I blew, past Kal, 3rd fem. sing. & 1st fem. Root נָפַח.

units.la: נָפִילָה dissiciemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. נָפַל.
units.tr: נָפִילָה we shall cast down, future Hiph. 1st pl. with paragogic. Root נָפַל.

units.la: נְפִילִים gigantes, No. pl. m. Rad. נָפַל cecidit.
units.tr: נְפִילִים giants, noun masc. pl. Root נָפַל he fell.

units.la: נפל procidemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. נפל.
units.tr: נפל we shall fall down, future Kal, 1st pl. Root נפל.

units.la: נפל cadens, נפל, נפל, cadere, לנפל ad cadendum, & נפל abortus, Ben. Kal, f. m. Infin. Kal, & No. f. m. Rad. נפל.

units.la: נפלה mira fuit, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. פלא.
units.tr: נפלה was wonderful, past Niph. 3rd pl. Root פלא.

units.la: נפלאות constr. נפלאות mirabilia, נפלאותיו ejus, &c. Part. Niph. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. פלא.
units.tr: נפלאות construct נפלאות wonders, נפלאותיו his wonders, etc., Participle Niph. pl. fem. with suffix. Root פלא.

units.la: נפלאים mirabilia, Part. Niph. pl. masc. Rad. פלא.
units.tr: נפלאים wonders, Participle Niph. pl. masc. Root פלא.

units.la: נפלאת admirabilis fuit, Pf. 118. 23. נפלאת occulta, Deut. 30. 11. praet. Niph. 3. f. f. contracte pro נפלאה, & Part. Niph. 1. f. pro נפלאת, Rad. פלא.
units.tr: נפלאת was wonderful, Ps. 118:23. נפלאת hidden, Deut. 30:11. past Niph. 3rd fem. fem., contracted for נפלאה, and Part. Niph. 1st fem. for נפלאת, Root פלא.

units.la: נפלאתה admirabilis fuit, 2 Sam. 1. 26. (pro נפלאה,) praet. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. פלא.
units.tr: נפלאתה was wonderful, 2 Sam. 1:26. (for נפלאה), past Niph. 3rd fem. fem. Root פלא.

units.la: נפלה divisa fuit, praet. Niph. 3. f. f. R. פלג [?].
units.tr: נפלה was divided, past Niph. 3rd fem. fem. Root פלג [?].

units.la: נפלה cecidit, praet. Kal, 3. f. f. R. נפל.
units.tr: [נפלה] she fell; preterite Kal, 3rd person fem. sing.; root [נפל].

units.la: נפלה procidemus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. נפל.
units.tr: [נפלה] we shall fall down; future Kal, 1st pl., with paragogic ending; root [נפל].

units.la: נפלי, & נפלו cadere ejus, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. נפל.
units.tr: [נפלי] and [נפלו], his falling; infinitive Kal with suffix; root [נפל].

units.la: נפלו, & נפלו ceciderunt, praet. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. נפל.
units.tr: [נפלו] they fell; preterite Kal, 3rd pl.; root [נפל].

units.la: נפלו cadite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. נפל.
units.tr: [נפלו] fall! imperative Kal, masc. pl.; root [נפל].

units.la: בנפלים inter cadentes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. praef. Rad. נפל.
units.tr: [בנפלים] among those falling; Benoni Kal, masc. pl., with prefix; root [נפל].

units.la: נפלין separabimur [?] a praet. Niph. 1. pl. R. פלה.
units.tr: [נפלין] we shall be separated [?] from; preterite Niph, 1st pl.; root [פלה].

units.la: נפליתי in admirationem rapior, Pf. 139. 14. praet. Niph. 1. f. (pro נפלאתי) Rad. פלא.
units.tr: [נפליתי] I am rapt in amazement (Ps. 139. 14); preterite Niph, 1st sing. fem. (for [נפלאתי]); root [פלא].

units.la: נפלת judicatus est [?], praet. Niph. 3. f. m. R. פלל [?].
units.tr: [נפלת] he was judged [?]; preterite Niph, 3rd sing. fem. and masc.; root [פלל] [?].

units.la: נפלהם cadere eorum, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad.
units.tr: [נפלהם] their falling; infinitive Kal with suffix.

units.la: נִפְלָה cadens, Ben. Kal, f. f. Rad. נָפַל.
units.tr: [נִפְלָה] falling; Benoni Kal, fem. sing.; root [נָפַל].

units.la: נִפֶּן respiciemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. apoc. (pro נִפְנֶה) Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: [נִפֶּן] we shall turn; future Kal, 1st pl., apocopated (for [נִפְנֶה]); root [פָּנָה].

units.la: נִפְעַמְתִּי concutior, praet. Niph. 1. f. Rad. פָּעַם.
units.tr: [נִפְעַמְתִּי] I am shaken; preterite Niph, 1st sing. fem.; root [פָּעַם].

units.la: נָפֵץ dispersio, No. f. m. Rad. נָפַץ dispersus fuit.
units.tr: [נָפֵץ] dispersion; noun, fem. and masc.; root [נָפַץ], he was dispersed.

units.la: נְפֻצָה dispersa est, נְפֻצוּ dispersi sunt, praet. Kal, 3. f. f. & 3. pl. Rad. נָפַץ.
units.tr: [נְפֻצָה] she was dispersed; [נְפֻצוּ] they were dispersed; preterite Kal, 3rd sing. fem. and 3rd pl.; root [נָפַץ].

units.la: נְפוּצוּ dispersa sunt, pret. Niph. 3. pl. R. פּוּץ.
units.tr: [נְפוּצוּ] they were dispersed; preterite Niph, 3rd pl.; root [פּוּץ].

units.la: נְפוּצָה dispersa, Paul Kal, pl. f. R. נָפַץ.
units.tr: [נְפוּצָה] dispersed; participle Kal, fem. pl.; root [נָפַץ].

units.la: נְפוּצֹתֶם dispersi estis, pret. Niph. 2. pl. m. Rad. פּוּץ.
units.tr: [נְפוּצֹתֶם] you were dispersed; preterite Niph, 2nd pl. masc.; root [פּוּץ].

units.la: נְפוּצִים dispersi, Part. Niph. pl. m. R. פּוּץ.
units.tr: [נְפוּצִים] dispersed; participle Niph, masc. pl.; root [פּוּץ].

units.la: נְפוּצֵיהֶם dispersi eos, praet. Piel, 1. sing. aff. Rad. נָפַץ.
units.tr: [נְפוּצֵיהֶם] I dispersed them; preterite Piel, 1st sing. with suffix; root [נָפַץ].

units.la: נִפְקַד visitatus est, praet. Niph. 3. sing. masc. Rad. פָּקַד
units.tr: [נִפְקַד] was visited; preterite Niph, 3rd sing. masc.; root [פָּקַד].

units.la: נִפְקְחוּ aperti sunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. פָּקַח.
units.tr: [נִפְקְחוּ] they were opened; preterite Niph, 3rd pl.; root [פָּקַח].

units.la: נִפְרְדוּ divisi sunt, praet. Niph. 3. pl. R. פָּרַד.
units.tr: [נִפְרְדוּ] they were divided; preterite Niph, 3rd pl.; root [פָּרַד].

units.la: נִפְרְצָה disrumpamus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad: פָּרַץ.
units.tr: [נִפְרְצָה] let us break through; future Kal, 1st pl., paragogic; root [פָּרַץ].

units.la: נִפְרַץ disruptus est, vel disruptus, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph, Rad. פָּרַץ.
units.tr: [נִפְרַץ] was broken, or broken; preterite Niph, 3rd sing. masc., and participle Niph; root [פָּרַץ].

units.la: נִפְרֹשׂ expandemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. פָּרַשׂ.
units.tr: [נִפְרֹשׂ] we shall spread out; future Kal, 1st pl.; root [פָּרַשׂ].

Infin. נָצַב. נִצָּבִים contendentes, vasti, Part. Niph. vel Nο. Part. pl. m. Rad. נִצָּלִים in Niph. [?] eripimur, præt. Niph. 1. pl. R. נָצַל. spoliastis, Præt. Piel, 2. pl. masc. Rad. נצמ flores, No- plim lin f. f. נִצָּה flos, Rad. נצה germinavit, vel scintillavit. [illegible, ~8 letters] fut. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. נצץ [?] abditus est, נִצְפַּן ab- diti sunt, præt. [נָצִיחַ] we shall justify ourselves, for [נַצְדִּיק]; future Hiph, 1st pl.; root [צדק]. [נָצִיב] pillars; [נְצִיבִים] stationed ones; noun, fem. sing. and masc. pl.; root infinitive [נָצַב]. units.la: 22. 49. pro [?], præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. שָׁבַר נִשְׁבַּת cessavit, נִשְׁבְּתוּ cessaverunt, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. שָׁבַת. נִשְׂגַּב editus est, נִשְׂגְּבָה editaest, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. Rad. שָׂגַב. נִשַּׁם vastatus est, נִשַּׁמּוּ pro נִשַּׁמּוּ vastati su-mus, Mich. 2. 4. præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 1. pl. R. שָׁמַם. הַנָּשָׂה mutuatus, No. f. m. Rad. נָשָׂה mutuavit. נָשָׂה mutuans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. נָשָׂה. נָשׁוּ mutuo dederunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָשָׂה. נָשְׂאוּ extollunt, Ezech. 39. 26. (pro נָשְׂאוּ,) præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. נָשָׂא. נָשׂוּא, & נָשָׂא, vel נָשׂא portando, Infin. Kal, Rad. נָשָׂא. נָשְׂאוּ portarunt, Ps. 139. 20. (pro נָשְׂאוּ,) præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. נָשָׂא. נָשׂוּא, constr. נְשׂוּא portatus, Paul Kal, f. m. Rad. נָשָׂא. נָשׁוּבָה, נָשׁוּבָה revertemur, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. שׁוּב. נָשׂוּא levatus, Ps. 92. 1: Paul Kal, f. m. pro נָשׂוּא, Rad. נָשָׂא; sed forma quasi, à Rad. נָשָׂה. נָשׁוּךְ morsus, Paul Kal, f. m. R. נָשַׁךְ. נַשְׁחִיתָה, נַשְׁחִיתָה corrumpemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. שִׁחַת. נִשְׁחַתְּ corruptus est, נִשְׁחָתָה corrupta est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. Rad. שָׁחַת. נִשְׁחָתוֹת corruptæ, Part. Niph. pl. f. à f. m. נִשְׁחַת corruptus, & f. נִשְׁחָתָה corrupta, R. שָׁחַת. נָשׁ mutuum, No. f. m. Rad. נָשָׂה mutuavit. נָשִׁים uxores, No. pl. f. constr. fut. R. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
units.tr: 22. 49, for [?]; perfect Niphal, 3rd person pl. Root [שָׁבַר]. [נִשְׁבַּת] he ceased; [נִשְׁבְּתוּ] they ceased; perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc. and 3rd person pl. Root [שָׁבַת]. [נִשְׂגַּב] he was exalted; [נִשְׂגְּבָה] she was exalted; perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc. and fem. Root [שָׂגַב]. [נִשַּׁם] he was laid waste; [נִשַּׁמּוּ] for [נִשַּׁמּוּ] we were laid waste, Mich. 2. 4; perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc. and 1st person pl. Root [שָׁמַם]. [הַנָּשָׂה] lent, noun masc. sing. Root [נָשָׂה] he lent. [נָשָׂה] lending; Benoni Kal, masc. sing. Root [נָשָׂה]. [נָשׁוּ] they lent; perfect Kal, 3rd person pl. Root [נָשָׂה]. [נָשְׂאוּ] they lift up, Ezek. 39. 26 (for [נָשְׂאוּ]); perfect Kal, 3rd person pl. Root [נָשָׂא]. [נָשׂוּא] and [נָשָׂא], or [נשׂא], bearing; Infinitive Kal. Root [נָשָׂא]. [נָשְׂאוּ] they carried, Ps. 139. 20 (for [נָשְׂאוּ]); perfect Kal, 3rd person pl. Root [נָשָׂא]. [נָשׂוּא], construct [נְשׂוּא], carried; Pual Kal, masc. sing. Root [נָשָׂא]. [נָשׁוּבָה], [נָשׁוּבָה] we shall return; future Kal, 1st person pl., paragogic. Root [שׁוּב]. [נָשׂוּא] lifted, Ps. 92. 1; Pual Kal, masc. sing., for [נָשׂוּא], Root [נָשָׂא]; but the form looks as if from the root [נָשָׂה]. [נָשׁוּךְ] bitten; Pual Kal, masc. sing. Root [נָשַׁךְ]. [נַשְׁחִיתָה], [נַשְׁחִיתָה] we shall corrupt; future Hiphil, 1st person pl., paragogic. Root [שִׁחַת]. [נִשְׁחַתְּ] he was corrupted; [נִשְׁחָתָה] she was corrupted; perfect Niphal, 3rd person fem. masc. and fem. Root [שָׁחַת]. [נִשְׁחָתוֹת] corrupted; Participle Niphal, pl. fem., from fem. masc. [נִשְׁחַת] corrupted, and fem. [נִשְׁחָתָה] corrupted. Root [שָׁחַת]. [נָשׁ] loan, noun masc. sing. Root [נָשָׂה] he lent. [נָשִׁים] wives, noun pl. fem., construct, future. Root [נָשָׁה] he forgot.

units.la: נְשִׂיא, constr. נְשִׂיא princeps, נְשִׂיאִים principes, נְשִׂיאֵיהֶם illorum, נְשִׂיאָה ejus, נְשִׂיאַי mei, &c. No. sing. & pl. m. aff. Rad. נָשָׂא levare.
units.tr: [נְשִׂיא], construct [נְשִׂיא] prince; [נְשִׂיאִים] princes; [נְשִׂיאֵיהֶם] their princes; [נְשִׂיאָה] his princes; [נְשִׂיאַי] my princes; etc.; noun, sing. and pl. masc. with suffix. Root [נָשָׂא] to lift.

units.la: נָשִׁיב reducemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. שׁוּב.
units.tr: [נָשִׁיב] we shall bring back; future Hiphil, 1st person pl. Root [שׁוּב].

units.la: נְשִׁיָּה oblivio, No. f. fœm. Rad. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
units.tr: [נְשִׁיָּה] forgetfulness; noun, sing. fem. Root [נָשָׁה] he forgot.

units.la: נְשֵׁיהֶם uxores eorum, נְשֵׁיךָ ejus; נְשֵׁיךָ tuæ, &c. No. pl. fœm. aff. Rad. נָשָׁה.
units.tr: [נְשֵׁיהֶם] their wives; [נְשֵׁיךָ] his wife; [נְשֵׁיךָ] your wife; etc.; noun, pl. fem. with suffix. Root [נָשָׁה].

units.la: נִשְׁכִּי, נִשְׁיֶךָ debitum tuum, No. f. m. נֶשִׁי, aff. Rad. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
units.tr: [נִשְׁכִּי], [נִשְׁיֶךָ] your debt; noun, masc., [נֶשִׁי] with suffix. Root [נָשָׁה] he forgot.

units.la: נָשִׁים mulieres, No. pl. fœm. R. נָשָׁה.
units.tr: [נָשִׁים] women; noun, pl. fem. Root [נָשָׁה].

units.la: נַשְׁמָה ponemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. שׂוּם.
units.tr: [נַשְׁמָה] we shall put; future Hiphil, 1st person pl., paragogic. Root [שׂוּם].

units.la: נַשִׁים desolabimus, Num. 21. 30. pro נָשִׁים, vel נְשִׁים; fut. Hiph. 1. pl. Rad. שָׁמַם.
units.tr: [נַשִׁים] we shall make desolate, Num. 21. 30 (for [נָשִׁים] or [נְשִׁים]); future Hiphil, 1st person pl. Root [שָׁמַם].

units.la: נָשִׁים exstirpabimus eos, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. (qu. à 3. sing. m. יַשִּׁיא exactorem aget, Ps. 55. 16. pro יִשַּׁח;) Rad. נָשַׁח.
units.tr: [נָשִׁים] we shall root them out; future Hiphil, 1st person pl. with suffix (perhaps from the 3rd person sing. masc. [יַשִּׁיא] he will drive out, Ps. 55. 16, for [יַשַּׁח]). Root [נָשַׁח].

units.la: נָשִׁים mutuantes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. à f. m. נָשָׁה; Rad. נָשָׁה.
units.tr: [נָשִׁים] lending; Benoni Kal, pl. masc., from fem. masc. [נָשָׁה]. Root [נָשָׁה].

units.la: נְשִׁינוּ mulieres nostræ, No. pl. fœm. נָשִׁים, aff. Rad. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
units.tr: Our women (nashim), a plural feminine noun in the absolute state, from the root נָשָׁה, "he forgot."

units.la: נְשִׁיקָה osculum, נְשִׁיקוֹת osculæ, No. f. & pl. f. Rad. נָשַׁק osculatus est.
units.tr: Nesiqah, a kiss; nesiqot, kisses, a feminine noun in the singular and plural. From the root נָשַׁק, "he kissed."

units.la: נְשִׁירָה cantabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. plur. parag. Rad. שִׁיר.
units.tr: Nesirah, "we will sing": imperfect Hiphil, first person plural with paragogic ending. From the root שִׁיר.

units.la: נָשִׁישׁ gaudebimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. שׂוּשׂ.
units.tr: Nashish, "we will rejoice": imperfect Hiphil, first person plural. From the root שׂוּשׂ.

units.la: נָשֵׁךְ mordens, נָשֶׁךְ usura, Ben. Kal, & No. f. m. Rad. נָשַׁךְ momordit.
units.tr: Nāshēkh, mordens (biting); nāshēkh, usura (usury): Ben. Kal, and No. f. m. Root נָשַׁךְ, he bit.

units.la: נִשְׁכְּבָה cubabimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. שָׁכַב.
units.tr: Nishkevah, "we will lie down": imperfect Kal, first person plural with paragogic ending. From the root שָׁכַב.

units.la: נִשְׁכָּה cubiculum, (idem quod לִשְׁכָּה) No. sing. fœm. Rad. נָשַׁךְ mo-
units.tr: Nishkah, "chamber" (the same as lishkah), a singular feminine noun. From the root נָשַׁךְ, "he bit."

units.la: mordit.
units.tr: "He bit."

units.la: נְשְׁכּוּ momorderunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. R. נָשַׁךְ.
units.tr: Nishku, "they bit": perfect Piel, third person plural. From the root נָשַׁךְ.

units.la: נִשְׂכָּה cubicula, plur. fæm. No. נִשְׂכָּה; Rad. נָשַׁךְ momordit.
units.tr: Nishkāh, cubicles, plural feminine, No. נִשְׂכָּה; Root נָשַׁךְ, he bit.

units.la: נִשְׁכְּחוּ oblivioni tradita sunt, נִשְׁכָּחָה oblivioni
units.tr: Nishkehū, they were given over to oblivion; nishkāhāh, given over to oblivion,

units.la: tradita, נִשְׁכָּחְתִּי oblivioni traditus sum, præt. Niph. 3. pl. (& Part. Niph. f. f. constr., & 1. f. Rad. שָׁכַח
units.tr: nishkaḥtī, I was given over to oblivion, past tense Niph. 3rd pl. (and Part. Niph. f. f. construct, and 1st f. Root שָׁכַח).

units.la: נִשְׁכִּימוּ matutinabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag Rad. שָׁכַם
units.tr: Nishkeru, "they are hired": perfect Niphal, third person plural. From the root שָׂכַר.

units.la: נִשְׂכְּרוּ conducuntur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. שָׂכַר.
units.tr: Nishkbatho, "his chamber," feminine with suffix; from nishkabah; root נָשַׁךְ, "he bit."

units.la: נִשְׁכְּבָתוֹ cubiculum suum, f. fæm. aff. No. נִשְׁכָּבָה; Rad. נָשַׁךְ momordit.
units.tr: Nishlechah, "by sending," Esther 3:13; infinitive Niphal (for hishlechah). From the root שָׁלַח.

units.la: נִשְׁלְחָה mittendo, Esth. 3. 13. Infin. Niph. (pro הִשְׁלְחָה) Rad. שָׁלַח
units.tr: Nishlechah, nishlachnu, "we will send": imperfect Kal, first person plural with paragogic ending. From the root שָׁלַח.

units.la: נִשְׁלְחָה, נִשְׁלַחְנוּ mittemus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. שָׁלַח
units.tr: Nishlaḥāh, nishlaḥnū, we shall send, future Kal, 1st pl. with paragogic ending. Root שָׁלַח.

units.la: נִשְׁלְחָךְ demittemus te,
units.tr: Nishlaḥkhā, we shall send you down,

units.la: נִשְׁלְחֵנוּ eum, fut. Piel, 1. pl. aff. Rad. שָׁלַח.
units.tr: nishlaḥēnū, him, future Piel, 1st pl. with suffix. Root שָׁלַח.

units.la: נִשְׁלִיךְ rejiciemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. שָׁלַךְ.
units.tr: Nishlem, nishlemah, "we will complete": imperfect Piel, first person plural with paragogic ending. From the root שָׁלַם.

units.la: נִשְׁלֵם, נִשְׁלְמָה perficiemus, fut. Piel, 1. pl. parag. Rad. שָׁלַם.
units.tr: Nishmedanu, "we are destroyed": perfect Niphal, first person plural. From the root שָׁמַד.

units.la: נִשְׁמְדָנוּ perditi sumus, præt. Niph. 1. pl. R. שָׁמַד.
units.tr: Nishamah, or nishammah, "desolate"; nishammot, "desolate" (feminine plural): participle Niphal, feminine and feminine plural. From the root שָׁמַם.

units.la: נִשַּׁמָּה, vel נִשַּׁמָּה desolata, נִשַּׁמּוֹת desolatæ, Part. Niph. f. & pl. f. R. שָׁמַם.
units.tr: Nishmu, "they were made desolate": perfect Niphal, third person plural. From the root שָׁמַם.

units.la: נִשְׁמוּ desolatæ sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. שָׁמַם.
units.tr: Nishmot, "souls," a feminine plural noun; from nishmah; root נָשַׁם.

units.la: נִשְׁמוֹת animæ, pl. fæm. No. נִשְׁמָה, Rad. נָשַׁם.
units.tr: Nishmechah, nishmach, "we will rejoice": imperfect Kal, first person plural with paragogic ending. From the root שָׂמַח.

units.la: נִשְׁמְחָה, נִשְׂמַח lætabimur, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. שָׂמַח.
units.tr: Nishmetu, "they withdraw themselves": perfect Niphal, third person plural. From the root שָׁמַט.

units.la: נִשְׁמְטוּ dimovent se, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. שָׁמַט
units.tr: Nishmeṭū, they shake themselves off, past tense Niph. 3rd pl. Root שָׁמַט.

units.la: intermisit.
units.tr: he omitted.

units.la: נַשְׁמִידָה perdemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. שָׁמַר.
units.tr: Nashmīdāh, we shall destroy, future Hiph. 1st pl. with paragogic ending. Root שָׁמַר.

units.la: נִשְׁמַע auditus est, audiemus,
units.tr: Nishma', it is heard; we shall hear,

units.la: mus,
units.tr: we shall,

units.la: [?]seus, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. vel fut. Kal, 1. pl. Rad. שָׁמַע.
units.tr: [?]seus, past tense Niph. 3rd f. m. or future Kal, 1st pl. Root שָׁמַע.

units.la: נִשְׁמָעֻנָה audiemus illud, fut. Kal, 1. plur. aff. Rad. שָׁמַע.
units.tr: Nishma'at, "heard," a participle Niphal, feminine, construct, from the masculine nishma', "heard"; root שָׁמַע.

units.la: נִשְׁמַעַת audita, Part. Niph. f. f. constr. à f. m. נִשְׁמָע auditus, Rad. שָׁמַע.
units.tr: Nishmerah, "they were kept": perfect Niphal, third person plural. From the root שָׁמַר.

units.la: נִשְׁמְרָה custoditi sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. שָׁמַר.
units.tr: Nishanni, "he has made me forget," Genesis 41:51, for nashanni; perfect Piel, third person feminine masculine with suffix. From the root נָשָׁה.

units.la: נִשַּׁנִי oblivisci fecit me, Gen. 41. 51. pro נָשַׁנִי Præt. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָשָׁה.
units.tr: Nishapu, "they are plundered": perfect Niphal, third person plural. From the root שָׁסַף.

units.la: נִשַּׁפּוּ diripiuntur, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. שָׁסַף.
units.tr: Nish'enu, "they leaned on": Niphal perfect, third person and first person plural, 2 Chronicles 14:11, for nish'anu. From the root שָׁעַן.

units.la: נִשְׁעָנוּ innixi sunt, נִשְׁעֲנוּ innixi fumus, 2 Chron. 14.11. pro נִשְׁעַנּוּ; præt. Niph. 3. & 1. pl. Rad. שָׁעַן.
units.tr: Nisʿarah, "it is stormy," Psalm 50:3, for nisʿarah; perfect Niphal, third person feminine. From the root שָׂעַר, for סָעַר.

units.la: נִשְׂעָרָה procellosa est, Ps. 50.3. pro נִסְעָרָה, præt. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. שָׂעַר, pro סָעַר.
units.tr: Nishpu, "its darkness," singular masculine with suffix; from nashaf, root נָשַׁף, "he blew."

units.la: נִשְׁפּוּ obscuritas ejus, sing.
units.tr: Nishmepah, "he adds": perfect Niphal, third person singular masculine. From the root סָפַח, "he joined."

units.la: m. aff. No. נָשַׁף, Rad. נָשַׁף flavit.
units.tr: Nishpetah, "we will judge": imperfect Niphal, first person plural with paragogic ending. From the root שָׁפַט.

units.la: נִשְׁמְּפָה adjungit, præt. Niph. 3. sing. masc. Rad. סָפַח aggregavit.
units.tr: Lin'shoq, "for kissing": infinitive Piel, with prefix; from the root נָשַׁק.

units.la: נִשְׁפְּטָה discepta-bimus, fut. Niph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. שָׁפַט.
units.tr: Min'shaq, "from the armour," bin'shaq, "in the armour"; masculine noun with prefix; from the root נָשַׁק, "he kissed."

units.la: לִנְשֹׁק ad osculandum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. נָשַׁק.
units.tr: Lin'shoq, "for kissing": infinitive Kal, with prefix; from the root נָשַׁק.

units.la: מִנְּשָׁק ab armatura, בְּנְשָׁק in armatura, No. f. m. præf. Rad. נָשַׁק osculatus est.
units.tr: Nishqah, "it was set on fire," nishqah, "she was set on fire": perfect Niphal, third person masculine and feminine; from the root נָשַׁק.

units.la: לִנְשֹׁק ad osculandum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. נָשַׁק.
units.tr: Nashqah, "we will water": imperfect Hiphil, first person plural; from the root שָׁקָה.

units.la: נִשְׁקָה succensus est, נִשְׂקָה succensa est; præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. Rad. נָשַׁק.
units.tr: Nishqah, "it is submerged," Amos 8:8, for nishqa'ah; perfect Niphal, third person feminine; from the root שָׁקַע; or it is for nishqatah, "it is watered," perfect Niphal, third person feminine, from nishqah; root שָׁקָה.

units.la: נַשְׁקָה irrigabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. שָׁקָה.
units.tr: Nashqāh, we shall water, future Hiph. 1st pl. Root שָׁקָה.

units.la: נִשְׁקָה submergitur, Amos 8.8. (pro נִשְׁקָעָה,) præt. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁקַע; vel est pro נִשְׁקָתָה irrigatur, præt. Niph. 3. f f. à 3. f. m. נִשְׁקָה; R.
units.tr: Nishqāh, it is submerged, Amos 8.8 (for נִשְׁקָעָה), past tense Niph. 3rd f. f. Root שָׁקַע; or it is for נִשְׁקְתָה, it is watered, past tense Niph. 3rd f. f. from the 3rd f. m. נִשְׁקָה; Root

units.la: שָׁקָה.
units.tr: שָׁקָה.

units.la: נִשְׁקוּ osculati sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָשַׁק.
units.tr: Nishqū, they kissed, past tense Kal, 3rd pl. Root נָשַׁק.

units.la: נִשְׁקוּ osculamini, Imper. Piel, pl. m. R. נַשֵּׁק.
units.tr: Nishqenu, "we will give him to drink": imperfect Hiphil, first person plural with suffix; from the root שָׁקָה.

units.la: נֹשְׁקִים osculantes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. constr. Rad. נָשַׁק.
units.tr: Nishqa', "he was submerged," "she was submerged": perfect Niphal, third person masculine and feminine; from the root שָׁקַע.

units.la: נִשְׁקַל appensum est, præt. Niph. 3. sing. m. Rad. שָׁקַל.
units.tr: Nishqaf, "he looked out," or "looking out," hanishqaf, "here looking out": perfect Niphal, third person masculine, and participle Niphal masculine; from the root שָׁקַף.

units.la: נִשְׁקְנוּ bibendum dabimus ei, fut. Hiph. 1. plur. aff. Rad. שָׁקָה.
units.tr: Nishqafah, "it was looked out upon," or hanishqafah, "looked out upon": perfect Niphal, third person feminine, or participle Niphal feminine; from the root שָׁקַף.

units.la: נִשְׁקַע submersus est, submersa est, præt. Niph. 3. f.m. & f. Rad. שָׁקַע.
units.tr: Nesharei, "eagles," from the masculine plural prefixed form min-nesharim, "than eagles," a masculine plural noun; from the root נָשַׁר, or from the Chaldee nesar, or from the root שׁוּר, "he sang."

units.la: נִשְׁקָף spectavit, vel spectans, הַנִּשְׁקָף hic spectans, præt. Niph. 3. f.m. & Part. Niph. f.m. Rad. שָׁקַף.
units.tr: Nishrafah, nishrefah, "we will burn": imperfect Kal, first person plural with paragogic ending; from the root שָׂרַף.

units.la: נִשְׁקָפָה spectata est, הַנִּשְׁקָפָה spectata, præt. Niph. 3. f.f. vel Part. Niph. f.fæm. Rad. שָׁקַף.
units.tr: Nishtah, "he perished," Jeremiah 51:30, and for it nishtah; perfect Kal, third person feminine; from the root נָשַׁח.

units.la: נְשָׁרִי aquilæ, מִנְּשָׁרִים præ aquilis, plur. m. præf.
units.tr: Nishtah, "we will drink": imperfect Kal, first person plural; from the root שָׁתָה.

units.la: No. Rad. נָשַׁר ; vel à Chald. נְשַׁר, vel à Rad. שׁוּר cecinit.
units.tr: Nishtu, "they failed": perfect Niphal, third person plural; from the root נִשַׁח.

units.la: נִשְׂרָפָה, נִשְׂרְפָה comburemus, fut. Kal, 1. plur. parag. Rad. שָׂרַף.
units.tr: Nishtavah, "it is made equal," Proverbs 27:15, compounded of the perfect Niphal nishwah and the perfect Hithpael nishtavvah, third person masculine; from the root שָׁוָה.

units.la: נִשְׁתָּה periit, Jer. 51. 30. & pro eo, נִשְׁתָּה ; præt. Kal, 3. f.f. Rad. נָשַׁח.
units.tr: Nishtan, "diploma," a masculine noun; from the root נָשַׁח, "he failed."

units.la: נִשְׁתָּה bibemus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. שָׁתָה.
units.tr: Nishtachavah, "we will bow down": imperfect Hithpael, first person plural; from the root שָׁחָה.

units.la: נִשְׁתּוּ defecerunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. נִשַׁח.
units.tr: Nishta'eh, "we will be astonished": imperfect Hithpael, first person plural (for nishta'eh); from the root שָׁעָה.

units.la: נִשְׁתָּוָה æquatur, Prov. 27. 15. comp. ex præt. Niph. נִשְׁוָה, & præt. Hithp. נִשְׁתַּוָּה, 3. f.m. Rad. שָׁוָה.
units.tr: Nitatzu, "they are stripped": perfect Niphal, third person plural. From the root נָתַץ.

units.la: נִשְׁתָּן diploma, No. f.m. Rad. נָשַׁח defecit.
units.tr: Nitatzu, "we are made to stand" ... [remainder of entry too damaged in the scan to be read with confidence].

units.la: נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה incurvabimus nos, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. Rad. שָׁחָה.
units.tr: "We are stirred up": imperfect Hithpael, first person plural.

units.la: נִשְׁתָּעֶה stupebimus; fut. Hithp. 1. pl. (pro נִשְׁתָּעֶה,) Rad. שָׁעָה.
units.tr: Nishtā'eh, we shall be astonished; future Hithp. 1st pl. (for נִשְׁתָּעֶה), Root שָׁעָה.

units.la: נ ת נְתַן, & נָתַן & dare, Inf. Kal, R. נָתַן. נָתוּן datus, נְתוּנִים dati, נְתוּנוֹת datæ, Paul Kal, f. m. & pl. masc. & fæm. Rad. נָתַן. נָתוּק avulsus, Paul Kal, f. m. R. נָתַק. נִתַּתָה divisit, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. R. נָתַח. נִתְחַזְקָה exhibebi-mus nos fortes, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. parag. Rad. חָזַק. נִתְחֵיךָ membra, נִתְחֵיךְ tua, pl. m. aff. No. נִתַּח Rad. נָתַח divisit. נְתִיבַת semita, נְתִיבָתִי mea, נְתִיבוֹת semitæ, f. f. constr. aff. & pl. f. No. f. fæm. נְתִיבָה, & f. m. נָתִיב semita, constr. נְתִיב; Rad. נָתַב. נִתְחַכְּמָה sapienter gera-mus nos, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. parag. Rad. חָכַם. חָכַם. נִתַּךְ effusus est, נִתְּכָה effu-sa est, נִתְּכֻם effusi estis, נִתְּכָה effusa, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. & 2. pl. m. ut & Part. Niph. f. fæm. Rad. נָתַךְ. נִתְכְּנוּ aptati sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. תָּכַן. נִתְלוּ suspensi sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. תָּלָה. נָתַן, נָתְנָה dabimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. נָתַן. נָתַן datus est, נָתְנָה data est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & f. Rad. נָתַן. נָתְנָה illa dedit, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. נָתַן. נָתְנָה dedit eam, נָתְנוּ eum, נָתְנִי te, נָתְנָם eos, נָתְנִי me, נָתְנוּ nos, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָתַן. נִתְנוּ dati sunt, נִתַּנּוּ dati sumus, Ezec. 9. 7. pro נָתְנוּ, præt. Niph. 3. & 1. 1. pl. Rad. נָתַן נָתְשׁוּ destruunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. נָתַשׁ [?] נָתְעַב abominabile visum fuit, vel ב abomina-tus, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & Part. Niph. f. m. R. תָּעַב [?] נִתְעָה seductus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. R. תָּעָה [?] נֶהֱמוּ commoluntur, Job. 4. 10. pro נֶהֱמוּ [?]; præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. נָהַם [?] וְנִתְעֹרְדוּ & erecti consistimus, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. Rad. עָרַד [?] נִתְעַלְסָה exsultemus, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. parag. Rad. עָלַס [?] נִתְפַּשׂ captus est, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. תָּפַשׂ [?] וְנִתְפְּשֵׂם & apprehendemus illos, fut. Kal, 1. plur. aff. Rad. תָּפַשׂ [?] נָתוּץ destructum est, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. R. נָתַץ [?] נָתְצוּ destruxerunt, præt. Kal, נִתְּצוּ destructi sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. Rad. נָתַץ [?] וַיִּתְּצֵם destruxerunt, & destruxistis, præt. Piel, 3. pl. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָתַץ [?] נָתַק avellitur, וַיִּתְּקוּ avellebantur, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. נָתַק [?] וַיִּתְּקֻהוּ & avellemus eum, Jud. 20. 32. pro נִתְּקֻהוּ, præt. Kal, 1. pl. aff. Rad. נָתַק [?] לִנְתֹּר ad saliendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. נָתַר [?] נָתֹר, & נֶתֶר nitrum, No. f. m. R. נָתַר [?] נִתְרָאֶה videamus nos, fut. Hithp. 1. pl. R. רָאָה [?] וַנְּתַשְׁתִּים exstirpavi eos, præt. Kal, 1. sing. aff. præf. Rad. נָתַשׁ [?] נָתַתִּי & נְתַתָּה dedi, נְתַתֶּם dedistis, נְתַתִּיס dedistis, &c. præt. [?] præt Kal, 2. f. m. parag. & 1. f. ut & 2. pl. m. & f. Rad. [נָתַן] [נָתַתִּי] dedisti, pro [נָתַתָּ], præt. Kal, 2. f. f. Rad. [נָתַן] [נְתַתֶּם] traditi estis, Lev. 26. 25. pro [נְתַתֶּם] præt. Niph. 2. pl. m. Rad. [נָתַן]
units.tr: Nithan, and nātan, to give, Inf. Kal, Root נָתַן. Nātūn, given; nětūnīm, given, nětūnōt, given, Participle Kal, f. m. and pl. masc. and fem. Root נָתַן. Nātūq, torn away, Participle Kal, f. m., Root נָתַק. Nithtāh, he divided, past tense Piel, 3rd f. m., Root נָתַח. Nithḥazqāh, we shall show ourselves strong, future Hithp. 1st pl. with paragogic ending, Root חָזַק. Nithḥēkha, limbs; nithḥēkh, your, pl. m. with suffix, No. נִתַּח Root נָתַח, he divided. Nətībat, path; nətībāti, my; nətībōt, paths, f. f. construct with suffix and pl. f., No. f. fem. נְתִיבָה, and f. m. נָתִיב, path, construct נְתִיב; Root נָתַב. Nithḥkamāh, we shall act wisely, future Hithp. 1st pl. with paragogic ending, Root חָכַם. חָכַם. Nittak, it was poured out, nittĕkhāh, she was poured out, nittĕkhem, you were poured out, nittĕkhāh, poured out, past tense Niph. 3rd f. m. and f. and 2nd pl. m., and Participle Niph. f. fem., Root נָתַךְ. Niṭkenū, they were fitted, past tense Niph. 3rd pl., Root תָּכַן. Niṭlū, they were hanged, past tense Niph. 3rd pl., Root תָּלָה. Nātan, nətānāh, we shall give, future Kal, 1st pl. with paragogic ending, Root נָתַן. Nittan, it was given, nětānāh, she was given, past tense Niph. 3rd f. m. and f., Root נָתַן. Nātenāh, she gave, past tense Kal, 3rd f. f., Root נָתַן. Nĕtānāh, she gave it, nĕtenū, him, nĕtenī, you, nĕtānām, them, nĕtenī, me, nĕtenū, us, past tense Kal, 3rd f. m. with suffix, Root נָתַן. Nittenū, they were given, nittannū, we were given, Ezek. 9.7, for נָתְנוּ, past tense Niph. 3rd and 1st pl., Root נָתַן. Nĕtashū, they destroy, past tense Kal, 3rd pl., Root נָתַשׁ. [?] Nĕ'eṭav, it seemed abominable, or he abominated, past tense Niph. 3rd f. m. and Participle Niph. f. m., Root תָּעַב. [?] Nith'āh, he was led astray, past tense Niph. 3rd f. m., Root תָּעָה. [?] Nehĕmū, they are moved, Job 4.10, for נֶהֱמוּ [?]; past tense Niph. 3rd pl., Root נָהַם. [?] Wĕnitʿŏrĕdū, and we stand upright, future Hithp. 1st pl., Root עָרַד. [?] Nith'alsāh, we shall exult, future Hithp. 1st pl. with paragogic ending, Root עָלַס. [?] Nitpaś, he was seized, past tense Niph. 3rd f. m., Root תָּפַשׂ. [?] Wĕnitpĕśēm, and we shall seize them, future Kal, 1st pl. with suffix, Root תָּפַשׂ. [?] Nātūṣ, it was destroyed, past tense Pual, 3rd f. m., Root נָתַץ. [?] Nĕtʿṣū, they destroyed, past tense Kal, Nittĕṣū, they were destroyed, past tense Niph. 3rd pl., Root נָתַץ. [?] Wayyittĕṣēm, they destroyed, and you destroyed, past tense Piel, 3rd pl. and 2nd pl. m., Root נָתַץ. [?] Nātaq, he is torn away, and wayyittĕqū, they were torn away, past tense Niph. 3rd f. m. and 3rd pl., Root נָתַק. [?] Wayyittĕqŭhū, and we tear him away, Judg. 20.32, for נִתְּקֻהוּ, past tense Kal, 1st pl. with suffix, Root נָתַק. [?] Linetōr, for leaping, Infinitive Piel, with prefix, Root נָתַר. [?] Nātōr, and nēter, nitre, No. f. m., Root נָתַר. [?] Nitrā'eh, let us see ourselves, future Hithp. 1st pl., Root רָאָה. [?] Wanneṯaštīm, I have utterly destroyed them, past tense Kal, 1st sing. with suffix and prefix, Root נָתַשׁ. [?] Nātattī and nĕtattāh, I have given, nĕtattem, you have given, nĕtattīs, you have given, etc., past tense [?] past tense Kal, 2nd f. m. with paragogic ending and 1st f., as well as 2nd pl. m. and f., Root [נָתַן]. [nātattī] you have given, for [nātattā], past tense Kal, 2nd f. f., Root [נָתַן]. [nĕtattem] you were delivered, Lev. 26.25, for [nĕtattem], past tense Niph. 2nd pl. m., Root [נָתַן].

units.tr: made, perf. Piel, עָלַל was made, perf. Pual, 3rd sing. masc. Rad. עָלַל

units.la: עָלַל naamando, Infin. Piel, Rad. עָלַל
units.tr: to naamand, infinitive Piel, root עָלַל.

units.la: שָׂלָּה illa fecit, præt. Piel, 3. s. f. R. עָלַל
units.tr: she made it, preterite Piel, 3rd person singular feminine, root עָלַל.

units.la: שָׂלִיתָ fecisti, factus es, שָׂלִיתִי feci, factus sum, præt. Piel, vel, Pual, 2. s. m. & 1. s. R. עָלַל
units.tr: you made, you were made / I made, I was made, preterite Piel or Pual, 2nd person singular masculine and 1st person singular, root עָלַל.

units.la: עוֹלָם seculum, עוֹלְמִי secula, No. s. & pl. constr. m. Rad. עָלַם latitavit.
units.tr: seculum (world, age), עוֹלְמִי secula, noun singular and plural construct masculine, root עָלַם, he hid himself.

units.la: עוֹלְתָה, & עוֹלָּתָה nequitia, No. sing. fæm. Rad. עָוַל iniquè egit.
units.tr: עוֹלְתָה and עוֹלָּתָה wickedness, noun singular feminine, root עָוַל, he acted unjustly.

units.la: עֹמְסִים onerantes, Neh. 4. 17. pro עוֹמְסִים, Ben. Kal, pl. m. Rad. עָמַס
units.tr: עֹמְסִים bearing burdens, Neh. 4. 17., for עוֹמְסִים, Qal participle plural masculine, root עָמַס.

units.la: עָוְיָה perversitas, עָוֹנִים perversitates, No. s. & pl. m. & f. Rad. עָוָה
units.tr: עָוְיָה perversity, עָוֹנִים perversities, noun singular and plural masculine and feminine, root עָוָה.

units.la: עֵין oculans[?], 1. Sam. 18. 9.
units.tr: עֵין making eyes[?], 1 Sam. 18. 9.

units.la: Part. Ben. Kal, (pro עַיִן, vel עֵין,) s. m. à Rad. עַיִן; vel, No. s. m. à No. Rad. עַיִן oculus.
units.tr: Participle Qal, (for עַיִן or עֵין,) singular masculine, from root עַיִן; or, noun singular masculine from the noun root עַיִן, eye.

units.la: עֵנִין præstigiis usus est, præt. Piel, 3. s. m. à No. Rad. עַיִן oculus.
units.tr: עֵנִין he used enchantments, preterite Piel, 3rd person singular masculine, from the noun root עַיִן, eye.

units.la: עֵינָתָה tempus ejus, No. s. f. עֵינָה tempus, aff. No. Rad. עַיִן
units.tr: עֵינָתָה her time, noun singular feminine, עֵינָה time, with suffix, noun root עַיִן.

units.la: עִתִּים tempora ipsorum, Hos. 10. 10. (pro quo scribitur, עִנָּתָם,) No. pl. f. aff. s. f. עֵנָה, à s. m. No. Rad. עַיִן tempus, vel pro, עֲוֹנָתָם iniquitates ipsorum, à s. m. עָוֹן, & f. עֲוֹנָה, in Rad. עָוָה perversè egit, vel pro, עֵינֵיהֶם oculi ipsorum, pl. fæm. aff. à s. No. Rad. עַיִן, vel pro מְעוֹנֹתָם habitationes ipsorum, à s. מְעוֹנָה, in No. Rad. עִין; vel, ut legitur, עֲתוֹתָם sulci eorum, eorum, No. pl. f. aff. à f. fæm. עֹנָה sulcus, idem, cum מַעְיָה sulcus, Rad. עָנָה exaudivit.
units.tr: עִתִּים their times, Hos. 10. 10. (for which is written עִנָּתָם), noun plural feminine with feminine singular suffix, from the masculine noun עֵת, root עַיִן, time; or for עֲוֹנָתָם their iniquities, from the masculine noun עָוֹן and the feminine עֲוֹנָה, in the root עָוָה, he acted perversely; or for עֵינֵיהֶם their eyes, plural feminine with suffix, from the noun singular root עַיִן; or for מְעוֹנֹתָם their habitations, from the noun singular מְעוֹנָה, in the noun root עִין; or, as it is read, עֲתוֹתָם their furrows, noun plural feminine with suffix, from the feminine noun עֹנָה, furrow, the same as מַעְיָה furrow, root עָנָה, he answered.

units.la: עָוְתִים[?] perversitates, No. pl. m. geminatâ primâ radicali, à Rad. עָוָה perversè egit.
units.tr: עָוְתִים[?] perversities, noun plural masculine, with the first radical doubled, from the root עָוָה, he acted perversely.

units.la: [illegible, ~3 letters] cum faciant ut volet, Infin. Piel, שַׁעֵף[?] praef. aff. Rad. עוּף.
units.tr: [illegible, about 3 letters] since they do as he wills, Infinitive Piel, שַׁעֵף[?] with prefix and suffix, root עוּף.

units.la: עָוַר excæcavit, cæcus, עִוְרִים, cæci, עִוְרָה cæca, עִוְרוֹת cæcæ, עִוְרוּת cæcitas, &c. præt. Piel, 3. f. m. & No. f. & pl. m. & f. & pl. fæm. ut & No. f. m. Rad. עוּר evigilavit.
units.tr: עָוַר he blinded, blind, עִוְרִים blind men, עִוְרָה blind woman, עִוְרוֹת blind women, עִוְרוּת blindness, etc., preterite Piel, 3rd person feminine singular and masculine, and noun feminine and plural masculine and feminine and plural feminine, as also noun masculine and feminine, root עוּר, he awoke.

units.la: עוֹר pellis, עוֹרָה[?] pelles nostræ, Thren. 5. 10. (pro, עוֹרוֹת,) עוֹרוֹת pelles, No. f. m. & No. pl. m. aff. & pl. f. Rad. עָרָה nudavit.
units.tr: עוֹר skin, עוֹרָה[?] our skins, Thren. 5. 10. (for עוֹרוֹת), עוֹרוֹת skins, noun feminine and masculine plural masculine with suffix and plural feminine, root עָרָה, he stripped.

units.la: עוּרִי evigila, Ps. 57. 9. parag. pro עוּר, Imper.
units.tr: עוּרִי awake, Ps. 57. 9. with paragogic ending, for עוּר, imperative.

units.la: Kal, f. m. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: Qal, feminine singular masculine, root עוּר.

units.la: עוֹרֵר excitavit, עוֹרְרוּ excitarunt, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: עוֹרֵר he stirred up, עוֹרְרוּ they stirred up, preterite Piel, 3rd person feminine singular and 3rd person plural, root עוּר.

units.la: עוֹרְרָה suscita, parag. pro עוּר, Imper. Piel f. m. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: עוֹרְרָה stir up, with paragogic ending, for עוּר, imperative Piel feminine singular, root עוּר.

units.la: עוֹשֶׂה conficiens, pro עֹשֶׂה, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: עוֹשֶׂה making, for עֹשֶׂה, Qal participle feminine singular, root עָשָׂה.

units.la: לְעוֹת ad tempestivè loquendum, (pro לַעֲוֹת,) Infin. Kal. R. עָוַת; vel, ab ipsâ Rad. עוּת.
units.tr: לְעוֹת to speak fittingly, (for לַעֲוֹת), Qal infinitive, root עָוַת; or, from the root עוּת itself.

units.la: עָוְתָה perversè egit, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. עָוָה.
units.tr: עָוְתָה she acted perversely, preterite Qal, 3rd person feminine, root עָוָה.

units.la: עִוְּתַנִי perversit ipsum, עִוְּתוּנִי perverterunt me, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. עָוַת.
units.tr: עִוְּתַנִי she perverted him, עִוְּתוּנִי they pervert me, preterite Piel, 3rd person feminine singular with suffix and 3rd person plural masculine with suffix, root עָוַת.

units.la: עָוָּתִי perversitas mea, No. sing. fæm. עַוָּתִי aff. Rad. עָוַת.
units.tr: עָוָּתִי my perversity, noun singular feminine, עַוָּתִי with suffix, root עָוַת.

units.la: עִוּ robustus, עִוּ robur.
units.tr: עִוּ strong, עִוּ strength.

units.la: No. f. m. Rad. עָזַז robo-ravit.
units.tr: Noun feminine and masculine, root עָזַז, he strengthened.

units.la: עָזְנֵךָ[?] nundinae tuae, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. עָזַב reliquit.
units.tr: עָזְנֵךָ[?] your markets, noun plural masculine with suffix, root עָזַב, he forsook.

units.la: עָזָה vehemens, עֲזוּזָה vehementes, No. f. & pl. fæm. à f. m. עָז; Rad. עָזַז roboravit.
units.tr: עָזָה vehement, עֲזוּזָה vehement, noun feminine and plural feminine, from the masculine עָז; root עָזַז, he strengthened.

units.la: עָז robur ejus, עָזִי meum, עָזְךָ tuum, עָזָם, עָזָּם eorum, &c. No. sing. m. עָז, vel עָזוֹ, aff. Rad. עָזַז.
units.tr: עָז its strength, עָזִי my, עָזְךָ your, עָזָם, עָזָּם their, etc., noun singular masculine, עָז, or עָזוֹ with suffix, root עָזַז.

units.la: בְּעָזוֹ cum roboraret, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. עָזַז.
units.tr: בְּעָזוֹ while he strengthened, Qal infinitive with prefix, root עָזַז.

units.la: עָזּוּז robustus, & עָזּוּז robur, No. f. m. R. עָז.
units.tr: עָזּוּז strong, and עָזּוּז strength, noun feminine and masculine, root עָז.

units.la: עָזִי robur meum, עָזְךָ tuum, &c. No. f. m. עָז, vel עָזוֹ, aff. Rad. עָזַז roboravit.
units.tr: עָזִי my strength, עָזְךָ your, etc., noun feminine and masculine, עָז, or עָזוֹ with suffix, root עָזַז, he strengthened.

units.la: עָזִים capræ; עָזֶךָ tuae, pl. aff. à f. f. No. Rad. עָז capra.
units.tr: עָזִים goats; עָזֶךָ your (plural), from the feminine noun עֵז, with suffix, root עָז, goat.

units.la: עֲזִיָּה halieætus, No. sing. fæm. Rad. עָזַז roboravit.
units.tr: עֲזִיָּה osprey, noun singular feminine, root עָזַז, he strengthened.

units.la: עֲזְרָתָה omnimodum auxilium, f. cum duplici terminatione f. g. constr. עֶזְרַת, à No. עֶזְרָה auxilium, R. עָזַר auxiliatus est.
units.tr: עֲזְרָתָה every kind of help, feminine with double feminine ending, construct עֶזְרַת, from the noun עֶזְרָה help, root עָזַר, he helped.
