units.tr: ע ט

units.la: עִיט volucris, No. f. m. constr. à No. עַיִט avis.
units.tr: עִיט bird of prey, noun feminine masculine, construct of the noun עַיִט bird.

units.la: עָמְדוּ amiciverunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. עָמָה amiciendo, Inf. Kal, R. עָמַה.
units.tr: עָמְדוּ they wrapped themselves, preterite Qal, 3rd person plural; עָמָה wrapping, Qal infinitive, root עָמַה.

units.la: כְּעָטָה quasi operta, Cant. 1.7. Ben. Kal, f. f. à f. m. עָטָה, Rad. עָטָה.
units.tr: כְּעָטָה as if covered, Cant. 1. 7., Qal participle feminine singular, from the feminine עָטָה, root עָטָה.

units.la: עַטְנָיו multralia ejus, No. pl. m. aff. à f. m. עַטָּן, Rad. inusit. עָטַן.
units.tr: עַטְנָיו his cords[?], noun plural masculine with suffix, from the feminine masculine noun עַטָּן, root unused עָטַן.

units.la: עַטְשְׁתָיו sternutationes ejus, No. pl. fæm. aff. à f. f. עַטְשָׁה, Rad. inusit. עטש.
units.tr: עַטְשְׁתָיו his sneezings, noun plural feminine with suffix, from the feminine noun עַטְשָׁה, root unused עטש.

units.la: עָטְךָ amiciens te, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. עָטָה, aff.
units.tr: עָטְךָ wrapping you, Qal participle masculine singular, עָטָה, with suffix.

units.la: Rad. עָטָה.
units.tr: Root עָטָה.

units.la: כְּעָטָף cum obrueretur, Thren. 2. 11. (pro בְּהַעֲטֵף,) Inf. Niph. præf. Rad. עָטַף.
units.tr: כְּעָטָף when he was overwhelmed, Thren. 2. 11. (for בְּהַעֲטֵף), Infinitive Niphal with prefix, root עָטַף.

units.la: ע
units.tr: ע

units.la: ע cumulus, לְעֵי in cumulum; עֵים cumuli, No. f. m. præf, & pl. m. Rad. inusit. עִיָה.
units.tr: ע heap, לְעֵי to a heap; עֵים heaps, noun feminine masculine with prefix, and plural masculine, root unused עִיָה.

units.la: בְּעֵי in cumulum, No. f. m. עֵי, præf. vel cum ב, Rad. בְּעִי postulatio, No. f. m. Rad. בָּעָה bullavit.
units.tr: בְּעֵי to a heap, noun feminine masculine עֵי, with prefix or with ב, root בְּעִי request, noun feminine masculine, root בָּעָה he bellowed.

units.la: עֵדֵי testes, Pf. 27. 12. No. pl. constr. pro עֵדֵי, à f. עֵד, R. עוד.
units.tr: עֵדֵי witnesses, Ps. 27. 12. noun plural construct for עֵדֵי, from the feminine noun עֵד, root עוד.

units.la: לְעֵטִי volucri, f. m. constr. à No. עֵטִי avis.
units.tr: לְעֵטִי to a bird, feminine masculine construct, from the noun עֵטִי bird.

units.la: עֵין acervi, בְּעֵי ad cumulos, No. pl m. à f. m. עֵי.
units.tr: עֵין heaps, בְּעֵי to the heaps, noun plural masculine, from the feminine masculine עֵי.

units.la: לְעוֹלָם in sæculum, 2 Par. 33. 7. pro לְעוֹלָם, No. f m. præf. Rad. עוֹלָם.
units.tr: לְעוֹלָם forever, 2 Chr. 33. 7. for לְעוֹלָם, noun feminine masculine with prefix, root עוֹלָם.

units.la: עַיִן oculus, עֵינַיִם oculi duo, עֵינִי oculus meus, עֵינַת [?]
units.tr: עַיִן eye, עֵינַיִם two eyes, עֵינִי my eye, עֵינַת [?]

units.la: fontes, &c. No. f. constr. du. aff. & pl. f. No. Rad. עַיִן oculus.
units.tr: fountains, etc., noun feminine construct dual with suffix and plural feminine, root עַיִן eye.

units.la: עַיִן oculans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. inusit. עַיִן, vel No. f. m. à No. Rad. עַיִן, עֵינוֹתָם, vide עֵינוֹתָם.
units.tr: עַיִן making eyes, Qal participle feminine masculine, root unused עַיִן, or noun feminine masculine from the noun root עַיִן, עֵינוֹתָם, see עֵינוֹתָם.

units.la: עָפָה obscuritas, No. f. fæm. Rad. עוּף volavit, sed עָפָה fessa, עֲפִים fessi, No. f. f. & pl. m. Rad. עָיֵף fessum esse.
units.tr: עָפָה darkness, noun feminine, root עוּף he flew; but עָפָה weary, עֲפִים weary, noun feminine feminine and plural masculine, root עָיֵף, to be weary.

units.la: בְּעִיר in civitate, לְעִיר ad civitatem, מֵעִיר à civitate, No. עִיר, præf. vel pro בְּהָעִיר in excitando, לְהָעִיר ad excitandum, מֵהָעִיר ab excitando, Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. עוּר evigilare.
units.tr: בְּעִיר in the city, לְעִיר to the city, מֵעִיר from the city, noun עִיר, with prefix; or for בְּהָעִיר in arousing, לְהָעִיר to arouse, מֵהָעִיר from arousing, Hiphil infinitive with prefix, root עוּר, to awake.

units.la: הָעִירָה in civitatem, evigila, No. עִיר, cum ה, præf. & loc. vel Imper. Hiph. f. m. cum ה, parag. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: הָעִירָה to the city, awake, noun עִיר with ה, prefix and locative; or imperative Hiphil feminine masculine with ה, paragogic, root עוּר.

units.la: עֵרוֹם nudus, עֲרֻמִּים nudi, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. עָרוֹם.
units.tr: עֵרוֹם naked, עֲרֻמִּים naked, noun feminine and plural masculine, root עָרוֹם.

units.la: עָרִים ערם [?] astu usus [?] fuit, עֲרִים asfelli, No. pl. m. à f. m. No. Rad. עִיר pullus, עִירָה ejus, pro עִירוֹ עָרְשׁ arcturus, No. f. m. à Rad. עשׁ coivit.
units.tr: עָרִים ערם [?] used cunning[?] was, עֲרִים asses' colts, noun plural masculine from the feminine masculine noun, root עִיר colt, עִירָה its, for עִירוֹ; עָרְשׁ Arcturus, noun feminine masculine from the root עשׁ he coupled.

units.la: ע ל עַל excelsus, No. f. m. Rad. עָלָה ascendit. עָלַי contra, juxta, עָלַי me, עָלֶיךָ te, עָלָיו eum, עֲלֵיהֶם ipsos, עֲלֵיהֶן ipsas, omnes, Præp. עַל aff. Rad. עָלָה scandit. עַל ne, pro Part. Rad. אַל ne. עַל, vel עַל jugum, הָעַל hoc jugum, וּמֵעַל & à jugo ejus, עֲלֵיכֶם jugum vestrum, עֲלֵינוּ nostrum, No. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. עָלַל fecit. עָלָה, constr. עֲלֵה folium, עֲלֵי folia, עֲלֵהּ folia sua, Jes. 1. 31. pro עֲלֵיהּ ; No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. עָלָה עֲלוֹת ascendere, בַּעֲלוֹת in ascendendo, כַּעֲלוֹת juxta ascendere, לַעֲלוֹת ad ascendendum, עֲלוֹתָהּ ascendere eam, מַעֲלוֹת ab ascendendo, בְּעֲלוֹתִי in ascendere me, בְּעֲלוֹתָם eos, Infin. Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. עָלָה . עֲלֵה ascende, עֲלִי ascende, f.g. עֲלוּ ascendite, Imper. Kal, f. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad. עָלָה . עֹלָה holocaustum, עֲלָיו ejus, עֲלָךְ tuum, עֲלוֹת holocausta, עֲלוֹתֵךְ tua, עֲלוֹתוֹ ejus, Ez. 40. 26. (pro תֵּי) &c. No. f. & pl. f. aff. Rad. עָלָה scandit. עֹלָה ascendens , עֹלִים ascendentes, עָלָה ascendens, עֹלוֹת ascendentes, f. g. Part. Ben. Kal, f. & pl. masc. & fæm. Rad. עלה [?]
units.tr: ע ל עַל high, noun feminine masculine, root עָלָה he ascended. עָלַי against, beside, upon, עָלַי me, עָלֶיךָ you, עָלָיו him, עֲלֵיהֶם them, עֲלֵיהֶן them (feminine), all, preposition עַל with suffix, root עָלָה climbs. עַל not, for the participle, root אַל not. עַל, or עַל yoke, הָעַל this yoke, וּמֵעַל and from his yoke, עֲלֵיכֶם your yoke, עֲלֵינוּ our, noun feminine masculine with prefix and suffix, root עָלַל he did. עָלָה, construct עֲלֵה leaf, עֲלֵי leaves, עֲלֵהּ its leaves, Isa. 1. 31. for עֲלֵיהּ; noun feminine and plural masculine with suffix, root עָלָה. עֲלוֹת to ascend, בַּעֲלוֹת in ascending, כַּעֲלוֹת as ascending, לַעֲלוֹת to ascend, עֲלוֹתָהּ to ascend her, מַעֲלוֹת from ascending, בְּעֲלוֹתִי in my ascending, בְּעֲלוֹתָם them, Infinitive Qal with prefix and suffix, root עָלָה. עֲלֵה ascend, עֲלִי ascend, feminine עֲלוּ ascend, Imperative Qal masculine, feminine and plural masculine, root עָלָה. עֹלָה burnt offering, עֲלָיו its, עֲלָךְ your, עֲלוֹת burnt offerings, עֲלוֹתֵךְ your, עֲלוֹתוֹ his, Ezek. 40. 26. (for תֵּי), etc., noun feminine and plural feminine with suffix, root עָלָה climbs. עֹלָה ascending, עֹלִים ascending, עָלָה ascending, עֹלוֹת ascending, feminine and plural masculine and feminine, Qal participle, root עלה [?]

units.la: עָלוּ ascenderunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. עלה [?]
units.tr: ʿalu they went up, perfect Qal, 3rd person plural. Root ʿlh [?].

units.la: עֲלִיָּה iniquitas, Hos. 10. 9. No. sing. fæm. (pro עוֹלָה,) Rad. עול inique egit.
units.tr: ʿaliyyah iniquity, Hos. 10. 9. Noun, feminine singular (for ʿawlah). Root ʿwl: he acted wickedly.

units.la: עֹלָלוֹת lactantes, No. pl. fæm. Rad. עול infan-tulus.
units.tr: ʿolalot sucklings, noun, feminine plural. Root ʿwl: a little child.

units.la: הָעֲלִילוֹת pistilla, 2. Chron. 24. 14. pro הָעֲלוֹת [?], No. pl. f. præf. vel, offerre, Infin. Hiph. Rad. עלה
units.tr: ha-ʿalilot pistils, 2 Chron. 24. 14. For ha-ʿalot [?]; noun, feminine plural with prefix; or to offer, infinitive Hiphil. Root ʿlh.

units.la: עָלְזָה exulta, Zeph. 3. 14. pro עָלְזִי, Imper. Kal, f. f. Rad. עלז
units.tr: ʿalzah exult, Zeph. 3. 14. For ʿalzi; imperative Qal, feminine singular. Root ʿlz.

units.la: עָלֶיהָ pistillum, No. f. m. Rad. עלה ascendit.
units.tr: ʿalehah pistil, noun, masculine and feminine. Root ʿlh: he went up.

units.la: עֲלִיָּה caenaculum, עֲלִיָּתוֹ in cænaculo suo, עֲלִיּוֹתָיו cænacula sua, No. f. & pl. f. præf. aff. Rad. עלה ascendit.
units.tr: ʿaliyyah upper room, ʿaliyyato in his upper room, ʿaliyyotav his upper rooms; noun, feminine and feminine plural, with prefix and suffix. Root ʿlh: he went up.

units.la: עֲלִיתָהּ excelsus, עֲלִינָה excelsa, עֲלִיּוֹת excelsæ, No. f. m. & f. & pl. f. Rad. עלה
units.tr: ʿalitah lofty, ʿalinah lofty (feminine), ʿaliyyot lofty (feminine plural); noun, masculine, feminine and feminine plural. Root ʿlh.

units.la: בְּעָלִיל catinus, בְּעָלִיל in catino, עֲלִילָה actio, עֲלִילוֹת actiones, עֲלִילָה actio, No. f. m. præf. & No. f. & pl. f. &c. ut & No. f. f. Rad. עלל fecit.
units.tr: be-ʿalil a bowl, be-ʿalil in a bowl, ʿalilah deed, ʿalilot deeds, ʿalilah deed; noun, masculine with prefix, and noun, feminine singular and plural, etc. Root ʿll: he did.

units.la: עָלִיזָה exsult abundus, עָלִיזָה exsultabunda, עָלִיזִי exsultabundi, No. f. m. & fæm. & No. pl. m. constr. Rad. עלז exsultavit.
units.tr: ʿaliz exulting, ʿalizah exulting (feminine), ʿalizi exulting (plural); noun, masculine and feminine, and masculine plural in construct. Root ʿlz: he exulted.

units.la: עֲלִים ascendentes, vide supra, in עלה.
units.tr: ʿalim ascending; see above, under ʿlh.

units.la: עָלִית ascendisti, עָלִית ascendisti, f. g. עֲלֵיתֶם ascendistis, עֲלֵינוּ ascendimus, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. & f. & 2. pl. m. ut & 1. pl. Rad. עלה
units.tr: ʿalit you ascended, ʿalit you ascended (feminine), ʿaletem you ascended (plural), ʿalenu we ascended; perfect Qal, 2nd person masculine and feminine, 2nd person plural masculine, and 1st person plural. Root ʿlh.

units.la: עָלְתָה ascendit, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. עלה
units.tr: ʿalethah she ascended; perfect Qal, 3rd person feminine singular. Root ʿlh.

units.la: עַלְתָה nequitia, No. f. f. à
units.tr: ʿalatah wickedness; noun, feminine, from

units.la: Rad. עול[?] perverse egit.
units.tr: Root ʿwl [?]: he acted perversely.

units.la: עולתו[?] holocaustum ejus, &c. vide, עלה[?].
units.tr: ʿolatho [?] his burnt offering, etc. See ʿlh [?].

units.la: עם
units.tr: ʿm

units.la: עם vel עם[?] populus, עמו[?] populo suo, עמי[?] populi, עמך[?] tui, No. f. m. praef. aff. & pl. m. aff. Rad. עמם[?] texit.
units.tr: ʿam or ʿam [?] people, ʿammo [?] his people, ʿammi [?] of the people, ʿammekha [?] your people; noun, masculine and feminine, with prefix and suffix, and masculine plural with suffix. Root ʿmm: he covered.

units.la: עמי[?] cum, עמו[?] à, עמי[?] mecum, עמך[?] tecum, עמו[?] cum eo, עמהם[?] ab eo, עמנו[?] nobiscum, &c. Part. Præp. præf. aff. Rad. עמם texit.
units.tr: ʿimmi with, ʿimmo from, ʿimmi with me, ʿimmekha with you, ʿimmo with him, ʿimmehem from him, ʿimmanu with us, etc. Participle-preposition, with prefixes and suffixes. Root ʿmm: he covered.

units.la: עמית[?] proximus, עמיתי[?] meus, עמיתו[?] ejus, No. f. m. aff. à Part. Præp. R. עמית secundum.
units.tr: ʿamit neighbour, ʿamiti my, ʿamito his; noun, masculine, with suffix, from the participle-preposition. Root ʿmyt: according to.

units.la: עמים[?] populis, עמם[?] populi, בעמיך[?] in populis tuis, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. עמם texit.
units.tr: ʿammim peoples, ʿammam of the peoples, be-ʿammekha in your peoples; noun, masculine plural, with suffix. Root ʿmm: he covered.

units.la: עמנו[?] nobiscum Deus, comp. ex Part. Præp.
units.tr: ʿimmanu El God with us, compounded of the preposition

units.la: cum, aff. עמם[?] nos, & Nomine Dei, אל[?] Deus, in Rad. אמץ[?] fortitudo.
units.tr: with, the suffix us, and the name of God, El, God; from root ʾmṣ, strength.

units.la: עמים[?] emerentes, Neh. 4. 17. (pro עמסים[?]) Part. Ben. Kal. pl. m. Rad. עמם.
units.tr: ʿammim carrying, Neh. 4. 17. (for ʿammasim [?]); participle Qal, masculine plural. Root ʿmm.

units.la: עמד[?] e regione, ex adverso ejus, לעמהם[?] illorum, & forma pl. f. ex adversa, Rad. Part. Præp. עמה[?] secundum, juxta, præf. & aff.
units.tr: ʿamad opposite, over against, le-ʿummahem of them, and the feminine plural form, opposite; from the participle-preposition ʿmh [?], beside, near, with prefix and suffix. Root ʿmd.

units.la: ענרם[?] annecte ea, Imper. Kal, sing. m. aff. Rad. ענה[?]
units.tr: ʿannem join them; imperative Qal, masculine singular, with suffix. Root ʿnh [?].

units.la: עמד[?] affige, canta, עמרה[?] cantare, affligere, לעמוך[?] ad affligendum te, עמר[?] affligere eum, Imper. Infin. Piel præf. aff. Rad. ענה.
units.tr: ʿanno afflict, ʿanno sing, ʿanoth to sing, to afflict, le-ʿannokha to afflict you, ʿannot to afflict him; imperative and infinitive Piel, with prefixes and suffixes. Root ʿnh.

units.la: ענרה[?] exaudivit eum, prot Kal, 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. עָנָה עָנוּ [?] exaudiverunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. עָנָה עָנָו [?] mansuetus, עֲנָוִים [?] mansueti, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. עָנָה exaudivit. עֲנֵה [?] comprimite, Imper. Piel, pl. m. à f. m. עָנָה, Rad. עָנָה respondit. עֲנֵי [?], & עֲנִיּוּ [?] exaudite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. à f. m. עָנָה ; Rad. עָנָה עָנוּ [?] compresserunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. à 3. f. m. עָנָה ; Rad. עָנָה עֲנָוָה mansuetudo, No. sing. fæm. Rad. עָנָה. עֲנָוָתְךָ [?] mansuetudo tua, No. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. עָנָה exaudivit. לַעֲנוֹת [?] exaudire, ad exaudiendum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. עָנָה. לְעַנּוֹת [?] demittere, Exod. io. 3. (pro לְהַעֲנוֹת [?],) Infin. Niph. Rad. עָנָה עֲנוּיֵי [?] affligi ejus, Infin. Pual, aff. Rad. עָנָה. עָנִי pauper, לְעָנִי [?] ad pauperem tuum, עֲנִיֶּיךָ [?] pauperes, עֲנִיָּיו [?] pauperes ejus, No. f. m. præf. & aff. ut & pl. m. aff. Rad. עָנָה exaudivit. עָנִי, עָנִי afflictio, עָנֵיהֶם [?] eorum, עָנִי mea, No. f. m. aff Rad. עָנָה exaudivit. עָנִי, constr. עָנִי negotium, עֲנִיוֹ ejus, No. f. m. aff. Rad. עָנָה. עָנִיתָ exaudivisti, עָנִיתִי exaudivi, præt. Kal, 2. & 1. f. Rad. עָנָה עִנִּיתָ afflixisti, עִנִּיתִי afflixi, עִנִּיתֶם afflixistis, עִנִּינוּ afflíximus, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. & 1. f. ut & 2. pl. m. & 1. pl. Rad. עָנָה עֻנֵּיתִי [?] afflictus sum, præt. Pual, 1. f. R. עָנָה עָנְתָה exaudivit te, præt. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. aff.
units.tr: ʿanah he heard him, perfect Qal, 3rd person masculine singular with suffix. Root ʿnh: he answered. ʿanu they heard, perfect Qal, 3rd person plural. ʿanav meek, ʿanavim meek; noun, masculine and feminine, and masculine plural. Root ʿnh: he heard. ʿanneh restrain; imperative Piel, masculine plural, from the masculine and feminine. Root ʿnh: he answered. ʿanei and ʿanniu hear; imperative Qal, masculine plural, from the masculine. Root ʿnh: they pressed; perfect Piel, 3rd plural, from the 3rd masculine and feminine. ʿanavah meekness; noun, feminine singular. Root ʿnh. ʿanavatekha your meekness; noun, feminine singular with suffix. Root ʿnh: he heard. la-ʿanot to hear, to answer; infinitive Qal, with prefix. Root ʿnh. le-ʿannot to let down, Exod. 10. 3. (for le-hanot); infinitive Niphal. Root ʿnh. ʿanuyei his afflictions; infinitive Pual, with suffix. Root ʿnh. ʿani poor, le-ʿani to your poor, ʿaniyyekha your poor, ʿaniyyav his poor; noun, masculine, with prefix and suffix, and masculine plural with suffix. Root ʿnh: he heard. ʿani, ʿoni affliction, ʿeihem their, ʿani my; noun, masculine, with suffix. Root ʿnh: he heard. ʿani, construct ʿoni business, ʿanio his; noun, masculine, with suffix. Root ʿnh. ʿanita you heard, ʿanitti I heard; perfect Qal, 2nd and 1st person, feminine. ʿinnita you afflicted, ʿinnitti I afflicted, ʿinnitem you afflicted, ʿinnunu we afflicted; perfect Piel, 2nd and 1st person, masculine, and 2nd and 1st plural masculine. Root ʿnh. ʿunnitti I was afflicted; perfect Pual, 1st person. Root ʿnh. ʿanetah she heard you; perfect Qal, 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix.

units.la: Rad. עָנָה.
units.tr: Root ʿnh.

units.la: עָנִי exaudivit eos, עָנִי me, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. עָנָה.
units.tr: ʿanam he heard them, ʿanani he heard me; perfect Qal, 3rd person masculine, with suffix. Root ʿnh.

units.la: עַנַּן præstigiis usus est, præt. Piel, 3. sing. m. unde, עַנִּים præstigiatores, עַנֵּיכֶם vestri, עַנָּנָה præstigiatrix, No. pl. m. aff. No. f. f. omnia, à No. Rad. עַיִן oculus.
units.tr: ʿannan he used enchantments; perfect Piel, 3rd person singular masculine. Hence ʿannim enchanters, ʿenneikhem your, ʿannanah enchantress; noun, masculine plural, with suffix, and noun, feminine, all from the noun root ʿyn, eye.

units.la: בְּעַנָּנִי cum obnubilavero, Gen. 9. 14. pro בְּעַנְנִי Infin. Piel, præf. aff. à præt. Piel, עָנַן obnubilavit, in No. Rad. עָנָן nubes.
units.tr: be-ʿannani when I cover, Gen. 9. 14. (for be-ʿanenni); infinitive Piel, with prefix and suffix, from the perfect Piel ʿanan, he covered with clouds, in the noun root ʿanan, cloud.

units.la: עַנֵּנִי exaudi me, עֲנֵנוּ nos, Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. עָנָה.
units.tr: ʿanneni answer me, ʿanenu us; imperative Qal, masculine, with suffix. Root ʿnh.

units.la: עַנַּתָּה exaudivit illa, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. עָנָה.
units.tr: ʿanatah she heard; perfect Qal, 3rd person feminine. Root ʿnh.

units.la: עַנּוֹתְךָ affligere eum, עַנּוֹתֶךָ te, Infin. Piel, aff. Rad. עָנָה.
units.tr: ʿannotekha to afflict him, ʿannoteka you; infinitive Piel, with suffix. Root ʿnh.

units.la: עַשְׂתָּם & conculcabitis, præt. Kal, 2. pl. masc. Rad. עָסַם.
units.tr: ʿastam and you will trample; perfect Qal, 2nd person masculine plural. Root ʿsm.

units.la: וְכִעֲסִים & velut mustum, No. f. m. præf. R. עָסַם conculcavit.
units.tr: ve-khaʿasisim and like must; noun, masculine, with prefix. Root ʿsm: he trampled.

units.la: עָפָה volans, עָפוֹת volantes, Ben. Kal, f. & pl. f. à f.m. עוֹף & Rad. עוּף.
units.tr: ʿafah flying, ʿafot flying; participle Qal, feminine and feminine plural, from the masculine ʿof. Root ʿwp.

units.la: עָפוּ volarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. à 3. f.m. עָף; Rad. עוּף.
units.tr: ʿafu they flew; perfect Qal, 3rd person plural, from the 3rd person masculine ʿaf. Root ʿwp.

units.la: עָפְעָפִים palpebræ, עַפְעָפָיו ejus, No. du. m. aff. constr. R. עוּף volavit.
units.tr: ʿaf'appim eyelids, ʿaf'appav his eyelids; noun, dual masculine, with suffix, in construct. Root ʿwp: he flew.

units.la: בְּ־עָפְפִי in volare facere me, Infin. Piel, præf. aff. Rad. עוּף volavit.
units.tr: be-ʿaffi in making me fly; infinitive Piel, with prefix and suffix. Root ʿwp: he flew.

units.la: עָפְתָה obscuritas maxima, Job. 10: 22. pro עֲפָתָה, namest No. f. f. à No. עָפְתָה obscuritas, in Rad. עוּף volavit.
units.tr: ʿafatah utter darkness, Job 10. 22. For ʿafatah; it is a noun, feminine, from the noun ʿafatah, darkness, in root ʿwp: he flew.

units.la: עֵץ lignum, עֲצֵי lig-
units.tr: ʿeṣ wood, ʿaṣei of wood

units.la: gne, עֵצוֹ ejus, No. f. fœm. & pl. m. aff. & f m.
units.tr: ʿeṣo his wood; noun, feminine, plural masculine with suffix, and masculine.

units.la: No. Rad. עֵץ lignum
units.tr: Noun. Root ʿṣ: wood.

units.la: עֵצָה consilium, בְּעֵצָה
units.tr: ʿeṣah counsel, be-ʿeṣah in counsel

units.la: in consilio, לְעֵצוֹ
units.tr: le-ʿeṣo to his counsel

units.la: consilio ejus, עֵצוֹת consilia,
units.tr: ʿeṣot counsels,

units.la: פָּה os, No. f. m. Rad. vel quasi pro פִּיהּ, Rad. i-nusit. פָּה.
units.tr: peh mouth, noun feminine masculine. Root, or as if for פִּיהּ, root he has breathed. פָּה.

units.la: פֹּה hic, מִפֹּה inde, אֵיפֹה ubinam? Part. Adv. Rad. præf.
units.tr: poh here, mippoh hence, eyfoh whence? Particle, adverb. Root, prefix.

units.la: פ ו
units.tr: Pe Vav (פ ו)

units.la: פּוֹ, מִפּוֹ hinc, אֵפּוֹ, & אֵפוֹא nunc, est pro Part. Rad. Adv. פֹּה hic.
units.tr: po, mippo hence, eypo, and eyfo now, are for the particle, root, adverb פֹּה here.

units.la: פּוּגָה intermissio, f. fæm.
units.tr: pugah intermission, feminine.

units.la: מִפֹּה hinc, illinc, &c. idem quod, פֹּה hic.
units.tr: mippoh hence, thence, etc., the same as פֹּה here.

units.la: פְּרִים instabiles, No. pl. m. Rad. inusit. פָּחַז[?].
units.tr: periym unstable ones, noun plural masculine. Root, not in use. פָּחַז[?].

units.la: בְּפוּךְ in fucum, Rad. No. f. m. præf.
units.tr: bepuch into a fool's cap, root, noun feminine masculine, prefix.

units.la: פֹּרִיר liberans, Ben. Kal, f. m. R. פָּצָה aperuit.
units.tr: popir liberating, participle Kal, feminine masculine. Root פָּצָה he opened.

units.la: פְּזִרִי dispersimei, dispersiones mee, Zeph. 3. 10. Part. Pahul, Kal, vel, No. Part. pl. m. aff. à f. m. פָּזַר, & Rad. פּוּז dispergi.
units.tr: pizri my dispersions, my dispersings, Zeph. 3. 10. Participle Pahul, Kal, or noun participle plural masculine, with suffix from the feminine masculine פָּזַר, and root פּוּז to be scattered.

units.la: לְפוּקָה titubationi, No. f. f. Rad. פּוֹק titubavit.
units.tr: lefukah to stumbling, noun feminine feminine. Root פּוֹק he stumbled.

units.la: פּוֹר disfrumpendo, Infin. Kal, Rad. פּוֹר.
units.tr: pur by breaking in pieces, infinitive Kal, root פּוֹר.

units.la: פּוֹר sors, פּוּרִים sortes, No. f. & pl. masc. Rad. פּוֹר disframpi[?].
units.tr: pur lot, purim lots, noun feminine and plural masculine. Root פּוֹר to break in pieces.

units.la: פָּרַרְתָּ disfrupisti, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. R. פּוּר; in Piel, gem. פֹּרֵר.
units.tr: parart you broke in pieces, preterite Piel, second person feminine masculine. Root פּוּר; in Piel, doubled, פֹּרֵר.

units.la: פּוֹרָה fructificans, Gen. 49. 22. pro פּוֹרָה, Part. Ben.
units.tr: porah fruitful, Gen. 49. 22., for פּוֹרָה, participle Pual.

units.la: פּוּ aurum solidum, No. f. m. Rad. פּוּ consolidari.
units.tr: pu solid gold, noun feminine masculine. Root פּוּ to be consolidated.

units.tr: [illegible]

units.la: מוֹקֵשׁ[?], vel מָה laqueus, מוֹקְשֵׁי laquei, No. pl. m. Rad. פּוּחַ afflavit.
units.tr: mokesh[?], or mah snare, mokshey snares, noun plural masculine. Root פּוּחַ he breathed upon.

units.la: מְחוּת ; מְחוּתֵי duces, מְחוּתָיו ejus, No. pl. f. aff. à f. m. No. Rad. מָחָה dux.
units.tr: mehut; mehutey leaders, mehutav his, noun plural feminine, with suffix from the feminine masculine noun. Root מָחָה leader.

units.la: רְפוּחַ & perflata, Imper. Kal, f. f. R. נָפַח.
units.tr: rehuach and breathed upon, imperative Kal, feminine feminine. Root נָפַח.

units.la: כְּפֶחִים in pruna, No. Rad. f. m. præf.
units.tr: kepechim in coals, noun, root feminine masculine, prefix.

units.la: פְּחִים dux eorum, Neh. 5. 14. contr. pro פְּחוֹתָם, No. f. m. פְּחָהָה, aff. à No. Rad. פָּחָה dux.
units.tr: pechim their leader, Neh. 5. 14., contracted for פְּחוֹתָם, noun feminine masculine, פְּחָהָה, with suffix, from the noun root פָּחָה leader.

units.la: פְּחוֹתְךָ dux tuo, f. m. cons. vel absol. aff. à No. Rad. f. m. פָּחָה dux.
units.tr: pechotecha your leader, feminine masculine, construct or absolute, with suffix, from the noun root feminine masculine פָּחָה leader.

units.la: לִנְפֹּחַ ad flare, Infin. Kal, præf. R. נָפַח.
units.tr: lin'poach to blow, infinitive Kal, prefix. Root נָפַח.

units.la: פֻּחָה fossa, פְּחָתִים corrosio, No. pl. m. & No. f. f. à No. Rad. f. m. פָּחָה favea.
units.tr: puchah pit, pechatim corrosion, noun plural masculine and noun feminine feminine, from the noun root feminine masculine פָּחָה pit.

units.la: [illegible, ~1 letter]
units.tr: [illegible]

units.la: פּ os meum, pro פִּי, aff. item, פִּיךָ tuum, פִּיהוּ ejus, פִּיהֶן illarum, פִּיהֶם eorum, פִּינוּ nostrum, No. f. m. confstr. & cum aff. à No. Rad. f. m. פֶּה os.
units.tr: pi my mouth, for פִּי, with suffix; likewise, piyk your, pihu his, pihen their (f.), pihem their (m.), pinu our, noun feminine masculine, construct and with suffix, from the noun root feminine masculine פֶּה mouth.

units.la: בְּפִי sicut as meum, לְפִי ori meo, vel secundum, vide, in No. Rad. פֶּה os.
units.tr: bepi as my mouth, lefi to my mouth, or according to, see under the noun, root פֶּה mouth.

units.la: בְּ־פִּיו in oppressione ejus, præf. & aff. No. Rad. פִּיד[?]
units.tr: beph-piv in his oppression, prefix and suffix, noun, root פִּיד[?].

units.la: פֶּה, פִּיּוֹת, & פִּים ora, No. pl. f. & m. à f. m. No. Rad. פֶּה.
units.tr: peh, piyot, and pim mouths, noun plural feminine and masculine, from the feminine masculine noun, root פֶּה.

units.la: פִּיחַ favilla, No. f. m. Rad. פּוּחַ afflavit.
units.tr: piach ash, noun feminine masculine. Root פּוּחַ he breathed upon.

units.la: פִּיכָה plicatura, No. f. f. à Rad. ipsa פִּים[?].
units.tr: piychah folding, noun feminine feminine, from the root itself פִּים[?].

units.la: פִּיפִיּוֹת acies, No. pl. fæm.
units.tr: pifiyot edges, noun plural feminine.

units.la: gem. à f. m. No. Rad. פָּה, constr. פִּי os.
units.tr: doubled, from the feminine masculine noun, root פָּה, construct פִּי mouth.

units.la: פּוֹק, vel פּוּק titubatio, No. f. m. R. פּוֹק titubavit.
units.tr: puk, or puk stumbling, noun feminine masculine. Root פּוֹק he stumbled.

units.tr: Pe Kaf (פ כ)

units.la: פַּכָּה lenticula, No. f. m. Rad. פָּכָה מָנַע.
units.tr: pachah lentil, noun feminine masculine. Root פָּכָה he restrained.

units.la: פ ל
units.tr: Pe Lamed (פ ל)

units.la: לְפַלֹּא segregando, Lev. 22. 21. pro לְפַלָּה, Infin. Piel, Rad. פָּלָה.
units.tr: lefalot by separating, Lev. 22. 21., for לְפַלָּה, infinitive Piel, root פָּלָה.

units.la: פְּלָא mirificus, Jud. 13. 18. pro פְּלֹא; & פְּלֵאָה mirifica, Ps. 139. 14. pro פְּלִיאָה, No. f. m. & f. R. פָּלָא mirum esse.
units.tr: pela wonderful, Judg. 13. 18., for פְּלֹא; and pelaah wonderful, Ps. 139. 14., for פְּלִיאָה, noun masculine and feminine, root פָּלָא to be wonderful.

units.la: פַּלֵּג divide, Ps. 55. 10. pro פַּלַּג, Imper. Piel, f. m. Rad. פָּלַג.
units.tr: palag divide, Ps. 55. 10., for פַּלַּג, imperative Piel, masculine singular. Root פָּלַג.

units.la: פְּלוֹנִי ploni, N. N. No. f. m. Rad. פָּלָה segregari.
units.tr: peloni so-and-so, N. N., noun masculine singular. Root פָּלָה to be separated.

units.la: פְּלֵיטָה liberatio, f. f. constr. No. פְּלֵיטָה; Rad. פָּלַט evasit.
units.tr: peletah deliverance, feminine feminine, construct noun פְּלֵיטָה; root פָּלַט he escaped.

units.la: פְּלִילִי judex; פְּלִילָה judicium, פְּלִילִיָּה judicatio, No. f. m. & f. Rad. פָּלַל judicavit.
units.tr: pelili judge; pelilah judgment, pelilyah judging, noun masculine and feminine. Root פָּלַל he judged.

units.la: לִפְנֵי ad tractum suum, praef. & aff. No. R. פָּנֶה scipio.
units.tr: lifnei to its drawing, prefix and suffix, noun, root פָּנֶה scipio.

units.la: פַּלְמוֹנִי vel פַּלְמֹנִי palmoni, N. N. compos. ex פַּלְנִי & אַלְמֹנִי, vide in Rad. פָּלָה.
units.tr: palmoni, or palmoni so-and-so, N. N., compound from פַּלְנִי and אַלְמֹנִי, see under the root פָּלָה.

units.la: פ נ
units.tr: P N

units.la: פֶּן ne forte, Part. Adv. Rad. פֵּן dubium esse.
units.tr: Pen, lest perhaps; particle of doubt, from the root Pen (to be doubtful).

units.la: פָּנָה aspicere, Infin. Kal, Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Panah, to look at; infinitive Kal, from the root Panah.

units.la: פָּנָה angulus ejus, Prov. 7. 8. pro פִּנָּהָ, sing. fem. constr. No. פִּנָּה; Rad. פָּנַן.
units.tr: Pinnah, its corner (Prov. 7:8), for the feminine singular construct form Pinnah, noun, from Pinnah; root Panan.

units.la: פִּנָּה angulus, No. sing. fem. Rad. פָּנַן.
units.tr: Pinnah, corner; noun, feminine singular; root Panan.

units.la: פּוֹנֶה aspiciens, Ben. Kal, s. m. Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Poneh, looking; participle Kal, masculine singular; root Panah.

units.la: פָּנוּ declinant, praet. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Panu, they turn aside; perfect Kal, third person plural; root Panah.

units.la: פַּנּוּ praeparate, Imper. Piel, pl. m. & f. s. m. פִּנָּה; Rad. פָּנָה aspexit.
units.tr: Panu, prepare! Imperative Piel, plural masculine and singular masculine of Pinnah; root Panah, he looked.

units.la: פְּנִי respicite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. à f. m. פָּנֶה, Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Pneu, look! Imperative Kal, plural masculine, from the feminine singular Panah; root Panah.

units.la: פָּנוּ expediverunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. à 3. f. m. פָּנָה ; Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Panu, they cleared away; perfect Piel, third person plural, from the third person feminine singular; root Panah.

units.la: פָּנוֹת aspicere, לִפְנוֹת ad aspiciendum, בִּפְנוֹתָם in aspiciendo eos, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Panot, to look; lifnot, for looking; bifnotam, in looking at them; infinitive Kal with prefixes and suffixes; root Panah.

units.la: פְּנוֹת anguli, pl. fæm. à No. s. f. פִּנָּה ; Rad. פַּנָּן.
units.tr: Penot, corners; plural feminine of the noun Pinnah, singular feminine; root Panan.

units.la: פְּנוֹת aspicientes, pl. f. Ben. Kal, Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Penot, looking; plural feminine participle Kal; root Panah.

units.la: לְפָנֵי anterius, No. s. m. (formæ, כִּילִי,) vel, pro לִפְנֵי coram, aut לִפְנִים &c. Rad. פָּנָה aspexit.
units.tr: Lifne, the front part; noun, singular masculine (of the form kili), or for lifne, before; or lifnim, etc.; root Panah, he looked.

units.la: פְּנֵי facies, לְפְנֵי ad conspectum, מִלִּפְנֵי à facie, פָּנַי facies mea, &c. לְפָנַי, לִפְנֵיו, מִפָּנַי, לְפָנֶיךָ, מִלְּפָנֶיךָ, &c. פָּנֶיךָ, פְּנֵיהֶם ,
units.tr: Pne, face; lifne, to the sight; mippne, from the face; panai, my face, etc.; lifnai, lifnaw, mippnai, lifnekha, miflifnekha, etc.; panekha, pnehem,

units.la: פְּנֵיכֶם, פְּנֵימוּ, פְּנֵינוּ, &c. omnia sunt pl. m. cum præf. & aff. No. pl. m. פָּנִים facies, Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: pneikhem, pnemu, pnenu, etc. All are plural masculine with prefixes and suffixes; noun plural masculine Panim, face; root Panah.

units.la: פָּנִים facies, לְפָנִים ? antea, מִפָּנִים ab ante, מִלִּפְנֵי à facie, &c. No. pl. m. Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Panim, face; lifnim, formerly; mippanim, from before; milifne, from the face, etc.; noun plural masculine; root Panah.

units.la: פְּנִים interius, מִלִּפְנִים intrinsecus, פְּנִימָה intus, מִפְּנִימָה, לִפְנִימָה intrinsecus, No. m. præf. & (cum ה, locali) Adv. præf. Rad. פָּנָה aspexit.
units.tr: Pnim, within; mililifnim, inwardly; pnimah, inward; mippnimah, lifnimah, inwardly; noun masculine with prefix; and (with the locative He) adverb with prefix; root Panah, he looked.

units.la: חַ־פְּנִים anguli, pl, à No. f. f. פִּנָּה ; Rad. פַּנָּן.
units.tr: Chapnim, corners; plural, from the noun feminine Pinnah; root Panan.

units.la: פָּנִינוּ aspeximus, præt. Kal, 1. pl. R. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Panu, we have looked; perfect Kal, first person plural; root Panah.

units.la: פְּנִינִים carbunculi, מִפְּנִינִים præ carbunculis, No. pl. m. Rad. inusit. פַּנָּן.
units.tr: Pninim, carbuncles; mippninim, before carbuncles; noun plural masculine; root unused, Panan.

units.la: פָּנִיתִי aspexisti, פָּנִיתִי aspexi, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. & 1. f. Rad. פָּנָה.
units.tr: Paniti, you (feminine singular) have looked; paniti, I have looked; perfect Kal, second person feminine singular and first person singular; root Panah.

units.la: פָּנִיתָ expedivisti, פְּנִיתָ ex- pedipedivi, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. & 1. f. Rad. פָּנָה
units.tr: Panita, you have cleared away; penita, I have cleared away; perfect Piel, second person feminine singular and first person singular; root Panah.

units.la: פָּנָה angulus, פִּנָּתָה ejus, sing. fæm. constr. aff. No. פִּנָּה ; Rad. פָּנַן.
units.tr: Panah, corner; pinnatah, its; singular feminine construct with suffix; noun Pinnah; root Panan.

units.la: פ ס
units.tr: P S

units.la: פָּסּוּ defecerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. פָּסַס.
units.tr: Pasu, they failed; perfect Kal, third person plural; root Pasas.

units.la: פָּסּוֹת transfeundo, Infin. Kal, Rad. פָּסַס.
units.tr: Pasot, by passing over; infinitive Kal; root Pasas.

units.la: פָּסִים particulæ, No. pl. m. à f. m. פַּס; Rad. פָּסַס defecit.
units.tr: Pasim, particles; noun plural masculine, from the singular masculine Pas; root Pasas, he failed.

units.la: פָּסָּה particula, sing. fæm. constr. No. פִּסָּה ; Rad. פָּסַס defecit.
units.tr: Pasah, particle; singular feminine construct; noun Pissah; root Pasas, he failed.

units.la: פ צ
units.tr: P TZ

units.la: הַפֹּצָה liberans, Ben. Kal, f. m. R. פָּצָה.
units.tr: Hapotzah, delivering; participle Kal, feminine singular; root Patzah.

units.la: פָּצוּ aperuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. פָּצָה.
units.tr: Patzu, they opened; perfect Kal, third person plural; root Patzah.

units.la: פְּצוּ dispergite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. פּוּץ.
units.tr: Petzu, scatter! Imperative Kal, plural masculine; root Putz.

units.la: פָּצִיתָ pandisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. פָּצָה.
units.tr: Patzita, you have opened wide; perfect Kal, second person feminine singular; root Patzah.

units.la: פָּצְנִי libera me, Imper. Kal, f. m. (פָּצָה) aff. Rad. פָּצָה.
units.tr: Patzeni, deliver me! Imperative Kal, feminine singular, with suffix; root Patzah.

units.la: פ ק
units.tr: P K

units.la: פָּקוּ titubarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. פּוּק.
units.tr: Paku, they stumbled; perfect Kal, third person plural; root Puk.

units.la: פָּקִיד præfectus, No. f. m. Rad. פָּקַד visitavit.
units.tr: Pakid, overseer; noun, masculine; root Pakad, he visited.

units.la: פ ר
units.tr: P R

units.la: פָּרָה onager, Jer. 2.24. prof. m. No. Rad. פָּרָא.
units.tr: Parah, wild ass (Jer. 2:24); noun, masculine, from the root Para.

units.la: פָּרָה fructificans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. פָּרָה.
units.tr: Parah, bearing fruit; participle Kal, feminine singular; root Parah.

units.la: פָּרוּ fœcificarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. פָּרָה.
units.tr: Paru, they were fruitful; perfect Kal, third person plural; root Parah.

units.la: פְּרוּ foetificate, Imper. Kal, pl. m. à f. m. פָּרוּ. Rad. פָּרָה.
units.tr: Peru, be fruitful! Imperative Kal, plural masculine, from the feminine singular Paru; root Parah.

units.la: פָּרוֹת faccæ, No. pl. f. No. s. f. פָּרָה, à f m. No. Radicali פַּר juvencus.
units.tr: Parot, cows; noun plural feminine, from the singular feminine Parah, from the masculine; root Par, young bull.

units.la: פָּרִיָּה fructifera, Pf.128.3.
units.tr: Pariyah, fruitful (Ps. 128:3).

units.la: & פָּרָת Gen.49.22. pro פָּרָה, Ben. Kal, f. f. Rad. פָּרָה.
units.tr: And Parat (Gen. 49:22), for Parah; participle Kal, feminine; root Parah.

units.la: פְּרִי fructus meus, פְּרִיָּה ejus, פְּרִיךָ tuus, פְּרִיוֹ ejus, פְּרִיךָ tuus, פְּרִיהֶם illorum, פְּרִיהֶן illarum, פְּרִיכֶם vester, No. s. f. m. aff. Rad. פָּרָה.
units.tr: Pri, my fruit; Priyah, its; Prikha, your; Priyo, his; Prikha, your; Prihem, their; Prihen, their (feminine); Prikhem, your; noun singular masculine with suffixes; root Parah.

units.la: פָּרִים juvenci, פְּרִיָּה illius, pl. m. aff. No. Rad. f. m. פַּר, vel פָּר juvencus.
units.tr: Parim, young bulls; Priyah, of it; plural masculine with suffix; noun, masculine Par, or Par, young bull.

units.la: פְּרִיָּמוֹ fructus eorum, פְּרִין earum, No. sing. m. פְּרִי, aff. Rad. פָּרָה.
units.tr: Priymo, their fruit; Prin, their (feminine); noun singular masculine Pri, with suffix; root Parah.

units.la: פְּרִינוּ fructuosi sumus, pret. Kal, 1. pl. R. פָּרָה.
units.tr: Prinu, we are fruitful; perfect Kal, first person plural; root Parah.

units.la: פ ש
units.tr: P SH

units.la: בְּשָׁ in abundantia, No. f. m. præf. Rad. פּוּשׁ a-bundare.
units.tr: Beshah, in abundance; noun, feminine masculine, with prefix; root Pus, to abound.

units.la: פָּשָׁה diffundendo, Infin. Kal, Rad. פָּשָׁה.
units.tr: Pashah, spreading; infinitive Kal; root Pashah.

units.la: פָּשׁוּ abundarunt, pret. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. פּוּשׁ.
units.tr: Pashu, they abounded; perfect Kal, third person plural; root Pus.

units.la: פָּשְׁתָה diffudit, pret. Kal, 3. f. f. R. פָּשָׁה.
units.tr: Pashtah, she poured out; perfect Kal, third person feminine singular; root Pashah.

units.la: פִּשְׁתִּי linum meum, Hos. 2.9. pro פִּשְׁתִּי, No. sing. fæm. פִּשְׁתָּהּ; vel est No. f. m. פִּשְׁתָּה, aff. à Rad. inusit. פָּשַׁת.
units.tr: Pishti, my flax (Hos. 2:9), for Pishti; noun singular feminine Pishtah, with suffix; or it is a noun masculine Pishtah, with suffix, from the unused root Pashat.

units.la: פִּשְׁתִּים lina, No. pl. m. à f. m. פִּשְׁתָּה, Rad. inusit. פָּשַׁת.
units.tr: Pishtim, flaxes; noun plural masculine, from the feminine Pishtah; root unused Pashat.

units.la: פִּשְׁתָּם crevistis, Mal. 4. 2. pro פִּשְׁתָּם, pret. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. פּוּשׁ.
units.tr: Pishtam, you have grown fat (Mal. 4:2), for Pishtam; perfect Kal, second person plural masculine; root Pus.

units.la: פ ת
units.tr: Pe, Tav

units.la: פַּת buccella, מִפִּתּוֹ de buccella ejus, פִּתְּךָ buccella tua, כְּפַּתִּים tanquam frusta, No. f. m. aff. & pl. m. præf. R. פַּתַּת fregit.
units.tr: pat [פַּת], a morsel of bread; mippito [מִפִּתּוֹ], from his morsel; pitkha [פִּתְּךָ], your morsel; kephattim [כְּפַּתִּים], like pieces; noun, feminine, with suffix, and masculine plural with prefix; root pattat [פַּתַּת], he broke.

units.la: פָּתָאִים fatui, Prov. 9.6. pro פְּתָיִים, No. pl. m. à f. m. פָּתִי ; Rad. פָּתָה seductus est.
units.tr: petaim [פָּתָאִים] fools, Prov. 9.6., for petayim [פְּתָיִים]; noun, masculine plural, from the masculine singular peti [פָּתִי]; root patah [פָּתָה] he was enticed.

units.la: פִּתְאֹם, vel פְּתָאוֹם subitò, Part. Ad. à Rad. inusit. פָּתָא, vel à R. פָּתָה.
units.tr: pit'om [פִּתְאֹם], or petaom [פְּתָאוֹם] suddenly, an adverb, from the unused root pata [פָּתָא], or from the root patah [פָּתָה].

units.la: פְּתָהּ fatua, No. f. f. à f. m. פְּתָהּ fatuus, R. פָּתָה seductus est.
units.tr: petah [פְּתָהּ] a foolish woman, noun, feminine, from the masculine fool petah [פְּתָהּ]; root patah [פָּתָה] he was enticed.

units.la: פָּתוֹת frangendo, Infin. Kal, Rad. פָּתַת.
units.tr: patot [פָּתוֹת] by breaking, infinitive Qal; root patat [פָּתַת].

units.la: וּבְפְּתוֹתִי & infrustulis, pl. m. constr. praef. No. pl. m. פְּתוֹתִים, Rad. פָּתַת fregit.
units.tr: uvephetotai [וּבְפְּתוֹתִי] and in little pieces, masculine plural construct with prefix; noun, masculine plural, petotim [פְּתוֹתִים]; root patat [פָּתַת] he broke.

units.la: פְּתִי allice, Imper. Piel, f. f. Rad. פָּתָה.
units.tr: peti [פְּתִי] entice, imperative Piel, feminine singular; root patah [פָּתָה].

units.la: פְּתִי, vel פְּתִי fatuus, fatuitas, No. f. m. R. פָּתָה seductus est.
units.tr: peti [פְּתִי], or peti [פְּתִי] foolish, folly, noun, masculine; root patah [פָּתָה] he was enticed.

units.la: פְּתִיּוּת simplicitas, No. sing. faem. Rad. פָּתָה.
units.tr: petiyut [פְּתִיּוּת] simplicity, noun, singular feminine; root patah [פָּתָה].

units.la: פָּתִיל, פְּתִיל filum, פְּתִילִם, pro פְּתִילִים fila, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. פָּתַל.
units.tr: pathil [פָּתִיל], petil [פְּתִיל] thread; pethilim [פְּתִילִם], for pethilim [פְּתִילִים] threads; noun, feminine and plural masculine; root patal [פָּתַל].

units.la: פְּתִים simplices, Prov. 1. 22. pro פְּתַיִּים, No. pl. m. à f. m. פְּתִי simplicitas, Rad. פָּתָה seductus est.
units.tr: pethim [פְּתִים] the simple, Prov. 1.22., for pethayyim [פְּתַיִּים]; noun, masculine plural, from the masculine singular peti [פְּתִי] simplicity; root patah [פָּתָה] he was enticed.

units.la: וְהֲפְּתִיתְ & nunquid pelleturus esses? praet. Piel, 2. sing. m. praef. Rad. פָּתָה ; vel est pro וְהַפְּתוֹתְ & confringas, praet. Hiph, 2. f. m. Rad. פָּתַת.
units.tr: vehaphtita [וְהֲפְּתִיתְ] and were you about to be persuaded?, perfect Piel, second person masculine singular with prefix; root patah [פָּתָה]; or it is for vehaphtot [וְהַפְּתוֹתְ] and you shall break in pieces, perfect Hiphil, second person masculine; root patat [פַּתַּת].

units.la: פִּתִּיתִי allexi, פִּתִּיתֵנִי allexisti me, praet. Piel, 1. sing. & 2. f. aff. Rad. פָּתָה.
units.tr: pitti'ti [פִּתִּיתִי] I enticed, pitti'theni [פִּתִּיתֵנִי] you enticed me, perfect Piel, first person singular and second person feminine with suffix; root patah [פָּתָה].

units.la: פַּתְלֻתַּל contortissimum, No. f. m. Rad. פָּתַל lutari.
units.tr: pathluthal [פַּתְלֻתַּל] most twisted, noun, masculine; root patal [פָּתַל] to wrestle.

units.la: פִּתְרוֹנוֹ interpretatio ejus, פִּתְרוֹנִים interpretationes, No. sing. m. פִּתְרוֹן, aff. & pl. m. R. פָּתַר interpretatus est.
units.tr: pitronō [פִּתְרוֹנוֹ] his interpretation, pitronim [פִּתְרוֹנִים] interpretations, noun, singular masculine with suffix, and plural masculine; pitron [פִּתְרוֹן]; root patar [פָּתַר] he interpreted.

units.la: פִּתְחָהָן pudendum earum, וְהַפְּתוֹת & cardines, No. f. m. aff. & pl. [?]
units.tr: pithhan [פִּתְחָהָן] their private parts, vehaphtot [וְהַפְּתוֹת] and hinges; noun, f. m., with suffix, and plural [?].

units.la: fæm. præf. à sing. m. No. Rad. פות cardo
units.tr: feminine, with prefix, from the masculine singular; noun; root puth [פות] hinge.

units.la: fœmina.
units.tr: feminine. ## Tsade, Aleph

Rad. יָצָא. הַצֵּאִים sordidi, No. pl. m. Rad. יָצָא exivit. צְאָלִים umbrosæ arbores, Job. 40. 16. No. pl. m. pro צְלָלִים, à f. m. צֵל Rad. צָלַל obumbrari, vel No. Rad. pl. m. Rad. צָאֵל umbrosum. צֵאנְךָ grex ejus, צֹאנְךָ tuus, צֹאנֵנוּ noster, צֹאנֵנוּ greges nostri, Neh. 10. 37. s. & pl. m. aff. No. Rad. s. m. צֹאן.
units.tr: tsei [צֵאִי] filth, dung, noun, singular masculine; root yatsa [יָצָא] he went out. tse [צֵא] go out, tsu [צְאוּ] go out, tsi [צְאִי] go out, feminine; tse'ena [צְאֶינָה] go out, feminine; imperative Qal, singular and plural, masculine and feminine; root yatsa [יָצָא]. tse'ah, tsah [צֵאָה, צְאָה] dung, noun, singular feminine; root yatsa [יָצָא]. hatse'im [הַצֵּאִים] filthy, noun, plural masculine; root yatsa [יָצָא] he went out. tse'alim [צְאָלִים] shady trees, Job 40.16., noun, plural masculine, for tselalim [צְלָלִים], from the masculine tsel [צֵל]; root tsalal [צָלַל] to be shaded; or a noun, plural masculine, from the root tsa'el [צָאֵל] shady. tso'neka [צֵאנְךָ] his flock, tso'nekha [צֹאנְךָ] your flock, tso'enu [צֹאנֵנוּ] our flock, tso'enu [צֹאנֵנוּ] our flocks, Neh. 10.37., singular and plural masculine with suffix; noun; root tso'n [צֹאן], singular masculine. ## Tsade, Bet

units.la: צ ב
צַבָּה, צְבָה tumens, צְבִים currus camerati, No. s. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad.
units.tr: tsabbah, tsevah [צַבָּה, צְבָה] swelling, tsevim [צְבִים] vaulted chariots, noun, singular masculine and feminine, and plural masculine; root

units.la: זבה
units.tr: tsabah [צָבָה]

units.la: צָבָה intumuit.
units.tr: tsabah [צָבָה] swelled up.

units.la: בְּ־צָבָאוֹת cum capreis,
units.tr: betsava'ot [בְּ־צָבָאוֹת] with roe-deer.

units.la: כְּ־צְבָאִים sicut capreæ,
units.tr: ketsava'im [כְּ־צְבָאִים] like roes.

units.la: pl. f.& pl.m. præf. (pro כְּצְבָיִם, בִּצְבָיוֹת) à f. m. צְבִי ; Rad. צָבָה intu-muit.
units.tr: plural feminine and plural masculine, with prefix (for ketsevayim [כְּצְבָיִם], betsevayot [בִּצְבָיוֹת]) from the masculine singular tsevi [צְבִי]; root tsavah [צָבָה] swelled up.

units.la: צְבָאִי militia mea, צְבָאָה ejus, צְבָאָם ipsorum, צְבָאוֹת exercitus, צְבָאֵינוּ nostri, צְבָאַי mei, No. f. m. צָבָא, aff. & pl. f. aff. R. צָבָא militare.
units.tr: tseva'i [צְבָאִי] my army, tseva'ah [צְבָאָה] his army, tseva'am [צְבָאָם] their army, tseva'ot [צְבָאוֹת] hosts, tseva'enu [צְבָאֵינוּ] our army, tseva'ai [צְבָאַי] my armies; noun, f. m., tsava [צָבָא], with suffix, and feminine plural with suffix; root tsaba [צָבָא] to serve in the army.

units.la: מִ־צָּבָה propter exercitum, Zach.9.8.(pro מִצָּבָא,) No. f. m. צָבָא, præf. Rad. צָבָא.
units.tr: mitstsavah [מִ־צָּבָה] because of the army, Zach. 9.8. (for mitstsava [מִצָּבָא]); noun, f. m., tsava [צָבָא], with prefix; root tsaba [צָבָא].

units.la: לְ־צָבוֹת ad tumidum reddendum, Num. 5. 22. pro לְהַצְבּוֹת , Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. צָבָה.
units.tr: letsavot [לְ־צָבוֹת] to make swollen, Num. 5.22., for lehatsbot [לְהַצְבּוֹת], infinitive Hiphil, with prefix; root tsavah [צָבָה].

units.la: צְבִי decus, צְבִיָּה caprea, צְבָיִם capreæ, No. f. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad. צָבָה intumuit.
units.tr: tsevi [צְבִי] glory, tsevayah [צְבִיָּה] roe, tsevayim [צְבָיִם] roes, noun, f. m. & f. & pl. m., root tsavah [צָבָה] swelled up.

units.la: צֹבָאִים militantes contra
units.tr: tsovaim [צֹבָאִים] fighting against

units.la: cam, Jef. 29. 7. (pro צִבְאָיָה,) Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. Rad. צָבָא.
units.tr: her, Isa. 29. 7. (for tsivayah [צִבְאָיָה]), participle Qal, plural masculine with suffix; root tsaba [צָבָא].

units.la: צָבְתָה intumuit illa, pret. Kal, 3. f. f. R. צָבָה.
units.tr: tsavetah [צָבְתָה] she swelled, perfect Qal, third person feminine singular; root tsavah [צָבָה].

units.la: הַצְּבָאִים manipuli, pl. m. præf. No. Rad. f. m. צָבָה manipulus.
units.tr: hatsevaim [הַצְּבָאִים] handfuls, plural masculine with prefix, noun, root f. m. tsavah [צָבָה] bundle. ## Tsade, Dalet

units.la: צ ד
הַצָּד venans, Ben. Kal, Rad. צוּד.
units.tr: hatsad [הַצָּד] hunting, participle Qal, root tsud [צוּד].

units.la: צַד latus, צִדָּה ejus, 1. Sam.20.20.(pro צִדָּה,) מִצִּדּוֹ ex latere ejus, לְצִדִּים ad latera, בְּ־צִדֵיכֶם in lateribus vestris, No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. צַד.
units.tr: tsad [צַד] side, tsiddah [צִדָּה] his side, 1 Sam. 20.20. (for tsiddah [צִדָּה]), mitstsiddo [מִצִּדּוֹ] from his side, letsiddim [לְצִדִּים] to the sides, betsidekhem [בְּ־צִדֵיכֶם] in your sides, noun, f. and plural m. with suffix, root tsad [צַד].

units.la: צֵדָה viaticum, No. sing. fæm. Rad. צוּד venatus est.
units.tr: tsedah [צֵדָה] provision for a journey, noun, singular feminine; root tsud [צוּד] he hunted.

units.la: צָרָה venaris, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. צָדָה.
units.tr: tsadah [צָדָה] you hunt, participle Qal, f. m.; root tsadah [צָדָה].

units.la: צָדּוּ venantur, pret. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. צָדָה, vel צוּד.
units.tr: tsadu [צָדּוּ] they hunt, perfect Qal, third person plural; root tsadah [צָדָה], or tsud [צוּד].

units.la: בְּצָרָה de industria, No. f. f. præf. Rad. צָרָה quærere.
units.tr: betsarah [בְּצָרָה] deliberately, noun, feminine, with prefix; root tsarah [צָרָה] to seek.

units.la: צִרְךָ latus tuum, No. f. m. צַד, aff. R. צָרְךָ.
units.tr: tsirkha [צִרְךָ] your side, noun f. m. tsad [צַד], with suffix, root tsarkha [צָרְךָ].

units.la: צִדְקָתְךָ justificare te, Ezech. 16.52. pro צִדְקָךְ, Infin. Piel, aff. Rad. צָדַק.
units.tr: tsidqatkha [צִדְקָתְךָ] to justify you, Ezek. 16.52., for tsidqekha [צִדְקָךְ], infinitive Piel, with suffix; root tsadaq [צָדַק]. ## Tsade, Vav

צַו, vel צַוָּה præceptum, No. f. m. Rad. צָוָה.
units.tr: tsav [צַו], or tsavah [צַוָּה] command, noun f. m.; root tsavah [צָוָה].

units.la: צַו præcipe, צַוּ præcipite, Imper. Piel, f. m. apoc. (pro צַוֵּה,) & pl. m. R. צָוָה.
units.tr: tsav [צַו] command, tsavu [צַוּ] command ye, imperative Piel, f. m. apocopated (for tsavveh [צַוֵּה]), and plural masculine; root tsavah [צָוָה].

units.tr: tso'im [צוֹאִים] filthy, noun, plural masculine; root yatsa [יָצָא] went out.

units.la: צַוָּא eam, Jos. 29.7. pro צוֹבֵאָה, Part. Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. Rad. צָבָא.
units.tr: tsavva [צַוָּא] her, Jos. 29.7. (for tsovea [צוֹבֵאָה]), participle Qal, plural masculine with suffix; root tsaba [צָבָא].

units.la: צוּר venari, pro צוּד, Infin. Kal, R. צוּד.
units.tr: tsur [צוּר] to hunt, for tsud [צוּד], infinitive Qal; root tsud [צוּד].

units.la: לְצוּד ad venandum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. צוּד.
units.tr: letsud [לְצוּד] for hunting, infinitive Piel, with prefix; root tsud [צוּד].

units.la: צוָּה præceptum fuit, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. R. צוָּה.
units.tr: tsuvvah [צוָּה] it was commanded, perfect Pual, third person f. m.; root [צוָּה].

units.la: צִוִּיתָ præcepisti, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. R. צִוָּה.
units.tr: tsiviita [צִוִּיתָ] you commanded, perfect Piel, second person f. m.; root tsivvah [צִוָּה].

units.la: צוּיתִי jussus sum, præt. Pual, 1. f. R. צִוָּה.
units.tr: tsuviti [צוּיתִי] I was commanded, perfect Pual, first person; root tsivvah [צִוָּה].

units.la: וְצִוָּךְ & præcepit tibi, præt. Piel, 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. צִוָּה.
units.tr: vetsivvakh [וְצִוָּךְ] and he commanded you, perfect Piel, third person singular masculine with suffix; root tsivvah [צִוָּה].

units.la: לְצוּלָה profunde, s. No. f. fæm. præf. Rad. צוּל.
units.tr: letsulah [לְצוּלָה] into the depths, substantive noun, feminine, with prefix; root tsul [צוּל].

units.la: הַצּוֹם an jejunando, Infin. Kal, præf. R. צוּם.
units.tr: hatstsom [הַצּוֹם] whether by fasting, infinitive Qal, with prefix; root tsum [צוּם].

units.la: צוֹפָה speculans, Prov. 31. 27. pro צוֹפִיָּה, Part. Ben. Kal, f. f. Rad. צָפָה.
units.tr: tsofah [צוֹפָה] watching, Prov. 31.27., for tsofiyah [צוֹפִיָּה], participle Qal, feminine; root tsafah [צָפָה].

units.la: צוּפִים favi, pl. m. No. f. m. צוּף favas, Rad. צוּף effluxit.
units.tr: tsufim [צוּפִים] honeycombs, plural masculine, noun f. m. tsuf [צוּף] honeycomb, root tsuf [צוּף] flowed out.

units.la: צוּר liga, Impor. Kal, f. m. Rad. צוּר, vel צָרָה.
units.tr: tsur [צוּר] bind, imperative Qal, f. m.; root tsur [צוּר], or tsarah [צָרָה].

units.la: צַוָּארָם collum suum, Neh. 3.5. (pro צַוָּארָם,) No. f. m. צַוָּאר, aff. Rad. צור obsedit.
units.tr: tsavvaram [צַוָּארָם] their neck, Neh. 3.5. (for tsavvaram [צַוָּארָם]), noun f. m. tsavvar [צַוָּאר], with suffix; root tsur [צור] besieged.

units.la: צוּרָם forma eorum, Pf. 49.15. (pro צוּרָתָם,) sing. fæm. aff. No. צוּרָה forma, vel est No. f. m. צוּר rupes, aff. Rad. צור obsedit.
units.tr: tsurām [צוּרָם] their form, Ps. 49.15. (for tsurātām [צוּרָתָם]) singular feminine with suffix, noun tsurah [צוּרָה] form, or it is noun f. m. tsur [צוּר] rock, with suffix; root tsur [צור] besieged.

units.la: מִ־צוּרָנֶיךָ è faucibus tuis, pl. m. præf. & aff. No. צוּרוֹן collulum, Rad. צור coarctavit [?].
units.tr: mitsuranekha [מִ־צוּרָנֶיךָ] from your throat, plural masculine with prefix and suffix, noun tsuron [צוּרוֹן] little neck, root tsur [צור] to constrict [?].

units.la: צִוָּתָה præceperat ei, Ruth 3.6. pro צִוָּתָה, præt. Piel, 3. s. f. aff. Rad. in Piel, צוה.
units.tr: tsivvatah [צִוָּתָה] she had commanded him, Ruth 3.6., for tsivvatah [צִוָּתָה], perfect Piel, third person singular feminine with suffix; root in Piel, tsavah [צוה]. ## Tsade, Het

units.la: צ ח
צַח candidus, צָחָה aridum, No. f. m. Rad. צַחָה candidum esse.
units.tr: tsach [צַח] white, tsachah [צָחָה] dry, noun f. m.; root tsachah [צַחָה] to be white.

units.la: צָחוּ nitidiores erant, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. צַחָה.
units.tr: tsachu [צָחוּ] were brighter, perfect Qal, third person plural, root tsachah [צַחָה].

units.la: צַחוֹת nitida verba, No. pl. f. Rad. צַחָה.
units.tr: tsachot [צַחוֹת] bright words, noun, plural feminine; root tsachah [צַחָה].

units.la: צַחִים nitidum, צָהִיָּה ari-ditas, צַחְצָחוֹת siccitates, No. f. m. & f. & No. pl. f. Rad. צָחָה candidum esse.
units.tr: tsachim [צַחִים] bright, tsechiyah [צָהִיָּה] aridity, tsachtsachot [צַחְצָחוֹת] dryness, noun f. m., f., and plural f.; root tsachah [צָחָה] to be white. ## Tsade, Yod

units.la: צ י
צִי navis, No. sing. m. Rad. צִיָּה aridus locus.
units.tr: tsi [צִי] ship, noun, singular masculine; root tsiyah [צִיָּה] dry place.

units.la: צִיד venatio, צֵידוֹ ejus, sing. m. constr. aff. No. צַיִד; Rad. צוד venatus est.
units.tr: tsid [צִיד] hunting, tsedo [צֵידוֹ] his hunting, singular masculine construct with suffix, noun tsayid [צַיִד]; root tsud [צוד] he hunted.

units.la: צֵידָה viaticum, (pro צֵידָה) No. sing. fæm. Rad. צוד venatus est.
units.tr: tsedah [צֵידָה] provision for a journey, (for tsedah [צֵידָה]), noun, singular feminine; root tsud [צוד] he hunted.

units.la: צַיָּדִים venatores, pl. m. No. צַיָּד; R. צוד.
units.tr: tsayyadim [צַיָּדִים] hunters, plural masculine, noun tsayyad [צַיָּד]; root tsud [צוד].

units.la: צִיּוֹן aridus locus, צִיּוֹן mons Tzion, No. f. m. Rad. צִיָּה siccitas.
units.tr: tsiyyon [צִיּוֹן] dry place, tsiyyon [צִיּוֹן] Mount Zion, noun, f. m.; root tsiyyah [צִיָּה] dryness.

units.la: הַצִּיּוּן monumentum hoc, צִיּוּנִים monumenta, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. צִיּוּן.
units.tr: hatsiyyun [הַצִּיּוּן] this monument, tsiyyunim [צִיּוּנִים] monuments, noun, f. & plural m.; root tsiyyun [צִיּוּן].

units.la: בְּצִיּוֹת per siticulosa loca, pl. f. No. Rad. f. f. צִיָּה siccitas.
units.tr: betsiyyot [בְּצִיּוֹת] through thirsty places, plural feminine, noun; root, feminine, tsiyyah [צִיָּה] dryness.

units.la: בְּצִים in naribus, Ezech. 30.9. (pro בְּצִיִּים,) No. pl. m. Rad. צִיָּה · צִיצַת flos, f. f. constr. No. צִיצָה, à f. m. צִיץ flos, Rad. צִיץ effloruit, unde & No. f. f. צִיצַת cincin-nus. צִירָה cardo ejus, צִירִים legati, No. f. m. aff. & pl. m. No. צִיר cardo, legatus. צִירֵי צִירִים tormina, צִירִי mea, צִירָיָה ejus, pl. m. constr. aff. à f. m. No. צִיר, Rad. צוּר obsedit.
units.tr: betsim [בְּצִים] in the nostrils, Ezek. 30.9. (for betsiyyim [בְּצִיִּים]), noun, plural masculine; root tsiyyah [צִיָּה] · tsitsat [צִיצַת] flower, feminine, construct, noun tsitsah [צִיצָה], from the masculine tsits [צִיץ] flower; root tsits [צִיץ] blossomed, whence also noun feminine tsitsat [צִיצַת] curl. tsirah [צִירָה] its hinge, tsirim [צִירִים] envoys, noun f. m., with suffix, and plural masculine; noun tsir [צִיר] hinge, envoy. tsire tsirim [צִירֵי צִירִים] pains, tsiri [צִירִי] my, tsirayah [צִירָיָה] her, plural masculine construct with suffix, from the masculine noun, tsir [צִיר], root tsur [צוּר] besieged.

units.la: צ ל
units.tr: צ ל

units.la: צַל umbra, בְּ־צִלּוֹ in umbra ejus, No. f. m. praef. aff. Rad. צלל obumbrari. לְ־צְלוֹת ad assandum, Infin. Kal, praef. R. צָלָה. צָלִי, constr. צָלִי assum, No. sing. masc. Rad. צָלָה assavit. צָלִיל tostum, torta, No. f. m. Rad. צָלָה assavit. צְלָלוֹ umbra ejus, צְלָלִים צִלְּלֵי umbrae, f. m. aff. & pl. m. No. צֵלֶל; Rad. צלל obumbrari. צַלְמָוֶת tenebrae, No. f. m. Rad. צָלַל. צַלְ־מָוֶת umbra mortis, comp. ex No. צֵל umbra, Rad. צלל obumbrari, & No. מָוֶת mors, R. מות mori. צַלְלַל umbrosa-densa, צַלְלָל sideratio, צַלְלֵי צַלְצָלִים cymbala, No. f. m. & No. pl. m. R. צלל obumbrari.
units.tr: Tsal, shadow; in his shadow (b'tsillo), noun masculine with prefix and suffix, from the root tsalal, to be overshadowed. Infinitive Kal of tsalah with prefix l'tsalot, to roast; tsali, roasted, noun singular masculine, from tsalah, he roasted. Tsalil, roasted, toasted (feminine tsalilah), noun masculine, from tsalah, he roasted. Tsalelo, his shadow; tsalalim and tsilelei tsilelim, shadows, masculine plural and with suffix, from the noun tselel, from the root tsalal, to be overshadowed. Tsalmavet, darkness, noun masculine, from the root tsalal. Tsal-mavet, shadow of death, compound of the noun tsel, shadow, from the root tsalal, to be overshadowed, and the noun mavet, death, from the root mut, to die. Tsalalal, thickly shaded; tsalal, sideration (blight); tsilelei tsalatsalim, cymbals, noun masculine and noun masculine plural, from the root tsalal, to be overshadowed.

units.la: צ מ
units.tr: צ מ

units.la: צַם jejunans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. צוּם. צַמָּאון sitis, No. f. m. Rad. צָמָא sitivit. צַמִּים horridus, No. f. m. Rad. צָמַם. צֹמְכֶם jejunium vestrum, sing. masc. aff. No. צוֹם; Rad. צוּם jejunavit.
units.tr: Tsam, fasting, Ben Kal, masculine participle, from the root tsum. Tsamaon, thirst, noun feminine, from the root tsama, he thirsted. Tsamim, horrid, noun masculine, from the root tsamam. Tsomkhem, your fasting, singular masculine with suffix, from the noun tsom; from the root tsum, he fasted.

units.la: צַמְרָת ramus summus[?], צַמְרָתוֹ ejus, No. f. fæm. aff. Rad. צמר; vel pro צַמֶּרֶת, Rad. צמר præcidit.
units.tr: Tsamrat, the top branch[?], tsamratho, his, noun feminine with suffix, from the root tsamar; or for tsameret, from the root tsamar, he cut off.

units.la: צַמֵּית sitities[?], Ruth. 2. 9. (pro צַמִּית, qu. à צָמָה atque id pro צַמְּאַת,) præt. Kal, 2. s. f. Rad. צָמָא sitivit.
units.tr: Tsamit, sittities[?], Ruth 2:9 (for tsamit, perhaps from tsamah, and this for tsamata), preterite Kal, second person feminine singular, from the root tsama, he thirsted.

units.la: צָמַתִּי jejunasti, צְמַתֶּם jejunastis, צַמְּתִּנִי jejunastis mihi, præt. Kal, 2. s. m. & 2. pl. m. vel f. aff. Rad. צום.
units.tr: Tsamarti, you fasted; tsamtem, you fasted; tsamtuni, you fasted for me; preterite Kal, second person masculine singular and second person plural masculine or feminine with suffix, from the root tsum.

units.la: צָמְתָה exscidit, צְמַתּוּנִי, & gem. צְמַתְּתוּנִי exscindunt me, Psal. 88. 17. צְמַתְּתַנִּי succidit me, præt. Piel, 3. s. m. & 3. pl. aff. ut & 3. s. f. (צְמַתָּה,) aff. Rad. צָמַת exscidit.
units.tr: Tsamtah, he cut off; tsamtuni, and doubled tsamtetuni, they cut me off, Psalm 88:17; tsamtetani, he cut me down, preterite Piel, third person masculine singular and third person plural with suffix, as also third person feminine singular (tsamtah) with suffix, from the root tsamat, he cut off.

units.la: צָמְתִּי sitio, Jud. 4. 19. (pro צַמְּאתִי,) præt. Kal, 1. s. Rad. צָמָא.
units.tr: Tsamti, I thirst, Judges 4:19 (for tsama'ti), preterite Kal, first person singular, from the root tsama.

units.la: צָמְתְּךָ crines tui, sing. fæm. aff. No. צָמָה coma, Rad. צמם.
units.tr: Tsamtekha, your locks, singular feminine with suffix, from the noun tsamah, hair, from the root tsamam.

units.la: צְנָה clypeus, scutum, No. sing. fæm. Rad. צנן.
units.tr: Tsenah, shield, buckler, noun singular feminine, from the root tsanan.

units.la: צֹנָה oves, greges, Psal. 8. 8. pro צַאנָה, atque id transp. pro No. Rad. צאן oves, grex, unde etiam צְנַאכֶם gregibus vestris, Num. 32. 24. pro transp. צַאנְכֶם, ab eod. No. Rad. צאן grex.
units.tr: Tsōnāh, oves, greges, Psalm 8:8, for tsaʾnāh [צַאנָה], and this is transposed, from the same root noun tsaʾn [צאן], sheep, flock. Likewise tsənaʾkhem [צְנַאכֶם], to your flocks, Numbers 32:24, for transposed tsaʾnkhem [צַאנְכֶם], from the same root noun tsaʾn [צאן], flock.

units.la: צְנוּרֶיךָ canales tui, pl. m. aff. No. צְנוֹר, Rad. inusit. צנר.
units.tr: Tsenurekha, your channels, masculine plural with suffix, from the noun tsenor, from the root tsanar.

units.la: בִּצְנָה in aculeis, pl. f. No. צְנָה ctypeus, R. צנן.
units.tr: Be-tsenah, in thorns, feminine plural, from the noun tsenah, shield, from the root tsanan.

units.la: צְנִים צְנִידִים aculei, spinæ, No. pl. masc. Rad. צנן.
units.tr: Tsenim, tsenidim, thorns, thorn-bushes, noun masculine plural, from the root tsanan.

units.la: צְנוּמוֹת graciles, pl. f. No. צְנוּמָה ; Rad. inusit. צנם.
units.tr: Tsenumot, slender, feminine plural, from the noun tsenumah; root unused, tsanam.

units.la: צ ע
units.tr: צ ע

units.la: צִיָּה, צִיָּה peregrinans ,
units.tr: Tsiyah, tsiyah, wandering,

units.la: צִיִּים peregrinantes , Ben. Kal, f. m. & f. ut & pl. m. Rad. צָיָה.
units.tr: Tsiyim, wandering ones, Ben Kal, masculine and feminine participle, and masculine plural, from the root tsayah.

units.la: וַיִּצְיָהוּ & peregrè agant eum, præt. Piel, 3. pl. aff. à 3. f. צִיָּה; Rad. צָיָה peregrè egit.
units.tr: Vayyitsyahu, and let them wander him, preterite Piel, third person plural with suffix, from the third person feminine tsiyah; root tsayah, he wandered abroad.

units.la: צִצְעִים motiones , No. pl. m. gem. R. צָיָה peregrinatus est, vel est idem quod ( & pro) צְאָאִים filii, prognati, No. pl. m. R. יָצָא exivit.
units.tr: Tsitsim, motions, noun masculine plural, doubled, from the root tsayah, he wandered; or it is the same as (and for) tsa'im, sons, offspring, noun masculine plural, from the root yatsa, he went out.

units.la: צִיָּק clama, Jer. 22.20. pro צַיֵּק, Imper. Kal, f. f. Rad. צָעַק.
units.tr: Tsiyak, cry out, Jeremiah 22:20, for tsayek, imperative Kal, second person feminine singular, from the root tsa'ak.

units.la: צ פ
units.tr: צ פ

units.la: צָפָה speculando , Infin. Kal, Rad. צָפָה.
units.tr: Tsafah, by watching, infinitive Kal, root tsafah.

units.la: צְפוּ excundurum [?] , præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. צוּף.
units.tr: Tsefu, excundurum[?], preterite Kal, third person plural, root tsuf.

units.la: צָפַי exploratus, Paul Kal, f. masc. item, צָפּוּי ob-
units.tr: Tsafai, explored, participle Paul Kal, masculine feminine; likewise tsafui, ob-

units.la: ductio, tectorium, No. sing. m. Rad. צָפָה speculatus est.
units.tr: ductio, plastering, noun singular masculine, from the root tsafah, he spied out.

units.la: צָפוֹן aquilo, צְפוֹנָה aquilonem versus, צְפוּנִים absconditi, צְפוּנְךָ tui, &c. vide in Rad. צָפַן abscondit.
units.tr: Tsafon, north wind, tsefonah, toward the north, tsefunim, hidden ones, tsefunekha, your hidden things, etc.; see under the root tsafan, he hid.

units.la: צֹפָּה speculans, צֹפִים speculatores, Ben. Kal, f. f. & pl. m. à f. m. צֹפָּה; Rad. צָפָה speculatus est.
units.tr: Tsofah, watching, tsofim, watchmen, Ben Kal, feminine singular and masculine plural from the masculine tsofeh; root tsafah, he watched.

units.la: צָפִּינוּ speculamur, præt. Piel, 1. pl. Rad. צָפָה; in Piel, צָפָה.
units.tr: Tsafinu, we watch, preterite Piel, first person plural, root tsafah; in Piel, tsafah.

units.la: הַצְּפִיָּה speculatio, No. f. f. Rad. צָפָה speculatus est.
units.tr: Ha-tsefiyah, the watching, noun feminine singular, root tsafah, he watched.

units.la: בְּצְפִיתֵנוּ in speculatione nostra, f. f. No. צְפִיָּה, præf. aff. Rad. צָפָה.
units.tr: Be-tsefitenu, in our watching, feminine singular noun tsefiyah, with prefix and suffix, root tsafah.

units.la: צְפַנַת Tzophnat, cognomentum Josephi, Gen. 41. 45. צָפַן abscondit.
units.tr: Tsefenat, Tzophnat, surname of Joseph, Genesis 41:45, from tsafan, he hid.

units.la: צְפְעוֹנִי regulus, basiliscus, צְפִיעַ egesta, & צִפְעוֹת nepotes, neptes, No. f. m.
units.tr: Tsefoni, basilisk, cockatrice; tsefia, egesta; and tsifot, grandsons, granddaughters, noun masculine, masculine plural construct, and feminine plural noun, from the noun root tsafa, regulus.

units.la: f. m. & No. pl. m. constr. ut & No. pl. f. à No. Rad. צָפָּא regulus.
units.tr: masculine and noun masculine plural construct, as also noun feminine plural from the noun.

units.la: צְפִצָפָה speculatio, No. f. f. gem. Rad. צָפָה speculatus est, sed, צִפָּךְ pipire, præt. Piel, gem. Rad. צָפַךְ.
units.tr: Tsefitsafah, watching, noun feminine singular, doubled, root tsafah, he watched; but tsifakh, to chirp, preterite Piel, doubled, root tsafakh.

units.la: בְּצִפְרן cum scalpro, No. f. m. præf. R. צָפַר evolavit.
units.tr: Be-tsifrun, with a chisel, noun masculine singular, prefixed, root tsafar, he flew away.

units.la: צָפָּה coronamentum, No. sing. fæm. Rad. צָפָה speculatus est.
units.tr: Tsafah, crown, coronation, noun singular feminine, root tsafah, he watched.

units.la: צָפְהָ natatio tua, Part. Kal, f. f. vel, No. f. f. צָפָה, aff. Rad. צוּף fluxit.
units.tr: Tsafta, your swimming, participle Kal, feminine singular, or noun feminine singular tsafah with suffix, root tsuf, he flowed.

units.tr: Ṣ Ṣ

units.tr: ṣaṣ effloruit, ṣiṣîm flores, 1 Reg. 6.18. pro ṣiṣîm, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & No. pl. m. R. ṣiṣ floruit.

units.tr: ṣaq funde, Imper. Kal, f. m. Rad. yāṣaq.

units.la: צִקּוּן funderunt, Jef.26 16. pro יִצְקוּן, præt. Kal, 3. pl. parag. Rad. יָצַק.
units.tr: They poured out, tsiqqun, Jer. 26.16, for yitsqun, perfect Qal, 3rd pl., with paragogic nun. Root yatsaq.

units.la: בְּצִקְלוֹנוֹ cum glumâ suâ, No. sing. m. præf. aff. Rad. inusit. צקל.
units.tr: bitsqilono, with its husk, noun, sing. masc., with prefix and suffix. Root not in use: tsql.

units.la: בְּצָקֹת in fundendo, Infin. Kal, præf. R. יָצַק.
units.tr: bĕṣāqōt in fundendo, Infin. Kal, præf. R. yāṣaq.
