units.tr: Ṣ R

units.la: צַר, צַר angustus, בְּצַר sicut rupes, צָרִים hostes, צָרוֹת angustiæ, No. f. m. præf. & pl. m. & f. Rad. צוֹר obsedit.
units.tr: tsar, tsar, narrow; betsar, like a rock; tsarim, enemies; tsarot, straits; noun, masc. and fem., with prefix; plural masc. and fem. Root tsur, besieged.

units.la: צַר acies, No. f. m. Rad. צוּר.
units.tr: ṣar acies, No. f. m. Rad. ṣûr.

units.la: צָרָה æmula, No. ff. à f. m. צַר, R. צוֹר obsedit.
units.tr: ṣārāh æmula, No. ff. à f. m. ṣar, R. ṣûr obsedit.

units.la: צָרִי, צָרִי opobalsamum, No. f. m. Rad. צָרָה.
units.tr: ṣĕrî, ṣŏrî opobalsamum, No. f. m. Rad. ṣārāh.

units.la: צָרִים rupes, בְּצֻרוֹת in rupibus, pl. m. & f. præf. f. m. צוֹר, Rad. צוֹר obsedit.
units.tr: tsarim, rocks; betsurot, in the rocks; plural masc. and fem., with prefix; fem. and masc. of tsur. Root tsur, besieged.

units.la: צָרַי hostes mei, No. pl. m. aff. צָרֵי constr. à f. m. צַר, R. צור. צַר vel צוֹר hostiliter agens, צָרִים, צָרִי agentes, צָרַי mei, צוֹרְרָיו hostes ejus, Ben. Kal, f. & pl. m. aff. R. צָרַר ligavit. צָרָה angustia, צָרָתִי mea, צָרָתוֹ ejus, צָרָתָם ipsorum, No. f. f. constr. aff. à f. f. צָרָה ; Rad. צוּר inimicatus est. צַרְתָּ obsedisti, צָרְתִּי obsedi, צָרָתֵנִי obsedisti me, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. & 1. f. Rad. צור.
units.tr: tsarai, my enemies, noun, plural masc. with suffix; tsarei, construct of the masc. tsar, root tsur. Tsar or tsur, acting hostilely; tsarim, tsari, acting; tsarai, my; tsorerav, his enemies; Benoni Kal, fem. and plural masc. with suffix; root tsarar, bound. Tsarah, distress; tsarati, my; tsarato, his; tsaratam, their; noun, fem., construct with suffix, from the fem. tsarah; root tsur, was hostile. Tsarta, you besieged; tsarti, I besieged; tsaratani, you besieged me, perfect Qal, 2nd masc. sing. with suffix, and 1st sing.; root tsur.

units.la: ק א
units.tr: Q ʾ

units.la: קָאָה evomens, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. & f. Rad. קוא vomuit. קָאָה platea, pelecanus, & constr. קָאַת No. f. Rad. קוא. קָאוֹ vomitus ejus, No. sing. masc. קָאוֹ, aff. Rad. קוא evomuit. קָאם surrexit, Hos. 10. 14. (pro קָם,) præt. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. קום.
units.tr: qa'ah, vomiting, participle, Benoni Kal, masc. and fem., root qua, vomited. Qa'ah, street, pelican, and construct qa'at; noun, fem.; root qua. Qa'o, his vomit, noun, sing. masc., qa'o, with suffix, root qua, he vomited. Qa'am, he rose, Hos. 10.14 (for qam), perfect Qal, 3rd masc. sing., root qum.

units.la: ק ב
units.tr: Q B

units.la: קב maledixit, קִבָּה, קִבּוֹ exsecratur illum, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. קָבַב. קַב, הַקָּב cabus, No. f. m. Rad. קָבַב maledixit. קְב exsecrando, לְקֹב ad exsecrandum, Inf. Kal, præf. R. קָבַב. קָבָּה exsecrare, Num. 22. 11. (pro קָבָּה,) Imper. Kal, קֹב, f. m. parag. Rad. קָבַב. הַקְּבָה ventriculus, No. f. f. Rad. קָבַב maledixit, sed forma qu. à קוֹב. קָבָּה lupanar, No. f. fæm. Rad. קבב exsecratus est. קבל receperunt, Esth. 9. 26. pro קבלו, praet. Piel, 3. pl. Rad. קבל. קבנו exsecrare eum, Num. 23. 13. pro קבו, vel קִבְנוּ ; Imp. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. קבב. קברה lupanar ejus, f. f. aff. No. קברה, (qu. a קום,) Rad. קבב male-dixit.
units.tr: Qav, cursed; qibbah, qibbo, curses him, perfect Qal, 3rd masc. sing. with suffix, root qabab. Qav, haqqav, cab (a measure), noun, masc.; root qabab, cursed. Qev, in cursing; leqov, for cursing, infinitive Qal, with prefix, root qabab. Qabbah, curse, Num. 22.11 (for qabbah), imperative Qal, masc. sing., paragogic, root qabab. Haqqevah, belly, noun, fem.; root qabab, cursed, but the form is perhaps from qub. Qabbah, brothel, noun, fem.; root qabab, cursed. Qibbel, received, Esth. 9.26 (for qibblu), perfect Piel, 3rd pl., root qabal. Qibnu, curse him, Num. 23.13 (for qibbu, or qibnu), imperative Qal, masc. sing. with suffix, root qabab. Qibrah, brothel of his, fem., with suffix, noun, qibrah (perhaps from qum), root qabab, cursed.

units.la: ק ד קדה casia, No. sing. fæm. Rad. קדד inclinavit. קדקדו vertex ejus, No. sing. m. קדקד, aff. Rad. קדד. קרורות atror, קרנית atrate, No. f.fæm. & Part. Adv. Rad. קדר obtenebratus fuit.
units.tr: Q d. Qedah, cassia, noun, sing. fem., root qdd, inclined. Qadqodo, its crown, noun, sing. masc., qadqod with suffix, root qdd. Qadrut, blackness, and qadrit, blackened, noun, fem., and participle adverb; root qdr, was darkened.

units.la: ק ה קהה hebetavit, praet. Piel, [?] קהל el, 3. f. m. R. קהה.
units.tr: Q H qĕhāh hebetavit, praet. Piel, [?] qĕhal el, 3. f. m. R. qhh.

units.la: ק ו קו linea, (& cum ה redund.) קוה Jer. 31. 39. קום ipsorum, No. f. m. aff. Rad. קוה exspectavit. קוב exsecrando, Infin. Kal, Rad. קבב maledixit, vel, נקב perforavit. קוה exspectando, קוה exspecta, קוו exspectate, קויו exspectarunt, & קויתי exspectavi, Infin. Piel, & Imper. Piel, f. & pl. m. ut & pret. Piel, 3. pl. & 1. f. Rad. קוה. קוים, קוי exspectantes, (pro קויי) קוי me, קוין eum, (pro קויו,) קויה te, Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. a f. m. קוה ; Rad. קוה. קום stare, קום surgere, קומי me, Infin. Kal,
units.tr: Q w. Qav, line (and with the redundant h, qavah), Jer. 31.39; qavam, their, noun, masc. with suffix; root qavah, waited. Qav, in cursing, infinitive Qal, root qabab, cursed, or naqab, pierced. Qavah, waiting; qavah, wait; qavu, wait (pl.); qavu, they waited; qavitti, I waited; infinitive Piel and imperative Piel, fem. and plural masc., as also perfect Piel, 3rd pl. and 1st sing.; root qavah. Qavim, qavi, waiting (for qavei); qavi, me; qavin, him (for qavvo); qavah, you, Benoni Kal, plural masc. with suffix, from the fem. and masc. qavah; root qavah. Qum, to stand; qum, to rise; qumi, me, infinitive Kal.

units.la: praef. aff. Rad. קוֹם.
units.tr: praef. aff. Rad. qwm.

units.la: קוֹמָה statura, קוֹמָתוֹ altitudo ejus, No. f. f. constr. aff. Rad. קוֹם surrexit.
units.tr: Qomah, stature; qomato, his height, noun, fem., construct with suffix, root qum, rose.

units.la: קוּמִים insurgentes, adversarii, 2 Reg. 16.7. pro קָמִים, Part. Ben. Kal, vel potius No. pl. Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: Qumim, rising, adversaries, 2 Kings 16.7 (for qamim), participle Benoni Kal, or rather noun, plural; root qum.

units.la: קוֹמֵם surgere fecit, &c. praet. Imper. vel Infin. Piel, Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: qômēm surgere fecit, &c. praet. Imper. vel Infin. Piel, Rad. qûm.

units.la: קוֹמְמִיּוּת erectio, No. f. f. Rad. קוּם surrexit.
units.tr: qômĕmiyyût erectio, No. f. f. Rad. qûm surrexit.

units.la: קוּמִי surgite, pro קוּמְנָה, Imper. Kal, pl. f. Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: qûmî surgite, pro qûmĕnāh, Imper. Kal, pl. f. Rad. qûm.

units.la: קוֹנְנוּ lamentatisunt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. R. קין.
units.tr: qônĕnû lamentatisunt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. R. qyn.

units.la: קִופִים simiae, No. pl. m. à sing. No. Rad. קוֹף simia.
units.tr: qôfîm simiae, No. pl. m. à sing. No. Rad. qôf simia.

units.la: קוּץ spina, קוֹצִים, קוּצֵי spinae, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. קוץ tadere [?].
units.tr: Quts, thorn; qotsim, qutsei, thorns, noun, fem. and plural masc.; root quts, to weary [?].

units.la: קוּצּוֹתָיו capilli ejus, No. pl. f. aff. R. קוץ.
units.tr: qûṣṣôtāyw capilli ejus, No. pl. f. aff. R. qûṣ.

units.la: קוֹנָא vocans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. קְרָא.
units.tr: qônā vocans, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. qĕrā'.

units.la: קוֹרִים vocantes, Ps. 99. 6. pro קוֹרִים, Part. Ben. Kal, pl. m. Rad. קְרָא.
units.tr: qôrîm vocantes, Ps. 99.6. pro qôrîm, Part. Ben. Kal, pl. m. Rad. qĕrā'.

units.la: קוֹרָה tignum, trabs, קוֹרָתוֹ ejus, No. sing. fem. aff. Rad. קָרָה evenit.
units.tr: Qorah, beam, rafter; qoratho, its, noun, sing. fem. with suffix; root qarah, happened.

units.la: קוֹדֵי telae, קוּרֵיהֶם eorum, pl. m. constr. aff. No. קוֹרִים; Rad. קוּר effodit.
units.tr: Qodei, threads; quriehem, their, plural masc., construct with suffix, noun qorim; root qur, dug out.

units.la: קוֹיָה exspectavit, praet. Piel, 3. f. f. R. קוּה.
units.tr: qôwāh exspectavit, praet. Piel, 3. f. f. R. qwh.

units.la: ק ח
units.tr: Qoph-Cheth (ק ח)

units.la: קָח accepit, Ezech. 17.5. pro לָקַח, & קָחָם accepit illa, Hos. 11. 3. praet. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. (pro קָחָם [?]) Rad. לקח.
units.tr: קָח accepit (he took), Ezech. 17.5, for לָקַח; and קָחָם accepit illa (he took them), Hos. 11.3. Perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix (for קָחָם [?]). Root לקח.

units.la: קַח accipe, קְחִי accipite, Imper. Kal, f. & pl. m. קְחִי accipe, f. Rad. לקח.
units.tr: קַח accipe (take), קְחִי accipite (take ye), Imperative Kal, sing. and pl. masc.; קְחִי accipe (take), fem. Root לקח.

units.la: קַחַת accipere, קָחְתִּי me, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. לקח.
units.tr: קַחַת accipere (to take), קָחְתִּי me (to take me), Infinitive Kal with suffix. Root לקח.

units.la: קט
units.tr: Qoph-Teth (קט)

units.la: קָט fastidivit, fastidium, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. vel No. f. m. Rad. קוּט.
units.tr: קָט fastidivit (he loathed), fastidium (loathing), Perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc., or Noun sing. masc. Root קוּט.

units.la: קָטָן parvus, קְטַנָּה parva, קְטַנִּי · קְטַנִּים parvi, קְטַנּוֹת parvæ, No. f. & pl. m. & f. Rad. קָטַן parvum esse.
units.tr: קָטָן parvus (small), קְטַנָּה parva (small, fem.), קְטַנִּי, קְטַנִּים parvi (small, pl. masc.), קְטַנּוֹת parvæ (small, pl. fem.), Adjective sing. and pl., masc. and fem. Root קָטַן parvum esse (to be small).

units.la: קָטֹן parvus, קְטָנִּי meus, sing. m. constr. aff. No. קָטֶן; Rad. קָטַן.
units.tr: קָטֹן parvus (small), קְטָנִּי meus (my small one), sing. masc. construct with suffix. Adjective קָטֶן; Root קָטַן.

units.la: ק׳
units.tr: Qoph (ק׳)

units.la: קִיא vomitus, בְּקִיאוֹ in vomitu suo, No. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. קוּא vomuit.
units.tr: קִיא vomitus (vomit), בְּקִיאוֹ in vomitu suo (in his vomit), Noun sing. masc. with prefix and suffix. Root קוּא vomuit (he vomited).

units.la: קִיאוּ & vomite, Jer. 25.27. Imper. Kal, pl. m. (pro קִיאוּ, qu. à Rad. קָאָה mutando א in י) Rad. קוּא.
units.tr: קִיאוּ & vomite (and vomit), Jer. 25.27. Imperative Kal, pl. masc. (for קִיאוּ, perhaps from the root קָאָה by changing א into י). Root קוּא.

units.la: קִיטוֹר fumus, No. f. m. Rad. קִטֵּר suffivit.
units.tr: קִיטוֹר fumus (smoke), Noun sing. masc. Root קִטֵּר suffivit (he burned incense).

units.la: קִים substantia, קִימְנוּ nostra, קִיָּמָה surrectio,
units.tr: קִים substantia (substance), קִימְנוּ nostra (our substance), קִיָּמָה surrectio (rising up),

units.la: ק׳
units.tr: Qoph (ק׳)

units.la: קִיפָּם eorum, No. f. m. & f. aff. Rad. קוּם surrexit.
units.tr: קִיפָּם eorum (their), Noun sing. masc. and fem. with suffix. Root קוּם surrexit (he rose).

units.la: קִים stabilivit, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. & קִים erige, קִימֵנִי me, Imper. Piel, f. m. aff. Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: קִים stabilivit (he established), Perfect Piel, 3rd sing. masc.; and קִים erige (raise up), קִימֵנִי me (raise me up), Imperative Piel, sing. masc. with suffix. Root קוּם.

units.la: קִימוּשׁ carduus, No. f. m. Rad. קמש.
units.tr: קִימוּשׁ carduus (thistle), Noun sing. masc. Root קמש.

units.la: קִינָה lamentatio, קִינוֹת. קִינִים lamentationes, No. f. & pl. f. & m. Rad. קוּן lamentatus est.
units.tr: קִינָה lamentatio (lamentation), קִינוֹת, קִינִים lamentationes (lamentations), Noun sing. and pl., fem. and masc. Root קוּן lamentatus est (he lamented).

units.la: קִינוֹ lancea ejus, sing. masc. aff. No. Rad. קִין.
units.tr: Kinno: his spear (singular masculine, with suffix). Root קִין.

units.la: קִיץ æstas, קִיצָהּ æstivi fructus tui, Jer. 16.9. (pro קִיצְךָ,) No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. קִין tædere.
units.tr: קִיץ æstas (summer), קִיצָהּ æstivi fructus tui (your summer fruit), Jer. 16.9. (for קִיצְךָ), Noun sing. and pl. masc. with suffix. Root קִין tædere (to be weary).

units.la: קִיצוֹן extremus, קִיצוֹנָה extrema, No. sing. m. & f. Rad. קָצָה abscidit.
units.tr: Qiẓōn, extreme; qiẓōnāh, extreme (feminine); noun, singular masculine and feminine. Root קָצָה, he cut off.

units.la: קִיקָיוֹן ricinus, No. f. m. à Rad. inusit. קִיק.
units.tr: קִיקָיוֹן ricinus (castor-oil plant), Noun sing. masc., from the root inusitatus (unused). קִיק.

units.la: קִיקָלוֹן vomitus ignominiæ, No. f. m. comp. ex No. קִיא vomitus, à Rad. קִיא evomuit No. קָלוֹן ignominia, à Rad. קָלָה assavit. קִירוֹת parietes, No. pl. fæm. à f. m. No. Rad. קִיר paries.
units.tr: קִיקָלוֹן vomitus ignominiæ (the vomit of shame), Noun sing. masc., compounded of the noun קִיא vomitus (vomit), from the root קִיא evomuit (he vomited), and the noun קָלוֹן ignominia (shame), from the root קָלָה assavit (he roasted). קִירוֹת parietes (walls), Noun pl. fem., from the sing. masc. noun. Root קִיר paries (wall).

units.la: ק ל קַל, קַלָּה levis, קַלִּים leves, No. f. m. & f. ut & pl. m. Rad. קָלַל levari. מִקַּל à levi, No. f. m. præf. Rad. קָלַל. הַקַּלּוּ levatæ sunt, an leviores factæ sunt? præt. Kal, 3. plur. præf. Rad. קָלַל. קָלוּ tostus, Paul Kal, f. m. Rad. קָלָה assavit. קָלוֹן levitas, ignominia, No. f. m. Rad. קָלָה. קָלוּתָ viluisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. קָלַל. קָלִי, vel קָלִיא tostum, No. f. m. Rad. קָלָה assavit. קְלָלָתְךָ maledictio tua, sing. fæm. aff., No. קְלָלָה; Rad. קָלַל levari.
units.tr: Qoph-Lamed (ק ל): קַל, קַלָּה levis (light), קַלִּים leves (light, pl.), Noun sing. masc. and fem., and pl. masc. Root קָלַל levari (to be made light). מִקַּל à levi (from the light one), Noun sing. masc. with prefix. Root קָלַל. הַקַּלּוּ levatæ sunt, an leviores factæ sunt? (were they lifted up, or were they made lighter?), Perfect Kal, 3rd pl. with prefix. Root קָלַל. קָלוּ tostus (roasted), Participle Kal, sing. masc. Root קָלָה assavit. קָלוֹן levitas (lightness), ignominia (shame), Noun sing. masc. Root קָלָה. קָלוּתָ viluisti (you became cheap), Perfect Kal, 2nd sing. masc. Root קָלַל. קָלִי, vel קָלִיא tostum (roasted), Noun sing. masc. Root קָלָה assavit. קְלָלָתְךָ maledictio tua (your curse), sing. fem. with suffix, Noun קְלָלָה; Root קָלַל levari.

units.la: ק מ קָלָם torrefecit eos, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. קָלָה. קִלְקָל, vel קְלוּקָל vilissimus, No. f. m. gem. Rad. קַלְקַל. קִלְקַל perdidit, Ezech. 21. 21. præt. Piel, 3. f. m. gem. pro קִלֵּל; Rad. קָלַל levari. קִלְשׁוֹן furca, No. f. m. R. inusit. קלשׁ.
units.tr: Qoph-Mem (ק מ): קָלָם torrefecit eos (he roasted them), Perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix. Root קָלָה. קִלְקָל, vel קְלוּקָל vilissimus (most vile), Noun sing. masc., doubled. Root קַלְקַל. קִלְקַל perdidit (he destroyed), Ezech. 21.21. Perfect Piel, 3rd sing. masc., doubled, for קִלֵּל; Root קָלַל levari. קִלְשׁוֹן furca (fork), Noun sing. masc. Root inusitatus (unused). קלשׁ.

units.la: ק מ קָם, קָמָה surrexit, קָמוּ surrexerunt, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. Rad. קוּם. קָם, קָמָה surgens, קָמִים, קָמִי surgentes, קָמִי in me, קָמָיו in eum, קָמֵינוּ in nos, קָמְךָ in te, Ben. Kal, f. m. & f. & pl. m. constr. aff. Rad. קוּם surrexit. קָמָה seges, בְּקָמוֹת in segetes, No. f. & pl. f. Rad. קוּם. קַמְנוּ surgimus, קַמְתָּ sur-
units.tr: Qoph-Mem (ק מ): קָם, קָמָה surrexit (he rose, she rose), קָמוּ surrexerunt (they rose), Perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc. and fem. and 3rd pl. Root קוּם. קָם, קָמָה surgens (rising), קָמִים, קָמִי surgentes (rising, pl.), קָמִי in me (against me), קָמָיו in eum (against him), קָמֵינוּ in nos (against us), קָמְךָ in te (against you), Participle Kal, sing. and pl. masc. and fem., construct with suffix. Root קוּם surrexit. קָמָה seges (standing corn), בְּקָמוֹת in segetes (in standing corn), Noun sing. and pl. fem. Root קוּם. קַמְנוּ surgimus (we rise), קַמְתָּ sur-

units.la: rexisti, קַמְתֶּם surrexistis, praet. Kal, 1. pl. & 2. f. & pl. m. Rad. קוּם.
units.tr: rexisti (you rose), קַמְתֶּם surrexistis (you rose, pl.), Perfect Kal, 1st pl., 2nd sing. fem. and 2nd pl. masc. Root קוּם.

units.la: ק נ
units.tr: Qoph-Nun (ק נ)

units.la: קֵן, vel קֵן nidus, קִנְּךָ tuus, קִנִּים nidi, No. f. m. aff. & pl. m. Rad. קנן nidificare.
units.tr: קֵן, vel קֵן nidus (nest), קִנְּךָ tuus (your nest), קִנִּים nidi (nests), Noun sing. masc. with suffix, and pl. masc. Root קנן nidificare (to build a nest).

units.la: קַנָּא zelotes, No. f. m. Rad. קנא.
units.tr: קַנָּא zelotes (zealot), Noun sing. masc. Root קנא.

units.la: קַנֵּא zelando, 1 Reg. 19. 10. pro קַנֵּא, Infin. Piel, Rad. קנא.
units.tr: קַנֵּא zelando (by being zealous), 1 Reg. 19.10. for קַנֵּא, Infinitive Piel. Root קנא.

units.la: קִנֵּא zelotypus fuit, קִנְּאוּנִי ad zelum commoverunt me, קִנְּאָתִי zelotypus fui, praet. Piel, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. aff. ut & 1. f. Rad. קנא.
units.tr: קִנֵּא zelotypus fuit (he was jealous), קִנְּאוּנִי ad zelum commoverunt me (they provoked me to jealousy), קִנְּאָתִי zelotypus fui (I was jealous), Perfect Piel, 3rd sing. and 3rd pl. with suffix, as also 1st sing. fem. Root קנא.

units.la: קִנְאָה, קִנְאַת zelus, קִנְאִתִּי meus, קִנְאָתְךָ tuus, No. f. f. constr. aff. Rad. קנא.
units.tr: קִנְאָה, קִנְאַת zelus (jealousy), קִנְאִתִּי meus (my jealousy), קִנְאָתְךָ tuus (your jealousy), Noun sing. fem., construct with suffix. Root קנא.

units.la: קִנְאוֹת zelotypiæ, No. pl. fæm. Rad. קנא.
units.tr: קִנְאוֹת zelotypiæ (jealousies), Noun pl. fem. Root קנא.

units.la: קָנֶה, & קָנָה canna, cala-
units.tr: קָנֶה, & קָנָה canna (reed), calamus (stalk,

units.la: mus, קָנֵהוּ ejus, קָנִים, קָנֵי calami, קִנֵּיהֶם eorum, No. f. m. aff. & pl. m. ut & No. pl. f. aff. Rad. קנה emit.
units.tr: mus, קָנֵהוּ ejus (his), קָנִים, קָנֵי calami (reeds), קִנֵּיהֶם eorum (their), Noun sing. masc. with suffix, and pl. masc. as also Noun pl. fem. with suffix. Root קנה emit (he bought).

units.la: קְנֵה eme, Imper. Kal, f. m. R. קנה.
units.tr: קְנֵה eme (buy), Imperative Kal, sing. fem. Root קנה.

units.la: קוֹנֶה possessor, קוֹנֵהוּ ejus, קוֹנֵיהֶן possessores earum, Ben. Kal, f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. קנה.
units.tr: קוֹנֶה possessor (owner), קוֹנֵהוּ ejus (his), קוֹנֵיהֶן possessores earum (their owners), Participle, sing. fem. and pl. masc., with suffix. Root קנה.

units.la: קְנוֹ, קְנוֹה, & קְנוֹת comparare, Infin. Kal, R. קנה.
units.tr: קְנוֹ, קְנוֹה, & קְנוֹת comparare (to acquire), Infinitive Kal. Root קנה.

units.la: קְנוֹת comparare, לִקְנוֹת ad emendum, קְנוֹתְךָ emere te, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. קנה.
units.tr: קְנוֹת comparare (to acquire), לִקְנוֹת ad emendum (for buying), קְנוֹתְךָ emere te (to buy you), Infinitive Kal with suffix. Root קנה.

units.la: קוֹנֶה emptor vel calami tui, pro קִנְּךָ, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. aff. vel, No. pl. m. aff. à f. m. קָנֶה calamus, pl. m. קָנִים calami, Rad. קנה emit.
units.tr: קוֹנֶה emptor (buyer), or קִנְּךָ calami tui (your reed), for קִנְּךָ, Participle, sing. masc. with suffix; or, Noun pl. masc. with suffix from the sing. fem. noun קָנֶה calamus (reed), pl. masc. קָנִים calami (reeds). Root קנה emit (he bought).

units.la: קִנְיָן possessio, קִנְיָנוֹ sua, קִנְיָנְךָ tua, קִנְיָנָם eorum, No. f. m. aff. Rad. קנה emit. emit.
units.tr: קִנְיָן possessio (possession), קִנְיָנוֹ sua (his), קִנְיָנְךָ tua (your), קִנְיָנָם eorum (their), Noun sing. masc. with suffix. Root קנה emit. emit.

units.la: קָנִיתָ comparasti, קָנִיתִי e-mi, præt. Kal, 2. s. m. & 1. s. Rad. קָנָה.
units.tr: קָנִיתָ comparasti (you acquired), קָנִיתִי emi (I acquired), Perfect Kal, 2nd sing. masc. and 1st sing. Root קָנָה.

units.la: קָנָהְ possidebat te, קָנַנִי me, קָנָהוּ illum, præt. Kal, 3. s. m. aff. Rad. קָנָה.
units.tr: קָנָהְ possidebat te (he possessed you), קָנַנִי me (he possessed me), קָנָהוּ illum (he possessed him), Perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc. with suffix. Root קָנָה.

units.la: קִנָּמוֹן cinnamomum, No. s. m. Rad. inusit. קִנָּם.
units.tr: קִנָּמוֹן cinnamomum (cinnamon), Noun sing. masc. Root inusitatus. קִנָּם.

units.la: קִנְּנוּ nidificarunt, קִנְּנָה nidificavit, præt. Piel, 3. pl. & 3. s. f. Rad. קִנַּן.
units.tr: קִנְּנוּ nidificarunt (they built a nest), קִנְּנָה nidificavit (she built a nest), Perfect Piel, 3rd pl. and 3rd sing. fem. Root קִנַּן.

units.la: קִנְצֵי fines, Job. 18.2. (pro קִצֵּי,) No. pl. m. constr. Rad. קָצַץ amputavit.
units.tr: קִנְצֵי fines (boundaries), Job 18.2. (for קִצֵּי), Noun pl. masc. construct. Root קָצַץ amputavit (he cut off).

units.la: קַם
units.tr: Qoph-Mem (קַם)

units.la: קָמֵי divina, pro קָסְמֵי, vel, קֹסְמֵי ; Rad. קָסַם.
units.tr: קָמֵי divina (divining things), for קָסְמֵי, or קֹסְמֵי; Root קָסַם.

units.la: קַע
units.tr: Qoph-Ayin (קַע)

units.la: קַעַע stigma, No. s. m. gein Rad. inusit. קָעַע.
units.tr: קַעַע stigma (brand-mark), Noun sing. masc., with gemination. Root inusitatus. קָעַע.

units.la: קַפּ
units.tr: Qoph-Pe (קַפּ)

units.la: קָפָּ concretio, No. s. m. Rad. [illegible, ~6 letters] concrescere,
units.tr: קָפָּ concretio (congealing), Noun sing. masc. Root [illegible, about six letters] concrescere (to congeal),

units.la: unde in præt. Kal, 3. pl. קָפְאוּ concreverunt.
units.tr: whence in the Perfect Kal, 3rd pl. קָפְאוּ concreverunt (they congealed).

units.la: קָפַר anataria, No. s. m. Rad. קָפַר præcidit.
units.tr: קָפַר anataria (?), Noun sing. masc. Root קָפַר præcidit (he cut off).

units.la: קָפּוּ merula, No. s. m. Rad. קָפּוּ.
units.tr: קָפּוּ merula (blackbird), Noun sing. masc. Root קָפּוּ.

units.la: קִפִּים simia, pl. m. No. Rad. s. m. קוֹף simia.
units.tr: קִפִּים simia (apes), pl. masc., Noun. Root; sing. masc. קוֹף simia (ape).

units.la: קַצ
units.tr: Qoph-Tsade (קַצ)

units.la: קָצָה æstivavit, קָצָה angustia afficitur, præt. Kal, 3. s. m. & f. Rad. קִיץ.
units.tr: קָצָה æstivavit (he summered), קָצָה angustia afficitur (is afflicted with distress), Perfect Kal, 3rd sing. masc. and fem. Root קִיץ.

units.la: קִיץ, (& cum ה parag.) קָצָה finis, קָצוֹ, & קָצָה ejus, קֵצִי meus, קָצֶךָ tuus, קִצֵּנוּ noster, No. s. m. aff. Rad. קָצַץ amputavit.
units.tr: קִיץ, (and with ה paragogic) קָצָה finis (end), קָצוֹ, and קָצָה ejus (his), קֵצִי meus (my), קָצֶךָ tuus (your), קִצֵּנוּ noster (our), Noun sing. masc. with suffix. Root קָצַץ amputavit (he cut off).

units.la: קֵצָה extremum, קְצוֹת extremitates, מִקְּצוֹת ab extremitatibus, קְצוֹתָו extremitates ejus, (qu. pro קְצוֹתָיו,) קְצוֹתָם eorum, No. f. & pl. fæm. aff. Rad. קָצָה abscidit.
units.tr: קֵצָה extremum (extremity), קְצוֹת extremitates (extremities), מִקְּצוֹת ab extremitatibus (from the extremities), קְצוֹתָו extremitates ejus (its extremities; perhaps for קְצוֹתָיו), קְצוֹתָם eorum (their), Noun sing. and pl. fem. with suffix. Root קָצָה abscidit (he cut off).

units.la: scidit.
units.tr: cut off.

units.la: קָצָה, constr. קְצֵה finis, בִּקְצֵהוּ in extremitate ejus, & מִקְּצֵיהֶם ab extremitatibus suis, No. f. & pl. m. præf. & aff. Rad. קָצָה abscidit.
units.tr: קָצָה, construct קְצֵה finis (end), בִּקְצֵהוּ in extremitate ejus (in its extremity), and מִקְּצֵיהֶם ab extremitatibus suis (from their extremities), Noun sing. and pl. masc. with prefix and suffix. Root קָצָה abscidit (he cut off).

units.la: קְצוֹת extremitates, pl. m constr. No. קְצוֹת, No. f. m. קָצָה finis.
units.tr: קְצוֹת extremitates (extremities), pl. masc. construct. Noun קְצוֹת, Noun sing. masc. קָצָה finis (end).

units.la: קְצוּצֵי amputati, Paul Kal, pl.m. constr. Kad. קָצַץ.
units.tr: קְצוּצֵי amputati (cut off), Participle Kal, pl. masc. construct. Root קָצַץ.

units.la: קָצוֹת extremitates, No. pl. f. Rad. קָצָה.
units.tr: קָצוֹת extremitates (extremities), Noun pl. fem. Root קָצָה.

units.la: לִקְצוֹת exscindendo, Infin. Kal, Rad. קָצָה.
units.tr: לִקְצוֹת exscindendo (by cutting off), Infinitive Kal. Root קָצָה.

units.la: לִקְצוֹת exscindere, Infin. Piel, Rad. קָצָה.
units.tr: לִקְצוֹת exscindere (to cut off), Infinitive Piel. Root קָצָה.

units.la: קָצִין dux, קְצִינֵי principes, קְצִינֶיךָ tui, No. f. m. & pl. m. aff. Rad. inusit. קצן.
units.tr: קָצִין dux (leader), קְצִינֵי principes (leaders, pl.), קְצִינֶיךָ tui (your leaders), Noun sing. and pl. masc. with suffix. Root inusitatus. קצן.

units.la: וַיִּקְצָתָה & amputabis, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. parag. Rad. קָצַץ.
units.tr: וַיִּקְצָתָה & amputabis (you will cut off), Perfect Kal, 2nd sing. fem. with paragogic. Root קָצַץ.

units.la: קָצָתִי tædio afficior, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. קוץ.
units.tr: קָצָתִי tædio afficior (I am wearied), Perfect Kal, 1st sing. Root קוץ.

units.la: קָר frigidum, קֹר frigus, No. f. m. Rad. קָרַר frigescere.
units.tr: Qar, cold (adjective), Qor, cold (noun), masc. and fem. Root qarar, to grow cold.

units.la: קִיר paries, f. m. pro No. Rad. קִיר.
units.tr: Qir, a wall, masc. and fem., for the noun. Root qir.

units.la: קְרָא, vel, קְרוּא vocatus, קְרָאִים, vel, קְרוּאִים vocati, Paul Kal, f. & pl. m. Rad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Qera, or qeru, called; qera'im, or qeru'im, called (plural), Participle Qal, fem. and plural masc. Root qara, to call.

units.la: קָרָא vocatum fuit, præt. Pual, 3.f.m. Rad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Qara, it was called, Perfect Pual, 3rd fem. masc. Root qara.

units.la: בִּקְרֹא in vocando me, Inf. Kal, קְרָא, præf. aff. R. קָרָא.
units.tr: Biqro, in calling me, Infinitive Qal, qera, with prefix and suffix. Root qara.

units.la: קְרֹא vocare, קְרָאנוּ invocare nos, Infin. Kal, aff. Kad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Qera, to call; qerana, to call us, Infinitive Qal, with suffix. Root qara.

units.la: קֹרָא perdix, No. f. m. Rad. קָרָא vocavit.
units.tr: Qora, a partridge, masc. and fem. noun. Root qara, he called.

units.la: קְרָאָהוּ obvenerit ipsi, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. קָרָא, vel, קָרָה.
units.tr: Qera'hu, it happened to him, Perfect Qal, 3rd masc., with suffix. Root qara, or qara (qarah).

units.la: קְרָאֵי invocantes, קְרָאָם eum, Ben. Kal, pl. m.
units.tr: Qera'ei, calling upon, qera'am, him, Benoni Qal, masc. plural.

units.la: aff. à f. m. קְרָא invo-cans, pl. m. קְרָאִים invocantes, Rad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Participle, masc. singular qera, calling upon, with suffix; masc. plural qera'im, calling upon. Root qara.

units.la: קְרָאן vocate, Exod.2.20. pro קְרָאנָה, Imper. Kal, pl.f. Rad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Qera'n, call (fem. plural), Exodus 2:20, for qera'na, Imperative Qal, fem. plural. Root qara.

units.la: קְרָאנִי vocavit me, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Qera'ni, he called me, Perfect Qal, 3rd masc., with suffix. Root qara.

units.la: קְרָאנִי invoca me, Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Qera'ni, call upon me, Imperative Qal, masc. singular, with suffix. Root qara.

units.la: קְרָאת vocasti, vel illa vocavit, pro קְרָאָה, præt. Kal, 2. & 3. f.f. Rad. קָרָא.
units.tr: Qarat, you called, or she called, for qara'ah, Perfect Qal, 2nd and 3rd fem. Root qara.

units.la: קְרָאת evenit, pro קְרָתָה, præt. Kal, 3. f.f. Rad. קָרָה.
units.tr: Qarat, it happened, for qartah, Perfect Qal, 3rd fem. Root qarah.

units.la: לִקְרָאת in occursum, לִקְרָאתוֹ ipsi, לִקְרָאתְכֶם vestri, f. f. constr. præf. aff. No. קְרָאָה occur-sus, Rad. קָרָה evenit.
units.tr: Liqrat, to meet, liqrato, to him, liqratkem, to you, fem. construct with prefix and suffix; noun qera'ah, meeting. Root qarah, it happened.

units.la: קָרַב admove, Ezec.37.17. pro קְרָב, Imper. Piel, f. m. Rad. קָרַב præt. Piel, קֵרֵב admo-vit, & fut. Piel; יִקְרַב admovebit.
units.tr: Qarab, bring near, Ezekiel 37:17, for qerab, Imperative Piel, masc. singular. Root qarab; Perfect Piel, qerev, he brought near; and Imperfect Piel, yiqrab, he will bring near.

units.la: קִרְבִּי medium meum, קִרְבּוֹ ejus, קִרְבָּךְ tuum, קִרְבָּם ipsorum, No. f. m. קָרֵב, aff. Rad. קרב appropin-quavit.
units.tr: Qirbi, my midst; qirbo, his; qirbak, your; qirbam, their own, masc. noun, with suffix. Root qarev, he drew near.

units.la: קׇרְבָּן vel, קׇרְבָּן oblatio, No sing. m. Rad. קרב.
units.tr: Qorban, or qurban, offering, masc. singular noun. Root qarav.

units.la: קְרִבְתָּם accedere eos, pro קִרְבָּם, Infin. Kal, à קִרְבָּה cum ה parag. & aff. Rad. קרב.
units.tr: Qirbtam, to approach them, for qirbam, Infinitive Qal, from qirbah, with paragogic he and suffix. Root qarav.

units.la: קַרְדֹּמִים secures, קַרְדֹּמוֹת pl. m. & f. à f. m. No. Rad. קַרְדּוֹם.
units.tr: Qardomim, axes; qardomot, plural masc. and fem., from the fem. noun, masc. Root qardom.

units.la: קָרָה frigus, No.fæm.sing. Rad. קָרַר frigescere.
units.tr: Qarah, cold, feminine singular noun. Root qarar, to grow cold.

units.la: מִקָּרֶה ex casu, sing. m. constr. præf. No. קָרֶה Rad. קָרָה obvenit.
units.tr: Miqqare, by chance, masc. singular, construct with prefix, noun qare. Root qarah, it happened.

units.la: קָרָהוּ evenit ei, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. קָרָה.
units.tr: Qarahu, it happened to him, Perfect Qal, 3rd masc., with suffix. Root qarah.

units.la: קָרְהוּ contignarunt eum, præt. Piel, 3. pl. aff. à 3. f. m. קָרָה contigna-vit, Rad. קָרָה evenit.
units.tr: Qarhu, they roofed him, Perfect Piel, 3rd plural, with suffix, from the 3rd masc. singular qarah, he roofed. Root qarah, it happened.

units.la: לְקָרוֹת ad contignandum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. קָרָה
units.tr: Laqarot, to roof, Infinitive Piel, with prefix. Root qarah.

units.la: קְרוֹת tigna, No. pl. fæm. à s. f. קָרָה ; Rad. קָרָה evenit.
units.tr: Qerot, beams, feminine plural noun, from the feminine singular qarah. Root qarah, it happened.

units.la: הַ־קְּרוֹת accidentia, Part. Ben. Kal, pl. f. præf. Rad. קָרָה
units.tr: Ha-qerot, the accidents, Participle Benoni Qal, fem. plural, with prefix. Root qarah.

units.la: קָרָה gelu, קָרָה calvus, No. s. m. R. קָרָה glabrare se.
units.tr: Qarah, frost; qarah, bald, masc. singular noun. Root qarah, to make oneself bald.

units.la: קָרְחָא calvitium, Ezech. 27. 31. pro קָרְחָה, קָרְחָתֵךְ tuum, No. s. f. aff. Rad. קָרַח glabrare se.
units.tr: Qarhah, baldness, for qarhah, Ezekiel 27:31; qarhatekh, your baldness, fem. singular noun with suffix. Root qarah, to make oneself bald.

units.la: קָרְחוֹ glacies sua, No. s. m. aff. Rad. קָרְחָה
units.tr: Qarho, his ice, masc. singular noun with suffix. Root qarhah.

units.la: קָרְחָתָה calvities, בְּ־קָרְחָתוֹ in loco calvo ejus, No. s. f. aff. Rad. קָרַח glabrare se.
units.tr: Qarhatah, baldness; be-qarhato, in his bald place, fem. singular noun with suffix. Root qarah, to make oneself bald.

units.la: קָרִי accidens, & in pausa קָרְיָ, pro בִּקְרִי per accidens, No. s. m. Rad. קָרָה evenit.
units.tr: Qari, accident, and in pause qari, for biqri, by accident, masc. singular noun. Root qarah, it happened.

units.la: קְרִיאָה proclamatio, No. s. fæm. Rad. קָרָא vocavit.
units.tr: Qeri'ah, proclamation, fem. singular noun. Root qara, he called.

units.la: קְרִיאֵי vocati, pro quo ke-thib, קְרִיּוֹא, No. pl. m. קְרִיאִים, constr. à Rad. קָרָא vocavit.
units.tr: Qeri'ei, called, for which the ketiv is qeri'o, masc. plural noun, construct qeri'im, from the root qara, he called.

units.la: קִרְיָה civitas, constr. קִרְיַת, No. s. fæm. Rad. קָרָה evenit.
units.tr: Qiryah, city, construct qiryat, fem. singular noun. Root qarah, it happened.

units.la: קָרִים frigidi, pl. m. à No. s. m. קָר ; Rad. קָרַר frigescere.
units.tr: Qarim, cold ones, masc. plural, from the masc. singular noun qar; root qarar, to grow cold.

units.la: קָרָךְ obvenit tibi, præt. Kal, 3. sing. masc. aff. Rad. קָרָה
units.tr: Qarak, it happened to you, Perfect Qal, 3rd masc. singular, with suffix. Root qarah.

units.la: קָרִיתִי excisus sum, præt. Pual, 1. s. f. R. קָרַץ
units.tr: Qaritti, I was cut off, Perfect Pual, 1st singular fem. Root qarats.

units.la: קָרִיעַ solum, No. s. m. quadratum Radicale.
units.tr: Qari'a, floor, masc. singular noun, quadriliteral radical.

units.la: קָרְקָר destruxit, Num. 24. 17. pro קָרְקָר, præt. Piel, 3. s. m. gem. à No. Rad. קָרַר paries.
units.tr: Qarqar, he destroyed, Numbers 24:17, for qarqar, Perfect Piel, 3rd masc. singular, geminate, from the masc. noun. Root qarar, wall.

units.la: קַרְתָּ civitas, No. sing. fæm. Rad. קָרָה evenit.
units.tr: Qarta, city, fem. singular noun. Root qarah, it happened.

units.la: קָרָה׳ fodi, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. קור.
units.tr: Qarah, I was dug, Perfect Qal, 1st fem. Root qur.

units.la: ק ש
units.tr: Q Sh

units.la: קַשׁ stipula, in pausa קַשׁ No. sing. m. Rad. קָשַׁשׁ recollegit.
units.tr: Qash, straw, in pause qash, masc. singular noun. Root qashash, he gathered together.

units.la: קִשְּׁאִים cucumeres, No. pl. m. Rad. inufit. קִשָּׁא vel cum א, pro ה, à Rad. קָשָׁה.
units.tr: Qish'a'im, cucumbers, masc. plural noun. Root unknown; qisha or, with aleph for he, from the root qashah.

units.la: קָשַׁב attentio, קַשְׁבָּה attenta, קַשְׁבוֹת attentæ, No. f. masc. & No. sing. & pl. fæm. Rad. קָשַׁב auscultavit.
units.tr: Qashav, attention, qashvah, attentive, qashvot, attentive, masc. and fem. noun, and fem. singular and plural. Root qashav, he listened.

units.la: קָשֶׁה קָשֵׁה durus, קָשָׁה dura, No. f. m. constr. & f. f. Rad. קָשָׁה durum esse.
units.tr: Qasheh, qaseh, hard, qashah, hard, masc. and fem. adjective, construct and fem. Root qashah, to be hard.

units.la: וַקְּשׁוּ & excutite, Imper. Kal, pl. m. Rad. קָשַׁשׁ.
units.tr: Vaqshu, and shake out, Imperative Qal, masc. plural. Root qashash.

units.la: קְשׁוֹת duræ, pl. fæm. No. f. f. קָשָׁה, Rad. קָשָׁה.
units.tr: Qeshot, hard ones, fem. plural, fem. adjective, from qashah. Root qashah.

units.la: קְשׁוֹת scutellæ, קְשׁוּתָיו ejus, pl. fæm. aff. No. Rad. קָשָׁה scutella.
units.tr: Qeshot, bowls, qeshutayv, his, fem. plural with suffix, noun. Root qashah, bowl.

units.la: קְשׁוֹת scutellæ, No. plur.
units.tr: Qeshot, bowls, plural noun,

units.la: fæm. à No. Rad. קָשָׁה.
units.tr: fem., from the noun. Root qashah.

units.la: קִשְׁטּ, & קִשֵּׁט veritas, No. sing. m. Rad. inufit. קִשְׁטּ.
units.tr: Qisht and qisht, truth, masc. singular noun. Root unknown, qisht.

units.la: קְשִׁי durities, No. f. m. Rad. קָשָׁה durum esse.
units.tr: Qeshi, hardness, fem. masc. noun. Root qashah, to be hard.

units.la: קִשְׁיטָה agnus, No. f. f. Rad. inufit. קִשְׁט.
units.tr: Qishitah, lamb, fem. fem. noun. Root unknown, qisht.

units.la: קִשִּׁים duri, constr. קִשֵּׁי, pl. m. No. f. m. קָשָׁה; Rad. קָשָׁה.
units.tr: Qashim, hard ones, construct qashe, masc. plural, masc. noun; root qashah.

units.la: בִּקְשִׁקְשִׁיךָ squama, in squamis tuis, קִשְׁקְשִׁים squamæ, Nomen quadratum Radicale, f. f. & pl. f. aff. ut & pl. m. vel est No. gem. à Rad. inufit. קִשְּׁשׁ.
units.tr: Biqshiqshekha, scale, in your scales, qashqashim, scales, quadriliteral noun, fem. and fem. plural, with suffix, as also masc. plural; or it is a geminate noun from the root unknown, qashash.

units.la: לִקְשֹׁשׁ ad conquirendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. קַשֵּׁשׁ.
units.tr: Liqshosh, to gather, Infinitive Piel, with prefix, root qashesh.

units.la: קִשְּׁשׁוּ conquirite, Imper. Piel, pl. m. Rad. קָשַׁשׁ.
units.tr: Qishshu, gather, Imperative Piel, masc. plural. Root qashash.

units.la: קַשָּׁת sagittarius, No. sing. m. à No. Rad. f. קַשָּׁת arcus.
units.tr: Qashat, archer, masc. singular noun, from the noun, root fem., qashat, bow.

units.la: קָשְׁתָה duræ est, præf. Kal, 3. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. קְשָׁה קִשְׁתּוֹת arcus, קִשְׁתּוֹתָם eorum, pl. fæm. aff. No. Rad. f. f. קֶשֶׁת קִשְׁתִּי arcus meus, f. f. aff. No. Rad. קֶשֶׁת
units.tr: Qashtah, it is hard, Perfect Qal, 3rd sing. fem. Root qashah; qishtot, bows, qishtotam, their, fem. plural with suffix, noun. Root fem., qeshet; qishti, my bow, fem. with suffix, noun. Root qeshet.

units.la: ר א
units.tr: R A (ר א)

units.la: לִרְא timere, 1. Sam. 18. 29. (pro לִירְא ,) Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. יָרָא. וְהָרְאָה & cornix, No. f. f. Rad. רָאָה vidit. רְאֵה vide, Imper. Kal, f. m. R. רָאָה. רֵאָה, pro רְאוֹ, & רָאוּ, pro רָאָה videre, Infin. Kal, Rad. רָאָה. רֹאָה videns, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. רָאָה. רֹאָה propheta, No. f. m. Rad. רָאָה vidit. רְאוּ videte, רְאֵה vide, Imper. Kal, pl. m. & f. f. Rad. רָאָה. רָאוּ visa sunt, præt. Pual, 3. pl. R. רָאָה. לְרָאוֹת ad aspiciendum, Ezech. 28. 17. (pro לִרְאוֹת, vel, לְרְאוֹת,) Infin. Kal, præf. cum ה parag. Rad. רָאָה. רָאוּךָ viderunt te, רָאוּהָ eam, præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. רָאָה. לְרְאוֹת ad comparendum, Ex. 34. 24. Infin. Niph. præf. (pro לְהֵרָאוֹת,) Rad. רָאָה. רְאוֹת videre, Infin. Kal, Rad. רָאָה. רְאוֹת aspectus, רְאוֹת visiones, בִּרְאוֹת in visionibus, No. f. & pl. f. præf. Rad. רָאָה. רָאִיתָ vidisti, pro רָאֵיתָ [?], præt. Kal, 2. f. m. parag. R. רָאָה. רָאִי visus, מַרְאֵה à visu, רְאִי visus, No. f. m. Rad. רָאָה.
units.tr: לִרְא to fear, 1 Sam. 18. 29 (for לִירְא), infinitive Kal, prefixed, root יָרָא. וְהָרְאָה and the kite, noun feminine, root רָאָה he saw. רְאֵה see, imperative Kal, masculine singular, root רָאָה. רֵאָה (for רְאוֹ, and רָאוּ, for רָאָה) to see, infinitive Kal, root רָאָה. רֹאָה seeing, participle Kal, masculine singular, root רָאָה. רֹאָה prophet, noun masculine singular, root רָאָה he saw. רְאוּ see (plural), רְאֵה see, imperative Kal, masculine and feminine plural and feminine singular, root רָאָה. רָאוּ they were seen, perfect Pual, 3rd person plural, root רָאָה. לְרָאוֹת for looking at, Ezek. 28. 17 (for לִרְאוֹת, or לְרְאוֹת), infinitive Kal, prefixed, with ה paragogic, root רָאָה. רָאוּךָ they saw you, רָאוּהָ they saw her, perfect Kal, 3rd person plural with suffix, root רָאָה. לְרְאוֹת for appearing, Ex. 34. 24, infinitive Niphal, prefixed (for לְהֵרָאוֹת), root רָאָה. רְאוֹת to see, infinitive Kal, root רָאָה. רְאוֹת sight, רְאוֹת visions, בִּרְאוֹת in visions, noun feminine and feminine plural, prefixed, root רָאָה. רָאִיתָ you saw (for רָאֵיתָ [?]), perfect Kal, 2nd person masculine singular, paragogic, root רָאָה. רָאִי seen, מַרְאֵה from sight, רְאִי vision, noun masculine, root רָאָה.

units.la: ראי videntes me, Ben. Kal, ראה, pl. m. aff. Rad. ראה
units.tr: ראי seeing me, participle Kal, root ראה, masculine plural with suffix.

units.la: כראים sicut unicornis, No. f. m. praef. Rad. ראם
units.tr: כראים like the unicorn, noun masculine, prefixed, root ראם.

units.la: הראיתָ an vidisti? praet. Kal, 2. sing. masc. interrog. Rad. ראה
units.tr: הראיתָ did you see? perfect Kal, 2nd person singular masculine, interrogative, root ראה.

units.la: ראמה exaltata est, Zach. 14. 10. praet. Kal, 3. f. f. per epenth. א, pro רמה, à 3. f. m. דם Rad. רום.
units.tr: ראמה she is exalted, Zech. 14. 10, perfect Kal, 3rd person feminine singular, with epenthetic א, for רמה, from the 3rd person masculine דם, root רום.

units.la: ראמות sandastri, coralia, No. pl. f. Rad. ראם vel רום altum esse.
units.tr: ראמות sandastri, coral, noun plural feminine, root ראם or רום to be high.

units.la: ראמות excelsæ, Prov. 24. 7. Ben. Kal, pl. f. pro רמות, à Rad. רום.
units.tr: ראמות high places, Prov. 24. 7, participle Kal, feminine plural, for רמות, from the root רום.

units.la: ראש pauper, Prov. 10 14. ראשים pauperes, Prov. 13. 23. pro רש, רשים No. f. & pl. m. Rad. רוש pauperari.
units.tr: ראש poor, Prov. 10. 14; ראשים poor, Prov. 13. 23 (for רש, רשים), noun masculine and masculine plural, root רוש to be impoverished.

units.la: ראשה paupertas, ראשך tua, pro רישך No. f. m. aff. Rad. רוש.
units.tr: ראשה poverty, ראשך your, for רישך, noun feminine and masculine with suffix, root רוש.

units.la: ראש summitas ejus, ראשים summitates, ראשיכם vestræ, f. & pl. m. aff. No. Rad. ראש caput.
units.tr: ראש its summit, ראשים summits, ראשיכם your, masculine and plural with suffix, noun, root ראש head.

units.la: ראשון primus, ראשונה prima, כראשונים sicut primi, No. f. m. & f. & pl. m. præf. à No. Rad. ראש.
units.tr: ראשון first, ראשונה first (feminine), כראשונים like the first, noun masculine, feminine and masculine plural, prefixed, from the noun, root ראש.

units.la: למך ראשונה inde à principio, pro למך, No. f. f. præf. Rad. ראש.
units.tr: למך ראשונה from the beginning, (for למך), noun feminine, prefixed, root ראש.

units.la: בראשית in principio, מראשית à, No. f. fæm. præf. à No. Rad. ראש.
units.tr: בראשית in the beginning, מראשית from the beginning, noun feminine, prefixed, from the noun, root ראש.

units.la: מראשיתיכם præ primordiis vestris, No. pl. f. præf. & aff. à No. Rad. ראש.
units.tr: מראשיתיכם from your first things, noun plural feminine, prefixed and with suffix, from the noun, root ראש.

units.la: ראתה vidit illa, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. ראה
units.tr: ראתה she saw, perfect Kal, 3rd person feminine singular, root ראה.

units.la: ר ב
units.tr: R B (ר ב)

units.la: רב litigavit, הרב an litigare, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & Infin. præf. Rad. רוב.
units.tr: רב he contended, הרב whether to contend, perfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, and infinitive, prefixed, root רוב.

units.la: jaculatus est, רָבָה mul-tæ est, רָבוּ, הָבוּ multi-plicant, הִבּוּ jaculati sunt, לִרְבַּב multiplica-ri, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. & f. & 3. pl. ut & Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. רָבַב.
units.tr: he threw, רָבָה she is many, רָבוּ, הָבוּ they multiply, הִבּוּ they threw, לִרְבַּב to be multiplied, perfect Kal, 3rd person feminine and masculine, and 3rd person plural, as well as infinitive Kal, prefixed, root רָבַב.

units.la: בַּב, vel הַב multus, רַבִּים multi, רַבָּיו ejus, רַבָּה multa, רַבּוֹת multæ, No. f. m. & pl. m. aff. & f. & pl. f. Rad. רָבַב.
units.tr: בַּב, or הַב many, רַבִּים many, רַבָּיו his, רַבָּה many, רַבּוֹת many, noun masculine and masculine plural with suffix, and feminine and feminine plural, root רָבַב.

units.la: מֵרֹב à multitudine, כְּרֹב secundùm, & רַב do, רִבּוֹ ejus, מֵרִבְּכֶם propter multitudinem vestram, No. f. m. præf. & aff. Rad. רָבַב multum esse.
units.tr: מֵרֹב from the multitude, כְּרֹב according to, & רַב do, רִבּוֹ his, מֵרִבְּכֶם because of your multitude, noun masculine, prefixed and with suffix, root רָבַב to be many.

units.la: רִבְכוֹת myriades, מֵרִבְּכוֹת à myriadibus, pl. f. præf. constr. No. רְבָבָה; Rad. רָבַב.
units.tr: רִבְכוֹת myriads, מֵרִבְּכוֹת from myriads, feminine plural, prefixed, construct, noun רְבָבָה; root רָבַב.

units.la: רֶכֶב torques, f. m. constr. def. No. רִכְבִּי ; Rad. רָכַד adornavit, unde
units.tr: רֶכֶב chain, masculine noun, construct, defective, noun רִכְבִּי; root רָכַד he adorned, whence

units.la: 1. f. præt. Kal, רְבַבְתִּי a-dornavi.
units.tr: first person feminine perfect Kal, רְבַבְתִּי I adorned.

units.la: רָבָה multiplica, Jud. 9. 29. pro הָרְבָה, Imper. Piel, f. m. Rad. רָבָה.
units.tr: רָבָה multiply, Judg. 9. 29 (for הָרְבָה), imperative Piel, masculine singular, root רָבָה.

units.la: רָבָה jaculans, רָבוּ multi-plicati sunt, רָבָה multiplicare, Ben. Kal, f. m. & præt. Kal, 3. pl. ut & Imper. f. m. Rad. רָבָה.
units.tr: רָבָה throwing, רָבוּ they were multiplied, רָבָה to multiply, participle Kal, masculine singular, and perfect Kal, 3rd person plural, as well as imperative feminine singular, root רָבָה.

units.la: רָבוּ litigarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. רוּב, vel רִיב.
units.tr: רָבוּ they contended, perfect Kal, 3rd person plural, root רוּב, or רִיב.

units.la: רָבוּ, רִבּוֹא myrias, רְבָּאוֹת myriades, רִבּוֹתַיִם duæ, No. f. & pl. fæm. & du-al. Rad. רָבַב multum esse.
units.tr: רָבוּ, רִבּוֹא myriad, רְבָּאוֹת myriads, רִבּוֹתַיִם two, noun feminine, feminine plural and dual, root רָבַב to be many.

units.la: כִּרְבוֹת in multiplicando, Infin. Kal, præf. R. רָבָה.
units.tr: כִּרְבוֹת in multiplying, infinitive Kal, prefixed, root רָבָה.

units.la: כְּרִבִּיבִים sicut imbres, No. pl. masc. præf. Rad. רָבַב.
units.tr: כְּרִבִּיבִים like showers, noun masculine plural, prefixed, root רָבַב.

units.la: רְבִיתָ multiplicaris, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. רָבָה.
units.tr: רְבִיתָ you are multiplied, perfect Kal, 2nd person feminine singular, root רָבָה.

units.la: רִבִּיתָ multiplicasti, רִבִּיתִי avi, vi, præt. Piel, 2. f. m. & 1. f à 3. f. m. רִכָּה Rad. פִּכָּה
units.tr: רִבִּיתָ you multiplied, רִבִּיתִי I multiplied, perfect Piel, 2nd person masculine and 1st person singular, from 3rd person masculine רִכָּה, root פִּכָּה.

units.la: לְיִכְבָּהּ ut ineat eam, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. [?]
units.tr: לְיִכְבָּהּ that he may lie with her, infinitive Kal, prefixed with suffix, root [?].

units.la: יִרְבַּע accubitus meus, No. f. m. רָבַע, aff. Rad. רָבַע quadratum esse.
units.tr: יִרְבַּע my bed, noun masculine, רָבַע with suffix, root רָבַע to be square.

units.la: רִבְצָת incubans, Part. Ben. Kal, sing. fæm. Rad. רָבַץ
units.tr: רִבְצָת lying down, participle Kal, feminine singular, root רָבַץ.

units.la: רַבַּת multum, רַבָּתִי multa, Thr. 1. 1. f. f. constr. parag. No. רַבָּה, Rad. רָבַב multum esse.
units.tr: רַבַּת much, רַבָּתִי many, Lam. 1. 1, feminine, construct, paragogic, noun רַבָּה, root רָבַב to be much.

units.la: רַבְּתָּ litigasti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. רוּב.
units.tr: רַבְּתָּ you contended, perfect Kal, 2nd person feminine singular, root רוּב.

units.la: רִבְּתָה educavit, præt. Piel, 3. f. f. à 3. f. m. רִבָּה Rad. דָּבָה
units.tr: רִבְּתָה she brought up, perfect Piel, 3rd person feminine singular, from 3rd person masculine רִבָּה, root דָּבָה.

units.la: ר ד
units.tr: R D (ר ד)

units.la: רָד dominatus est, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. R. רוּד.
units.tr: רָד he ruled, perfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, root רוּד.

units.la: יָרַד descendit, Jud. 19. 11. præt. Kal, 3. f. m. def. pro Rad. יָרַד
units.tr: יָרַד he went down, Judg. 19. 11, perfect Kal, 3rd person masculine singular, defective, for root יָרַד.

units.la: לְרָד ad sternendum, Jes. 45. 1. pro רָדַד, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. רָדַד expandit.
units.tr: לְרָד to subdue, Isa. 45. 1 (for רָדַד), infinitive Kal, prefixed, root רָדַד to spread out.

units.la: יְרֵד, רָדָה, vel רֵדִי, descende, רִדוּ descendite, Imper. Kal, f. m. parag. ut & f. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָרַד
units.tr: יְרֵד, רָדָה, or רֵדִי, go down, רִדוּ go down (plural), imperative Kal, masculine singular with paragogic, and feminine singular and masculine plural, root יָרַד.

units.la: מְרָדָה à descendendo, Gen. 46. 3. pro רְדָת, Infin. Kal, R. יָרַד.
units.tr: מְרָדָה from going down, Gen. 46. 3 (for רְדָת), infinitive Kal, root יָרַד.

units.la: רְדוֹת dominari, Infin. Kal, Rad. רָדָה.
units.tr: רְדוֹת to rule, infinitive Kal, root רָדָה.

units.la: רְדִיד carbasus meus, וְהָרְדִידִים & hæc carbasa, No. sing. m. רְדִיד aff. & pl. m. præf. Rad. רָדַד extendit.
units.tr: רְדִיד my veil, וְהָרְדִידִים and these veils, noun masculine singular with suffix, and masculine plural prefixed, root רָדַד to spread out.

units.la: רָדָם dominator eorum, Ben. Kal, f. m. רָדָה, aff. Rad. רָדָה dominari.
units.tr: רָדָם their ruler, participle Kal, masculine singular, רָדָה with suffix, root רָדָה to rule.

units.la: רְדֵנוּ dominati sumus, præt. Kal, 1. pl. R. רוּד.
units.tr: רְדֵנוּ we have ruled, perfect Kal, 1st person plural, root רוּד.

units.la: רָדַף persecutionem passus est, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. R. רָדַף.
units.tr: רָדַף he suffered persecution, perfect Pual, 3rd person masculine singular, root רָדַף.

units.la: יָרַד descendere, בְּיִרְדָּתוֹ [?] in descendendo, Infin Kal, præf. & aff. Rad. יָרַד.
units.tr: יָרַד to go down, בְּיִרְדָּתוֹ [?] in going down, infinitive Kal, prefixed and with suffix, root יָרַד.

units.la: ד ו
units.tr: ד ו

units.la: רוֹאֶה videns, pro, רֹאֶה & רוֹאֵנִי me, pro רוֹאֵנִי; Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. רָאָה.
units.tr: רוֹאֶה seeing, for רֹאֶה, and רוֹאֵנִי me, for רוֹאֵנִי; participle, Ben (Kal), feminine masculine, suffix form. Root רָאָה.

units.la: רוֹב litigans, litigare, pro רָב, Part Ben. Kal, f m. & pro רוּב, Infin. Kal, R. רוּב.
units.tr: רוֹב contending, to contend, for רָב, participle, Ben (Kal), feminine masculine; and for רוּב, infinitive Kal. Root רוּב.

units.la: רוֹבוּ jaculati sunt, pro רָבוּ, præt. Kal, 3. plur. Rad. רָבַב.
units.tr: רוֹבוּ they shot (arrows), for רָבוּ, perfect Kal, 3rd person plural. Root רָבַב.

units.la: רָוָה irriguus, רָוָה irrigua, No. f. masc. & fæm. Rad. רָוָה inebriari.
units.tr: רָוָה watered, רָוָה watered (feminine), noun, masculine and feminine. Root רָוָה to be made drunk.

units.la: רְוֵה irriga, Imper. Piel, f. m. R. רָוָה.
units.tr: רְוֵה water (her), imperative Piel, feminine masculine. Root רָוָה.

units.la: רְדוּנִים & dominatores, No. pl. m. Rad. רָדַן.
units.tr: רְדוּנִים and rulers, noun, masculine plural. Root רָדַן.

units.la: רוּחָה, רוּחָה respiratio, לְרוּחָתִי ad respirationem meam, No. f. m. & No. sing. fæm. præf. & aff. Rad. רָוַח respira...xit.[?]
units.tr: רוּחָה, רוּחָה respite, לְרוּחָתִי for my respite, noun, feminine masculine, and noun singular feminine, prefix and suffix. Root רָוַח to take breath.

units.la: רוּחַ spiritus meus, רוּחוֹת spiritus, No. רוּחַ, aff. & pl. f. Rad. רָוַח respi-ravit.
units.tr: רוּחַ my spirit, רוּחוֹת spirits, noun, רוּחַ with suffix, and plural feminine. Root רָוַח to take breath.

units.la: לְרַוָּיָה in irriguam, No. f. f. præf. Rad. רָוָה irrigare se.
units.tr: לְרַוָּיָה into a well-watered (place), noun, feminine feminine, prefix. Root רָוָה to water oneself.

units.la: רָוִיתִי inebriavi, præt. Piel, 1. f. Rad. רָוָה, in Piel, רְוֵה.
units.tr: רָוִיתִי I have made drunk, perfect Piel, 1st person feminine. Root רָוָה; in Piel, רְוֵה.

units.la: רוֹם exaltare, exalta, exaltatio, רוֹמָה, כְּרִם Infin. Kal, præf. & Imper. f. m. parag. vel No. f. m & f. Rad. רוֹם.
units.tr: רוֹם to exalt, exalt, exaltation, רוֹמָה, כְּרִם infinitive Kal, prefix, and imperative feminine masculine, with paragogic or noun masculine and feminine. Root רוֹם.

units.la: רוֹמָה jaculans, רוֹמֵי tes, Ben. Kal, f m. & pl. m. constr. Rad. רָמָה.
units.tr: רוֹמָה hurling, רוֹמֵי (those) who hurl, participle Kal, feminine masculine, and plural masculine construct. Root רָמָה.

units.la: רוּמוּ attollunt se, Job. 24. 24. pro רָמוּ, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. רָמַם.
units.tr: רוּמוּ they lift themselves up, Job 24:24, for רָמוּ, perfect Kal, 3rd person plural. Root רָמַם.

units.la: רוֹמֵם attollere ipsos, Ezech. 10. 17. pro רוֹמְמָם, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. רוֹם.
units.tr: רוֹמֵם to lift them up, Ezek. 10:17, for רוֹמְמָם, infinitive Kal, suffix. Root רוֹם.

units.la: וְרוֹמַם & elatus fuit, præt. Pual, 3. sing. m. Rad. רוֹם. רוּמְמוּ extulerunt, רוּמְמָתִי [?] extuli, præt. Piel, 3. pl. & 1. f. Rad. רוּם. רוּעַ malitia, No. f. m. Rad. רוּעַ malum esse. רוּעָה confringere, Jef. 24. 19. parag. pro רוּעַ, Infin. Kal, Rad. רָעַע. רוֹעִי pastor meus, pastor, Jef. 38. 12. Ben. Kal, f. m. aff. vel, pro רוֹעָה, Ben. Kal, Jod. parag. Rad. רָעָה. לְרוּץ ad currendum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. רוּץ. רֻצָה benevolus, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. רָצָה. רוֹשׁ venenum, Deut. 32. 32. No. f. m. Rad. רוֹשׁ, vel, רֹאשׁ.
units.tr: וְרוֹמַם and was exalted, perfect Pual, 3rd person singular masculine. Root רוֹם. רוּמְמוּ they exalted, רוּמְמָתִי [?] I exalted, perfect Piel, 3rd person plural and 1st person feminine. Root רוּם. רוּעַ evil, noun feminine masculine. Root רוּעַ to be evil. רוּעָה to break in pieces, Isa. 24:19, paragogic for רוּעַ, infinitive Kal. Root רָעַע. רוֹעִי my shepherd, shepherd, Isa. 38:12, participle Kal, feminine masculine with suffix, or for רוֹעָה, participle Kal with paragogic yod. Root רָעָה. לְרוּץ to run, infinitive Kal, prefix. Root רוּץ. רֻצָה well-pleased, participle Kal, feminine masculine. Root רָצָה. רוֹשׁ poison, Deut. 32:32, noun feminine masculine. Root רוֹשׁ, or רֹאשׁ.

units.la: ר ז רָזוֹן macies, No. f. m. Rad. רָזָה emaciavit. רָזִי macies, No. f. m. Rad. רָזָה. רוֹזְנִים dominatores, No. pl. im. Rad. רָזַן [?] רַחוּם misericors, No. f. m. Rad. רָחַם dilexit.

units.la: ר ח רְחוּקָה longinquus, qua, רְחוּקִים qui, No. f. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad. רָחַק longinquum esse. רַחַיִם molæ, No. du. m. Rad. רִיחַ olfecit. רְחָמָה consecuta est miseri-cordiam, præt. Pual, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. רָחַם. רָחַץ lotus est, רָחַצְתָּ lota-es, præt. Pual, 3. f. m. & 2. f. f. Rad. רָחַץ. רְחַק procul esto, Imper. Kal, f. f. R. רָחַק.
units.tr: ר ח רְחוּקָה distant, which, רְחוּקִים those who, noun feminine masculine, feminine and plural masculine. Root רָחַק to be far off. רַחַיִם millstones, noun dual masculine. Root רִיחַ he smelled. רְחָמָה she obtained mercy, perfect Pual, 3rd person singular feminine. Root רָחַם. רָחַץ he was washed, רָחַצְתָּ you were washed, perfect Pual, 3rd person feminine masculine and 2nd person feminine. Root רָחַץ. רְחַק be far off!, imperative Kal, feminine. Root רָחַק.

units.la: ר ט רָטְשׁוּ collisi sunt, præt. Pual, 3. pl. R. רָטַשׁ.
units.tr: ר ט רָטְשׁוּ they were dashed together, perfect Pual, 3rd person plural. Root רָטַשׁ.

units.la: ר י בְּרִי pro irrigatione, No. f. m. præf. Rad. רָוָה irrigare se, vel בְּרִי serenitas, potest esse No. sing. m. R. בָּרָה comedit.
units.tr: ר י בְּרִי for watering, noun feminine masculine, prefix. Root רָוָה to water oneself, or בְּרִי serenity, may be a noun singular masculine. Root בָּרָה he ate.

units.la: ריב contentio, ריבי mea, ריבות à litibus, מדיבי lites, No. f. m. affi & pl. m. præf. ut & No. pl. f. Rad. רוב, vel ריב contendit.
units.tr: ריב contention, ריבי my contention, ריבות from quarrels, מדיבי quarrels, noun feminine masculine with suffix and plural masculine with prefix, as also noun plural feminine. Root רוב, or ריב he contended.

units.la: ריב, & ריבה, pro הריב contende, Imper. Hiph. f. m. Rad. רוב.
units.tr: ריב, and ריבה, for הריב contend!, imperative Hiphil feminine masculine. Root רוב.

units.la: ריב ad litigandum, ריבה litiga, ריבו litigate, pro הריבו, הריבה, לריב Infin. Hiph. præf & Imper. Hiph. sing. m. parag. & pl. m. Rad. רוב.
units.tr: ריב to contend, ריבה contend!, ריבו contend!, for הריבו, הריבה, לריב, infinitive Hiphil with prefix, and imperative Hiphil singular masculine with paragogic and plural masculine. Root רוב.

units.la: ריבותָּ litigasti, Job. 33.13. pro הריבותָּ, præt. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. רוב.
units.tr: ריבותָּ you contended, Job 33:13, for הריבותָּ, perfect Hiphil, 2nd person feminine masculine. Root רוב.

units.la: ריח odor, ריחו ejus, ריחנו noster, No. f. m. aff. Rad. ריח odoratus est.
units.tr: ריח odor, ריחו its odor, ריחנו our odor, noun feminine masculine with suffix. Root ריח he smelled.

units.la: רים monocerós, Job. 39. 12. contracte pro No. ראם Rad. [?]
units.tr: רים unicorn, Job 39:12, contracted for noun ראם. Root [?]

units.la: ריעכם amicus vester, Job. 6.27, No. f. m. aff. Rad. [?]
units.tr: ריעכם your friend, Job 6:27, noun feminine masculine with suffix. Root [?]

units.la: רעה pascere.
units.tr: רעה to pasture.

units.la: moles, Nor. pl f. Rad. רוף concutere.
units.tr: mole, noun plural feminine. Root רוף to shake.

units.la: ריק, & ריקם vacuus, ריקם vacui, ריקם inaniter, ריקה vacua, No. f. & pl. m. ut & Part. Adv. & No. f. f. Rad. ריק evacuavit.
units.tr: ריק, and ריקם empty, ריקם of the empty, ריקם in vain, ריקה empty, noun feminine and plural masculine, as also participle adverb and noun feminine feminine. Root ריק he emptied.

units.la: ריד in albumine, ריד saliva ejus, No. f. m. præf. & aff. Rad. ריד salivavit.
units.tr: ריד in the white of an egg, ריד his saliva, noun feminine masculine, prefix and suffix. Root ריד he spat.

units.la: ריש, & ריש paupertas, ריש ejus, ם eorum, No. f. m. aff. Rad. רוש pauperari.
units.tr: ריש, and ריש poverty, ריש his, ם their, noun feminine masculine with suffix. Root רוש to be poor.

units.la: ראשון prior, Job. 8.8. pro ראשון, No. sing. m. Rad. ראש caput.
units.tr: ראשון first, Job 8:8, for ראשון, noun singular masculine. Root ראש head.

units.tr: ו כ

units.tr: ך he was softened, דכו they were ...ti, perfect Kal, 3rd person feminine masculine and 3rd person plural. Root רך.

units.tr: רך tender, רכה tender (feminine), רכים tender, רכות soft, noun feminine and plural masculine and feminine. Root f. Root רָכַּךְ to be softened. & from softness, noun feminine masculine. Root רָכַּךְ.

units.tr: רֻכְּכָה she was softened, perfect Pual, 3rd person feminine feminine. Root רָכַּךְ, Pual, רֻכַּךְ.

units.tr: R M

units.tr: Ra, "shouting"; noun, feminine and masculine; root רִיעַ, "to shout aloud". Haera, "friend"; noun, feminine and masculine, with prefix; root רָעָה, "to pasture". Ra, "wickedness"; noun, feminine and masculine; root רָעַע, "to be evil". Raah, "was evil"; preterite, Kal, 3rd person feminine singular; root רעע. Reah, "friend"; construct רֵעַה, "toward his friend"; noun, singular masculine; root רָעָה, "to pasture". Ureeh, "and pasture!"; imperative, Kal, masculine singular; root רָעָה. Roah, "broken", Proverbs 25:19; noun, singular feminine; root רָעַע, "he broke". Reu, "break!"; imperative, Kal, masculine plural; root רָעַע. Veraeu, "and they shall pasture"; preterite, Kal, 3rd person plural; root רָעָה. Lirot, "to pasture"; infinitive, Kal, with prefix; root רָעָה. Reutah, "her neighbour"; noun, feminine singular with suffix; root רָעָה, "to pasture". Reotai, "my female friends"; plural feminine with suffix; noun רֵעָה; root רָעָה. Birreotem, "in their evils"; plural feminine, with prefix and suffix; noun רָעָה; root רַע. Lereei, "to my friend"; reacha, "your friend"; noun, masculine; רֵעַ, with prefix and suffix; root רָעָה, "to pasture". Reei, and Roei, "pasture"; noun, masculine; root רָעָה.

units.la: שְׂדֵה agri, (pro שְׂדִים agertuas, שְׂדָיו ejus, שְׂדְךָ agri, שְׂדְךָ tui, f.&pl. m. aff. No. Rad. שָׂדָה.
units.tr: Field of (שְׂדֵה), of the field (for שְׂדִים, fields), שְׂדָיו, his, שְׂדְךָ, field, שְׂדְךָ, your, fem. and masc. pl., with suffix, noun. Root שָׂדָה.

units.la: שֵׁדִי omnipotens, No. sing. m. Rad. שָׁדַד vastavit, vel No. Rad. דֵּי sufficientia, & שׁ qui, præf. vel à No. Rad. שַׁד mamma.
units.tr: Almighty (שֵׁדִי), noun, masc. sing. Root שָׁדַד, he laid waste, or noun, root דֵּי, sufficiency, and שׁ, who, with prefix, or from the noun, root שַׁד, breast.

units.la: שַׁדַּי, שָׁדֵי mammæ, שָׁדַי mee, dual. constr. & aff. No. Rad. שַׁד.
units.tr: Breasts (שַׁדַּי, שָׁדֵי), my breast (שָׁדַי), dual, construct and with suffix, noun. Root שַׁד.

units.la: וְיַשְּׁדֵם & perdet eos, Prov. 11, 3. pro יְשַׁדֵּם, fut. Kal, 3. f m. aff. Rad. שָׁדַד; vel est præt. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. שָׁדַד. הַשְּׁרֵדוֹת ordines, 1 Reg. 11. 8. pro סְרֻדוֹת, No. pl. f. Rad. סדר ordo. שָׂרָתָּ linivisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. שור.
units.tr: And he will destroy them (וְיַשְּׁדֵם), Prov. 11. 3. for יְשַׁדֵּם, future Kal, 3rd person fem. or masc., with suffix. Root שָׁדַד; or it is a perfect Kal, 3rd person fem. or masc., with prefix and suffix. Root שָׁדַד. Orders (הַשְּׁרֵדוֹת), 1 Kings 11. 8. for סְרֻדוֹת, noun, fem. pl. Root סדר, order. You anointed (שָׂרָתָּ), perfect Kal, 2nd person fem. or masc. Root שור.

units.la: ש ה שֵׁה pecus, f. m. constr. No. Rad. שה. שַׁהַדְּתָא testimonium, sing. fæm. forma Chald. à No. Rad. שָׁהֵד testis. שָׁהֲדִי, vel שָׁהָדִי, vel שַׁהֲדִי, & testificator meus, f. m. aff. No. Rad. שָׁהֵד, vel שָׁהַד, vel שָׁהַד. [?] שָׁהְיָה quod fuit, est præf. שׁ cum Rad. הָיָה. שֶׁהִכָּה quod percussit, est præt.Hiph. 3. f. m. cum שׁ præf. Rad. נָכָה. שַׁחֲרֹנִים lunulæ, Jud. 8. 16. pro סַהֲרֹנִים, No. pl. m. à No. Rad. סַהַר rotunditas.
units.tr: Sheep (שֵׁה), cattle, masc., construct, noun. Root שה. Testimony (שַׁהַדְּתָא), noun, sing. fem., in the Chaldee form, from the noun. Root שָׁהֵד, witness. My witness and my testifier (שָׁהֲדִי, or שָׁהָדִי, or שַׁהֲדִי), masc., with suffix, noun. Root שָׁהֵד, or שָׁהַד, or שָׁהַד. [?] That which was (שָׁהְיָה), is with prefix ש and root הָיָה. That which smote (שֶׁהִכָּה), is perfect Hiph., 3rd person masc., with prefix ש. Root נָכָה. Lunulae, little moons (שַׁחֲרֹנִים), Judg. 8. 16. for סַהֲרֹנִים, noun, masc. pl., from the noun סַהַר, roundness.

units.la: ש ו בְּשָׁוְא in vanitate, Job. 15. 31. (pro לְשָׁוְא, בְּשָׁוְא) in vanum, præf. cum No. Rad. שָׁוְא. שָׁוֹא ferre, pro נָשָׂא, Infin. Kal, Rad. נָשָׂא. שׁוֹאָה vastatio, No. sing. fæm. Rad. שָׁאָה vastari. לְשׁוֹב ad reducendum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. שוב. שׁוּבָה aversa est, שׁוּב a-versus, שׁוּבִים aversi, præt. Pual, 3. f. f. & Part. Pual, f. & pl. m. Rad. שׁוּב, Piel, שׁוֹבֵב. Pual, שׁוּבָב. שׁוּבְתִּי reverti feci, præt. Piel, 1. f. R. שׁוב. שׁוּבָה revertere, שׁוּבוּ revertimini, שׁוּבִי revertere, f. שׁוּבְנָה revertimini, f. Imper. Kal, f. m. parag. pl. m. & f. & pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב. שׁוּבִיהֶם captivos abducentes eos, שׁוּבֵינוּ nos, Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. Rad. שָׁבָה. שׁוּבִינוּ converte nos , Ps. 85. 5. pro שׁוּבֵנוּ , Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּב . שׁוּבָנָה revertimini , pro שׁוּבָנָה , Imper. Kal, pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב . שׁוֹגִים errantes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. à f. שׁוֹגָה , Rad. שָׁגָה . שָׁוָה utilis, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. שָׁוָה æquari. לְשׁוֹחַ ad meditandum , Infin. Kal, præf. R. שׁוּחַ . שׁוּחָה fovea , No. sing. fæm. Rad. שׁוּחַ inclinari. מִשּׁוּט à peragrando, pro מִשּׁוּט ; Inf. Kal, præf. R. שׁוּט . שׁוּטְטוּ percurrerunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. R. שׁוּט . בְּשׁוּטִים scuticis, pl. m. præf. No. שׁוֹט ; Rad. שׁוּט itare. שׁוִּתִּי proponebam, præt. Piel, 1. f. R. שׁוָּה . שׂוּכָה ramus suus , pro שׂוּכוֹ, No. f. m. שׂוּךְ, aff. vel pro שׂוּכָתוֹ, שׂוּכָה, aff. Rad. שׂוּךְ sepivit. שׂוֹכְנִי habitans, Deut. 33. 16. pro שׁוֹכֵן, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. parag. Rad. שָׁכַן . שׂוּכָה ramus, f. fæm. constr. No. שׂוּכָה ; Rad. שׂוּךְ, vel שׂוּךְ sepivit. שׂוּלֵי fimbriæ, ejus, שׁוּלֵךְ tuæ, pl. m. constr. aff. No. Rad. שׁוּל . שִׂים ponere , pro שִׂים , בְּשׂוּמוֹ in ponere eum, מִשּׂוּמִי à ponere me, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. שׂוּם . שׂוּמָה positio, 2. Sam.13. 32. No. sing. fæm. Rad. שׂוּם ponere. הַשּׂוּמִים allia, pl. m. præf. No. Rad. שׂוּם . שׂוֹסְתָּה conculcantes nos , Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. Rad. שׂוֹסָה[?] שֵׁיעַ clamor meus, No. f. m. שִׁיעַ, aff. R. שָׁעַע vociferari.
units.tr: In vanity (בְּשָׁוְא), Job. 15. 31. (for לְשָׁוְא, בְּשָׁוְא), in vain, with prefix, from the noun, root שָׁוְא. To bear (שָׁוֹא), for נָשָׂא, infinitive Kal, root נָשָׂא. Devastation (שׁוֹאָה), noun, sing. fem., root שָׁאָה, to be laid waste. To bring back (לְשׁוֹב), for reducing, infinitive Piel, with prefix, root שוב. She was turned aside (שׁוּבָה), turned away (שׁוּב), turned aside, pl. (שׁוּבִים), perfect Pual, 3rd person fem., and participle Pual, fem. and masc. pl. Root שׁוּב; Piel, שׁוֹבֵב; Pual, שׁוּבָב. I caused to return (שׁוּבְתִּי), perfect Piel, 1st person sing., root שׁוב. Return (שׁוּבָה), turn back (שׁוּבוּ), return (שׁוּבִי), fem., turn back (שׁוּבְנָה), imperative Kal, fem. and masc., with paragogic, masc. and fem. pl. and fem. pl. Root שׁוּב. Leading them away captive (שׁוּבִיהֶם), us (שׁוּבֵינוּ), participle Kal, masc. pl., with suffix. Root שָׁבָה. Convert us (שׁוּבִינוּ), Ps. 85. 5. for שׁוּבֵנוּ, imperative Kal, fem. and masc., with suffix. Root שׁוּב. Turn back (שׁוּבָנָה), for שׁוּבָנָה, imperative Kal, fem. pl. Root שׁוּב. Erring (שׁוֹגִים), participle Kal, masc. pl., from the fem. שׁוֹגָה. Root שָׁגָה. Useful (שָׁוָה), participle Kal, fem. and masc. Root שָׁוָה, to be equal. To meditate (לְשׁוֹחַ), infinitive Kal, with prefix, root שׁוּחַ. A pit (שׁוּחָה), noun, sing. fem., root שׁוּחַ, to be bowed down. From walking about (מִשּׁוּט), for מִשּׁוּט, infinitive Kal, with prefix, root שׁוּט. They ran about (שׁוּטְטוּ), perfect Piel, 3rd pl., root שׁוּט. With whips (בְּשׁוּטִים), masc. pl., with prefix, noun, from שׁוֹט; root שׁוּט, to ride. I was setting forth (שׁוִּתִּי), perfect Piel, 1st person fem., root שָׁוָּה. Its branch (שׂוּכָה), for שׂוּכוֹ, noun, fem., from שׂוּךְ, with suffix; or for שׂוּכָתוֹ, שׂוּכָה, with suffix. Root שׂוּךְ, to hedge round. Dwelling (שׂוֹכְנִי), Deut. 33. 16. for שׁוֹכֵן, participle Kal, masc., with paragogic. Root שָׁכַן. Branch (שׂוּכָה), noun, fem., construct, from שׂוּכָה; root שׂוּךְ, or שׂוּךְ, hedged round. The fringes (שׁוּלֵי), its, your fringe (שׁוּלֵךְ), masc. pl., construct, with suffix, noun. Root שׁוּל. To place (שִׂים), to set, for שִׂים; in placing him (בְּשׂוּמוֹ), from placing me (מִשּׂוּמִי), infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root שׂוּם. A setting (שׂוּמָה), 2 Sam. 13. 32., noun, sing. fem., root שׂוּם, to place. The garlics (הַשּׂוּמִים), masc. pl., with prefix, noun, from שׂוּם. Trampling upon us (שׂוֹסְתָּה), participle Kal, masc. pl., with suffix. Root שׂוֹסָה[?]. My cry (שֵׁיעַ), noun, masc., with suffix, from שִׁיעַ, root שָׁעַע, to cry out.

units.la: שׁוְעָה clamor, שַׁוְעָתָם eorum, f. f. constr. aff. No. שַׁוְעָה ; Rad. שׁוַע [?]
units.tr: Cry (שׁוְעָה), their cry (שַׁוְעָתָם), fem., construct, with suffix, noun, from שַׁוְעָה. Root שׁוַע [?]

units.la: שׁוֹק crura, יו ejus, ים [?] duo crura, pl. m. constr. aff. & dual. Rad. שׁוק appetivit.
units.tr: Legs (שׁוֹק), his (יו), two legs (ים [?]), masc. pl., construct, with suffix and dual. Root שׁוק, to desire.

units.la: בְּ שׁוֹקִים per plateas, pl. m. præf. No. שׁוק ; Rad. שׁוק appetivit.
units.tr: Through the streets (בְּ שׁוֹקִים), masc. pl., with prefix, noun, from שׁוק. Root שׁוק, to desire.

units.la: שׁוּר contemplare, Imper. Kal, f. m. Rad. שׁוּר.
units.tr: Look upon (שׁוּר), imperative Kal, masc. sing. Root שׁוּר.

units.la: שׁוּרָה principale, No. sing. fæm. Rad. שׁוּר principatum tenuit.
units.tr: Principal (שׁוּרָה), noun, sing. fem. Root שׁוּר, to hold the chief place.

units.la: שׁוּרוֹתָם muri eorum, Job. 24.11. pl. fæm. aff. No. שׁוּר ; Rad. שׁוּר cantavit.
units.tr: Their walls (שׁוּרוֹתָם), Job 24. 11., fem. pl., with suffix, noun, from שׁוּר. Root שׁוּר, to sing.

units.la: בְּ שׁוֹרַי in inimicis meis, No. pl. m. שׁוֹרִים, præf. aff. Rad. שׁוּר.
units.tr: Among my enemies (בְּ שׁוֹרַי), masc. pl. noun, from שׁוֹרִים, with prefix and suffix. Root שׁוּר.

units.la: בְּ שׁוּרִי in decedendo me, (בְּכוּר ,) Inf. kal. præf. aff. Rad. שׁוּר.
units.tr: In my departing (בְּ שׁוּרִי), (בְּכוּר), infinitive Kal, with prefix and suffix. Root שׁוּר.

units.la: שׁוֹרִים boves, pl. m. No. שׁוֹר ; R. שׁוּר cecinit.
units.tr: Oxen (שׁוֹרִים), masc. pl., noun, from שׁוֹר; root שׁוּר, to sing.

units.la: שׁוּרַי inimici mei, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּר ; Piel, שׁוּר.
units.tr: My enemies (שׁוּרַי), masc. pl., noun, with suffix. Root שׁוּר; Piel, שׁוּר.

units.la: שׁוּרָשׁ radices egit, שׁוּרְשׁוּ egerunt, pro שָׁרַשׁ, שָׁרְשׁוּ, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. שָׁרַשׁ.
units.tr: Has taken root (שׁוּרָשׁ), they have taken root (שׁוּרְשׁוּ), for שָׁרַשׁ, שָׁרְשׁוּ, perfect Piel, 3rd person fem. and masc., and 3rd pl. Root שָׁרַשׁ.

units.la: לְשׂוּשׁ ad lætandum, Infin. Kal; præf. R. שׂוּשׁ.
units.tr: To rejoice (לְשׂוּשׁ), infinitive Kal, with prefix, root שׂוּשׁ.

units.la: שׁוּשָׁתִּי depræcatus sum, Jes. 10.13. pro, שׁוּמְתִּי ; præt. Piel, 1. f. Rad. שָׁמַה [?]
units.tr: I besought (שׁוּשָׁתִּי), Isa. 10. 13. for שׁוּמְתִּי; perfect Piel, 1st person fem. Root שָׁמַה [?]

units.la: שׁוּשַׁן lilium, שׁוּשַׁנִּים hexachorda, שׁוּשַׁנָּה lilium ; No. f. & pl. m. & No. f. f. à No. Rad. שֵׁשׁ sex.
units.tr: Lily (שׁוּשַׁן), hexachords (שׁוּשַׁנִּים), lily (שׁוּשַׁנָּה); noun, fem. and masc. pl., and noun, fem. fem., from the noun, root שֵׁשׁ, six.

units.la: שׁוּת ponere, pro שׂוּת, Infin. Kal, R. שׂוּם.
units.tr: To place (שׁוּת), for שׂוּת, infinitive Kal, root שׂוּם.

units.la: שׁוֹתָה bibens, יִם ... bibentes, Ben. Kal, f. & pl. m. constr. Rad. שָׁתָה.
units.tr: Drinking (שׁוֹתָה), drinking (יִם ... drinking, pl.), participle Kal, fem. and masc. pl., construct. Root שָׁתָה.

units.la: ש י [?]
units.tr: ש י [?]

units.la: שְׁפָתוּ contuitus est eum, שְׁפָתַנִי quod me contuitus sit, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. aff. Rad. שָׁפַת.
units.tr: He looked upon him (שְׁפָתוּ), that he looked upon me (שְׁפָתַנִי), perfect Kal, 3rd person fem., with suffix. Root שָׁפַת.

units.la: ש ח
units.tr: Š-Ḥ

units.la: וְ־שְׁחֵה & humilis, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁחַח curvari.
units.tr: wə-šəḥēh: humble, adjective, masculine singular. Root šāḥaḥ: to be bowed down.

units.la: שְׁחֵי meditatio, שִׂיחוֹ sua, No. f. m. aff. R. שׂוּחַ meditari.
units.tr: šəḥi: meditation; śîḥô: his own; noun, masculine singular with suffix. Root śûaḥ: to meditate.

units.la: הַ־שֹּׁחָה natans, Ben. Kal, f. m. R. שָׁחָה.
units.tr: hašŠōḥâ: swimming; Ben. Qal participle, masculine singular. Root šāhâ.

units.la: שְׂחוֹ natatio, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁחָה natavit.
units.tr: šəḥô: swimming; noun, masculine singular. Root šāhâ: he swam.

units.la: שָׁחוּ, vel שָׁחוּ depressi sunt, præt. Kal, 3. plur. Rad. שָׁחָה.
units.tr: šāḥû, or šāḥû: they were bowed down; perfect Qal, 3rd person plural. Root šāhâ.

units.la: שְׁחוּחַ incurvando se, Infin. Kal, vel No. Infin. Rad. שָׁחַח.
units.tr: šəḥûaḥ: bowing oneself down; infinitive Qal, or noun infinitive. Root šāḥaḥ.

units.la: שְׁחוֹק ridere, risus, Infin. Kal, vel No. Infin. Rad. שָׂחַק.
units.tr: šəḥôq: to laugh, laughter; infinitive Qal, or noun infinitive. Root śāḥaq.

units.la: לִשְׂחוֹת ad natandum, Infin. Kal, præf. R. שָׁחָה.
units.tr: liśəḥôt: for swimming; infinitive Qal, with prefix. Root šāhâ.

units.la: שְׁחוֹתִי curvarem me, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. שָׁחַח.
units.tr: šəḥôtî: I would bow myself down; perfect Qal, 1st person feminine singular. Root šāḥaḥ.

units.la: שְׁחִי abjice te, Imper. Kal, f. f. Rad. שָׁחָה.
units.tr: šəḥî: cast yourself down; imperative Qal, feminine singular. Root šāhâ.

units.la: מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָם de retibus, vel foveis eorum, pl. fæm.
units.tr: miššəḥîtôtām: from their nets, or from their pits; plural feminine, with prefix and suffix; noun šəḥîtâ. Root šāḥat: to corrupt.

units.la: præf. aff. No. שְׁחִיתָה; Rad. שָׁחַת corrumpere.
units.tr: [Continued from [12]]

units.la: שְׁחִרְחֹרֶת subnigra, No. f. f. gem. R. שָׁחַר nigrum esse.
units.tr: šəḥirḥōret: somewhat black; noun, feminine singular, doubled. Root šāḥar: to be black.

units.la: בְּ שְׁחַת in perdere, לְשַׁחְתָּם ad perdendum eos, Infin. Piel, præf. aff. Rad. שָׁחַת.
units.tr: bə-šaḥt: in destroying; lə-šaḥtām: to destroy them; infinitive Piel, with prefix and suffix. Root šāḥat.

units.la: שִׁחַתָּם corrupisti, לִשְׁחַתְּ tis, pro שְׁחַתָּה, & שְׁחַתֶּם; præt. Piel, 2. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁחַת.
units.tr: šiḥattām: you have corrupted; lišḥatt: you (fem.); for šiḥattâ and šiḥtem; perfect Piel, 2nd person feminine and masculine plural. Root šāḥat.

units.la: שִׁחַתְּךָ perdidit te, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. שָׁחַת, aff. Rad. שָׁחַת.
units.tr: šiḥatkā: he has destroyed you; perfect Piel, 3rd person masculine singular, with suffix. Root šāḥat.

units.la: בְּ־שְׁחָתָם in fovea eorum, No. f. m. שַׁחַת, præf. aff. Rad. שָׁחַת corrupit.
units.tr: bə-šəḥātām: in their pit; noun, masculine singular, šaḥat, with prefix and suffix. Root šāḥat: he corrupted.

units.la: ש ט
units.tr: Š-Ṭ

units.la: שְׁטֵה declina, Imper. Kal, f. m. R. שָׁטָה.
units.tr: šəṭēh: turn aside; imperative Qal, masculine singular. Root šāṭâ.

units.la: שָׁטוּ itaverunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. שׁוּט.
units.tr: šāṭû: they went wandering; perfect Qal, 3rd person plural. Root šût.

units.la: וְ־שֵׁט & in flagellum, No. f. m. præf. R. שֵׁט.
units.tr: wə-šēṭ: and a whip; noun, masculine singular, with prefix. Root šēṭ.

units.la: vel שׁט.
units.tr: or šṭ.

units.la: הַשָּׁטִים itantes vel remiges, Ben. Kal, pl. m. vel No. Part. præf. Rad. שׁוּט.
units.tr: haššāṭîm: those going about, or rowers; Ben. Qal, plural masculine, or noun participle with prefix. Root šût.

units.la: שַׁטִּים declinantes, No. pl. m. Rad. שָׁטָה.
units.tr: šaṭṭîm: turning aside; noun, masculine plural. Root šāṭâ.

units.tr: šiṭṭîm: cedars; noun, masculine plural, from the singular šiṭṭâ. Root šāṭaṭ.

units.la: שָׁטִית declinasti, præt. Kal, 2. f. f. R. שָׁטָה.
units.tr: šāṭîṭ: you turned aside; perfect Qal, 2nd person feminine singular. Root šāṭâ.

units.la: שִׁיאוּ excellentia ejus, No. f. m. Rad. נָשָׂא tulit.
units.tr: šî'ô: his excellence; noun, masculine singular. Root nāśā': he bore.

units.la: שִׂיבָה, שֵׂיבָת canities, מִשֵּׂיבוֹ propter canitiem ejus, No. f. f. constr. & No. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. שׂוּב, vel שִׂיב canescere.
units.tr: śêbâ, śêbāt: grey hair; mišśêbô: because of his grey hair; noun, feminine singular construct, and noun, masculine singular with prefix and suffix. Root śûb, or śîb: to be grey.

units.la: שִׁבְיָה captivitas, f. fæm. constr. No. שִׁבָה; Rad. שָׁבָה captivum cepit.
units.tr: šiḇyâ: captivity; feminine noun, construct, noun šiḇâ; root šāḇâ: he took captive.

units.la: שִׁיג insectatio, No. f. m.
units.tr: šîg: pursuit; noun, masculine singular.

units.la: Rad. נָשַׂג attigit.
units.tr: Root nāśaḡ: he reached.

units.la: שִׂיר calx, No. f. m. Rad. שׂוּר, vel שִׂיד linere.
units.tr: śîr: lime; noun, masculine singular. Root śûr, or śîd: to smear.

units.la: שַׂיָּהוּ, שִׂיּוּ pecus suum, f. m. aff. No. Rad. שֵׂה. שִׂיחַ loquere, שִׂיחוּ loquimini, (pro הַשִּׂיחַ, הַשִּׂיחוּ,) Imper. Hiph. sing. & plur. m. Rad. שׂוּחַ.
units.tr: śayyəhû, śiyyô: his flock; masculine noun with suffix. Root śeh. śîaḥ: speak, śîḥû: speak (plural), (for haśśîaḥ, haśśîḥû); imperative Hiphil, singular and masculine plural. Root śûaḥ.

units.la: לְ־שִׂיחַ ad meditandum, בְּ־שִׂיחִי in sermone meo, (pro לְהָשִׂיחַ,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. שׂוּחַ; vel Infin. Kal, Rad. שִׂיחַ.
units.tr: lə-śîaḥ: to meditate; bə-śîḥî: in my speech; (for lə-hāśîaḥ); infinitive Hiphil, with prefix. Root śûaḥ; or infinitive Qal, root śîaḥ.

units.la: שִׂיחַ meditatio, שִׂיחִי mea, No. f. m. Rad. שׂוּחַ, vel שִׂיחַ meditari.
units.tr: śîaḥ: meditation; śîḥî: my; noun, masculine singular. Root śûaḥ, or śîaḥ: to meditate.

units.la: שִׂיחָה fovea, שִׂיחוֹת foveæ, No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. שׂוּחַ inclinari.
units.tr: śîḥâ: pit; śîḥôt: pits; noun, feminine singular and plural. Root śûaḥ: to be bent.

units.la: שִׂיחָתִי meditatio mea, No. f. f. שִׂיחָה, aff. Rad. שׂוּחַ, vel שִׂיחַ meditari.
units.tr: śîḥātî: my meditation; noun, feminine singular, śîḥâ, with suffix. Root śûaḥ, or śîaḥ: to meditate.

units.la: שֵׁט שַׁשׁ remus, No. f. m. Rad. שׂוּט itare.
units.tr: šēṭ, šaš: oar; noun, masculine singular. Root śûṭ: to row.

units.la: שִׁילָה Schilo, secundina
units.tr: Šîlâ: Shiloh; afterbirth.

units.la: vel filius ejus, No. f. m. Rad. שָׁלָה tranquillum esse.
units.tr: or: his son; noun, masculine singular. Root šālâ: to be at rest.

units.la: שׂוּם, שִׂימָה ponere vel pone, (pro הָשִׂים, vel הָשֵׂם, &c.) Infin. vel, Imper. Hiph. f. m. parag. Rad. שׂוּם; vel Imper. Kal, Rad. שִׂים.
units.tr: śûm, śîmâ: to set, or set (for hāśîm or hāśēm, etc.); infinitive or imperative Hiphil, masculine singular, with paragogic ending. Root śûm; or imperative Qal, root śîm.

units.la: שִׁינֵיהֶם urinæ suæ, (pro שִׁינֵיהֶם, scil. quoad literas; & sic est No. pl. m. שִׁנַיִם urinæ, aff. à f. No. Rad. inusit. שִׁין, vel, שִׁין; sed (secundum Judæos, quoad puncta) pro מִמֵּי רַגְלֵיהֶם, vide Rad. שִׁין.
units.tr: šînêhem: their urine; (for šênêhem, namely as to letters; and so it is a masculine plural noun, šanayim: urine, with a feminine noun suffix. Root šîn, or šîn, unused; but (according to the Jews, as to vowel points) for mimmê raglêhem; see root šîn.

units.la: שִׁיר, ה canticum, ים, ות tica, No. f. & pl. m. & f. Rad. שִׁיר cantavit.
units.tr: šîr, ā: song; -îm, -ôt: songs; masculine and feminine noun, singular and plural. Root šîr: he sang.

units.la: לְשִׁיר ad cantandum, (pro לְהָשִׁיר, ) Inf. Hiph. præf. Rad. שִׁיר.
units.tr: lə-šîr: to sing; (for lə-hāšîr); infinitive Hiphil, with prefix. Root šîr.

units.la: שִׁירוּ cantate, (pro הָשִׁירוּ,) Imper. Hiph. pl. m. Rad. שִׁיר, vel Imper. & Infin. Kal, Rad. שִׁיר.
units.tr: šîrû: sing; (for hāšîrû); imperative Hiphil, masculine plural. Root šîr, or imperative and infinitive Qal, root šîr.

units.la: בְּשִׁירַת in cantico, s.f. constr. R. שִׁיר cantavit.
units.tr: bə-šîrat: in the song; feminine noun, construct. Root šîr: he sang.

units.la: שִׁישׁוּ gaudete, שִׁישׁ gaude, (pro הָשִׁישׁוּ, &c.) Imper. Hiph. pl. m. & sing. fæm. Rad. שׁוּשׁ, vel Imper. Kal, Rad. שִׁישׁ.
units.tr: šîšû: rejoice; šîš: rejoice; (for hāšîšû, etc.); imperative Hiphil, masculine plural and feminine singular. Root šûš, or imperative Qal, root šîš.

units.la: לְשִׁית ad ponendum, (pro לְהָשִׁית,) Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. שׁוּת.
units.tr: lə-šît: to put; (for lə-hāšît); infinitive Hiphil, with prefix. Root šût.

units.la: שִׁית pone, שִׁיתוּ ponite, Imper. Hiph. f. & pl. masc. Rad. שׁוּת, vel Imper. & Infin. Kal, Rad. שִׁית.
units.tr: šît: put; šîtû: put (plural); imperative Hiphil, feminine and masculine plural. Root šût, or imperative and infinitive Qal, root šît.

units.la: שִׁיתָה pro הָשִׁיתָה, & שִׁיתִי pro הָשִׁיתִי pone, Imper. Hiph. f. m. parag. & f. f. R. שׁוּת posuit.
units.tr: šîtâ, for hāšîtâ; and šîtî, for hāšîtî: put; imperative Hiphil, masculine singular with paragogic ending, and feminine singular. Root šût: he put.

units.la: שִׁית, & שִׁית ornamentum, שִׁיתוֹ ejus, No. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּת, vel שִׁית posuit.
units.tr: šît, and šît: ornament; šîtô: his; masculine noun with suffix. Root šût, or šît: he put.

units.tr: ש כ

units.la: שָׂךְ sepiens, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. שׂךְ.
units.tr: Sāk, "wise," Ben. Kal, m. Root שׂךְ.

units.la: כְּשָׂךְ, & כְּשָׂךְ secundum ponere, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. שָׁכַן ponere. שְׁכוֹ [?] sepes sua, No. f. m. שׂוֹךְ, aff. Rad. שׂוּךְ sepivit, vel, pro סְכוֹ tugurium ejus, Rad. סָכַךְ texit. לְשָׁכְנִי [?] menti, No. f. m. præf. R. שָׁכָה aspicere. בְּשְׂכּוֹת [?] in tabernaculis, No. pl. f. Rad. שָׁכַךְ vel סָכַךְ texit. שְׁכִיּוֹת [?] imagines, No. pl. f. à f. fæm. שְׁכִיָּה; Rad. שָׁכָה aspicere. שָׁכִין [?] culter, (pro שְׂכִים,) No. pl. m. Rad. שָׁכַךְ, vel est No. Rad. f. m. שָׁכִין, qu. à Rad. שָׁכַן. שָׁכְכָה [?] sedata est, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. R. שָׁכַךְ. שָׁכְּכָה [?] quod sic, est שׁ præf. cum Part. Adv. כְּ, & parag. כָּכָה. שָׁכְתִּי [?] sepivisti, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. R. שׂוּךְ. שָׁכְּתִי [?] sedatus sum, præt. Kal, 1. f. f. Rad. שָׁכַךְ ; vel pro סְכֹתִי [?] obtexi, Rad. סָכַךְ.
units.tr: Ksāk and ksāk, "to place according to," Infin. Kal, with prefix; Root שָׁכַן, "to place." Shekho [?], "its hedge," No. m. Shōakh, with suffix; Root שׂוּךְ, "he hedged in," or for סְכוֹ, "his booth," Root סָכַךְ, "he covered." Lishkeni [?], "to the mind," No. m., with prefix; Root שָׁכָה, "to look at." Bishkot [?], "in the tabernacles," No. pl. f.; Root שָׁכַךְ or סָכַךְ, "he covered." Shekhiyot [?], "images," No. pl. f., from the f. noun שְׁכִיָּה; Root שָׁכָה, "to look at." Shākhin [?], "a knife" (for שְׂכִים), No. pl. m.; Root שָׁכַךְ, or it is No. Root f. m. שָׁכִין, which is from Root שָׁכַן. Shākhkhāh [?], "she was calmed," perf. Kal, 3rd f. sing.; Root שָׁכַךְ. Shākkhāh [?], "which thus," is שׁ with prefix, with the particle כְּ, and the adverb כָּכָה. Shākhtī [?], "you hedged," perf. Kal, 2nd m. sing.; Root שׂוּךְ. Shākkhtī [?], "I was calmed," perf. Kal, 1st f. sing.; Root שָׁכַךְ; or for סְכֹתִי [?], "I covered," Root סָכַךְ.

units.la: ש ל שָׁלַל [?] spoliare, Infin. Kal, Rad. שָׁלַל. שָׁלַחּ [?] extrahe, Imper. Kal, f. m. Rad. נָשַׁל. הַשָּׁל [?] error, No. f. m. præf. Rad. שָׁלָה tranquillum esse. שַׁלְּאָנָן [?] tranquillissimus, est No. שַׁאֲנָן, (cum epenth. ל,) à Rad. שַׁאַן; vel est comp. ex No. שָׁלוֹ [?] tranquillus, R. שָׁלָה tranquillum esse, & שַׁאֲנָן tranquillus, Rad. שַׁאַן. שְׁלַהֶבֶת [?] flamma, est No. לַהֶבֶת, (cum prothesi ש) unde comp. cum יָהּ Deus, שַׁלְהֶבְתְּיָה [?] flamma Dei, Rad. להב flamma. שָׁלְיוֹ [?], vel שָׁלָיו, & שָׁלוּ [?] tranquilquillus, שָׁלוּ h,& שְׁלָוָה la, No. f. & pl. m. constr. ut & No. f. f. Rad. שָׁלָה tranquillum esse.
units.tr: Sh L: Shālal [?], "to plunder," Infin. Kal; Root שָׁלַל. Shālakh [?], "draw out," Imper. Kal, m. sing.; Root נָשַׁל. Hashsāl [?], "error," No. m., with prefix; Root שָׁלָה, "to be at rest." Shalʾānān [?], "most tranquil," is No. שַׁאֲנָן (with epenthetic ל), from Root שַׁאַן; or it is compounded from No. שָׁלוֹ [?], "tranquil," Root שָׁלָה, "to be at rest," and שַׁאֲנָן, "tranquil," Root שַׁאַן. Shalhevet [?], "flame," is No. לַהֶבֶת (with prothetic ש), whence, compounded with יָהּ, God: Shalhevtyah [?], "flame of God," Root להב, "flame." Shālyo [?], or shālyāv, and shālu [?], "tranquil," shālu (h), and shelāvāh (la), No. f. and pl. m. in construct, as also No. f. f.; Root שָׁלָה, "to be at rest."

units.la: בְּ־שְׁלוֹ in tranquillitate mea, (pro בְּ־שְׁלוֹתִי,) sing. f. constr. שְׁלוֹת, aff. No. שְׁלָוָה tranquil-litas, Rad. שָׁלָה tran-quillum esse.
units.tr: Beshlo, "in my tranquillity" (for בְּ־שְׁלוֹתִי), sing. f. construct שְׁלוֹת, with suffix; No. שְׁלָוָה, "tranquillity"; Root שָׁלָה, "to be at rest."

units.tr: שְׁלָיו coturnices, pl. m. No. Rad. שְׁלָו coturnix.

units.tr: שְׁלוֹת spoliasti, praet. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁלַל.

units.tr: שָׁלְוָתִי quievi, Job. 3. 26. pro שָׁלִיתִי, (cum י pro 3. Rad. ה,) praet. Kal, 1. f. Rad. שָׁלָה.
