units.tr: שָׁלְחָה dimisit, שָׁלְחוּ dimi-serunt, pro שִׁלְחָה, & שִׁלְחוּ ; praet. Piel, 3. f. f. & 3. pl. Rad. שָׁלַח.

units.tr: שָׁלְחֵנִי dimitte me, pro שַׁלְחֵנִי, Impet. Piel, 1 f. aff. Rad. שָׁלַח.

units.tr: No. f. m. שָׁלִי, praef. Rad. שָׁלָה tranquillum esse.

units.tr: Ūvishlishtāh, "and in its afterbirth," sing. f.; שְׁלִיתָה, with prefix and suffix; No. שָׁלָה, "to be at rest."

units.la: שְׁמָמָה res stupenda, שַׁמּוֹת desolationes, No. f. & pl. faem. Rad. שָׁמַם desolare. שָׂמָה posuit illam, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. שָׂם, aff. R. שׂוּם posuit. שָׂמוּ posuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. שׂוּם. וְשִׂמוּ & apponite, (pro הַשִּׂימוּ, idque pro, שִׂמוּ) Imper. Hiph. pl. m. R. שׂוּם. שִׂמּוּ desolate, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. שָׁמַם. מִשְּׂמוֹ à ponere eum, Infin. Kal, præf. aff. Rad. שׂוּם. שָׂמֻנִי posuerunt me, pro שָׂמוּנִי præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. שׂוּם. שִׁמּוֹת desolare, Ezech. 36. 3. pro שׁוּם, Infin. Kal, Rad. שָׁמַם. שְׁמוֹת nomina, שְׁמוֹתָם illorum, pl. fæm. aff. No. Rad. שֵׁם. שְׁמֵי cœli, שָׁמֶיךָ tui, שְׁמֵיכֶם vestri, pl. masc. constr. aff. No. Rad. שֵׁם. שְׁמְךָ nomen meum, שָׁמֶךָ tuum, שָׁמָם illorum, aff. [?] cum No. Rad. שֵׁם. שִׂמְּ appone, pro הַשִּׂימִי, Imper. Hiph. f. f. Shāmayim, "heavens," No. Root dual, or compounded from the particle שָׁם, "there," or from Root שָׁמַם, "to lay waste," and No. מַיִם, "waters," or from No. Root אֵשׁ, "fire," and מַיִם. Hashshāmīmāh, "toward heaven," with prefix and local ה, with No. Root שָׁמַיִם. Shāshamam, "who was laid waste," with prefix, from Root שָׁמַם, or שָׁמַם. Shemāmū, "they were laid waste," (for שָׁמְמוּ), Ezek. 35. 12, perf. Kal, 3rd pl.; Root שָׁמֵם. Shāmemū, "we placed," perf. Kal, 1st pl.; Root שׂוֹם. Shāmenū, "they are fat," perf. Kal, 3rd pl.; Root שָׂמַן. Shāmānī, "he placed me," perf. Kal, 3rd m. sing. with suffix; Root שׂוֹם. Shemaʿan, "hearken," (for שְׁמַעְנָה), Imper. Kal, pl. f.; Root שְׁמַע. Šənê: both, plural masculine with suffix, noun feminine, plural feminine שָׁנוֹת, root שָׁנָה, to repeat. Šənayim: two; šənênû: we two; šənêhem: they two, dual with suffix, root שָׁנָה. units.la: שָׂרוֹת principissæ, שָׂרוֹתֵיהֶם ipsorum, No. pl. f. à f. f. שָׂרָה, Rad. שׁוּר, vel שָׂר principatum te-nuit.
units.tr: Śārôṯ: princesses, śārôṯêhem: their own, plural feminine noun from the feminine noun שָׂרָה, root שׁוּר, or שָׂר, to hold princely rule.

R. שׂר. שִׁרְיָה , שִׁרְיוֹן , lorica , שִׁרִינוֹת , & וְהַשִּׁרְיוֹנִים , & loricæ , Item , שִׁרִין lorica , No. f. f. & No. f.& pl. m. ut & No. pl. f. omnia à Rad. שָׂרָה sol-vere. שָׂרִים cantores , Ben. Kal , vel pl. m. No. f. m. שָׁר , Rad. שׁוּר cantavit. שָׂרִיהֶם principes , eorum , pl. m. aff. No. f. m. שַׁר , Rad. שׁוּר prin-cipatum tenuit. שְׁרִירוּת aspectus , בְּ־שְׁרִירִי in umbilicis , Nó. f. f. & No. pl. m. constr. Rad. שָׁרַר. שָׂרִיתָ principem te gessisti , præt. Kal , 2. f. m. R. שָׂרָה. שְׁרוּתֵךְ residuum tuum , Jer. 15. 11. pro שְׁרִיתֵךְ , & hoc, contr. pro שְׁאֵרִיתֵךְ , No. f. f. שְׁאֵרִית , & contractè , שְׁרִית , aff. R. שְׁאָר reliquum esse , vel est pro שְׁרִיתֵךְ solvi te , præt. Piel , 1. f. aff. Rad. שָׂרָה. לְשָׁרְךָ umbiliço tuo , contractè , seu defectivè , pro שָׁרֵךְ , No. f. m. שָׁרְ , aff. Rad. שָׁרַר. שָׁר principatum tenens , Part. Ben. Kal , f. m. R. שָׁרַר. שָׁרוּ contemplati sunt , præt. Piel , 3. pl. Rad. שׁוּר. שָׁרְשׁוֹ radix ejus , שָׁרָשָׁיו ra-dices , שָׁרְשָׁיו ejus , f. m. aff. & pl. m. constr. aff. No. R. שֹׁרֶשׁ. שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת , & שַׁרְשֶׁרָה cate-næ , No. pl. f. à f. f. שַׁרְשֶׁרֶת , vel שַׁרְשְׁרָה , à No. Rad. שֹׁרֶשׁ radix. וַיִּשְׁרְתוּ & ministrabunt , præt. Piel , 3. pl. à Rad. in Piel, שֵׁרֵת. ש ש שָׂשׂ gavisus fuit, gaudens , præt. Kal , 3. f. m. vel , Part. Ben. Kal , f. m.
units.tr: Wəhaśśārôṯ: and chains, plural feminine noun with prefix, root שׂר. Širyāh, širyôn: coat of mail, širînôṯ: and coats of mail, and wəhašširyônîm: and coats of mail; likewise, širîn: coat of mail, feminine noun, masculine noun, and masculine plural, and feminine plural noun, all from the root שָׂרָה, to loosen. Śārîm: singers, participle Piel, or masculine plural noun, from שָׁר, root שׁוּר, to sing. Śārêhem: their princes, masculine plural with suffix, from the masculine noun שַׁר, root שׁוּר, to hold princely rule. Širêṯ: sight, bišrîrî: in navels, feminine noun and masculine plural construct, root שָׁרַר. Śārîṯā: you have made yourself a prince, preterite Qal, 2nd masculine singular, root שָׂרָה. Šərûṯēḵ: your remainder, Jeremiah 15:11, for שְׁרִיתֵךְ, and this, contracted for שְׁאֵרִיתֵךְ, feminine noun שְׁאֵרִית, and contracted שְׁרִית, with suffix, root שְׁאָר, to remain; or it is for שְׁרִיתֵךְ, I was loosed, preterite Piel, 1st feminine singular with suffix, root שָׂרָה. Lišrəḵā: to your navel, contracted or defective for שָׁרֵךְ, masculine noun שָׁרְ with suffix, root שָׁרַר. Šār: holding princely rule, participle Qal, masculine singular, root שָׁרַר. Šārû: they contemplated, preterite Piel, 3rd plural, root שׁוּר. Šārəšô: its root, šārāšāyw: its roots, šārəšāyw: its, masculine noun with suffix and masculine plural construct with suffix, root שֹׁרֶשׁ. Šarəšərôṯ, and šarəšerāh: chains, plural feminine nouns, from the feminine noun šarəšeret, or šarəšərāh, from the noun šōreš, root. Wayyišərəṯû: and they shall minister, preterite Piel, 3rd plural, from the root in Piel, שֵׁרֵת. Š Š Śāś: rejoiced, rejoicing, preterite Qal, 3rd masculine singular, or participle Qal masculine singular.

units.la: Rad. שׁוּשׁ.
units.tr: Root שׁוּשׁ.

units.la: שֵׁשׁ marmor, No. f. m. contr. à No. Rad. שֵׁשׁ marmor.
units.tr: שֵׁשׁ marble, noun, masc. contracted from the noun, root שֵׁשׁ marble.

units.la: שֵׁשְׁתֵּךְ sextavité, Ezec. 39. 2. præt. Piel, 1. f. aff. pro שִׁשְּׁתִיךְ, à præt. Piel, שִׁשָּׂה, & No. Rad. שֵׁשׁ sex.
units.tr: שֵׁשְׁתֵּךְ you have sextupled, Ezek. 39. 2. Piel perfect, 1st person, feminine, assimilated for שִׁשְּׁתִיךְ, from the Piel perfect שִׁשָּׂה, and the noun root שֵׁשׁ six.

units.la: שִׁשָּׂה sax, sing. masc. à No. Rad. sing. fœm. שֵׁשׁ.
units.tr: שִׁשָּׂה six, singular masculine, from the noun root; singular feminine שֵׁשׁ.

units.la: שָׂשִׂים, constr. שְׂשִׂים gaudi-um, No. f. m. à Rad. שׂוּשׂ, contr. שָׂשׂ gavi-sus fuit.
units.tr: שָׂשִׂים, construct שְׂשִׂים joy, noun, masc., from the root שׂוּשׂ, contracted שָׂשׂ he rejoiced.

units.la: שְׁשׁוֹתַנִּי quod contritus est me, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. שׁוּפָה, præf. aff. Rad. [?]
units.tr: שְׁשׁוֹתַנִּי because I was crushed, Perfect Kal, 3rd person, feminine; the prefixed letter and the root [?].

units.la: שִׁשִּׁי sextus, No. f. m. à No. Rad. sing. fœm. שֵׁשׁ sex.
units.tr: שִׁשִּׁי sixth, noun, masc., from the noun root, singular feminine שֵׁשׁ six.

units.la: שִׁשִּׁים sexaginta, pl. comm. gen. No. Rad. f. f. שֵׁשׁ.
units.tr: שִׁשִּׁים sixty, plural, common gender, noun root feminine שֵׁשׁ.

units.la: שִׁשָּׁה sexta, f. f. No. f. m. שֵׁשׁ, à No. Rad. f. f.
units.tr: שִׁשָּׁה sixth, feminine, noun masc. שֵׁשׁ, from the noun root feminine.

units.la: שִׁשְּׁתָּם sextavistis, præt. Piel, 2. pl. m. à 3. f. m. שִׁשֵּׁה, No. Rad. f. f. שֵׁשׁ sex.
units.tr: שִׁשְּׁתָּם you have sextupled, Piel perfect, 2nd person plural masculine, from the 3rd person masculine שִׁשֵּׁה, noun root feminine שֵׁשׁ six.

units.la: שָׁשָּׁם quod ibi, præf. שׁ, cum Part. Rad. שָׁם.
units.tr: שָׁשָּׁם that there, prefix שׁ, with the participle of the root שָׁם.

units.la: שְׁשָׁנִים hexachorda, pl. m. No. f. m. שׁוּשַׁן lilium, à No. Rad. שֵׁשׁ sex.
units.tr: שְׁשָׁנִים sixchords, plural masculine, noun masc. שׁוּשַׁן lily, from the noun root שֵׁשׁ six.

units.la: שֶׁשָּׁה sex, constr. f. m. שִׁשָּׁה, à No. Rad. f. f. שֵׁשׁ.
units.tr: שֶׁשָּׁה six, construct feminine שִׁשָּׁה, from the noun root feminine שֵׁשׁ.

units.la: שִׁשָּׁה sexta, def. pro שִׁשִּׁית, à No. f. m. שֵׁשׁ, à No. Rad. f. f. שֵׁשׁ sex.
units.tr: שִׁשָּׁה sixth, definite, for שִׁשִּׁית, from the noun masc. שֵׁשׁ, from the noun root feminine שֵׁשׁ six.

units.la: שִׁשְׁתִּי gavisus sum, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. שׂוּשׂ, contr. שָׂשׂ.
units.tr: שִׁשְׁתִּי I rejoiced, Perfect Kal, 1st person, root שׂוּשׂ, contracted שָׂשׂ.

units.la: שׁ ת
units.tr: ש ת

units.la: שָׁת posuit, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. שִׂים ponere, Ihf. Rad. שׁוּת.
units.tr: שָׁת posuit [sháth, "he placed"], preterite Kal, 3rd person masc. sing., from שִׂים to put; Inf. Rad. שׁוּת.

units.la: שָׂתָּ, & שַׂתָּה posuisti, שָׂתוּ, & שָׂתוּ posuerunt, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. parag. & 3. & 3. pl. Rad. שׁת.
units.tr: שָׂתָּ and שַׂתָּה posuisti [sátta, sathah, "you placed"], שָׂתוּ and שָׂתוּ posuerunt [sátu, "they placed"]: preterite Kal, 2nd person masc. sing. with paragogic vowel, and 3rd person plural. Rad. שׁת.

units.la: שָׁת nates, No. sing. masc. à Rad. שׁת, contr. שָׁת posuit.
units.tr: שָׁת nates [shath, "buttocks"], noun, sing. masc., from the root שׁת, contracted from שָׁת posuit.

units.la: שָׁתָה posuit, f. praet. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. שׁת, contr. שָׁת.
units.tr: שָׁתָה posuit [shathah, "she placed"], preterite Kal, 3rd person fem. sing. Rad. שׁת, contracted to שָׁת.

units.la: שְׁתוֹ bibere, Infin. Kal, & שְׁתוּ bibete, Imper. Kal, pl. m. Rad. שָׁתָה.
units.tr: שְׁתוֹ bibere [shetho, "to drink"], infinitive Kal; and שְׁתוּ bibite [shetu, "drink ye"], imperative Kal, masc. plur. Rad. שָׁתָה.

units.la: מִשְּׁתוֹ à ferendo illo, vel, de excellentia ejus, contractè, pro מְשַׂאתוֹ Infin. Kal, vel potiùs, No. f. f. שָׂאת, præf. aff. Rad. נָשָׂא tulit.
units.tr: מִשְּׁתוֹ à ferendo illo [misshetho, "from bearing him"], or, de excellentia ejus [or, "concerning his excellence"], contracted for מְשַׂאתוֹ; infinitive Kal, or rather noun, fem. sing., from שָׂאת, with preposition and suffix; Rad. נָשָׂא tulit [he bore].

units.la: שְׁתוֹתָיו fundamenta, ejus, No. pl. fæm. aff. Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת posuit.
units.tr: שְׁתוֹתָיו fundamenta [shethotav, "its foundations"], ejus [his], noun, plur. fem., with suffix; Rad. שׁוּת, contracted from שָׁת posuit.

units.la: לִשְׁתּוֹת ad bibendum, Inf. Kal, præf. R. שָׁתָה.
units.tr: לִשְׁתּוֹת ad bibendum [lishtot, "for drinking"], infinitive Kal, with preposition; Rad. שָׁתָה.

units.la: שְׁתוֹתֵיהֶם nates ipsarum, pl. f. aff. à f. m. שׁת, Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת posuit.
units.tr: שְׁתוֹתֵיהֶם nates ipsarum [shethotehem, "their buttocks"], plur. fem. with suffix, from fem. masc. שׁת, Rad. שׁוּת, contracted from שָׁת posuit.

units.la: שָׁתִי posui, pro שָׁתִּתִּי, praet. Kal, 1. f. Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת.
units.tr: שָׁתִי posui [shathi, "I placed"], for שָׁתִּתִּי, preterite Kal, 1st person sing.; Rad. שׁוּת, contracted from שָׁת.

units.la: הַשָּׁתִי stamen, compotatio, בְּשָׁתִי in compotatione, שְׁתִיָּה potio, No. f. m. præf. & No. sing. fæm. Rad. שָׁתָה bibit.
units.tr: הַשָּׁתִי stamen [hashshathi, "the warp"], compotatio [drinking party], בְּשָׁתִי in compotatione [beshathi, "at a drinking party"], שְׁתִיָּה potio [shethiyyah, "drinking"], noun, masc. with article and noun, sing. fem.; Rad. שָׁתָה bibit [he drank].

units.la: שֹׁתִים bibentes, לִשְׁתָּיו bibentibus eam, Ben. Kal, pl. m. constr. aff. & præf. R. שָׁתָה.
units.tr: שֹׁתִים bibentes [shotim, "drinking"], לִשְׁתָּיו bibentibus eam [lishtayw, "for those drinking it"], participle Kal, plur. masc., construct and with suffix and preposition; Rad. שָׁתָה.

units.la: שְׁתַּיִם, constr. שְׁתֵי duæ, שְׁתַּיִהֶן duæ illæ, pro שְׁנָתַּיִם, No. du. f. constr. aff. à du. m. שְׁנַיִם; Rad. שָׁנָה iterare.
units.tr: שְׁתַּיִם, construct שְׁתֵי duæ [two], שְׁתַּיִהֶן duæ illæ [those two], for שְׁנָתַּיִם; numeral, dual fem., construct with suffix, from dual masc. שְׁנַיִם; Rad. שָׁנָה iterare [to repeat].

units.la: שְׁתִיתִי bibi, praet. Kal, 1. f. Rad. שָׁתָה.
units.tr: שְׁתִיתִי bibi [shethithi, "I drank"], preterite Kal, 1st person sing.; Rad. שָׁתָה.

units.la: שָׁתַם obstruxit, cum ש, pro ס, praet. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. סָתַם.
units.tr: שָׁתַם obstruxit [shatham, "he stopped up"], with ש for ס, preterite Kal, 3rd person masc. sing.; Rad. סָתַם.

units.la: שְׁתַנִי posuisti me, praet. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּת, contr. שָׁת.
units.tr: שְׁתַנִי posuisti me [shethani, "you placed me"], preterite Kal, 2nd person masc. sing. with suffix; Rad. שׁוּת, contracted from שָׁת. ## ת א

units.la: ת א
תֵּאָבְדוּ peribitis, fut. Kal. 2. pl. m. R. אָבַד.
units.tr: תֵּאָבְדוּ peribitis [te'avdu, "you will perish"], future Kal, 2nd person plur. masc.; Rad. אָבַד.

units.la: תֵּאָבֶה acquiesces, vel cet, כִּי cetis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. R. אָבָה.
units.tr: תֵּאָבֶה acquiesces [te'abbeh, "you will consent"], or cet [consent], כִּי cetis [ki, "that"], future Kal, 2nd person fem. sing. or 3rd person fem. sing., as also 2nd person plur. masc.; Rad. אָבָה.

units.la: תֵּאָהַבּוּן, pro תֵּאֲהַבּוּ ama-bitis, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. Rad. אָהַב.
units.tr: תֵּאָהַבּוּן, for תֵּאֲהַבּוּ amabitis [te'ahabun, "you will love"], future Kal, 3rd person plur. masc.; Rad. אָהַב.

units.la: תְּאוֹ bubalus, No. f. m. Rad. תָּאָה determinare.
units.tr: תְּאוֹ bubalus [te'o, "wild ox"], noun, masc. sing.; Rad. תָּאָה determinare [to determine].

units.la: תֵּאָוֶה desiderabis, fut. Pi-el, 2. f. m. R. אָוָה.
units.tr: תֵּאָוֶה desiderabis [te'aweh, "you will desire"], future Piel, 2nd person fem. sing.; Rad. אָוָה.

units.la: תְּאוֹמִים, תְּאוֹמֵי gemelli, No. pl. masc. constr. Rad. תָּאַם.
units.tr: תְּאוֹמִים, תְּאוֹמֵי gemelli [te'omim, te'omei, "twins"], noun, plur. masc., construct; Rad. תָּאַם.

units.la: תָּאוּרְנָה lucebitis, vel bunt, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3 pl. f. R. אוֹר lucere.
units.tr: תָּאוּרְנָה lucebitis [ta'urnah, "you will shine"], or bunt [they will shine], future Kal, 2nd or 3rd person plur. fem.; Rad. אוֹר lucere [to shine].

units.la: תָּאוֹנָת finis, constr. f. fæm. No. תַּאֲוָה; Rad. תָּאָה determinare.
units.tr: תָּאוֹנָת finis [ta'onat, "end"], construct fem. sing., noun, from תַּאֲוָה; Rad. תָּאָה determinare.

units.la: תַּאֲוָתִי desiderium meum, f. f. aff. No. תַּאֲוָה; Rad. אָוָה appetivit.
units.tr: תַּאֲוָתִי desiderium meum [ta'avati, "my desire"], noun fem. sing. with suffix, from תַּאֲוָה; Rad. אָוָה appetivit [he desired].

units.la: וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי & accinges me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. אָזַר.
units.tr: וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי & accinges me [vatte'azzerêni, "and she girded me"], future Piel, 2nd person fem. sing. with suffix; Rad. אָזַר.

units.la: תָּאֵי, הַתָּאִים thalami, תָּאֵי ejus, & הַתָּאוֹת תָּאוֹ thalami, pl. m. constr. aff. & pl. f. No. R. תָּא, vel הוֹא.
units.tr: תָּאֵי, הַתָּאִים thalami [ta'ei, hata'im, "chambers"], תָּאֵי ejus [his chambers], and הַתָּאוֹת תָּאוֹ thalami [chambers], plur. masc., construct with suffix, and plur. fem., noun; Rad. תָּא, or הוֹא.

units.la: תָּאִיצוּ urgebitis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. אִין.
units.tr: תָּאִיצוּ urgebitis [ta'itzu, "you will press"], future Hiph., 2nd person plur. masc.; Rad. אִין.

units.la: תָּאִיר lucere facies vel faciet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. אוֹר.
units.tr: תָּאִיר lucere facies [you will cause to shine] or faciet [she will cause to shine], future Hiph., 2nd person masc. sing. or 3rd person fem. sing.; Rad. אוֹר.

units.la: תַּאְכֵּל comedere facies, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. אָכַל.
units.tr: תַּאְכֵּל comedere facies [you will cause to eat], future Hiph., 2nd person masc. sing.; Rad. אָכַל.

units.la: תֵּאָכַלְנָה comedetur, comedemini, vel dentur, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. אָכַל.
units.tr: תֵּאָכַלְנָה comedetur [it will be eaten], comedemini [you will be eaten], or dentur [they will be given], future Niph., 3rd person fem. plur. and 2nd or 3rd person plur. fem.; Rad. אָכַל.

units.la: תְּאָכְלֶהוּ consumet eum, Job.20.26.pro תְּאָכְלֶהוּ; fut. Piel, 3. f. f. aff. vel est תְּאָכְלֶהוּ, ex forma Poel תְּאַכֵּל, aff. Rad. אָכַל edit. תֵּאָלַמְנָה obmutescant, fut. Niph. 3. pl. f. Rad. אָלַם. תַּאֲלָתְךָ exsecratio tua, f. f. constr. תַּאֲלַת, aff. Rad. אָלָה exsecratus est. תְּאוֹמֵי gemelli, pl. m. constr. No. תֹּאַם ; Rad. תָּאַם gemellos parere. תֵּאָמִין, תֵּאֲמִינוּ credes, credetis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. & pl. m. Rad. אָמַן nutrivit. תְּאוֹמִים gemelliparae, Ben Kal, pl. m. Rad. תָּאַם. תָּאְמִינוּ dextram petetis, Jef. 30. 21. pro תִּימִינוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. inusit. in Kal, יָמַן sed in Hiph. הִימִין. [?] תֵּאָמַנָּה nutrientur, Jef. 60. 4. pro תֵּאָמַנָּה, vel תֵּאָמְנָה, fut. Niph. 3. pl. f. R. אָמַן. [?] תֵּאָמְנוּ nutriemini, תֵּאָמְנָה nutrientur, fut. Niph. [?] 2. pl. m. & 3. pl. f. R. אָמַן. תְּאֻנָּה objicietur, fut. Pual, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. אָנָה luxit. תַּאֲנִיָּה, תַּאֲנָה occasio, No. f. f. R. אָנָה mæstius fuit. תְּאֵינֵיכֶם ficus vestrae, pl. m. תְּאֵנִים, aff. No. תְּאֵנָה ficus, R. inusit. תָּאַן. תְּאָנִים molestiae, No. pl. m. Rad. אוֹן. תַּאֲנָתָהּ occasio ejus, f. f. constr. תַּאֲנַת, aff. No. תַּאֲנָה ; Rad. אָנָה mæstus fuit. תַּאֲנָתְךָ ficus tua, f. f. constr. תַּאֲנַת, aff. No. תַּאֲנָה ; Rad. inusit. תָּאַן. תַּאְסִפִין addetis, Exod. 5. 7. pro תּוֹסִיפוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. יָסַף. [?] תַּאָסֵף colligetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. R. אָסַף. תַּאְסְפוּ tolletis, fut. Hiph.
units.tr: תְּאָכְלֶהוּ consumet eum [she will consume him], Job 20:26, for תְּאָכְלֶהוּ; future Piel, 3rd person fem. sing. with suffix, or it is תְּאָכְלֶהוּ, from the form Poel תְּאַכֵּל, with suffix; Rad. אָכַל. Edition: תֵּאָלַמְנָה obmutescant [they will be silent], future Niph., 3rd person plur. fem.; Rad. אָלַם. תַּאֲלָתְךָ exsecratio tua [your curse], fem. sing., construct תַּאֲלַת, with suffix; Rad. אָלָה exsecratus est [he cursed]. תְּאוֹמֵי gemelli [twins], plur. masc., construct, noun תֹּאַם; Rad. תָּאַם gemellos parere [to bear twins]. תֵּאָמִין, תֵּאֲמִינוּ credes, credetis [you will believe, you will believe], future Hiph., 2nd person fem. and plur. masc.; Rad. אָמַן nutrivit [he nourished]. תְּאוֹמִים gemelliparae [bearing twins], Ben Kal, plur. masc.; Rad. תָּאַם. תָּאְמִינוּ dextram petetis [you will seek the right hand], Isa 30:21, for תִּימִינוּ, future Hiph., 2nd person plur. masc.; Rad. not used in Kal, יָמַן, but in Hiph. הִימִין. [?] תֵּאָמַנָּה nutrientur [they will be nourished], Isa 60:4, for תֵּאָמַנָּה or תֵּאָמְנָה, future Niph., 3rd person plur. fem.; R. אָמַן. [?] תֵּאָמְנוּ nutriemini [you will be nourished], תֵּאָמְנָה nutrientur [they will be nourished], future Niph., [?] 2nd person plur. masc. and 3rd person plur. fem.; R. אָמַן. תְּאֻנָּה objicietur [it will be cast against], future Pual, 3rd person sing. fem.; Rad. אָנָה luxit [he mourned]. תַּאֲנִיָּה, תַּאֲנָה occasio [occasion], noun, fem.; R. אָנָה mæstius fuit [was sad]. תְּאֵינֵיכֶם ficus vestrae [your figs], plur. masc., with suffix, noun תְּאֵנָה ficus [fig]; R. not used, תָּאַן. תְּאָנִים molestiae [troubles], noun, plur. masc.; Rad. אוֹן. תַּאֲנָתָהּ occasio ejus [her occasion], fem. sing., construct תַּאֲנַת, with suffix, noun תַּאֲנָה; Rad. אָנָה mæstus fuit. תַּאֲנָתְךָ ficus tua [your fig], fem. sing., construct תַּאֲנַת, with suffix, noun תַּאֲנָה; Rad. not used, תָּאַן. תַּאְסִפִין addetis [you will add], Exod 5:7, for תּוֹסִיפוּ, future Hiph., 2nd person plur. masc. with paragogic vowel; Rad. יָסַף. [?] תַּאָסֵף colligetur [it will be gathered], future Niph., 3rd person fem. sing.; R. אָסַף. תַּאְסְפוּ tolletis [you will take up], future Hiph.

units.tr: 2nd person plur. masc. with paragogic vowel; Rad. אָסַף.

units.tr: תֵּאָסֵר[?] vincieris [you will be bound], future Niph., 2nd person masc. sing.; R. אָסַר.

units.tr: תֵּאָכֶה[?] caquetur [it will be babbled], תְּאַפִּינָה[?] caquentur [they will be babbled], future Niph., singular and plural; Rad. אָפָה.

units.tr: תֵּאֹר[?] maledices [you will curse], future Kal, 2nd person masc. sing.; Rad. אָרַר.

units.tr: תְּאָרַכְנָה prolongabuntur [they will be prolonged], future Kal, 3rd person plur. fem.; R. אָרַךְ.

units.tr: תְּאָרְשִׂי desponsabis [you will betroth], future Piel, sing.; Rad. אָרַשׂ.

units.la: תְּבוּאָתָה advenient, Jef. 5. 19. Deut. 33. 16. תִּבּוֹאֲךָ tibi, pro תָּבוֹא fut. Kal, 3. s. f. parag. & aff. Rad. בוא. תְּבוֹאֶנָּה advenient, Ps. 45.16. pro תָּבֹאנָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. בוא. תְּבוּאַת proventus, תְּבוּאָתוֹ suus, מִתְּבוּאֹתֵיכֶם ex proventibus vestris, No. s. constr. & aff. ut & pl. f. aff. Rad. בוא. תָּבוֹאָה veniet, Deut. 33.16. pro תָּבוֹאָה, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. parag. Rad. בוא. תְּבוֹאִי advenies, 1. Sam. 25.34. pro תָּבוֹא, fut. Kal, 2. s. f. Rad. בוא. Vide Clavem nostram Hebr. ad hunc locum. תְּבוֹאָתְךָ obveniet tibi, Job. 22.21. pro תְּבוֹאֵךְ, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. aff. Rad. בוא. תָּבָא, vel תָּבוֹא, & תָּבוּ sper-net, vel nes, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. vel 2. s. m. Rad. בוא, vel בָּוָה [?]. תִּבָּא contemnetur, vel di-ripietur, תָּבָּא diripietis, fut. Niph. 3. s. f. & fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. בוא vel בָּוֹא. תִּבּוּ diripietur, pro תִּבָּו, fut. Niph. 3. s. f. Rad. בוז. תְּבוּנָה intelligentia, תְּבוּנָתוֹ ejus, תְּבוּנוֹת tiæ, No. s. f. aff. & pl. f. Rad. בין intellexit. בִּתְבוּנָם pro intellectu suo, Hos. 13.2. pro בִּתְבוּנָתָם No. s. f. f. aff. & præf. R. תְּבוּנָה intelligere. תִּבּוֹק exhauriētur, Jes. 24.3. pro תִּבַּק, fut. Niph. 3. s. f. Rad. בקק. תָּבוּשׁ erubescet, pro תָּבוּשׁ, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. Rad. בוש. תִּבְּטְחוּ probabimini, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. R. בטח. תִּבְטְּחוּ fiduciam ponetis, Jer. 49.11. pro תִּבְטְחָה, fut. Kal, pl. m. pro f. Vide Clav. Hebr. Rad. בטח.
units.tr: tᵊbû'ātâ, they will come, Isa. 5. 19., Deut. 33. 16.; tibbôʼăkā, to you, for tābôʼ, future Kal, 3. sing. f., with paragogic and suffixed forms, root בוא. tᵊbôʼennâ, they will come, Ps. 45. 16., for tābōʼnâ, future Kal, 3. pl. f., root בוא. tᵊbû'at, produce; tᵊbû'ātô, his; mittᵊbû'ōtêkhem, from your produce, noun, construct and with suffixes, sing. and pl. f. with suffix, root בוא. tābôʼâ, it will come, Deut. 33. 16., for tābôʼâ, future Kal, 3. sing. f. with paragogic, root בוא. tᵊbôʼî, you will come, 1 Sam. 25. 34., for tābôʼ, future Kal, 2. sing. f., root בוא. See our Hebrew Clavis on this passage. tᵊbôʼᵊkā, it will come upon you, Job 22. 21., for tᵊbôʼēkh, future Kal, 3. sing. f. with suffix, root בוא. tābā', or tābô', and tābû, he despises, or you despise, future Kal, 3. sing. f. or 2. sing. m., root בוא or בָּוָה [?]. tibbā', he will be despised, or he will be plundered; tabbā'û, you will be plundered, future Niph., 3. sing. f., and future Kal, 2. pl. m., root בוא or בָּוֹא. tibbû, it will be plundered, for tibbāzû, future Niph., 3. sing. f., root בוז. tᵊbûnâ, understanding; tᵊbûnātô, his; tᵊbûnôt, understandings, noun, sing. f. with suffix, and pl. f., root בין, he understood. bitbûnām, according to their understanding, Hos. 13. 2., for bitbûnātām, noun, sing. f. with suffix and prefix, root תְּבוּנָה, to understand. tibbôq, they will be drained, Isa. 24. 3., for tibbaq, future Niph., 3. sing. f., root בקק. tāḇûš, she will be ashamed, for tābôš, future Kal, 3. sing. f., root בוש. tibbāṭᵊḥû, you will be proved, future Niph., 2. pl. m., root בטח. tibṭᵊḥû, you will place confidence, Jer. 49. 11., for tibṭᵊḥāh, future Kal, pl. m. for f. See our Hebrew Clavis, root בטח.

units.la: תָּגוּשׁ exigendo arctabis, Deut. 14. 3. pro תִּגַּשׁ[?], fut. Kal, 2. s. m. Rad. נָגַשׁ הָגַז[?] tondebis, avelles, fut. Kal, sing. Rad. גָּזַז, vel גּוֹז. וַתְּנַח[?] & prodis, fut. Kal, sing. Rad. גּוּחַ. תַּגִּיד, תַּגִּיד[?] indicabis, תַּגִּידוּ indicabitis, fut. Hiph. s. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָגַד תַּגִּין[?] mærore afficietis, Job 19. 2. pro תָּגוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. נָגָה תָּגִיל, תָּגַל exsultabis, תָּגִלְנָה exsultabitis, &c. fut. Hiph. sing. & plur. Rad. גִּיל. תָּגִיץ[?] partigerit, וַתָּגֹץ[?] & abjecit, fut. Hiph. sing. Rad. נָגַץ תִּגִּישׁ[?] offertis, תַּגַּשׁ, vel תִּגּוּשׁ accedas, תִּגְּשׁוּ accedite, תִּגַּשְׁנָה accedent illæ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. & fut. Kal, sing. & plur. Rad. נָגַשׁ תָּגוֹל[?] retegetur, (pro תִּגָּלֶה,) תָּגֹל retegito, (pro תִּגְלָה,) תִּגְלִי detegito, fut. Niph. & Piel, sing. apoc. & f. Rad. גָּלָה תְּגַמְּלוֹהִי[?] beneficia ejus, Pf. 116. 12. pl. m. aff. Syr. No. תִּגְמוֹל, Rad. גָּמַל retribuit. תִּגַּע attinges, תִּגְּשׁ attingetis, fut. Kal, sing. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָגַע. וַתָּגָר[?] & peregrinata fuerat, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. R. גּוּר. וַתַּגֵּר[?] & fecisti diffluere, fut. Hiph. sing. Rad. נָגַר. תִּגְרְמֵי[?] confringes, fut. Piel, 2. s. f. R. גָּרַם. תִּגְרְשֶׁן[?] expelles, תִּגְרְשׁוּן expelletis, fut. Piel, sing. & 2. pl. m. Rad. גָּרַשׁ. מִ תִּגְּרָת[?] à conflictu, constr. sing. fem. præf. No. תִּגְרָה; Rad. נָגַר miscere prælia.
units.tr: you shall press hard by exacting exigendo arctabis, Deut. 14. 3, for תִּגַּשׁ[?], future Kal, 2nd person singular masculine. Root נָגַשׁ. הָגַז[?] you shall shear, you shall pull off avelles, future Kal, singular. Root גָּזַז, or גּוֹז. וַתְּנַח[?] and you shall betray, future Kal, singular. Root גּוּחַ. תַּגִּיד, תַּגִּיד[?] you shall declare indicabis, תַּגִּידוּ you shall declare indicabitis, future Hiphil, singular and 2nd person plural masculine. Root נָגַד. תַּגִּין[?] you shall afflict with grief mærore afficietis, Job 19. 2, for תָּגוּ, future Hiphil, 2nd person plural masculine, with paragogic ending. Root נָגָה. תָּגִיל, תָּגַל you shall exult exsultabis, תָּגִלְנָה you shall exult exsultabitis, etc., future Hiphil, singular and plural. Root גִּיל. תָּגִיץ[?] he shall partition, וַתָּגֹץ[?] and he cast away, future Hiphil, singular. Root נָגַץ. תִּגִּישׁ[?] you offer, תַּגַּשׁ, or תִּגּוּשׁ you approach, תִּגְּשׁוּ approach ye, תִּגַּשְׁנָה they shall approach, future Hiphil, 2nd person plural masculine, and future Kal, singular and plural. Root נָגַשׁ. תָּגוֹל[?] it shall be uncovered, (for תִּגָּלֶה,) תָּגֹל uncover, (for תִּגְלָה,) תִּגְלִי uncover, future Niphal and Piel, singular apocopated and feminine. Root גָּלָה. תְּגַמְּלוֹהִי[?] his benefits, Ps. 116. 12, plural masculine, with suffix. Syriac, no. תִּגְמוֹל, Root גָּמַל he rewards. תִּגַּע you shall touch, תִּגְּשׁ you shall touch, future Kal, singular and 2nd person plural masculine. Root נָגַע. וַתָּגָר[?] and she had sojourned, future Kal, 3rd person singular feminine. Root גּוּר. וַתַּגֵּר[?] and you caused to flow, future Hiphil, singular. Root נָגַר. תִּגְרְמֵי[?] you shall break, future Piel, 2nd person singular feminine. Root גָּרַם. תִּגְרְשֶׁן[?] you shall expel, תִּגְרְשׁוּן you shall expel, future Piel, singular and 2nd person plural masculine. Root גָּרַשׁ. מִ תִּגְּרָת[?] from conflict, construct singular feminine, with preformative, see תִּגְרָה; Root נָגַר, to stir up strife.

Kal, f R. דָּרַן. תְּדִיחֶנּוּ [?] expelles eum, תְּדִיחֻהוּ [?] expellétis eos, fut. Hiph. sing. & 2. pl. m. aff. Rad. נָדַח. תְּדִינֵנִי [?] judicabis, תְּדִינֵנִי me, fut. Hiph. sing. aff. Rad. דִּין. תְּדַבְּאוּ [?] canteretis, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. דָּבָא. תְּדַבְּאֵנִי [?] atteretis me, Job. 19. 2. pro תְּדַבְּאֵנִי [?], fut. Piel, parag. & aff. Rad. דָּכָא. וַתִּתְלֶה [?] & hauserunt, Exod. 2. 16. fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. R. דָּלָה. תִּרַם [?] filaat, pro תְּרוּם [?]. תִּרְמִי filebis, pro תִּרְמִי [?]; fut. Kal, 3. & 2. f. fæm. תִּרְמִי exscinderis, Jer. 48. 2. pro תִּתְדַּמֵּי [?] fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. Rad. דָּמַם. תִּרְמָה [?] assimilabitur, תִּרְמִינָה [?] assimilabuntur, fut. Kal, sing. & plur. Rad. דָּמָה. תִּרְמִי [?] imagineris, תִּרַמִּין [?] assimilabitis, Jes. 40. 18. (pro תִּדְמוּ [?]) תִּדְמוּנִי [?] me, pro תִּרַמְּנִי [?] fut. Piel, 2. sing. fæm. & 2. pl. m. parag. & aff. Rad. דָּמָה. תֵּדַע [?] scies, וְתֵדְעִי [?] & noscas eam, תֵּדְעִין [?] rescis cas, תֵּדְעִין [?] cognosceris, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. ut & 2. f. f. & 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. יָדַע.
units.tr: תִּדְבָּקִין [?] you will cling, for תִּדְבַּק, future Qal, 2nd feminine singular, with paragogic ending. Root דָּבַק. תִּדְבָּקַנִּי [?] let it cling to me, Gen. 19. 19, for תִּדְבְּקֵנִי, future Qal, 3rd feminine singular with suffix. Root דָּבַק. וַתִּדַּד [?] and fled, future Qal, 3rd feminine singular. Root נָדַד. תְּדִהָר [?] a stamping, noun feminine masculine form, root דָּהַר to clap. תָּדְרוֹן [?] and תָּדְרֹן he leapt up, future Qal, root דָּרַן. תְּדִיחֶנּוּ [?] you will drive him out, תְּדִיחֻהוּ [?] you will drive them out, future Hiphil, singular and 2nd plural masculine with suffix. Root נָדַח. תְּדִינֵנִי [?] you will judge, תְּדִינֵנִי me, future Hiphil, singular with suffix. Root דִּין. תְּדַבְּאוּ [?] you will bruise, future Piel, 2nd plural masculine. Root דָּבָא. תְּדַבְּאֵנִי [?] you will crush me, Job 19. 2, for תְּדַבְּאֵנִי [?], future Piel, with paragogic ending and suffix. Root דָּכָא. וַתִּתְלֶה [?] and they drew, Exod. 2. 16, future Qal, 3rd plural feminine. Root דָּלָה. תִּרַם [?] he will lift up, for תְּרוּם [?]. תִּרְמִי you will lift, for תִּרְמִי [?]; future Qal, 2nd and 3rd feminine. תִּרְמִי you will cut off, Jer. 48. 2, for תִּתְדַּמֵּי [?], future Hithpael, 2nd feminine singular. Root דָּמַם. תִּרְמָה it will be likened, תִּרְמִינָה they will be likened, future Qal, singular and plural. Root דָּמָה. תִּרְמִי you will be imagined, תִּרַמִּין you will liken, Isa. 40. 18 (for תִּדְמוּ [?]) תִּדְמוּנִי me, for תִּרַמְּנִי [?], future Piel, 2nd feminine singular and 2nd plural masculine, with paragogic ending and suffix. Root דָּמָה. תֵּדַע you will know, וְתֵדְעִי and you may know her, תֵּדְעִין you know them, תֵּדְעִין you will be known, future Qal, 2nd feminine singular with suffix, as also 2nd feminine plural and 2nd plural masculine with paragogic ending. Root יָדַע.

units.la: תְּהוֹתְּתוּ producetis sermonem, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. הָתַת.
units.tr: תְּהוֹתְּתוּ you will produce speech, future Piel, 2nd plural masculine. Root הָתַת.

units.la: תִּהְיֶה eris, (apoc. pro) תִּהְיֶה; תִּהְיוּ eritis, m. תִּהְיֶנָה & תִּהְיֶנָה eritis, f. &c. fut. Kal, 2. sing. & plur, Rad. הָיָה.
units.tr: תִּהְיֶה you will be, (apocopated for) תִּהְיֶה; תִּהְיוּ you will be, masculine. תִּהְיֶנָה and תִּהְיֶנָה you will be, feminine, etc. Future Qal, 2nd singular and plural. Root הָיָה.

units.la: תְּהוֹמְמָנָה perstrepent, Mich. 2. 12. pro תְּהֵימֶנָה, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. f. Rad. הוּם.
units.tr: תְּהוֹמְמָנָה they will roar, Mich. 2. 12, for תְּהֵימֶנָה, future Hiphil, 3rd plural feminine. Root הוּם.

units.la: וַתְּהוּנוּ & voluistis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. הִין.
units.tr: וַתְּהוּנוּ and you wished, future Hiphil, 2nd plural masculine. Root הִין.

units.la: תָּהֵל splendebit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. R. הָלַל.
units.tr: תָּהֵל it will shine, future Hiphil, 3rd feminine singular. Root הָלַל.

units.la: תַּהֲלָה splendor, No. sing. fæm. Rad. הָלַל הָלַל insanivit.
units.tr: תַּהֲלָה splendour, noun singular feminine. Root הָלַל; הָלַל he went mad.

units.la: תְּהִלָּתוֹ, תְּהִלָּתְךָ, תְּהִלָּה laus, ejus, tua, תְּהִלּוֹת laudes, (unde etiam in plur. masc. תְּהִלִּים laudes seu Psalmi ; est titulus libri Psalmorum) No. f. f.
units.tr: תְּהִלָּתוֹ, תְּהִלָּתְךָ, תְּהִלָּה praise, his, thy; תְּהִלּוֹת praises (whence also in the masculine plural תְּהִלִּים praises, or Psalms; it is the title of the book of Psalms), noun feminine.

units.la: constr. & aff. & No. p l. fæm. & pl. m.) Rad. הָלַל insanivit.
units.tr: construct and suffixed, and noun plural feminine and plural masculine.) Root הָלַל he went mad.

units.la: תְּהֹלְלוּ insaniatis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. הלל.
units.tr: תְּהֹלְלוּ you go mad, future Qal, 2nd plural masculine. Root הלל.

units.la: תְּהַלֵּךְ ambulabit, Pf. 37. 9. pro תְּהַלּוּךְ, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. הלך.
units.tr: תְּהַלֵּךְ he will walk, Ps. 37. 9, for תְּהַלּוּךְ, future Qal, 3rd feminine singular. Root הלך.

units.la: תְּהַלֹּכֹת progressiones, No. pl. f. Rad. הלך.
units.tr: תְּהַלֹּכֹת goings, noun plural feminine. Root הלך.

units.la: תְּהַלֵּל laudabit, fut. Piel, sing. Rad. הלל.
units.tr: תְּהַלֵּל he will praise, future Piel, singular. Root הלל.

units.la: וַיִּתְהֹם & tumultuata est, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. הום.
units.tr: וַיִּתְהֹם and it was tumultuous, future Niphal, 3rd feminine singular. Root הום.

units.la: תְּהַמֵּי perstrepes, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. Rad. המה.
units.tr: תְּהַמֵּי you roar, future Qal, 2nd feminine singular. Root המה.

units.la: וּתְהַמֵּם & conteres eos, Pf. 144. 6. fut. Kal, 2. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. המם.
units.tr: וּתְהַמֵּם and you will crush them, Ps. 144. 6, future Qal, 2nd masculine singular with prefix and suffix. Root המם.

units.la: תְּהַפֵּךְ verteris, fut. Niph. sing. Rad. הפך.
units.tr: תְּהַפֵּךְ you will be turned, future Niphal, singular. Root הפך.

units.la: וַתְּהַר & concepit, fut. Kal, 3. f. fæm. apoc. (pro תִּהְרֶה,) R. הרה.
units.tr: וַתְּהַר and she conceived, future Qal, 3rd feminine singular, apocopated (for תִּהְרֶה), Root הרה.

units.la: תִּהָרַגְנָה occidentur, fut. Niph. plur. R. הרג.
units.tr: תִּהָרַגְנָה they will be slain, future Niphal, plural. Root הרג.

units.la: תַּהֲרוּ concipietis, רַתַּהֲרֶיןָ & conceperunt, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. & 3. pl. f. Rad. הָרָה.
units.tr: תַּהֲרוּ you will conceive, רַתַּהֲרֶיןָ and they conceived, future Qal, 2nd plural masculine and 3rd plural feminine. Root הָרָה.

units.la: תַּהְרוֹס destrues, fut. Kal, תְּהָרֵס destruetur, fut. Niph. תְּהָרֵס destrues, destruet, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. הָרַס.
units.tr: תַּהְרוֹס you will destroy, future Qal; תְּהָרֵס it will be destroyed, future Niphal; תְּהָרֵס you will destroy, he will destroy, future Piel, 2nd masculine singular or 3rd feminine singular. Root הָרַס.

units.la: תְּהַתְּלוּ illuseritis, pro תְּהַתְּלוּ, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. הָתַל.
units.tr: תְּהַתְּלוּ you will mock, for תְּהַתְּלוּ, future Piel, 2nd plural masculine. Root הָתַל.

units.la: ת ו
units.tr: Tav-Vav [ת ו]

units.la: הַתּוֹ signum, תָוֵי meum, No. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. תָּוָה signare. [?]
units.tr: hatto [הַתּוֹ], sign; tavai [תָוֵי], my sign. Noun, f. m., with prefix and suffix. Root tavah [תָּוָה], to mark. (?)

units.la: כְּתוֹא sicut bubalus, No. f. m. præf. Rad. תָּאָה determinare.
units.tr: kethoa [כְּתוֹא], like a wild ox. Noun, f. m., with prefix. Root ta'ah [תָּאָה], to determine.

units.la: תּוֹאֵמִם gemelliparæ, Part. Ben. Kal, pl. m. Rad. תָּאַם.
units.tr: to'amim [תּוֹאֵמִם], bearing twins. Participle benoni, Kal, pl. m. Root ta'am [תָּאַם].

units.la: תּוּבָא voles, Prov. 1. 10. pro תּוּבָה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. אָבָה.
units.tr: tuba [תּוּבָא], you will, Prov. 1. 10., for tuba [תּוּבָה]. Future Kal, 2nd sing. fem. Root avah [אָבָה].

units.la: תּוּבַל adducetur, תֻּבְלוּן deducenimi, תּוּבְלָה educentur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. f. 2. pl. m. parag. ut & 3. pl. f. Rad. יָבַל.
units.tr: tubal [תּוּבַל], shall be brought; tubelun [תֻּבְלוּן], you shall be led down; tubelah [תּוּבְלָה], shall be led out. Future Hoph., 3rd sing. fem., 2nd pl. masc. (paragogic), and 3rd pl. fem. Root yaval [יָבַל].

units.la: תּוֹנֵן merore afficietis, Job. 19.2. pro תּוֹנּוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. יָגָה.
units.tr: tonen [תּוֹנֵן], you will afflict with grief, Job 19. 2., for tonu [תּוֹנּוּ]. Future Hiph., 2nd pl. masc., paragogic. Root yagah [יָגָה].

units.la: תּוּגַת meror, f. fæm. constr. No. תּוּגַה; Rad. יָגָה maerore affecit.
units.tr: tugat [תּוּגַת], grief. Noun, f. sing., construct form of tugah [תּוּגַה]. Root yagah [יָגָה], he afflicted with grief.

units.la: תּוֹרָה celebratio, תּוֹרוֹת laudationes, No. f. & pl. fæm. Rad. יָרָה jecit.
units.tr: torah [תּוֹרָה], celebration; torot [תּוֹרוֹת], praises. Nouns, f. sing. and pl. fem. Root yarah [יָרָה], he cast.

units.la: תּוֹדִיעַ notum facies, תּוֹדִיעֵנִי mihi, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָדַע.
units.tr: todia [תּוֹדִיעַ], you make known; todia'eni [תּוֹדִיעֵנִי], make me known. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc., with suffix. Root yada' [יָדַע].

units.la: תּוֹרֵךְ celebrabit te, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. תּוֹרָה, aff. Rad. יָדָה.
units.tr: tora'ech [תּוֹרֵךְ], he will celebrate you. Future Hiph., 3rd sing. fem., from torah [תּוֹרָה], with suffix. Root yadah [יָדָה].

units.la: תּוֹדֵעַ notus fies, תּוֹדְעִי nota fies, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. & f. Rad. יָדַע.
units.tr: todea' [תּוֹדֵעַ], you will be made known; todeh'i [תּוֹדְעִי], you will be made known. Future Niph., 2nd sing. masc. and fem. Root yada' [יָדַע].

units.la: תּוֹהֵל expectabis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. יָחַל.
units.tr: tohel [תּוֹהֵל], you will wait. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. Root yachal [יָחַל].

units.la: תּוֹחַלְתִּי spes mea, תּוֹחַלְתּוֹ ejus, No. sing. fem. תּוֹחַלְתָּהּ, aff. Rad. יָחַל.
units.tr: tochaltí [תּוֹחַלְתִּי], my hope; tochaltô [תּוֹחַלְתּוֹ], his hope. Noun, sing. fem., tochaltah [תּוֹחַלְתָּהּ], with suffix. Root yachal [יָחַל].

units.la: תּוֹךְ medium, תּוֹכוֹ ejus, תּוֹכִי meum, תּוֹכְךָ tuum, תּוֹכָם eorum, No. f. m. constr. aff. No. Rad. תָּוֶךְ medium.
units.tr: tôch [תּוֹךְ], middle; tocho [תּוֹכוֹ], his; tochi [תּוֹכִי], my; tochcha [תּוֹכְךָ], your; tocham [תּוֹכָם], their. Noun, f. m., construct, with suffixes. Root tavech [תָּוֶךְ], middle.

units.la: תּוֹךְ, vel תּוֹךְ delus vel medium, No. f. m. Rad. תָּכְךָ; vel constr. à No. Rad. תָּוֶךְ medium.
units.tr: tôch [תּוֹךְ], deceit or middle. Noun, f. m. Root tachech [תָּכְךָ]; or construct form of the noun, root tavech [תָּוֶךְ], middle.

units.la: תּוֹכַח corripies, pro תּוֹבִיחַ, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. יָכַח.
units.tr: tochach [תּוֹכַח], you will rebuke, for tochiach [תּוֹבִיחַ]. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. Root yachach [יָכַח].

units.la: תּוֹכַחַת increpatio, תּוֹכַחְתִּי mea, תּוֹכָחוֹת increpationes, f. f. constr. aff. & pl. f. No. תּוֹכָחָה increpatio, Rad. יָכַח arguit.
units.tr: tochachat [תּוֹכַחַת], rebuke; tochachti [תּוֹכַחְתִּי], my rebuke; tochachot [תּוֹכָחוֹת], rebukes. Noun, f. sing. construct with suffix, and pl. fem. Noun tochachah [תּוֹכָחָה], rebuke. Root yachach [יָכַח], he argued.

units.la: תּוֹכִיחֵנִי reprehendes me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָכַח.
units.tr: tochichenî [תּוֹכִיחֵנִי], you will reprove me. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc., with suffix. Root yachach [יָכַח].

units.la: תּוֹכִיחֲךָ corripient te, Jer. 2.19. pro תּוֹכִחֲנָה ךְ; fut. Hiph. 3. pl. masc. pro fæm. aff. Rad. יָכַח.
units.tr: tochichach [תּוֹכִיחֲךָ], they will rebuke you, Jer. 2. 19., for tochachanah [תּוֹכִחֲנָה]. Future Hiph., 3rd pl. masc. for fem., with suffix. Root yachach [יָכַח].

units.la: תּוֹכַל poteris, תּוֹכְלִי pote-ritis,
units.tr: tochal [תּוֹכַל], you will be able; tochli [תּוֹכְלִי], you will be able.

units.la: ritis [?], poteris, f. fut. Kal, 2. f. & pl. m. & 2. f. f. Rad. יָכַל
units.tr: tochli (?), you will be able. Future Kal, 2nd sing. fem. and 2nd pl. masc., and 2nd sing. fem. Root yakal [יָכַל].

units.la: תּוֹלֵד nasteris [?], fut. Niph. תּוֹלִיד gignes vel gignet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָלַד
units.tr: tolad [תּוֹלֵד], you will be born (?). Future Niph. tolid [תּוֹלִיד], you will beget or he will beget. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root yalad [יָלַד].

units.la: תּוֹלְדוֹת generationes, No. pl. f. Rad. יָלַד genuit.
units.tr: toldot [תּוֹלְדוֹת], generations. Noun, pl. fem. Root yalad [יָלַד], he begot.

units.la: תּוֹלָלִין contumulatores nostri, pl. m. תּוֹלֵלִים aff. Rad. תָּלַל aggerare.
units.tr: tolalin [תּוֹלָלִין], our revilers; tolelim [תּוֹלֵלִים], with suffix, pl. masc. Root talal [תָּלַל], to heap up.

units.la: תּוֹלְעָה, תּוֹלַעַת vermis, תּוֹלָעִים coccinei, f. f. & pl. m. No. תּוֹלֵעַ; Rad. תָּלַע coccus.
units.tr: tola'ah, tola'at [תּוֹלְעָה, תּוֹלַעַת], worm; tola'im [תּוֹלָעִים], scarlet. Nouns, f. sing. and pl. masc. Noun tola' [תּוֹלֵעַ]. Root tala' [תָּלַע], scarlet dye.

units.la: תּוֹמֵךְ sustentans, Pf. 16. 5. pro תּוֹכֵךְ, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. תָּמַךְ.
units.tr: tomech [תּוֹמֵךְ], sustaining, Ps. 16. 5., for tochech [תּוֹכֵךְ]. Participle benoni, Kal, f. m. Root tamach [תָּמַךְ].

units.la: תּוֹמִם gemelli, Gen. 25. 24 pro תּוֹאֲמִים, Ben. Kal, pl. m, Rad. תָּאַם.
units.tr: tomim [תּוֹמִם], twins, Gen. 25. 24., for to'amim [תּוֹאֲמִים]. Participle benoni, Kal, pl. m. Root ta'am [תָּאַם].

units.la: תּוֹמְרוּ dicetis, pro תֹּאמְרוּ, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. אָמַר.
units.tr: tomru [תּוֹמְרוּ], you will say, for tomru [תֹּאמְרוּ]. Future Kal, 2nd pl. masc. Root amar [אָמַר].

units.la: הוּמַת morte afficieris, vel afficietur, fut. Hoph.
units.tr: humat [הוּמַת], you will be put to death or it will be put to death. Future Hoph.

units.la: 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מוּת.
units.tr: 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root mut [מוּת].

units.la: תּוֹנָה opprimes, תּוֹנֶנָּה [?], תּוֹנִי [?] opprimeris, &c. fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָנָה.
units.tr: tonah [תּוֹנָה], you will oppress; tonenah (?) [תּוֹנֶנָּה], tonî (?) [תּוֹנִי], you will be oppressed, etc. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., with suffix, and 2nd pl. masc. Root yanah [יָנָה].

units.la: תּוּסַר fundaberis, vel fundabitur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel, 3. f. f. Rad. יָסַד.
units.tr: tusar [תּוּסַר], you will be founded or it will be founded. Future Niph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root yasad [יָסַד].

units.la: תּוֹסֵף, תּוֹסֶפָּה, תּוֹסֵף, תּוֹסֵף addes, addet, תּוֹסְפוּ addetis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָסַף.
units.tr: tosef [תּוֹסֵף], you will add; tosefah [תּוֹסֶפָּה], he will add; tos'fu [תּוֹסְפוּ], you (pl.) will add. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., and 2nd pl. masc. Root yasaf [יָסַף].

units.la: תּוֹסֵף addes, pro תּוֹסֵף, vel תּוֹסְפָה, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. יָסַף.
units.tr: tosef [תּוֹסֵף], you will add, for tosefah [תּוֹסְפָה]. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. Root yasaf [יָסַף].

units.la: תּוֹסֵף recipies, Pf. 104. 29. pro תֹּאסֵף, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. אָסַף.
units.tr: tosef [תּוֹסֵף], you will receive, Ps. 104. 29., for ta'sef [תֹּאסֵף]. Future Kal, 2nd sing. masc. Root asaf [אָסַף].

units.la: תּוֹסֵף addes, Prov. 30. 6. pro תּוֹסֵף, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. יָסַף.
units.tr: tosef [תּוֹסֵף], you will add, Prov. 30. 6., for tosef. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. Root yasaf [יָסַף].

units.la: תּוּסַר castigabimini, fut. Niph. 2. pl m. R. יָסַר.
units.tr: tusar [תּוּסַר], you will be chastened. Future Niph., 2nd pl. masc. Root yasar [יָסַר].

units.la: תּוֹעֲבוֹת abominationes pl. fæm. No. תּוֹעֲבָה ; Rad. תָּעַב
units.tr: to'avot [תּוֹעֲבוֹת], abominations. Noun, pl. fem. Noun to'avah [תּוֹעֲבָה]. Root ta'av [תָּעַב].

units.la: תּוֹעֲפוֹת vires, No. pl. f. Rad. יָעַף defessus fuit.
units.tr: to'afot [תּוֹעֲפוֹת], strength. Noun, pl. fem. Root ya'af [יָעַף], he was weary.

units.la: תּוֹפְּהוּ coquet eum, 1. Sam. 28.24. pro תּאֲפֶּהוּ, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. aff. Rad. אָפָה.
units.tr: tofehu [תּוֹפְּהוּ], she will bake it, 1 Sam. 28. 24., for ta'afeh [תּאֲפֶּהוּ]. Future Kal, 3rd sing. fem., with suffix. Root afah [אָפָה].

units.la: תּוֹפָּה illuxisses, illuxisset, fut. Hiph. 2. f m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָפַע
units.tr: tofah [תּוֹפָּה], you would have shone, it would have shone. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root yafa' [יָפַע].

units.la: תּוֹפְּפוֹת tympana pulsantes, pro תּוֹכְּפוֹת, Ben. Kal, pl. f. vel No. pl. f. Rad. תָּפַף
units.tr: tofpot [תּוֹפְּפוֹת], beating the timbrels, for tochpot [תּוֹכְּפוֹת]. Participle benoni, Kal, pl. fem., or noun, pl. fem. Root tafaf [תָּפַף].

units.la: תּוֹצְא proferes, educet, pro תּוֹצִיא, נִי me, נוּ eum, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָצָא
units.tr: totze [תּוֹצְא], you will bring forth, he will lead out, for totzi' [תּוֹצִיא], with me (ni), him (nu). Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., with suffix. Root yatza' [יָצָא].

units.la: תּוֹצָאוֹת exitus, No. pl. f. Rad. יָצָא exivit.
units.tr: totza'ot [תּוֹצָאוֹת], issues. Noun, pl. fem. Root yatza' [יָצָא], he went out.

units.la: תּוּקַּ succenderis, succendetur, fut. Hoph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָקַד
units.tr: tuk [תּוּקַּ], you will be burned, it will be burned. Future Hoph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root yakad [יָקַד].

units.la: תּוּקַשׁ illaqueeris, illaqueetur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָקַשׁ
units.tr: tukash [תּוּקַשׁ], you will be ensnared, it will be ensnared. Future Niph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root yakash [יָקַשׁ].

units.la: לִתּוּר ad explorandum, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. תּוּר.
units.tr: lithur [לִתּוּר], to explore. Infinitive Kal, with prefix. Root tur [תּוּר].

units.la: תּוּרָא timearis, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. R. יָרָא
units.tr: tura [תּוּרָא], you will be feared. Future Niph., 2nd sing. masc. Root yara' [יָרָא].

units.la: תּוּרַד dejicieris, fut. Hoph. תּוּרִידָם dejicies vel dejiciet eos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָרַד
units.tr: tured [תּוּרַד], you will be cast down. Future Hoph. turidam [תּוּרִידָם], you will cast them down or he will cast them down. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., with suffix. Root yarad [יָרַד].

units.la: תּוֹרֶה docebis vel docebit, תּוֹרְךָ te, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָרָה
units.tr: tore [תּוֹרֶה], you will teach or he will teach; torcha [תּוֹרְךָ], you. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., with suffix. Root yarah [יָרָה].

units.la: תּוּרְךָ turtur tuus, תּוֹרִים vel תּוֹרִים turtures, ordines, f. m. aff. & pl. m. No. תּוֹר; Rad. תּוּר scrutatus est.
units.tr: turcha [תּוּרְךָ], your turtle-dove; torim or torim [תּוֹרִים], turtle-doves, rows. Noun, f. m. with suffix, and pl. m. Noun tor [תּוֹר]. Root tur [תּוּר], he searched.

units.la: תּוֹרֵם docebis vel docebit eos, fut. Hiph, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָרָה
units.tr: torem [תּוֹרֵם], you will teach them or he will teach them. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., with suffix. Root yarah [יָרָה].

units.la: תּוּרַק evacuatur, fut. Hoph. 3. f. f. R. רִיק
units.tr: turak [תּוּרַק], is emptied. Future Hoph., 3rd sing. fem. Root riq [רִיק].

units.la: תּוֹרִישׁ pauper fias, fut. Niph. תּוֹרִישׁ expelles, expellet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָרַשׁ תוֹרָה lex, תוֹרוֹת leges, תּוֹרָתוֹ lex ejus, תּוֹרָתְךָ tua, No. f. f. constr. & aff. & pl. f. Rad. יָרָה pro-jecit. תּוֹשָׁבִים inquilinus, תּוֹשָׁבִים inquilini, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָשַׁב sedit. תּוּשַׁב habitaberis, vel habitabitur, fut. Hoph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָשַׁב תּוּשַׁד vastaberis, vastabitur, fut. Hoph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁדַד תּוֹשִׁיב habitare facies, נִי me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. יָשַׁב תּוּשִׁיָּה substantia, No. sing. fæm. Rad. יֵשׁ, vel יֵשָׁה est, sunt. תּוּשִׁיעַ servabis, servabit, נִי me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָשַׁע תּוּשָׁעוּ servaberis, servabitur, תּוּשְׁעִי servaberis, f. תּוּשְׁעוּן servabimini, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. f. f. & 2. pl. m. parag. R. יָשַׁע. תּוֹתִּירוּ reliquum facietis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. יָתַר תּוֹתַר fies excellens, pro תּוֹתַר, fut. Hoph. 2. f. m. Rad. יָתַר
units.tr: torish [תּוֹרִישׁ], you will become poor. Future Niph. torish [תּוֹרִישׁ], you will drive out, he will drive out. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. fem. or masc., or 3rd sing. fem. Root yarash [יָרַשׁ]. torah [תּוֹרָה], law; torot [תּוֹרוֹת], laws; torato [תּוֹרָתוֹ], his law; toratecha [תּוֹרָתְךָ], your law. Noun, f. sing. construct and with suffix, and pl. fem. Root yarah [יָרָה], he cast. toshavim [תּוֹשָׁבִים], sojourner; toshavim [תּוֹשָׁבִים], sojourners. Noun, f. and pl. m. Root yashav [יָשַׁב], he dwelt. tushav [תּוּשַׁב], you will be inhabited or it will be inhabited. Future Hoph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root yashav [יָשַׁב]. tushad [תּוּשַׁד], you will be laid waste, it will be laid waste. Future Hoph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root shadad [שָׁדַד]. toshiv [תּוֹשִׁיב], you will make to dwell, with me [נִי]. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc., with suffix. Root yashav [יָשַׁב]. tushiyah [תּוּשִׁיָּה], substance. Noun, sing. fem. Root yesh [יֵשׁ], or yeshah [יֵשָׁה], is, are. tushia' [תּוּשִׁיעַ], you will save, he will save, with me [נִי]. Future Hiph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., with suffix. Root yasha' [יָשַׁע]. tushe'u [תּוּשָׁעוּ], you will be saved, it will be saved; tush'i [תּוּשְׁעִי], you will be saved, fem.; tush'un [תּוּשְׁעוּן], you (pl.) will be saved. Future Niph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., as well as 2nd sing. fem. and 2nd pl. masc., paragogic. Root yasha' [יָשַׁע]. totiru [תּוֹתִּירוּ], you (pl.) will leave a remainder. Future Hiph., 2nd pl. masc. Root yatar [יָתַר]. totar [תּוֹתַר], you will become excellent, for totar [תּוֹתַר]. Future Hoph., 2nd sing. masc. Root yatar [יָתַר].

units.la: ת ז תָּזוּב profluës vel profluet, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. זוּב. תְּזוֹרֶה comprimet illud, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. תָּזוּר, aff. Rad. זוּר. תִּזִּירוּ superbè agetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. זוּר. תִּזְכֶּה purus sis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. R. זָכָה. תִּזְכֹּר memoreris, mentio fiat, תִּזְכְּרִי memoreris, f. תִּזְכֹּרָן commemorabi-mini, buntur[?], (pro נָה) fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. זָכַר [?]
units.tr: Tav-Zayin [ת ז]: tazuv [תָּזוּב], you will flow or it will flow. Future Kal, 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem. Root zuv [זוּב]. tezoreh [תְּזוֹרֶה], he will restrain it. Future Kal, 3rd sing. fem., tazur [תָּזוּר], with suffix. Root zur [זוּר]. tizzeru [תִּזִּירוּ], you (pl.) will act proudly. Future Hiph., 2nd pl. masc. Root zur [זוּר]. tizkeh [תִּזְכֶּה], you will be pure. Future Kal, 2nd sing. masc. Root zakah [זָכָה]. tizkor [תִּזְכֹּר], you will be remembered, mention will be made; tizkeri [תִּזְכְּרִי], you will be remembered, fem.; tizkoran [תִּזְכֹּרָן], you (pl.) will be commemorated. Future Niph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., and 2nd sing. fem. and 2nd or 3rd pl. fem. Root zakar [זָכַר] (?).

units.la: תִּזַּל [?] fluet, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. נָזַל [?]
units.tr: tizzal [תִּזַּל] (?), it will flow. Future Kal, 3rd sing. fem. Root nazal [נָזַל] (?).

units.la: תִּזְלִי [?] ibis, Jer. 2. 36. (pro תֵּאוֹלִי [?], ex forma Chald.) fut. Kal, 2. sing. fæm. Rad. אָזַל [?]
units.tr: tizli (?) [תִּזְלִי], you will go, Jer. 2. 36., for te'oli [תֵּאוֹלִי] (?), from the Chaldee form. Future Kal, 2nd sing. fem. Root azal [אָזַל] (?).

units.la: וַתִּזֶּן [?] & scortata est, es, וַתִּזֹּנָה [?] & scortata es cum illis, תִּזֹּנָה [?] scor-tabimini, buntur, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. (apoc. pro תִּזֹּנָה [?],) & 2. f. f. aff. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. זָנָה [?]
units.tr: [vattizen] she played the harlot; [vattizzonah] you played the harlot with them; [tizzonah] you will play the harlot, you (pl.) will play the harlot, they will play the harlot; future Kal, 3rd fem. (apocopated) and 2nd fem. sing., also 2nd or 3rd fem. pl. Root: zanah.

units.la: וַתִּזְנֶה [?] & scortari fecisti, fecit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. זָנָה [?]
units.tr: [vattizneh] you caused to play the harlot, she caused to play the harlot; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: zanah.

units.la: תִּזְנוּתֵךְ [?] scortatio tua, No. f. f. aff. R. זְנָה [?] scorta-tus est.
units.tr: [tizenutekh] your harlotry; noun fem. sing. with suffix. Root: zanah, he played the harlot.

units.la: תִּזָּנִי [?] scortaberis, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. pro תִּזֹּנָה [?]; Rad. זָנָה [?]
units.tr: [tizzani] you will be a harlot; future Kal, 2nd fem. sing. (for [tizzonah]). Root: zanah.

units.la: תְּזֹרֶה [?] disperges, get, תְּזֹרֵם [?] eos, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. זָרָה [?]
units.tr: [tezoreh] you will scatter, scatter; [tezorem] them; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix. Root: zarah.

units.la: וַתְּזַרְנִי [?] & accinxisti me, 2. Sam. 22. 40. (pro תְּאַזְּרֵנִי [?],) fut. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. אָזַר [?]
units.tr: [vattezarni] and you girded me, 2 Sam. 22. 40 (for [te'azzerenni]); future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. with suffix. Root: azar.

units.la: תִּזְרָע [?] feminaberis, bitur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. זָרַע [?]
units.tr: [tizra] you will be made fruitful, it will be made fruitful; future Niph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: zara.

units.la: ת ח [?]
units.tr: T, Ch

units.la: תִּחְבָּא [?] abscondet te, fut. Niph. וַתִּחָבֵא [?] & ab-scondis, vel dit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. Rad. חָבָא [?]
units.tr: [tichba] he will hide you; future Niph.; [vattichaveh] and you hide, or she hides; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chaba.

units.la: תַּחְגּוּ [?] celebrabitis, תַּחְגֵּי [?] eum, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. aff. Rad. חָגַג [?]
units.tr: [tachgu] you (pl.) will celebrate; [tachgei] him; future Kal, 2nd masc. pl. with suffix. Root: chagag.

units.la: תְּחַגְּרְנָה [?] accingetis, vel gent se, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. חָגַר [?]
units.tr: [techagnah] you will gird, or they gird themselves; future Kal, 2nd or 3rd fem. pl. Root: chagar.

units.la: תְּחַוֵּר [?] adulator, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָוַר [?]
units.tr: [techavvar] you will flatter; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chavar.

units.la: תְּחַדְּרֵהוּ [?] exhilarasti eum, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. תְּחַדֵּהוּ [?] aff. Rad. חָדָה [?]
units.tr: [techaddereihu] you cheered him; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing., with suffix [techaddeihu]. Root: chadah.

units.la: יָחוּל [?] dolebit, וַיָּחֹל [?] & do-luit, bit, fut. Kal, תְּחִילֶ exspecta, vel parturit, תְּחוֹלְלֶכֶם quae formavit vos, fut. Piel, (aff.) 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חול
units.tr: [yachul] he will grieve; [vayachol] and he grieved, he grieves; future Kal. [techile] wait, or she travails; [techolelekhem] who formed you; future Piel (with suffix), 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chul.

units.la: תְּחוֹם parcas, vel parcat, pro תְּחוֹם, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חם
units.tr: [techom] you spare, or she spares (for [techom]); future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chamam.

units.la: וַתְּחֱזֶה & videbis, vel videbit, (apoc. pro תְּחֱזֶה) תֶּחֱזוּ videbitis, תֶּחֱזֶינָה videbitis vel videbunt, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. חזה
units.tr: [vattechezeh] and you will see, or she will see (apocopated for [techezeh]); [techezu] you (pl.) will see; [techezeinah] you will see, they will see; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., 2nd masc. pl., and 2nd or 3rd fem. pl. Root: chazah.

units.la: וַתְּחֲטָא & peccare fecisti, vel fecit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חטא
units.tr: [vattechata] and you caused to sin, or she caused to sin; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chata.

units.la: תְּחִי vives, vivet, (apoc. pro תִּהְיֶה) תְּחִי vives, תִּחְיוּן vivetis, תְּחֱיֶינָה vivetis, vivent, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. parag. & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. חיה
units.tr: [techi] you will live, she will live (apocopated for [tihyeh]); [techi] you will live; [tichyun] you (pl.) will live; [techeyenah] you will live, they will live; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., 2nd fem. sing., 2nd masc. pl. with paragogic ending, and 2nd or 3rd fem. pl. Root: chayah.

units.la: תְּחַיֶּה vivificabis, bit, תְּחַיֵּנִי, vel תְּחַיֵּנִי me, pro תְּחַיֵּנוּ & תְּחַיֵּנוּ nos, pro תִּחְיֶה in vita conservabitis תְּחַיֶּין vivas conservabitis, bunt, (pro נה) fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. & 2. pl. m. parag. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. חיה
units.tr: [techayyeh] you will give life, he will give life; [techayyeni] me, for [techayyenu]; [techayyenu] us, for [techayyenu]; [tichyeh] you will keep alive; [techayyen] you will keep alive, they will keep alive (for [-nah]); future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. with suffix, 2nd masc. pl. with paragogic ending, and 2nd or 3rd fem. pl. Root: chayah.

units.la: תְּחִילֶן dolebis, bit, תְּחִילוּ trepidabitis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. חיל
units.tr: [techilen] you will grieve, she will grieve; [techilu] you (pl.) will tremble; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., and 2nd masc. pl. with paragogic ending. Root: chil.

units.la: תְּחַכֶּה exspectabis, vel bit, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חכה
units.tr: [techakkeh] you will wait, or she will wait; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chakah.

units.la: תָּחִיל trepidabis vel bit, וַתְּחֶל & trepidas, vel dat, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חיל
units.tr: [tachil] you will tremble, or she will tremble; [vattechel] and you trembled, or she gives; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chil.

units.la: תְּחַל incipies, vel piet, (pro) תְּחֵלוּ, תְּחֵל incipietis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. חלל: vel, תְּחַל profanat se, est pro תְּחַל, fut. Niph. 3. f. fæm.
units.tr: [tachel] you will begin, or he will begin (for [techelu]); [techelu] you (pl.) will begin; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., and 2nd masc. pl. Root: chalal. Or: [tachel] he profanes himself, which is for [tachel]; future Niph., 3rd fem. sing. Root: chalal.

units.la: Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: Root: chalal.

units.la: תַּחְלוּאִים infirmitates, (vel, תַּחְלוּאֵי ל[?], תַּחְלוּאָיָה[?], ejus, תַּחְלוּאֵיכִי[?] tuae, (pro ךָ.ְ[?]) No. pl. m. constr. aff. cum א pro ה, Rad. חָלָה ægrotavit.
units.tr: [tachluim] infirmities (or [tachluei] of him, [tachluyah] of her, [tachluekhi] of you, for [...]); noun masc. pl. construct and suffixed, with aleph for he. Root: chalah, he was sick.

units.la: תַּחְלֵימֵנִי revalescere faci-es me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. חָלַם somniavit.
units.tr: [tachlimeni] you cause me to recover; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. with suffix. Root: chalam, he dreamed.

units.la: וַתַּחְלֶינָה & cæperunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. fæm. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: [vattachlenah] and they began; future Hiph., 3rd fem. pl. Root: chalal.

units.la: תַּחֲלֵל profanabis, vel bit, תַּחְלְלוּ profanabitis, וַתַּחְלֶלְנָה & profanatis, vel nant, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. fæm. Rad. חָלַל.
units.tr: [tachalel] you will profane, or he will profane; [tachalelu] you (pl.) will profane; [vattachalenah] and you profaned, or they profane; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., 2nd masc. pl., and 2nd or 3rd fem. pl. Root: chalal.

units.la: תִּחְלַק dividéris, vel etur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָלַק.
units.tr: [tichlak] you will be divided, or it will be divided; future Niph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chalak.

units.la: תְּחִלַּת initium, f. f. constr. No. תְּחִלָּה ; Rad. חלל perforari.
units.tr: [techilat] beginning; noun fem. sing. construct; [techillah] (absolute form). Root: chalal, to be pierced.

units.la: תַּחֹם incalescet, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. R. חָמַם.
units.tr: [tachom] it will grow hot; future Niph., 3rd fem. sing. Root: chamam.

units.la: תְּחַמֵּם calefacies, vel faciet; fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָמַם.
units.tr: [techammem] you will warm, or she will make warm; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chamam.

units.la: וַתַּחְמְרָה, vel ה & bituminavit eam, Exod. 2. 3. fut. Kal, 3. f. f. parag. vel aff. Rad. חָמַר.
units.tr: [vattachmerah] and she smeared it with bitumen, Exod. 2. 3.; future Kal, 3rd fem. sing., with paragogic he or suffix. Root: chamar.

units.la: תְּחֹן, vel תְּחוֹן gratiam facias, vel at, תְּחָנֵם eis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. R. חָנַן.
units.tr: [techon] you will show favour, or she will; [techonem] to them; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix. Root: chanan.

units.la: תַּחֲנָה castra metaberis, vel tur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָנָה.
units.tr: [tachanah] you will pitch camp, or it will be pitched; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chanah.

units.la: תַּחֲנוּנִים deprecationes, תַּחֲנוּנֹתַי meae, No. pl. m. constr. & aff. & pl. f. aff. R. חָנַן gratiosus fuit.
units.tr: [tachanunim] supplications; [tachanunotai] my; noun masc. pl. construct and suffixed, and fem. pl. with suffix. Root: chanan, he was gracious.

units.la: תַּחֲנָתִי deprecatio mea, f. f. aff. No. תַּחֲנָה ; Rad. חָנַן.
units.tr: [tachanati] my supplication; noun fem. sing. with suffix, from [tachanah]. Root: chanan.

units.la: תָּחֹס parcas, vel parcat, וַתָּחֹס & pepercisti, vel cit, fut. Kal; 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חוּס.
units.tr: [tachos] you will spare, or she will spare; [vattachos] and you spared, or she spared; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chus.

units.la: תָּחְסֶה sperabis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel, 3. f. f. Rad. חָסָה.
units.tr: [tachseh] you will hope, or she will hope; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: chasah.

units.la: תַּחְסֹם obturabis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. חָסַם.
units.tr: [tachsom] you will stop up; future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. Root: chasam.

units.la: וַתֵּחָן[?] & dividetnr, Dan. 11. 4. (pro תַּחְצָה,) fut. Niph. 3. f. f. apoc. Rad. חָצָה.
units.tr: [vattechan] and it will be divided, Dan. 11. 4. (for [tachtzah]); future Niph., 3rd fem. sing., apocopated. Root: chatzah.

units.la: תַּחְרָא lorica, No. f. m. R. תחר.
units.tr: [tachra] coat of mail; noun fem. sing. Root: tachar.

units.la: תַּחְרִים devovebis, vel bit, תַּחְרִימֵם eos, devovebitis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. & 2. pl. m. Rad. חָרַם.
units.tr: [tachrim] you will devote, or she will devote; [tachrimem] them; you (pl.) will devote; future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix and 2nd masc. pl. Root: charam.

units.la: תַּחְרֵשׁ araberis, vel tur, תַּחְשֵׁב reputaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָרַשׁ, & חָשַׁב.
units.tr: [tachrash] you will be ploughed, or it will be ploughed; [tachshev] you will be reckoned, or it will be reckoned; future Niph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Roots: charash and chashav.

units.la: תַּחְשְׁבֵנִי reputant me, Job. 19. 15. Vide in Clavi Hebr. pro תַּחְשׁוּבְנָה אוֹתִי; fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. aff. R. חָשַׁב.
units.tr: [tachshevni] they reckon me, Job 19. 15. See the Clavis Hebraica for [tachshuvnah oti]; future Kal, 3rd fem. pl. with suffix. Root: chashav.

units.la: תָּחְשִׁים pelles taxeæ, pl. m. No. Rad. תַּחַשׁ taxus, melis.
units.tr: [tachshim] badger skins; noun masc. pl. Root: [tachash], badger, melis.

units.la: תַּחַת descendes, vel det, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. (pro תְּנַחַת,) Rad. נָחַת.
units.tr: [tachat] you will go down, or he will go down (for [tenachat]); future Kal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: nachat.

units.la: תַּחַת, vel תָּחַת consternator, תַּחְחוּ, vel תָּחֲחוּ consternemini, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. חָתַת.
units.tr: [tachat] you will be dismayed, or she will be dismayed; [tachachu] you (pl.) will be dismayed; future Niph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., and 2nd masc. pl. Root: chatat.

units.la: הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה, תַּחְתּוֹנָה inferior, & plur. מֵהַתַּחְתּוֹנוֹת ab inferioribus, No. sing. masc. תַּחְתּוֹן inferior, parag. ut & No. f. & pl. f. præf. à part. Rad. תַּחַת subter.
units.tr: [hatachtonah] the lower; plural [mehatachtonot] from the lower ones; noun masc. sing. [tachton] lower, with paragogic ending; noun fem. and pl. fem., with preposition from the particle. Root: tachat, under.

units.la: תַּחְתִּי sub me, יְ loco ejus, יְנוּ pro nobis, qu. in forma f. m. & pl. m. aff. à part. Rad. תַּחַת.
units.tr: [tachtai] under me; [-ei] in its place; [-enu] for us; found in masc. and fem. pl. forms with suffix, from the particle. Root: tachat.

units.la: תַּחְתִּי inferior, יָה, יִת, infima, יִם, יוֹת inferiora, No. f. & pl. m. & fæm. à part. Rad. תַּחַת.
units.tr: [tachti] lower; [-iah], [-it] lowest; [-im], [-ot] lower ones; noun masc. and fem., sing. and pl., from the particle. Root: tachat.

units.la: וַיִּתְחַתֹּם & obsignavit fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. חָתַם [?].
units.tr: [vaiyitchatom] and he sealed; future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. Root: chatam.

units.la: ת ט
units.tr: T, Ṭ

units.la: inclinabis, vel bit, (apoc. pro תַּטֶּה,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָטָה.
units.tr: [tatteh] you will incline, or he will incline (apocopated for [tatteh]); future Hiph., 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. Root: natah.

units.la: declinaveris, vel rit, (apoc. pro תְּטֶה,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָטָה.
units.tr: you shall decline, or she shall decline (apocopated for תַּטֶּה), future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root נָטָה.

units.la: stillabitis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. נָטַף.
units.tr: you shall drip, future Hiphil, 2nd person plural masculine. Root נָטַף.

units.la: polluetis vos, (pro תְּתַטְּמְאוּ,) fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. טָמָא.
units.tr: you shall defile yourselves (for תִּתַּטְּמְאוּ), future Hithpael, 2nd person plural masculine. Root טָמָא.

units.la: plantabis, vel bit, plantabitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָטַע.
units.tr: you shall plant, or he shall plant, or you shall plant (plural), future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular and 2nd person masculine plural. Root נָטַע.

units.la: stillabitis, vel bunt, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. נָטַף.
units.tr: you shall drip, or they shall drip, future Kal, 2nd or 3rd person feminine plural. Root נָטַף.

units.la: servabis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f m. vel 3.
units.tr: you shall keep, or she shall keep, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root נָטַר.

units.la: f. f. Rad. נָטַר.
units.tr: Root נָטַר.

units.la: deseres, vel ret, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָטַשׁ.
units.tr: you shall forsake, or she shall forsake, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root נָטַשׁ.

units.la: deseres me, fut. Kal, 2. sing. m. aff. Rad. נָטַשׁ.
units.tr: you shall forsake me, future Kal, 2nd person singular masculine with suffix. Root נָטַשׁ.

units.la: ת׳
units.tr: ת׳

units.la: vociferata fuit, fut. Piel, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. יָבַב.
units.tr: she has cried out, future Piel, 3rd person singular feminine. Root יָבַב.

units.la: exaresces, fut. Kal, arefacies, vel et, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָבֵשׁ.
units.tr: you shall dry up, future Kal; you shall make dry, or she shall make dry, future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָבֵשׁ.

units.la: fatigabis, vel gabit, ipsum, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָנַע.
units.tr: you shall weary, or she shall weary him, future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix. Root יָנַע.

units.la: labores, vel ret, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָגַע.
units.tr: you shall labour, or she shall labour, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָגַע.

units.la: melior videberis, vel tur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָטַב.
units.tr: you shall be made better, or he shall be made better, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָטַב.

units.la: benefeceris, vel rit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel
units.tr: you shall do good, or she shall do good, future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular or
3rd person feminine singular.

units.la: 3. f. f. Rad. יָטַב[?]
units.tr: 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָטַב[?]

units.la: תִּיכוֹנָה[?] medianum, וּמֵהַתִּיכֹנוֹת[?] & ex medianis, No. f. m. & f. ut & pl. f. praef. à No. Rad. תָּוֶךְ medium.
units.tr: תִּיכוֹנָה[?] middle, וּמֵהַתִּיכֹנוֹת[?] and from the middle ones, feminine, masculine and feminine singular and plural, formed from the noun. Root תָּוֶךְ, middle.

units.la: תִּילִילוּ ejulabitis, Jef. 65. 14. pro תִּילִילוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. יָלַל
units.tr: תִּילִילוּ you shall wail, Isa. 65. 14, for תִּילִילוּ, future Hiphil, 2nd person plural masculine. Root יָלַל.

units.la: תֵּימָן auster, meridies, תֵּימָנָה versus meridiem, No. f. m. cum ה loc. à No. Rad. יָמִין dexter, ra, rum.
units.tr: תֵּימָן south, midday; תֵּימָנָה toward the south, masculine noun with the locative ה, formed from the noun. Root יָמִין, right hand.

units.la: וַתִּינְקֵהוּ[?] & lactavisti, vel vit eum, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. R. יָנַק
units.tr: וַתִּינְקֵהוּ and you nursed him, or she nursed him, future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix. Root יָנַק.

units.la: תִּינָקִי suges, תִּינְקוּ sugetis, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָנַק
units.tr: תִּינָקִי you shall suck, תִּינְקוּ you shall suck, future Kal, 2nd person feminine singular and 2nd person plural masculine. Root יָנַק.

units.la: תְּיַסְּרֵנִי castiges, vel get me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָסַר
units.tr: תְּיַסְּרֵנִי you shall chastise, or she shall chastise me, future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix. Root יָסַר.

units.la: תִּיעֲשֶׂה fiet, Exod. 25. 31. (pro תֵּעָשֶׂה) fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. עָשָׂה
units.tr: תִּיעֲשֶׂה it shall be done, Exod. 25. 31, for תֵּעָשֶׂה, future Niphal, 3rd person feminine singular. Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: וַתִּיפִּי & pulchra fuisti, Ezech. 16. 13. fut. Kal, 2. f. f. R. יָפָה
units.tr: וַתִּיפִּי and you were beautiful, Ezek. 16. 13, future Kal, 2nd person feminine singular. Root יָפָה.

units.la: וַתִּיקַר & exarsisti, vel sit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָקַר
units.tr: וַתִּיקַר and you were kindled, or she was kindled, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָקַר.

units.la: תִּיקַר pretiosa fis, vel sit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָקַר
units.tr: תִּיקַר you are made precious, or she is made precious, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָקַר.

units.la: תִּירָא timebis, vel bit, תִּירְאוּ timebitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָרֵא
units.tr: תִּירָא you shall fear, or she shall fear, תִּירְאוּ you shall fear, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd person plural masculine. Root יָרֵא.

units.la: תִּירְשֶׁם[?] mustum eorum, No. f. m. aff. Rad. יָרַשׁ possedit.
units.tr: תִּירְשֶׁם their new wine, masculine noun with suffix. Root יָרַשׁ, he possessed.

units.la: תִּירַשׁ possidebis, vel bit, תִּירְשׁוּ possidebitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fem. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָרַשׁ.
units.tr: תִּירַשׁ you shall possess, or she shall possess, תִּירְשׁוּ you shall possess, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd person plural masculine. Root יָרַשׁ.

units.la: תְּיָשִׁים hirci, arietes, pl. m. No. Rad. תַּיִשׁ hircus, aries, caper.
units.tr: תְּיָשִׁים he-goats, rams, masculine plural noun. Root תַּיִשׁ, he-goat, ram, buck.

units.la: תִּישְׁמֶנָה desolabimini, vel buntur[?], fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. יָשַׁם.
units.tr: תִּישְׁמֶנָה you shall be made desolate, or they shall be made desolate, future Kal, 2nd or 3rd person feminine plural. Root יָשַׁם.

units.la: תִּישַׁן dormies, vel dormiet, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָשַׁר[?]
units.tr: תִּישַׁן you shall sleep, or she shall sleep, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָשַׁר[?].

units.la: וַתִּיּשַׁר[?] & rectum visum es, vel fuit, fut. Kal, תִּיָּשַׁר[?] diriges, vel get, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָשַׁר.
units.tr: וַתִּיּשַׁר and you seemed right, or it was right, future Kal; תִּיָּשַׁר you shall direct, or she shall direct, future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root יָשַׁר.

units.la: ת כ
units.tr: ת כ

units.la: וַתַּכְתָּ[?] & percussisti, vel sit, (apoc. pro תַּכָּה,) תַּכֶּנּוּ eum, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נָכָה.
units.tr: וַתַּכְתָּ and you struck, or she struck, (apocopated for תַּכָּה) תַּכֶּנּוּ she struck him, future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix. Root נָכָה.

units.la: תַךְ dolus, fraus, No. f. m. à Rad. inusit. תָּכַךְ.
units.tr: תַךְ deceit, fraud, masculine noun, from the uncommon root תָּכַךְ.

units.la: וַתַּכָּה & caligavit, Job. 17.7. (pro תַּכְהָה,) וַתַּכְהֵין & caligarunt, (pro [illegible, ~3 letters]) fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. f. Rad. כָּהָה.
units.tr: וַתַּכָּה and she grew dim, Job 17.7, (for תַּכְהָה) וַתַּכְהֵין and they grew dim, (for [illegible]) future Kal, 3rd person feminine singular and feminine plural. Root כָּהָה.

units.la: תֻּכּוּ percutiemini, fut. Hoph, 2. pl. m. R. נָכָה.
units.tr: תֻּכּוּ you shall be struck, future Hophal, 2nd person plural masculine. Root נָכָה.

units.la: תֻּכּוּ medientur, Deut. 33. 3. præt. Pual, 3. pl. Rad. תָּכָה; vel, ut quidam deducunt, potest esse à Rad. תָּוָךְ, vel תָּכַךְ.
units.tr: תֻּכּוּ they shall be healed, Deut. 33. 3, perfect Pual, 3rd person plural. Root תָּכָה; or, as some derive it, it may be from the root תָּוָךְ or תָּכַךְ.

units.la: תִּכְוֶה[?] uretis, vel uretur,
units.tr: תִּכְוֶה you shall burn, or it shall be burned,

units.la: תִּכָּוֶינָה[?] uremini, vel urentur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. כָּוָה.
units.tr: תִּכָּוֶינָה you shall be burned, or they shall be burned, future Niphal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd or 3rd person feminine plural. Root כָּוָה.

units.la: תִּכּוֹן stabilieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כּוֹן.
units.tr: תִּכּוֹן you shall be established, or she shall be established, future Niphal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כּוֹן.

units.la: תְּכוּנָתוֹ לַ־תְּכוּנָה apparatui, dispositio ejus, No. f. f. præf. & aff. Rad. כּוֹן aptavit.
units.tr: תְּכוּנָתוֹ, לַ־תְּכוּנָה for the preparation, his arrangement, feminine noun with prefix and suffix. Root כּוֹן, he prepared.

units.la: תְּכוּנִין aptabis, vel bit, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כּוּן.
units.tr: תְּכוּנִין you shall prepare, or she shall prepare, future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כּוּן.

units.la: תִּכּוֹנִין firmeris, vel tur, Num.21.27. תִּכּוֹנָנִי stabilieris, (pro תִּתְכּוֹנִין, תִּתְכּוֹנָנִי,) fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. & 2. sing. fæm. Rad. כּוֹן.
units.tr: תִּכּוֹנִין you shall be made firm, or she shall be made firm, Num. 21.27, תִּכּוֹנָנִי you shall be established, (for תִּתְכּוֹנִין, תִּתְכּוֹנָנִי) future Hithpael, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd person feminine singular. Root כּוֹן.

units.la: תִּכָּחֵד exscinderis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּחַד.
units.tr: תִּכָּחֵד you shall be cut off, or she shall be cut off, future Niphal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כָּחַד.

units.la: תָּכִּים, vel תּוּכִּיִּים pavones, psittaci. No. pl. m. Rad. תָּכַךְ.
units.tr: תָּכִּים, or תּוּכִּיִּים peacocks, parrots. Masculine plural noun. Root תָּכַךְ.

units.la: תָּכִין parabis, vel bit, תָּכִיךְ te, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m.
units.tr: תָּכִין you shall prepare, or she shall prepare, תָּכִיךְ you, future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular

units.la: vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. כּוּן.
units.tr: or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix. Root כּוּן.

units.la: תְּכִירוּ agnoscetis, fut.
units.tr: תְּכִירוּ you shall recognise, future

units.la: Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. נָכַר.
units.tr: Hiphil, 2nd person plural masculine. Root נָכַר.

units.la: תְּכֻכִים calliditates, No.
units.tr: תְּכֻכִים cunning devices, noun

units.la: pl. m. R. תָּכַךְ.
units.tr: plural masculine. Root תָּכַךְ.

units.la: וַתִּכֶּל & absolutum fuit;
units.tr: וַתִּכֶּל and it was finished;

units.la: Exod. 39. 32. (pro תִּכְלָה,) fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: Exod. 39. 32, (for תִּכְלָה) future Kal, 3rd person feminine singular. Root כָּלָה.

units.la: וַתְּכַל & absolves, vel vet, (pro תְּכַלָּה ,) fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּלָה.
units.tr: וַתְּכַל and you finish, or she finishes, (for תְּכַלָּה) future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כָּלָה.

units.la: תִּכְלָא cohibeas, vel at,
units.tr: תִּכְלָא you shall restrain, or she shall restrain,

units.la: תִּכְלָאֶ cohibeto, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. ut. & 2. f. f. Rad. כָּלָא.
units.tr: תִּכְלָאֶ restrain, imperative, future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; and 2nd person feminine singular. Root כָּלָא.

units.la: תְּכִלָּה, תְּכִלִּית perfectio, consummatio, No. f. f. R. כָּלָה consumi.
units.tr: תְּכִלָּה, תְּכִלִּית perfection, consummation, noun feminine singular. Root כָּלָה, to be consumed.

units.la: תִּכָּלֵם rubore suffunderis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּלַם.
units.tr: תִּכָּלֵם you shall be covered with shame, or she shall be covered with shame, future Niphal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כָּלַם.

units.la: תְּכֵלֶת hyacinthus, No. f. f. Rad. inufit. תכל.
units.tr: תְּכֵלֶת hyacinth, noun feminine singular. Root uncommon, תכל.

units.la: תָּכִּין, vide תָּכִּין.
units.tr: תָּכִּין, see תָּכִּין.

units.la: תָּכֵן, vide תָּכוּן.
units.tr: תָּכֵן, see תָּכוּן.

units.la: תָּכִין תְּכִינִית summa, demensum, No. f. m. & No. f. f. Rad. תָּכַן expendit.
units.tr: תָּכִין, תְּכִינִית sum, measure, noun masculine and noun feminine. Root תָּכַן, he weighed.

units.la: תַּכַּס tegas, vel tegat, (apoc. pro תְּכַסֶּה) תְּכַסֵּנִי me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. כָּסָה.
units.tr: תַּכַּס you shall cover, or she shall cover, (apocopated for תְּכַסֶּה) תְּכַסֵּנִי she covers me, future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix. Root כָּסָה.

units.la: תִּכְסוּ numerabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. כָּסַם.
units.tr: תִּכְסוּ you shall number, future Kal, 2nd person plural masculine. Root כָּסַם.

units.la: תִּכְרִי comparabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. כָּרָה.
units.tr: תִּכְרִי you shall buy, future Kal, 2nd person plural masculine. Root כָּרָה.

units.la: תִּכְרִיךְ stola, pallium, No. f. m. Rad. inufit. כָּרַךְ.
units.tr: תִּכְרִיךְ robe, mantle, noun masculine. Root uncommon, כָּרַךְ.

units.la: תִּכָּרֵת excscinderis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּרַת.
units.tr: תִּכָּרֵת you shall be cut off, or she shall be cut off, future Niphal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כָּרַת.

units.la: תִּכָּשֵׁל impinges, vel get, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּשַׁל.
units.tr: תִּכָּשֵׁל you shall stumble, or she shall stumble, future Niphal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כָּשַׁל.

units.la: תִּכָּתֵב scriberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּתַב.
units.tr: תִּכָּתֵב you shall be written, or she shall be written, future Niphal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular. Root כָּתַב.

units.la: ת ל
units.tr: ת ל

units.la: תִּל tamulus, aggeris[?], תְּלָה ejus, No. f. m. aff. R.
units.tr: תִּל mound, heap, תְּלָה its mound, noun masculine with suffix. Root

units.la: תָּלַל accumulare.
units.tr: תָּלַל to heap up.

units.la: וַתֵּלָא & defatigaris, vel tur, Job. 4. 5. (pro תִּלְאֶה,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. apoc. R. לאה.
units.tr: וַתֵּלָא and you are wearied, or it is wearied, Job 4. 5, (for תִּלְאֶה) future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, apocopated. Root לאה.

units.la: תְּלָאוֹת siccitates, No. plur. fæm. Rad. inusit. לאב [?].
units.tr: תְּלָאוֹת droughts, noun feminine plural. Root uncommon, לאב[?].

units.la: תְּלָאָה labor, defatigatio, (unde comp. cum מֵ, מֵתְּלָאָה quantum fatigationis, Mal. 1.13. pro מִתְּלָאָה,) No. f. f. Rad. לָאָה ægre ferre.
units.tr: תְּלָאָה labour, weariness, (whence with מֵ, מֵתְּלָאָה how much weariness, Mal. 1.13, for מִתְּלָאָה) noun feminine singular. Root לָאָה, to bear with difficulty.

units.la: תְּלָאוּ fatigabitis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. לאה.
units.tr: תְּלָאוּ you shall weary, future Hiphil, 2nd person plural masculine. Root לאה.

units.la: תְּלָאִים suspensi, Deut. 28. 66. pro תְּלוּיִם, Part. Pahul Kal, pl. Rad. תָּלָה.
units.tr: תְּלָאִים hanged, suspended, Deut. 28. 66, for תְּלוּיִם, participle Pahul Kal, plural. Root תָּלָה.

units.la: וַתִּלְבַּב ut placentas paret, fut. Piel, 3. f. f. R. לבב.
units.tr: וַתִּלְבַּב she made cakes, fut. Piel, 3rd person feminine singular, from the root לבב.
