units.la: תָּלַד paries, vel et, תְּלֵדִי paries, תִּלְדֵי parietis, תִּלְדֶּין parient, (pro נָה) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: תָּלַד she bears, or you bear; תְּלֵדִי you bear; תִּלְדֵי of bearing; תִּלְדֶּין they will bear (for נָה); fut. Kal, 2nd person feminine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd or 3rd person plural feminine; from the root יָלַד.

units.la: תִּלְדֶּנָה pariant, Ezech. 23.4. pro תִּלְדֶּינָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. יָלַד.
units.tr: תִּלְדֶּנָה they will bear, Ezek. 23:4, for תִּלְדֶּינָה; fut. Kal, 3rd person plural feminine; from the root יָלַד.

units.la: וַתָּלֶה & furebat, Gen. 47.13. (pro וַתָּלֶה quod pro תִּלְהָה,) fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. לָהָה.
units.tr: וַתָּלֶה and she was furious, Gen. 47:13, (for וַתָּלֶה, which is for תִּלְהָה); fut. Kal, 3rd person singular feminine; from the root לָהָה.

units.la: תְּלַהֵט incendes, vel det, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לָהַט.
units.tr: תְּלַהֵט you will set on fire, or he will set; fut. Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root לָהַט.

units.la: תָּלוּ suspenderunt, pret. Kal, 3. pl. R. תָּלָה.
units.tr: תָּלוּ they hanged; pret. Kal, 3rd person plural; from the root תָּלָה.

units.la: תְּלָנָה mutuo acceperis, vel rit, fut. Kal, תִּלְוֶה mutuo dederis, vel rit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לָוָה.
units.tr: תְּלָנָה you will have borrowed, or she will; fut. Kal, and תִּלְוֶה you will lend, or she will; fut. Hiph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root לָוָה.

units.la: תָּלוּם suspenderunt eos, 2 Sam. 21. 12. (pro תָּקְאוּם,) quod juxta Consonantes pro תָּלוּם, pret. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. תָּלָה, sed juxta Puncta, à Rad. inusit. תלא.
units.tr: תָּלוּם they hanged them, 2 Sam. 21:12, (for תָּקְאוּם); this, according to the Consonants, stands for תָּלוּם, pret. Kal, 3rd person plural with suffix, from the root תָּלָה; but according to the Points, it is from a root not in use, תלא.

units.la: תְּלֻנּוֹת murmurationes, No. pl. f. Rad. לון per-noctare.
units.tr: תְּלֻנּוֹת murmurings; noun, plural feminine; from the root לון, to lodge overnight.

units.la: תִּלְחַם pugnabis, vel bit, תִּלְחֲמוּ[?] comprimes, vel met, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לחם & לחץ.
units.tr: תִּלְחַם you will fight, or he will; תִּלְחֲמוּ[?] you will press, or they will; fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the roots לחם and לחץ.

units.la: תָּלִין pernoctabis, vel bit, תָּלִינוּ pernoctabitis, (pro תָּלִינוּ,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. לון.
units.tr: תָּלִין you will lodge overnight, or he will; תָּלִינוּ you will lodge overnight, (for תָּלִינוּ); fut. Hiph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd person plural masculine; from the root לון.

units.la: תִּלָּכֵד capieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. לכד.
units.tr: תִּלָּכֵד you will be taken, or he will be; fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root לכד.

units.la: תִּלְכּוּ ibitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. ילך.
units.tr: תִּלְכּוּ you will go; fut. Kal, 2nd person plural masculine; from the root הלך.

units.la: תִּלֵּכְנָה ibunt, ibitis, pro תִּלֵּכְנָה, fut. Kal, 3. vel 2. pl. f. Rad. ילך.
units.tr: תִּלֵּכְנָה they will go, you will go, for תִּלֵּכְנָה; fut. Kal, 3rd or 2nd person plural feminine; from the root הלך.

units.la: תַּלְמִיד discipulus, No. f. m. Rad. למד didicit.
units.tr: תַּלְמִיד disciple; noun, masculine; from the root למד, he learned.

units.la: תָּלֵן pernoctato, Job. 17. 2. pro תָּלִין, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. vel 3. f. m. Rad. לון.
units.tr: תָּלֵן having lodged overnight, Job 17:2, for תָּלִין; fut. Hiph., 3rd person feminine singular or 3rd person masculine singular; from the root לון.

units.la: תַּלְפִּיּוֹת armaria, vox
units.tr: תַּלְפִּיּוֹת armoires; a word

units.la: comp. ex Rad. תָּלָה suspendit, & פִּיּוֹת acies, pl. f. No. Rad. פֶּה os oris.
units.tr: compounded from the root תָּלָה he hanged, and פִּיּוֹת edges, plural feminine noun; from the root פֶּה mouth.

units.la: תַּלְהֲלִים crispaturæ, No. pl. m. Rad. תָּלַל accumulare.
units.tr: תַּלְהֲלִים curled locks; noun, plural masculine; from the root תָּלַל, to heap up.

units.la: ת מ
units.tr: ת מ

units.la: תָּם integer, תֹּם integritas, No. f. m. כְּתָם juxta absolvi, Inf. Kal, præf. Rad. תמם perfici.
units.tr: תָּם whole, תֹּם wholeness; noun, masculine; כְּתָם as one who is acquitted, infinitive Kal with prefix; from the root תמם, to be finished.

units.la: תַּם absumptus est, præt. Kal, 3. sing. m. Rad. תַּמַּם.
units.tr: תַּם was consumed; pret. Kal, 3rd person singular masculine; from the root תַּמַּם.

units.la: תְּמָאֵן renues, vel et, תְּמָאֲנוּ renuetis, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. מָאַן.
units.tr: תְּמָאֵן you will refuse, or she will; תְּמָאֲנוּ you will refuse, fut. Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd person plural masculine; from the root מָאַן.

units.la: תְּמַאֵם spernes, vel net, תְּמַאֵם spretaes, vel est, fut. Kal, & Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָאַם.
units.tr: תְּמַאֵם you will despise, or he will; תְּמַאֵם you will be despised, or it will be; fut. Kal and Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מָאַם.

units.la: תָּמֹג liquefiet, pro תָּמוֹג, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. מוּג. תִּמְנָגְךָ[?]
units.tr: תָּמֹג it will melt, for תָּמוֹג; fut. Kal, 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מוּג. תִּמְנָגְךָ[?]

units.la: תְּמַגְּנֶךָּ[?] trades, vel tradet tibi, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. מָגַן[?].
units.tr: תְּמַגְּנֶךָּ[?] you will hand over, or she will hand over to you; fut. Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix; from the root מָגַן[?].

units.la: תָּמְהוּ[?] admirati sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. R. תָּמַהּ[?].
units.tr: תָּמְהוּ[?] they were astonished; pret. Kal, 3rd person plural; from the root תָּמַהּ[?].

units.la: בַּ־הַתְּמָהוֹן[?] stupore, No. f. m. Rad. תָּמַהּ[?] admiratus fuit.
units.tr: בַּ־הַתְּמָהוֹן[?] with astonishment; noun, masculine; from the root תָּמַהּ[?], he was astonished.

units.la: תָּמוּ[?] consumpti fuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. תָּמַם[?].
units.tr: תָּמוּ[?] they were consumed; pret. Kal, 3rd person plural; from the root תָּמַם[?].

units.la: תָּמוּ[?] integritas sua, sing. masc. aff. No. תָּם[?] ; Rad. תָּמַם[?] absolvi.
units.tr: תָּמוּ[?] its integrity; masculine singular with suffix; noun from תָּם[?]; root תָּמַם[?], to be complete.

units.la: תָּמוּג[?] liquefies, vel fiet, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מוּג[?].
units.tr: תָּמוּג[?] it will melt, or it will be; fut. Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מוּג[?].

units.la: תְּמוֹנְנָּה[?] dissolves, vel vet eam, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. מוּג[?].
units.tr: תְּמוֹנְנָּה[?] it dissolves, or you will dissolve it; fut. Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix; from the root מוּג[?].

units.la: תָּמוֹר[?] metieris, vel re, תָּמְדוּ[?] metiemini, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. R. מָדַד[?].
units.tr: תָּמוֹר[?] you will measure, or you will; תָּמְדוּ[?] you will be measured; fut. Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd person plural masculine; from the root מָדַד[?].

units.la: תָּמוּט[?] vacillabis, vel bit, תְּמוּטָנָה[?] nutabunt, Jes. 54.10. pro תְּמוּטֶנָּה[?] ; fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. מוּט[?].
units.tr: תָּמוּט[?] you will totter, or he will; תְּמוּטָנָה[?] they will totter, Isa. 54:10, for תְּמוּטֶנָּה[?]; fut. Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd or 3rd person plural feminine; from the root מוּט[?].

units.la: תָּמוּט[?] dimoveberis, vel bitur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מוּט[?].
units.tr: תָּמוּט[?] you will be moved, or he will be; fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מוּט[?].

units.la: מֵתְּמוּט[?] ab heri, est præf. cum No. Rad. תְּמוּל[?] heri, vel à Rad. inusit. תמל[?].
units.tr: מֵתְּמוּט[?] from yesterday; a prefixed noun with the noun תְּמוּל[?] yesterday, or from a root not in use, תמל[?].

units.la: תְּמוּנָתְךָ[?] similitudo tua, f. fæm. aff. No. תְּמוּנָה[?] ; Rad. מוּן[?].
units.tr: תְּמוּנָתְךָ[?] your likeness; feminine noun with suffix; noun תְּמוּנָה[?]; root מוּן[?].

units.la: תְּמוּרָתוֹ[?] permutatio[?] ejus, f. f. No. תְּמוּרָה[?], aff. Rad. מוּר[?] mutare.
units.tr: תְּמוּרָתוֹ[?] his exchange[?]; feminine noun, with suffix; noun תְּמוּרָה[?]; root מוּר[?], to change.

units.la: תְּמוּשׁ[?], vel תָּמֹשׁ[?] recedas, vel dat, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מוּשׁ[?].
units.tr: תְּמוּשׁ[?], or תָּמֹשׁ[?] you will depart, or he will; fut. Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מוּשׁ[?].

units.la: תָּמוֹת[?] morieris, vel tur, pro תָּמוּתוּן[?] moriemini, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. parag. & תְּמוּתֶנָה[?] morientur, pro תְּמוּתֶנָה[?], 3. pl. f. & omnia à Rad. מוּת[?].
units.tr: תָּמוֹת[?] you will die, or he will; for תָּמוּתוּן[?] you will die; fut. Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, and 2nd person plural masculine with paragogic ending; and תְּמוּתֶנָה[?] they will die, for תְּמוּתֶנָה[?], 3rd person plural feminine; all from the root מוּת[?].

units.la: תְּמוּתָה[?] occisio, No. sing. fæm. Rad. מוּת[?] mori.
units.tr: תְּמוּתָה[?] killing; noun, feminine singular; from the root מוּת[?], to die.

units.la: תְּמוּתָת[?] interficies, vel et, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מוֹת. תַּמִּית delebis, vel bit, (pro תַּמִּיחָה,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. apoc. R. מָחָה. תַּמַּח, & תַּמְּחִי deleas, Neh. 13.14. Jer. 18.23. pro תַּמָּחָה; fut. Hiph. 2. f. Rad. מָחָה. Vide Clav. Hebr. תִּמָּה delearis, vel tur, (pro תִּמָּחָה,) fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. apoc. Rad. מָחָה. תִּמָּכֵר vendetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. מָכַר. תַּמִּי consumere me, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. תָּמַם. וּבְ־תָּמִי juxta integritatem meam, No. f. m. תֹּם, præf. תַּמִּים tummim, No. pl. m. Rad. תָּמַם absolvi. תָּמִים, תְּמִים perfectus, תְּמִימָה integra, תְּמִימִים, תְּמִימֵי integri, No. f. m. f. & pl. m. constr. Rad. תָּמַם absolvi. תָּמִים perfecti, pl. m. No. תָּם; Rad. תָּמַם perfci. תְּמִישׁוּ removebitis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. מוּשׁ. תְּמִיתוּ interficietis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. מוּת. תַּמְלָא impleberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָלָא. תַּמְלֵט eripies, vel pietse, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָלַט. תַּמְּנוּ, est vel pro תִּמּוּ perficiunt, 3. pl. vel pro תַּמְּנוּ conficimur, 1. plur. præt. Kal, Rad. תָּמַם. תָּמַס liquefacies, Pf. 39. 12. (pro תַּמְסָה,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. apoc. Rad. מָסָּה. תָּמַס liquefactio, No. f. m. Rad. מַס liquefieri.
units.tr: תְּמוּתָת[?] you will kill, or she will; fut. Piel, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מוֹת. תַּמִּית you will destroy, or he will, (for תַּמִּיחָה); fut. Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, apocopated; from the root מָחָה. תַּמַּח, and תַּמְּחִי you will blot out, Neh. 13:14, Jer. 18:23, for תַּמָּחָה; fut. Hiph., 2nd person feminine singular; from the root מָחָה. See Clavis Hebraica. תִּמָּה you will be blotted out, or he will be, (for תִּמָּחָה); fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, apocopated; from the root מָחָה. תִּמָּכֵר it will be sold; fut. Niph., 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מָכַר. תַּמִּי to consume me; infinitive Kal with suffix; from the root תָּמַם, to be complete. וּבְ־תָּמִי according to my integrity; noun, feminine masculine, תֹּם, with prefix. תַּמִּים Thummim; noun, plural masculine; from the root תָּמַם, to be complete. תָּמִים, תְּמִים perfect, תְּמִימָה whole, תְּמִימִים, תְּמִימֵי whole; noun, masculine and feminine, and plural masculine construct; from the root תָּמַם, to be complete. תָּמִים perfect ones; plural masculine noun, from תָּם; root תָּמַם, to be finished. תְּמִישׁוּ you will remove; fut. Hiph., 2nd person plural masculine; from the root מוּשׁ. תְּמִיתוּ you will kill; fut. Hiph., 2nd person plural masculine; from the root מוּת. תַּמְלָא you will be filled, or he will be; fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מָלָא. תַּמְלֵט you will deliver, or he will; fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מָלַט. תַּמְּנוּ, is either for תִּמּוּ they finish, 3rd person plural, or for תַּמְּנוּ we are consumed, 1st person plural pret. Kal; from the root תָּמַם. תָּמַס you will melt, Ps. 39:12, (for תַּמְסָה); fut. Hiph., 2nd person masculine singular, apocopated; from the root מָסָּה. תָּמַס melting; noun, masculine; from the root מַס, to be melted.

units.la: תִּמָּצֵא invenieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָצָא.
units.tr: תִּמָּצֵא you will be found, or he will be; fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מָצָא.

units.la: תִּמְצוּ exprimatis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. מָצַץ.
units.tr: תִּמְצוּ you will squeeze out; fut. Kal, 2nd person plural masculine; from the root מָצַץ.

units.la: תִּמַּק tabefies, vel fiet, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָקַק.
units.tr: תִּמַּק you will waste away, or it will; fut. Niph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מָקַק.

units.la: תִּמַּקֶנָה tabefient, Zach. 14. 12. pro תִּמַּקְנָה, fut. Niph. 3. pl. f. Rad. מָקַק.
units.tr: תִּמַּקֶנָה they will waste away, Zech. 14:12, for תִּמַּקְנָה; fut. Niph., 3rd person plural feminine; from the root מָקַק.

units.la: תַּמֵּר exacerbes, Exod. 23. 21. pro תַּמֵּר, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. מָרַר ama-rum esse.
units.tr: תַּמֵּר you will provoke, Exod. 23:21, for תַּמֵּר; fut. Hiph., 2nd person masculine singular; from the root מָרַר, to be bitter.

units.la: וַתַּמֵּר & rebellâsti, vel vit, (apoc. pro תַּמְּרָה,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. Rad. מָרָה.
units.tr: וַתַּמֵּר and you rebelled, or she did, (apocopated for תַּמְּרָה); fut. Hiph., 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular; from the root מָרָה.

units.la: תָּמָר, תְּמָרָה palma, תְּמֹרוֹת palmae, תָּמְרוֹ ejus, E-zech. 40. 22. (pro יו,) No. f. m. & No. f. f. & pl. f. ut & pl. m. aff. Rad. תָּמָר palma.
units.tr: תָּמָר, תְּמָרָה palm, תְּמֹרוֹת palms, תָּמְרוֹ its, Ezek. 40:22, (for יו,) noun, masculine and noun, feminine, and plural feminine, and plural masculine with suffix; from the root תָּמָר, palm.

units.la: תִּמְרוּ rebellaveritis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. מָרָה.
units.tr: תִּמְרוּ you will rebel; fut. Hiph., 2nd person plural masculine; from the root מָרָה.

units.la: תַּמְרִיקִין, תַּמְרוּק mundatio, mundationes earum, No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. מָרַק tersit.
units.tr: תַּמְרִיקִין, תַּמְרוּק cleansing, cleansings of them; noun, feminine and plural masculine with suffix; from the root מָרַק, he scoured.

units.la: תַּמְרוֹת elationes, constr. No. pl. f. תַּמְרוֹת; Rad. תָּמָר palma.
units.tr: תַּמְרוֹת elations; construct, noun, plural feminine, תַּמְרוֹת; from the root תָּמָר, palm.

units.la: תַּמְרִים palmae, pl. m. No. תָּמָר; Rad. תָּמָר.
units.tr: תַּמְרִים palms; plural masculine noun, from תָּמָר; root תָּמָר.

units.la: תַּמְשֵׁךְ protraheris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. מָשַׁךְ.
units.tr: tamshekh: thou wouldst draw out, or he shall be drawn out; future Niphal, 2nd person masc. or 3rd person fem. sing.; root מָשַׁךְ.

units.la: תַּמְתִּיק dulce fueris, vel fuit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. מָתַק.
units.tr: tamtiq: thou shalt be sweet, or he shall be sweet; future Hiphil, 2nd person masc. or 3rd person fem. sing.; root מָתַק.

units.la: תָּמַת integritas, תָּמְתּוֹ ejus, תָּמָתִי mea, f. f. constr. aff. No. תָּמָה, à f. m. תֹם, R. תָּמַם absolvi.
units.tr: tamat: integrity; tamto: his; tamati: my; feminine, construct with suffix, from the noun tamah, from the masculine tom; root tamam, to be complete.

units.la: ת נ
units.tr: t n

units.la: תֵּן, vel תֵּן da, pro תַּן; Imper. Kal, f. m. תְּנָה Pf. 8. 2. Inf. Kal, pro תִּתֵּן dare, seu ponere, pro ponis, Rad. נָתַן.
units.tr: tēn, or tēn, give, for tan; imperative Qal, masc. sing.; tᵊnah, pausal form; infinitive Qal, for tittēn, to give or to put, for "thou puttest"; root nathan.

units.la: תְּנָאֲפֵנָה adulterantur, fut. Piel, 3. pl. f. Rad. נָאַף. תְּנָאִין תְּנָאֵן contemnas, vel contemnat, fut. Kal. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָאַץ תִּנָּבֵא prophetabis, vel bit, תִּנָּבֶאנָה [?] prophetabitis, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָבָא. תִּנָּגֵף percutieris, vel tur, תִּנָּגְפוּ percutiemini, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. R. נָגַף. תִּנְגְּשׁוּ exigetis, Jes. 58. 3. pro תִּגְּשׁוּ, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. נָגַשׁ. תָּנוּד condoleas, vel at, תִּנְּדוּ condoleatis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נוּד. תִּנְעֵי vagari facias me, vel faciat, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נוּעַ [?]. תִּנְדֹּף impelles, Ps. 68. 3. pro תִּדֹּף, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. נָדַף. תָּנָה da, pro תֵּן, Imper. Kal, s. f. m. parag. Rad. נָתַן. וַתְּנַהֵג & abduxisti, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. Rad. נָהַג. וַתְּנַהֲלֵנִי & deducito me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. נָחַל. תְּנוּ date, Imper. Kal, pl. m. R. נָתַן. תְּנוּאָתִי ruptura mea, תְּנוּאוֹת ruptura, s. f. aff. & pl. f. No. תְּנוּאָה, Rad. נוּא rupit. תְּנוּבָה proventus, No. f. f. R. נוּב progerminare. תָּנוּחַ quiesces, vel cet, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נוּחַ. תָּנוּט nutabis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נוּט. תָּנוּךְ imum auris, No. f. m. Rad. inusit. תָּנַךְ תְּנוּמָה dormitatio, No. f. f. Rad. נוּם dormitavit. תָּנוּס fugies, vel et, תְּנוּסִין fugietis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. נוּם .
units.tr: tᵊnaʾᵃphēnah, they commit adultery; future Piel, 3rd person fem. pl.; root naʾaph. tᵊnaʾin, tᵊnaʾen, thou shalt despise, or he shall despise; future Qal, 2nd masc. or 3rd fem. sing.; root naʾats. tinnabeʾ, thou shalt prophesy, or he will; tinnabeʾnah [?], you shall prophesy; future Niphal, 2nd masc. or 3rd fem. sing. and 2nd masc. pl.; root naba. tinnagēph, thou shalt be struck, or he shall be; tinnagᵊphu, you shall be struck; future Niphal, 2nd masc. or 3rd fem. sing. and 2nd masc. pl.; root nagaph. tinᵊgᵊshu, you shall exact, Isaiah 58:3, for tiggᵊshu; future Qal, 2nd masc. pl.; root nagash. tanud, thou shalt condole, or he shall; tinᵊdu, you shall condole; future Qal, 2nd masc. or 3rd fem. sing. and 2nd masc. pl.; root nud. tin'ei, cause me to wander, or he shall cause; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root nuaʿ [?]. tindoph, thou shalt impel, Psalm 68:3, for tidoph; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing.; root nadaph. tanah, give, for tēn; imperative Qal, masc. sing., with paragogic ending; root nathan. wattᵊnahēg, and thou hast led away; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing.; root nahag. wattᵊnahalenī, and lead me; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing., with suffix; root nachal. tᵊnu, give; imperative Qal, masc. pl.; root nathan. tᵊnuʾath, my rupture; tᵊnuʾoth, ruptures; feminine singular with suffix and feminine plural, from tᵊnuʾah; root nuʾ, he broke. tᵊnuvah, produce; noun feminine; root nuv, to sprout. tanuach, thou shalt rest, or he shall rest; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nuach. tanuṭ, thou shalt totter, or he shall; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nuṭ. tanuk, the lowest part of the ear; noun masc.; root not in use, as tanakh. tᵊnumah, slumber; noun feminine; root num, he slept. tanus, thou shalt flee, or he shall; tᵊnusin, you shall flee; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing. and 2nd masc. pl., with paragogic ending; root num.

units.la: תָּנוּעַ, vel תָּנֻעַ nutabis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. נוּעַ.
units.tr: tanua, or tanua, thou shalt totter, or he shall; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nua.

units.la: תְּנוּפָה agitatio, No. f. f. Rad. נוּף stillavit.
units.tr: tᵊnuphah, waving; noun feminine; root nuph, he dripped.

units.la: תַּנּוּרִים fornaces, pl. m. No. תַּנּוּר ; Rad. inufit. תָּנַר.
units.tr: tannurim, furnaces; plural masc.; noun tannur; root not in use, as tanar.

units.la: לְתַנּוֹת draconibus, No. pl. f. præf. à f. m. תַּנִּין draco, balæna, Rad. inufit. תָּנַן.
units.tr: lᵊtannoth, to dragons; noun plural feminine, with prefix, from masculine tannin, dragon, whale; root not in use, as tanan.

units.la: לְתַנּוֹת ad confabulandum, Infin. Piel, præf. R. תָּנָה mercede condu-xit.
units.tr: lᵊtannoth, to converse; infinitive Piel, with prefix; root tanah, he hired for wages.

units.la: וַתָּנַח & quievisti, vel vit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נוּחַ.
units.tr: wattanach, and thou hast rested, or he shall; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nuach.

units.la: תְּנַח dimittes, vel tet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָנַח.
units.tr: tᵊnach, thou shalt dismiss, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root yanach.

units.la: תַּנְחוּמִים, ות consolatio-nes, No. pl. m. & f. Rad. נָחַם solatus est.
units.tr: tanchumim, consolations; noun plural masc. and fem.; root nacham, he comforted.

units.la: תַּנְחֵם deduces eos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. נָחָה.
units.tr: tanchem, thou shalt lead them; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing., with suffix; root nachah.

units.la: תְּנַחֵם consolaberis, vel bi-tur, תְּנַחֲמֵנִי me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נָחַם.
units.tr: tᵊnachem, thou shalt be comforted, or he shall be; tᵊnachamēni, comfort me; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root nacham.

units.la: תְּנַחֲמוּ consolatione fruemini, fut. Pual, 2. pl. m. Rad. נָחַם.
units.tr: tᵊnachamu, you shall enjoy consolation; future Pual, 2nd masc. pl.; root nacham.

units.la: תְּנַחְשׁוּ augurabimini, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. נָחַשׁ.
units.tr: tᵊnachshu, you shall practise augury; future Piel, 2nd masc. pl.; root nachash.

units.la: וַתִּנָּחֵת & descendis, vel dit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָחַת.
units.tr: wattinnachet, and thou didst descend, or he shall; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nachath.

units.la: תְּנִיאוּן frangetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. נוא .
units.tr: tᵊniʾun, you shall break; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. pl., with paragogic ending; root nuʾ.

units.la: תְּנִידֵנִי, vide תְּנֵרְנִי.
units.tr: tᵊnidenī, see tᵊnarᵊnī.

units.la: תְּנִיחֲנוּ quietum reddidisti, vel dit eum, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נוּחַ quievit.
units.tr: tᵊniḥanu, thou hast made him quiet, or he made him; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nuach, he rested.

units.la: תְּנִיחֵנִי, vel תַּנְחֵנִי permit-tas me, vel tat, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָנַח.
units.tr: tᵊniḥenī, or tanḥenī, thou shalt permit me, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root yanach.

units.la: תַּנִּין draco, vel nes, תַּנִּינִים &
units.tr: tannin, dragon, or serpent; tanninim, and

units.la: & contracte תַּנִּים dracones, No. f. & pl. m. Rad. inusit. תָּנַן .
units.tr: and, contracted, tannim, dragons; noun feminine and masc. plural; root not in use, as tanan.

units.la: וַתְּנִיעֵנִי[?] & commovisti me, vel vit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נוּעַ .
units.tr: wattᵊniʿeni, and thou hast moved me, or he moved; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root nuaʿ.

units.la: תָּנִיף agitabis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נוּף .
units.tr: tanif, thou shalt wave, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nuph.

units.la: תְּנִיקֵהוּ lactabit eum, Exod. 2. 9. pro תְּנִיקֵהוּ, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָנַק fuxit.
units.tr: tᵊniqehu, she shall nurse him, Exodus 2:9, for tᵊniqeh; future Hiphil, 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root yanaq, he sucked.

units.la: וַתָּנֻם & fugisti, vel git, pro תָּנוּם ,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נוּם .
units.tr: wattanum, and thou hast fled, or he; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root num.

units.la: תַּנְסוּ tentabitis, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. R. נָסָה .
units.tr: tanesu, you shall tempt; future Piel, 2nd masc. pl.; root nasah.

units.la: תְּנַפְּצֵם dispergeseos, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. נָפַץ .
units.tr: tᵊnaphᵊtsem, thou shalt scatter them; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing., with suffix; root naphats.

units.la: תְּנַצֵּל eripieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָצַל .
units.tr: tᵊnatsel, thou shalt be rescued, or he shall be; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root natsal.

units.la: תְּנַצְּרֵנִי custodies me, fut. Kal, 2. sing. m. aff. Rad. נָצַר .
units.tr: tᵊnatsrēni, thou shalt keep me; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing., with suffix; root natsar.

units.la: תִּנָּקֵה insons eris, vel erit, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָקָה .
units.tr: tinnaqeh, thou shalt be innocent, or he shall be; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root naqah.

units.la: תְּנַקֵּנִי emundabis me, vel bit, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נָקָה .
units.tr: tᵊnaqqeni, thou shalt cleanse me, or he shall; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root naqah.

units.la: תִּנָּקֵשׁ illaqueeris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָקַשׁ .
units.tr: tinnaqesh, thou shalt be ensnared, or he shall be; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root naqash.

units.la: תִּנָּשֵׂא, attollet se, Num. 24. 7. (pro תִּתְנַשֵּׂא ,) fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. נָשָׂא .
units.tr: tinnasa, he shall lift himself up, Numbers 24:7, for titnassa; future Hithpael, 3rd fem. sing.; root nasa.

units.la: תִּנָּשְׂאוּ portabimini, תִּנָּשֶׂאנָה portabuntur, vel ni, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. & 2. vel 3. pl. fæm. R. נָשָׂא .
units.tr: tinnᵊsʾu, you shall be carried, tinnᵊsaʾnah, they shall be carried, or they; future Niphal, 2nd masc. pl. and 2nd or 3rd fem. pl.; root nasa.

units.la: תִּנָּשֵׁנִי oblivioni traderis à me, fut. Niph. 2. sing. m. aff. Rad. נָשָׁה .
units.tr: tinnashēni, thou shalt be forgotten by me; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing., with suffix; root nashah.

units.la: תִּנָּחֵשׁ exstirpaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. נָחַשׁ .
units.tr: tinnachesh, thou shalt be rooted out, or he shall be; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nachash.

units.la: ת ס
units.tr: t s

units.la: תִּסֹּב, vel תְּסוֹב vertes, vel vertet se, (pro תִּסֹּב ,) fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. סָבַב. תְּסַבּוּ[?] circuibitis, תְּסַבֶּינָה[?] circuibunt, fut. Kal, 2. pl m. & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. סָבַב. תָּסֹג amovebis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָסַג apprehendit. תִּסָּגֵר includeris, vel tur, Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָגַר. תְּסֹבֵּב[?] circumdabit, vel bis, pro תְּסוֹבֵּב, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. vel 2. f. m. Rad. סָבַב. תְּסוֹבְּבֶךָּ[?] circumdabis te, vel bit, נִי[?] me, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. סָבַב. תָּסוּךְ unges, vel unget te, תְּסוּכִי unges te, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. f f. Rad. סוּךְ. תְּסוּרוּ[?] recedetis, fut. Kal, 2 pl. m. R. סוּר. תָּסִיג[?] amovebis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f f. Rad. נָסַג appre-hendit. תַּסִּיעַ[?] transferes, vel ret, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָסַע. תָּסִיר removebis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סִיר. וַתְּסִיתֵנִי[?] & incitasti, vel vit me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. סִית[?]. תָּסֹךְ obteges, vel get, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָכַךְ. תִּסְּכוּ[?] libabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. נָסַךְ. תִּסְכְּנִי[?] obteges me, vel get, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. סָכַךְ. תְּסֻלָּה[?] æstimaberis, vel tur, fut. Pual, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָלָה[?]. תִּסְּף[?] colliges, (pro תֵּאָסֵף[?], vel תֵּאָסֵף,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. אָסַף. תִּסָּפֶה[?] consumeris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. כָּפָה. וַיָּסֶר & amovit, (pro וַיָּסֶר[?] תָּסֵר[?],) fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. Rad. סוּר. תָּסֻרוּ recedetis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. סוּר. תִּסְתֵּר abscondes te, vel det, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָתַר. תִּסְתַּתֵּר abscondes te, vel det se, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. סָתַר.
units.tr: tissob, or tᵊsob, thou shalt turn, or she shall turn herself, for tissob; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root sabab. tᵊsabbu, you shall go round; tᵊsabbenah, they shall go round; future Qal, 2nd masc. pl. and 2nd or 3rd fem. pl.; root sabab. tasoḡ, thou shalt remove, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nasag, he laid hold of. tissagēr, thou shalt be shut in, or he shall be; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root sagar. tᵊsobeb, he shall surround, or thou shalt, for tᵊsobeb; future Kal, 3rd fem. sing. or 2nd masc. sing.; root sabab. tᵊsobᵊbekha, thou shalt surround thee, or he shall, meni, me; future Piel, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root sabab. tasuk, thou shalt anoint, or he shall anoint thee; tᵊsuki, thou shalt anoint thee; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., and 2nd fem. sing.; root suk. tᵊsuru, you shall depart; future Qal, 2nd masc. pl.; root sur. tasig, thou shalt remove, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nasag, he laid hold of. tassiaʿ, thou shalt transfer, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root nasaʿ. tasir, thou shalt remove, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root sir. wattᵊsitenī, and thou hast incited me, or he incited me; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root sit. tasoḵ, thou shalt cover, or he shall; future Hiphil, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root sakhakh. tissᵊku, you shall pour out; future Qal, 2nd masc. pl.; root nasakh. tiskᵊni, thou shalt cover me, or he shall; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing., with suffix; root sakhakh. tᵊsullah, thou shalt be esteemed, or he shall be; future Pual, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root salah. tissph, thou shalt gather, for tēasaph, or he shall be gathered; future Qal, 2nd masc. sing.; root asaph. tissaphe, thou shalt be consumed, or he shall be; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root kaphah. wayyaser, and he removed, for wayyaser or tasser; future Hiphil, 3rd fem. sing.; root sur. tasᵊru, you shall depart; future Qal, 2nd masc. pl.; root sur. tistper, thou shalt hide thyself, or he shall; future Niphal, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root satar. tistattēr, thou shalt hide thyself, or he shall hide himself; future Hithpael, 2nd masc. sing. or 3rd fem. sing.; root satar.

units.la: ת ע תֵּעָבֵד coleris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָבַד. תַּעַבְדֵם coles ea, pro תַּעַבְרֵם, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. עָבַר. תַּעֲבוּרִי transfeas, Ruth. 2. 8. pro תַּעְבְּרִי, vel תַּעֲבַר fut. Kal, 2. f f. Rad. עָבַר. תַּעֲבֹר adamabit, Ezech. 23. 16. pro תַּעְגְּבָה, idque, pro תַּעְגּוֹב, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. עָנַב. תַּעֲנֶינָה retardabitis vos ipsas, Ruth. 1. 13. (pro תַּעֲנֶנָּה, vel pro תַּעֲנֶה,) fut. Niph. 2. pl. fæm. Rad. עָנַן. תַּעֲנֶה placentam coques, eam, Ez. 4. 12. pro תְּעֻנֶּנָּה, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. aff. Rad. עוּג. וַתַּעַר & contestatus fuisti, (pro תָּעִיר, vel תָּעֵר,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. עוּר. וַתַּעַר & ornavit se, Hos. 2. 14. (apoc. pro תַּעֲרָה,) תַּעֲרִי ornabis te, fut. Hiph. vel Kal, 3. & 2. sing. fæm. Rad. עָרָה. תָּעוּ errarunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. תָּעָה. תְּעוּדָה testimonium, No. sing. fæm. Rad. עוּד testatus est... תְּעַנֵּנוּ præstigiabimini, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. עַיִן oculus.
units.tr: Tiphal Hithpael... Tê'aḇēd: thou art served, or he/she is served, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עָבַד. Taʿabḏēm: thou shalt serve them, for taʿabrēm, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. with suffix. Root עָבַר. Taʿăḇûrî: thou shalt pass over, Ruth 2. 8., for tiʿbĕrî, or taʿăḇar, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. Root עָבַר. Taʿăḇōr: she shall love, Ezek. 23. 16., for taʿăgḇâ, and this for taʿăgôḇ, fut. Kal, 3. sing. fem. Root עָנַב. Taʿănênâ: you shall detain yourselves, Ruth 1. 13., (for taʿănennâ, or for taʿăneh,) fut. Niph. 2. pl. fem. Root עָנַן. Taʿăneh: you shall bake a cake of it, Ezek. 4. 12., for tᵊʿunnennâ, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. with suffix. Root עוּג. Vattaʿar: and you have been adjured, (for tâʿîr or tâʿēr,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Root עוּר. Vattaʿar: and she adorned herself, Hos. 2. 14. (apocopated for taʿărâ,) Taʿărî: you shall adorn yourself, fut. Hiph. or Kal, 3. & 2. sing. fem. Root עָרָה. Tāʿû: they erred, perf. Kal, 3. pl. Root תָּעָה. Tᵊʿûdâ: testimony, noun sing. fem. Root עוּד, he testified... Tᵊʿannû: you shall practise augury, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Root עַיִן, eye.

units.la: תָּעוּף volabis, vel bit, תְּעוּפְנָה advolabitis, vel bunt, Jef. 60. 8. pro תְּעוּפְנָה; fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. עוּף.
units.tr: Tāʿûp: thou shalt fly, or he shall, Tᵊʿûpᵊnâ: you shall fly swiftly, or they shall, Isa. 60. 8., for tᵊʿûpᵊnâ; fut. Kal, 2. f. m. or 3. f. f., and likewise 2. or 3. pl. f. Root עוּף.

units.la: תָּעוּר excitabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: Tāʿûr: he shall be stirred up, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Root עוּר.

units.la: תָּעוּרִי excitabitis, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: Tāʿûrî: you shall stir up, fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Root עוּר.

units.la: תָּעֻזִּי corroboraberis, vel tur, וַתָּעֻז & roborata es, vel fuit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָזַז.
units.tr: Taʿuzzî: thou shalt be strengthened, or it shall be, Vattāʿuz: and she was made strong, or it was, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עָזַז.

units.la: תֵּעָזֵב relinqueris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָזַב.
units.tr: Tēʿāzēḇ: thou shalt be forsaken, or he shall be, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עָזַב.

units.la: וַתַּעַט & contendit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. R. עט.
units.tr: Vattaʿaṭ: and he contended, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. Root עט.

units.la: וַתַּעַט & declinasti, vel vit, (pro תַּעֲטוּ) תַּעֲטוּ operietis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. עָטָה obvelavit.
units.tr: Vattaʿaṭ: and thou hast turned aside, or she did, (for taʿăṭû) Taʿăṭû: you shall cover, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. or 3. f. f., and also 2. pl. m. Root עָטָה, he veiled.

units.la: וַתַּעִידֵנִי & testificaberis, vel tur, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עוּד.
units.tr: Vattaʿîdēnî: and thou shalt testify, or he shall, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עוּד.

units.la: תָּעִים errantes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. R. תָּעָה.
units.tr: Tāʿîm: wandering, Ben. Kal, pl. m. Root תָּעָה.

units.la: הַתָּעִיף an involare facies, vel faciet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עוּף.
units.tr: Hattāʿîf: wilt thou make him fly, or shall he make, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עוּף.

units.la: תַּעִיק premes, vel [illegible, ~1 letter]el Piel, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. [illegible, ~1 letter]el 3. f. f. Rad. עוּק.
units.tr: Taʿîq: thou shalt press, or [illegible]el Piel, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. [illegible]el 3. f. f. Root עוּק.

units.la: תָּעִירוּ excitabitis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. עוּר.
units.tr: Tāʿîrû: you shall stir up, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Root עוּר.

units.la: תָּעִיתִי erravi, praet. Kal, 1. f. R. תָּעָה.
units.tr: Tāʿîtî: I have erred, perf. Kal, 1. sing. Root תָּעָה.

units.la: תַּעַכְסֶנָּה tinnitum edunt, fut. Piel, 3. pl. f. Rad. עָכַס.
units.tr: Taʿakᵊsennâ: they make a tinkling sound, fut. Piel, 3. pl. f. Root עָכַס.

units.la: וַתַּעַל & ascendit, vel ascendere fecit, (apoc. pro תַּעֲלֵנִי) תַּעֲלֵנִי educes me, תַּעֲלוּ ascendetis, vel offeretis, fut. Kal, vel Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. עָלָה.
units.tr: Vattaʿal: and she went up, or made to go up, (apocopated for taʿălēnî) Taʿălēnî: thou shalt bring me up, Taʿălû: you shall go up, or you shall offer, fut. Kal, or Hiph. 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. with suffix, and also 2. pl. m. Root עָלָה.

units.la: תַּעֲלוּ ascendere facti estis, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. R. עָלָה.
units.tr: Taʿălû: you have been made to go up, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. Root עָלָה.

units.la: תַּעֲלוּלִים facinora, No. pl. m. R. עָלַל fecit.
units.tr: Taʿălûlîm: wicked deeds, noun pl. m. Root עָלַל, he did.

units.la: תַּעֲלָה aquaeductus, תַּעֲלוֹתֶיהָ aquaeductus sui, s. f. constr. & pl. f. aff. No. תְּעָלָה, R. עָלָה ascendit.
units.tr: Taʿălâ: aqueduct, Taʿălôtehâ: its aqueducts, noun sing. fem. constr. and pl. fem. with suffix. Noun תְּעָלָה, Root עָלָה, he went up.

units.la: תַּעַן loqueris, vel respondebit, (apoc. pro) תַּעֲנֶה, תַּעֲנֵנִי exaudias nos, ני.. me, תַּעֲנוּ respondebitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. עָנָה.
units.tr: Taʿan: thou shalt speak, or he shall answer, (apocopated for) Taʿăneh, Taʿănēnî: thou shalt hear us, ...me, Taʿănû: you shall answer, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. with suffix, and also 2. pl. m. Root עָנָה.

units.la: תַּעֲנֶה afflixeris, vel rit, תַּעֲנוּ affligetis, תַּעֲנֶה affligeris, vel tur, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. ut & fut. Pual, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָנָה respondit.
units.tr: Taʿănēh: thou shalt afflict, or he shall, Taʿănû: you shall afflict, Taʿănēh: thou shalt be afflicted, or it shall be, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. and 2. pl. m., likewise fut. Pual, 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עָנָה, he answered.

units.la: תַּעֲנוּגֶיהָ deliciae suae, תַּעֲנוּגוֹת deliciae, pl. m. aff. & pl. f. No. תַּעֲנוּג; Rad. עָנַג deliciari.
units.tr: Taʿănûgêhā: her delights, Taʿănûgôt: delights, pl. m. with suffix and pl. fem. noun תַּעֲנוּג; Root עָנַג, to delight.

units.la: תַּעֲנִיק munerabis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָנַק.
units.tr: Taʿănîq: thou shalt bestow, or he shall, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עָנַק.

units.la: תַּעֲנָנָה respondebunt, Jud. 5. 29. pro תַּעֲנֶינָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. עָנָה.
units.tr: Taʿănênâ: they shall answer, Judg. 5. 29., for taʿănênâ, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Root עָנָה.

units.la: תַּעֲפָה evolabis, Job. 11. 17. pro תָּשׁוּף, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. parag. praeter morem. Rad. עוּף.
units.tr: Taʿănâ: thou shalt fly away, Job 11. 17., for tāšûp, fut. Kal, 2. f. m., with a paragogic syllable contrary to custom. Root עוּף.

units.la: תַּעֲצְבוּ dolore afficiamini, תַּעֲצְלוּ pigri fiatis, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. Rad. עָצַב, & עָצַל.
units.tr: Taʿăṣᵊḇû: you shall be grieved, Taʿăṣᵊlû: you shall become idle, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. Root עָצַב, and עָצַל.

units.la: וְתֵּעָצֵר & cohibitus es, vel ta est, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָצַר.
units.tr: Vᵊtēʿāṣēr: and thou wast restrained, or she was, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. Root עָצַר.

units.la: תֵּעַר nudabis, Pf. 141. 8. (apoc. pro תְּעָרָה,) fut. Piel, 2. f. m. Rad. עָרָה.
units.tr: Tēʿar: thou shalt make bare, Ps. 141. 8. (apocopated for tᵊʿārâ,) fut. Piel, 2. f. m. Root עָרָה.

units.la: בְּ־תַּעֲרָה in vagina sua, praef. & aff. cum No. Rad. תַּעַר novacula.
units.tr: Bᵊ-taʿărâ: in its sheath, preposition and suffix with noun. Root תַּעַר, razor.

units.la: תַּעַשׂ facies, vel et, (apoc. pro תַּעֲשֶׂה,) תַּעֲשִׂי facietis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. עָשָׂה.
units.tr: Taʿaś: thou shalt make, or she, (apocopated for taʿăśeh,) Taʿăśî: you shall make, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. or 3. f. f. and also 2. pl. m. Root עָשָׂה.

units.la: וְתַּעַשׂ & fiet, (apoc. pro) תַּעֲשֶׂה; fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. f. Rad. עָשָׂה · תַּעֲשֶׂה facies, Gen.26.29. pro הַעֲשֶׂה, fut. Kal, 2. f m. Rad. עָשָׂה· תַּעֲשִׂין facies, f. pro תַּעֲשִׂי, fut. Kal, 2. f f. parag. Rad. עָשָׂה· תַּעֲשְׂרֶנָה ditas eam, Pf. 6s.10. pro תַּעֲשְׂרֶנָּה, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. עָשַׁר· תַּעְתּוּעִים seductiones graves, No. pl. m. gem. Rad. תָּעָה errare.
units.tr: Vᵊtaʿaś: and it shall be done, (apocopated for) taʿăśeh; fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Root עָשָׂה. Taʿăśeh: thou shalt make, Gen. 26. 29., for hâʿăśeh, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Root עָשָׂה. Taʿăśîn: thou shalt make, for taʿăśî, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. with paragogic syllable. Root עָשָׂה. Taʿăśᵊrennâ: thou shalt enrich her, Ps. 68. 10., for taʿăśᵊrennâ, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. with suffix. Root עָשַׁר. Taʿtûʿîm: grievous seductions, noun pl. m., doubled. Root תָּעָה, to err.

units.la: ת פ תֹּף tympanum, No. f. m. Rad. תָּפַף · תָּפְאַר decorabis, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. Rad. פָּאַר תִּפְאַרְתּוֹ decor ejus, ה tuus, ם ipsorum, נוּ noster, f. f. aff. No. תִּפְאָרָה, vel תִּפְאֶרֶת; Rad. פָּאַר ornavit. וַתִּפְּחֹהוּ & coxit eam, 1 Sam. 28.24. (pro תֹּאֲפֶהוּ,) fut. Kal, 3. f. f. aff. R. אָפָה · תָּפוּג intermittebas, vel hat, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f f. Rad. פּוּג · תַּפּוּחִים poma, mala, pl. m. No. Rad. תַּפּוּחַ · תִּפֹּל cades, cadet, pro תִּפֹּל, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f f. Rad. נָפַל · תִּפּוֹלֶנָה cadent, pro תִּפֹּלְנָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. נָפַל. וּתְפוּצוֹתֵיכֶם & dispersiones vestræ, pl. fæm. præf. aff. Rad. פּוּץ spargere se. תְּפוּצֶינָה dispergentur, Ezech.34.5. pro תְּפוּצֶינָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. פּוּץ. תְּפוּשׁוּ augescetis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. פּוּשׁ. תֻּפִּים tympana, תָּפֶיךָ tua, pl. m. aff. No. תֹּף; Rad. inusit. תָּפַף. תְּפִינִי coctura, Levit. 6. 21. pl. m. constr. No. תִּפִינִים, תִּפְּינִם, (pro תאַפּינִם,) Rad. אָפָה coxit. תִּפִּין dispërges, vel get, תִּפִּיצִם eos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. פּוּץ. תַּפֵּל, vel תִּפִּיל projicies, vel et, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָפַל. תְּפִלָּה insulsitas, No. f. f. à No. Rad. תָּפֵל insulsum. תִּפְּלוּ cadetis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. נָפַל. תִּפְלַצְתְּךָ horror tuus, No. f. f. תִּפְלָצַת, aff. Rad. פָּלַץ tremere. תִּפְלָתָם oratio ejus, ם ipsorum, תְּפִלּוֹת orationes, f. f. aff. & pl. f. No. תְּפִלָּה, Rad. פָּלַל judicavit. תִּפֶּן respicias, vel at, (apoc. pro תִּפְנֶה,) תִּפְנוּ respiciatis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. פָּנָה. תִּפְעֵם & concussus es, vel sa fuit, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פָּעַם. תַּפִּיק educas, vel cat, pro תַּפִּיק, fut. Hiph. 2. 1. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פּוֹק. תִּפָּקֵד visitaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פָּקַד. תִּפָּקְחוּ aperiemini, vel ntur, fut. Niph. 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. פָּקַח. תִּפַּר irritum fies, vel fiet, pro תִּפֵּר, fut. Hoph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פּוּר. תַּפְרֵי irritum facietis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. פּוּר. תִּפְרֹשׂ expandes, vel det, fut. Piel 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פָּרַשׂ. תְּפַתֶּה pelliciès, vel et, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פָּתָה. תִּפָּתַח aperies te, vel aperiet se, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. פָּתַח. תֵּצֵא egredieris, vel tur, תֵּצְאִי exibitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. יָצָא. וַתֹּצִיאִי & eduxisti, vel xit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָצָא. תָּצוּר venaberis, vel tur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צוּר. תְּצַוֶּה præcipies, vel et, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צָוָה. תְּצוּמִי jejunabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. צוּם. תָּצוּר obsidebis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צוּר. תִּצְּרִי custodies, vel et, pro תִּצַּר, & תִּצֹּרְנָה custodient, pro תִּצַּרְנָה; fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 3. pl. f. Rad. נָצַר. תִּצַּיבֵנִי statues me, vel statuet me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. יָצַב. תָּצִיג statues, vel et, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָצַג. תַּצִּיל eripies, vel et, תַּצִּילֵנִי me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. aff. Rad. נָצַל. תְּצִינָה vastabuntur, fut. Kal, 3. pl. fæm. Rad. נָצָה. תַּצִּיתוּ incendetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. יָצַת. תְּצַלֶּינָה tinnient, pro תְּצַלֶּינָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. צָלַל; vel potius est fut. Hiph. 3. pl. f. Rad. צָלַל. תִּצַּלֶּינָה tinnient, Jer. 19.3. pro תִּצַּלֶּינָה, fut. Niph. 3. pl. f. Rad. צָלַל. תִּצְפֶּינָה speculemini, vel entur, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. צָפָה. תִּצְפְּצֵף pipias, vel at, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. gem. Rad. צפף. וַתִּצֹק[?] & effudisti, vel dit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָצַק. תָּצַר obsidebis, Deut. 2. 9. pro תָּצוּר, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. צוּר. תָּצָר obsidebis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צוּר. וַתָּצַר & angustia es, vel fuit, תְּצָרִי angustabe-ris, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. sing. fæm. Rad. יָצַר. וַתָּצַר & custodivisti, vel vit, תִּצְרֵנִי custodies me, נּוֹ[?] eum, fut. Kal, 2. sing. masc. vel 3. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. נָצַר. תָּצַת[?] incendes, vel det, תִּצָּחֶנָּה succendantur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 3. pl. f. Rad. יָצַת.
units.tr: Tof (Tsaf), tympanum (a drum), a noun, masculine, no plural. Root תָּפַף. TIFARE, you will adorn, future Piel, 2nd person masculine singular, root פָּאַר. TIFARTO, his beauty/glory; your (sing. fem.) beauty; of them; our beauty, feminine noun, with suffixes; from TIFARAH or TIFERET, no. Root פָּאַר, he adorned. VAT-TIFHOHU, and she cooked it (1 Sam. 28.24), for TO'AFEHU, future Kal, 3rd person feminine singular with suffix, root אָפָה, he baked. TAFUG, you were relaxing, or she [was relaxing], future Kal, 2nd person masculine or 3rd person feminine singular, root פּוּג. TAPPUCHIM, apples, fruits, masculine plural, no. Root תַּפּוּחַ. TIPPOL, you fall, she falls, for TIPPOL, future Kal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular, root נָפַל. TIPPOLENAH, they will fall, for TIPPOLNAH, future Kal, 3rd person feminine plural, root נָפַל. UTEFUTSOTEKHEM, and your dispersions, feminine plural, with prefix and suffix, root פּוּץ, to scatter. TEFUTSENAH, they will be dispersed (Ezek. 34.5), for TEFUTSENAH, future Kal, 3rd person feminine plural, root פּוּץ. TEFUSHU, you will increase, future Kal, 2nd person masculine plural, root פּוּשׁ. TUPPIM, drums, your drums, masculine plural, with suffix; from TOF, root not in use, TAFAF. TEFINI, a baking, Lev. 6.21, masculine plural construct, no. TIFINIM, TIPPENIM (for TE'AFFINIM), root אָפָה, he baked. TIFFIN, you will scatter, or he will scatter; TIFFITSAM, them; future Hiphil, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular with suffix, root פּוּץ. TAPPEL, or TIPPIL, you will cast, or he will cast; future Hiphil, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular, root נָפַל. TEFILLAH, foolishness, feminine noun, from the noun TAFEL, foolish. TIPPELU, you will fall, future Kal, 2nd person masculine plural, root נָפַל. TIFLATSTEKHA, your terror, feminine noun TIFLATSAT, with suffix; root פָּלַץ, to tremble. TIFLATAM, their prayer, feminine noun with suffix; TEFILLOT, prayers, feminine plural, no. TEFILLAH; root פָּלַל, he judged. TIFEN, you will turn, or she will turn (apocopated for TIFNEH); TIFNU, you (plural) will turn, future Kal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular, and 2nd masculine plural; root פָּנָה. TIFEM, you were shaken, or she was; future Niphal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root פָּעַם. TAPPIK, you will bring out, or he will bring out, for TAPPIK, future Hiphil, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root יָצָא, or פּוֹק. TIPPAKED, you will be visited, or he will be visited; future Niphal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root פָּקַד. TIPPAKHU, you will be opened, or they will be opened; future Niphal, 2nd or 3rd person plural; root פָּקַח. TAPPAR, you will be made void, or it will be made void, for TIPPER, future Hophal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root פּוּר. TAPHRI, you will make void, future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine plural; root פּוּר. TIFRES, you will spread out, or he will spread out; future Piel, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root פָּרַשׂ. TEFATTEH, you will entice, or she will entice; future Piel, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root פָּתָה. TIPPATACH, you will open yourself, or she will open herself; future Niphal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root פָּתַח. TEETZE, you will go out, or it will go out; TETZEI, you (feminine) will go out, future Kal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular, and 2nd masculine plural; root יָצָא. VATOTZII, and you led out, or she led out; future Hiphil, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root יָצָא. TATZUR, you will hunt, or it will hunt; future Kal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root צוּר. TEZAVVEH, you will command, or she will command; future Piel, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root צָוָה. TZUMI, you will fast, future Kal, 2nd person masculine plural; root צוּם. TATZUR, you will besiege, or he will besiege; future Kal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root צוּר. TITZRI, you will guard, or she will guard, for TITZAR; and TITZORNAH, they will guard, for TITZARNAH; future Kal, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular, and 3rd person feminine plural; root נָצַר. TATZIVENI, he will set me, or she will set me; future Hiphil, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular with suffix; root יָצַב. TATZIG, you will set, or she will set; future Hiphil, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular; root יָצַג. TATZIL, you will rescue, or she will rescue; TATZILENI, me; future Hiphil, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular with suffix; root נָצַל. TETZINAH, they will be laid waste; future Kal, 3rd person feminine plural; root נָצָה. TATZITU, you will set on fire; future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine plural; root יָצַת. TETZALLENAH, they will ring, for TETZALLENAH; future Kal, 3rd person feminine plural; root צָלַל; or rather it is future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine plural; root צָלַל. TITZALLENAH, they will ring (Jer. 19.3), for TITZALLENAH; future Niphal, 3rd person feminine plural; root צָלַל. TITZPENAH, you will watch, or they will watch; future Kal, 2nd or 3rd person plural feminine; root צָפָה. TITZPETZEF, you will chirp, or she will chirp; future Piel, 2nd masculine or 3rd feminine singular, doubled; root צפף. root קיא. תִּקַּל it will be light, Gen. 16. 4, for תִּקַּל; imperfect Niph., 3rd fem. sing. fem.; root קלל. תִּקַּלֶּה it will be cursed; imperfect Pual, 3rd fem. sing. fem.; root קלל. תָּקִים you will raise, or he will raise, for תָּקִים;
