units.tr: & pl. f. aff. Rad. רוּם

units.la: No. f. f. aff. R. רָמָה pro-jecit.
units.tr: Noun, fem. sing., with suffix; root [רָמָה], he cast.

units.la: תְּרַמְּסֶנָּה conculcabuntur, pro תְּרַמַּסְנָה, fut. Niph. 3. pl. f. Rad. רָמַס.
units.tr: [תְּרַמְּסֶנָּה] they will be trampled, for [תְּרַמַּסְנָה]; fut. Niph., 3rd pl. fem.; root [רָמַס].

units.la: תִּרְמֹשׂ conculcabit, pro תִּרְמֹס, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. f. Rad. רָמַס.
units.tr: [תִּרְמֹשׂ] he will trample, for [תִּרְמֹס]; fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem.; root [רָמַס].

units.la: [?]וְתָרֶן & cantabis, vel bit,
units.tr: [וְתָרֶן] and you will sing, or she will sing.

units.la: תִּרְנֶּה cantabitis, vel bunt, fut. Kal, 2. s. m. vel 3. s. f. & 2. vel 3. pl. f. R. רָנַן.
units.tr: [תִּרְנֶּה] you will sing, or she will sing; you (pl.) will sing, or they will sing; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem., and 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [רָנַן].

units.la: תִּרְנָה sonabit, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. R. רָנָה.
units.tr: [תִּרְנָה] she will sound; fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem.; root [רָנָה].

units.la: תִּרְנִין facis, vel facit ut cantent, fut. Hiph. 2. s. m. vel 3. s. f. תִּרְנַנָּה cantabitis, vel bunt, vel contracte תִּרְנָּנָה fut. Piel, 2. vel 3. pl. f. R. רָנַן.
units.tr: [תִּרְנִין] you make or she makes (them) sing; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem. [תִּרְנַנָּה] you will sing, or they will sing, or contracted [תִּרְנָּנָה]; fut. Piel, 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [רָנַן].

units.la: תָּרְנָם malus suus, f. m. aff. No. Rad. תָּרֶן malus, arbor navis.
units.tr: [תָּרְנָם] its mast; noun, masc., with suffix; root [תָּרֶן], mast, the mast of a ship.

units.la: תָּרַע malefacies, vel et, [?]וַתָּרַע & malefecisti,
units.tr: [תָּרַע] you will do evil, or and (she will); [וַתָּרַע] and you did evil.

units.la: vel cit, תָּרַע malefacietis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. s. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. רוּעַ.
units.tr: or she will; [תָּרַע] you (pl.) will do evil; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. fem. or 3rd sing. fem., and 2nd pl. masc.; root [רוּעַ].

units.la: תַּרְעָלָה horror, No. f. f. Rad. רָעַל horrere.
units.tr: [תַּרְעָלָה] horror; noun, fem. sing.; root [רָעַל], to shudder.

units.la: תַּרְעֵם intonabis, fut. Hiph. 2. sing. masc. Rad. רָעַם.
units.tr: [תַּרְעֵם] you will thunder; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc.; root [רָעַם].

units.la: תִּרְעֵם confringes eos, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. תָּרַע, aff. Rad. רָעַע.
units.tr: [תִּרְעֵם] you will break them; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. masc./fem., [תָּרַע] with suffix; root [רָעַע].

units.la: תָּרֶף remittas, vel tat, (apoc. pro תַּרְפָּה,) תַּרְפֵּנִי me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. s. f. aff. Rad. רָפָה.
units.tr: [תָּרֶף] you will release, or she will (apocopated for [תַּרְפָּה]); [תַּרְפֵּנִי] release me; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem., with suffix; root [רָפָה].

units.la: תִּרְפָּא curaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. s. m. vel 3. s. f. Rad. רָפָא.
units.tr: [תִּרְפָּא] you will be cured, or she will be; fut. Niph., 2nd sing. masc. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [רָפָא].

units.la: וַתִּרְפָּאנִי & curasti me, fut. Kal, 2. s. m. aff. Rad. רָפָא.
units.tr: [וַתִּרְפָּאנִי] and you cured me; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. masc., with suffix; root [רָפָא].

units.la: תִּרְפָּנָה remittebatis, vel bant, fut. Piel, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. רָפָה.
units.tr: [תִּרְפָּנָה] you were remitting, or they were remitting; fut. Piel, 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [רָפָה].

units.la: תִּרְפָּנָה remissæ eritis, vel erunt, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. רָפָה; vel (pro תִּרְפָּאנָה medicantur,) Rad. רָפָא.
units.tr: [תִּרְפָּנָה] you will be slack, or they will be slack; fut. Kal, 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [רָפָה]; or (for [תִּרְפָּאנָה] they are healed) root [רָפָא].

units.la: תִּרְפַּשׁ conturbabis, E-zech. 32. 2. pro תִּרְפֹּס, & תִּרְפְּשׁוּן conculcatis, Ezech. 34. 18. pro תִּרְפְּסוּ, fut. Kal, 2. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. רָפַס.
units.tr: [תִּרְפַּשׁ] you will trouble (Ezek. 32. 2), for [תִּרְפֹּס]; and [תִּרְפְּשׁוּן] you trample (Ezek. 34. 18), for [תִּרְפְּסוּ]; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. fem. and 2nd pl. masc.; root [רָפַס].

units.la: תִּרְיץ confringet, תָּרִיץ celeriter extendit, (pro תָּרִיץ, ) fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. Rad. רָצַץ vel רוּץ.
units.tr: [תִּרְיץ] she will break; [תָּרִיץ] she extends quickly (for [תָּרִיץ]); fut. Hiph., 3rd sing. fem.; root [רָצַץ] or [רוּץ].

units.la: וַתָּרֶץ & atteritur, Eccl. 12.6. & curres, וַתָּרֻץ & concussisti, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. רָצַץ, vel רוּץ.
units.tr: [וַתָּרֶץ] and it is crushed (Eccl. 12. 6); and you run; [וַתָּרֻץ] and you shook; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [רָצַץ] or [רוּץ].

units.la: תָּרִין acquiesces, vel et, (apoc. pro תִּרְצָה,) fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. רָצָה.
units.tr: [תָּרִין] you will acquiesce, or and (apocopated for [תִּרְצָה]); fut. Kal, 2nd sing. fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [רָצָה].

units.la: תִּרָצְחוּ occidemini, Pf.62. 4. pro תִּרְצְחוּ, fut. Pual, pl. m. Rad. רָצַח.
units.tr: [תִּרָצְחוּ] you will be slain (Ps. 62. 4), for [תִּרְצְחוּ]; fut. Pual, pl. masc.; root [רָצַח].

units.la: תִּתְפַּשׁ scrutatus sum, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. תּוּר.
units.tr: [תִּתְפַּשׁ] I searched; perf. Kal, 1st sing.; root [תּוּר].

units.la: ת ש
units.tr: Tav-Shin

units.la: תִּשְׂאִי portabis, vel bit, תִּשָּׂאִי portabitis, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: [תִּשְׂאִי] you will carry, or she will carry; [תִּשָּׂאִי] you (pl.) will carry; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem., and 2nd pl. masc.; root [נָשָׂא].

units.la: תַּשָּׂא, vide תַּשֵּׂה.
תִּשְׁאָה vastaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁאָה.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁאָה] you will be laid waste, or she will be; fut. Niph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [שָׁאָה].

units.la: תִּשְׁאוּ decipiatis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁאוּ] you will deceive; fut. Hiph., 2nd pl. masc.; root [נָשָׂא].

units.la: תִּשְׁאוֹת fragores, No. pl. f. Rad. שָׁאָה vastari.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁאוֹת] crashes; noun, fem. pl.; root [שָׁאָה], to be laid waste.

units.la: תִּשָּׂאנָה tollent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: [תִּשָּׂאנָה] they will lift; fut. Kal, 3rd pl. fem.; root [נָשָׂא].

units.la: תַּשְׁאִיר reliquum facies, vel et, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁאַר.
units.tr: [תַּשְׁאִיר] you will leave a remnant, or she will; or and; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [שָׁאַר].

units.la: תִּשֶּׂאנָה portabunt, Ruth. 1. 14. fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: [תִּשֶּׂאנָה] they will carry (Ruth. 1. 14); fut. Kal, 3rd pl. fem.; root [נָשָׂא].

units.la: תִּשְׁאֵר relinqueris, vel tur,
units.tr: [תִּשְׁאֵר] you will be left, or she will be left.

units.la: תִּשְׁאֲרֽנָה relinquemini, vel eritur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שָׁאַר.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁאֲרֽנָה] you (pl.) will be left, or they will be left; fut. Niph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem., and 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [שָׁאַר].

units.la: תָּשֵׁב reduces, pro תָּשִׁיב, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שׁוּב.
units.tr: [תָּשֵׁב] you will bring back (for [תָּשִׁיב]); fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem.; root [שׁוּב].

units.la: תֵּשֵׁב habitabis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. יָשַׁב.
units.tr: [תֵּשֵׁב] you will dwell, or she will dwell; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [יָשַׁב].

units.la: תַּשְׁבִּירֵנִי, vel, תַּשְׁבְּרֵנִי vendes mihi, Deut. 2. 28. pro, תַּשְׁפִּיר לִי ; fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁבַר.
units.tr: [תַּשְׁבִּירֵנִי] or [תַּשְׁבְּרֵנִי] you will sell me (Deut. 2. 28), for [תַּשְׁפִּיר לִי]; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem., with suffix; root [שָׁבַר].

units.la: תַּשְׁבִּית cessare facies, תַּשְׁבִּיתוּ facietis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁבַת.
units.tr: [תַּשְׁבִּית] you will make cease; [תַּשְׁבִּיתוּ] you (pl.) will make cease; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. fem. and 2nd pl. masc.; root [שָׁבַת].

units.la: תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ captivum tenebit te, fut. Kal, 3. sing. f. aff. Rad. שָׁבָה.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁבֶּךָּ] she will hold you captive; fut. Kal, 3rd sing. fem., with suffix; root [שָׁבָה].

units.la: תָּשְׁבֻּנָה restitueetis, vel ent, pro תָּשִׁבְנָה, fut. Hiph. 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב.
units.tr: [תָּשְׁבֻּנָה] you (pl.) will restore, or they will restore (for [תָּשִׁבְנָה]); fut. Hiph., 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [שׁוּב].

units.la: תָּשְׁבֻּנָה, vel תָּשֻׁבְנָה revertemini, vel tur, & pro eo, תָּשְׁבִּינָה, & תָּשְׁבֻּנָה, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב.
units.tr: [תָּשְׁבֻּנָה], or [תָּשֻׁבְנָה] you (pl.) will return, or it will return; and for it [תָּשְׁבִּינָה] and [תָּשְׁבֻּנָה]; fut. Kal, 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [שׁוּב].

units.la: תִּשְׁבַּע jurabis, vel bit, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַע.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁבַּע] you will swear, or she will swear; fut. Niph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [שָׁבַע].

units.la: תִּשְׁבַּר confringes, vel get, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַר.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁבַּר] you will break, or she will break; fut. Piel, 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [שָׁבַר].

units.la: תִּשְׁבַּר frangeris, vel tur, pro תִּשָּׁבֵר, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַר.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁבַּר] you will be broken, or she will be broken (for [תִּשָּׁבֵר]); fut. Niph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [שָׁבַר].

units.la: תִּשְׁבְּרֶנָּה exspectabitis, fut. Piel, 2. pl. f. Rad. שָׁבַר.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁבְּרֶנָּה] you (pl.) will wait; fut. Piel, 2nd pl. fem.; root [שָׁבַר].

units.la: תִּשְׁבֹּת quiesces, vel cet, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f.f. Rad. שָׁבַת.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁבֹּת] you will rest, or she will rest; fut. Kal, 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [שָׁבַת].

units.la: תִּשְׁגּוּ errabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. שָׁגָה.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁגּוּ] you (pl.) will err; fut. Kal, 2nd pl. masc.; root [שָׁגָה].

units.la: תִּשְׁגֶּיא augebis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁגָא: vel pro תִּשְׁגֶּה fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁגָה.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁגֶּיא] you will increase; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem.; root [שָׁגָא]; or for [תִּשְׁגֶּה], fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem.; root [שָׁגָה].

units.la: [illegible, ~6 letters] facies ut evescat, Jes. 17. 11. fut. Piel gem. 2. f. f. Rad. שָׁנָה crescere.
units.tr: [illegible, ~6 letters] you will make it grow (Isa. 17. 11); fut. Piel, doubled, 2nd sing. fem.; root [שָׁנָה], to grow.

units.la: תִּשָּׁנְלָה vitiabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. fæm. Rad. שָׁגַל[?].
units.tr: [תִּשָּׁנְלָה] they will be defiled; fut. Niph., 3rd pl. fem.; root [שָׁגַל][?].

units.la: תַּשְׁגַּנִי errare facias me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. תַּשְׁגָּה aff. Rad. שָׁנָה.
units.tr: [תַּשְׁגַּנִי] you make me err; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem., with suffix (for [תַּשְׁגָּה]); root [שָׁנָה].

units.la: תִּשְׁדַּד vastabis, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. R. שָׁדַד.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁדַּד] you will lay waste; fut. Piel, 2nd sing. masc.; root [שָׁדַד].

units.la: תַּשָּׁה mutuo dederis, vel, cum א, pro ה, תַּשָּׁא, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. נָשָׂה.
units.tr: [תַּשָּׁה] you will lend; or, with א for ה, [תַּשָּׁא]; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem.; root [נָשָׂה].

units.la: תָּשׁוּב reverteris, vel tur, pro תָּשׁוּב, & תְּשׁוּבְנָה revertemini, vel tentur, pro תְּשׁוּבְנָה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שׁוּב.
units.tr: [תָּשׁוּב] you will return, or it will be turned (for [תָּשׁוּב]); and [תְּשׁוּבְנָה] you (pl.) will return, or they will be turned (for [תְּשׁוּבְנָה]); fut. Kal, 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem., and 2nd or 3rd pl. fem.; root [שׁוּב].

units.la: תְּשׁוֹבֵב redire facies, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. R. שׁוּב.
units.tr: [תְּשׁוֹבֵב] you will cause to return; fut. Piel, 2nd sing. masc./fem.; root [שׁוּב].

units.la: לִתְשׁוּבָה in reditu,
units.tr: [לִתְשׁוּבָה] in return.

units.la: תְּשׁוּבֹתֵיכֶם responsiones vestræ, No. f. f. תְּשׁוּבָה, constr. præf. & pl. f. aff. Rad. שׁוּב reverti.
units.tr: [תְּשׁוּבֹתֵיכֶם] your answers; noun, fem., from [תְּשׁוּבָה], construct with prefix, and fem. pl. with suffix; root [שׁוּב], to return.

units.la: תְּשַׁוֶּה æquabis, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. R. שָׁוֶה, Piel, שָׁוֶה.
units.tr: [תְּשַׁוֶּה] you will make equal; fut. Piel, 2nd sing. masc./fem.; root [שָׁוֶה], Piel [שָׁוֶה].

units.la: תְּשַׁוֶּה adæqueris, fut. Kal, תְּשַׁוֶּה æquabis, vel bit, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & תַּשְׁוּו æqua-bitis, 2. pl. m. Rad. שָׁוֶה.
units.tr: [תְּשַׁוֶּה] you will be made equal; fut. Kal; [תְּשַׁוֶּה] you will make equal, or she will make equal; fut. Hiph., 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; and [תַּשְׁוּו] you (pl.) will make equal; 2nd pl. masc.; root [שָׁוֶה].

units.la: תְּשׁוֹכְכֵנִי texisti me, Job. 10. 11. pro תְּסוֹכְכֵנִי, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. סָכַךְ.
units.tr: [תְּשׁוֹכְכֵנִי] you have covered me (Job 10. 11), for [תְּסוֹכְכֵנִי]; fut. Piel, 2nd sing. masc./fem., with suffix; root [סָכַךְ].

units.la: תְּשׁוֹמֵם desolationem accerses tibi, Eccl. 7. 17. est forma comp. ex תִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם, fut. Hithp. & ex תְּשַׁמֵּם, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁמַם.
units.tr: [תְּשׁוֹמֵם] you will bring desolation upon yourself (Eccl. 7. 17); it is a compound form of [תִּשְׁתּוֹמֵם], fut. Hithpael, and of [תְּשַׁמֵּם], fut. Niph., 2nd sing. masc./fem.; root [שָׁמַם].

units.la: תִּשְׁמַע vociferaberis, vel bitur, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁעַע, Piel שַׁעֵּע.
units.tr: [תִּשְׁמַע] you will cry out, or she will cry out; fut. Piel, 2nd sing. masc./fem. or 3rd sing. fem.; root [שָׁעַע], Piel [שַׁעֵּע].

units.la: תְּשׁוּעָה salus, תְּשׁוּעָתְךָ tua, No. f. f. תְּשׁוּעָה, constr. aff. Rad. יָשַׁע salvavit, sed forma, quasi à Rad. שוע vociferari. תְּשׁוּפֶנּוּ conteres ipsi, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. תָּשׁוּף, aff. Rad. שוף. תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ appetitus ejus, No. f. f. תְּשׁוּקָה, aff. Rad. שוק appetivit. וּתְשׁוּרָה & munus, No. f. f. Rad. שור cantavit. תְּשׁוּרִי contemplaberis me, תְּשׁוּרֶנּוּ eum, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. & 2. f. m. תָּשׁוּר aff. R. שור. הָשְׁחָה incurvata erit, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. שחה. תִּשְׁחָדִי munerata es, pro תִּשְׁחֲדִי, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. Rad. שָׁחַד muneravit. תִּשָּׁחֵטִי jugulaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁחַט. הַתִּשָּׂחֵק an ludes, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. praef. Rad. שָׂחַק. תִּשְׁחַר tempestive quaeres, vel ret, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁחַר. תִּשְׁחַת perderis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. Rad. שָׁחַת. תָּשִׁ oblitus es, Deut. 32. 18. pro תָּשֶׁה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. נָשָׁה. תָּשִׁיב reduces, vel cet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שׁוּב. תָּשִׁיבוּ reducetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. R. שׁוּב. וּתְשִׁיבוּ reduxistis, pro תּוֹשִׁיבוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. שׁוּב. תְּשִׁיבֵנִי reduces me, תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ nos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּב. תָּשִׁיג assequeris, vel tur, תָּשִׁיגוּם assequemini eos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. pl. m. aff. Rad. נָשַׂג. תָּשִׂיחַ colloquetur tecum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. f. תָּשִׂיחֵךְ aff. Rad. שׂוּחַ. תַּשִּׁיךְ facias ut mordeat, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. נָשַׁךְ. תָּשִׂים pones, תְּשִׁימֵנִי me, תְּשִׁימֻנוּ nos, תָּשִׂימוּ ponetis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. & 2. pl. m. Rad. שׂוּם. תָּשִׁיר cantabis, vel bit, תָּשִׁירוּ cantabitis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. fing. fæm. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. שׁוּר. תָּשֵׂשׂ gaudebis, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. R. שׂשׂ. תָּשִׁית pones, תָּשִׁיתוּ ponetis, תְּשִׁיתֵהוּ pones eum, תְּשִׁיתֵהוּ eos, תְּשִׁיתֵנִי me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. & pl. m. ut & 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּת. תִּשְׁכַּבְנָה concubitu violabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. fæm. Rad. שָׁכַב. תִּשָּׁכַח oblivioni traderis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁכַח. תִּשְׁכִּים surges mane, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁכַם. תַּשְׁכֵּן habitare facies, pro תַּשְׁכִּין, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁכַן. תִּשְׁכֹּנָּה habitabitis, vel bunt, pro תִּשְׁכֹּנָּנָה, fut. Kal, 2. vel 3. pl. f. Rad. שָׁכַן. תִּשְׁכְּרִי inebriabis te, fut. Kal, 2. f. f. R. שָׁכַר. תִּשְׁלֶג nivesces, vel cet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁלַג. תַּשְׁלָה errare facies, vel faciet, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁלָה. תִּשְׁלוּ spoliabitis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. שָׁלַל. תִּשָּׁלוּ errabitis, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. R. שָׁלָה. תַּשְׁלִימֵנִי perficies me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁלַם. תִּשְׁלְכִי abjicieris, pro תָּשְׁלִכִי, fut. Hoph. 2. f. f. Rad. שָׁלַךְ.
units.tr: Techuah, salus; tekuathkha, tua: a noun feminine, feminine, tekuah, in the construct with suffix. From the root yasha, he saved, but the form seems to come from the root shua, to cry out. Tishupenno, you will crush him: future Kal, second person masculine singular, tashuph, with suffix; from the root shuph. Tishuqatho, his desire: a noun feminine, tishuqah, with suffix; from the root shuq, he desired. Uthshurah, and gift: a noun feminine; from the root shur, he sang. Tishuri, you will contemplate me; tishurenno, you will contemplate him: future Kal, second person feminine singular and second person masculine singular, tashur, with suffix; root shur. Hashchah, will be bowed down: future Niphal, third person feminine singular; root shachah. Tishchadi, you will be bribed, for tishchaladi: future Kal, second person feminine singular; root shachad, he bribed. Tishachtei, you will be slaughtered, or he will be: future Niphal, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular; root shachat. Hatishchaq, will you play: future Piel, second person masculine singular, with prefix; root sachaq. Tishchar, you will seek early, or he will: future Piel, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular; root shachar. Tishchat, you will be destroyed, or he will be: future Niphal, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular; root shachat. Tashi, you have forgotten, Deut. 32. 18, for tashe: future Kal, second person masculine singular; root nashah. Tashiv, you will bring back, or he will: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular; root shub. Tashibu, you will bring back: future Hiphil, second person masculine plural; root shub. Uthshibu, you have brought back, for toshibu: future Hiphil, second person masculine plural; root shub. Tashibeni, you will bring me back; tashibenu, us: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular, with suffix; root shub. Tasig, you will overtake, or he will; tasigum, you will overtake them: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular, and second person masculine plural, with suffix; root nasag. Tasiach, he will speak with you: future Hiphil, third person feminine singular; tasichekh, with suffix; root suach. Tashik, you will make him bite: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular; root nashak. Tasim, you will place; tashimeni, you will place me; tashimenu, us; tasimu, you will place: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular with suffix, and second person masculine plural; root sum. Tashir, you will sing, or he will; tashiru, you will sing: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular, and second person masculine plural; root shur. Tasesh, you will rejoice: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular; root shush. Tashit, you will place; tashitu, you will place; tashitehu, you will place him; tashitehu, them; tashitenni, me: future Hiphil, second person feminine and plural masculine, and second person masculine singular with suffix; root shut. Tishkavnah, they will be violated by lying with them: future Niphal, third person plural feminine; root shachav. Tishachach, you will be forgotten, or he will be: future Niphal, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular; root shachach. Tashkim, you will rise early in the morning: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular; root shakam. Tashken, you will make to dwell, for tashkin: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular; root shakan. Tishkonah, they will dwell, or they will, for tishkonanah: future Kal, second or third person plural feminine; root shakan. Tishkeri, you will be made drunk: future Kal, second person feminine singular; root shakar. Tishleg, you will be melted as snow, or he will: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular; root shalag. Tashlah, you will make to err, or he will: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular; root shalah. Tishlu, you will plunder: future Kal, second person plural masculine; root shalal. Tishalu, you will err: future Niphal, second person plural masculine; root shalah. Tashlimeni, you will perfect me: future Hiphil, second person masculine singular with suffix; root shalam. Tishlekhi, you will be cast down, for tashlikhi: future Hophal, second person feminine singular; root shalakh.

units.la: תָּשֵׂם apponēs, vel net, pro תָּשֵׂם, vel תָּשִׂים; fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שׂוּם.
units.tr: Thou shalt set (or: he shall set), or "you will put" / "he will put" — the form תָּשֵׂם for תָּשִׂים, future Hiphil, second person masculine singular or third person feminine singular, from the root שׂוּם.

units.la: תָּשַׁם desolabitur, Gen. 47.19. pro תָּשַׁם, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. יָשַׁם.
units.tr: It shall be laid waste (or: it will be desolate), Gen. 47.19, for תָּשַׁם, future Kal, third person feminine singular, from the root יָשַׁם.

units.la: תִּשְׁמְאִילוּ sinistram petetis, pro תִּשְׁמְאִילוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. שְׂמֹל.
units.tr: You will go to the left, for תִּשְׂמְאִילוּ, future Hiphil, second person plural masculine, from the root שְׂמֹל.

units.la: תִּשְׁמְרוּן perdemini, fut. Niph. 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. שָׁמַר.
units.tr: You will perish, future Niphal, second person plural masculine, with paragogic letter, from the root שָׁמַר.

units.la: תִּשְׁמֹן apponetis, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. parag. pro תָּשִׁימוּ; Rad. שׂוּם.
units.tr: You will set (or: you will appoint), future Hiphil, second person plural masculine, with paragogic letter, for תָּשִׁימוּ; from the root שׂוּם.

units.la: תִּשְׁמוֹרִם custodiet eos, Prov.14.3. pro תִּשְׁמְרֵם, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. aff. Rad. שָׁמַר. Vide clav. Hebr.
units.tr: She will keep them, Prov. 14.3, for תִּשְׁמְרֵם, future Kal, third person feminine singular, with suffix, from the root שָׁמַר. See the Hebrew clavis.

units.la: תִּשְׁמְטֶנָּה dimittes eam, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שָׁמַט.
units.tr: You will let her go, future Kal, second person feminine singular, with suffix, from the root שָׁמַט.

units.la: תַּשְׁמִיעַ promulgabis, pro תִּשְׁמַע, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁמַע.
units.tr: You will proclaim, for תִּשְׁמַע, future Hiphil, second person feminine singular, from the root שָׁמַע.

units.la: תִּשְׁמַע audieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁמַע.
units.tr: You will be heard (or: it will be heard), future Niphal, second person feminine singular or third person feminine singular, from the root שָׁמַע.

units.la: תִּשְׁמָר cavebis, vel bit, תִּשְׁמְרוּ cavebitis vobis, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. שָׁמַר.
units.tr: You will beware (or: she will beware), future Niphal, second person feminine singular or third person feminine singular; תִּשְׁמְרוּ, you will beware for yourselves, second person plural masculine; from the root שָׁמַר.

units.la: תִּשְׂנָא odio habebis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׂנֵא.
units.tr: You will hate, future Kal, second person feminine singular or third person feminine singular, from the root שָׂנֵא.

units.la: תִּשָּׂאנָה extollent, Zach. 5. 9. pro תִּשְׂאנָה, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. Rad. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: They will lift up, Zech. 5.9, for תִּשְׂאנָה, future Kal, third person feminine plural, from the root נָשָׂא.

units.la: תִּשְׁנוּ diversi eritis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. Rad. שָׁנָה.
units.tr: You will be different, future Kal, second person plural masculine, from the root שָׁנָה.

units.la: תִּשְׁעָה, תִּשְׁעַת novem, תִּשְׁעִים nonaginta, תִּשְׁעִי nonus, תִּשְׁעִית nona, No. f. m. constr. & pl. comm. ut & No. f. m. & fæm. omnia à No. Rad. f. f. תִּשַּׁע novem.
units.tr: Nine, nonaginta (ninety), ninth, ninth (feminine): the construct and common plural forms, and the masculine and feminine numerals, all from the numeral; root feminine form תִּשַּׁע, nine.

units.la: תִּשְׁעֶה desistes, תִּשְׁעֶנָּה re-spicient, fut. Kal, 2. f. 2. f. m & 3. pl. f. Rad. שָׁעָה תִּשָּׁעֶה? innititor, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁעַן תִּשְׁעַשְׁעוּ lætificabimini, fut. Pual, 2. pl. m. Rad. שָׁעָה, in Piel, geminatis duabus primis Rad. שַׁעְשַׁע, & in Pual, שֻׁעְשַׁע וַתַּשְׁקֵּה? & bibendum dedit, Gen. 49.18. pro רַתַּשְׁקֵה?, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. fæm. apoc. Rad. שָׁקָה, Hiph. הִשְׁקָה וַתִּשַּׁק & osculata est, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. Rad. נָשַׁק הַשְׁקֵם adaquabis eos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. תַּשְׁקֵה?, aff. Rad. שָׁקָה וַתַּשְׁקֵה? & appetis eam, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. שַׁק? וַתָּשַׁר & cecinit, Jud. 5. 1. pro תָּשִׁיר, fut. Kal, vel pro תָּשִׁר, sive תָּשִׁר, fut. Hiph. 3. s. f. Rad. שׁוּר וַתִּשְׂרָי & contemplaris, fut. Kal, 2. s. f. Rad. שׁוּר תִּשָּׂרֵךְ comburetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. f. Rad. שָׂרַךְ תִּשְׁרַשׁ eradicabis, vel bit, fut. Piel, תְּשָׁרֵשׁ facies, vel faciet radicare, fut. Hiph. 2. s. m. vel 3. s. f. à præt. Piel, שֵׁרֵשׁ, & No. Rad. שֹׁרֶשׁ radix. וַתְּשָׁרְתֵהוּ & ministrabit ei, fut. Piel, 3. s. f. aff. à Rad. in Piel, שֵׁרַת תָּשֶׁת pones, vel ponet, pro תָּשִׂית, fut. Hiph. 2. s. m. vel 3. s. f. Rad. שׂוּם תִּשְׁתֶּה bibes, vel bibet, apoc. pro תִּשְׁתֶּה, תִּשְׁתּוּ bibetis, fut. Kal, 2. s. m. vel 3. s. f. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. שָׁתָה תִּשְׁתַּחְוֶה dejiciet se , fut. Hithp. 3. & 2. f. f. Rad. שָׁחָה , Hithp. הִשְׁתַּחְוֶה [?], vel הִשְׁתַּחֲוֵי [?]. תִּשְׁתַּחֲוִי dejicies te , fut. Hithp. 3. & 2. f. f. Rad. שָׁחָה , Hithp. הִשְׁתַּחֲוִי [?]. וַתִּשְׁתַּחְו & incurvavit se , pro תִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ , atque id , apoc. pro תִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה [?]. תִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ incurvabitis vos , pro תִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה , & תִּשְׁתַּחְווּ , fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. & 2. pl. m. à Rad. שָׁחָה , in praet. Hithp. הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה [?], pro הִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה [?]. תִּשְׁתַּכְּרִין ebriam ages , pro תִּשְׁכְּרִי , fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. parag. Rad. שָׁכַר , in Hithp. הִשְׁתַּכֵּר [?]. תִּשְׁתָּהּ stupeto , apoc. pro תִּשְׁתָּעֶה , fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׁעָה respex-is , Hithp. הִשְׁתָּעֶה [?] ob-stupescere. תִּשְׁתַּפֵּךְ effundet se , fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. שָׁפַךְ , in praet. Hithp. הִשְׁתַּפֵּךְ [?]. תִּשְׁתָּר principatum sumas , fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. שָׂרַר , in praet. Hithp. הִשְׂתָּרֵר [?]. ת ת תָּת dare , לָתֵת ad dan-dum , est contractum , pro תֵּת , praef. & cum aff. תְּהוּ eum , מִתְּהוּ à dare me , Infin. Kal, praef. aff. Rad. נָתַן. תִּתְאַבְּלוּ lugebitis , fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. אָבַל. תִּתְאֶה determinabitis , Num. 34. 7. pro תִּרְאֶה [?], fut. Piel, 2. pl. m. Rad. תָּוָה , Piel, תִּוָּה ; vel fut. Piel, ab ipsa Rad. תָּאָה [?]. תִּתְאַוֶּה concupiscies , apoc. pro תִּתְאַוֶּה [?] ; fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. אָוָה , in Hithp. תִּתְאַוֶּה [?]. תִּתְאַפֵּק continebis te , fut. Hithp. 2. sing. m. Rad. אָפַק [?]. תִּתְבּוֹנְנוּן intelliges, תִּתְבּוֹנְנוּ etis, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. & 2. pl. m. Rad. בּוֹן, in Piel, בּוֹנֵן, & Hithp. הִתְבּוֹנֵנוּן. תִּתְבַּלַּע absorbeatur, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. בָּלַע. תִּתְבָּר purum te exhibes, 2 Sam. 22. 27. pro תִּתְבָּרֵד, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. בָּרַד. תִּתְגּוֹרְדִי incides te, תִּתְגּוֹרְדוּ incidetis vos, fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. גָּרַד. תִּתְנַעֵשׁ commovebitur, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. נָעַשׁ. תִּתְנֵר miscebis te, apoc. pro תִּתְנֶרָה, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. נָרָה. תַּתָּה dedisti, 2. Sam. 22. 41. pro נְתַתָּה, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. aphær. literæ Nun & parag. Rad. נָתַן. תִּתְהַדַּר honorem tibi arroges, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. הָדַר. תִּתְהַלֵּל gloriaberis, vel tur, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. הָלַל. תִּתְהַפַּךְ mutaberis, vel mutabitur, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. הָפַךְ. תִּתּוֹם consumetur, Gen. 47. 18. pro תָּתוֹם, fut. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. תָּמַם. תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ renovas, vel vat se, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. חָדַשׁ. תִּתְחַטָּאוּ purgatote vos, fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. חָטָא. תִּתְחַכָּם sapiens eris, fut. Hithp. 2. sing. m. Rad. חָכַם. תִּתְחַלְחָל dolore affecta est, תִּתְחוֹלֵל exspecta, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. & 2. f. m. Rad. חוֹל, in Piel ad formam Poel, חוֹלֵל & formæ gem. חֻלְחַל, unde Hithp. הִתְחוֹלֵל, & הִתְחַלְחֵל.
units.tr: tiš'eh, desistes; tiš'enna, respicient: future Kal, 2nd person feminine singular and 3rd person feminine plural, from the root שָׁעָה. tiš'āh, innititor [I lean upon]: future Niph., 2nd person feminine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, from the root שָׁעַן. tiš'a'šə'ū, lætificabimini [you will rejoice]: future Pual, 2nd person plural masculine, from the root שָׁעָה; in Piel the two first radicals are doubled, שַׁעְשַׁע, and in Pual שֻׁעְשַׁע. wattašqēh, and he gave to drink, Gen. 49.18, for ותשקה: future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine singular apocopated, from the root שָׁקָה, Hiphil הִשְׁקָה. wattišsaq, and she kissed, future Kal, 3rd person feminine singular, from the root נָשַׁק. hašqēm, you will water them: future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular, with the suffix. tišqēhā, and you desire her: future Piel, 2nd person feminine singular, with suffix, from the root שָׁקַק. wattāšar, and she sang, Judg. 5.1, for תָּשִׁיר: future Kal, or for תָּשִׁר or תָּשִׁר, future Hiphil, 3rd person feminine singular, from the root שׁוּר. wattiśrē, and you contemplate: future Kal, 2nd person feminine singular, from the root שׁוּר. tiśśāraḵ, it shall be burned: future Niph., 3rd person feminine singular, from the root שָׂרַךְ. tišraš, you will uproot, or it will be: future Piel. tešārēš, you will make, or she will make to take root: future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, from the preterite Piel שֵׁרֵשׁ, and the noun שֹׁרֶשׁ, root. wattešāratēhū, and she will minister to him: future Piel, 3rd person feminine singular, with suffix, from the root שֵׁרַת. tāšeṯ, you will place, or she will place, for תָּשִׂית: future Hiphil, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, from the root שׂוּם. tišteh, you will drink, or she will drink, apocopated for תִּשְׁתֶּה; tištū, you will drink: future Kal, 2nd person masculine singular or 3rd person feminine singular, as also 2nd person plural masculine, from the root שָׁתָה. tiš'taḥweh, it will bow itself down: future Hithpael, 3rd person and 2nd person feminine singular, from the root שָׁחָה, Hithpael הִשְׁתַּחְוֶה [?]. tiš'taḥăwî, you will cast yourself down: future Hithpael, 3rd person and 2nd person feminine singular, from the root שָׁחָה, Hithpael הִשְׁתַּחֲוִי [?]. wattišt'aḥw, and she bowed herself, for תִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ, and this apocopated for תִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה [?]. tišt'aḥăwû, you will bow yourselves, for תִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה and תִּשְׁתַּחְווּ: future Hithpael, 2nd person feminine masculine or 3rd person feminine feminine and 2nd person plural masculine, from the root שָׁחָה, in the preterite Hithpael הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה [?], for הִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה [?]. tišt'akkərîn, you will make drunk, for תִּשְׁכְּרִי: future Hithpael, 2nd person feminine feminine with paragogic letter, from the root שָׁכַר, in Hithpael הִשְׁתַּכֵּר [?]. tištāh, you will be astonished, apocopated for תִּשְׁתָּעֶה: future Hithpael, 2nd person feminine masculine, from the root שָׁעָה; you look, Hithpael הִשְׁתָּעֶה [?], to be astonished. tišt'appēḵ, it will pour itself out: future Hithpael, 3rd person feminine feminine, from the root שָׁפַךְ, in the preterite Hithpael הִשְׁתַּפֵּךְ [?]. tiš'tār, you will assume principality: future Hithpael, 2nd person feminine masculine, from the root שָׂרַר, in the preterite Hithpael הִשְׂתָּרֵר [?].

units.la: תִּתְחַמְּקִין subduces te, pro [?]קִין, fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. parag. Rad. חָמַק.
units.tr: תִּתְחַמְּקִין, you will slip away, for [?]קִין, future Hithpael, second person feminine singular, paragogic, from the root חָמַק.

units.la: תִּתְחַסֵּד benignum te ex-hibebis, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. חָסַד.
units.tr: תִּתְחַסֵּד, you will show yourself kind, future Hithpael, second person feminine singular masculine, from the root חָסַד.

units.la: תִּתְחַקָּה imprimeris, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. חָקָה.
units.tr: תִּתְחַקָּה, you will be imprinted, future Hithpael, second person feminine singular masculine, from the root חָקָה.

units.la: תִּתְּחָךְ ira accenderis, apoc. pro תִּתְחָרֶה, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. חָרָה.
units.tr: תִּתְּחָךְ, you will be inflamed with anger, apocopated for תִּתְחָרֶה, future Hithpael, second person feminine singular masculine, from the root חָרָה.

units.la: תִּתְחָרָה miscebis te, Jer. 12. 5. pro תִּתְחַר, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. Rad. תָּחַר.
units.tr: תִּתְחָרָה, you will mingle yourself, Jer. 12.5, for תִּתְחַר, future Piel, second person feminine singular masculine, from the root תָּחַר.

units.la: תִּתְחַתָּן affinitate junges te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. חָתַן.
units.tr: תִּתְחַתָּן, you will join yourself by marriage, future Hithpael, second person feminine singular masculine, from the root חָתַן.

units.la: תַּתִּיכֵנִי fundes me, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. aff. Rad. נָתַךְ.
units.tr: Tittikeni, "you will pour me out" (fut. Hiph. 2nd pers. f. m., with suffix; root נָתַךְ).

units.la: תִּתְיַמְּרוּ summe praedica-bitis, Jef. 61. 6. pro תִּתְאַמְּרוּ, fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. אָמַר.
units.tr: Tithyammeru, "you will proclaim most loudly" (Isa. 61:6, for תִּתְאַמְּרוּ; fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. pl. m.; root אָמַר).

units.la: תִּתְיַפַּח anhelat, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. יָפַח.
units.tr: Tithyapah, "she pants" (fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. f. sg.; root יָפַח).

units.la: תִּתִּיפִי reddes te pulchram, fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. Rad. יָפָה.
units.tr: Tittifi, "you will make yourself beautiful" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. sg.; root יָפָה).

units.la: תִּתִּיצַב sistes te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. יָצַב.
units.tr: Tittitseb, "you will set yourself" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root יָצַב).

units.la: תִּתַּךְ effunderis, vel tur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָתַךְ.
units.tr: Tittak, "you will be poured out," or "it will be poured out" (fut. Kal, 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root נָתַךְ).

units.la: תִּתְּכוּ fundemini, fut. Hoph. 2. pl. m. Rad. נָתַךְ.
units.tr: Tittekhu, "you will be poured out" (fut. Hoph. 2nd pers. pl. m.; root נָתַךְ).

units.la: וַתִּתְכַּס & operuit se, a-poc. pro תִּתְכַּסֶּה, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. כָּסָה.
units.tr: Vattitkas, "and she covered herself" (apocopated for תִּתְכַּסֶּה; fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. f. f.; root כָּסָה).

units.la: תִּתְלוֹצְצוּ derideatis, fut.
units.tr: Tithlotsetsu, "you may mock" (fut.

units.la: Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. רוּן[?].
units.tr: Hithp. 2nd pers. pl. m.; root רוּן[?]).

units.la: תַּתִּם integrum exhibes, Job. 22. 3. pro תַּתִּם fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. Rad. תָּמַם.
units.tr: Tattim, "you will show the whole" (Job 22:3, for תַּתִּם; fut. Hiph. 2nd pers. f. m.; root תָּמַם).

units.la: תֹּתַּם, vel תְּתַּם consume-ris, vel tur, pro תָּתַּם, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. תָּמַם.
units.tr: Tottam, or Tettam, "you will be consumed," or "it will be consumed" (for תָּתַּם; fut. Kal, 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root תָּמַם).

units.la: תִּתְמַה miraberis, vel tur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. תָּמַהּ.
units.tr: Titmah, "you will wonder," or "it will wonder" (fut. Kal, 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root תָּמַהּ).

units.la: תִּתְמּוֹגַג dissolvat se ipsam, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. מוּג.
units.tr: Titmog, "she will dissolve herself" (fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. f. f.; root מוּג).

units.la: תִּתְמוֹגְגֶנָה colliquescent, pro תִּתְמוּגַּגְנָה, fut. Hithp. 3. pl. f. Rad. מוּג.
units.tr: Titmoguggena, "they will melt" (for תִּתְמוּגַּגְנָה; fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. pl. f.; root מוּג).

units.la: תִּתְמֶךָּ tenebis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. תָּמַךְ.
units.tr: Titmekha, "you will hold," or "she will hold" (fut. Kal, 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root תָּמַךְ).

units.la: תִּתַּמֶּם integrum exhibes te, Psal. 18. 26. pro תִּתְתַּמֵּם, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. תָּמַם.
units.tr: Tittammem, "you will show yourself whole" (Ps. 18:26, for תִּתְתַּמֵּם; fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root תָּמַם).

units.la: תִּתַּן dare, 1. Reg. 17. 14. pro תֵּת, Infin. Kal, pro תֵּתָן, cum Nun redund. Rad. נָתַן.
units.tr: Tittan, "to give" (1 Kings 17:14, for תֵּת, infinitive Kal, for תֵּתָן, with redundant Nun; root נָתַן).

units.la: תִּתֵּן dabis, תִּתְּנוּ dabitis, תִּתְּנִי dabis, f. תִּתְּנָהּ dabis eum, תִּתְּנֵנוּ nos, תִּתְּנֶנּוּ eum, תִּתְּנִנִי me, fut. Kal, 2. f. & pl. m. & 2. f. f. ut & 2. f. m. cum aff. Rad. נָתַן.
units.tr: Tittén, "you will give"; tittenu, "you will give" (pl. m.); titténi, "you will give" (f. sg.); tittenah, "you will give her" (f.); tittenenu, "you will give us"; tittenenu, "you will give him"; tittennini, "you will give me." These are the future forms: 2nd pers. f. and pl. m., 2nd pers. f. f., and 2nd pers. f. m. with suffixes (root נָתַן).

units.la: תִּתְנוֹדֵד commoves te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. נָדַד, vel נוֹד; & utriusque Piel, est נוֹדֵד.
units.tr: Titnodedu, "you will move yourself" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root נָדַד, or נוֹד; and the Piel of either is נוֹדֵד).

units.la: תִּתְנַחֲלוּ possessionem adibitis, fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. נָחַל.
units.tr: Titnakhalu, "you will come into possession" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. pl. m.; root נָחַל).

units.la: תִּתְנַקָּם ultionem sumeres, vel ret, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. R. נָקַם.
units.tr: Titnaqqam, "you would take vengeance," or "she will take vengeance" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root נָקַם).

units.la: תִּתְנַשָּׂא attolles, vel let se, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. נָשָׂא.
units.tr: Titnasa, "you will lift yourself up," or "she will lift herself up" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root נָשָׂא).

units.la: תִּתְעֶה aberrabis, apoc. pro תִּתְעֶה, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. תָּעָה. תִּתְעַב abominaberis, vel tur, fut. Piel, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. תָּעַב, in Piel, תִּעֵב. תִּתְעַטָּף obruetur, fut. Hithp. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. עָטַף. תִּתְעַלְּמ abscondes te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. עָלַם. תִּתְעַלָּפְנָה [?] obteget se, תִּתְעַלָּפְנָה animo deficient, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. & 3. pl. f. Rad. עָלַף. תִּתְעַמֵּר uteris ad quæ-stum, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. R. עָמַר. תִּתְעַנֶּנּוּ oblectabis te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. à Rad. עָנַג. תַּתְעֵנוּ errare facies nos, fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. תַּתְעֵה, aff. Rad. תָּעָה. תִּתְעָרֵב miscebis te, vel bit, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. עָרַב. תִּתְעָרֵ nudabis te, fut. Hithp. 2. f. f. R. עָרָה. תִּתְעַרֶּר nudabitur, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. gem. duabus primis radicalibus, pro תִּתְעָרָה, Rad. עָרָה. תִּתְפַּתָּל elucłaberis, 2. Sam. 22. 27. contr. pro תִּתְפַּתָּל, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. פָּתַל. תִּתְפַּלָּא mirificum te exhibebis, pro תִּתְפַּלָּא, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. פָּלָא. תִּתְפַּלָּל orabis, vel orabit, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. פָּלַל. תִּתְפַּעַם consternata erit, fut. Hithp. 3. f. f. Rad. פָּעַם. תִּתְפֹּשׂ prehendes, vel det, fut. Piel, & תִּתְפֹּשׂ capieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. sing. fæm. Rad. תָּפַשׂ. וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ & prehendes eum, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. תָּפַשׂ. תִּתְפַּתָּל elucłaberis, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. R. פָּתַל. תִּתְצַב stabit, Exod. 2.4. pro תִּתְיַצֵּב, fut. Hithp. 3. s.f. Rad. יָצַב. תִּתּוֹצוּ diruetis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. נָתַץ. תִּתְקְעוּ clangetis, fut. Kal, 2. pl. m. R. תָּקַע. תִּתְקַּפְּחוּ prævalebis ei, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. תָּקַף. וַתֹּתַר & reliquum faciat, fut. Hiph. 3. s.f. Rad. יָתַר. תִּתְרָאוּ aspicietis vos in-vicem, fut. Hithp. 2. pl. m. Rad. רָאָה. תִּתְרַע amicitiam coles, Prov.22.24. apoc. pro תִּתְרָעָה, fut. Hithp. 2. f. m. Rad. רָעָה. וַתְּהַשׁ & evulsa fuit, fut. Hoph. 3. s.f. R. נָתַשׁ.
units.tr: Titeh, "you will go astray" (apocopated for תִּתְעֶה; fut. Kal, 2nd pers. f. m.; root תָּעָה). Titab, "you will be abhorred," or "it will be abhorred" (fut. Piel, 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root תָּעַב; in Piel, תִּעֵב). Titatef, "it will be overwhelmed" (fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. sg. f.; root עָטַף). Titalem, "you will hide yourself" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root עָלַם). Titalmekha, "she will cover herself," or Titalappena, "they will faint" (fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. f. f. and 3rd pers. pl. f.; root עָלַף). Titammer, "you will use for gain" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root עָמַר). Titanneno, "you will delight yourself" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; from root עָנַג). Tatenu, "you will make us err" (fut. Hiph. 2nd pers. f. m., from תַּתְעֵה, with suffix; root תָּעָה). Titarev, "you will mingle yourself," or "it will be mingled" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root עָרַב). Titar, "you will make yourself naked" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. f.; root עָרָה). Titarer, "she will be made naked" (fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. f. f., doubled in the first two radicals, for תִּתְעָרָה; root עָרָה). Titpattal, "you will be shown to be crooked" (2 Sam. 22:27, contracted for תִּתְפַּתָּל; fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root פָּתַל). Titpalla, "you will show yourself wonderful" (for תִּתְפַּלָּא; fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root פָּלָא). Titpallal, "you will pray," or "she will pray" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. f. f.; root פָּלַל). Titpa'am, "she will be dismayed" (fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. f. f.; root פָּעַם). Titpos, "you will seize," or "it will be seized" (fut. Piel, and Titpos, "you will be captured," or "she will be captured" (fut. Niph. 2nd pers. f. m. or 3rd pers. sg. f.; root תָּפַשׂ). Vattitpeshehu, "and you will seize him" (fut. Kal, 2nd pers. f. m., with suffix; root תָּפַשׂ). Titpattal, "you will be shown to be crooked" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root פָּתַל). Tittzav, "it will stand" (Exod. 2:4, for תִּתְיַצֵּב; fut. Hithp. 3rd pers. s. f.; root יָצַב). Titto'u, "you will tear down" (fut. Kal, 2nd pers. pl. m.; root נָתַץ). Titq'u, "you will blow" (fut. Kal, 2nd pers. pl. m.; root תָּקַע). Tittaqqeppehu, "you will prevail against him" (fut. Kal, 2nd pers. f. m., with suffix; root תָּקַף). Vattottar, "and she will leave a remainder" (fut. Hiph. 3rd pers. s. f.; root יָתַר). Titra'u, "you will see one another" (fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. pl. m.; root רָאָה). Titra', "you will cultivate friendship" (Prov. 22:24, apocopated for תִּתְרָעָה; fut. Hithp. 2nd pers. f. m.; root רָעָה). Vattehash, "and it was plucked up" (fut. Hoph. 3rd pers. s. f.; root נָתַשׁ).

repay [הַשְׁלֵם], imperative aphel, root [שלם]; to destroy [לְהַשְׁמִידָהּ], infinitive aphel with prefix and suffix, root [שמד]; to change [לְהַשְׁנִיא] or [הָשְׁנָיא], infinitive aphel with prefix, root [שנא]; units.tr: יבנון they will build, future peh. Root בנה. יִבְעָא he will seek, future peh. יִבְעֶן they will seek, future pah. Root בעה. יִבְקַשׁ he will inquire, future pah. Root בקר. יְבֶשְׁתָּא dry land, noun fem. Root יבש. יַר heap, noun masc. fem.; Root יָד hand: יָדְךָ your; כְּיָדְךָ into your hand; יָדָהּ her; בְּיָדָם in their hands; בְּיַד in the hands; יָדִי my, noun fem. and pl. with suffix and prefix. Root יד. וַיַּרְדְּחִלֻנִי and he terrified me, future pah. Root דוחל. יָדַע he knew; יָדְעָה you knew; יָדַעְתִּי I knew, perfect; יָדַע knowing; יֹדְעִים knowing, participle present fem. and pl. constr.; יָדַע known, participle perfect peh. Root ידע. יִשְׁכְּנוּ they will dwell, 3rd future peh. with redundant letter. Root ישׁב. יָהַב he gave; יְהַבְתָּ you gave; וַיִּתְּנוּ and they gave, perfect; יָהָבוּ giving; יָהֵב giving, participle present peh.; יְהָב about to give; יְהִיבַת was given; יְהִיבוּ were given, perfect passive pehil. Root יהב. יוֹבְדוּן they will destroy, aph. future 3rd pl. Root אבד. יְהוֹדֶה he will declare, future aph. Root הוה. יוֹדִיעַ he will make known; יוֹדִיעֵנִי to me; יוֹדִיעוּן they will make; יוֹדִיעֻנִי to me, future fem. and pl. with suffix, aphel. Root ידע. וַיָּהֵךְ and let him go [?]; וַיָּהֵךְ and let him arrive, future peh. Root הוך. יְהוּדָה Judea; יְהוּדָיִן Jews, noun fem. and pl. abs. and emph. Root יהד. יְהַעֲבִירוּן they will transfer, future aph. Root עבר [?]. יְהָקִים he will establish, future aph. Root קום. יְהַשְׁפִּיל he will bring low, future Aphel with characteristic letter. Root שפל. יום, יומא, יומין, יומיא day; יומי days; בימי in the days; יומיהן their days; יומת days, noun masc. fem. and pl. abs. emph. constr. prefix. suffix and pl. fem. constr. Root יום. יהוני he will declare to me; יהונה it; יהחוה he will declare, future pah. with suffix and future aph. with expressed ה. Root הוה. יחיטו they will join, future aph. Root חוט. יהלפון they will pass by, future peh. Root חלף. יחסנון they will possess, future aph. or peh. Root חסן. יטעמון they will give to taste; יטעמונה to him, future pl. and suffix pah. Root טעם. יטב it will seem good, future peh. Root יטב. יכלה was he able; יכלתי you were able, perfect with prefix; יכיל able; יכלה she is able; יכלין they can, participle prefix masc. fem. and pl.; יוכל he may be able, future peh. Root יכל. ילבש he will be clothed, future peh. Root לבש. ימא sea, noun fem. emph. Root ימ[?]. ימנר he will cast down, future Pah. Root מגר. ימחא he will strike, future pah. Root מחא. ימטא he will reach, future peh. Root מטא. ימלל he will speak, future pah. Root מלל. ינרעון they will know, future peh. Root ידע. ינתן he would give; ינתנון they will give, future peh. fem. and pl. Root נתן. יסכר he will think, future peh. Root סבר. יסגדון he will worship; יסגדון they will worship, future fem. and pl. peh. Root סגד. יעדה he will pass by, future peh. Root עדה. יעטוהי his counsellors, noun pl. with suffix. Root יעט[?]. יִפֹּל he will fall, future peh. Root נפל. יִפְלְחוּן they will serve, future peh. 3rd pl. masc. Root פלח. יִצְבָּא he will be willing, future peh. Root צבא. יִצְבַּע let him be dyed, future Ithpahel with metathesis and change of ת into ט. Root צבע. יִצֵּב, יִצִּבָה, יִצִּבָא truly, truth, noun fem. Root יצב. לִיקְדַת[?] into the burning; אֲיִקְדָתָא, יִקְּדָה, noun fem. constr. prefix and emph. Root יקד. וִיקַבְּלוּן and they will receive, future pah. Root קבל. יְקוּם let him rise; יְקוּמוּן they will rise; יְקִים he will raise up; future fem. and pl. peh. and sing. aphel. Root קום. יְקַר glory; יִקַּר[?] to glory; יְקָרָא glory; יְקָרָה precious, noun masc. fem. prefix emph. and noun adj. Root יקר. יִקְרָא he will read; יִקְרוּן they will read, future fem. and pl. peh. Root קרא. יָרַח month; יְרָחִין months, noun fem. and pl. Root ירח. יְרַכְתֵּהּ his thigh, noun fem. suffix; אֲיִרְכָּה, Root ירך. יִשְׁאֲלִנְכוֹן he will ask of you, future peh. with epenthetic ג and suffix. Root שאל. יִשְׁגֵּא he will increase, future peh. Root שגא. יִשּׁוּבְךָ he will rescue you; יִשּׁוּבְנוֹן you, future pah. and suffix. Root שוב. יִשְׁכְּנָן they will dwell, future pl. fem. peh. Root שכן. יִשְׁלַח he will stretch out, future peh. Root שלח. יִשְׁלַט he will rule, future peh. Root שלט. יִשְׁמַע he will hear; יִשְׁתַּמְעוּן they will listen, future peh. and Ithpah. with metathesis.
